items.de: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follo
items.dz: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水

items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ。支持 OneBot 11/12、Satori、Milky 与 QQ 官方机器人接口，群聊和私聊各有一条独立会话；内置九个工具：群管理、聊天记录与图片理解、联网搜索、网页抓取、图片反搜、生图等，另有按间隔自主接话的主动发言（判断与发言可分用两个模型）。模型、代理、白名单等全部在 DSH 设置页里配置，不需要改代码。首次使用必须先填拥有者 auth.owners：留空时插件不驱动任何会话（默认拒绝，避免装机即对外开放）；填好后私聊与群聊立即可用，访客只能使用访客工具白名单，qqbot 与 qqconfig 仅限拥有者。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

items.de: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact history, switch models, with streaming, markdown and approval forwarding. Access is not gated per user — anyone who can message the bot cont
items.dz: 通过 QQ（官方 Bot API v2，仅单聊）远程控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话与工作区：列出/切换工作区、新建会话、压缩历史、切换模型，支持流式输出、Markdown 与审批转发。未做按用户门禁——任何能给该机器人发消息的人都能控制这些会话，消耗你的模型额度与文件权限。

items.de: Cheap enough to leave running in a QQ group all day. The lite reply mode bypasses the full agent loop and calls chat completions directly: about ¥0.0027 per turn, roughly ¥0.2 for 80 turns a day, around 75x cheaper than a full DSH session. Still includes switchable persona cards, image and video und
items.dz: 便宜到能天天泡在群里：lite 模式绕过完整 agent 会话、直连 chat completions，一轮约 ¥0.0027，一天 80 轮也就 ¥0.2 出头，比走完整 DSH 会话便宜约 75 倍。同时带可切换人格卡、图片与视频理解、自动打标签的群图素材库、群聊冷存储检索；SSH 一键部署到远程主机，含环境体检、不落密钥的配置生成、systemd 单元与看门狗。内置引擎 fork 自 Derpyu520/qq-bridge（MIT）；请勿在已运行上游桥接的主机上重复部署。

items.de: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
items.dz: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

items.de: Full upstream REA 6.4.0 integration over the official DSH MCP bridge: all 170 tools, the version-matched reverse-engineering skill, and the six original MCP prompts with argument completions reachable from the composer / menu, all sharing one REA process and complete structured Evidence. External an
items.dz: 通过 DSH 官方 MCP 桥接接入原版 REA 6.4.0：完整 170 个工具、同版本原版逆向 Skill，以及输入框 / 菜单里的六个原版 MCP prompts 与参数补全，共用同一个 REA 进程并保留完整结构化 Evidence。外部分析引擎需自行配置。

items.de: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
items.dz: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

items.de: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session
items.dz: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

items.de: Promo studio panel for DSH plugins: type a plugin name, match it to a case file and render a promo film and poster locally. The bundled Remotion template pipeline works from the npm package; the real-UI (V0.1) pipeline also needs a local Onetake runtime and the repository checkout, otherwise the pan
items.dz: DSH 插件宣传台面板：输入插件名称，匹配案例文件，在本机渲染宣传片与海报。npm 包内置的 Remotion 模板管线可直接用；真机界面（V0.1）管线还需要本机 Onetake 运行时和仓库源码，否则面板提示环境未就绪。DSH 工具 reel_scan、reel_plan、reel_render 仍是脚手架。需要 Node.js 22+ 与 Chrome 或 Chromium。

items.de: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
items.dz: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

items.de: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an
items.dz: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay 两种传输穿 NAT，两侧都有 Web 面板。

items.de: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and a remote host running Linux or macOS.
items.dz: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

items.de: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH
items.dz: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

items.de: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
items.dz: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

items.de: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
items.dz: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

items.de: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result
items.dz: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

items.de: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
items.dz: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

items.de: Sword Art Online theme with two Link Start animations and Kirito/Asuna voices; full or startup-only mode; independent light/dark accents, theme and surface colours, local fonts, accent-tinted glass settings with 220ms sliding selectors, optimized scrolling and theme transitions; liquid/frosted glass
items.dz: 刀剑神域主题：双 Link Start 启动动画与桐人／亚丝娜语音，可选全部功能或仅限启动动画；明暗主题色独立记忆、界面底色与本机字体、带主题色的玻璃设置及 220ms 平移选项，优化滚动和主题切换；液态／磨砂玻璃、分组件透明度与连续右栏／上下文背景；紧凑会话标签与单行状态读数；九张内置壁纸、本地图片或 4K／5K 循环视频及静态省电；模型思考强度滑条。

items.de: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
items.dz: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

items.de: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
items.dz: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
items.dz: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

items.de: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

items.de: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
items.dz: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

items.de: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
items.dz: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

items.de: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

items.de: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
items.dz: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

items.de: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
items.dz: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

items.de: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
items.dz: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

items.de: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
items.dz: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

items.de: Sessivra: drag sessions into resizable split views, insert native @ references into drafts, exchange linked replies and review delegated work before queued follow-ups. npm package dsh-plugin-sessivra.
items.dz: Sessivra：拖拽会话自由分屏、调宽，拖入草稿插入原生 @ 引用；支持关联回复、共享裁决、验收后继续排队任务及会话树。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-sessivra。

items.de: ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
items.dz: 把 ShaderToy 作品作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景：WebGL2 播放器 + 背景库（含 5 个预设），可调界面不透明度、亮度、分辨率与帧率，支持画面循环与音乐播放设置，并能在设置页直接编辑当前着色器代码。

items.de: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API
items.dz: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.
items.dz: 观察 agent 执行轨迹，在每个成功回合结束时按信号触发 LLM 评审，把值得复用的工作流结晶为已注册技能，并随后续运行持续改进。

items.de: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 技能生命周期管理：技能库（纯技能池）、工作区启用白名单、会话勾选三层模型；Web 设置面板与对话页内嵌视图，支持技能文件浏览/编辑、zip 与文件夹批量导入、引擎实际加载校验。

items.de: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan
items.dz: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

items.de: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight t
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供夜间自我进化：离线复盘过往会话，在你的 API 预算内重放高频任务，并把学到的技能凝练成经得起门禁验证的技能。把 microsoft/SkillOpt 的 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎带进 dsh，作为原生工具加内置技能——无需模型训练。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎(pip install skillopt)。

items.de: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.
items.dz: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

items.de: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
items.dz: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

items.de: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
items.dz: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

items.de: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
items.dz: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

items.de: Skin manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable whale button that restores the default look on left-click and switches between installed skins on right-click.
items.dz: DSH 网页皮肤管理器：可拖动的鲸鱼按钮，左键恢复默认界面，右键列出并切换所有已安装皮肤。

items.de: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.
items.dz: 光遇·遇境主题皮肤：星盘之上的光之子，烛火暖金与深蓝星空双主题，为 dsh WebUI 定制。

items.de: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
items.dz: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

items.de: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.
items.dz: 用图片做全屏开机动画：启动 HTML 首帧即铺满画面并缓慢推近，横向光带扫过，左下进度与阶段提示，应用挂载完成后淡出。点击任意处或按 Esc / 空格 / 回车可跳过。

items.de: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.

items.de: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of

items.dz: 四六级背单词悬浮窗：窗口可拖动、可最小化并记住位置；内嵌 ECDICT 提取的 5805 词；翻卡三键评分与形近词干扰的选择题；艾宾浩斯间隔复习、到期复习与加练；每日新词数可调；在线真人美/英发音，断网回落本地 TTS；另有「循环朗读」（只读单词/词+翻译/词→译→词，例句来自词典 API 与 Tatoeba 语料双渠道）。v0.2.4 新增「斩单词」（斩掉的词转入低频维护池，按 15/30/60 天抽查并可召回，不删除不毕业）、维护抽查角标，以及界面精修（设计令牌统一、减少重复边框、统一焦点与按压反馈、支持减少动态效果）。进度与窗口位置保存在浏览器配置里，更新不会覆盖。

items.de: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

items.de: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.

items.de: Create a chat with its own workspace in one click, so everyday questions and small tasks can start without manually choosing a project directory.
items.dz: 一键新建自带独立工作区的会话，让日常问答和小型任务无需手动选择项目目录即可开始。

items.de: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.
items.dz: 对话列宽度与位置调节、带序号与快捷键跳转的提问历史（支持自动加载更早提问），以及对话区和文件预览区的 Markdown 大纲目录。

items.de: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 15 cherry_* tools for agents, sessions, history and interactions, a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope, and an experimental subagent that delegates the way DSH's own subagent does (Claude Code /

items.de: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

items.de: Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.

items.de: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent pr

items.de: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
items.dz: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（上游分支，修复以适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1）：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度，以及一键还原原生界面的总开关。

items.de: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. items.dz: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

items.dz: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

items.de: Embeds chat.deepseek.com in a DSH desktop panel and moves text both ways round by round: pick any round of the web conversation and copy it, or send it as a user message into a session of a chosen workspace; and fill any answer of the current agent session back into the web input box without sending

items.de: Install it by asking DSH in one sentence, then it reads your local Codex CLI/Desktop chat history from ~/.codex/sessions and makes it usable inside DeepSeek Harness: a panel under the composer lists sessions with keyword and date filters and one-click import, the codex_history tool lets an agent lis

items.de: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
items.dz: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compac
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

items.de: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
items.dz: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

items.de: Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.
items.dz: DSH 输入框命令历史：按 ↑/↓ 浏览此前发送的指令，回到历史末尾时恢复原草稿；官方桌面端与 Web profile 均可用。

items.de: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
items.dz: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

items.de: Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion, and Alt+Up/Alt+Down candidate cycling.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web 界面的输入框提供 Tab 自动补全：下一条消息的灰色幽灵文本、草稿行内续写，以及 Alt+Up/Alt+Down 切换候选。

items.de: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy); file paths inside the card are highlighted and click-to-open with the OS default app, and a deliverables zone lists the fil
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），卡内文件路径高亮可点（系统默认应用打开），卡底按本回合真实工具产出汇总交付物；按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。

items.de: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
items.dz: 把本机 opencode serve 目录里的全部免费模型（覆盖所有 provider，含你自定义的 provider）接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，并禁用 OpenCode 原生工具，执行权留在 DSH。

items.de: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.

items.dz: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话

items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：每轮只注入「人设框架 + 相关记忆索引」，原文留在磁盘按需展开，不把整个库塞进上下文。事实层按槽位做冲突消解，改口后旧值自动失效；人设框架由模型从记忆里自行归纳，带三道防污染闸门（拒收开发流水、拦截自身注入的回流、同一件事按共享实词归并）。记忆周期性固化——合并近似重复、把大话题压成摘要、归档低价值旧条目，全程只打标签不删原文；追加式存储也会就地压缩（实测 4.7 MB → 355 KB）。零第三方依赖，无构建步骤。⚠️ 注意：每轮注入会不可避免地降低缓存命中率，请勿在工作场景使用。

items.de: Runtime plugin firewall for sessions started through its launcher (the DSH Desktop app cannot be injected and is not covered): filesystem, network and subprocess calls plugins make are attributed to the plugin that made them and judged against what that plugin declares, so a plugin doing its declare
items.dz: 运行时插件防火墙，仅覆盖经其启动器启动的会话（DSH Desktop 桌面应用注入不进去，不在覆盖范围）：插件发起的文件、网络、子进程调用会归属到发起它的插件，并用该插件自己声明的需求去衡量——本职范围内的行为零打扰，越出声明才被记录。归因是尽力而为，不是保证：覆盖不到的调用退回 host，不会被记到别的插件头上。附带装前体检卡（能力面、红线组合、PASS/WARN/BLOCK）、越界判定、可选的执行前拦截（含 credential-exfil 规则）、更新 diff 与隔离子进程试装、SARIF/CSV 审计导出与多源汇总。数据只存本机，无遥测；webhook 默认关闭。

items.dz: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏：按会话管理报告、图片、数据、视频与音频，提供内联预览、产物质检和可按轮次检索的历史目录。

items.de: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
items.dz: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

items.de: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
items.dz: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

items.de: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
items.dz: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

items.de: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
items.dz: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

items.de: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
items.dz: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

items.de: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailyt
items.dz: 本地长期日程面板:顶栏「日程」文字按钮、今天/本周/历史月历统计视图、完成打勾(按天记录历史)、日程↔会话链接点击跳转、重复日程(每天/每周)、一次性日程可选未完成自动顺延,以及 dailytask_* agent 工具。

items.de: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.
items.dz: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

items.de: Creates a throwaway workspace with its own folder and session, manages running ones from a sidebar panel, and moves finished folders to the system Trash.
items.dz: 一键创建一次性临时工作区（独立文件夹、独立工作区与会话），在侧边栏统一管理，用完把文件夹移入系统废纸篓。

items.de: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.
items.dz: 让视口外的聊天行与轨迹行不参与渲染，长会话滚动更稳；行高按实测保留，滚动条不跳，屏幕内画面不变。

items.de: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
items.dz: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

items.de: Adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar subagent questions and default-browser link opening to DSH. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and
items.dz: 为 DSH 增加划词批注、引用、划词翻译、侧边子代理提问，链接用默认浏览器打开。选中的原文连同评论随下一条消息交给模型，正文保留高亮与序号角标、可跳回原文；菜单可划词浮出或从右键打开，翻译可单独指定模型。

items.de: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
items.dz: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

items.de: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality)
items.dz: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

items.de: Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 已归档会话管理面板：按工作区目录分组、按标题实时搜索、只读预览用户问题、一键恢复，或二次确认后删除。

items.de: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
items.dz: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

items.de: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
items.dz: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

items.de: Adds Activity and Favorites views to the DSH sidebar for running, waiting, unread, recent, and natively pinned sessions across workspaces, while preserving the native workspace tree. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏添加 Activity 和 Favorites 视图，跨工作区查看运行中、等待回复、未读、最近及原生置顶会话，并保留原生工作区树。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

items.de: A plugin to completely delete sessions and clean up the associated files in the .dsh/sessions directory.
items.dz: 用于彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并同步清理 .dsh/sessions 目录下相关文件的插件。

items.de: Permanently deletes one session from the sidebar session menu, or several at once from the "..." menu beside the sidebar section title: tick sessions in the list (running ones are refused), then confirm in a dialog — log directory, workspace membership, live Host instances and the client list row ar
items.dz: 在侧栏会话行的「…」菜单里永久删除单个会话;也可从侧栏标题旁的「⋯」菜单进入批量删除:在列表里勾选会话(运行中的不能删),再在确认弹窗里一次删掉 —— 会话日志、工作区归属、宿主内存实例、客户端列表行一并清理。同一个「⋯」菜单还收着会话搜索与视图选项;另可清理日志已不存在的残留行,用户消息与 AI 回复的复制按钮右侧各有「重试」。

items.de: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
items.dz: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

items.de: Export the current session to portable, schema-versioned Markdown and JSON files via the `session_export` tool and slash commands, with cross-platform-safe filenames.
items.dz: 把当前会话导出为可移植、带 schema 版本的 Markdown 与 JSON 文件，提供 `session_export` 工具与斜杠命令两种入口，文件名跨平台安全。

items.de: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
items.dz: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

items.de: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word
items.dz: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

items.de: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windo
items.dz: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

items.de: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.
items.dz: 为 DSH 对话加入可搜索、按工作区分组的多选面板，支持 Shift 范围选择与 Ctrl/Cmd 追加选择，然后批量删除、归档或置顶。

items.de: Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for t
items.dz: 不用再翻日志，也能随时知道 DeepSeek Harness 的会话做到哪一步了：agent 维护一份实时嵌套清单——从整个阶段到单个步骤——每一项都带权重，所以输入框下方 dock 行的进度环与百分比胶囊始终反映真实进度。悬停可看当前活动，或打开原生右侧边栏的 Session Progress 标签页，查看目标、带单项占比的加权清单、后续步骤与工作备注；会话结束时，它就是一份清晰的工作记录。

items.de: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
items.dz: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

items.de: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
items.dz: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

items.de: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
items.dz: 在所有或指定工作区、会话中搜索已存储的 DSH 对话文本，支持精确、正则表达式、拼写容错及词内子序列匹配。

items.de: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
items.dz: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

items.de: Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost badges.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 会话用量面板：价格、token、每轮累计曲线，以及每个回答末尾的价格标记。

items.de: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, install
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里跨编码 Agent 继续工作：六个 sessionflow_* 工具查询 sessionFlow 构建的本地会话索引，找回过去的工作、看清当前项目做到哪了，并把目标、涉及文件与未完成事项交给下一个 Agent。需要另行安装独立的 sessionFlow 核心（见其 GitHub 仓库）。全程本地运行——无云端、无遥测。

items.de: Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.
items.dz: 让你选择 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧导航要显示哪些栏目。

items.de: ASCII sharks and schooling fish swim behind the DSH Web interface, with a settings page for veil opacity, shark count, size, fish density, swim speed and grid strength.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面背景中游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼与鱼群，设置页可调遮罩浓度、鲨鱼数量与体型、鱼群密度、游速和网格浓度。

items.de: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

items.de: A sidebar assistant plugin for the Web interface, allows users to select any text, displays the model’s reasoning process and final answer in a floating panel.
items.dz: Web 界面的侧边栏助手插件,在 Web 聊天界面里选中任意文本，在浮层面板里流式显示思考过程与最终答案。

items.de: Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.
items.dz: 在 设置 → 通用 里集中管理左侧全局面板图标：显示或隐藏、拖动排序；自带侧栏开关的插件，其开关与本插件保持同步。

items.de: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be route
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

items.de: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
items.dz: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

items.de: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit
items.dz: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的

items.de: Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.
items.dz: 侧边栏技能选择器：列出已安装技能并标注 Global 与所属 repo，支持本会话勾选与常驻默认启动、可选 Guard、Codex/Grok/Hermes 用户技能，以及 /skill 注入。

items.de: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web s
items.dz: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

items.de: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
items.dz: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

items.de: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

items.de: Skill index browser with search, custom alias editing, and chat-input skill insertion.
items.dz: 技能索引浏览器，支持关键词检索、自定义中文别名与输入框多技能快捷插入。

items.de: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
items.dz: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

items.de: Homepage-style chat background skin for DeepSeek Harness, ported line by line from deepseek.com/harness: WebGL fluid background (5-colour noise field, flow-field brush, light, bloom, vignette, grain), white 90px dot-line grid with mouse perturbation and spring return, and a digital point-cloud whale
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 首页风格聊天背景皮肤，对照 deepseek.com/harness 首页逐行移植：WebGL 流体背景（5 色噪声场、流场笔刷、光源、辉光、暗角、颗粒）、白色 90px 点线网格（鼠标扰动 + 弹簧回弹）、数字点云鲸鱼（粒子聚形、呼吸游动、鼠标径向推开、光标光束提亮）。仅深色主题生效，系统开启减少动态效果时自动停用。

items.de: Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.
items.dz: 皮肤切换器：右上角一键切换主题，自动发现社区皮肤。

items.de: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstal
items.dz: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

items.de: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
items.dz: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply/health 五工具），Socket Mode 免公网回调。

items.de: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag

items.dz: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

items.de: IM stand-in seat for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel polls Feishu/Lark, WeCom and DingTalk (switched on from the panel) through the platform CLI you are already logged in to, and wakes the DSH session you bound when a new message arrives, so that session reads it and replies as you — drafts are sh
items.dz: 把「替你值守 IM」做成 DSH 侧边栏的常驻席位：复用本机已登录的飞书/Lark、企业微信、钉钉（需在面板里先启用）CLI 按节奏拉取会话，新消息进来就唤醒你绑定的 DSH 会话，由它读上下文、以你本人的语气起草回复；默认先把草稿给你看，你明确说全自动才直接发出。群要你加进值守名单才开始轮询，且默认只有 @你 的消息唤醒 agent；屏蔽的会话永不拉取，消息正文只留在本机状态文件里，插件不开任何端口。

items.de: Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the or
items.dz: 在 dsh-pet 桌宠的右键菜单里增加「识屏模式」子菜单（开启、关闭、识别间隔 15、30、60、120 秒），把选择转发给 dafeiyu-screensense。dsh-pet 没有菜单扩展接口，因此本插件在其 renderer.js 末尾追加一段带标记的补丁，首次修改前备份为 renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak；补丁幂等，dsh-pet 重装后会自动补回。

items.de: Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble
items.dz: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠增加识屏模式：每 30 秒截取主屏，用 8×8 均值哈希比较画面，只在画面变化时（以及空闲间隔到点、即使没变化时）把截图交给当前会话模型，让桌宠用一句短气泡吐槽；另提供 /fish、/fish_look、/fish_screen 命令、status 与 control 两个 HTTP 接口，以及可在插件配置里调整的画面对比阈值与空闲重说间隔。仅 Windows（PowerShell WinForms）。

items.de: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.
items.dz: 将近期中文 Markdown 对话导出文件中的片段发送给 DeepSeek API（需 API key），生成一场梦境并保存为本地 Markdown 文件。

items.de: Daoist Canon (DaoZang) retrieval skill: keyword or semantic search over 285,117 scripture chunks with exact original-text extraction (line numbers, hit markers), and one-command workspace setup from the Godners/DaoZang dataset.
items.dz: 道藏知识库离线检索与原文提取：对 28.5 万段经文进行关键词或语义检索，精确提取原文（带行号与命中标记），可从 Godners/DaoZang 数据集一键搭建工作区。

items.de: Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.
items.dz: 为 dsh agent 提供安全且可审计的 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 访问：schema 内省、强制只读查询、写审批门与持久化 JSONL SQL 审计追踪。

items.de: DeepSeek balance and usage monitor for DSH: a corner widget showing topped-up balance, per-model period consumption, token breakdown, and a Beijing-time peak/off-peak price reminder. Add a DeepSeek API key in the settings first.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的余额与用量监控：右下角悬浮组件，显示充值余额、按模型的周期消耗、Token 明细，以及北京时间高峰/低谷价格提醒；需先在设置里填入 DeepSeek API key。

items.de: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话统计行下方新增彩色状态行，实时显示 DeepSeek API 费用、用量与账户余额，并带高峰/错峰计费指示。

items.de: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH'
items.dz: 把 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等外部 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）Agent 注册为 DSH 模型提供方：Agent 的 thought_level 选项映射为推理等级菜单，Agent 声明 promptCapabilities.image 时转发图片，权限请求走 DSH 原生审批框；附带 ACP Agents 设置页，可导入 Zed 的 agent_servers JSON 并发现模型。

items.de: Adds a Desktop card to the settings page that detects the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and launches it with one click.
items.dz: 在设置页加入「桌面端」卡片，检测 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用并一键唤起。

items.de: Evidence-first guard: warns the agent when it claims success without a matching tool-execution record in recent context.
items.dz: 证据铁律守卫：模型声称成功但上下文中没有对应工具执行记录时，自动注入警告。

items.de: Real-compute verification gates: math simplification, logic proofs, regex validation, E-prover FOL, state-machine checks, and code repair, backed by Go-compiled binaries with prebuilt Windows executables.
items.dz: 真实计算验证门：数学化简、逻辑证明、正则校验、E-prover 一阶逻辑、状态机检查与代码修复，由 Go 编译的二进制支撑（附 Windows 预编译产物）。

items.de: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
items.dz: 基于 BM25 关键词检索的记忆召回。

items.de: Traditional Chinese Medicine toolkit: eight-axes diagnosis and herb-pair lookup.
items.dz: 中医工具集：八纲辨证与药对查询。

items.de: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
items.dz: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

items.de: Run a read-only Dameng DM8 database inspection with 85 checks and produce an HTML report.
items.dz: 只读巡检达梦 DM8 数据库：85 项检查项，生成 HTML 报告。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 8.1.60.80 for network access

items.de: Port of pstack to DeepSeek Harness: 58 agent-workflow skills plus a deterministic router that picks each subagent model from the models you checked for subagents.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 pstack：58 个 agent 工作流技能，外加确定性路由器，按任务意图从你勾选的子 agent 模型池里选型。

items.de: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
items.dz: 视觉桥：纯文本 DeepSeek 也能收图（单独发、图文混发均可），快速小识图模型后台描述，对话框里图还在、模型只见文字；纯插件，卸载即复原。

items.de: Select a model and its reasoning effort in one drag with a two-dimensional grid.
items.dz: 使用二维网格，一次拖动同时选定模型与推理强度。

items.de: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
items.dz: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

items.de: Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
items.dz: 暂存精确的 DSH 工具调用而不执行，在持久化批量审查收件箱中展示完整规范参数；编辑或重启后审批失效，仅允许携带匹配 SHA-256 摘要与一次性 nonce 的批次通过 DSH 正常工具管线提交。

items.de: Adaptation packs for third-party DSH plugin panels on phones — 44px touch floor, width reclaim, shell hit targets and floating-widget clearance — loaded by the dsh-mobile plugin from its extensions directory (dsh-mobile must be installed for them to take effect), with a settings page that installs t
items.dz: 第三方 DSH 插件面板的手机适配包：44px 触控地板、宽度回收、外壳命中区与浮动控件让位；由 dsh-mobile 插件从其 extensions 目录加载（须先装 dsh-mobile 才会生效），附设置页一键装/卸与插件兼容清单。

items.de: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
items.dz: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

items.de: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
items.dz: 在隔离的 Git 工作树中比较编码智能体，并提供确定性验证、评分和显式胜者应用。

items.de: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.
items.dz: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

items.de: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
items.dz: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

items.de: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.
items.dz: 中文多智能体工作流，支持按角色配置模型回退、版本化 Mermaid 任务规划、独立 Agent 与 Jev 审核、专家持久化协作和纯函数计算工具。

items.de: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
items.dz: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

items.de: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
items.dz: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

items.de: VS Code-style local IDE for DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, explorer, search, Git, terminal, and language services. With pnpm, run `pnpm approve-builds --all` so the native build of node-pty is allowed.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 VS Code 风格的本地 IDE：Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、搜索、Git、终端与语言服务。用 pnpm 安装时需运行 `pnpm approve-builds --all`，允许 node-pty 的原生构建。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
items.dz: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

items.de: Filesystem permissions for shell calls, granted per path and capability rather than per command name. The command line is parsed for the read, write, create, delete and execute effects it needs, a capability it lacks raises the approval card instead of a flat refusal, and the same rules are compiled
items.dz: 按路径与能力（read / write / create / delete / execute）授予 shell 调用的文件权限，而不是按命令名判断。命令行的文件效果由解析得出，缺哪个能力就出审批卡片而不是一律拒绝，同一套规则还会编译成进程、它的子进程、以及命令行根本没露出来的代码共同运行其下的 macOS Seatbelt profile。会话里的「审批」标签页把审计日志读回来，显示每次判定是规则、自动复核还是人拍的板。

items.de: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-a
items.dz: DSH 会话指令定锚：新会话的第一个 step 把自由组合的指令块作为插件来源消息注入，之后在完成压缩、跨过设定轮数、或计量到的上下文压力越过阈值时重锚。`/anchor` 命令可按需定锚且不触发模型调用；设置页管理分页预设库、注入顺序、重锚来源与字数上限。

items.de: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SD
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 Android 开发工具链：23 个 android_* 工具负责探测 SDK、创建与管理 AVD、启停模拟器、生成 Kotlin/Compose 工程、用 Gradle 构建运行，并完成安装、启动、截图、logcat 与 UI 操作。设置页集中管理 SDK、模拟器、API 级别、构建与输出参数。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.android.com

items.de: Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.
items.dz: Google Antigravity 与 Cloud Code Assist 模型提供方插件，支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、沙箱端点容灾与多账号配额管理。

items.de: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
items.dz: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

items.de: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-clic
items.dz: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。

items.de: Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes fo
items.dz: 注册 apiCost 会话投影，按官方公布的峰谷价目表把上报的 token 用量折算成 ¥/$ 花费，覆盖本会话、委派树与经校验的团队三种范围：输入框下方的胶囊与其详情面板、/cost 命令、session_cost 工具，以及读取视图与当前价目表的 GET 路由。面板上的开关可在高峰时段把模型请求停在 llm/stream 上，待谷时窗口开启后原样派发，于是按谷时价计费，且会话中不会出现任何失败。

items.de: Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the
items.dz: 在审批卡片上加一个「解释」按钮：一次模型调用返回固定三行解读——做什么、读写改了什么、是否安全（风险等级加一句理由）。同时补上 `write`/`edit` 类调用详情区留白的问题——官方渲染器只读 `command` 字段，那两类调用没有该字段。

items.de: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set
items.dz: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

items.de: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
items.dz: 归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。

items.de: Deletes any DSH session from its sidebar row, in bulk, or through a settings panel — into a recoverable trash, with ghost entries pruned automatically.
items.dz: 会话删除：任意会话行上直接删、多选批量清空、从回收站还原，删和还原都立刻生效不用重启；僵尸条目自动清理.

items.de: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

items.de: Adds a resident system-prompt rule asking the assistant to report every file it produces as a full absolute path (a soft rule, not enforced), and replaces the official context menu on a file link with eight actions: open in the sidebar, open in a floating window, open with the default app, reveal in
items.dz: 常驻系统提示词规则，要求助手为每个产物给出完整绝对路径（软约束，不保证），并把文件链接上的官方右键菜单替换成八项：在侧边栏打开、在悬浮窗打开、用默认程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、另存为到指定位置、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框，产物一键分享给好友（复制文件与另存为仅 Windows）。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: An Artifacts tab in the DSH sidebar that lists the files an agent produced and previews them in place with live reload, plus artifact template tools for agents.
items.dz: DSH 侧栏里的 Artifacts 标签页：列出 agent 产出的文件并就地预览、支持实时刷新，另提供 artifact 模板工具。

items.de: Overhead conversation background with five whale species formed from custom text or ASCII, shaded cells, frosted content cards, input-box avoidance, independent dives, spouts, ripples, wind, and cloud shadows.
items.dz: 海面正上方俯视的对话背景，支持用自定义文字或 ASCII 组成五种鲸类，含彩色字格、内容框毛玻璃、输入框避让、独立下潜、喷水、尾拍涟漪、风纹与云影。

items.de: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.
items.dz: 对话旁的会话级便笺：会话右上角入口用角标显示未完成数量，点开是可拖拽调宽高的右侧面板，便笺可添加、勾选完成、复制、编辑和一键转发到输入框，面板尺寸与草稿保存在浏览器本地。

items.de: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
items.dz: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

items.de: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
items.dz: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

items.dz: 在对话头部加一个搜索按钮，结果显示在右侧栏；整段历史都能搜（不只是已加载的那部分），命中关键词在用户消息和 AI 回复里都标黄，点结果可跳转到对话中的位置。历史检索走宿主日志，所以全文索引被关闭时也能用。

items.de: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.

items.de: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up.
items.dz: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事后还查得到。不调用模型，也不改动对话内容。它不阻止压缩，拿不回已经被压掉的部分。

items.de: Context governance for DSH: folds oversized tool results, collapses the tool surface and keeps the prompt cache warm, so long sessions stop getting more expensive.

items.de: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
items.dz: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

items.de: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
items.dz: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

items.de: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
items.dz: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

items.de: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
items.dz: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

items.de: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

items.de: Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
items.dz: 将模糊或丰富的 DSH 交互状态实时推送到本地 Discord 客户端作为 Rich Presence——不携带任何工作区内容，状态消息列表可自由编辑，并可在设置中切换丰富模式。

items.de: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — reports where DSH disk usage goes and reclaims only what is safe to rebuild, always keeping the resources currently in use.
items.dz: DSH 磁盘清理插件：看清磁盘占用都花在哪，只清理可以安全重建的部分，正在使用中的资源始终保留。

items.de: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.
items.dz: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供持久自主循环、侧边栏 GitHub 插件发现、AI 安装和工作区快捷入口。

items.de: UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent customizable left Dock, cross-workspace pinned chats, a draft-first home, global search, a completion inbox and right-panel video previews.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻可自定义的左侧 Dock、跨工作区置顶会话、先写草稿的首页、全局搜索、完成通知收件箱，以及右侧文件面板视频预览。

items.de: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone, and any app notification can wake her; she installs apps herself and browses, likes and comments in apps such as Xiaoheihe or Bilibili; she has her own QQ (NapCat / SnowLuma, multi-part replies, stickers); memory
items.dz: 住在自己手机上的角色：插件自动安装并运行她的 Android 手机，任何 App 的新通知都能叫醒她；她自己装 App，逛小黑盒、B 站等并点赞评论；有自己的 QQ（NapCat / SnowLuma，分条回复、发表情包）；记忆含人物卡、每天 23:30 的日记和叫醒前的自动召回（默认本机 embedding，可切 SiliconFlow / DashScope）；两次对话之间的生活（幕间，按 HDS-Interlude）；可选 microVM 电脑带审批闸门。右侧栏有手机画面、虚拟机画面和 dot 面板；个人设置集中在 ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json，六个组件都能单独关闭。只有 `/

items.de: Runs a Douyin subagent that browses videos and reads comments in valley hours and reports back, with dy_* tools for publishing and replying (comments sent from the already-logged-in page with its own request signature, no IM ticket), a daily quota timer, and a settings panel under Settings → Douyin:
items.dz: 让子代理在谷时刷抖音、读评论并汇报；附带发作品/回评论的 dy_* 工具（评论从已登录页面带签名直发，不依赖 IM ticket）、每日配额定时，以及设置页「刷抖音」里的控制面板（总开关、自动模式、谷时窗口、每天轮数、报告详细度）。偏 Windows；搜索与评论依赖另装的 douyin-mcp 可执行文件（yunsur/douyin-mcp 的 Release，路径经 dy_config 的 mcpExe 设置）及 Edge/Chromium 登录；回评论需要开了 CDP 端口的已登录浏览器；发作品还需多数账号没有的额外凭据。

items.de: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

items.de: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the
items.dz: 按会话持久化输入框中尚未发送的附件：切页、切换会话乃至重启应用后回到该会话，草稿图片与文件会经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道自动恢复；消息发出或手动移除后不会再出现。

items.de: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
items.dz: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

items.de: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
items.dz: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

items.de: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
items.dz: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

items.de: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
items.dz: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

items.de: Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.
items.dz: 让 DSH 网页聊天支持拖拽任意类型文件：非图片文件保存到当前会话工作区，供 Agent 读取使用。

items.de: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about t
items.dz: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

items.de: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window err
items.dz: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在确实毫无产出的轮次补一条继续——整段调用写进正文且没有发出任何工具调用，或只剩闭合标签且正文近乎为空。上游抖动类错误会续跑，额度、限流、鉴权与上下文超限一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

items.de: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when the context crosses a size line or keeps growing. By default it requires DSH's experimental Session Search plugin (session_event_read / sess
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的分层上下文压缩插件：把旧轮次折成由模型撰写摘要的 L1–L3 块，在地图里显示每层占用与可压位置，并在占用越过提醒线或持续增长时叫醒模型决定是否压缩。默认需要启用 DSH 实验性插件「会话搜索」（session_event_read / session_event_search），否则 compress 与 context_map 会停用（可关闭 requireSessionQuery）。

items.de: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
items.dz: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

items.de: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.
items.dz: 原生推理档位控件：蓝紫渐变档位条，带星点与流光。它自己占用模型座位并只对接官方 modelDirectories 服务，档位由每个模型自身的 reasoning 声明决定，不依赖任何其它插件。

items.de: Per-model jailbreak armor: a Settings table arms model patterns with spells (25 spells: 20 across 11 model families, plus a model-agnostic armor, an upstream preferences file and three stackable persona layers), previews the exact injected block, and writes it into the armed model's system prompt on
items.dz: 按模型开启的破甲表：在设置里给模型匹配串挂上咒语（25 条：11 个模型族 20 条，另有 1 条通用破甲、1 份上游偏好文件和 3 条可叠加的人格层），可逐字预览注入块，只写进被开启模型的系统提示，其他模型完全不动。

items.de: Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
items.dz: 把 DSH 的运行错误与编程任务复盘渲染成可交互的 GPU 图谱，并把记录下来的教训送回模型上下文。

items.de: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
items.dz: 给 DSH 网页端与桌面端加一个 ETA 挂件：按 todo 清单与步进节奏估算本轮何时完成，显示剩余时长、进度条与置信度徽章。

items.de: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
items.dz: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

items.de: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only
items.dz: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。
rl: uses literal IP 1.1.0.37 for network access

items.de: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
items.dz: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

items.de: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
items.dz: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

items.de: Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.
items.dz: 用一套声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

items.de: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements)
items.dz: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

items.de: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
items.dz: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
items.dz: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

items.de: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.
items.dz: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

items.de: Scan and fix Low integrity labels, non-inherited S-1-4 sandbox ACEs, and related Everyone deny ACEs in DSH workspaces on Windows. Maps live DSH workspaces, defaults to read-only, repairs after confirmation, verifies the result, and keeps one replaceable ACL rollback record per workspace.
items.dz: 扫描并修复 Windows 上 DSH 工作区中的 Low 完整性标签、非继承 S-1-4-* 沙箱授权 ACE 及关联的 Everyone 拒绝项。按 DSH 实时工作区映射，默认只读，确认后修复并复扫校验；每个工作区保留一条可替换的 ACL 回滚记录。

items.de: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
items.dz: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

items.de: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.
items.dz: 屏蔽 agent 对指定文件或目录的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，使其内容不进入对话——含敏感词的文件也在其中，避免它们的文字让之后的 provider 请求以 400 失败。规则在插件页面上点选。

items.de: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
items.dz: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

items.de: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firew
items.dz: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

items.de: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
items.dz: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

items.de: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
items.dz: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

items.de: Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 插件组合分析工具：依赖树、冲突检测、风险评估（含预测）、可视化与组合模拟。

items.de: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its
items.dz: DSH 的 fork 伴随插件:官方 fork 发生后,把原会话的直接子 agent 复制到 fork 出的新对话下(递归复制整棵子树,副本经官方 agent API 创建),每个副本留在磁盘上成为可被官方恢复路径唤醒的冷会话——新对话保留子代理面板,并能继续给这些子代理发消息;原件仍留在旧分支。

items.de: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.
items.dz: AI填表智能体：支持自动填表、表格填充、表格补全、Excel填表与 Excel回填；使用企查查 MCP 填写 XLSX 空白字段，预览确认后导出新副本。

items.de: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
items.dz: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

items.de: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys an
items.dz: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
items.dz: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

items.de: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
items.dz: dsh 第四个权限预设：进程全权限（GPU 可用），同时工作区外与受保护文件（.git/**、.env*）的写入逐次向用户审批；纯插件实现，零核心改动。

The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher

items.de: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the l

items.de: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
