Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no netw
items.dz: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

items.de: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their ev
items.dz: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

items.de: Turns each DSH workspace into a project: every new session auto-injects a project-workspace convention (read code before acting, empty folder means a brand-new project); a per-session Project toggle in the composer downgrades the session to a plain workspace with an explicit notice, with the state k
items.dz: 把 DSH 工作区文件夹变成项目：新会话自动注入精简的「项目工作区约定」上下文（先读代码、空目录即新建项目）；输入框旁每会话「项目」开关可将会话显式降级为普通工作区（状态渲染式注入，关时有提示，不整块消失），状态存于会话日志。

items.de: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
items.dz: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

items.de: Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.
items.dz: 全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。

items.de: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the composer with a line-by-line diff; 🗺️show the panel 🎨 customise the 🪄 prompt-button icon 📍 and button position yourself.
items.dz: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

items.de: Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is st
items.dz: 输入框提示词优化：工具行一个按钮，用你已配置的模型渠道改写草稿，结果流式输出到贴着输入框上沿、不占布局的面板里。只有点「采纳」才会替换草稿，且生成中拒绝采纳——半截答案不会被写回；草稿含 @引用或附件时先确认一次，因为整段替换会把它们降级成纯文本。没有任何全局快捷键，密钥也不会进浏览器（模型调用在宿主半边完成）。

items.de: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
items.dz: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

items.de: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
items.dz: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

items.de: Composer-side prompt library: a button next to the input opens a picker with group chips and word-split AND search over saved snippets, inserting one into the draft or appending it, filling {{variables}} before insertion, with 13 built-in templates. Snippets live in one local JSON file behind a rev
items.dz: 输入框旁的本地提示词库：按钮打开取用浮层，按分组 chips 与分词 AND 搜索筛选，插入或追加到草稿，插入前填充 {{变量}}，内置 13 套模板；数据存单个本地 JSON 文件，带 rev 乐观锁、每次保存前备份与整库 JSON 导入导出；设置页管理编辑、分组、置顶与 6 秒删除撤销。

items.de: Layered system-prompt profiles — global, per-workspace and per-session entries injected in order — where individual builtin sections and runtime contexts can be disabled or overridden, with a line-level diff of what an override changed; each entry carries a subagent scope that targets the main agent
items.dz: 分层提示词档案：全局、按工作区、按会话三级条目按序注入系统提示词；可单独禁用或覆盖内置段落与运行期 context，覆盖效果有逐行 diff 对照；每条条目可限定只注入主代理、只注入子代理，或两者都注入；装配快照记录每一轮实际收到的提示词，子代理也包括在内。由 Web 面板与 `prompt_manager` 工具管理。

items.de: Prompt-polish template injector for DSH: click ✨ in the composer to inject a "polish my prompt" template (current draft auto-embedded), no send, no network, no model — the main agent rewrites with full context. Replaces narrative-prompt-polish (2026-09-14 migration).
items.dz: 点会话输入框右座 ✨，把「打磨提示词」模板写进输入栏——当前草稿自动嵌进 `<内容>` 位置，不发送、不联网、不调模型，由当前会话的主 agent 带着全部上下文改写。替代 narrative-prompt-polish（2026-09-14 更名并整体重构）。

items.de: Adds an Optimize prompt control next to the composer send button that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (plain, sections, or role-task-goal) streamed from the session model, with Use, Undo, Copy and Close.
items.dz: 在输入框发送按钮旁加上「优化提示词」控件，用当前会话模型把草稿流式改写为结构化提示词（plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格），并提供使用、撤销、复制与关闭。

items.de: Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.
items.dz: 输入框有内容时单次调用优化草稿，空白时预测下一句；两类任务独立，支持草稿保护、结果预览和原文恢复。

items.de: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.
items.dz: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

items.de: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
items.dz: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

items.de: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
items.dz: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

items.de: Predicts your next message after each turn and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab takes the whole line, Alt+Right takes one word at a time, Enter takes it and sends, Esc dismisses, and Alt+R asks the model again without repeating the old one. Typing a few characters completes from prom
items.dz: 每轮结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 显示在输入框：Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐词采纳、Enter 采纳并发送、Esc 忽略、Alt+R 换一条且不重复旧的那条；输入几个字时用本会话发过的提示做前缀补全，空输入框按 ↑ 回填上一条；插件页可设置服务商、模型、思考强度、各按键开关与生成参数。

items.de: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.
items.dz: 右侧面板中的全局与会话级提示词模板——插入草稿或立即发送、编辑、会话模板提升为全局，SQLite 持久化走内置的 node:sqlite。

items.de: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
items.dz: 在设置里为每个已启用的 provider 单独配置正向代理（HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5），未配置的 provider 与其它流量保持直连。

items.de: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
items.dz: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

items.dz: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

Computer control is enabled from the settings; on macOS it needs Screen Recording, Accessibility and Input Monitor

items.dz: 用本机 QQ 的音效提醒 DSH：任务完成响好友消息音，需要审批或回答问题时响系统消息音；Windows 下自动发现 QQ 目录，其它平台回落到内置音效。

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。

items.de: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
items.dz: 一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸鱼悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。

items.de: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the l
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

items.de: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota
items.dz: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

items.de: Unofficial QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for DSH, adapted from dsh-magpie-connect and magpie (MIT): device-code sign-in and request signing live inside the plugin, so no desktop client or forwarding process is needed. Requires an active QwenWork plan and DSH 0.2.x.
items.dz: 非官方的千问办公（QwenWork）模型 provider，改编自 dsh-magpie-connect 与 magpie（MIT）：设备码登录与请求签名均在插件内实现，不需要桌面客户端或本地转发进程。需有效的千问办公套餐，DSH 0.2.x。

items.de: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
items.dz: 把 AMD Radeon Cloud 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，思考档位按模型逐个声明。provider 定义随插件自带的补丁层交付，而不是写进 profile。

items.de: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server version, and reports capability gaps in a settings card.

items.de: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
items.dz: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

items.de: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 在线小说阅读器：书源搜索、聊天式阅读界面、整本下载 TXT 到本地。

items.de: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions, per-chapter distillation, Legado-compatible book-source search that adds online books chapter by chapter, and a bundled reading
items.dz: 在侧边栏里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转与书内链接跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答、按章蒸馏，并能导入 Legado 格式书源按章抓取在线书籍，随包还带一个陪读教练 skill。PDF 只支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

items.de: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured
items.dz: 右侧栏本地 TXT 阅读器 + 不剧透的 AI 陪读：模型只能看到你已经读到的部分（本章全文、上一章结尾，以及随进度增量补齐的背景认识）；摘抄、感想与 AI 回应写成结构化 Markdown 笔记，可导出到 Obsidian。只有你标记「已读完」的那一本才向它放开原文。

items.de: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
items.dz: dsh-reasoning-effort 的分支：输入框里的两级模型选择器（Provider 列表 + 右侧滑出的模型栏）、搜索与紧凑行，并保留推理强度滑块与最高档特效。

items.de: Aborts a DSH reasoning stream that starts repeating itself instead of letting the turn stall: five rules over the streamed reasoning text (periodic unit, repeated block, repeated line above a share floor, 64-gram density, and a long trailing run of punctuation or whitespace), plus a JSONL fire journ
items.dz: 在推理流开始自我重复时提前中断本轮，避免长时间卡死：对推理文本做五条判据（周期单元、重复块、带占比下限的重复行、64-gram 密度、末尾超长标点或空白段），并附带 JSONL 触发日志、Web GUI 日志面板，以及可选的重试恢复（带纠正消息）。

items.de: A Workspaces-native Recent sessions section for the DSH left sidebar: favorites, running, waiting-for-you and unread sessions at a glance, with a one-click ☆ on every session row, one-line collapse and in-section search. It takes over the sidebar shell (the shipped sidebar package is disabled) and r
items.dz: 像官方「工作区」一样融入左侧栏的「最近会话」分区：收藏、运行中、等待你的回应、完成未读、最近活跃一屏直达；每个会话行 ☆ 一键收藏，可收起到一行、支持就地搜索。它会接管侧栏外壳（禁用官方侧栏包）并在其中原样渲染官方工作区/会话浏览区；其 recent-sessions 面板 id 与 huangxp12/whybebabo 冲突，不要同装。

items.de: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.
items.dz: 一块面板列出所有工作目录里的最近会话：时间分组、两种排序、内容检索、在文件管理器中显示目录，以及只存在本机、回到那个会话时提示填入草稿的想法。

items.de: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
items.dz: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

items.de: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall
items.dz: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-i

items.de: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn already generating keeps running; restart asks for one confirmation, quits the whole app and reopens it with sessions and workspaces intact.
items.dz: 在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话内容、零运行时依赖。

items.de: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from a HarmonyOS phone: list, switch and create sessions; send prompts (the phone follows the host's busy-enter behaviour, queue or steer); stream assistant text, reasoning and tool steps; answer approval requests and questions; view session images as inline thumbnail
items.dz: 用 HarmonyOS 手机遥控 DeepSeek Harness：浏览/切换/新建会话；发送提示词（手机跟随宿主的繁忙行为，排队或插话）；流式接收正文、思考与工具步骤；应答审批请求与提问；查看会话图片（缩略图内联 + 大图按需拉取）；切换模型与思考强度；取消运行中的任务；接收推送通知。流量端到端加密（HKDF-SHA256 派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM），经只转发密文的哑管道中继；v1.1.3 增加会话纪元抗重放握手与中继原生 TLS。中继可跑在本机（由插件托管）或 VPS 上；手机 App 与插件同仓库发布。5 个 Remote 方法。

items.de: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a sing
items.dz: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

items.de: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
items.dz: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

items.de: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.
items.dz: 从 DeepSeek Harness 白名单 SSH 接入 Unix/AIX/macOS（不走 shell；默认只读），含 remote_ssh_probe 按系统探测套装。

items.de: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
items.dz: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

items.de: Use DSH from your phone anywhere: a self-hosted relay plus a desktop host plugin form a token-authenticated tunnel (order-preserving HTTP reverse proxy + WebSocket bridging) with QR pairing, an admin console for device/token management, and an injected mobile adaptation layer (full-width chat, full-
items.dz: 随时随地用手机操作 DSH：自托管中继 + 桌面 host 插件组成令牌认证隧道（保序 HTTP 反向代理 + WebSocket 桥接），扫码配对、管理台可管理设备与令牌，并自动注入移动适配层（聊天全宽、设置弹窗全屏、侧栏抽屉化）。

items.de: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
items.dz: 在可配置次数后硬拦截连续相同的工具调用，避免 Agent 原地空转。

items.de: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
items.dz: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

items.de: Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话整理成日报、周报、交接与文章稿件，支持可核验的 HTML 导出与复核收据。

items.de: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request wil
items.dz: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

items.de: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
items.dz: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

items.de: One-click restart for the DSH desktop client, from five entries you can toggle individually: a sidebar panel, the sidebar footer, the conversation header, a Settings → General row, or the /restart slash command. The app is closed gracefully (only the main process is signalled, so the host can flush
items.dz: DSH 桌面版一键重启，五个入口可逐项开关：侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、设置 → 通用行、斜杠命令 /restart。只给主进程发关闭信号让宿主优雅退出（会话日志得以下盘），再由脱离进程树的助手自动拉起；可选守卫会等待进行中的任务或插件安装结束，重启结果写成回执，动作请求仅限本机同源，所有开关落 profile 配置文件。四个界面入口可单独关闭，斜杠命令始终可用。

items.de: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

items.de: Three-position toggle (off / this turn / always-on) for an "unlimited mode" that injects a "do not conserve tokens" instruction into the system prompt; the "this turn" mode reverts automatically on the kernel agent/status idle event.
items.dz: 三档切换的「无限大白饭模式」（关 / 本轮 / 常开），控制要不要给系统提示注入「别省 token」的指令；「本轮」靠内核 agent/status 的 idle 事件自动回落。

items.de: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
items.dz: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

items.de: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path,
items.dz: DSH Web 界面里的右键菜单，覆盖文件与链接：在文件树一行、对话消息里的文件路径或文件提及、以及超链接上右键，可预览、用默认程序或指定关联程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、复制路径／相对路径／文件名／链接地址／链接文字／文件内容、另存为，并可把 http(s) 链接在侧边栏浏览器或系统浏览器中打开；在非文件非链接处右键仍保留浏览器原生菜单。

items.de: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
items.dz: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

items.de: Reviews side-effecting tool calls against the project rules and the current goal before they run, and denies anything out of scope with a fail-closed verdict and no bypass switch.
items.dz: 在写文件、跑非只读命令、联网、派子代理等有副作用的动作执行前，按项目规则与当前目标复核，超出范围即拒绝（失败即拒，无可配置豁免开关）。

items.de: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
items.dz: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

items.de: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
items.dz: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

items.de: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
items.dz: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

items.de: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
items.dz: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

items.de: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

items.de: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

items.de: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message
items.dz: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

items.de: Eight academic skills bundled for one-command install — publication-ready academic figures designed from real data with visual review, AI-text humanization, paper polishing and rewriting, PubMed citation verification (DOI/PMID reconciliation), Chinese citation and medical-book reference checks, and
items.dz: 八个学术技能一次装齐——学术图表（按真实数据设计+视觉审核）、去 AI 味改写、论文润色与改写、PubMed 引文核验（DOI/PMID 逐条对账）、中文著作引用核验、公众号医学文章结构化。三项纯本地运行，五项按功能访问外部服务（NCBI、DOI 解析、发布平台）并逐技能如实声明；零遥测、无安装期脚本。技能经本机 Python 3.8+ 运行；academic-figures 另需安装其 pip 依赖。

items.de: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的左栏便签插件：带标签的随手记、图片/文件附件、Markdown 待办、发到对话、唤起快捷键、JSON 导入导出，以及 Agent 工具。

items.de: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

items.de: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 界面即时屏幕翻译：支持菜单、设置、Shadow DOM 与嵌套 iframe，覆盖 45+ 种语言。

items.de: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day
items.dz: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

items.de: Cross-session memory and a per-workspace knowledge base in one plugin. Memories are plain JSONL under ~/.dsh/memory by default; each session starts with the relevant ones already in the system prompt and writes one back when it ends. A read-only kb/ folder per workspace plus one global folder is sea
items.dz: 跨会话记忆与工作区知识库合一。记忆默认是 ~/.dsh/memory 下的纯 JSONL，会话开始把相关记忆放进系统提示，会话结束回写一条；每个工作区的 kb/ 目录加一份全局目录构成只读知识库，检索结果能引用到文件行号。十一个工具统一带 scribe_ 前缀（七个 scribe_memory_*、四个 scribe_kb_*），一个 /scribe 斜杠命令，以及概览 / 记忆 / 知识库 / 迁移四页的设置页。云端后端（百炼记忆库、ChromaDB、云端主 + 本地镜像）按需启用；迁移数据必须经显式审批，并留有可回滚的日志。

items.de: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
items.dz: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

items.de: Select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, translate, or read it aloud with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a streaming always-on-top overlay with a horizontal capsule menu.
items.dz: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，弹出解释 / 总结 / 翻译 / 朗读，结果以流式输出落在原生置顶浮窗里，菜单为横向胶囊条。

items.de: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
items.dz: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

items.de: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches
items.dz: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

items.de: Windows serial-port monitor for DeepSeek Harness — port parameters, live text/hex receive and data sending.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 串口调试面板：串口参数设置、文本/十六进制实时接收显示与数据发送。

items.de: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
items.dz: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

items.de: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
items.dz: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.
items.dz: 会话交互折叠：每次交互压成一行（时间胶囊 + 提问摘要），只保留最近一次展开；切换工作区/会话或产生新交互都会重置到最新一条；执行过程仅在单独点击时展开。

items.de: Adds delete and batch delete to the session list menu; sessions go to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of being erased, and the files a session produced are listed first so you decide whether to remove them together.
items.dz: 在会话列表菜单里加删除与批量删除：会话移入 Windows 回收站而不是永久删除，删除前先列出该会话产出过哪些文件，由你决定是否一并清理。

items.de: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
items.dz: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

items.de: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
items.dz: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

items.de: Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget's whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏的会话清理：把会话行拖到余额挂件的小胖鱼嘴边，它张嘴吃掉 —— 会话目录移入回收站，不是 rm。删除前只问一句「消耗了多少 token，真的给我吃吗？」（可在设置里关掉）；撤销走常驻回执或设置里 12 条持久台账。点侧栏那条小鱼直达插件设置：换形象、拖拽校准嘴位、改写全部 17 段界面文案；空白会话 / 正在聊的 / 正在跑的会被就地拒绝并写明原因。

items.de: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
items.dz: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

items.de: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
items.dz: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

items.de: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.
items.dz: 设置 → 插件 下的会话管理面板：列出全部会话的标题、工作目录、agent 预设、更新时间、轮次与步数，展开可查看消息历史，删除非运行中的会话，并经浏览器 Blob URL 导出为 JSON 或 Markdown。

items.de: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
items.dz: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

items.de: Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived.
items.dz: 在侧边栏把会话直接拖到其他工作区的标题行即可移动：目标工作区生成携带完整历史的新会话，原会话归档。

items.de: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
items.dz: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

items.de: Two-level sidebar organizer with workspace groups and nested per-workspace session folders, drag-and-drop, live session status dots, a pending-sessions overview, and manual unread marks.
items.dz: 两级侧边栏组织器：工作区分组 + 工作区内嵌套会话文件夹，支持拖拽、会话状态点、待处理会话概览与手动未处理标记。

items.de: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
items.dz: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

items.de: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
items.dz: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

items.de: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
items.dz: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

items.de: Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.
items.dz: 在侧栏「已归档」会话的菜单里加一行彻底删除，一次清掉会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记。

items.de: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it
items.dz: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

items.de: Session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: deleting a session from its row menu (or in bulk from the sidebar header) moves it into a recycle bin kept for 15 days by default — 7, 15 or 30 in settings — and expired entries are purged automatically. The bin table shows the days left for each entry, rest
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 会话回收站：从会话行菜单删除（或从侧栏标题栏批量移入）后，会话进入回收站，默认保留 15 天（设置里可选 7 / 15 / 30 天），到期条目自动清除；回收站表格显示每条还剩几天，可还原回原工作区，也可单条彻底删除或清空。

items.de: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachm
items.dz: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 会话两段式删除：对话移入回收站、可恢复回侧栏原位置；两段确认式删除，防止误删文件，连带整条子代理树、侧栏账本、投影缓存、日志与专属附件。同时能扫出一条对话真正写过的文件，增加文件查询功能，点击后将路径信息粘贴到对话中，通过Agent来判断哪些文件可以删除；在资源管理器中多选高亮，并复制按类型分好的路径。本插件与 iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

items.de: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
items.dz: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

items.de: Saves a whole DSH session as one .dsproj project file and opens it back. The session header gains an open button, a save button, a save-as button and an autosave switch, and the blank-session page gains its own open button. The first save asks where to put the file and later saves overwrite it; open
items.dz: 把整个 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，并能再打开回来。会话标题栏上多了打开、保存、另存为三个按钮和自动保存开关，空会话页面另有自己的打开入口。第一次保存会问存到哪里，之后一键覆盖；打开 .dsproj 会导入该会话并切过去，按需可以把包里的工作区记忆合并回本机。

items.de: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
items.dz: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

items.de: Tag each session as a long-term or short-term task, record the agent mode it was created with, and auto-archive it once the archive window you set elapses.
items.dz: 为每个会话标记长期任务或短期任务、记录创建时的 Agent 模式，并在你设定的归档时间窗结束后自动归档。

items.de: Right-sidebar session timeline: fishbone layout of every workspace session with native fork/handoff lineage, manual drag links, branch fan-outs, archived-session display and per-turn detail browsing.
items.dz: 右侧栏会话时间线：以鱼骨布局展示工作区全部会话，含原生 fork/handoff 血缘、手工拖拽衔接、分支扇出、归档会话显示与逐轮详情浏览。

items.de: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
items.dz: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

items.de: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.
items.dz: 在输入框下方显示当前这一轮 DeepSeek Harness 任务的实时进度条、百分比与预计剩余时间；估计随轮次实时重锚，任务失败或中断时进度条变红。

items.de: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
items.dz: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

items.de: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
items.dz: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

items.de: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
items.dz: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

items.de: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
items.dz: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

items.de: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
items.dz: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。
rl: uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

items.de: Adds a strip of saved prompts above the composer: click a chip to insert its text at the draft caret, and manage the list — add, edit, reorder, delete — in an inline panel that opens in place. Prompts persist per profile and are also exposed to the agent as a quick_prompts tool; a fresh install star
items.dz: 在会话输入框上方维护常用 prompt：点胶囊把内容插入草稿光标处，并可展开内联面板新增、编辑、排序、删除；条目按 profile 持久化，同时以 quick_prompts 工具提供给 agent，初始不预置任何条目。

items.de: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

items.de: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
items.dz: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

items.de: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
items.dz: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

items.de: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs
items.dz: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

items.de: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with p
items.dz: 把侧边栏的加项面板行（自动化任务、agent 团队、插件市场、上下文页等）收进宿主「更多」行：在该行挂一个 28x28 箭头按钮，点一下把它们收成一行、再点复原；折叠状态按窗口持久化，保持可见的行用逐行开关从当前侧边栏实时枚举后选择，被管理行的图标与文字还能切换左/中/右对齐。纯 client 插件：只新增 DOM，不打宿主补丁，卸载后恢复原样。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，其它版本装上也不会生效。

items.de: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; rea
items.dz: DSH 右侧边栏页：把当前会话的仓库画成 VS Code 风格的分支/合并提交图谱（彩色泳道、ref 徽章、提交详情），上方带工作区 Changes 区（staged/unstaged 分节、行内 diff），覆盖仓库的每个工作树；只读，装不装 dsh-better-sidebar 都能用，装了 dsh-session-worktree 时跟随会话的 worktree 标签。

items.de: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
items.dz: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

items.de: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.
items.dz: 把 dsh Web 侧边栏的全局面板菜单（插件、扩展管理、定时任务、IM）从竖排文字列表收起为一行 36×36 图标按钮，悬停显示名称；可在「设置 → 通用」里切回列表，选择按浏览器记忆。

items.de: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
items.dz: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

items.de: Per-turn first-token latency and output speed beside the built-in usage pill, folded on the host over the durable event log: first-token time is replayed from each message's compact stream, so historical turns stay exact after a reload rather than showing an estimate.
items.dz: 在自带用量胶囊旁显示每轮的首字延迟与输出速度，由宿主在持久事件日志上折叠得出：首字时刻从每条消息的压缩流中重放还原，所以刷新后历史轮次依然精确，而不是估算值。

items.de: Sends a Markdown file from the conversation into a self-hosted SiYuan notebook: a button on every delivered-file card and on the document-preview toolbar, or just ask the agent to send it, all through the SiYuan kernel HTTP API. Existing notes are never overwritten — a repeated title gets a timestam
items.dz: 把对话里交付的 Markdown 文件一键送进自建的思源笔记：交付文件卡片和文档预览工具栏各有一个按钮，也可以直接让智能体发送，统一走思源内核 HTTP API。已有笔记绝不覆盖——重名自动加时间戳——API token 只存在宿主凭据库里，不落设置文件、也不发给浏览器。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
items.dz: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

items.de: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
items.dz: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

items.de: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
items.dz: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

items.de: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, valid
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailab

items.de: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
items.dz: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

items.de: Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).
items.dz: DSH 设置面板内的「技能管理」页面：按系统 / 用户 / 工作区 / 预设浏览技能，展开技能查看文件树、查看和编辑文件，支持从 zip 导入技能，以及导出、删除（系统技能只读）。

items.de: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to t

items.de: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. items.de: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.

items.dz: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

items.de: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的工具不进工具注册表，因此不占用每一轮的上下文。每张卡片带连接状态标签（已连接并显示工具数 / 重试中 / 已放弃重试 / 激活失败）与一键重连，让启动时连不上、工具悄悄消失的服务器看得见。另可从 26 个 MCP 客户端导入既有配置。

items.de: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skill

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

Applied when each in-process child is created (agent/create
