items.de: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the
items.dz: 通过 ai-ball 悬浮球给 agent 一张嘴：让球逐字打出你要说的话、按 mood 改变边缘光颜色、显示或收起独白面板、读回你打的字，以及检查接线和启动球。球是独立的 Python 3.10+ 悬浮层，需自行另外安装；插件只写它监听的那几个文件。

items.de: A second, agent-owned cursor with a floating control panel for opacity, colour, size, badge and a permission ladder only a human can raise. It never moves the real pointer. Windows 10 (2004 or newer) only — the overlay is a Win32 program with no macOS or Linux fallback.
items.dz: 给 AI 的第二只光标加一个浮动控制面板，可调透明度、颜色、大小与提示显隐，并按只能由人提高的权限等级限制它；从不移动你的真实鼠标指针。仅支持 Windows 10 2004 及以上——浮层是 Win32 程序，macOS 与 Linux 没有实现。

items.de: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced res
items.dz: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

items.de: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.
items.dz: 用会话自己的模型从对话内容生成会话标题，可走 /ai-title 命令，也可点重命名弹窗里的按钮。提供四种标题结构（主题、动作、主题 + 结论、自定义提示词）和可选的「月-日」前缀，均可在插件设置页调整。

items.de: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
items.dz: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

items.de: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

items.de: Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.
items.dz: 拦截粘贴进输入框或被工具写入的 API 密钥，记录泄露事件，并扫描工作区中暴露的密钥。

items.de: Alibaba Cloud coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the sidebar footer, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI.
items.dz: 在侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券的剩余余额、已用额度与到期时间，数据来自只读 BSS OpenAPI。

items.de: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
items.dz: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

items.de: Policy-layer guard that checks tool calls before they run: a read whitelist, a sensitive-path deny list (credentials, browser profiles, chat history, other users' home directories), dangerous-command blocking, subagent isolation, and a static scan that quarantines executables. Every denial is append
items.dz: 在工具调用真正执行之前做判定的策略层护栏：读取白名单、敏感路径拒绝（凭据、浏览器配置、聊天记录、其他用户目录）、危险命令拦截、子代理隔离，以及对可执行文件的静态扫描与隔离区。每次拒绝都写进审计日志。它是文本与路径过滤，不是沙箱也不是杀软：动态拼接的路径、编码载荷、加壳程序都可能绕过，也不能替代系统自带防护。

items.de: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
items.dz: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

items.de: Adds an Amadeus-inspired launch panel with a clock and navigation shortcuts.
items.dz: 添加 Amadeus 风格启动面板，包含时钟和导航快捷入口。

items.de: Appends ambiguity-handling rules to the dsh system prompt so the agent asks clarifying options before guessing.
items.dz: 向 dsh system prompt 追加歧义处理规则，让 agent 在猜测前先列出 A/B/C/D 选项请求澄清。

items.de: Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy H.264 streaming, agent taps verified by screenshots and a UI tree, and screenshots / recordings / debug evidence saved into one host directory. Debug sessions keep segmented video, full logcat and per-action frames. Emulators and USB pho
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话旁打开 Android 设备实时画面：scrcpy H.264 串流，agent 可点按操作并用截图与控件树自证，截图 / 录屏 / 调试证据统一存进你指定的电脑目录；调试会话自带分段视频、全量 logcat 与逐动作前后帧。模拟器与 USB 真机通吃，人机共屏，仅限本机回环。

items.de: Mirrors a USB-connected Android phone in the DSH sidebar and drives it over scrcpy's control protocol: 12 agent tools for tap/swipe/type/keys, multi-frame scroll-and-stitch long screenshots, and agent-first control that hands over the moment a human touches the phone. Ships its own adb and scrcpy-se
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏实时显示 USB 连接的安卓手机，并通过 scrcpy 控制协议直接操作手机：12 个 agent 工具（点按/滑动/输入/按键）、多帧滚动拼接的长截图，以及「默认交给 agent、人一碰手机就立刻交出控制权」的控制权模型。自带 adb 与 scrcpy-server。仅 Windows 10/11；侧栏实时镜像还需 dsh-better-sidebar。

items.de: Anime theme for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen wallpaper, glassmorphism panels, six color themes, video wallpaper, particle effects, and a random corner sticker.
items.dz: 二次元主题：全屏动漫壁纸、玻璃拟态面板、六套全局配色主题、动态壁纸、粒子效果与右下角随机动图挂件。

items.de: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏里的标注浏览器：通过 CDP 推流并转发输入的实时页面，点选元素或划选文字后，把源码位置、组件栈、样式与裁图带进聊天输入框。需本机 Chrome（Windows 须设置 chromePath）。

items.de: Annotate quoted answer text in the transcript: each selection keeps its quote plus a note of your own, notes pile up as chips in the composer and travel with the message, and two or more also get a chip above the input to jump back or clear them. The chips need dsh-paste-chip installed; without it e
items.dz: 划选回答文字就地加注释：保留原文引用加自己写的备注，每条在草稿里变成一枚胶囊，多条一起随消息发出；两条以上时输入框上方会多一个胶囊用来跳回原文或全部清除。胶囊需另装 dsh-paste-chip，否则每条注释在草稿里是一行纯文本。

items.de: Select text in assistant replies, add optional comments, and send the annotations with the next message.
items.dz: 在助手回复中选中文字，添加可选评论，并将注释随下一条消息一起发送。

items.de: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

items.de: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.
items.dz: 逐次回答耗时拆解：把每次回复分成模型、工具与其它三段，给出首字、生成与各工具耗时，并在本地落一份 JSONL 账本。需要 DSH 运行时为 Node 24 或更新版本。

items.de: An enhanced fork of dsh-any-background. Its own work, from v0.4.0 onward, adds a dual-lane wallpaper: the same picture down each side of the window, split at the exact centre so the wallpaper stays visible beside the conversation column. Each lane can also read its own folder (one directory per side
items.dz: dsh-any-background 的增强分支。v0.4.0 起的改动为本 fork 自作，新增左右双图轮播：同一轮播在窗口两侧各推进一步，以绝对中心为分界，壁纸不再被会话区完全挡住。两条车道还可各读一个文件夹（左右各一），共用同一轮播频率与模式，左右边缘淡化效果完全一致。

items.de: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events.
items.dz: 把 dsh 内部能力（语言、工作区注册表、agent-status 与 approval 事件）以 HTTP 路由的形式暴露在 dsh 已监听的本地回环 socket 上，前缀 /dsh-api，并通过 /dsh-api/events 提供 SSE 事件推送。

items.de: Floating API-balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: live balance for DeepSeek, Moonshot, OpenAI and custom endpoints; draggable, resizable, frosted-glass look, with text color adapting to the content beneath.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮 API 余额徽章：实时显示 DeepSeek / Moonshot / OpenAI / 自定义接口余额；可拖动缩放、亚克力质感、文字颜色随下方内容明暗自适应。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same reques
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

items.de: Detect which installed apps have a newer version and update them with one click, downloading each vendor's full installer from its official site and installing it silently. Windows via winget, macOS via Homebrew casks, matching the machine's ARM64 or x64 architecture.
items.dz: 检测本机已安装应用里哪些有可用新版本，并一键从各软件官网下载完整安装包静默更新；Windows 走 winget、macOS 走 Homebrew cask，并按本机 ARM64 / x64 架构挑选对应安装包。

items.de: Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.
items.dz: 在输入框模型位旁边加一个控件，一键把当前会话的模型应用到其余所有会话。

items.de: macOS 13+. Plays a macOS system sound when DeepSeek Harness needs a tool approval, an agent question, a macOS permission prompt, or an administrator password sheet, then repeats on a 0/25/20/15/10/5 second cadence until the request is resolved. Ships as a bundle with a switch and a config form in th
items.dz: 需 macOS 13+。在 DeepSeek Harness 需要工具审批、Agent 提问、macOS 权限弹窗或管理员密码弹窗时播放系统提示音，并按 0/25/20/15/10/5 秒节奏重复提醒，直到请求被处理。以 bundle 形式提供，在侧边栏插件页带开关和中文配置表单；需 macOS 13+。

items.de: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.
items.dz: 审批卡片的键盘确认：卡片出现时自动聚焦，按 Enter 允许一次、按 Esc 拒绝；焦点离开卡片后这两个键仍会转交给卡片处理。不会自动批准，也不会抢输入框的焦点。

items.de: Maintained fork of dsh-approval-gate. A neutral operation whose confirmation count has reached the threshold auto-approves when the judge is unavailable, instead of prompting a human again; approver-facing explanations are generated in Chinese from the real sandbox mode, command and paths. Also carr
items.dz: dsh-approval-gate 的维护中 fork。判定器不可用时，确认次数已达阈值的中立操作直接自动放行，不再重复弹人工审批；审批说明由真实的沙箱模式、命令与路径生成中文。另含凭据外泄与系统路径销毁的确定性硬拒、判定输入脱敏、判定模型候选链、带操作指纹的放行规则，以及可查看 unified diff 与一键撤销的审批视图。

items.de: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, the agent asks you to choose an option, or a session finishes a turn, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused; an optional chime covers cases where the browser or Windows suppresses the notification
items.dz: 工具调用等待审批、智能体提问等你选择、或会话跑完一轮时，弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不看 DSH 页面（后台或未聚焦）时提醒；浏览器或 Windows 抑制通知时可用可选提示音兜底。

items.de: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay s
items.dz: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

items.de: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
items.dz: DSH审批汉化 — 审批弹窗在渲染前自动翻译成中文：DeepSeek 驱动、宿主侧完成，React 重渲染也无法还原。

items.de: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hu
items.dz: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（适配 DSH v0.2.x 与桌面端 v0.22.3+）：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图悬浮在 WebGL 流体板或图片/视频壁纸上的磨砂玻璃片，云母/兼容双布局，模糊、磨砂、色调、亮度可调，海洋装饰（粒子鲸鱼、小鱼、网状交互、鼠标辉光），一键恢复默认，总开关关闭即完全还原原生界面；承 WYH66666666 原作（0.1.x）与 du-u-uck 的 0.1.1-rc.2 适配。

items.de: Conversation management for DSH: bulk-archive idle conversations (archiving only marks them; by default it also sends their snapshot ledgers to the Windows Recycle Bin), permanently delete conversations after confirmation, star the ones worth keeping, undo the last reply with a per-turn snapshot, an
items.dz: DSH 对话管理工具箱：按闲置批量归档（归档只做标记，默认顺带把快照账本送进 Windows 回收站），确认后可永久删除对话；收藏常看会话；按轮次撤销回复并保留轮次快照；一键清理快照与归档档案。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.
items.dz: 双 Tab 归档面板（已归档 / 活跃），每行的归档或取消归档与彻底删除并排；显示绑定的工作目录且可直接点击打开，删除后的归档记录进入待清理队列，避免已删会话重新出现在活跃列表。

items.de: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
items.dz: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

items.de: Manage and delete archived DSH conversations: a Settings page lists every archived session with per-row and bulk delete, and the sidebar session menu gains a Delete row next to Unarchive. Deletion is real — the session log, its projection cache and both indexes are cleaned up, not just an unarchive.
items.dz: 管理并删除已归档的 DSH 对话：设置里新增「归档会话」页，列出所有归档会话，支持单条与批量删除；侧边栏会话「…」菜单在「取消归档」旁新增红色的「删除归档会话」。删除是真正的删除（会话日志、投影缓存与两套索引一起清理），不只是取消归档。

items.de: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x228
items.dz: DSH 桌宠插件：内置 486 位明日方舟干员素材目录，选定干员后从固定上游版本下载 Codex v2 图集并逐个校验 Git 哈希再本地安装；也可导入自己的 Codex 图集（1536×1872 或 1536×2288）或普通 PNG/WebP/GIF 图片；桌宠随会话状态切换动作，等待确认时显示气泡，可拖动并调整尺寸。

items.de: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiat
items.dz: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义

items.de: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
items.dz: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

items.de: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
items.dz: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

items.de: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never s
items.dz: 在输入框加一个按钮：先复述你的草稿，再用可点的选项问几个问题——每题都带一个「我不知道，你替我定」的逃生项——最后把草稿改写成 AI 能直接开工的需求。全程可以一个字都不打，而且它不会替你发送。

items.de: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
items.dz: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

items.de: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.
items.dz: 给助手回复加一层可调节的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质，并让过程、工具调用与思考等周边行同步。

items.de: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; c
items.dz: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

items.de: Mirrors assistant streaming frames (deltas, blocks, commits, turn fences) to a configurable NDJSON sink for external consumers.
items.dz: 把助手流式输出帧（增量、块、提交、轮次栅栏）以 NDJSON 形式写入可配置的接收端，供外部进程消费。

items.de: Answers @file completion from the Everything index through es.exe instead of walking the workspace, keeping the workspace root as the ranking scope. Windows only; needs Everything and es.exe on PATH.
items.dz: 用 es.exe 从 Everything 索引回答 @file 补全，而不是遍历工作区，并以工作区根目录作为排序范围。仅限 Windows；需先安装 Everything 与 es.exe 并加入 PATH。

items.de: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.
items.dz: 只读附件库：列出本机保存的所有图片和文件附件及其占用空间，以及哪些对话（包括会话回收站中的）仍在使用它们，并可在访达中显示或用预览打开。

items.de: Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness: a short synthesized sound when an agent needs confirmation, finishes a turn or a background job, or fails, with five sound packs, per-event toggles and volume, and do-not-disturb rules stored in the host settings document.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 音效提示：智能体需要确认、回合完成、后台任务结束或失败时播放短提示音，内置 5 套音色、逐事件开关与音量、免打扰规则，配置存放在宿主设置文档。

items.de: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. D
items.dz: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail 同装——两者驱动同一处锚点并注册相同的 /audio-rail/events 与 /audio-rail/status 路由。

items.de: Auto-archives sessions idle beyond a configurable threshold, with safety guards (never touches live or running sessions), plus a full archived-session management UI: list, unarchive, safe delete and content preview.
items.dz: 按闲置天数自动归档冷会话（带运行中、驻留会话安全护栏），并提供归档会话管理面板：查看、释放、安全删除与内容预览。

items.de: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
items.dz: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

items.de: A session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: the trigger point is configurable, compaction does not make the local engine re-read the whole history, and the model writes a structured handoff summary from the prefix that is already cached. Trigger ratio, summary template, displa
items.dz: 对本地模型友好的会话自动压缩插件：可自定义压缩触发点，不会使本地引擎重读全部历史，并让模型基于已缓存的前缀撰写结构化交接摘要，触发比例、摘要模板、显示样式与逐预设生效范围均可配置。安装重启 DSH 后接管；卸载即恢复DSH原生压缩。

items.de: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.
items.dz: 回答因达到单次输出 token 上限被截断时自动发送"继续"续写，无需手动操作；面向自部署 Ollama 等小输出上限场景。

items.de: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
items.dz: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

items.de: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.
items.dz: DSH 桌面版启动时自动最大化主窗口，等价于手动点一次最大化按钮。跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），尽力而为，host-only 插件。

items.de: Records the version of the edit target as an observation when the agent inspected the file with bash instead of the read tool, so the filesystem observation policy stops rejecting edits with FS_NOT_OBSERVED. Applies to edits only; blind whole-file overwrites stay guarded.
items.dz: 当 agent 用 bash（sed/awk/cat）看过文件而非 read 工具时，为编辑目标补登记一次真实版本的观察记录，使文件系统观察策略不再以 FS_NOT_OBSERVED 拒绝编辑；只作用于编辑，整文件盲覆盖仍受保护。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
items.dz: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

items.de: Restores the permission preset a session was last set to when that session is reopened; a session opened for the first time is left untouched. Load it after dsh-experimental-auto-review to restore the auto preset.
items.dz: 重新打开会话时恢复该会话上次设置的权限预设；首次打开不干预。需排在 dsh-experimental-auto-review 之后加载才能恢复 auto 预设。

items.de: Connects DSH to local HTTP proxies automatically via a loopback relay. No TUN, no env vars, zero-restart switching, with sidebar/composer dock controls and live topology.
items.dz: DSH 自动代理：自动识别本机代理端口，固定本地入口无感热切换，免 TUN、免改环境变量、无需重启 DSH。支持侧栏、底栏工作台与输入框胶囊一键启停，内嵌链路拓扑图。

items.de: LLM approval answerer for sandbox escalations beyond workspace-write: a deterministic regex filter first, then a clean-context reviewer model; humans are asked only when it is unsure. Requires the bundled core patches.
items.dz: 沙箱越权审批的 LLM 应答器：先过确定性正则过滤，再交给干净上下文的审核模型；拿不准才转人工。需要随附的核心补丁。

items.de: Jev Review approval mode for DSH ^0.2.2-rc.1, reviewing each native/PTC inner tool call through System One (Jev or D3), with audit logs and a settings UI; requires the companion Jev host extension. Fork of gbthui/dsh-auto-review; do not install it alongside the upstream, as both gate the same tool-c
items.dz: 面向 DSH ^0.2.2-rc.1 的 Jev Review 审批模式：通过 System One（Jev／D3）逐次审查原生及 PTC 内层工具调用，提供审计日志和设置页；需配套 Jev 宿主扩展。fork 自 gbthui/dsh-auto-review；请勿与上游同装，两者都会接管工具调用的审批判定。

items.de: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
items.dz: Codex 风格自动审查权限模式：新增 auto-review 权限档，自动放行安全沙箱提权，危险或模糊操作转人工确认，未确认的致命操作直接拒绝。

items.de: Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.
items.dz: 思考时自动展开、结束时自动折叠，展开与收起都带高度与透明度过渡；侧边栏开关只控制是否自动，动画始终生效。

items.de: Windows only; the upgrade path needs DSH_AUTO_UPDATE_LAUNCH_CMD configured. Checks, installs and rolls back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page, switching the launcher pointer only after the new version passes a config-tree check and a health-checked restart, and reverting automa
items.dz: 仅 Windows；升级路径需配置 DSH_AUTO_UPDATE_LAUNCH_CMD。在 Web 设置页检查、安装、回滚 DeepSeek Harness CLI 更新：新版本装上后先过配置树检查与健康重启，通过才切换启动指针，起不来就自动退回旧版本。

items.de: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
items.dz: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

items.de: Drives the installed AutoCAD over COM and exposes it to the agent as 18 mcp__autocad__ tools: connect and status, cancel the current command, list registered ProgIDs, list or create documents, save, create and list layers, draw lines, circles, rectangles, polylines, arcs and text, list entities, zoo
items.dz: 通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD，把它暴露成 18 个 mcp__autocad__ 工具：连接与状态、取消当前命令、列出本机注册的 ProgID、列出或新建文档、保存、新建与列出图层、绘制直线/圆/矩形/多段线/圆弧/文字、列出图元、缩放到范围，以及透传任意 AutoCAD 原生命令。侧边栏面板托管驱动它的 Python 桥进程——启动、停止、重启、安装依赖、实时日志与崩溃自动重启——所有路径在运行时解析，同一个 bundle 在 Web 版与桌面版都能用。仅 Windows，Python 3.10-3.12，文档覆盖 AutoCAD 2022-2024（默认 2024；其他版本

items.de: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
items.dz: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

items.de: Windows boot autostart and one-click restart for the DSH service, from inside DSH: a resident supervisor that outlives the host, so a failed restart cannot leave DSH down; DSH spawned attached to a hidden console the supervisor owns, so no console window appears; plus a restart button, the current t
items.dz: Windows 平台的 DSH 服务开机自启与一键重启（都在 DSH 设置页内）：由常驻看护进程启动 DSH，它活得比 DSH 久，因此重启失败不会让 DSH 停摆；DSH 依附在看护进程的隐藏控制台上，不再每条命令弹一个控制台窗口；另有设置页重启按钮、当前带 token 的访问地址与可选的服务启动后钩子。

items.de: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
items.dz: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

items.de: Scheduled update checks for DeepSeek Harness itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows — four schedule modes (daily, every N hours/days/minutes), bidirectional plugin whitelist, disk-verified installs, and a web settings panel with hot-reload config.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 定时自动更新插件：本体与已装插件一并检查，仅在空闲窗口执行。四种调度模式（每日/每N小时/每N天/每N分钟）、双向白名单、磁盘回读验证、内嵌设置面板热生效。

items.de: Moves the sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip with four placements, including a zero-height inline mode in the brand row, and three heights down to an avatar-only row, with adjustable spacing and a settings card on the Plugins page, while other plugins' footer widgets stay pinned at the b
items.dz: 把侧栏底部的账号头像移出，支持四种位置（含零高度的品牌行内嵌）、三档高度（最小仅头像）、可调间距，并在插件页提供设置卡；其他插件的底栏小组件保持原位贴底。

items.de: Installs a skill-router skill that semantically searches a local skill corpus on demand, keeping the corpus out of the per-turn model catalog.
items.dz: 安装一个 skill 路由技能：按需对本地技能库做语义检索，让庞大的技能库不占每轮的模型目录。

items.de: Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.
items.dz: Azure 资源管理：查询/展示资源、部署 Bicep/ARM 模板、查看活动日志。

items.de: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer with a 5-day spending chart.
items.dz: 在侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击展开最近 5 天消费柱状图。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: DeepSeek account balance and model cost tracking with official peak/off-peak pricing, three-tier token billing (cache miss, cache hit, output), per-model and per-session breakdowns, a composer summary bar with hover details, CSV export, and a settings panel.
items.dz: DeepSeek 账户余额与模型消耗：官方价格表分高峰/空闲时段计价，三档计费口径（缓存未命中/命中/输出），按模型与会话统计，主页摘要条悬停明细，支持导出 CSV 与重置记录。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a d
items.dz: 读取当前 DSH 路由背后的 API 余额或订阅余量——包括经控制面读取 OpenDesign（AMR）的钱包与 Design Plan 窗口——绝不猜数字：查不到时如实说明原因（仅解析失败时附原始响应）；OpenDesign 需先 `vela login` 或在桌面端写入 `~/.amr/config.json` 的 controlKey。

items.de: Monitors multi-provider balances, DeepSeek peak/off-peak usage costs, per-session analytics, and configurable spending limits in the DSH sidebar.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏监控多个平台的余额，统计 DeepSeek 峰谷用量成本与会话消耗，并支持配置消费上限。

items.de: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Shows the selected provider's balance below the Harness composer and estimates spend from observed balance drops.
items.dz: 跟随所选模型供应商显示余额，并根据观察到的余额下降估算消耗。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A TRAE-宝-style personal assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session long-term memory, auto-extracted candidate memories, first-time onboarding, a dedicated assistant agent preset, scheduled daily digest, desktop notifications, and a live overview panel.
items.dz: DSH 宝 —— TRAE 宝式个人助理插件：跨会话长期记忆、自动候选记忆提取、首次启动引导、专属助理 Agent 预设、定时每日简报、桌面通知与实时工作状态面板。

items.de: Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
items.dz: DSH 权限守卫：原生权限菜单里的四范围读写执行权限位，bash 命令可选 Jev 语义分类层。

items.de: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.
items.dz: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

items.de: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.
items.dz: Windows 上的一键 Git Bash 开关，替换四种内置模式的 PowerShell，极简模式保留持久终端。

items.de: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 新手的说人话需求路由面板：用本地关键词引擎把一句大白话需求路由成可直接用的方案（提问话术变体、匹配技能、进阶玩法），选中的方案可一键填入新会话。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off
items.dz: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

items.de: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-cli
items.dz: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上的 0.2.x（已在 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20+。由 buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note（MIT）派生、并受 MichengAI/dsh-btw（Apache-2.0）启发；不要与 dsh-questio

items.de: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
items.dz: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

items.de: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with uncompleted/completed filters and incremental loading, items that open read-only with an edit toggle in the corner, image attachments that zoom
items.dz: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板——窗口可拖动并吸附屏幕四边，首页按「今天/更多」分组，另有全部事项标签页（未完成/已完成筛选、增量加载），条目默认只读查看、点右上角「编辑」才可修改，图片附件点击放大、其它附件点击下载，内置番茄钟（15/30/45/60 或自定义，可设轮数与休息间隔）到点推送 Windows 通知并在进入下一阶段前等待确认，另提供 5 个 agent 工具与 /todo 斜杠命令读写任务。

items.de: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
items.dz: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

items.de: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
items.dz: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

items.de: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of e
items.dz: 按时间做模型路由：在设置页定义工作日峰谷时段与各时段使用的 Provider/模型（候选来自 harness 已注册的 API 与订阅账号），打开开关后由该策略决定每次请求的模型与思考档。开关按会话独立，会话列表每行带指示灯显示各自状态，设置页顶部写明此刻生效的模型与原因。无任何时段命中的日子（周末、假期）使用第一个方案的主力模型；高级思考模型是另一根轴，只在会话自身要求 max 思考时使用。

items.de: A liquid-glass skin built on your current desktop wallpaper: the wallpaper is blurred and veiled into the window canvas, panels stay translucent, and every surface that carries text (composer, code blocks, preview pane, menus) gets its own frost level so nothing is washed out. Apple-style liquid-gla
items.dz: 以当前桌面壁纸为基础做模糊处理的液态玻璃换肤：壁纸被模糊并蒙一层白纱作为整窗画布，侧栏与聊天面板保持半透明；输入框、代码块、预览面板、菜单等承载文字的表面按可读性分档加磨砂，控件为 Apple 液态玻璃质感。Windows 上读取当前桌面壁纸作为画布，其他平台回退到自绘渐变。

items.de: Bilibili autopilot run by a local Ollama model: it picks videos within per-topic quota, reads subtitles, hot comments and keyframes, decides whether a reply is warranted, then writes and posts one comment through a five-level safety gate. Triggered by dsh-schedule; write tools are not registered whi
items.dz: 本地模型刷 B 站：由 Ollama 小模型按题材配额挑片，读字幕、热评与关键帧，判断要不要评论，再经五档安全闸写出并发布。节奏由 dsh-schedule 触发；未开启写权限时不注册写工具。v1.1 收紧写路径：撤权改为运行时状态（每次发送前检查）、发布原子化、风控错误会持久化为暂停、发前复核人设风格。需 Python 3.10+ 并装好仓库里的 requirements.txt。

items.de: Windows only. Bilibili video summarizer: downloads the audio track, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper (Python + faster-whisper, about 725 MB of models on first run), then writes the analysis markdown and renders a one-page infographic PNG.
items.dz: 仅 Windows。B 站视频一键总结：下载音轨并用 faster-whisper 本地转写（需 Python 与 faster-whisper，首次运行下载约 725 MB 模型），随后生成解析 md 与一页「一图读懂」PNG。

items.de: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
items.dz: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

items.de: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

items.de: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
items.dz: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

items.de: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
items.dz: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

items.de: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web sur
items.dz: 让 XP 时代的风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃界面同框的主题：DeepSeek Harness Web 界面 之下的固定壁纸底板、经主题 token 应用的面板玻璃样式、支持导入自定义图片的 壁纸选择器与明暗切换按钮——桌面与移动端均可使用。

items.de: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
items.dz: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

items.de: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
items.dz: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放一段开机视频，播完才露出界面，按 Esc 可跳过。

items.de: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.
items.dz: 网页界面的启动动画：页面加载时蓝鲸由下往上被墨色淹没成黑鲸，随后左移、从身后拉出 | deepseek HARNESS 字标，再把窗口交给应用。

items.de: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory
items.dz: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

items.de: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags
items.dz: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

items.de: A floating Bot / ADE switch for the DSH web UI. One click moves between ds-bot's Bot surface and the classic DSH Agent surface, while ds-bot keeps running with its data untouched.
items.dz: 悬浮在 DSH 界面上的 Bot / ADE 切换开关：一键在 ds-bot 的 Bot 界面与经典 DSH Agent 界面之间切换，ds-bot 保持加载、数据不受影响。

items.de: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, w
items.dz: 一个制动踏板自检彩蛋。DSH 网页界面上有一颗可拖动的胶囊，做六脚全力制动测试：支架在第二到第六脚之间伪随机地断裂，也可能整轮通过，随后弹出一份虚构通报。踏板力由会话事实推导并在界面上标为推导值，而这些事实取自真实会话日志。它从不拦截、延迟或接管真实的停止动作。

items.de: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
items.dz: 为相关 DSH 会话分支记录人工决策：保留、淘汰或待跟进，并保存理由、标签与外部链接。

items.de: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
items.dz: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

items.de: Project canvas for DSH sessions, with linked conversation cards, text-selection follow-up branches, notes, and a document-style reader.
items.dz: 为 DSH 项目提供会话画布，支持对话卡片连线、选中文字创建追问分支、笔记和文档式阅读。

items.de: Registers Brave as the web_search provider, resolving the API key from the DSH credential store, $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml, or the environment. No settings card and no fallback engine: one request to Brave's Web Search API per search.
items.dz: 把 Brave 注册为 web_search 的搜索提供方，API Key 依次从 DSH 凭证库、$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml 或环境变量读取。无设置卡片、无备用引擎：每次搜索向 Brave Web Search API 发起一次请求。

items.de: Slash commands ported from other coding agents (setup, connect, install, trust, browse, doctor, status, model, memory, compact, resume, review, mcp, init, suggest, improve, refactor), a zero-dependency static scanner for plugin source, and an in-repo catalog of audited plugin report cards that cite
items.dz: 从其他编码 Agent 移植过来的斜杠命令（setup、connect、install、trust、browse、doctor、status、model、memory、compact、resume、review、mcp、init、suggest、improve、refactor），一个零依赖的插件源码静态扫描器，以及一份内置的插件评级报告卡目录，每条结论都给出文件与行号级别的证据。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.169.254

items.de: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and paym
items.dz: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端

items.de: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

items.de: 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser ins
items.dz: 19 个 browser_* 工具，让 agent 通过回环桥驱动 DSH 内置的侧边栏浏览器：带稳定 ref 的无障碍树读取、CDP 真实点击与按键、截图、网络拦截、设备模拟、Cookie 保险库、document-start 脚本注入、多浏览器实例，以及任意 CDP 命令透传。需以 --remote-debugging-port=9222 启动 DSH。

items.de: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.
items.dz: 输入 /tabs 弹出浏览器标签页选择器，点选后链接自动填入输入框。

items.de: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
items.dz: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

items.de: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as
items.dz: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

items.de: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
items.dz: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

items.de: Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.
items.dz: 使用当前会话上下文进行侧边提问，支持独立流式回复与取消。

items.de: One-off btw side questions that inherit the current DSH session, with selectable context ranges and an optional compressed summary you review before sending it into the main session.
items.dz: 在当前 DSH 会话里发起一次性 btw 旁问，可选上下文范围；旁问默认不写入会话，可把压缩摘要预览确认后送入主会话。

items.de: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

items.de: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count,
items.dz: 一个对话文风层：谈到「便宜的路有坑」这类取舍时，把警告换成另一种说法——快而便宜的是隔壁黑心店，慢而可靠的老店在立规矩。附带改写引擎，可把任意文本拧成固定骨架的对白，有五个互相独立的旋钮（幕数、招牌台词密度、收尾走向、种子、预设档）；一个四档强度滑条；以及 /bushaoxin 命令，按会话的工具调用记录生成一份段子式的「烧心指数」病历。每篇改写末尾永远附一行真实技术结论，不可关闭。零依赖、无构建步骤，引擎是纯函数。

items.de: Clean Architecture reference library for DSH: 8 pinned reference repos (Go, Java, C#, Python) indexed into a local FTS5 database, with assertion rules, a review ledger, and a read-only observation panel.
items.dz: DSH 的 Clean Architecture 参考库:8 个钉版参考仓(Go / Java / C# / Python)索引进本地 FTS5,提供断言规则、审查台账与只读观察窗面板。

items.de: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
items.dz: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

items.de: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
items.dz: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

items.de: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏里的纯记事本日历：周一起始的 70 天网格，格子里直接显示当天内容；每天一条，写进你自己指定的 .xlsx，沿用 DesktopCal 两列格式（Excel 日期序列号 + 自由文本，新日期在前）。点某天即打开该日编辑框；导入导出走同一格式，导入先预览，冲突可选保留、覆盖、拼接或跳过。

items.de: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框里加一条档位条：思考三档（常规 / 严格 / 极致）、互斥的循环模式三档（3 / 5 / 8 轮）、可叠加的对抗审查开关；模型通过 clarify_tier 与 forge_level 两个工具读取当前档位。

items.de: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的极端 LLM 调用压缩：标题生成短路、飞行中请求去重、24 小时回放缓存，并用 `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` 分隔协议把 N 个并行请求批量合并为 1 次上游调用——更少 API 调用、更低开销、相同答案。

items.de: One panel for MCP servers, skills and Claude Code plugins across global/profile/project scopes: live status, import/export, trash & backups, and the official claude-plugins-official market (install/update/uninstall).
items.dz: 一个面板统一管理全局 / Profile / 项目三个作用域的 MCP 服务与技能：实时状态与工具数、导入导出、回收站与备份，并可安装/更新/卸载 Anthropic 官方 claude-plugins-official 市场的 Claude Code 插件。

items.de: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
items.dz: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

items.de: Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect c
items.dz: 在 DSH Web GUI 中加入能力面板：浏览、安装（上传 / zip / 宿主路径 / URL）、启停、编辑与导出技能，新增与编辑 Claude Code 兼容的 MCP 服务器，覆盖全局与项目双作用域（项目副本、屏蔽占位、默认关闭声明），显示实时挂载状态并提供零副作用连通性探测；会话视图只对当前对话开关能力；「Jev 模型」Tab 用 TypeSafe Jev 按输入草稿为本会话技能与 MCP 打分。需 dsh Web 外壳 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上。fork 自 chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel；与其及 pure-craft/dsh-capab

items.de: Registers 12 CatPaw (妙手) models as a DeepSeek Harness provider, with per-model reasoning effort, harness-executed tool calls, and QR-code login. The bundled catpaw-cli is a macOS arm64 binary (other platforms must supply their own copy), and calls use the signed-in CatPaw account quota.
items.dz: 把妙手（CatPaw）的 12 个模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持按模型区分的推理档位、由 Harness 执行的工具调用与扫码登录。内置 catpaw-cli 仅提供 macOS arm64 版本（其它平台需自备），调用消耗妙手账号额度。

items.de: Claude Code-compatible persistent memory: the host injects the MEMORY.md index at session start, the model maintains memory files with plain read/write/edit tools, and a Settings page lists saved memories. Same on-disk format as Claude Code; claude mode shares the exact memory directory.
items.dz: Claude Code 兼容的持久记忆：每个会话开始时自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，模型用普通 read/write/edit 文件工具维护记忆，Settings 内置记忆列表页。落盘格式与 Claude Code 完全一致，claude 模式直接共享同一记忆目录。

items.de: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 持久记忆插件：记忆读写/检索工具、回合自动记录、项目作用域召回注入、管理界面，可非破坏导入 Claude Code 记忆。

items.de: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing,
items.dz: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

items.de: Self-editing desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a full dsh web replica with an edit mode in which the agent modifies the workbench (patch layers, plugins, UI) with hot reload.
items.dz: 可自修改的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：完整 dsh web 副本 + 编辑模式，agent 在对话中实时修改工作台（补丁层、插件、UI）并热更新生效。

items.de: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
items.dz: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

items.de: Live change review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session, lists changed files above the composer and opens each file's line-level diff in a plugin-registered right-sidebar tab, with session-log / initial-version / Git comparison modes, per-change and per-file revert, subagen
items.dz: 实时审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用，改动列表常驻输入框上方，点开即在插件自注册的右侧栏标签页里查看行级 diff，支持「会话记录 / 初始版本 / Git 版本」三种对比、单项与整文件撤回、子代理聚合与 SSE 实时刷新，配色可自定义；fork 自 cirelir/dsh-change-review，审查界面整体重构到右侧栏。

items.de: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
items.dz: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

items.de: Repairs dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, so DSH survives when codex or Claude Code is detected. Warning: install it together with the crasher; it cannot revive a host that has already exited. Joke plugin.
items.dz: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher 的引信，让 DSH 在检测到 codex / Claude Code 时也不退出。警告：必须和一号插件一起装；宿主已经退出后它救不回来。玩笑插件。

items.de: Repairs dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, keeping the four-plugin chaos chain stable. Warning: it only disarms this specific crash, not arbitrary uncaught exits. Joke plugin.
items.dz: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher 的引信，让四个插件互相咬的链子保持稳定。警告：它只拆这一种崩溃，不处理其它未捕获退出。玩笑插件。

items.de: Exits the DSH host with code 1 when the dsh-chaos-crash-fixer repair plugin is installed. Warning: it crashes DSH on boot while the repair plugin is present; install dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer to disarm it. Joke plugin.
items.dz: 发现 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer（修复器）在岗就让 DSH 宿主以 1 退出。警告：修复器在的时候它会开机即崩，必须装 dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer 拆引信。玩笑插件。

items.de: Detects codex or Claude Code on the machine and exits the DSH host with code 66. Warning: on machines with either tool, installing it alone causes a boot crash loop; pair it with dsh-chaos-crash-fixer or set DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log. Joke plugin, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
items.dz: 检测到电脑上的 codex 或 Claude Code 就让 DSH 宿主以 66 退出。警告：在装有 codex 或 Claude Code 的机器上单装会变成启动崩溃循环，请先装 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer，或设 DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log。这是玩笑插件，与 OpenAI、Anthropic 无关。

items.de: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak t
items.dz: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

items.de: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, ope
items.dz: 给 DSH 对话区加右键菜单：复制选中内容或整条消息；把消息图片和点击预览后的大图复制为 PNG 到剪贴板或另存为文件；识别绝对路径、相对会话工作区的路径、~/ 以及代码内联路径，一键打开、 在文件管理器中显示、用其他应用打开、复制绝对/相对路径；链接可打开或复制。所有候选路径都会 先由 Host 文件系统校验存在性，再显示打开项。

items.de: Keeps a panel of what you must do, what you can apply for and what is worth knowing, distilled from your WeChat and QQ chat logs by one resident agent session that re-reads them on a schedule or when you click Fetch; each item can link straight to its source file or image.
items.dz: 把微信与 QQ 聊天记录里「必须做的、可以报名的、值得知道的」摘成一张面板：由一个常驻会话按计划或在你点 Fetch 时重读聊天记录并改写条目，每条可直链到原始文件或图片。

items.de: Open and copy local files and web links from a chat turn.
items.dz: 打开和复制本轮的本地文件与网页链接。

items.de: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
items.dz: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

items.de: CLI-style chat history recall for the DSH input box: press ArrowUp/ArrowDown to recall previously sent messages.
items.dz: 给 DSH 聊天输入框加 CLI 风格历史记忆：按上下方向键召回之前发送过的消息。

items.de: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
items.dz: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

items.de: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
items.dz: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

items.de: Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog
items.dz: 在 DSH 桌面版标题栏加入聊天/工作切换：聊天模式用原生 webview 内嵌 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com），插件自身不调用 DSH API，首次启动默认进入聊天；工作模式保留原生 Agent 界面，切换时网页保持挂载；「带入工作」对话框需先确认，只会填入工作模式草稿、不自动发送。

items.de: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

items.de: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.
items.dz: 设置DSH Harness对话流字体、字号行间距，以及对话文字到窗口边缘的留白。

items.de: Desktop pet for DSH with voice chat, personas, memory, Bilibili and QQ context, and command-gated computer control; enable DSH built-in voice input first to use voice chat. A fork of dsh-pet (MIT), not installable alongside the original.
items.dz: DSH 桌面宠物：语音聊天、多人设、聊天记忆、B 站视频与 QQ 群记忆（只读本地文件）；「电脑操作」需在面板里显式打开总开关后才响应语音指令，语音聊天需先在 DSH 中启用内置语音输入。dsh-pet（MIT）的 fork，不能与原版同时安装。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
items.dz: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

items.de: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.
items.dz: 在输入框左侧加一个中文模式开关，点开可分别切换回复、思考与工具说明的语言，配置随 profile 持久化。

items.de: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minim
items.dz: 让所有会话的思考与回复都说中文：简洁、略沾文言、说人话，专有名词保留英文原形；并附一条「只答所问、不主动跑命令、动手前先提醒」的交互偏好。实现只是一条全局 system-prompt 段落（order 10）：没有界面、没有二进制、不联网。切到极简预设时不生效——那个预设会把整个 prompt 换成它自己的人设。

items.de: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.
items.dz: Chrome DevTools Protocol 插件 for DeepSeek Harness。通过 chromremote-interface 以 CDP 连接并操控 Chrome。连接带有图形界面。

items.de: Control the Chrome browser you are already using: open new tabs or reuse your logged-in tabs, so the model can read pages, click, fill inputs, drag page elements, scroll, take screenshots, open tabs in groups and close the tabs it opened, inspect console and network logs, and debug the browser. Requ
items.dz: 操纵你正在使用的 Chrome 浏览器：新建或复用已登录的标签页，让模型读取页面、点击、填写、拖拽页面元素、滚动、截图，新建标签页并分组、关闭本会话打开的标签页，并查看控制台与网络日志，调试浏览器等。需要 Chrome 120 或更新版本；扩展从 Chrome 应用商店安装，用 8 位配对码连接。

items.de: GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 化身 GitHub 副驾：PR 审查、CI 失败修复、Issue 分类与自动发版说明。

items.de: Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的出网流量走本地 Clash 代理，代理关闭时自动回落直连。

items.de: Drives the Claude desktop app from DSH over its claude:// deep links: open a Claude Code session with a prompt and folders, a Cowork task with files, or push a CLI session id back into the app. Also presses Ctrl+Enter for you (SendKeys) and reads the reply back from the local Claude Code transcripts
items.dz: 用桌面端自己的 claude:// 深链把活派过去：开新 Claude Code 会话（带 prompt、目录）、带文件开 Cowork 任务、把 CLI 会话 id 交回应用；再代按 Ctrl+Enter 发送，并从本机 Claude Code 的 transcript（~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl）把回答读回来。七个工具：desktop_send / desktop_continue / desktop_open / desktop_sessions / desktop_read / desktop_wait / desktop_pro

items.de: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
items.dz: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

items.de: Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the sam
items.dz: Claude Code Desktop 风格的选区引用：在对话里选中文字，可在弹窗里针对这段话回复，或把当前会话 fork 成右侧栏的侧边对话并带上引用。引用以可移除的卡片放在输入框上方，按与 Claude Code Desktop 相同的格式作为纯 Markdown 引用块发送，已发送消息里显示为可折叠的引用块。

items.de: Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.
items.dz: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

items.de: Cleanup Mode agent preset for DSH: read-only scans of leftovers (including duplicate detection), a manifest before anything is deleted, trash-first removal only after confirmation, and a per-session audit log. Cleaning outside the workspace requires a danger-full-access session; under workspace-writ
items.dz: DSH 清理模式 agent 预设：只读扫描残留（含重复文件检测），删除前先出清单，确认后优先移入回收站，并按会话写审计记录。清理工作区之外的位置需要 danger-full-access 会话；workspace-write 下只能检查并会提示你提升权限。

items.de: A deliberately context-free chat panel in the right sidebar: it sends only a one-line system prompt plus what you type there, with no tools, no session history and no fork of the current conversation, and keeps the panel history in memory. Each reply reports its own token usage, plus the cache hit r
items.dz: 在右侧栏加一个刻意「无上下文」的对话面板：只发一句系统提示和你在面板里输入的内容，不带工具、不复制当前会话、不派生分支，面板历史只存在内存里。每条回复下方显示本轮 token 用量；在返回缓存统计的路由上同时显示缓存命中率。

items.de: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.
items.dz: DSH 桌面壳增强版：启动即自动拉起后端（不弹浏览器）、退出时询问是否关闭后端、后端与窗口并行启动加速冷启动。基于 dsh-clean-desktop-shell 的 fork。

items.de: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置中统计本地 Token 用量，支持小时活动图、日历热力图、自定义日期、模型用量分布、本地/API 筛选和原生缓存命中口径，不估算费用，不替换输入框状态栏。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高兼容版本。

items.de: 64-entry external CLI catalog with bounded public discovery and guarded package-manager or manual official installation, exposed through DSH tools and a standalone command.
items.dz: 包含 64 个条目的外部 CLI 清单，支持受限公开来源发现，并通过 DSH 工具和独立命令行提供受保护的包管理器或官方手动安装。

items.de: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
items.dz: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

items.de: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.
items.dz: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

items.de: Aqua glass theme adapted for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with floating glass sidebars and fixes for Windows sidebar and titlebar controls.
items.dz: 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Aqua 玻璃主题，提供悬浮玻璃侧栏，并修复 Windows 侧栏和标题栏控件布局。

items.de: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

items.de: Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.
items.dz: 给 DSH Web 客户端用的 Minecraft 风格皮肤：MC 调色板与像素立体边框、像素标志图、开关图案、设置里两个可持久化的开关，以及由 Host 半边按需发货的 16 MB Minecraft AE 像素字体。

items.de: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.
items.dz: 在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

items.de: Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.
items.dz: 输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。

items.de: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
items.dz: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

items.de: Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI wh
items.dz: 屏幕截图与外部视觉识别：take_screenshot、list_windows、analyze_image、view_image 四个工具，可配置 GPT 视觉通道（gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra），API Key 经凭据服务存储，带设置卡片；view_image 在 Web 对话中显示截图，模型上下文只保留文字。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Injects the current date and time into the runtime context on every turn, so the agent can read the time instead of inferring it.
items.dz: 每一轮把当前日期时间注入运行上下文，让 agent 能读到准确时间而不是靠推算。

items.de: Task timing for DSH agents: a task_clock tool that measures elapsed time on the host monotonic clock, resumes across DSH or system restarts with the gap estimated, and returns unknown rather than inventing a number; it does not touch presets.
items.dz: 给 DSH Agent 的任务计时工具：task_clock 用宿主单调时钟测实际耗时，DSH 或系统重启后可续算并标注空档为估算，桥接不了时返回 unknown 而不是编造数字；不覆盖任何 preset。
