items.dz: dsh-company：多智能体 AI 团队、子智能体公司。员工管理、CEO 认单派活、n8n 式工作流编排：拖拽员工节点到画布、连线、并行执行。DeepSeek Harness 插件，七个内置角色（项目总监、产品经理、技术总监、工程师、数据分析师、测试工程师、审核员），每人各有人设、模型与工具白名单。任务广播下去，员工自己决定接不接——回复第一行必须是【接单】或【不接】——接单的人并行开工，而不是走流水线。工作流画布用开始节点串起员工节点，用 {{input}} 引用上游产出，图按拓扑分层执行：跨员工并行、同员工串行、上游失败下游自动跳过。附员工管理、任务板与员工对话详情的网页面板，/dsh

items.de: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
items.dz: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

items.de: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superse
items.dz: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

items.de: Adds next-message prediction, inline draft completion, and prompt optimization to the DSH composer, with a call budget, request stats, and glossary protection in Settings. A fork of Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant; both put their controls on the same composer, so do not install the two together.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框中提供下一句预测、输入续写和提示词优化，并在设置页提供调用额度、请求统计和术语保护。基于 Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant 改造的分支，两者都在同一个输入框上加控件，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.
items.dz: DSH 聊天输入框的括号/引号自动配对：输入左半边自动补右半边并把光标停在中间；也支持用符号包裹选中文字，以及中文输入法提交的括号。

items.de: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.
items.dz: 启动器面板：统管能力组合、插件清单与 MCP 桥，并引导安装浏览器标签页扩展。

items.de: Type Markdown, see it rendered live — Open-WebUI-style composer for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web, with syntax-highlighted code blocks, task lists, format toolbars and smart paste.
items.dz: 打 Markdown，边打边渲染——给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 输入框带来 Open WebUI 风格的实时编辑体验，代码块语法高亮、任务列表、格式工具栏、智能粘贴。

items.de: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.
items.dz: 在一轮对话结束后，用灰字在空的输入框里给出下一句建议；Tab 填入草稿，Esc 或打字忽略。

items.de: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
items.dz: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

items.de: Adds a drag handle above the chat composer so its height can be set by hand at any content length, with double-click to restore auto-grow capped at 168px.
items.dz: 给聊天输入框加一条拖动把手，任何内容长度下都能手动设定高度；双击恢复自动增高（上限 168px）。

items.de: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
items.dz: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

items.de: Three-tier deny/ask/auto gate for the computer-use (cua-driver) tool family: each tool category gets one segmented control in Settings, and an allow list or deny list overrides the tiers per tool name.
items.dz: 给 computer-use（cua-driver）工具族加三档「禁止 / 询问 / 自动授权」闸门：每个工具类别在设置里各占一个分段控件，另可用放行名单或拒绝名单按工具名覆盖档位。

items.de: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and rep
items.dz: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差

items.de: Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.
items.dz: DSH 启动时扫描加载器中的插件冲突（重复挂载、启动失败、依赖缺失、配置行 id 重复），自动停用或恢复冲突插件，并在 Web 界面弹出冲突报告。

items.de: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
items.dz: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。

items.de: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.
items.dz: 注册千问办公（QwenWork）模型提供器，复用桌面客户端的本机登录态，在 127.0.0.1 起一个 OpenAI 兼容回环桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成上游真正使用的 ACP 控制信封对话协议。

items.de: Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.
items.dz: 复用超算互联网（SCNet）计算服务客户端已写入的 API key，把它的模型接入 DSH，带 30 个模型的目录与逐模型默认思考档位。

items.de: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
items.dz: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

items.de: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convent
items.dz: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

items.de: Per-step context ledger for dsh: measures what every step actually re-sends, then offers three opt-in gates — a schema-budgeted tool table, long-tail result externalization, and duplicate-read pointers. In the author's A/B test the tool-table gate cut 16,110 first-step prompt tokens (-49.7%), about
items.dz: 每步上下文账本：量化每步重发量，并提供三个可单独开关的闸门——按 schema 体积裁工具表、长结果外置、重复读回指针。 作者 A/B 实测，工具表闸门省首步 16,110 token（-49.7%），长会话每步上下文约降 23%。 v0.3.1 新增只读 /budget-doctor 自检、spill 索引维护与增速预测。

items.de: One-click context compression for the dsh web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
items.dz: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

items.de: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
items.dz: 上下文用量环，支持按字符自定义自动压缩阈值、手动压缩、保留用户要求和回查原文，适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

items.de: Indexes each chat of a workspace into a small topic graph every 4 turns (one model call, verbatim source kept under .context-graph/), appends up to 5 matching topics from the other chats to each message, searching a named day such as "yesterday" first, and adds a recall tool that returns the origina
items.dz: 每 4 轮把工作区里的每个对话索引成小型主题图谱（一次模型调用，原文保存在 .context-graph/），在每条消息末尾附上其他对话中最多 5 个匹配主题，提到“昨天”等时间时先搜那一天，并提供 recall 工具按主题、对话、日期或轮次取回原文。默认开启并共享；/context-graph off 与 unshare 可让某个对话退出，stats、build、map、find 用于查看。

items.de: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route realWindows with windowSource evidence, routeKey, handoffAt forced-handoff line, and slash commands.
items.dz: 新增交接、上下文决策、上下文诊断三个技能，自带 context_pressure/context_history 工具（峰值 token、压缩复盘），支持按线路实测窗口 realWindows（含 windowSource 证据）、routeKey 直出与 handoffAt 强制交接线，附斜杠命令。

items.de: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
items.dz: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

items.de: A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the
items.dz: 输入框工具行里、紧挨发送键左侧的「继续」按钮：点一下就把续接指令写进草稿并提交，让中断的任务接着跑，不用重新交代上下文。指令会写明中断原因，并附上当前任务与上一轮回复的结尾片段；按住 Alt 点击或右键点击只发裸的「继续」，草稿非空时只追加不覆盖。

items.de: Adds a Continue button to the composer dock and resumes automatically when a turn is cut off by a network drop or an upstream output-limit cut. A resident link monitor asks every 10 seconds whether the network is back, because the link returning fires no event, and a turn that completes normally cou
items.dz: 在输入框停靠区加一个「继续」按钮，并在某一轮被断网或上游输出超限截断时自动续跑。常驻的链路监测每 10 秒问一次网络是否回来（链路恢复本身不发任何事件），而一个正常跑完的回合会被当作链路可用的证据。点击走宿主真实的提交链路（beginSubmission + session.prompt），消息带的是真实用户署名而不是伪造来源，真实拒绝会被如实报告而不是重试。宿主重启时还会扫描最近的会话日志，同时识别「宿主半路走了」的两种指纹：回合没关，以及被 disposed 关掉的回合（正常关闭宿主写下的正是这一种）。用户自己按过停止的回合永不续跑。

items.de: Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.
items.dz: 持久化项目记忆、事件溯源的任务生命周期、上下文预算控制与多智能体协作交接。

items.de: Shows a 0-100 conversation coherence badge and commentary by running parallel contradiction analysis on the live DSH session, with a manual trigger and interval-based auto-analysis (on by default, editable per session or globally).
items.dz: 对当前 DSH 会话做并行矛盾分析，在会话标题栏显示 0–100 连贯性徽章与评注，支持手动触发和按轮数的自动分析（默认开启，可按会话或全局调整）。

items.de: GitHub-style contribution grid in the Web sidebar showing how many prompts you sent each day, with a switch to count conversations, total tokens or output tokens instead. Counts only messages you sent yourself; injected context is excluded.
items.dz: Web 侧边栏的 GitHub 风格日历网格，按天展示你发出的对话条数，可切换为会话数、Token 总量或输出 Token。只统计你亲手发送的消息，注入的上下文不计入。

items.de: Live per-turn progress capsule with an empirical ETA table and a click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.
items.dz: 在输入框下方常驻显示当前对话的进度与预估剩余时间，点击可回看该会话的历史任务记录。

items.de: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
items.dz: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

items.de: A left-sidebar gallery of every file the assistant wrote, edited or delivered across all conversations, grouped by file type with preview thumbnails and one-click open. Document previews and the open / open-with / Trash actions require macOS; the gallery, text previews and filters work anywhere.
items.dz: 左侧栏画廊：汇总所有对话里助手写入、修改或交付的文件，按类型分组、显示预览缩略图，点击即可用默认应用打开。文档预览与「用默认应用打开 / 选择应用 / 移到废纸篓」需要 macOS；画廊本身、文本预览与筛选在任何平台可用。

items.de: Reference other conversations from the current one — type @ to attach a session's record, drag a sidebar conversation into the composer, or open any conversation, tick single messages and insert them into another one.
items.dz: 在当前对话里引用别的对话：输入 @ 附加某段对话的记录，从左侧栏把对话拖进输入框，或打开任意对话、勾选其中几条消息插入到另一个对话中。

items.de: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.
items.dz: DSH 对话地图：当前工作区全部会话的实时树状图，子代理谱系、运行状态一目了然，双击即跳转。

items.de: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
items.dz: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

items.de: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is
items.dz: 在会话列表菜单或会话页头部删除对话，可勾选一并删除该对话关联的记忆节点（确认框先显示命中条数）；删除进入插件回收站可恢复，每次操作写入审计日志，批量删除有限流与逐会话回滚。

items.de: Star conversation exchanges and edit any sent user message in the native composer while keeping previous conversation versions. Supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
items.dz: 星标重点问答，在原生输入框中编辑任意已发送的用户消息，并保留旧对话版本。支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: Recycle bin for conversations - delete a session from the sidebar into a trash folder, undo within 8 seconds, restore or delete forever later.
items.dz: 对话回收站——侧边栏里删除的会话先进入回收站，8 秒内可撤销，之后可恢复或彻底删除。

items.de: Workspace-wide conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: every conversation and branch on one canvas with its source turn, own token usage and notes; compare two branches, bring a summary back, export a Markdown outline, archive (undoable through DSH's native archive), and delete a whole subtree (macO
items.dz: 工作区级对话树：所有对话与分支画在同一块画布上，节点显示来源轮次、各自用量与备注；可并排对比两条分支、把来源会话压缩成摘要带回、导出 Markdown 提纲、归档（走 DSH 原生归档，可撤销），并可删除整棵子树（仅 macOS 与 Windows；删除确认后立即生效且不可撤销）。

items.de: Conversation-map rail down the left edge of the transcript: one tick per user turn, read from the full session log on the host rather than from the rendered page, so long sessions are covered end to end. Hovering fans the neighbouring ticks open by pixel distance and floats a scrollable preview of t
items.dz: 主对话区左缘的对话地图刻度列：每条刻度是一轮用户提问，刻度由宿主直读会话完整日志得来，不受客户端分页窗口限制，长会话也是全量覆盖。hover 时邻近刻度按像素距离连续展开，右侧浮出该轮提问与最后一次回复的预览卡（可进卡滚动看完）；点击跳转到该轮，老轮次尚未渲染时先自动分页加载再跳；滚动对话时当前轮次的刻度保持高亮。

items.de: The cyber-elixir of youth for the desktop client: fixes the `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed` (HTTP 431) launch failure — an Electron random-port launch lets `dsh-auth-*` login cookies pile up per port (70+ of them, ~229 B each), the startup request headers blow past Node's default 16 KB
items.dz: 桌面客户端的赛博端粒不老药：解决启动报 `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`（HTTP 431）的现象——Electron 随机端口启动，`dsh-auth-*` 登录 cookie 随端口越积越多（70 余条、单条约 229 B），启动请求头撑爆 Node 默认 16 KB 上限，客户端直接起不来。两味药：脚本化清理器——报告并清理 cookie 库（Chromium SQLite）里残留的登录凭据，显式、离线、保留 `.bak` 副本，`--expired-only` 可收窄范围；设置面 patch 功能——经由 profile 的 `c

items.de: Windows-only guard against the desktop shell locking itself out: it counts the dsh-auth-* launch cookies the shell has accumulated, reports how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they consume, and once the count passes 40 it backs up the whole Cookies database and lets DSH rebuild it, so every
items.dz: 仅 Windows，防止桌面外壳把自己锁死：数出已累积的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，报出它们占掉 16 KiB 请求头预算的比例；超过 40 条时把整个 Cookies 数据库备份后移走、由 DSH 重建，因此该 profile 下的所有 cookie 都会被清掉。安装只需一条命令：插件加载时自己注册指向包内脚本的每周计划任务，卸载时又把该任务一并删除——不用往用户目录复制文件，也不用手工敲 schtasks。检查本身在应用关闭时执行（会最多等 3 小时让外壳退出）。不抬高请求头预算、不挂常驻浮窗；scripts/ 里的脚本不装应用也能单独跑。

items.de: Caps the lifetime of DSH desktop's dsh-auth-* session cookies at 7 days, so they stop piling up in the Cookie header until startup fails with HTTP 431.

items.dz: DeepSeek API 额度面板折叠为左侧边框把手：点击展开查看余额、官方精确今日已消费（配置平台 token 后）与实时对话费用；dsh-deepseek-quota 的修改版。

Desktop (Electron) only; keeping the login acr
items.dz: 左侧栏一行把 chat.deepseek.com 开进右侧栏标签页，不影响当前对话，可随时全屏；与侧边栏浏览器共用同一 cookie 分区，附带脚本让登录跨重启保留。仅限桌面版（Electron）；跨重启保留登录需运行自带的 PowerShell 补丁，该补丁仅支持 Windows，且每次升级 DSH 后都要重跑。

items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 余额，并在每轮对话底部显示该轮花费（人民币，含搜索请求费用）。需要官方 DeepSeek（deepseek-official）渠道及其 API Key（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），且只在带 Web 界面的 profile 中生效。

items.de: Shows the live DeepSeek account balance in the composer toolbar and prices each completed turn in CNY beside its token usage, using the official peak/off-peak table: peak on Beijing-time weekday mornings and afternoons, valley on weekends and statutory holidays. The balance needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
items.dz: 在输入框工具栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮完成对话的 token 用量旁显示按官方峰谷价计费的人民币金额：北京时间工作日上下午为高峰价，周末与法定节假日为空闲价。余额需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 凭据，仅通过 DeepSeek OAuth 登录的账号不显示余额。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
items.dz: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

items.de: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 对话流的阻塞型工具调用下方显示「已等待/预算」进度条与随进度移动的图片（可换成动图），并提供图形化设置页调整样式与工具列表。

items.de: Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.
items.dz: 智能委派套件：按角色路由最强模型、失败自动互备、每个子代理可设思考强度、名字带模型标签、支持 fork 委派与可视化路由编辑。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

items.de: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
items.dz: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

items.de: DSH design-delivery plugin with 10 tools for UI lint, design tokens, three-candidate shortlists, JND parameter probes, and PPTX deck check/export/render. Deck tools need ppt-master, Python with python-pptx and DSH's LibreOffice Kit; design_capture needs a real browser.
items.dz: DSH 设计交付插件：10 个工具覆盖界面审查、设计 tokens、三方向粗选、JND 参数精调，以及 PPTX 质检/导出/渲染。deck 工具依赖 ppt-master、带 python-pptx 的 Python 与 DSH 自带的 LibreOffice Kit；design_capture 需要真实浏览器。

items.de: Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conf
items.dz: 设计方案与事故教训强制交叉评审：自动识别设计文档写入并入队（tier=review），外部评审结论投递回发起会话，approved 的防复发措施以 append-only + 冲突检测方式追加到守则文件。

items.de: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
items.dz: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

items.de: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI
items.dz: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

items.de: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
items.dz: 把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。

items.de: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

items.de: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications wi
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows，安装包见仓库 Releases，内置 dsh 运行时）：托盘常驻启动器（按 profile 分端口与窗口）、最多自愈 3 次的进程守护、本地或远程 dsh、带 Dock 角标的任务完成通知、实时启动控制台。本插件是该应用的页面内半区——桌面 chrome 与通知桥只在 DSH 运行于桌面应用内时生效；在普通 DSH 里用 `dsh plugin add` 安装时，提供的是随附的「把 DSH Web GUI 打包成 Tauri 应用」技能。

items.de: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
items.dz: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。
rl: runs code at install time (postinstall)

items.de: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
items.dz: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

items.de: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent review, and npm package browsing, packing, pre-publish review and publishing.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。

items.de: Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents (includes Termux companion example).
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Companion 桥：手机 / IoT / 旧世界薄 Agent（含 Termux 样例）。

items.de: GitLab and Kubernetes monitoring for DSH: merge request and pipeline management, deployment and pod status with logs and events, webhook-triggered alerts, and a dashboard UI.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的 GitLab 与 Kubernetes 监控：合并请求与流水线管理、部署与 Pod 状态（含日志与事件）、Webhook 告警，以及仪表盘界面。

items.de: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
items.dz: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

items.de: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
items.dz: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

items.de: Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.
items.dz: 将聊天中的 mermaid 代码块原位渲染为图表（流程图/时序图/类图/状态图/ER图/甘特图/饼图），支持放大、源码切换、复制 PNG 与下载 SVG。

items.de: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.

items.de: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
items.dz: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

items.de: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
items.dz: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

items.de: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.
items.dz: 让 DSH 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的目录开始（仅 Windows），并在设置里提供配置入口；目录不存在时静默回退到原生选择框。

items.de: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown soft
items.dz: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

items.de: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can se
items.dz: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

items.de: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

items.de: Customizes the DSH home sidebar plugin entries without harness source changes: one- or two-column panel list, icon-only mode with 500ms hover tooltips, and per-entry ordering, hiding, and a settings page for the upper panel area and the footer plugin row.
items.dz: 无需改动 Harness 源码即可自定义主页侧边栏的插件入口：上方面板列表支持单栏/双栏与仅图标（悬浮 500ms 显示名称），底部插件行支持默认横向/单列/双列，两个区域均可逐条目排序、显示或隐藏，并提供设置页。

items.de: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
items.dz: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

items.de: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
items.dz: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

items.de: Document review workbench: select text in a Markdown file, leave comments saved as MRSF sidecar files next to it, and let the agent read them with doc_review_* tools and propose edits you accept or reject.
items.dz: 文档批注台：在 Markdown 文档上划词写批注，批注按 MRSF 侧车文件存在文档旁，Agent 用 doc_review_* 工具读取并登记改动提案，你在批注页逐条接受或拒绝。

items.de: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
items.dz: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

items.de: Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.
items.dz: 为「DeepSeek Harness 开关」程序坞应用写出运行中 dsh Web 服务的 PID、端口与带 token 的地址（运行时文件权限 0600），并在退出时删除。

items.de: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
items.dz: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

items.de: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
items.dz: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

items.de: Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
items.dz: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

items.de: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Lon
items.dz: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。只有请求里提到「公文」时才套用版式，用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

items.de: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
items.dz: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

items.de: Keeps an agent working continuously over long stretches: set a deadline, and if it finishes the task early, Dont-Stop automatically nudges it to keep iterating and take on the next step on its own.
items.dz: 保证智能体长时间持续工作：设定一个截止时间，若提前完成任务，Dont-Stop 会自动督促它继续迭代、自主推进下一步任务。

items.de: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
items.dz: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

items.de: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
items.dz: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

items.de: Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium,
items.dz: npm 包名 dsh-doudizhu-lan。三人局域网斗地主，从浮窗里打：一台机器用自己的端口开房，另外两家填六位房间码加地址入座。空位可以交给电脑补，四档强度（简单/中等/困难/地狱）随时可换，一个人或两个人也能打完整一局；座位坐满就发牌。54 张牌四种花色，叫分为 1/2/3 或不叫，地主拿三张底牌共 20 张，顺时针出牌，下局首叫位顺时针轮换。规则引擎为纯函数，覆盖 11 种合法牌型，大王 > 小王 > 2 > A > K 直到 3，花色不参与比较，顺子、连对与飞机不含 2 和王，王炸最大。牌桌本身按「一眼看懂」来做：三张座位卡按出牌顺序并排（我、下家、上家），带身份、剩余张数和一条

items.de: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
items.dz: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

items.de: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
items.dz: DSH 侧栏底部的内嵌抖音窗口：用 Electron webview 租约绕过 douyin.com 的 X-Frame-Options: DENY。仅桌面版。

items.de: Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.
items.dz: DSH 会话头里的下载进度：百分比、速率、剩余时间与阶段，下载前先探测文件大小，中断后按字节区间续传。进度卡片以固定浮层显示在聊天窗口右上角。

items.de: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. Jobs that report nothing show as unknown p
items.dz: DSH 会话头里的下载进度指示器：读取后台任务名册，把下载器自己已经打印出来的进度（curl --progress-bar、wget、aria2，或 JSON 进度文件）解析成环形进度、动画进度条、传输速率与剩余时间；不上报进度的任务显示为未知进度而不是被隐藏。已完成文件单击即开，也可在文件管理器里定位。不依赖任何第三方插件，运行时零依赖。

items.de: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
items.dz: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

items.de: Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.
items.dz: 输入草稿超过阈值后自动折叠为摘要卡，不改变消息提交路径。

items.de: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer — and on the new-conversation screen — that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框下方（以及新建对话窗口）加一个 ✦ 按钮，用当前配置的默认模型把草稿改写成更完整的提示词（保持原意与语言），原地替换草稿、不发送。

items.de: One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.
items.dz: DSH 输入框一键润色草稿：把口语化表达改写成专业措辞；只发送草稿快照、绝不夹带会话上下文；LLM 不可用时优雅降级，不阻塞发送。

items.de: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder'
items.dz: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。拖侧栏的工作区（文件夹）行，则把那个文件夹的路径插进草稿，整个目录一起交给模型。候选按 session id 匹配而不是按标题，标题重名或为空都不会插错对话。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，宿主侧调大后自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

items.de: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.
items.dz: 像 Codex/Claude 一样：拖入任意格式文件或文件夹，真实绝对路径立即插入输入框，不用一个个打字。工作区优先智能定位、大小校验、同名弹候选选择器，支持批量拖入与粘贴，兼容 Windows/macOS。

items.de: A draw.io editor as a .drawio file viewer in the DSH sidebar: diagrams are ordinary workspace files (new ones default to docs/diagrams/), edits autosave, and a file changed outside the editor is refused with a conflict bar instead of being overwritten; the editor is downloaded once from a pinned ups
items.dz: 把 draw.io 编辑器接进 DSH 侧边栏的 .drawio 文件预览器：图纸就是工作区里的普通文件（新建默认落在 docs/diagrams/），改动自动保存，文件被编辑器以外的东西改过时会拒绝覆盖并弹出冲突条；编辑器首次使用时从固定上游版本下载并校验 SHA-256，之后完全离线运行。

items.de: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text prev
items.dz: 把文件拖入或粘贴进 Web 输入框，图片与文件共用预览栏；PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 保留出厂图片通道，其他文件优先引用匹配的本地路径，否则流式暂存到 Host，发送时才追加 @ 引用。提供浏览器媒体/PDF 和限长文本预览；Office 与压缩包显示身份卡，未发送文件清单仅保存在页面内。

items.de: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
items.dz: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

items.de: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
items.dz: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

items.de: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.
items.dz: 双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。

items.de: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
items.dz: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

items.de: An Auto toggle next to the model selector that schedules reasoning_effort per request: complexity is scored by a MiniMax/OpenAI-compatible model with a zero-dependency heuristic fallback (fallbacks not cached), effort ladders adapt to each model real effort list (low/high/max, low/high/highx/max/ult
items.dz: 输入栏模型选择器旁的「自动」按钮：按消息复杂度逐请求调度推理档位。档位表跟随各模型的真实分档（low/high/max 或 low/high/highx/max/ultra 等），MiniMax/OpenAI 兼容端点打分、失败回退零依赖启发式（回退结果不缓存）；同会话内出现重工具调用自动升档；点亮按钮与回复角标实时显示实际使用的档位；每次调度决策与实际 token 用量记入 JSONL 账本。本插件是 imkingjh999/dsh-adaptive-effort 的独立按钮 fork，请勿与原版同时安装。

items.de: Remembers the reasoning effort you explicitly chose for each provider and model and restores it when you switch back, without replacing DSH's own model picker.
items.dz: 按 Provider + Model 记住你最后一次明确选择的推理档位，切回该模型时用同一次原生选择调用恢复，不替换 DSH 原生模型选择器。

items.de: Replaces the composer's reasoning-effort dropdown with a card that shows one illustration per level (off / low / high / max); the four levels keep their original meanings, and swapping an illustration only means replacing a file in assets/.

items.de: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.
items.dz: dsh-effort-slider 的修改版：把输入框的模型座位拆成两个按钮——点模型名打开模型列表，点推理等级打开带 WebGL 火焰的滑块面板。

items.de: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
items.dz: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

items.de: Email notifications for DSH with an away-mode switch: mails you when a turn ends, a tool waits for approval, or the assistant asks a question. Title and body are editable templates.
items.dz: DSH 邮件通知插件，带一个「离开模式」开关：任务完成、工具等你授权、助手向你提问时发邮件给你；标题与正文都是可自定义的模板。

items.de: OAuth2-capable IMAP email reader for accounts where password authentication is disabled. items.de: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separ

items.de: A 44x44 always-on-top desktop ball for DSH that reflects what the agent is actually doing (thinking, searching, web fetch, error, waiting for input) and shows an exclamation or question-mark badge when a task finishes or needs an answer while you are away. Windows only; it downloads its own Electron
items.dz: 给 DSH 的桌面情绪小球：44×44 置顶小挂件，实时反映 agent 正在做什么（思考、检索、联网、出错、等待输入）；任务在你不看时完成、或有问题等你回答时，右上角亮「!」「?」角标。仅 Windows；首次使用会自行下载 Electron 运行时。

items.de: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.

items.de: A Web3D energy orb decoration for the DSH Web GUI: a particle core wrapped in three mechanical rings that shrinks and falls silent while the session is idle and pulses in a double-beat heartbeat while a turn runs. UnrealBloom glow, draggable with its corner, position and size remembered, and three.j

items.de: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected ev

items.de: Injects live time, weather, location, battery, and device context into the DSH system prompt, with a bilingual settings page.
items.dz: 将实时的时间、天气、地点、电量和设备信息注入 DSH 系统提示，并提供双语设置页面。

items.de: Original CSS gold and purple glass theme with local avatar upload, crop controls, assistant naming and reading styles; no bundled game media. items.de: Conversation search, checkpoints, context management, main and side chats, local long-term memory, tasks, and daily planning for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索、检查点、上下文管理、主聊旁聊、长期记忆、目标待办与今日计划。

items.de: EVA armor HUD theme skin for DSH, with startup animation and sequential UI entrance animation.

items.de: Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
items.dz: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

items.de: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **st
items.dz: 跨会话经验记忆：经验按证据定级，本轮话题相同时才注入；动手前提示只在记录自己声明了适用哪次调用时才出现。不管聊什么都要守的规矩（例如「一律用中文」）可以标成**常驻**，之后每一轮都会带上它——24 个隔离真模型回合实测：标常驻 6/6，对照组（空库、同一条不标、无关常驻）合计 0/18。光是猜的东西进不了常驻层：标了常驻也必须有可核实的出处。没人再查的记录会被退役（可逆）。五个模型工具、七个斜杠命令、运行时零依赖。

items.de: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never
items.dz: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

items.de: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.
items.dz: 基于角色的专家子代理并行协作，各角色可配置模型与思考深度，并提供 Expert Group 任务侧栏。

items.de: Expert market for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy expert/expert-team system ported onto native agent presets, 425-expert catalog installed on demand, capability subtraction, and team delegation tools.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 专家市场：WorkBuddy 专家/专家团体系原生 agent preset 移植，425 个官方专家目录按需安装，内置能力减法声明、开场白与团队委派工具。

items.de: Manage skills, MCP servers, instruction files, custom commands and hooks.
items.dz: 管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。

items.de: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.
items.dz: 外部 Agent 控制面，接入 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor Agent 与 Antigravity，并提供设置和后台任务可见性。

items.de: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
items.dz: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

items.de: Fail-fast tool batches for DeepSeek Harness: inside a step, concurrency-safe calls still overlap, but after the first failed call every remaining unstarted call is denied before dispatch and returned to the model as a synthesized `is_error` "not executed" result.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具批次增加“失败即停”（fail-fast）机制：同一并行组内的只读调用仍可并发，一旦有调用失败，所有尚未开始的调用都会在派发前被拦截，并以合成的 is_error「未执行」结果返回给模型。

items.de: Stops the agent after N consecutive failures on the same tool. Instead of another retry it pushes a four-part stop instruction: what was tried, the exact error text, the likely cause, and what the user must do. Detection reads real tool results (isError or a non-zero shell exit code) and mirrors the
items.dz: 同一工具连续失败达阈值时叫停。不是再试一次，而是推送一条四部分停手指令：试过什么、完整错误原文、初判原因、需要用户做什么。判定读真实工具结果（isError 或 shell 退出码非零），通过 agent.steer 回灌，让 agent 把它当成收到的消息而不是日志。

items.de: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.
items.dz: 在后台准备上下文摘要并于安全步骤应用，保留原生压缩回退，并提供摘要内容、应用状态、耗时与用量的会话压缩历史。

items.de: One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.

items.de: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
items.dz: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

items.de: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
items.dz: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

items.de: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
items.dz: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

items.de: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
items.dz: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

items.de: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
items.dz: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

items.de: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
items.dz: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

items.de: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero n
items.dz: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

items.de: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
items.dz: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

items.de: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：把工作区与对话附件中的 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、TXT、CSV、HTML 文档提炼为 Markdown 知识，提供类 VS Code 预览、按工作区授权，以及检索、读取和入库的模型工具。

items.de: Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh
items.dz: 本地知识库：每篇笔记一个 Markdown 文件，支持标签、层级目录、全文检索、附件用系统默认程序打开、Office 零依赖文本抽取，以及引用到对话。面向宿主 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2；Windows 下默认根目录为 E:/dsh-kb。

items.de: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
items.dz: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

items.de: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
items.dz: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

items.de: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and veri
items.dz: KuroWhale 黑色系鲸鱼娘桌宠，参考 DeepSeek Harness 官方图标设计的非官方 Windows x64 桌宠，九种动画会随 DSH Agent 的工作状态作出反应；需要 WebView2，首次启动会联网下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时与素材并做 SHA-256 校验。

items.de: Local model scheduler for DSH on Windows 10/11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.x: a bundled console for engine/model import, VRAM estimation, load/close, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的本地模型调度插件（仅 Windows 10/11，需 DSH Desktop 0.2.x），内置控制台，支持引擎/模型导入、显存预估、加载关闭和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

items.de: Clamps the session history page request to 120 messages and replaces request/header tool schemas larger than 200k characters with an empty array before React renders them, so long sessions open without freezing the transcript.
items.dz: 把打开会话时的历史取数收到 120 条消息，并在进入 React 之前把超过 20 万字符的工具 schema 换成空数组，让长会话打开时不再卡死界面。

items.de: One shelf for WeChat Reading, GitHub book repos and your own EPUB/PDF/Markdown, with an immersive reader and AI notes.
items.dz: 把微信读书、GitHub 书库和自己的 EPUB/PDF/Markdown 收进一个书架，沉浸阅读并让 AI 解释划词。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.
items.dz: 仅内网的远程访问：手机或另一台电脑通过扫码或令牌接入同一份 DSH Web 界面，并可选内网免密钥直连。

items.de: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).
items.dz: 通过浏览器把 DSH 工作区分享到局域网：手机、平板、其它电脑可浏览、下载、上传文件，无需 DSH 登录。带令牌门卫、路径边界、只读模式与速率限制，零依赖(node:http)。

items.de: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.
items.dz: 向系统提示注入固定语言指令，让 Agent 始终用简体中文回复（含工具调用之间的叙述文字），除非你明确要求其他语言；对所有会话与预设生效，且不覆盖 persona。

items.de: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
items.dz: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

items.de: Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit th
items.dz: 让 Agent 的思考过程也自动使用中文。在每步推理前向 System Prompt 最顶部注入语言约束，强制思维链、规划、工具调用推理全部使用中文，防止工具返回英文内容后发生语言漂移。支持在设置面板中实时编辑约束文本。

items.de: Compiles LaTeX with the TeX Live installed on the machine: one `latex` tool typesets a formula into an SVG, PNG or PDF and a whole document into a PDF (Chinese text switches to xelatex with ctexart), writes the file into the workspace and returns a Markdown reference to it. A system-prompt section a
items.dz: 用本机已装的 TeX Live 真编译 LaTeX：`latex` 工具把一个公式排成 SVG、PNG 或 PDF，把整份文档排成 PDF（正文含中文时自动切 xelatex + ctexart），产物写进工作区并返回可直接引用的 Markdown 链接。同时注入系统提示词段落，让模型用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 而不是代码块写公式；本机没有 TeX Live 时，输入框上方会给出 BasicTeX / TinyTeX 一键安装。

items.de: Free LaTeX formula editor in the DSH sidebar with offline MathJax/PDF.js rendering: ten symbol tiles with hover palettes, ten template groups, live preview, colour/font/size/environment controls, favourites with titles and search, and nine export formats (SVG/PNG/JPG, LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/Math
items.dz: 免费的 DSH 侧栏 LaTeX 公式编辑器，MathJax/PDF.js 渲染全部离线：10 个符号磁贴悬停展开分类面板、10 组公式模板、实时预览、颜色/字体/字号/环境控制、带标题与搜索的收藏夹，以及九种导出格式（SVG/PNG/JPG、LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML）与转义和分享链接。图片与 PDF 识别需要 DSH 中可用的视觉模型，或你自己配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点；其余功能全部离线运行。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: macOS menu bar app for the DSH web server, plus the host plugin it reads: the plugin writes the running server's port, PID and tokenized URL to ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json and removes it on shutdown, so start, open, restart and stop work from the status bar even for a server started from a t
items.dz: DSH Web 服务的 macOS 菜单栏应用，以及它所读取的 Host 插件：插件把运行中服务的端口、PID 与带 token 的 URL 写入 ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json，并在停止时删除，因此即使服务器是从终端启动的，也能在状态栏完成启动、打开、重启与停止。

items.de: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).
items.dz: 法律知识库工作台：直读本地法规 .doc/.docx 语料，关键词/统计语义/向量三路融合检索、双维度筛选、案名索引与民事案由树、文书编辑器，以及引用核验/合同审查/AI 分析/AI 文书生成四件套。

items.de: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

items.de: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.
items.dz: dsh 的按需 MCP 网关：每个 server 首次使用时才连接、空闲后自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，可导入现有的 mcpServers 配置，并对子进程环境变量做脱敏。

items.de: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
items.dz: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

items.de: Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single valid
items.dz: 读取会话自身的事件流（不额外发起模型调用），把纠正、失败与修法变成待确认的候选教训。每条候选按写死的标准逐项判定，并给出通过或被拒的理由；只有确认之后才写成技能，而且只能经过唯一的写入口 `learn_skill_manage`。闲置时由 curator 把长期不用的技能标为陈旧并归档（是移动，不是删除），仍在被加载的技能会被豁免。五个工具：`learn`、`learn_review`、`learn_curator`、`learn_skill_manage`、`learn_skills`。另外注册一段写明判定标准的提示词段落，并挂一个工具守卫，拒绝直接编辑技能文件，使写入口无法被绕过。

items.de: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
items.dz: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

items.de: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
items.dz: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

items.de: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin
items.dz: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

items.de: Local-first bookkeeping plus a separate wealth-holdings ledger: text entries and receipt OCR through an optional local provider, a running balance, a strictly degrading daily profit chain, and a two-section month-end report where cash and wealth totals are never merged.
items.dz: 本地优先的记账插件，附带独立的理财持仓账本：文字记账与小票 OCR（可选本地 OCR 提供方）、running balance、严格降级的每日收益链，以及现金与理财永不合并的月末双节报告。

items.de: Language-pack framework that rewrites model replies: A is an independent LLM rewrite, B injects FTS5 terminology retrieval into that rewrite, C applies local dictionary and regex rules, and composite runs a pipeline such as B then A then C. Ships a GitHub pack marketplace, a ZIP installer with path,
items.dz: 改写模型回复的语言包框架：A 为独立 LLM 改写，B 将 FTS5 术语检索注入改写请求，C 执行本地字典与正则规则，composite 按 B→A→C 等管线组合。附 GitHub 语言包市场、带路径/体积/文件类型校验的 ZIP 安装器，以及强制风险免责闸门。

items.de: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from ma
items.dz: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

items.de: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
items.dz: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

items.de: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
items.dz: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

items.de: Stores bookmarks as local Markdown files in a folder you choose, with a sidebar page for collections and links, library-wide search, automatic favicon downloads, and three agent tools.
items.dz: 把收藏的链接存成你指定文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面管理收藏夹与链接、全库搜索、自动抓取图标，以及三个 agent 工具。

items.de: Free literature fetching: give it a DOI, a title or a keyword and it locates the paper, then walks 8 Sci-Hub mirrors first and falls back to Unpaywall open access only when every mirror fails. PDFs are checked for the %PDF- magic bytes and a minimum size, and a clickable manifest is generated for th
items.dz: 免费文献下载：给 DOI、标题或关键词就能定位论文，先依次遍历 8 个 Sci-Hub 镜像，全部失败才用 Unpaywall 开放获取兜底。PDF 要过 %PDF- 魔数与最小体积校验，抓不到的论文生成可点击的批量获取清单。不需要付费订阅，也不需要 API Key。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

items.de: LittleStar Meeting Room: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of werewolf. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer (targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks, elimination) was contributed by 插件·3代小星辰. Any session can host
items.dz: 星辰会议室：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 开一场会 —— 或者，跑一局狼人杀。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；「四件套」（定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发 / 出局）由插件·3代小星辰扩建。在 DSH 里，每个会话是一个独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，先定议题与目标，按顺序邀请其他会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会生成纪要。它也能跑狼人杀这类对抗游戏。本插件附带小白使用指南.md，看了你就会用，由插件·3代小星辰编写。

items.de: Floating card above the composer with the conversation's spend, the account balance and the current peak/off-peak billing period, plus a per-answer cost figure under every finished turn.
items.dz: 输入框上方浮动一张卡片，显示本次对话花费、账户余额与当前峰谷时段，并在每条回答末尾显示该轮消耗。

items.de: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.
items.dz: DSH Web 的会话绑定单轮语音预览：提供无需凭证的本地合成演示和可选的 Qwen Audio，保持精确会话隔离，并仅在明确操作后将转写写入草稿，不会自动提交。

items.de: Renders a Live2D Cubism 4 model as the DSH web UI background: a transparent click-through canvas that covers the window without blocking any control. Eyes, head and body follow the pointer; expressions track the agent state (thinking, running a tool, turn finished, error, waiting) and the conversati
items.dz: 把 Live2D Cubism 4 模型渲染成 DSH 网页界面的背景层：透明画布铺满窗口且不挡任何控件。眼、头、身体跟随鼠标；表情跟着智能体状态（思考、调用工具、回答结束、报错、等待确认）和对话（收到消息、回答结束、向你提问）变化；空闲到设定时间会冒台词气泡，并从你勾选的池子里随机播动作和表情。设置页列出 ~/.dsh/live2d-stage/models 里的模型，开放位置、缩放、透明度、视线强度与每一项间隔和概率，并可拖拽改大小的实时预览窗查看同一块画布。模型清单里没声明的 exp3/motion3 会被自动识别，另附示例模型。

items.de: Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.
items.dz: 使用 Codex OAuth 的 WebRTC 实时语音，并可将任务交给 DSH 会话执行。

items.dz: 使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。

items.de: Multi-provider LLM API balances under the chat input, with presets for DeepSeek, OpenRouter and SiliconFlow.
items.dz: 聊天输入框下方显示多个 LLM API 账户余额，内置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow 预设。

items.dz: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

items.de: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/termina
items.dz: 给 dsh web 客户端加四个右侧栏面板：产物浏览、长期记忆、终端、记事本。两两配成一个标签、中间可拖拽分栏，因此两个窗格就能同时看到四个。终端每行执行一条 bash 命令，默认 120 秒期限、可随时终止。宿主侧一并提供 9 个 memory_* 工具、artifacts_list、/memory 命令，以及 /api/artifacts/* 与 /api/terminal-notes/* 路由。需要 dsh 0.1.5 及以上，以及 0.2 系列。

items.de: Native MiniMax provider for DeepSeek Harness: chat over the official MiniMax API, plus image, video, speech, music and transcription tools.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入原生 MiniMax：通过官方 MiniMax API 对话，并提供生图、视频、语音、音乐与语音转写工具。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Turns the MiniMax Code (Mavis) subscription already signed in on this machine into a DSH model provider, renewing the OAuth token itself so the desktop client can stay closed, with points, check-in and subscription-quota panels.
items.dz: 把本机已登录的 MiniMax Code（Mavis）订阅接入 DSH 作为模型 provider，自己完成 OAuth 续期所以桌面客户端可以一直关着，并提供积分、签到与订阅额度面板。

items.de: Add MiniMax image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription tools to DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 MiniMax 识图、文生图、语音合成和语音转写工具。

items.de: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
items.dz: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

items.de: Shows real-time Mistral Vibe and API budget usage in the sidebar, with per-model token cost tracking, cached-token spend, and API-key management. Requires a Mistral API key (MISTRAL_API_KEY by default, or a custom apiKeyEnv).
items.dz: 在侧边栏实时显示 Mistral Vibe 与 API 预算使用情况，按模型追踪令牌成本与缓存令牌支出，并支持管理 API 密钥。需要配置 Mistral API key（默认环境变量 MISTRAL_API_KEY，或自定义 apiKeyEnv）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Transparent multimodal routing for text-only models: every image in every model call is fully transcribed (verbatim OCR, data, uncertainty zones, injection-hardened) by your own multimodal understander, with focused re-look via vision_relook and automatic retry on image-related failures. No bundled
items.dz: 纯文本模型的透明多模态路由：每一次模型调用里的每张图片先由你自己配置的多模态理解模型全量转述（逐字 OCR、数据、不确定区、防注入），vision_relook 定点复看，图片类报错自动转述重试。不内置端点、不借登录态。

items.de: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, enforced subagent gating (dual-shape session indexing), derived per-re
items.dz: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控（双形态会话目录索引，修复后实效）、按成分派生的配方级视觉（视觉参考路可为纯文本聚合转述图像）、节拍节奏（定调与巡检两套阵容、拍间冻结复用）、退化守卫（剔除退化的参考输出）、模型面匿名（失败提示零供应商身份）、缓存友好化注入（预演记录钉在产出它的那一步而非每步追加到请求末尾，缓存前缀覆盖它、每步只付新增量，缺省开启、全 cadence 档生效）。

items.de: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
items.dz: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 的 Safari 打开 Mac 或 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web：8 位配对码、回环监听的局域网网关、可选 Tailscale Serve，以及仅 iOS 生效的 Safari 输入与触摸补丁。可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

items.de: A PIN-protected, chat-only mobile web client for DeepSeek Harness, served on an isolated port over LAN or a self-provided tunnel.
items.dz: 受 PIN 保护的 DeepSeek Harness 移动端对话界面，在独立端口上通过局域网或自备隧道访问。

items.de: Mobile access gateway for the Web GUI: isolated child-process reverse proxy with a first-visit PC approval gate (admin-token auth, DNS-rebinding defense), LAN/VPN/WAN auto-detection with network-mode switching, QR-code entry, WebSocket forwarding, and narrow-screen UI adaptations (composer reflow, t
items.dz: 移动端访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问 PC 审批（管理 token 认证、DNS rebinding 防护）+ 局域网/VPN/公网自动识别与网络模式切换 + 扫码访问 + WebSocket 实时转发 + 窄屏 UI 适配（输入区重排、第三方插件弹窗适配、crypto.randomUUID polyfill）。

items.de: Phone-portrait layout shell for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by swiping from the left, a persistent 56px action bar sits under the composer, and the settings panel plus the model and permission pickers are reflowed for touch. Ships native, merged and floating layou
items.dz: DSH Web UI 的手机竖屏布局壳：侧边栏变成左侧右滑打开的抽屉，输入区下方常驻一条 56px 操作栏，设置页与模型 / 权限选择器按触控重排；提供原生、融合、悬浮三套布局预设，全部样式受 html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"] 作用域保护，桌面、平板与横屏保持官方原样。

items.de: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.
items.dz: DSH 任务停下来时把通知推送到手机，支持 10 个渠道：ntfy、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Server酱、PushPlus、Telegram、Qmsg 与通用 webhook；消息里带会话、目录、耗时、回合号与回复摘要，运行在 Host 侧而不是浏览器页面里。

items.de: Mobile web shell for DSH Web with drawer navigation, touch-sized controls, safe areas and a full-width conversation; the desktop layout stays unchanged.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 提供手机端外壳：抽屉导航、触控尺寸控件、安全区适配和全宽对话区，桌面端布局保持不变。

items.de: Android in the sidebar, driven by text instead of screenshots. 30 tools read the real UI tree, tap by text/id/ref, measure animation motion, and mirror the screen into the sidebar where you circle a spot and send it back with one sentence — the host ships the marked-up frame plus the controls inside
items.dz: 安卓真机，在右栏，用文字而不是截图驱动。30 个工具直接读界面树、按文字/id/ref 点按、量动效曲线；画面实时推到右栏，圈一处、写一句话，「发送」把带圈的画面连同圈内控件一起回到对话，不用你复述屏幕。省 token 是重点：看一次屏是一段 200–600 token 的文本，不是一张上千 token 的截图，热帧判断 100–200 ms 出结果。视频把 scrcpy 的原始 H.264 直接送进 WebCodecs，不转码：26 秒稳态实测宿主写出到解码帧 p50 2 ms、单解码器、丢帧 0；解不了自动退 MSE，`?avc=0` 可强制旧路径对比。声音只有一个开关，默认关、按序列号记

items.de: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
items.dz: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

items.de: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。

items.de: Auto-detect the current model vendor (7 built-in) and show its balance or quota in the composer input row, with custom endpoints for unsupported vendors.
items.dz: 自动识别当前模型厂商（内置 7 家），在输入框内显示余额或配额，未内置厂商可配置自定义接口。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency
items.dz: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

items.de: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/fa
items.dz: 在设置 → 模型页底部增加连接测试面板：读取部署的模型目录，对每个已配置模型经宿主 LLM 服务发送一次最小对话请求（“ping”，小输出上限），以真实请求验证连通性。每行报告成功/失败、宿主失败码（NO_ADAPTER、MISSING_CREDENTIAL、AUTH、RATE_LIMIT、TIMEOUT 等）及首字/总耗时，支持单模型测试与全部测试（并发 3）。凭据只在宿主进程内解析，浏览器不可见；每模型一次独立请求，测试路由带同源围栏与请求体上限。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

items.de: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.
items.dz: 切换供应商、模型与思考强度，每个模型各自记住档位。

items.de: Publishes whichever model the profile has selected in chat or on the Models page as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint: /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions (streaming SSE and non-streaming), /health. A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switc
items.dz: 把当前在聊天或「模型」设置页选中的模型发布成 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 端点：/v1/models、/v1/chat/completions（SSE 流式与非流式）、/health。请求可指定本 profile 能路由的任意模型；省略 model 时使用聊天中当前选中的模型，因此在聊天里换模型就等于换端点所服务的模型。开启后还可把 Harness 中逐个开关的工具借给模型，经 Harness 工具运行时执行并回填结果，往返次数可设上限。监听器由插件自身创建，绑定 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 或经 NAT 转发的端口行为一致，请求路径不变。设置项含绑定地址、端口、可随机生成的 API

items.de: Model failover for DeepSeek Harness: pick one or more providers and the pool becomes every model inside them; when a request fails (rate limit, quota, timeout, server or transport error) the next untried model in the pool retries automatically, and the original error surfaces once the pool is exhaus
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的模型故障自动转移：可选一个或多个供应商，池=所选供应商内的全部模型；请求失败（限流、配额、超时、服务端或传输错误）时自动用池中下一个未试过的模型重试，整池试尽则交还原错误。在输入框右下角模型选择器旁的「故障转移」面板或 model_failover 工具里配置，无需重启。

items.de: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
items.dz: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

items.de: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
items.dz: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

items.de: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.
items.dz: 替换模型选择器，提供全局搜索、收藏、最近使用、模型家族导航与思维强度选择。

items.de: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, an
items.dz: 两级模型调度：先在模型层选最优模型组，再在该模型的渠道层选最佳渠道；失败时先换同模型的其它渠道，整个模型不可用才换模型。偏好模式把单个模型锁在它的各条渠道上，输入框下方的状态条实时显示当前模型、渠道健康与今日 token 用量，并可从测速/智力报告导入路由先验；另提供 model_orchestrator 工具与 /route 命令。

items.de: Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 的全局 Alt+M 模型命令面板：模型与提供商的模糊搜索、收藏与最近使用、每模型思考档位、提供商与模型配置、请求重试、容量预设，以及可选的 OpenRouter 图片/视频生成工具。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Provider logos and model IDs in the DSH model picker, registered as a label decorator on the official conversation.input.model.label slot; providers match by token, display name, model ID and explicit override, falling back to a letter monogram when unknown.

items.de: Declarative provider/model fallback chains for the model picker: an ordered root chain plus named pools, failure-code triggered switching, per-model cooldowns, time-slot presets, and subagent role routing. A fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5; do not install it alongside that plugin (both use
items.dz: 模型选择器用的可配置降级链：有序主链加命名池，按失败码自动切换，支持按模型冷却、分时段预设与子代理角色路由。omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5 的 fork；不要与上游同时安装（两边的 profile 行 id 都是 "llm-fallbacks"）。

items.de: Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The s
items.dz: 模型顺序：在「设置 → 模型」的提供方卡片里拖动调整；卡片格被别的插件占用时，入口在设置左导航的「模型顺序」分区。顺序通过宿主 settings 服务带版本校验写回，设置页与模型选择器保持同步；设置左导航本身也可拖拽排序。

items.de: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.
items.dz: Provider-first 三级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，两级均可行内搜索，失败供应商以可重试行展示，触发器显示 Model · Provider。

items.de: Turns the composer's model menu into a two-level list (provider first, then that provider's models), shows the current model together with its provider name, asks for a reasoning effort after a model is picked, and adds settings switches that hide whole providers or single models from the picker.
items.dz: 把输入框的模型菜单改成「先选厂商、再选模型」的两级列表，当前模型位同时显示厂商名，点模型后再选推理等级；设置里可按厂商或单个模型把条目从选择器中隐藏。

items.de: Provider-first model picker for the composer. Every provider is listed in the left rail and its models in the right pane. Providers, models within a provider, and pins reorder by drag or Alt+Arrow; providers take a local display alias; one provider can be the panel default; a model's reasoning level
items.dz: 输入框里的供应商优先模型选择器：左栏列出全部供应商，右栏列出选中供应商的模型。供应商、组内模型与收藏都可用拖拽或 Alt+方向键排序；可给供应商起本地显示别名、可指定面板默认供应商；推理档位内联展开；搜索同时匹配模型名、供应商名与别名。切换走官方模型目录服务，/model 弹窗与面板始终一致。

items.de: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets
items.dz: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

items.de: Sidebar leaderboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): LMArena blind-test ratings, Artificial Analysis intelligence index, LiveBench 2.0 capability, OpenRouter weekly/monthly usage and market share, price, speed and context — plus a local token-usage dashboard built from your own session logs (tokens, esti
items.dz: 侧栏大模型排行榜：LMArena 盲测评分、Artificial Analysis 智能指数、LiveBench 2.0 能力榜、OpenRouter 周榜/月榜与市场份额，附价格、速度与上下文；另有本机用量仪表盘（只读会话日志统计 tokens、估算花费与模型用量排行）、明细抽屉与 CSV 导出。数据由宿主每日快照，面板打开即显示，并高亮本机已接入的模型。

items.de: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and
items.dz: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

items.de: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
items.dz: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

items.de: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商模型路由插件：规则路由 + 首 token 前无感故障切换 + cooldown 熔断 + 用量记账 + 状态接口。

items.de: Adds per-model hide/show switches for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers to the DSH settings page. Hidden models disappear from the conversation model picker and are archived verbatim, so they can be restored at any time; disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores everything automatically. Built-in Dee

items.de: A composer switch between running always and running only in off-peak hours, set per session: a task is judged by the session that owns it, so changing one session no longer changes the others, and a session without its own choice follows a default. In off-peak mode every task, including one already
items.dz: 在「全天运行」与「仅空闲时段运行」之间切换，且按会话独立：任务按所属会话判定，改一个会话不再影响其他会话，没有单独设置的会话跟随默认值。选择空闲模式后，任务（含正在运行的）在进入北京高峰时段（周一至周五 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，法定节假日除外）时，会在下一个 agent 步进或工具分发边界被扣住，并由一个定时器在边界时刻精确放行；周末与法定节假日全天为空闲。内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅公布的逐日放假数据，无数据的年份如实标为未知，而不是默认按工作日处理。

items.dz: 把本机与多台远端 DeepSeek Harness 聚合进官方侧栏：远端工作区/会话作为原生行出现、由官方中栏打开，执行始终留在远端，经 HTTP/TLS 直连。远端无需安装插件，界面不使用 iframe。

items.de: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for Deep

items.de: Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.
items.dz: 把 DSH 权限拆成 9 个可选预设（3 种沙箱 × 4 种审批），规则 + LLM 双通道四档风险分级，高风险操作需输入批准密码才放行，附 JSONL 审计日志。

items.de: Persona mode with character cards, long-term memory that fades and can be reviewed, diaries, a reference library, and stickers.
items.dz: 人设模式、会自然变淡并可复习的长期记忆、日记、资料库和表情包。

items.de: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optiona
items.dz: 按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。

items.de: Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.
items.dz: 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。

items.de: Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past message

items.de: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
