items.de: Live usage gauge injected into the system prompt every turn: session tokens and estimated spend, a next-turn estimate, and two predictions the model can act on — which step fills the context window and which step burns the budget. /qm panels, zero-config by default, optional price table, and it publ
items.dz: 实时用量仪表：每回合向系统提示注入一行 token/花费仪表，含下一步预估，以及模型可以自刹的两条预测——第几步撑满上下文、第几步烧穿预算。/qm 面板自查，零配置即用，价格表可选，并向家族发布 summary.json 预算契约供兄弟插件读取。

items.de: 余额显示quota-balance — shows the DeepSeek account balance at the left of the composer status row; clicking it opens a panel with the normal and bonus wallet split, the refresh time and a top-up link. The chip and panel read the host surface tokens, so they follow the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine glass s
items.dz: 余额显示quota-balance：在输入框下方的用量行最左侧显示账户余额，点开可查看普通余额与赠送额度的分项、更新时间，并可跳转充值；徽标与浮层读取宿主表面 token，可跟随 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 的玻璃参数、明暗主题与壁纸切换。

items.de: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
items.dz: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

items.de: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.
items.dz: Web UI 插件：以阶段性文字回复为界分段，把每段的 think 与工具调用收进限高可滚动、高度可配置的 slide 窗口，中间过程始终可见。

items.de: Adds a Restart card to the harness settings: one click hands the restart to the DeepSeek Harness launcher (`Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which replaces the running web process, and the page reconnects itself once the new instance answers. Windows only; without that launcher the button reports an er
items.dz: 在设置页增加「重启」卡片：一键把重启交给 DeepSeek Harness 启动器（`Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`）替换正在为页面提供服务的 web 进程，新实例就绪后页面自行重连。仅支持 Windows；缺少该启动器时按钮会报错，而不是完成重启。

items.de: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.
items.dz: 侦察 deepseek-harness 官方仓库与所有 dsh-plugin topic 仓库，发现与目标相关的 harness，并判断每个值得试用、观望还是跳过。

items.de: Search field on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page that filters the installed and official plugin cards as you type, matching each card title, description and package name; space-separated keywords must all match.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness「插件」页加一条关键词搜索框：边输入边过滤已安装与官方插件卡片，命中范围是卡片标题、描述与包名，空格分隔的多个关键词之间是 AND。

items.de: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
items.dz: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

items.de: Permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness UI: a header trash button and a sidebar menu item behind a risk-consent dialog, plus a workbench_session_delete agent tool. Started from lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete and maintained independently since v0.4.0; do not install it alongside that
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里彻底删除会话：会话头部垃圾桶按钮与侧栏「…」菜单项（带风险确认弹窗），另提供 workbench_session_delete agent 工具。从 lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete 派生并自 v0.4.0 起独立维护；请勿与上游同装，两者都会注册同一个 workbench_session_delete 工具。

items.de: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
items.dz: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

items.de: Permanently delete a DSH session — not just archive it — cascading over its log directory, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping and child (subagent) sessions. Adds a settings-page panel that groups sessions by workspace with size, age and live/archived/child markers, supports filtering and batch
items.dz: 永久删除 DSH 会话（而非仅归档），级联清理它的日志目录、投影缓存、工作区记账与子会话（子代理）。提供设置页面板：按工作区分组，显示体积、时间与「打开中 / 已归档 / 子会话 N / 无工作区」标记，支持筛选与批量删除，每条删除都在行下方内联二次确认。

items.de: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.
items.dz: 会话回收站：移入回收站、恢复或永久删除会话。

items.de: Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.
items.dz: 本机全部会话的全文检索：sessiongraph 跨工作区查找对话，中文两字词也能命中，sessiongraph_index 负责建索引。

items.de: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.
items.dz: 在侧栏列表上方加「工作区 / 最新会话」切换条，含固定会话分组、行级菜单（固定/取消固定、复制 Session ID）、标题过滤；pin 存于浏览器 localStorage，并对 dsh-plugin-pin-session 做一次性迁移与过渡双写。

items.de: Windows anime companion for DeepSeek balances and Codex quotas, with integrated Codex multi-account OAuth, per-account quota and model management, compact mode and autosaving settings. Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers rema
items.dz: Windows 二次元桌宠：查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Codex 额度，内置 Codex 多账号 OAuth 管理、逐账号额度与模型接入，支持简洁模式和设置自动保存。可选面板一键切号及逐账号授权的每日预热；多账号启动/5h满额触发暂不可用。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

items.de: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of rewriting the query.
items.dz: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

items.de: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

items.de: Sidebar sticky-note wall with colour-coded notes, checklists, folding, a trash drawer that restores deleted notes, drag and resize, and five sticky_wall_* model tools for writing and restoring notes from chat.
items.dz: 侧栏便签墙：彩色便签、待办勾选、折叠、可恢复的回收站抽屉、拖拽与改尺寸，并给模型 5 个 sticky_wall_* 工具从对话里记事和恢复。

items.de: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
items.dz: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

items.de: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
items.dz: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

items.de: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
items.dz: 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok、Antigravity、OpenRouter、Agnes AI、Qwen、星火、文心一言共 9 个订阅账号的 OAuth 登录，零配置直连，内置用量看板。

items.de: Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book (goal / context / constraints / acceptance / decisions / open gaps, all numbered) and hands it to any AI window losslessly: the receiver must pass a read-back handshake — restate, list gaps, declare READY — before work starts; /answer closes gaps with
items.dz: 把大白话编译成开源标准任务书（目标/约束/验收/决策/缺口全编号），再无损交接给任意窗口的 AI：接收方必须通过回读握手——复述理解、列出缺口、声明 READY——才被允许开工；缺口答案回填自动升版本，台账记录哪个窗口持有哪个版本。

items.de: Judges the right reasoning level locally from the current draft and recent turns and switches it in one click; nudges a new session when the conversation grows long — less overthinking on simple tasks, enough reasoning on hard ones.
items.dz: 根据当前任务和最近几轮对话在本地判断合适的推理等级，一键切换；会话过长时提醒并可直接新建会话：简单任务不过度思考、节省 token，复杂任务给足推理。

items.de: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置 → 插件页直接启用或停用插件：切换开关即时停止或启动插件（无需重启），并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

items.de: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.
items.dz: 在 Web 设置面板中启用、停用、删除/撤回插件，并支持版本检测与 npm 插件更新；运行时开关持久化到 profile。

items.de: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
items.dz: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

items.de: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
items.dz: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

items.de: Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates.
items.dz: 只读 DSH 插件审查器：静态扫描、当前会话模型审查和启用前确认。

items.de: Undermind literature search inside DeepSeek Harness. The plugin owns the OAuth authorization-code + PKCE login the remote MCP server requires, refreshes the rotating refresh token before expiry, re-initializes the MCP session when the server drops it, and registers every tool Undermind tools/list re
items.dz: 把 Undermind 的文献检索接进 DeepSeek Harness。插件自己维护远端 MCP 服务要求的 OAuth 授权码 + PKCE 登录，在到期前刷新并轮换 refresh token、在服务端丢弃会话时重新初始化，并把 Undermind tools/list 返回的每个工具注册成 mcp__undermind__* 工具，另加一个常驻的 undermind_auth 工具用于查状态、登录、登出与重试。需要一个 Undermind 账号和一个 client id：Undermind 接受 Client ID Metadata Document URL（CIMD）或预注册 cli

items.de: Auto check-in and claim credits for WorkBuddy via an isolated Chrome profile, no tokens required.
items.dz: 用独立 Chrome 登录态自动签到并领取 WorkBuddy 积分，无需令牌。

items.de: Adds an Archive workspace item to the workspace row menu: archives the sessions under that workspace through the official command, leaving the one you are currently viewing open, and refusing the batch while any session is still running. The host hides archived sessions but keeps the emptied workspa
items.dz: 在工作区行菜单里加一项「归档工作区」：对该工作区下每个会话调用官方归档命令，当前正在查看的那条保持打开；组内有会话仍在运行时整批拒绝。官方会隐藏已归档的会话，却把清空后的工作区行留在侧栏——本插件把这一行也一并收起，并从底部面板按 $DSH_HOME/storages 里带跨进程锁写入的账本整组恢复。数量角标可设为常驻、仅新归档时、或隐藏。

items.de: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
items.dz: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

items.de: Gathers custom plugin settings pages and cards into draggable top tabs under a unified Plugin settings navigation row.
items.dz: 在设置弹窗中增加「插件设置」导航，将各插件的设置页与卡片统一收纳到可拖拽排序的顶部标签页中。

items.de: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: extracts durable facts from sessions in the background, recalls relevant memories on demand, and keeps a layered summary, a persona snapshot and a commitment ledger; data stays local unless you point it at your own private Git repository.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆：后台从会话中抽取耐久事实，按需召回相关记忆，维护分层摘要、persona 快照与承诺台账；数据默认留在本机，可选同步到自己的私有 Git 仓库。

items.de: Inserts the full path as text when a folder is pasted into the input box, instead of trying to upload it (Windows and macOS).
items.dz: 粘贴复制来的文件夹时插入完整路径文本，而不是尝试上传（支持 Windows 与 macOS）。

items.de: Opens a folder in DeepSeek Harness from the OS: a Windows Explorer context-menu verb, a macOS Finder Quick Action and QSpace service, and the dsh-open launcher that starts or hands off to the desktop app. The OS menu entries need a one-time registration script (install-menu.ps1 on Windows, install-m
items.dz: 从系统里用 DeepSeek Harness 打开文件夹：Windows 资源管理器右键动词、macOS Finder 快速操作与 QSpace 服务，以及负责启动或交接桌面端的 dsh-open 启动器。系统菜单需在安装插件后运行一次注册脚本（Windows 用 install-menu.ps1，macOS 用 install-macos.sh）才会出现。

items.de: Shrinks oversized bash and job_output text by piping it through the external rtk binary, keeps the original in a spill file and lets the model fetch it back on demand; keeps the original text when rtk is missing or fails.
items.dz: 把超大 bash / job_output 文本交给外部 rtk 二进制压缩，原文写入 spill 文件供模型按需取回；rtk 缺失或失败时保留原文。

items.de: Session operations for DeepSeek Harness: really delete persisted sessions (ungrouped, temp, archive and subagent filters; guards on running, live and workspace sessions) and move sessions between workspaces (log relocation, header.cwd rewrite, workspace registry follow). Ships the shared session-sto
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的会话运维：真正删除持久化会话（未分组、临时、归档、子代理四种筛选；运行中、仍在宿主加载中与属于工作区的会话默认拒绝删除），并在工作区之间搬迁会话（日志迁移、header.cwd 改写、workspace 注册表跟随）。内含共享的会话存储库。

items.de: Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.
items.dz: 给 DSH 插件页加文件夹：把已装插件分组、整组开关、批量移动并可撤销、跨分组搜索、长按拖动排序，卸载后按记录一键装回，还能一键重启 Harness。

items.de: Sorts the entries of the DSH sidebar panel list into one or two levels of categories, draws a titled collapsible header for each group, and shows or hides each entry, all edited from a Plugin Sidebar page in Settings and mirrored to $DSH_HOME/plugins-sidebar-manager.json.
items.dz: 把 DSH 侧栏的面板入口按一级或二级分类归位，为每个分类在侧栏画出可折叠的标题行，并能逐个显示或隐藏；都在设置的「插件侧栏管理」里调整，布局同时写入 $DSH_HOME/plugins-sidebar-manager.json。

items.de: Manage API providers and enabled models, with provider-grouped model switching and keyword search in the native model menu.
items.dz: 管理API供应商与启用模型，在原生模型菜单中按供应商分组切换并搜索模型。

items.de: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
items.dz: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

items.de: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every
items.dz: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

items.de: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
items.dz: 自动化审批审核：只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，策略引擎 fail-closed。

items.de: Highlights answered ask blocks (the “question n/n answered” tool rows) in the conversation with a soft brand-tinted card that follows the light/dark theme; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look. Settings can toggle highlighting and expand-by-default.
items.dz: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和品牌色卡片凸显，明暗主题自适应；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。设置页可开关「高亮已答复提问块」与「默认展开」。

items.de: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
items.dz: 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，必要时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并用 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口打开 Web UI。

items.de: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without `?token=`, PWA install with icon and app name, desktop and mobile Web Push notifications for task/approval events, and optional session-id r
items.dz: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，支持上传证书或由插件自签发本地 CA），无需 `?token=` 即可在局域网 / 远程登录；整合 PWA 安装与应用名 / 图标、桌面通知与手机 Web Push（任务完成、等待审批等事件），并可选地把当前会话的 session id 注入第三方 OpenAI 兼容路由的请求头，均在设置页统一配置。

items.de: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode for non-destructive exploration, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` to submit the plan for review. No settings.
items.dz: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式先做非破坏性探索，再配合内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 提交方案评审。无设置项。

items.de: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
items.dz: MCP 客户端增强：分页工具发现、非阻塞启动、mcp_tool_search 搜索，自研 stdio/streamable-http 传输。

items.de: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.
items.dz: 项目作用域持久化键值记忆：set/get/list/delete/search 模型工具，JSON 文件存储。

items.de: Git tab in the DSH web UI right sidebar for the current session repository — switches branches from a dropdown of local and remote branches (with ahead/behind counts), stages files in staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted groups, commits, fetches, pulls and pushes with automatic upstream setup, draft
items.dz: DSH Web 右侧边栏的 Git tab，跟随当前会话的仓库：下拉切换本地/远程分支（带 ahead/behind），按 staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 分组暂存，提交、fetch、pull、push（无 upstream 时自动建跟踪分支），用默认模型按已暂存 diff 起草约定式提交信息（模型不可用时降级为普通 chore 文案），并以每条分支一种颜色的形式渲染 git log --graph 和词级高亮的 diff。

items.de: PWA icon: replaces the icon and app name used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop, covering desktop browsers and the iOS home screen. Ships a ready-to-use bundled icon set and accepts your own image plus manifest overrides.
items.dz: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装 / 添加到桌面时使用的图标与应用名换成自定义内容，覆盖桌面浏览器与 iOS 主屏幕。包内自带开箱即用的图标集，也支持换成自己的图片并覆盖 manifest 字段。

items.de: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
items.dz: 引用选中的对话文本并添加可选备注，在发送下一条消息时自动附带引用内容。

items.de: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
items.dz: 工具结果敏感信息自动脱敏：模型看到前掩码 API key / token / JWT / 私钥与配置密钥。

items.de: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
items.dz: 系统代理检测（scutil/env/PAC）：状态工具 + proxy_export 导出 bash 代理片段。

items.de: Token usage and cost tracking with daily/session budget alerts and a usage_report tool.
items.dz: Token 用量与成本统计：日/会话预算告警 + usage_report 工具。

items.de: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper right above the conversation, with a draggable splitter setting its height (initial height configurable). Phones and tablets are untouched.
items.dz: 竖屏布局（仅电脑窗口）：浏览器窗口为竖屏时，左侧导航占整列，文件 / 终端面板移到对话区上方（右上），中间分隔线可拖拽调整高度（初始高度可配）。手机 / 平板不受影响。

items.de: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
items.dz: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

items.de: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
items.dz: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

items.de: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
items.dz: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

items.de: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
items.dz: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

items.de: Configure a global system-prompt section with a multiline editor, an enable toggle, and persistent storage that preserves the original text.
items.dz: 通过多行编辑框与开关配置全局系统提示词段，持久保存并保留正文原文。

items.de: A customized usage-statistics-panel dashboard with a 52-week square heatmap, bar-only token trends, and ended-turn labels, using the upstream collector and history. Same package name as upstream HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel, so the two cannot be installed together.
items.dz: 基于 usage-statistics-panel 定制统计看板，提供 52 周方块热力图、纯柱状 Token 趋势与已结束轮次标签，沿用上游采集与历史数据。与上游 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 同包名，二者不能同时安装。

items.de: Control pnpm build-script approval across DSH profiles from Add Plugin, and repair same-Git-URL updates on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
items.dz: 在“添加插件”中统一控制各 DSH 配置的 pnpm 构建脚本审批，并修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的同一 Git 地址更新问题。

items.de: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the pho
items.dz: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

items.de: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
items.dz: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

items.de: Texas Hold'em table for DeepSeek Harness: model-callable poker tools, six heuristic opponents, an optional coach, and a browser table whose buttons never post a chat message.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的德州扑克插件：无限注规则、机器人对手、真实感牌桌，教练模式讲解打法与赔率。

items.de: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native settings, a composer status band, and a reported-usage dashboard. It cannot be installed alongside another DSH Ponytail adapter — remove @mengyul
items.dz: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

items.de: Ponytail port: a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that makes the model finish tasks with the least tokens, with lite / full / ultra levels.
items.dz: Ponytail 移植：让模型消耗最少的 token 完成任务，解决浪费，支持 lite / full / ultra 三档强度。deep seek harness 可用

items.de: Bottom-right DSH-styled Windows cards for approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished runs: click to jump back to the app that started the session (DSH by default), close with the × button, or let it close when you return.
items.dz: 工具请求审批、模型提问、计划待审阅或运行结束时，在右下角弹出 DSH 风格置顶卡片；点一下切回发起该会话的应用（默认 DSH），点 × 关闭，或切回时自动关闭。

items.de: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandb
items.dz: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

items.de: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a nati
items.dz: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback 块，同一批服务器仍可加载。

items.de: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
items.dz: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

items.de: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

Editing is line based, so YAML comments and layout survive. The same package also ship

items.de: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.
items.dz: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

items.de: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.
items.dz: DSH 实时预览标签页：把任意 dev server 嵌入 iframe，透明代理 SPA 路由。

items.de: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
items.dz: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

items.de: Keeps a pricing-period badge in the sidebar footer of the Web UI. It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an off-peak or peak period, plus how long until the next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account.
items.dz: 在 Web 界面侧栏底部常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于 空闲时段还是高峰时段、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额。

items.de: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
items.dz: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

items.dz: Prism 主题工作室为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 带来 24 套明暗双生主题和实时主题工作室。

items.de: Structured math problem bank with multi-solution support, layered knowledge graph and six-dimensional difficulty for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化数学题库：多解法、分层知识图谱、六维难度与技巧驱动的变式出题。

items.de: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; a collapsed box shows its latest two items, the stacked lines above its border open that one box, the border itself folds it back, and user dialogue, interactive questions and mod
items.dz: 把每轮 DSH Web 会话中的思考、工具调用与上下文折叠进带边框的过程框，在每段模型文本处切开；折叠时每框只显示最新两项，点上边框的堆叠线展开这一个框、再点上边框收回，用户对话、交互式提问与模型文本始终留在框外。

items.de: Shows processing time and rotating Chinese tips above the DSH composer.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框上方显示处理中计时和轮换的中文趣味提示。

items.dz: 在远程 Web 中显示并复制 DSH 每轮产出文件的绝对路径。

items.de: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.
items.dz: 以访达式分栏浏览对话节点中的本地图片、视频与 SVGA 产物。

The
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/

items.de: A consent-gated personal profile store: people are indexed by name, entries by person and key, and no profile record is read before the current session is authorised. Sensitive entries come back masked unless the user authorises that tier separately; credential-like values are refused at write time.
items.dz: 带授权的本地个人信息库：以姓名为索引存人，以「姓名 + 条目」取值，未获当次会话授权不会读取任何档案。敏感条目（证件、银行卡、住址、健康）默认掩码，凭证类数据写入时直接拒收；年龄和下次生日一律查询时现算，asOf 能复原过去某天的答案，身高体重住址这类会过期的条目带新鲜度提醒。提供五个 profile_* 工具和设置页，可浏览、编辑、删除与撤销授权。

items.de: Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/pro
items.dz: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。

items.de: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session Progress tab, and a manual "nudge now" action.
items.dz: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

items.de: Personal assistant for projects, conversations, memory, reviews and news. Bundled WeChat pins the QR-confirmed account; first messages cannot claim ownership. An optional allowlist further restricts access. Missing or conflicting identity requires desktop recovery. API acceptance is not phone receip
items.dz: 个人助理：在授权范围内整理项目，衔接原生对话、记忆、回顾与资讯。单包内置微信，扫码确认账号为唯一操作者，陌生人先发消息不能认领；白名单可进一步限制，身份缺失或冲突会暂停并提示在电脑恢复。接口接受不代表手机实收。

items.dz: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`、`enabled` 开关和对某个既有条目的编辑器；按项目的工具策略（`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`）配合固定项与 `mcp_search_tools` 决定模型可见范围；`${VAR}` 引用依次从项目 `.env` 文件与

Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semant
items.dz: 北极星记忆：DeepSeek Harness 本地优先项目记忆插件。每项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 工具、/memory 命令与设置页；分级注入（用户画像常驻 + 场景触发记忆带 P1/P2/P3 等级）、语义召回（IDF+同义词层）、底线记忆硬守卫机制（识别禁止语义→授权→拦截 AI 删除；用户可确认绕过）。

items.dz: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

items.dz: ai-shushu/dsh-quota-meter 的增强衍生版，不能与上游同装（都占用 /quota 路由）。DSH 的会话额度与花费监控：按可编辑的模型价目表（含峰谷价）对真实 token 用量记账，输入框上方显示消耗进度条、会话头部右侧显示余额胶囊（余额需 DeepSeek API Key），额度耗尽时拦截新的模型调用；子代理与辅助调用的消耗并入父会话账本。

items.de: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quo
items.dz: 把引用与消息正文彻底分开：引用任意助手回合里的段落会打开输入框上方的引用行，随下一回合作为 system-prompt 上下文注入模型（带来源与时间标注），并在回合尾部以可展开的「引用(N)」行显示这一轮到底用了哪几条；引用本地落盘、刷新不丢、按回合认领；宿主与客户端两半体做版本握手并上报兼容结论。

items.de: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed.
items.dz: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

items.de: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页版会话里划词后，把选中内容引用到当前输入框，或分派到子智能体会话：引用落在输入框正上方的引用条上，或在右侧新开一格打开该子智能体会话。目标还没有子智能体时先挂起这条引用，并在输入框写入派生请求，新子会话一出现就自动接续。纯客户端。

items.de: Alibaba Cloud / Qwen balance card above the Settings row in the DSH web sidebar: account available and cash balance, coupon balances with expiry dates (student vouchers included) read through the BSS OpenAPI, and OpenAI-compatible relay quota. An official DashScope sk- key has no balance endpoint at
items.dz: DSH Web 侧栏「设置」行上方的阿里云 / Qwen 余额卡片：经 BSS OpenAPI 显示账户可用额度与现金余额、代金券余额与到期日（含学生 300 元券），以及 OpenAI 兼容中转站额度。官方百炼 / DashScope 的 sk- key 没有任何余额接口，想看真金白银与代金券必须用带 bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount（建议只挂 AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess）的阿里云 AccessKey；密钥只留在宿主进程，浏览器只拿到掩码后的 AccessKey ID，/api/dsh-qwen-balance/* 仅允

items.de: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
items.dz: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

items.de: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.
items.dz: 在 composer 状态行加一条 24px 胶囊，播放 7 个预置网络电台；带实时频谱、Nightride FM 与 Radio Paradise 的当前曲目，并记住音量和上次电台。

items.de: Violet-gold acrylic DSH Web theme with light and dark stage art, framed chat, workspace mascot, and an optional Raiden agent preset.
items.dz: 紫金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色与深色舞台背景、描边对话框、工作区吉祥物与可选 Raiden Agent 预设。

items.de: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).
items.dz: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

items.de: Ranks the top 400 DSH plugin candidates by live npm download counts and shows the top 200, with daily, weekly and monthly boards.
items.dz: 对前 400 个候选按 npm 实时下载量排序、展示前 200 名，支持日榜、周榜、月榜。

items.de: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端顶部标题栏「编辑」右边加一个「刷新」按钮，只重载界面、不重启应用。

items.de: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
items.dz: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

items.de: An AI reading buddy: it sits next to you while you read, and only knows the pages you have already reached — so it cannot spoil the rest, and it never summarizes the whole book for you. Highlight a sentence and ask about it, or just ask about what you finished; it usually restates what you seem to m
items.dz: 读书时旁边坐一个 AI 同读的人：它只知道你读到的位置，所以不会剧透，也不会替你把整本书总结掉。觉得哪句有分量就划出来问它，或者直接问刚读完的内容——它多半先复述你的意思，再反问一个具体的问题。想明白的东西可以存成「收获」，之后变成复习卡片，点一下跳回原句。支持 EPUB、MOBI、FB2、TXT、Markdown、HTML、CBZ。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.idpf.org

items.de: Immersive read-only reading panel for DSH — the model delivers pre-formatted Markdown to a native right-sidebar tab via `reading_pad_send`, with three low-blue-light themes and 30em measure typography; also browse manuscript chapters read-only.
items.dz: DSH 沉浸式只读阅读板：模型用 `reading_pad_send` 把已排版 Markdown 推到原生右侧栏「📖 阅读板」tab，三套低蓝光主题、30em 限宽排版；也可只读浏览当前写作工程的章节。

items.de: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes anchored to text offsets and three agent tools for listing books, reading highlights and pulling text excerpts.
items.dz: DSH 阅读工作台：封面网格书架 + 单/双页分页阅读器，支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML、EPUB、MOBI、PDF，划线笔记以文本偏移锚定，并提供书目、划线、正文节选三个 Agent 工具。

items.de: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while keeping a recovery path. Pruning happens at the source, not after content reaches the context. Measured 43.9% fewer prompt tokens in a modelled
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

items.de: A 3D-rendered whale desktop pet that swims around the lower-right corner of the dsh web UI and reacts to task events with attention animations and whale-call sounds.
items.dz: 在 dsh web 界面右下角游动的 3D 渲染鲸鱼桌面宠物，任务完成或出错时播放 attention 动画与鲸吟声。

items.de: Uses a configurable system-prompt section to request a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and expands thinking rows by default while preserving rows the user manually collapses.
items.dz: 通过可配置的系统提示词章节要求模型使用指定语言推理（默认简体中文），并默认展开思考行，同时保留用户手动折叠的状态。

items.de: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
items.dz: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

items.de: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
items.dz: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

items.de: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the tu
items.dz: 轻量级解压并读取历史会话，让新会话读取之前会话的内容，单次操作毫秒级。`/recall` 列出当前项目的历史会话（标题、最后活动时间、轮次、首问）；`/recall <序号>` 读回该会话的轮次内容；`/recall all` 覆盖所有项目；也可用自然语言让模型调用 `recall_sessions` 工具查询。

items.de: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.
items.dz: 在左下角显示这一场里，失败或空结果之后又用同一组参数重试花了多少钱。

items.de: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.
items.dz: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

items.de: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not
items.dz: 跨所有工作目录的扁平会话列表：显示最后一句提问、按时间分组、全文搜索，并让随手记下的想法在重开会话时提醒。是 huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions 的重写分支，界面按原生样式重做；两者注册同一个 recent-sessions 面板 id，不要与原版同装。

items.de: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collap
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置。

items.de: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context
items.dz: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

items.de: Double-click one of your own messages to rewrite it and continue in a new branch from that point.
items.dz: 双击自己发送的消息即可修改，并从该处开一条新分支继续。

items.de: A port of DeepSeek-Refined for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), which injects "Obsidian Border"-style Markdown styling and multi-theme color schemes into the DSH frontend.
items.dz: DeepSeek-Refined 的 DSH 移植版：为 DSH 前端注入 Obsidian Border 等 5 个风格的 Markdown 美化与 5 套主题配色，并提供调色板按钮。

items.de: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.
items.dz: DSH 桌面应用重启按钮：侧栏一个入口，关闭全部 Harness 进程后重新启动应用；启动过程无控制台窗口、无关闭确认框。仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Three things for DSH plugin development: reload the plugins whose files changed, restart the client when a reload cannot apply a change, and let the model trigger a reload itself. Reload uses DSH's own path, so untouched plugins keep running. Restart starts outside the client, so it completes even w
items.dz: 给 DSH 插件开发准备三件事：重载文件有改动的插件、重载办不到的改动就重启客户端、模型能自己触发热重载。重载走 DSH 自带的路径，没碰过的插件继续运行。重启从客户端外部发起，所以被替换的正是客户端也能完成，有会话或后台任务在跑时拒绝。轻量：不带参数、不添加上下文、按钮默认不出现。

items.de: Two buttons in the top-left of the DSH header — reload the UI and restart the app.
items.dz: 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个按钮：刷新界面、重启应用。

items.de: Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.
items.dz: 扫码即可用手机远程控制 DeepSeek Harness：查看会话、发送消息、上传图片，支持局域网、IPv6 与 Cloudflare 隧道。

items.de: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel inside the DSH WebUI settings: five cards in the main list (remote access, public tunnel, devices, trash, app dow
items.dz: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里提供「手机设置」面板：主列表五张卡（远程访问 / 外网隧道 / 设备 / 回收站 / App 下载），另有「高级设置」组收纳授权根目录、识图与插件三项。

items.de: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

items.de: Use SSH hosts and WSL distributions as remote DSH workspaces, with environment setup, model configuration porting, and the remote interface embedded locally.
items.dz: 将 SSH 主机与 WSL 发行版接入远程 DSH 工作区，支持环境安装、模型配置移植与本地内嵌远程界面。

items.de: SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 SSH 会话管理：连接档案、Agent 远程执行、交互终端与 SFTP；秘密仅存于 DSH 凭据中心。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
items.dz: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

items.de: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
items.dz: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

items.de: Adds a diagram button under every finished reply in the DSH Web UI: the configured model writes a single-file HTML page with inline SVG and the right sidebar renders it in a sandboxed iframe, with diagram, source and original-text views, a per-session replay history that is served from a disk cache
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面每条定稿回复下加一个「图解」按钮：模型产出单文件 HTML（内联 SVG），右侧栏以沙箱 iframe 渲染；带图解／源码／原文三个视图、命中磁盘缓存即回放（不再调用模型）的会话内历史列表、重画与另存 .html。

items.de: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
items.dz: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

items.de: Lets the conversation AI maintain a plain-language functional requirements checklist in a dedicated session view. A non-official rebuild of Songran241/dsh-req-workbench that keeps the upstream package name; do not install it alongside the upstream original.
items.dz: 让对话中的 AI 在会话需求页整理、合并和更新通俗的功能清单。基于 Songran241/dsh-req-workbench 的非官方重构版，沿用上游包名，不能与原版同时安装。

items.de: Registers fifteen slash commands (/idea, /review, /poster, ...) that inject the matching research skill's SKILL.md as a user message, so installed skills run without a marketplace. The skills are not bundled and must already be under ~/.dsh/skills or ~/.agents/skills, otherwise commands report skill
items.dz: 把装好的研究技能变成斜杠命令：/idea、/novelty、/review、/poster……一共十五条，敲一下就把对应的 SKILL.md 塞进对话，照着跑那个技能。技能不随包提供，须已装在 ~/.dsh/skills 或 ~/.agents/skills 下，否则命令只提示找不到技能。

items.de: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, dra
items.dz: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

items.de: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from three places: a Settings row, the account menu above Sign out, and a configurable keyboard shortcut. Asks before interrupting running tasks. If a newer update is already downloaded and waiting, restarting installs it first. Windows desktop app only.
items.dz: 从三处重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：设置里的按钮、账号菜单「退出登录」上方的一项、以及可自定义的快捷键；有运行中的任务时会先确认；若新版本更新已下载并等待安装，重启时会先静默安装更新。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

items.de: Draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows only, dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own, with a cancel button, a watchdog and a clear failure message. Icon, background colour and position lock are edited in Settings.
items.dz: 给 dsh Web GUI 的悬浮重启按钮（仅 Windows，需 dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1）：拖动改位置、点击确认后一键重启应用与 Host，可中途取消、超时会自动收手并说明原因；图标（4 个自带矢量图或上传图片）、底色、位置锁定都在设置里改。

items.de: Restarts the DSH desktop host on macOS when a change needs it, then hands the conversation back to the same session with a note the model writes about why it restarted and what comes next.
items.dz: 改动需要重启时自动重启 DSH 桌面宿主（仅 macOS），重启后把模型写的交接话（为什么重启、下一步做什么）投回原会话继续。

items.de: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.
items.dz: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。

items.de: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
items.dz: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

items.de: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 界面添加基于本机回环接口的重启按钮，按当前进程的可执行文件、参数和工作目录请求重新启动。

items.de: Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready.
items.dz: 检测 DSH 服务重启后自动唤醒主 agent：对比上次运行时间、人性化播报中断时长，并把提示消息投递回来让中断的工作自动恢复。仅依赖 cordis ctx 服务，兼容 DSH Desktop 打包环境。

items.de: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
items.dz: 把每个产物文件卡片变成按文件操作的下拉菜单：打开文件、拷贝路径、在系统文件浏览器中定位，或打开终端并进入其目录。

items.de: A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions.

items.dz: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

items.de: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.

items.de: Session replay view for DSH conversations: replays a session turn by turn at reading pace for prompts and answers while reasoning and tool output stream past, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. items.de: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that f
items.dz: 模型路由浪费取证：回放每个会话，按请求形状确定性判定每轮任务复杂度（不调 LLM），报两类浪费——贵模型干 便宜活（差额可计算），以及便宜模型干贵活且因自身能力失败（每次重试重发整个上下文，比直接升级更贵）。会 区分服务商容量限制（RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）与模型能力失败，所以不会天天喊狼来了。并从证据推导路由 规则，按内置每百万 token 价目表估算金额。

items.de: Brings the rtk token-saving setup from Claude Code to DeepSeek Harness: commands rtk can rewrite are rewritten, and builds, tests and logs it cannot reach are compressed; git, cargo, npm and pytest are covered. items.dz: 把 Claude Code 里 rtk 的省 token 机制接进 DSH：能改写的命令交给 rtk 重写，改写够不着的构建、测试、日志也会被压缩；git、cargo、npm、pytest 等常见命令都有覆盖。压缩后会告诉模型省略了什么、怎么找回原文——读不到 rtk 存储时原文另存并给出路径；省了多少不用敲命令，输入框下方的浮标直接显示，`/rtk stats` 看明细。改写不可靠时原命令照常执行：rtk 跑不起来，或命令会丢参数，都不会失败。rtk 二进制随包，主流平台不用像多数其他 rtk 插件那样先自行安装。
