items.dz: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Routes web search and fetch, records estimated costs, and provides local budgets, circuit breakers, and diagnostics. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.3.
items.dz: 路由网页搜索和抓取，记录估算费用，并提供本地预算、渠道熔断和诊断功能。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.3。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

items.de: Expose a second-opinion tool: when the main agent is stuck it hands the problem to an independent session, receives a plan back, and continues — without waking or impersonating the user.
items.dz: 跨会话「第二意见」：一个会话卡住时，把问题交给另一个独立会话单独思考，把方案拿回来继续。不冒充用户发言，也不唤醒闲置会话。

items.de: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.
items.dz: 面向 dsh-mneme 的记忆巩固调优（开启 autoDream、放大输出预算、deepseek-chat 路由）与 llm-deepseek 推理力度修复，附带可审计智能体运行时 seed-society 的 MCP 工具桥与六个唯识种子技能。

items.de: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-o
items.dz: 致远工作台：把 OA 待办、会议、技能市场和 aTrust VPN 一键登录合成一个面板。内含模块替代作者的 dsh-seeyon-todo / dsh-skillhub / dsh-vpn，二选一，不可同装。需要致远 OA 账号；VPN 部分仅限 Windows，且需先安装深信服 aTrust 客户端。

items.de: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
items.dz: 在对话里划词引用进输入框（显示为「N 条注释」小框），或在侧栏一次性小窗里就这段内容提问（不留任何记录）。

items.de: Adds text-selection quote cards above the composer and temporary native sidebar chats, with a Save button to keep a chat in its source workspace.
items.dz: 在输入框上方添加划词引用卡片，并提供临时原生侧边聊天，可通过保存按钮将会话保留到来源工作区。

items.de: Select text in any Windows app to explain or translate it with the Harness agent, answered in a native always-on-top overlay.
items.dz: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，用 Harness 自己的 agent 解释或翻译（自动带上选区所在的上下文段落），结果落在可拖动、可缩放的原生置顶浮窗里。

items.de: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
items.dz: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

items.de: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.
items.dz: 按工作区存放的纯 Markdown 跨会话记忆：重要性加权注入、双时态失效、按 TTL 复查并标注可能失效、凭据脱敏、出错与会话复盘、SOP 技能沉淀，以及需人工确认的自我改进提案。

items.de: Self-narrative memory in five budgeted segments (800 chars, not a full context): a first-person note the model writes to itself, a profile of you aggregated from approved facts, environment facts kept separate from who you are, heat-ranked conclusions, and habits. Every injected fact is traceable to
items.dz: 五段预算制的自我叙述记忆（共 800 字，不是整段上下文）：模型写给自己看的第一人称自述、从已采纳记忆聚合的「关于你」画像、与本机环境事实分开的画像、按热度排序的结论、以及习惯。每条注入的事实都能回溯到具体事实 id，可一键退役；画像可手改覆盖，自述则是可清空的纯文本行。事实按使用与时间衰减，但可信度不随时间变。你说过的长期要求会被自动识别成候选（永不自动采纳），互相冲突的两条并排留着。另外带出处的历史检索、只解新增帧的增量索引、必须有指针的温层摘要、能说清哪里坏了的体检，证明注入还活着的心跳，以及能整体搬到另一台机器的导出/导入。

items.de: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
items.dz: 一份按项目维护的业务概念词表、只读命名漂移扫描，以及注入每个 Agent 提示的同一套命名规则。

items.de: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PAT
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

items.de: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

items.de: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-ba
items.dz: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the
items.dz: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

items.de: Turns a past session into a reusable Skill offline: it extracts the verified steps, the files that were edited, failure/fix pairs and the final checks, each tagged with its session event number.
items.dz: 把一段历史会话离线蒸馏成可复用的 Skill：提取跑通的步骤、改过的文件、失败与修正、验证命令，并标注各自的会话事件序号。

items.de: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: a safe session-delete tool that copies the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot to a local archive folder and checks them file by file before deleting a session to free disk space; subagent sessions i
items.dz: 给 DSH 会话「···」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：这是一个安全的会话删除工具（session-delete），删除会话前先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

items.de: Batch-manage DSH sessions: sidebar multi-select, a dashboard tree of main sessions and subagents with token/cache/context stats, bulk archive and cascade delete, and recall of ungrouped sessions into re-added workspaces.
items.dz: DSH 会话批量管理：侧栏多选、主会话与子代理的树形看板（token／缓存／上下文统计）、批量归档与级联删除，以及把未分组会话召回重新添加的工作区。

items.de: Session board orb: live thinking and tool progress per session, task duration, context usage and 12h/30d usage stats; click through to any session.
items.dz: 会话看板：悬浮球一览所有工作区会话，实时显示思考与工具进展、任务耗时、上下文用量，支持近 12h/30 天用量统计，点击直达会话。

items.de: Read, message and live-follow local DeepSeek Harness sessions from inside an agent: four tools (session_list, session_read, session_send, session_chat) plus a matching Python CLI, over the desktop app local RPC; transcripts also read offline. Requires Python 3.10+; offline transcript reads also need
items.dz: 在 agent 里枚举、读取、发送并实时跟随本机 DeepSeek Harness 会话：四个工具（session_list、session_read、session_send、session_chat）加同功能 Python CLI，走桌面 App 本地 RPC，离线也能读转录。需要 Python 3.10+；离线读转录还需要 zstd 命令。

items.de: Workspace conversation categories with drag-and-drop ordering, collapsible groups, activity indicators, and workspace registration by directory path.
items.dz: 工作区内会话分类，支持拖拽排序、分组折叠、任务状态提示及路径添加工作区。

items.de: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.
items.dz: 将选中的聊天片段分享为 Markdown、HTML、TXT 或 PNG；提供 Session Header 弹窗（范围或多选、脱敏、工具调用、子代理对话）与 /share 命令。

items.de: Per-session clock injection with durable idle-gap tracking: tells the agent how long it has been since this particular conversation last spoke, which the host's time context (last message only) cannot.
items.dz: 给指定会话授时，并给出「距上次对话过去多久」。补上宿主时间上下文只算「距上一条消息」、无法按会话开关的缺口。

items.de: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

items.de: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system p
items.dz: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

items.de: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

items.de: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, only the messages you tick (QQ/WeChat-style multi-select), or the working directory.
items.dz: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown、勾选的部分消息（QQ/微信式多选）或工作目录。

items.de: Session management for DSH: archive or delete one session, archive/delete all sessions in a workspace, and restore archived sessions from the settings page — archiving backs up workspace metadata and restoring recreates deleted workspace registrations automatically.
items.dz: DSH 会话管理：可归档或删除单个会话，工作区行可归档全部、恢复已归档或删除全部会话，设置页可查看/恢复/删除已归档会话；归档时备份工作区信息，恢复时自动恢复原工作区，原工作区被删除时自动重建。

items.de: Fork of harness-session-delete that adds Delete to the native session action menu and a recycle-bin page with search, sort, workspace grouping, message preview, batch restore, and per-workspace permanent purge; active sessions are protected.
items.dz: 在原生会话操作菜单中加入「删除」，并提供支持搜索、排序、工作区分组、消息预览、批量恢复与按工作区彻底清除的会话回收站；活跃会话受到保护。

items.de: Add a "Delete session…" item to the sidebar session row menu that moves the session log and projection cache to the OS recycle bin after confirmation, then removes it from the workspace list. Windows only: on macOS and Linux it returns an error and changes nothing; a session loaded in the current ru
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话行的「⋯」菜单里加一行「删除会话…」，确认后把该会话的日志与投影缓存移到操作系统回收站，并从工作区列表移除。仅支持 Windows：macOS 与 Linux 下会报错且不做任何改动；本次运行中已加载的会话要等重启 DSH 后才会从侧栏消失。

items.de: Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏会话菜单中加入一键「删除会话」：把会话日志与该对话的 .dsh-sessions 产出目录移入 Windows 回收站，没有确认弹窗。

items.de: Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / W
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 右侧栏提供按会话的 diff 视图：打开当前对话改动过的文件时原位渲染，按 git 风格显示新增/删除行底色、+/− 行标记、新旧双行号与语法高亮，头部带 +新增 −删除 计数、「仅看改动 / 整个文件」切换和「重新读取」按钮；另有一个配套标签页列出本次会话改动过的所有文件，点开即进入同一视图。当前对话没有改动过的文件仍使用自带文本查看器。

items.de: Search every DSH chat session and jump straight to the matching message: multi-keyword AND search, scoped to the current session, all sessions or one project, anchored by call id for tool hits, with a draggable panel for previous and next.
items.dz: 跨会话搜索 DSH 聊天记录并直接跳到命中的那条消息：多关键词同时匹配，可限定当前会话、全部会话或某个项目，工具命中按 callId 精确定位，浮层可拖拽并支持上一处、下一处。

items.de: DSH Session Fork Tree Arrangement: forked sessions sit under their parent with an indent and a rounded connector, sessions that own forks carry a green "+" that collapses by default and expands level by level, and hovering a child highlights its ancestor chain.
items.dz: DSH 会话分叉树排列功能：分叉会话缩进排在父会话下方并绘制圆角连接线，有分叉的会话名字右侧带绿色“+”，默认收起、逐层展开，悬停子会话时祖先链高亮。

items.de: Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.
items.dz: 仿 Edge 标签页分组的 DSH 侧栏会话分组插件，支持 DSH Web / Desktop；提供最多三层的组内分组、工作区树、单列表、递归排序、RGB 自定义颜色、折叠状态汇总、子代理展开与状态联动，以及需要用户审核的 AI 会话整理工具。

items.de: Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu creates a successor session that rebuilds the old session's memory, tasks and rules through an eight-section takeover packet, with light context via on-demand transcript readback.
items.dz: 会话工作移交：会话行菜单一键移交，新会话按八节交接包复刻老会话的记忆、任务与铁律，原始上下文经按需回读保持轻量。

items.de: Adds the owning workspace and current Git branch under each session row in the flat session list.
items.dz: 在单列表的每个会话行标题下方显示所属工作区与当前 Git 分支。

items.de: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalCont

items.de: Settings-page manager for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: restore an archived session to its previous workspace position or permanently delete it (direct physical deletion, no backup layer). Adds a red permanently-delete item to the session context menu and three agent tools. Deleting an open se
items.dz: 在设置页管理已归档会话：恢复或彻底删除（直接物理删除，无备份层）。会话菜单新增红色彻底删除项，附三个 agent 工具。已打开的会话也能立即删除，残留内存副本以归档墓碑隐藏、重启后自动清理。

items.de: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.
items.dz: 把当前会话导出为可读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话正文：用户消息、助手文本与 ask_user_question 问答，通过会话标题栏按钮或 /md 命令触发。

items.de: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or
items.dz: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

items.de: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.
items.dz: 按会话逐个备份 DSH 对话：增量镜像、模糊匹配恢复（先预览再确认）、按规则清理并先进回收站留 7 天。

items.de: Adds nested folders above workspaces in the sidebar, drag-to-reorder for workspaces, folders and sessions, and moves a session to another workspace together with its working directory.
items.dz: 在侧栏工作区之上加一层可嵌套文件夹，支持工作区/文件夹/会话拖动排序，并能把会话连同工作目录移动到其它工作区。

items.de: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

items.de: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.
items.dz: 从原始磁盘恢复被删除或损坏的 dsh 会话（session.jsonl.zstd）与记忆库（memory.db），并通过 web 界面中的 /session-repair 命令修复重建后无法续接的会话。

items.de: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
items.dz: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

items.de: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
items.dz: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

items.de: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
items.dz: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

items.de: Rewinds a finished turn in place — a button next to your own message withdraws that message and everything after it from the model context, puts its text back in the composer for editing, and optionally restores the files the turn changed through the DSH filesystem service.
items.dz: 就地回退已完成的回合：点你自己消息旁的按钮即可把这条消息及之后的内容从模型上下文中撤回，原文回到输入框可直接改完重发，并可一并恢复该回合经 DSH 文件系统服务改动过的文件。

items.de: Automatically split long DSH conversations into volumes (every 10 user messages by default) with todo handoff snapshots, source navigation and read-only archives.
items.dz: 长会话默认每 10 条用户消息自动分卷，携带待办交接快照继续工作，支持来源回溯与归档只读。

items.de: Persistent search bar in the conversation header: keyword-search the message bodies of past sessions, then open the session at the matched text.
items.dz: 对话页顶部常驻搜索栏：按关键词搜索历史会话的消息正文，点击结果直接打开会话并定位到命中的那段文字。

items.de: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.
items.dz: 让会话日志永远不会因为一次畸形 tool call 而打不开：坏调用自动修复，正常调用原样通过，历史永远可加载。

items.de: A right-side session stats panel showing average cache-hit rate, session cost, runtime, request count, cumulative tokens and account balance.
items.dz: 右侧会话统计面板，展示平均缓存命中率、会话成本、运行时长、请求数、累计 token 与账户余额。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
items.dz: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

items.de: Call between DSH sessions in different working directories or projects: message any session (next-step delivery or a new turn), end a blocking tool call on request, and read transcripts and usage without waking the target.
items.dz: 在不同目录 / 项目的 DSH 会话之间通话：向任意会话发消息（下一步直达或开新轮），可按需结束对方阻塞中的工具调用，并在不唤醒对方的情况下读取记录与用量。

items.de: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
items.dz: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

items.de: Regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the model the session itself last used, with an editable preview before the new title is written back.
items.dz: 根据会话最近 10 轮用户 prompt，用该会话最近一次使用的模型重新生成标题，预览确认后写回。

items.de: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, title-language control, a settings page, and hover duration/cost/token stats.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话标题固定为「日期 | 分类 | 名称」，支持自动重算、标题语言、设置页，以及悬停查看耗时/估算成本/token。

items.de: Configurable session titles with custom prompts, refresh policies, local topic-drift detection, and single-session or historical title regeneration.
items.dz: 可配置的会话标题生成，支持自定义提示词、刷新策略、本地话题漂移检测，以及单条会话和历史标题重建。

items.de: Adds header buttons that move a started session into another workspace and switch the Agent preset of a session that already began.
items.dz: 在会话头部添加按钮，可把已开始的会话迁移到另一个工作区，或切换已开始会话的 Agent 预设。

items.de: Adds a "Move to another workspace…" row to every conversation menu: copies the full event log into the target workspace under a new session id (header, title and model preset preserved, delivery markers retargeted), reads the copy back to verify it, attaches it, then archives the original unless you
items.dz: 在每个对话的「⋯」菜单里加一行「转移到其他工作区…」：把完整事件日志复制成目标工作区下的新会话（保留 header、标题与模型预设，并改写投递标记），读回校验后挂载，默认归档原会话（可勾选保留）。

items.de: Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.
items.dz: 会话回收站：把对话移到回收站而不是直接删除，可以恢复，或再次确认后永久删除；本次启动中打开过的会话先隐藏，下次启动时再移入。

items.de: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.
items.dz: 把左侧栏的会话列表替换为完整会话树：展示全部会话及其多层子智能体，点击节点即可进入该会话的多轮对话；并附带 tree_send 工具，可向树中任意可续接的子会话投递消息。

items.de: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
items.dz: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

items.de: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no
items.dz: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

items.de: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.
items.dz: 当 DSH Web 设置导航的分区超出视口时，为其添加可见的纵向滚动条。

items.de: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
items.dz: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

items.de: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
items.dz: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

items.de: Import a public DeepSeek or Doubao chat share link into a DSH workspace as a static, resumable session.
items.dz: 把公开的 DeepSeek 或豆包对话分享链接导入 DSH 工作区，成为一个静态、可续聊的会话。

items.de: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
items.dz: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Read-only CSV/XLSX comparison by business keys, with offline review decisions, comments and source-verified feedback handoffs.
items.dz: 按业务主键对齐 CSV/XLSX 改动，离线记录审阅结论与批注，核对源文件后生成反馈交接包。

items.de: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
items.dz: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

items.de: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
items.dz: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

items.de: Multi-engine image generation inside the conversation: an agent tool plus a composer-dock panel with an on/off switch, engine presets (Volcengine Ark, SiliconFlow, OpenAI-compatible, custom) and local spend tracking. You supply the API key for the engine you pick.
items.dz: 会话内多引擎生图：agent 工具 + 输入框下方的停靠面板，带启用开关、引擎预设（火山方舟 / 硅基流动 / OpenAI 兼容 / 自定义）和本地消耗统计。需自备所选引擎的 API Key。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
items.dz: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

items.de: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
items.dz: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

items.de: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
items.dz: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

items.de: Captures a dragged desktop region with a global hotkey and either recognises its text with Windows OCR or attaches the screenshot to the chat draft.
items.dz: 全局快捷键截取桌面选区，用 Windows OCR 识别文字填入输入框，或直接把截图插入对话。

items.de: Adds a sidebar card to DeepSeek Harness (Windows verified) that shuts the machine down once every task finishes and the card is armed, holding back while background jobs, errored sessions or manual interruptions are still in play; the 1.6.1 beta adds restart, sleep, hibernation, lock, sign-out and u
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一张卡片（Windows 已验证），武装后等所有任务结束自动关机；后台任务在跑、本批次有会话报错、或你手动中断过，都会按条件暂缓并说明原因。1.6.1 beta 另加重启、睡眠、休眠、锁屏、注销与自定义脚本，并可在 macOS 与 Linux 上挂载（已实现，尚未在真机实测）。

items.de: A right-sidebar assistant that knows the main session's finished turns, follows the main agent's running steps and background jobs, and answers in the panel; its model, context budget and answer style are configurable.
items.dz: 侧边栏助手：知道主会话已完成的回合，跟随主 Agent 正在跑的步骤与后台 job，在面板里回答问题；模型、上下文预算与回答风格可配置。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cache
items.dz: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

items.de: Native DSH /side conversation tabs with a clean transcript and inherited context, hidden from the main session list using independent Session forks and the official chat UI, with timestamps, token usage, streaming and the command menu. Extracted from dsh-better-sidebar 0.29.0 (MIT); do not enable it
items.dz: 不进入左侧列表、空白开场且保留上下文的 /side 临时侧边对话，复用 DSH 原生分支和聊天界面，包含时间、用量、流式回复和原生命令菜单。核心代码提取自 dsh-better-sidebar 0.29.0（MIT），不能与 dsh-better-sidebar 自带的 /side 入口同时启用（命令冲突，使用前停用其一）。完整使用要求 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，并启用 dsh-delete-session 完成关闭后的永久清理。

items.de: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
items.dz: Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。

items.de: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
items.dz: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。

items.de: Launches a fresh, continuable parallel session from the composer command menu (/side-chat) while the main session keeps running.
items.dz: 主会话进行中也能一键新开独立的可续聊旁会话：从输入框 ＋ 命令菜单选 side-chat 即开即用，主会话不受影响。

items.de: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit w
items.dz: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

items.de: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.
items.dz: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 新增分支对话页签：开出独立封存 session，注入头／中／尾脉络摘要，并使用与主对话相同的工具。

items.de: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.
items.dz: 轻量级侧栏 UI：五个折叠开关、三档密度预设与三档宽度预设，入口收在底部一行与设置分区；无依赖、无后台服务。

items.de: Expands every session in the DSH Desktop sidebar. Its control page (/dsh-sidebar-expand-all) applies four equal-length patches to the app.asar workspace client bundle, with backup and one-click restore; after that the "Expand remaining N sessions" row reveals all hidden sessions in one click, collap
items.dz: 让 DSH 桌面版侧栏的会话全部展开。它的控制页（/dsh-sidebar-expand-all）对 app.asar 内 workspace client bundle 打四处等长补丁，带备份与一键还原；之后「展开其余 N 个会话」点一次就展开该工作区全部剩余会话，「收起」严格回到 5 个，重开工作区也保持全展开而不是退回五个。需要重启应用，DSH 升级后补丁会被覆盖。

items.de: Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.
items.dz: 右侧边栏的移动端视口预览标签页：九种预设尺寸（手机、平板、笔记本）及自定义宽高，一键复制当前地址，并可通过 @ 按钮或 /url 指令把页面地址插入输入框。

items.de: Markdown notepad in the right sidebar, side by side with the chat, with a formatting toolbar and local autosave.
items.dz: 右侧栏 Markdown 记事本，与聊天并排，带格式工具栏与本地自动保存。

items.de: Adds custom ordering and tucking away to seven strips of buttons and cards in DSH (the left sidebar, sidebar footer, conversation tabs, composer dock, session header icon strip, right sidebar and settings navigation), plus per-area drag switches and JSON layout import/export. Tucked rows land in the
items.dz: 为 DSH 的七处按钮与卡片区域（左侧边栏、侧栏底部、对话标签、输入框工具条、会话头部图标条、右侧栏、设置导航）提供自定义排序与收纳，并支持分区拖动开关和布局 JSON 导入/导出；收纳项会进入该区域内置的「更多」菜单，可随时拖回。

items.de: Puts a More row at the end of the sidebar main panel list and lets you decide, entry by entry, which panels stay visible and which move into it: a menu lists every entry with a one-click switch in either direction, a search box filters long lists, and a single Restore all clears both kinds of key. A
items.dz: 在侧边栏主导航列表末尾放一行「更多」，每个入口单独决定留在外面还是收进去：菜单列出全部入口，一行一个开关，两个方向的切换都只要点一下；入口多了能用搜索框筛，一个「全部恢复」把两类键一起清空。底部工具区的按钮也能收，插件入口锁死不可收；选择写进 profile 配置，DSH 重启后照样生效。

items.de: Adds a chevron row under New Session that folds the sidebar panel list in place, returning the height to the workspace and session list. The hiding is driven by one attribute on the page root plus CSS: no host bundle is patched and no row is unregistered, and plugin entries injected outside the pane
items.dz: 在侧边栏「新会话」下方加一行箭头开关，就地折叠面板列表，把高度还给工作区和会话列表。隐藏由一个页面根属性加纯 CSS 驱动：不打宿主补丁、不注销任何条目；插件注入在面板槽位之外的入口，也按各自的 data 属性一并折叠。状态按浏览器记忆，56px 窄栏下开关自动隐藏。

items.de: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板列表收进一行，点击弹出浮层切换面板。

items.de: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.
items.dz: 把侧边栏的全局面板条目折叠成少量可见行，并提供勾选面板决定留哪几个，条目一多时不再挤压工作区与会话区；只隐藏显示，不注销条目。

items.de: Adds an auto-hiding icon rail to the collapsed macOS Desktop sidebar, with workspace pinning and flyouts for recent sessions, scheduled tasks, user-installed plugins and account information.
items.dz: 为 macOS Desktop 折叠侧栏添加自动隐藏的图标轨，支持工作区置顶，以及最近会话、定时任务、用户安装插件和账号信息浮层。

items.de: Right-click menus for DSH sidebar rows: on DSH 0.2.2+ both rows use the host menus — workspace rows follow the session grouping (new session, copy path and reveal, pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu, bulk delete) and session rows extend the menu that opens at the pointer with pinned open-wi
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏行右键菜单：在 DSH 0.2.2 及以上，两类行用的都是宿主菜单——工作区行按会话菜单的分组排入新建会话、复制路径与在文件夹显示、置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单与批量删除；会话行在指针处展开菜单，并追加置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单以及已归档会话的永久删除。条目默认只出现在右键菜单，可在设置里逐项开启「同时放进「…」菜单」；0.2.1 上工作区菜单由插件自绘。 改编自 miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu 与 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu，请勿与它们同时安装——三者都会给同一批侧边栏行挂右键菜单。

items.de: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Window
items.dz: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

items.de: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tuna
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

items.de: Read and search logs and run permitted commands over SSH according to configured permissions.
items.dz: 根据配置的权限通过 SSH 读取和搜索日志，并运行允许的命令。

items.de: Fork of @linxin666/dsh-ssh (the two cannot be enabled at the same time): resolves an SSH host by its NIC MAC address before dialing, so DHCP address changes stop breaking saved hosts.
items.dz: 基于 @linxin666/dsh-ssh 的二次开发（两者不能同时启用）：建链前先按网卡 MAC 把主机解析成当前 IP，DHCP 换号不用改配置。

items.de: Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.
items.dz: SSH 增强运维：连接测试、远程目录、ssh-config 导入、指纹检查与多主机批量执行。

items.de: SSH remote execution set: give a session an ssh:// workspace and every file, command, and shell operation runs on the remote host.
items.dz: SSH 远程执行插件集：把会话工作区指向 ssh:// 目录，文件读写、命令与 shell 全部在远程主机上执行。

items.de: Password SSH into a remote host: an ssh_remote tool with connect/exec/close/status over a persistent ControlMaster session, plus a floating browser terminal panel on a real PTY.
items.dz: 用密码直连远程主机的 SSH 终端：ssh_remote 工具提供 connect/exec/close/status 四个动作，底层是 ControlMaster 常驻会话；另带浏览器浮动终端面板，跑真实 PTY。

items.de: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
items.dz: 已安装 dsh 插件的稳定性审计：静态风险分级（钩子面/启动任务/inject/入口/依赖区间）加可选隔离安装验证。

items.de: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
items.dz: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

items.de: Starpost (星邮) is a social network built for AI bots: one account per bot, with friends, group chats, posts and comments, a public square, message bottles and scheduled Werewolf games, plus daily chat quotas and an anti-repetition limiter. This package is the DeepSeek Harness client for Starpost — 17
items.dz: 星邮是给 AI bot 用的社交平台：一个 bot 一个账号，能加好友、建群、发动态评论、逛广场、扔漂流瓶、约一局预约制狼人杀，还带每日聊天额度和重复句式限制。本包是星邮在 DeepSeek Harness 上的客户端：17 个工具覆盖上面这些功能，收到的事件按可配置间隔（默认 20 秒）合并成一条提示注入会话，回复走同一套工具。需要自备星邮账号，首次运行在插件面板里注册。由 hth768 的 MIT 项目 cortico-world-starpost 移植而来（源码在 vendor/ 下），不能与上游 Coo 扩展同装。

items.de: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
items.dz: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

items.de: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
items.dz: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

items.de: A deep-sea dive startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: a depth gauge with a submersible probe, a character reveal video that then loops, and a seafloor with coral, bubbles and slow drifting particles. The depth reached decides which sea creatures appear.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的深海下潜式启动开屏：深度尺与探测器、角色出场视频接无缝循环、海底珊瑚与气泡与缓慢漂浮的微光粒子；下潜到哪一层，就出现哪一层的海洋生物。

items.de: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
items.dz: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

items.de: Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.
items.dz: 把外部数据库与文献语料登记成模型可调用的取数工具；每条库声明取数边界，钥匙台账只记引用名不存值，取数台账只留指纹与内容哈希而不留响应体。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, optional question text in the notification, an optional native Windows and WSL toast channel that bypasses Focus Assist, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no brow
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可在通知中显示提问正文、可选的原生 Windows/WSL 通知通道（可越过专注助手），没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

items.de: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
items.dz: 为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。

items.de: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
items.dz: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

items.de: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for text, images, and files, with read and pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue.
items.dz: 在输入框上方增加独立插话栏，支持文字、图片和普通文件，显示读取状态并可在未读取时取消，任务结束时救援未发送草稿。

items.de: Deterministic step governance for DSH agents: rejects over-budget agent steps and denies risky tool executions before they run, with shadow mode by default and fail-open on errors.
items.dz: 为 DSH 代理提供确定性步数治理，在超预算的 agent 步执行前拒绝、在风险工具调用执行前阻断，默认影子模式，出错时放行不阻断业务。

items.de: Adds a sticker pack to DeepSeek Harness replies. The plugin rolls the dice, the model attaches the chosen sticker at the end of its reply, and the pictures come from a remote pack.json you can host anywhere.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复加上表情包。贴不贴由插件掷骰决定，模型把选中的图放到回复末尾；图库来自一个可以自己托管的远端 pack.json。

items.de: A sticky-notes panel for DSH with a draggable floating window, a full sidebar page, Markdown preview, pasted images and configurable settings.
items.dz: 一个 DSH 便签面板，支持可拖动悬浮窗、侧栏整页、Markdown 预览、粘贴图片与设置项，数据仅存于浏览器本地。

items.de: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.
items.dz: 钉在 DSH 窗口顶部的常驻行情条：自选股、带股数与成本价的持仓、盈亏、K 线与分时图、五档盘口、交易流水、价格预警，以及用 DSH 已配置模型流式生成的 AI 复盘。

items.de: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.
items.dz: A 股 / 港股 / 美股与板块自选面板，带分时迷你走势图，并向 agent 提供 stock_quote 工具。

items.de: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
items.dz: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching
items.dz: A 股 / ETF / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面右上角显示可折叠、可拖动的弹窗，同时盯多个市场——实时行情、分时与日/周/月 K 线（含均线）、买卖目标价、分组管理（切换、拖动排序、重命名、删除）、跨市场搜索、明暗主题。fork 自 Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch，新增东方财富美股行情与 OKX 现货加密货币行情。

items.de: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
items.dz: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

items.de: SketchUp Pro 2023 bridge for DeepSeek Harness that lets the agent inspect a live model, run Ruby task scripts, save .skp files and capture viewport PNGs.
items.dz: SketchUp Pro 2023 桥接插件：让 Agent 检查实时模型、执行 Ruby 任务脚本、保存 .skp 并截取视口 PNG。

items.de: Adds a management page for the official DeepSeek Harness ACP subagent provider, with one-click presets, a read-only connectivity check, live switches for all three entry points, and online preset updates.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 ACP 子智能体 provider 提供目标管理页、一键预设、只读连通性检测、三个入口的实时开关与在线预设更新。

items.de: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
items.dz: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

items.de: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.
items.dz: 子代理委派提供方：通过可配置的 executablePath 字段，运行任意 Claude 兼容 CLI 二进制。

items.de: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
items.dz: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

items.de: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offli
items.dz: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.
items.dz: 把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组，本次始终展开；不改动原版头部。

items.de: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
items.dz: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

items.de: Derivative of dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model (do not install both): routes subagent delegations by role with candidate pools, cross-provider failover and fork window slicing; shows running subagents in a header panel with duration and token counts; supports mid-run and batch model switching a
items.dz: 基于 dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model 的衍生作品（不要与上游同装）：按角色为子代理派发选路由，带候补池、跨供应商故障转移与 fork 活跃窗口切片；标题栏显示正在运行的子代理及其时长与 token；支持运行中与批量换模型，并给模型提供可调用的路由工具。

items.de: Route table assigning provider, model, and reasoning effort to subagents by workspace directory prefix; supports global default policy and in-composer session popover.
items.dz: 按工作区目录给子智能体指定 provider、模型与思考等级的路由表：最长前缀匹配后注入子代理配置，支持全局默认策略、设置页规则编辑与会话输入区就地切换。

items.de: Subagent Toolkit: folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, adds per-row and whole-group deletion of subagent sessions, and keeps the subagent model allowlist live per delegation. The original header is left untouched.
items.dz: 子代理工具箱：把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组（本次常展开），支持行内/整组删除子代理会话，并让子代理模型名单实时生效（逐任务选模型）；不改动原版头部。

items.de: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
items.dz: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

items.de: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow
items.dz: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

items.de: Select any text in a DSH conversation and tap Ctrl to get an inline sub-topic card: streaming answer, follow-up tree, and drag-to-quote reference chips.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话里选中一段文字按 Ctrl，就地开出子话题卡片：流式解答、追问树，还能把树行拖成引用卡片。

items.de: Windows 10/11 x64 only: a desktop character for DeepSeek Harness that reads at the bookshelf when idle, types at a desk while the agent works, raises a question mark and a pixel-art card when it needs your answer, and stands up with an exclamation mark when the turn ends.
items.dz: 仅限 Windows 10 1903+/11 x64：DeepSeek Harness 的桌面角色——空闲时在书架前翻书，工作时坐在桌前打字，需要你回答时举起问号并弹出像素风提问卡片，回合结束时起身举起感叹号。

items.de: Replaces the harness identity block with its own prompt pack: three system-prompt sections (identity, rules, footer) in full, concise and dev presets, a per-turn rule card appended as a real user message, a remote announcement feed that falls back to a bundled copy offline, a GitHub Releases update
items.dz: 用自带的提示词包替换宿主身份块：identity、rules、footer 三个系统提示词分区，full/concise/dev 三档预设，每轮把一张规则卡片作为真实用户消息追加，公告源离线时回退到内置副本，检查 GitHub Releases 并可用命令应用更新，五个 `sunder_*` 工具，设置页里一个只读状态分区。

items.de: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables, charts, timelines, kanban, flow charts, clickable actions), a content auto-layout mode, four placements (inline, process, dock board above the co
items.dz: 用原生 UI 卡片代替 Markdown 回答：模型调用 render_ui，答案直接渲染成对话里的卡片——29 种区块（指标、表格、图表、时间线、看板、流程图、可点击按钮）、content 自动排版模式、四种落位（正文内联、过程折叠区、输入框上方看板、回合尾卡）、原生设置表单，以及可选的自动「下一步」卡片。卡片按会话日志里的调用参数重建，回放与 fork 后仍在；253 个离线测试，无构建步骤。

items.de: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.
items.dz: 跨压缩记忆：压缩时把被压掉的内容存到本机，提问时只注入相关的那几段（没有就一点不注入），让模型重新想起你早先定过的事。

items.de: Product-thinking companion for DeepSeek Harness: clarifies negative boundaries first, separates facts from assumptions, routes through seven product lenses, and persists confirmed decisions to project memory.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的产品思考助手：先明确负向边界，拆开事实与假设，经七套产品视角讨论取舍，并将确认的决策沉淀到项目记忆中。

items.de: Per-session supervision with role assignments and handoff workflows; off until enabled with /supervise. Requires @harzva/dsh-role-registry 0.1.0-alpha.1 (not on npm) installed first from its GitHub tag archive.
items.dz: 为会话提供监督、角色分配和交接流程；默认关闭，用 /supervise 开启。需先从 GitHub 标签压缩包安装 @harzva/dsh-role-registry 0.1.0-alpha.1（未发布到 npm）。

items.de: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
items.dz: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

items.de: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
items.dz: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

items.de: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
items.dz: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

items.de: Encrypted, scheduled backup and restore of a DSH profile — plugins, settings, skills, UI preferences and optional MCP connector or API keys — to S3-compatible storage, WebDAV or a local folder.
items.dz: 把 DSH 配置档案（插件、设置、技能、界面偏好与可选的 MCP 连接器或 API Key）加密定时备份到 S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 或本地目录，恢复时自动重装缺失的插件。

items.de: Composer dock monitor with 5 drag-reorderable pills (Context, Tokens, CPU, GPU, MEM): a 20x5 context brick matrix, per-turn net upload/download token bars, and 200ms native macOS Mach/IOKit scrolling charts with top-5 process lists. items.de: Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry
items.dz: 潮汐记忆：一份会忘事的长期记忆。该记的记着，没被想起来的自己淡掉。进不进由证据分 C = s/(s+2) 决定，低于阈值（默认 0.35）根本不进上下文；事件按半衰期淡忘（30 天，带情绪 7 天），事实永不衰减；被取代的旧条目不删，标成过时留档。被召回的那几句会进入上下文、确实消耗 token（量很小，但确实不是零）；不做 embedding、不联网、不上云。设置页能看见每轮到底注入了哪几句。
