items.dz: 通过 OpenRouter 统一 Image API 的文生图与图生图：以别名配置模型，参数按实时模型能力列表校验，支持参考图输入、设置卡片与对话内联展示结果。

items.de: Hides tool schemas from the model's prefill and reveals one tool at a time through a decision model API. Requires a running decision-model API endpoint and pnpm on PATH.
items.dz: 通过决策模型 API 把工具 schema 从模型 prefill 中隐藏，每次按需揭示一个工具。需运行决策模型 API 端点，且 PATH 中有 pnpm。

items.de: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
items.dz: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

items.de: Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud co
items.dz: 本地优先的结构化视觉插件：图片交给本地 OpenAI 兼容 VLM，返回 JSON 证据（摘要、逐字 OCR、版面区域、实体/关系、配色、显式不确定项），带反幻觉回退与可选粘贴/上传桥；零云端成本，图片不出本机。

items.de: Model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge: on text-only sessions, pasted images auto-convert to file paths at send time and render back in the transcript, so they never trip image admission. Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; e
items.dz: 面向模型的 image_describe（识图）工具（DashScope OpenAI 兼容接口，qwen3.7-flash）+ 粘贴桥：纯文本模型会话里粘贴的图片在发送时自动转为文件路径并在聊天记录中回显，不再触发图片准入拦截。自带 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY；端点/模型/预算可配置，重定向防护 HTTP 客户端，所有 Agent 预设均可用。

items.de: Model-facing weather tool that queries current conditions and 7-day forecasts from public Open-Meteo APIs, with no API key required.
items.dz: 面向模型的天气工具，基于公开 Open-Meteo API 查询当前天气与 7 天预报，无需 API Key。

items.de: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new ar
items.dz: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

items.de: Shows DeepSeek API balance and per-turn conversation cost directly in the session UI.
items.dz: 在会话界面里直接显示 DeepSeek API 余额与每轮对话花费。

items.de: Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.
items.dz: 增加删除会话的操作，永久移除会话日志、工作区条目与归档。

items.de: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
items.dz: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

items.de: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
items.dz: 把 DSH Web 侧栏里工作区上方的全局面板入口收成侧栏底部的一个开关。

items.de: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
items.dz: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

items.de: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's top-right corner.
items.dz: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

items.de: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
items.dz: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

items.de: Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.
items.dz: 将 Trae CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需单独 OAuth：复用桌面端登录，17 个模型（含 deepseek-v4.1-flash）带倍率标注与思考强度映射。

items.de: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
items.dz: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

items.de: Translation and refinement workspace with topic memory, revision history, and main-model coordination; Normal mode uses the companion Composer extension.
items.dz: 提供主题记忆、版本历史与主模型协作的翻译润色工作区，普通模式配套 Composer 扩展使用。

items.de: Restart control for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. A session header button or a tray icon stops the app and its host process, waits for both to exit, clears a stale profile lock, and relaunches, so a newly installed plugin loads without quitting the app by hand.
items.dz: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启开关。会话头部按钮与系统托盘图标都会结束应用及其 Host 进程、等待完全退出、清理残留的 profile 锁，然后重新拉起应用，装好新插件后不必手动退出再进。

items.de: Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.
items.dz: AI 回复流式 TTS 朗读插件，思考等待期有文字与语音同步的趣味短语反馈。内置 Edge TTS，支持任意 OpenAI 兼容云端引擎。

items.de: Drive the Tuanjie editor from DeepSeek Harness by connecting to the running editor's Codely bridge, creating and modifying GameObjects, editing component properties, running editor commands, and executing C# inside the editor process. Adapted from opdsh/unity-plugin for the Tuanjie Codely bridge.
items.dz: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动团结引擎编辑器：连接已运行编辑器的 Codely 桥，创建与修改 GameObject、改组件属性、执行编辑器命令，并在编辑器进程里跑 C#。改自 opdsh/unity-plugin，适配团结引擎的 Codely 桥。

items.de: Clean and simple TUI.
items.dz: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

items.de: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).
items.dz: dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。

items.de: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
items.dz: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

items.de: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-pe
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面显示每轮与整个会话的预估费用：按 provider 上报的 token 用量（四桶）与内置官方 DeepSeek 人民币峰谷价目计价，高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价；可用本机费率表叠加其它或自部署模型的单价，没有单价的模型只显示 token。

items.de: Folds streaming reasoning and tool calls into collapsed step bars and collapses each finished turn into a single summary bar; step bars show native tool icons, filenames, edited line counts, and failure counts, finished turns restore duration, first-token time, token usage, generation speed, and cac
items.dz: 流式回复期间将推理与工具调用折叠为收起的步骤栏，回合完成后整轮收拢为一条摘要栏；步骤栏显示原生工具图标、文件名、编辑增删行数与失败计数，已完成回合从记录的 Session 事件恢复耗时、首字延迟、Token 用量、生成速度与缓存命中率，偏好由 Host 持久保存。仅改变浏览器呈现，需要 DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1。

items.de: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
items.dz: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

items.de: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
items.dz: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

items.de: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
items.dz: 对话轮次导航。

items.de: Shows a system notification when a turn finishes, carrying the session title and a summary of the reply.
items.dz: 每轮对话正常结束时弹出系统通知，标题是会话名，正文是本轮回答的摘要。

items.de: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for tool arguments, raw results, and source. Client-only; prices are estimated from recorded model usage.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

items.de: Per-turn file changes, per-file diffs and deterministic safety verdicts for DSH sessions, plus a preview-first rewind that refuses when the worktree has drifted since the preview.
items.dz: 逐轮次文件变更与逐文件差异、确定性安全结论，外加 preview-first 安全回退：预览不写盘，确认后才应用，工作区在预览后发生漂移则直接拒绝。

items.de: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on confidence using typed judgments instead of prompt-and-parse. Ships no API key; the user supplies OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
items.dz: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

items.de: Typst live preview as a native right-Sidebar tab: clicking a .typ file opens a tab whose toolbar switches between the tinymist-rendered page and the highlighted source, with the preview page and its WebSocket served through the app's own origin.
items.dz: 原生右侧边栏里的 Typst 实时预览：点开 .typ 文件即得一个 tab，工具栏在 tinymist 渲染的页面与高亮源码之间切换；预览页面与其 WebSocket 都经应用自身 origin 提供。

items.de: A customized fork of TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance for theme palettes, wallpapers, and glassmorphism, with a layout fix for duplicate blank space alongside better-sidebar 0.18.0.
items.dz: 基于 TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance 的定制 fork，提供主题调色、壁纸与毛玻璃，并修复与 better-sidebar 0.18.0 共用时的重复留白。

items.de: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
items.dz: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

items.de: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
items.dz: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

items.de: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a water-drop highlight lens on the selected item, and per-control parameters tuned from the bottom-right panel.
items.dz: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

items.de: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

items.de: OS-level system notifications for the dsh web GUI: popups when a turn finishes or the agent needs your approval, answer, or plan review while the page is in the background.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面系统通知：回合结束或 agent 等待授权/回答/计划审核时，页面在后台也弹出系统级提醒。

items.de: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.
items.dz: DSH 网页端界面打磨层：补上浮层毛玻璃材质，用可拖动滑杆替换推理等级单选列表，模型菜单一次点击直达列表、Esc 一次关闭。

items.de: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.
items.dz: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

items.de: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.
items.dz: 为 DSH 设置侧边栏添加自定义图标，并开放 keyed `settings.section.icon` 槽位供第三方设置分区注册图标。

items.de: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

items.de: Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the s
items.dz: 一个插件装五个 Web UI 工具：供应商 + 模型双按钮选择器（含推理等级调节）、侧边栏工作区折叠/展开全部、会话「修改的文件」选项卡（需内核 0.1.2-alpha.1+，旧内核上静默缺席）、会话标题旁的工作区徽章，以及集中开关这些功能的设置页。

items.de: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中翻译可见的中文界面与内容：会话标题、工作区名称、消息、搜索结果和插件主动标记的正文使用浏览器本地 OPUS-MT，远程翻译仅限白名单界面标签。

items.de: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

items.de: Rewind conversation turns and checkpointed file changes while restoring tasks and evidence at the same history boundary.
items.dz: 回退会话回合和文件检查点，并在同一历史截点恢复任务与证据。

items.de: One MCP tool surface over two Windows desktop-automation backends (dsh-computer-use-win and windows-mcp). Both must be installed first: dsh-computer-use-win as a DSH plugin, windows-mcp via uv tool install windows-mcp --python 3.14, then run the bundled scripts/patch-backend.mjs once (it rewrites th
items.dz: 把两个需自行安装的 Windows 桌面自动化后端（dsh-computer-use-win 插件 + 用 uv 装的 windows-mcp，Python 3.14）合成一个 MCP 工具面：装完还要跑一次随包的 scripts/patch-backend.mjs 改写本机 windows-mcp 源码（不跑则 screenshot/read_webpage/launch_app 会失败），并在 profile 里禁用单独挂载的 wincu。44 个后端工具去重为 29 个（去掉 10 个重复、4 个危险工具 PowerShell/Registry/FileSystem/Process、1

items.de: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线确定性公共 API 目录检索，支持中英文查询，以及认证、HTTPS、CORS、状态、来源层级与分类的精确筛选。

items.de: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.
items.dz: 输入框 ∞ 开关：最高推理档位下点一下，向系统提示词追加一段可配置的宣告。

items.de: Bridge to the UnrealAgentLink editor plugin: the Unreal Engine editor dials this WebSocket bridge on 127.0.0.1:17860 and the agent drives it through 12 tools covering all 170 cataloged commands (actors, levels, blueprints, materials, PCG, screenshots, logs, undo).
items.dz: UnrealAgentLink 编辑器插件的桥接端：Unreal 编辑器拨入 127.0.0.1:17860 的 WebSocket 桥，agent 由此用 12 个工具驱动全部 170 个已编目命令（Actor、关卡、蓝图、材质、PCG、截图、日志、撤销）。

items.de: Registers Epic's Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, create-toolset, unreal-skill), injects Unreal project context, and connects the editor's ModelContextProtocol server with a port form on the Plugins page.
items.dz: 注册 Epic 的 Unreal Engine 三个技能（unreal-mcp、create-toolset、unreal-skill），注入 UE 工程上下文，接通编辑器的 ModelContextProtocol 服务器，并支持在插件页修改端口。

items.de: Keeps a DeepSeek Harness run going on its own: continues a turn that ended abnormally, and continues a turn logged as completed while the model tool call was emitted as plain text instead, which leaves the agent silently idle. Revives a model request that stops streaming. A wait on an approval or on
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回合自己接上：轮次异常结束时补一条继续；工具调用被中转站当成正文吐出、回合却仍记为正常结束时，补一条带指向性的继续，让它重新发起工具调用；模型请求不再出流时掐掉当前轮重来。卡在审批或提问只记录并提醒，不代为回答。

items.de: Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏跨工作区汇总置顶与最近会话，提供状态标记和显示设置。

items.de: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

items.de: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.
items.dz: 每小时检查 npm 上已安装插件的新版本，并询问升级其中哪些。

items.de: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install on
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

items.de: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.
items.dz: Web GUI 与桌面端的用量统计面板：静默按模型采集 token、活跃热力图、趋势图、费用估算与每日超限守卫。

items.de: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and pr
items.dz: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

items.de: Usage panel for the provider account behind the current model: quota windows, credit balance and token usage, following the model automatically. It renders as a full page, plus a sidebar entry and a per-session usage chip in the conversation header.
items.dz: 当前模型背后的大模型账户用量面板：额度窗口、账户余额与 token 用量，随模型自动切换，支持dsh中内置的主流大模型厂商，支持详情查看与页面左下角概览查看。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A Usage page in DSH settings that folds every model call into a local ledger and reports requests, tokens, and estimated cost by day, route, and model, with editable unit prices and CSV export.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置里加一页「用量查询」：把每次模型调用记进本地账本，按天、接口、模型汇总请求数、Token 与费用估算，支持单价修改与 CSV 导出。

items.de: Local usage ledger that reads this machine's session logs and reports per-day, per-model and per-workspace token consumption, cache hit rate, tool-vs-chat split and estimated cost, with an in-app editor for per-model prices.
items.dz: 本地用量账本：从本机会话日志统计每日、每模型、每工作区的 token 消耗、缓存命中率、工具请求占比与估算费用，并提供按模型编辑单价的设置面板。

items.de: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话用量面板：常驻用量圆环 + 可拖动面板，从本地会话日志聚合 token 用量、缓存命中率、成本与余额，支持工具级成本归因、iOS 式磁贴布局编辑与可选表情伴侣；数据只在本机读取，不联网。

items.de: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
items.dz: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

items.de: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
items.dz: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

items.de: Delegates independent tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenAI Codex CLI and returns the result to the current conversation. Provides four tools (task execution, status check, danger-mode toggle, enable/disable switch), enforces a real-path working-directory whitelist with symlink-escape prot
items.dz: 把独立任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 执行，并把结果返回当前会话。提供四个工具（任务执行、状态检查、危险模式开关、启停开关），强制真实路径白名单并做软链逃逸防护，默认使用 Codex workspace-write 沙箱模式，任务正文以单个 argv 参数传递避免 shell 注入，超时或取消时终止完整 Codex 进程组，并限制输出长度。需要 Node.js >= 20 和支持 codex exec 的 Codex CLI。

items.de: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget
items.dz: 白箱两段记忆：四层用户自写的长期记忆（必须遵守／行为设定／用户画像／可选遵守）注入为系统提示词的一节；另有「临时记忆」（跨对话交接／阶段目标／等待项）独立成节、独立预算（默认 1200 字），条目完结即停止注入。长期记忆是记忆目录里可读可改的 Markdown 文件，AI 只能提议，用户在中文面板点「采纳」才写入；临时记忆只在用户明确要求时写入，存放在 <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json（首次写入才创建），不在记忆目录里。不自动采集、不后台回写、不联网。

items.de: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
items.dz: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

items.de: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.
items.dz: 仅数据的事务式配置包管理器，提供完整性、归属、预览、差异和回滚保护。

items.de: Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing.
items.dz: 将 DeepSeek Harness 中已完成的公开内容工作整理为浏览器本地的视觉杂志，支持显式更新和经审核的单篇文章分享。

items.de: Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面背后循环播放本地视频，支持播放/暂停、不透明度、遮罩与填充调节。

items.de: Reads a local video or page link with ffmpeg and Paraformer ASR, returning a timestamped transcript plus key-frame images the agent can open; finds candidate videos by keyword and installs its own runtime dependencies on first use. Requires Python 3.8+ on PATH; video_discover also needs a one-time d
items.dz: 用 ffmpeg 与 Paraformer 读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与可逐帧打开的关键帧图片；可按关键词检索候选视频，首次使用时自动安装运行时依赖。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+；video_discover 还需一次性登录抖音/小红书。

items.de: Turn a script into a narrated explainer video: text-card slides by default (fast and exact for tutorials) or AI-generated footage per segment (needs AGNES_API_KEY); 14 online neural Chinese voices plus 3 offline Windows voices, with a one-command sample pack for picking a voice by ear. Requires ffmp
items.dz: 把文案变成带配音的讲解视频：默认用文字卡片（快且准确，适合教程），也可逐段调用 AI 生成真实画面（需 AGNES_API_KEY）；内置 14 个在线中文神经音色和 3 个离线 Windows 音色，一条命令即可生成全部音色的试听包。前置需要 ffmpeg，并把仓库内的 video-remix skill 放到 <工作区>/.dsh/skills/video-remix 后在该目录执行 npm install（在线音色所需）。

items.de: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
items.dz: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

items.de: Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.
items.dz: 基于 FFmpeg.wasm 的浏览器端音视频工具集，支持抽帧、截图、图片压缩与视频转 GIF。

items.de: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with encrypted browser-session import, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
items.dz: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入与加密保存、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

items.de: Persona and memory from a single AGENT.md: the file is injected into the system prompt of every session (the first 40,000 characters; longer text is truncated with a note), a Settings page edits it, and per-turn diary lines are merged by similarity, grouped by how often they were recalled, and prune
items.dz: 一份 AGENT.md 同时管人格与记忆：整份注入每个会话的系统提示（上限 4 万字，超出按整行截断并在提示里注明），设置页直接编辑；每轮日记按相似度合并、按被提起的次数分节，只有到 2 MB 上限才淘汰。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 图像理解插件：8 种分析模式（描述、OCR、图表取数、UI 评审、目标检测、对比、代码生成、诊断），支持任意 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容视觉 API，内置免费视觉模型与限流自动切换。

items.de: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admissi
items.dz: 为纯文本模型提供的图像识别转发：后台调用你配置的 GLM 兼容视觉接口分析图片，原模型在同一会话继续作答，你的消息、图片、模型与历史全程不变。需先运行仓库自带的 patches/apply-core-patch.cmd 给 DSH 打核心补丁，否则带图消息会在入库前被原版 DSH 拒绝（可用 restore 脚本还原）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
items.dz: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
items.dz: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

items.de: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.
items.dz: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

items.de: Select elements, draw arrows or frame areas in DSH previews, send visual feedback to chat and compare before-and-after snapshots.
items.dz: 在 DSH 预览中点选元素、画箭头或框选区域，将修改意见加入对话，并查看更新前后的截图对比。

items.de: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

items.de: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
items.dz: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

items.de: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
items.dz: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

items.de: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model
items.dz: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

items.de: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加入两个豆包云端识别器，可选再用大模型把口语顺成通顺的书面句子。

items.de: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
items.dz: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

items.de: A draggable Volcengine Coding Plan usage card for DeepSeek Harness Web using a local console session.
items.dz: 一个使用本地控制台登录态、可拖动的 DeepSeek Harness Web 火山引擎 Coding Plan 用量卡片。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).
items.dz: 起床包：每开一段新对话，赶在人开口之前把家读一遍注入会话——身份、规矩、错题、日记和账；家还是可写的，对话里认下的东西当场写回去，人设由它自己改。家目录不存在时什么都不做（默认为用户主目录下的 dsh-home，或在配置里填 home）。

items.de: Searches wallhaven.cc from a settings page and sets any wallpaper as the DSH web GUI background, with opacity, blur and scrim controls, a sidebar shuffle button and one-click original download; all fetching runs in the host process, so the browser never needs to reach wallhaven.
items.dz: 在设置页搜索 wallhaven.cc,把任意壁纸铺成 DSH Web GUI 背景,支持透明度、模糊与遮罩调节,侧边栏一键换图,可下载原图;图片全部由宿主进程取回,浏览器无需能访问 wallhaven。

items.de: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web
items.dz: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

items.de: Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.
items.dz: 把本地视频/图片变成全屏动态壁纸，支持实时效果调节、壁纸切换与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊导入，设置自动保存永久生效。

items.de: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.
items.dz: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

items.de: Windows only. With Wallpaper Engine installed it follows the active wallpaper or a pinned pick from the Workshop library; without it the plugin ships four starter wallpapers in a drop folder. Translucent panels, per-block blur and wallpaper-matched text contrast.
items.dz: 仅 Windows。装了 Wallpaper Engine 就跟随当前壁纸，或从创意工坊库里固定一张；没装也能用，投放文件夹里自带四张起始壁纸。面板半透明、分块模糊、字色自动跟随壁纸。

items.de: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
items.dz: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

items.de: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

items.de: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector.
items.dz: 在侧边栏对话列表上方增加关注区：每行一个状态圆点（未读、待回复、运行中、失败），有新回复的置顶、运行中的置底，模型选择器左侧还有关注按钮。

items.de: Structure-level watermark removal for PDF and Word: finds full-page Form XObject overlays drawn on every page and text blocks matching a watermark vocabulary, lists them by confidence, then excises only the drawing operators or runs — the text layer, embedded images and their resolution are not re-r
items.dz: 面向 PDF 与 Word 的结构级去水印：识别每页都会绘制的整页 Form XObject 图层水印，以及命中水印词表的文字块，按置信度列出候选后仅摘除对应的绘制指令或 run——正文文字层、内嵌图片与其分辨率均不重绘、不改动。

items.de: Renders WorkBuddy SOUL, USER, MEMORY and topic Markdown files from an existing ~/.workbuddy/user-*-personal directory into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with a byte budget and a settings page; the profile's AGENTS.md loader must be disabled first.
items.dz: 把 WorkBuddy 的 SOUL / USER / MEMORY / topics（需已有 ~/.workbuddy/user-*-personal 目录）渲染进 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt，带字节预算与设置页；需先在 profile 中停用 AGENTS.md 加载器。

items.de: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
items.dz: DSH Web 顶部居中的天气栏：定位 + 当前天气 + 未来 12 小时/7 天预报与恶劣天气提醒，数据来自 Open-Meteo（免费、无需 API key）。

items.de: Weather card once per session: remembers your home city so a VPN never moves it, inline city picker, theme presets, custom separators, optional TTS hook for third-party voices.
items.dz: 每次启动出现一次的天气卡片：记住没开 VPN 时的家城市、VPN 不再让城市跑偏、城市可手选、主题预设与自定义分隔线，并留了给第三方语音库的可选朗读接口。

items.de: Browse and continue DeepSeek web conversations in DSH, or import them with attachments into a workspace.
items.dz: 在 DSH 内浏览和继续 DeepSeek 网页会话，或将历史与附件导入工作区。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
items.dz: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

items.de: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.dz: 为 DSH Web 提供 56px 紧凑应用导航栏、独立对话列表与侧栏展开/收起控制；并在对话模型菜单和 /model 中筛除向量、重排及生图/视频型号。

items.de: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.
items.dz: DSH Web 明暗配色主题：APTX 胶囊标志、浏览器标签标题与图标、可选的灰原哀（名侦探柯南）展示素材，在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」中配置，可选无装饰模式。

items.de: Workbench shell: a fixed top bar (account, balance, Restart DSH button) with a second row of page tabs, plus a small module API for full-page plugins. Does nothing without a module; Restart DSH exits the web host and only works where a Windows scheduled task named philomel-dsh-web relaunches it.
items.dz: 工作台外壳：固定顶栏（账号、余额、「重启 DSH」按钮）加第二行页面标签，外加一套给整页插件用的模块 API。没有模块时不起作用；「重启 DSH」会退出 Web 宿主进程，仅在存在名为 philomel-dsh-web 的 Windows 计划任务来重新拉起时才有效。

items.de: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same
items.dz: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

items.de: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Require
items.dz: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Work-data hub for DingTalk and Yunxiao: syncs todos, logs, meeting notes, attendance, schedules, projects, requirements, commits and worklogs into local SQLite, then renders dashboards, a work calendar, project analysis and reports, with workhub_* agent tools over the same data. Requires the DWS CLI
items.dz: 钉钉与云效的个人工作数据中心：把待办、日志、AI 听记、考勤、日程、项目、需求、代码提交与报工同步到本地 SQLite，展示驾驶舱、工作日历、项目分析与智能报告，并向 Agent 提供 workhub_* 工具。需先安装并登录 DWS CLI（`dws auth login`）；云效 PAT 仅存 macOS 钥匙串。

items.de: Durable task-decomposition plans for DeepSeek Harness with a self-learning loop: every department subtask runs in three ordered phases (plan, execute, verify), the verify phase must submit a retrospective of problems, detours and resolutions, and that retrospective is written to a permanent lessons
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化任务分解计划，并加入自我学习闭环：每个部门子任务按「计划→执行→验证」三阶段推进，验证阶段必须提交问题、弯路与解决方式的复盘，写入永久教训记忆文件，下次派发时按部门与关键词排序注入，避免重犯。新增只读 dsh_workplan_lessons 工具（共 11 个模型工具）、环形图/四段构成条/逐阶段步进条进度面板，以及按 ISO/IEC 15408:2026 结构编写的公开安全自评估——每条声明都可被读者核对，零运行时依赖。

items.de: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
items.dz: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

items.de: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with their session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations.
items.dz: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

items.de: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).
items.dz: Codex 式的创建工作区对话框：填名称就自动建出目录，或者选文件夹——原生选择窗口会记得你上次在哪（原生选择窗口仅 Windows 可用，其它平台请直接填名称）。

items.de: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
items.dz: 把侧边栏中的对话拖到任意工作区分组，即可在 DSH 工作区之间迁移该对话，同步更新其 cwd、磁盘位置与工作区注册表归属。

items.de: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files and folders can be dragged into the composer as @path references; clicking a file opens the built-in preview; the right-click menu reveals a f
items.dz: 在左侧栏「工作区」标题旁加入「对话 | 文件」切换，把会话列表换成当前会话工作区的按需加载文件树。文件和文件夹可拖进输入框作为 @路径 引用；单击文件打开自带预览；右键可在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹或复制路径；条目按 VS Code 的方式显示相对最近一次提交的 Git 状态（修改、未跟踪、新增、删除、冲突、忽略）。

items.de: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
items.dz: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

items.de: Folder organization for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: display-only Workspace folders (drag a Workspace onto a folder block to file it, nest and re-order folders, collapse with counts), durable per-Workspace nested Session folders, per-row icons chosen from 40 host icons or 48 emoji, and a Workspace-
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加原生手感的文件夹组织：纯显示的工作区文件夹（把工作区拖到文件夹整块区域即可归档、嵌套、排序、折叠），每个工作区独立且持久化的多层会话文件夹，40 个原生图标 + 48 个 Emoji 的逐行图标自定义，以及工作区级"一键归档全部空闲会话"。本插件是 WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper（MIT，源自 ht719/dsh-session-categories）的分叉，会替换 sidebar.workspaces 区域，不能与上游插件同时安装。

items.de: Custom sidebar workspace groups for DeepSeek Harness - group directories, drag to regroup and reorder, per-group session browsing and content search, with a one-click fallback to the official workspace list.
items.dz: 在侧边栏以自定义分组组织工作目录 - 拖拽变更分组与顺序、组内会话浏览与内容搜索，可一键切回官方工作区列表。

items.de: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
items.dz: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

items.de: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidde
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

items.de: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotl
items.dz: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

items.de: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.
items.dz: 按工作区迁移 DSH：把一个项目的会话、文件与附件打包，在新机器上还原到指定根目录并重写历史绝对路径，之后只增量同步改动的文件。

items.de: Adds one action to the workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top once, without a favorites system or automatic reordering.
items.dz: 在工作区的「…」菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，只调整一次顺序，不做收藏、星标或自动重排。

items.de: Four filter chips on their own row at the foot of the sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting for your approval, plan review or answer, sessions with something unread (a turn that finished unseen, or newer activity the panel was not opened on), and sessions updated since local midnight. Each chi
items.dz: 侧边栏底部独占一行的四个筛选 chip：正在运行、在等你确认（审批、计划审阅、待回答）、有未读内容（跑完没看，或最近有更新但没打开过）、以及本地零点之后有更新的今日会话，各自带当前数量；点开就在上方按工作区分组列出命中会话，点行直接打开。同一行行尾还有一颗 DeepSeek 服务状态灯（绿=正常、黄=部分异常、红=有进行中的故障、灰=取不到），它每分钟带 ETag 条件订阅一次 status.deepseek.com 的 Atom feed，悬浮显示当前结论、状态更新时间与最近三次故障，点击打开状态页。另有完整面板：多一个「全部」chip、「更多」菜单（最近一天、三天、一周、三十天），以及「管

items.de: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
items.dz: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

items.de: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上显示彩色状态标记（等待你处理、运行中、刚刚完成，按工作区聚合），并在列表上方提供已置顶会话区与仅针对置顶会话的通知，持久保存。

items.de: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏虚拟会话分类树、点击式移动菜单与任务状态胶囊。

items.de: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工 Git worktree 任务工作台，将验证结果绑定到合并交付。

items.de: Registers /wrapped, which reads the session's own stats and renders a shareable dark SVG summary card — tool vs. thinking time, decode speed, and a tool/thinking-ratio verdict.
items.dz: 注册 /wrapped 命令，读取会话自身的统计数据，渲染成一张可分享的深色 SVG 总结卡：工具耗时与思考耗时对比、解码速度，以及工具/思考占比的评语。

items.de: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
items.dz: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

items.de: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
items.dz: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

items.de: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
items.dz: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

items.de: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.
items.dz: 在 Windows 默认浏览器中打开来自 WSL 的 http(s) 链接。

items.de: Read-only khal calendar list.
items.dz: 日历只读：khal list / today。

items.de: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.
items.dz: 从 WSL 读写 Windows 剪贴板。

items.de: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.
items.dz: 检测相对 Windows 的 WSL2 时钟偏差，避免 TLS 与 token 异常。

items.de: Docker Compose ps/logs with richer status; up/down double-gated.
items.dz: Docker Compose：ps/logs 与更丰 status；up/down 需双重确认。

items.de: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.
items.dz: 提供 WSL 下 Git Credential Manager 的安全指引，不回传密钥。

items.de: Read-only psql + redis-cli probes.
items.dz: psql / redis-cli 只读探针。

items.de: Windows security posture from WSL: Defender real-time state and signature age, recent detections, exclusions, and firewall profiles.
items.dz: Windows 安全态势：Defender 实时状态与特征库年龄、近期检出、排除项与防火墙配置。

items.de: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.
items.dz: 报告当前 WSL 发行版，并提醒多发行版混用风险。

items.de: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.
items.dz: 对比 WSL 与 Windows 对常用域名的 DNS 解析结果。

items.de: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.
items.dz: 报告 WSL 内 Docker CLI、context 与 daemon 是否可达，并探测 vLLM :8000 的 /v1/models 健康与 GPU runtime。

items.de: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.
items.dz: 列出或复制 Windows「下载」文件夹中的文件到 WSL 工作区。

items.de: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).
items.dz: 用 Windows 的 Cursor、VS Code 或 Notepad 打开 WSL 路径（可选行列；含 win_editor_status）。

items.de: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.
items.dz: 报告 PowerShell、cmd 与 LANG 编码，便于排查 UTF-8 与代码页问题。

items.de: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.
items.dz: Windows 事件日志：按日志名、级别、来源与时间窗读取近期条目。

items.de: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.
items.dz: 为 WSL 监听端口提供白名单 Windows portproxy 建议或应用；本机 dsh UI 优先用 kit 的 :3081 中继与 launch token。

items.de: Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).
items.dz: 在 ctx.web 注册 wsl-proxy 抓取后端，让官方 web_fetch 经 HTTP(S)_PROXY 用 undici ProxyAgent 出网，避免官方实现在 WSL 里 DNS 钉死后直连公网 IP，从而在 Windows 代理后出现 TypeError: fetch failed。

items.de: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
items.dz: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

items.de: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as a \\wsl.localhost workspace whose sidebar terminals open inside the distribution and whose files the agent can write. Requires Windows 10/11
items.dz: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

items.de: Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).
items.dz: 截断版 Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline。

items.de: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.
items.dz: 通过 GitHub App 查询当前仓库未关闭 PR 与最近一次 Actions，不回传密钥。

items.de: Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.
items.dz: glab 只读：MR / issue / ci。

items.de: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.
items.dz: 探测 WSL 内的 nvidia-smi 与 GPU 可见性。

items.de: Read-only Helm list / status / history.
items.dz: Helm 只读：list / status / history。

items.de: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.
items.dz: 从 WSL 探测 Windows 上的 Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM 与 llama-server，比对 ctx，并报告 /v1/models 的 apiReady 与 TCP 是否打通。

items.de: Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty
items.dz: 把飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Slack、Discord、Telegram、Mattermost 桥进 dsh agent（出站长连接/长轮询/Webhook），提供 im_status、可选本机 Whisper ASR、QQ/钉钉/TG/MM 纯文本出站，以及环境变量白名单（DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS）。allowedUserIds 为空即任何人都能驱动 agent——对外暴露前请先设白名单。

items.de: Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).
items.dz: 对接 TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One：jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank。

items.de: Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).
items.dz: kubectl 只读：get / describe / logs / contexts（可配置 logs 行数帽）。

items.de: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.
items.dz: 从 WSL 白名单启动 Windows 应用（如 VS Code、资源管理器、浏览器）。

items.de: OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).
items.dz: 对接 llama.cpp / Unsloth 的 OpenAI 兼容接口（默认 :8080）。

items.de: Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).
items.dz: 邮件只读：himalaya / notmuch（不发送）。

items.de: Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).
items.dz: 本地媒体/文档管线：ffprobe、抽音轨、缩略图、PDF、ASR、pandoc、OCR、exif（allowRoots 含 IM inbox）。

items.de: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.
items.dz: 当工作区路径落在缓慢的 /mnt/c 上时发出告警。

items.de: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.
items.dz: 长任务结束后从 WSL 弹出 Windows MessageBox 或 toast（气球提示）。

items.dz: 《习惯提示小模型》：本地小模型每隔几轮读一次近期对话，生成「习惯 / 重点 / 提示语」并注入系统提示词，训练与模型数据都在本机。需要带 torch/transformers/peft 的 Python 虚拟环境，以及用户自备的 Qwen3-0.6B 基座与 LoRA 适配器（插件不打包）；默认只在开启伴侣记忆（companion-memory）的会话里工作，路径没配好时静默不注入。

items.de: DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).
items.dz: DSH GitHub 连接器:检查 PR、分诊 issue、调试 CI、准备代码变更(18 个工具,gh 优先 + REST 回退,写操作人工审批)。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

items.de: Structured machine-readable CI output for DeepSeek Harness: JSON/NDJSON session reports, JUnit XML, semantic exit codes, artifact collection and privacy redaction - a dsh profile bundle plus a standalone CLI.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化、机器可读的 CI 输出：JSON/NDJSON 会话报告、JUnit XML、语义化退出码、工件收集与隐私脱敏——一个 dsh profile bundle 外加独立 CLI。

items.de: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.
items.dz: 跨机 DSH 群聊适配修复包：安装期自动对 dsh-weave rc.14 打四合一补丁（注入崩溃、随机端口、4KB ack 帧上限），并附带 dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge 聊天室的部署、机制与运维文档。

items.de: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
items.dz: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

items.de: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with six scenes: Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern sea and Big fat whale.
items.dz: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气、北冥和大肥鲸六个场景。

items.de: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
items.dz: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

items.de: Batch recursive extraction: magic-byte format detection (disguised extensions), nested archive auto-unroll, multi-password pool with per-layer dynamic discovery, SFX/split-volume pairing.
items.dz: 批量递归解压：魔数识别真实格式（伪装后缀/无后缀/乱序后缀）、嵌套压缩包自动解到底、多密码池+层内动态发现（"第二层密码:xxx"）、SFX/分卷自动配对、工具运行库目录防误递归。

items.de: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
items.dz: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
items.dz: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

items.de: An audit workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a multi-agent consultation venue where each review seat is filled by an agent, every judgment is routed to a named review face, and the whole run is kept as a traceable record. Works out of the box: the service endpoint is built in, a workspace is provisioned
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多人会商审校的「场地」——每个审核席位由一个 Agent 承担，判定逐面路由，全程留痕可回看。装上即用：内置服务端接入，首次打开自动开铺，场景、席位与审核 Agent 开箱在位。

items.de: Companion sidebar panel for the Kaipu site plugin: shows the built-in advisory team and seat status. Install together with kaipu-platform — seat data comes from the site plugin's gateway endpoints; a standalone install honestly reports "channel not ready". Removable: uninstall it and the site plugin
items.dz: 山海·开铺 智囊团插件：配套侧边面板，展示内置谋士团队与席位状态。需与 kaipu-platform 一起安装——灯位数据由开铺插件经网关提供，单独安装会如实显示「通道未就绪」。可摘除：卸掉它，开铺仍完整可用。

items.de: Kaipu Workstation — a cross-cloud, cross-platform console where agents collaborate on one workspace. Any agent runtime that speaks plain HTTP can take a seat, each with its own device credentials: project context is shared, files are kept per seat, and tasks rotate between seats with a trace of who
items.dz: 山海·开铺 · 工位插件 —— 跨云、跨端的 Agent 协作操作台：不同机器、不同平台的 Agent 通过普通 HTTP 接入同一张工位，各自独立设备凭据；项目上下文共享、资料按位存放、任务在席位间轮转交接，谁做了什么一路留痕。工位数据存在服务端，插件只是界面：卸载不丢数据，重装即回到原样。面板渲染工位持久化态（非实时流）。

items.de: Registers six native DeepSeek Harness tools for deterministic fixture-based or read-only Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle database analysis, planning, preview, and readback.
items.dz: KaleidoSphere 数据库分析插件：六个原生工具（状态/发现/分析/计划/预览/回读），针对只读的 Microsoft SQL Server 与 Oracle，默认走内置确定性 fixture，运行时随包分发、无需外部服务。

items.de: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
items.dz: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

items.de: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
items.dz: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

items.de: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic
items.dz: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

items.de: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same mach
items.dz: Kizuna Agent 信箱：四个工具让 Agent 读自己的信箱（信箱状态、待处理信件、读一封信全文），并以 completed / failed / input-required / working 状态回信。Kizuna 是带可靠投递的 Agent 通讯录：同一台机器上的 kizuna-box 持有信箱，对无人签收的信按 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟重试，每次投递尝试都写入只增不改的留痕。插件只连本机回环信箱，不持有任何凭证。

items.de: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
items.dz: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

items.de: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.
items.dz: 会话备注 0.3.1：一个会话挂多条备注（1 2 3 按创建顺序编号），会话级颜色+置顶（弹窗标题行一键操作），复制挑选器（多条备注点哪条复制哪条），🗑 会话备注批量清理，兼容 DSH Desktop 0.8.2。

items.de: Gives your DSH agent a long memory: it remembers past chats, people, and promises, can recall them days later, and keeps a diary linked to the original messages. Old memories fade naturally. Requires Node 22+ and a DeepSeek API key; the installer and desktop notifications are Windows-only.
items.dz: 让你的 DSH 助手记得久一点：聊过的事、重要的人和答应过的话都会记住，过几天问起还能想起来；还会写日记，每条都连着当时的对话。旧记忆会自然淡忘。需要 Node 22+ 和 DeepSeek API key；安装器与桌面通知仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Lingshu (灵枢) is a brain-inspired persistent memory, persona and growth system for AI coding agents: pure Python standard library, zero dependencies, local-first, requires Python 3.9+. Hippocampus/cortex layered memory with forgetting curves, dream consolidation, fuzzy associative recall, emotion sys
items.dz: 灵枢（lingshu-skill）：面向 AI 编程助手的类脑持久记忆、人格与成长系统。纯 Python 标准库、零依赖、本地优先，需 Python 3.9+。海马体/皮层分层记忆与遗忘曲线、做梦巩固、模糊联想回忆、情绪系统、人格漂移防护、知识库、技能自编辑，并带本地可视化面板。以 DSH bundled skill 形式安装；仓库另含可单独安装的 cordis 启动注入插件，仅在灵枢已安装到 ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu（或配置 brainPy）且 Python 3 可用时才会自动注入会话；可选的更新检查会访问 GitHub/Gitee.

items.de: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
items.dz: 将 Liquid Inference 拍卖式推理交易所接入为模型路由，提供 liquid.auto 及其排序变体，并附带四个工具，用于读取报价、市场、路由器与任务收据。需 Liquid Inference API Key（LIQUID_API_KEY，spend 权限）。

items.de: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
items.dz: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

items.de: Self-hosted chat room where the owner and coding agents share one room: a local Node server (SQLite, REST, SSE) that the plugin starts when it is not running, a DSH sidebar entry that opens the room in a panel, five tools (room_join, room_send, room_read, room_status, room_leave) that push an incomi
items.dz: 自托管聊天室：主人与编码 agent 共用一个房间。插件在服务未运行时启动本地 Node 服务（SQLite、REST、SSE），侧边栏入口在面板中打开房间界面，五个工具（room_join、room_send、room_read、room_status、room_leave）把收到的消息以标注发送者的用户消息推入会话并写入会话日志，Codex 连接器把房间消息经 codex queue 转发。每条消息带服务端盖章的 author、platform、seq，非主人消息按数据处理并标注发送者。需 Node.js 24+。

items.de: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.
items.dz: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板：按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总；含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出与缓存读写明细、轮次/步骤、平均 tok/s，归档后仍保留历史。

items.de: Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PA
items.dz: 为纯文本模型注册一个 `ocr` 工具：调用仓库自带的离线脚本识别单张图片或 PDF 并返回文字——Windows 原生 OCR 优先，其次 RapidOCR，最后 Tesseract；识别过程在本机完成，不发网络请求、不需要 API key。需自备 PATH 上的 Python 3.11 并 `pip install winocr pillow`（winocr 为首选引擎，RapidOCR 与 Tesseract 为兜底）。图片返回逐行结果，PDF 返回逐页结果。

items.de: Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.
items.dz: 桥接本机 doc2md（markdown_monitor）命令行——一个 doc2md 工具，提供 convert / read / scan / status 四个动作，支持 docx、doc、xls、xlsx、pdf 与图片。

items.de: Financial market monitor bundle for dsh: real-time quotes, a local watchlist, threshold alerts with cooldowns, periodic polling, and in-chat ASCII/mermaid charts for A-share stocks/indices and crypto (Tencent + CoinGecko).
items.dz: dsh 的金融行情监控插件:实时报价、本地自选列表、带冷却的阈值提醒、定时轮询,以及在会话内用 ASCII/mermaid 渲染 A 股与加密货币图表(数据源腾讯 + CoinGecko)。

items.de: Auditable mathematical proving for DeepSeek Harness: a local stdio MCP server with 23 machine-checking tools, a bundled workflow skill, and the /prove and /audit-proof commands. proven, refuted and inconclusive are never conflated, and unproven steps are reported instead of hidden. Needs Python 3.10
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的可审计数学证明:本地 stdio MCP 服务器(23 个机器校验工具)+ 工作流技能 + /prove、/audit-proof 命令。proven / refuted / inconclusive 绝不混淆,未证明的步骤如实报告而非隐藏。需 Python 3.10+，首次运行要 pip install -r requirements.txt（就绪前 23 个工具不可用）。

items.de: DSH bundle porting Matt Pocock's 25 promoted engineering and productivity agent skills (grilling, TDD, code review, domain modeling, etc.).
items.dz: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个精选工程与效率 Agent 技能（grilling、TDD、代码审查、领域建模等）移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。

items.de: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of the 25 promoted mattpocock/skills with a native agent preset, an invocation-aware skill provider, and a light grilling-to-implement bootstrap.
items.dz: 将 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个正式技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、区分人触发与模型调用的技能 provider，以及轻量 grilling 到 implement 引导。

items.de: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
items.dz: Qwen 媒体工具：通过阿里云百炼提供多模态视频音频理解、带预置音色的语音合成，以及场景音频生成。

items.de: RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows as a background task pool: submit a batch, and a watcher dispatches it within a concurrency budget, polls each job, downloads every output to disk, and wakes the session when the pool drains. A shared ledger records batches, costs, instance tiers, submit and finish
items.dz: 把 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流当作后台任务池来跑：提交一批任务后，watcher 按并发上限自动派发、逐轮询每个任务、把产物全部下载到本地，池子排空时唤醒会话。共享台账记录批次、费用、实例规格、发起与完成时间以及每个文件的保存位置，右侧边栏有实时看板。

items.de: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones fall asleep instead of bloating your context. Long-term writes stop in an approval center, so the agent cannot rewrite your persona on its own.
items.dz: 会遗忘的记忆插件：短期记忆 48 小时自动过期，长期记忆按艾宾浩斯/SM-2 曲线复习，久不用的沉进沉睡区（可唤醒）而不是无限撑爆上下文。长期写入停在审核中心，模型不能自行改写人格设定。

items.de: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
items.dz: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header, with launch logs in a sidebar tab. One-shot tasks such as data generation and GameTest report a pass or fail verdict when they finish.
items.dz: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

items.de: Opens a browser console to prepare Minecraft Java on Windows x64 and run DeepSeek-controlled survival through native-player MCP tools, with spatial observations and an optional livestream overlay from a separate extension. Requires an installed Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x client and an official De
items.dz: 在 Windows x64 上打开浏览器控制台准备 Minecraft Java 环境，通过原生玩家 MCP 工具让 DeepSeek 自主生存，提供空间观察与（需另装扩展的）可选直播挂件。需已安装 Minecraft Java 1.21 系列正式版，并准备余额不少于 ¥1 的官方 DeepSeek API 密钥。

items.de: Auto-discovers model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalizes them, and emits ready-to-use model configs for dsh.
items.dz: 从 OpenAI 兼容 API 主机自动发现模型列表、定价与能力，归一化后生成 dsh 可直接使用的模型配置。

items.de: Floating photo companion for the DSH Web UI with a 15/25/45/60-minute focus timer, water and stretch reminders, Open-Meteo weather, and a session radar listing running, ended, input-waiting and permission-requesting conversations for one-click navigation.
items.dz: DSH Web UI 的悬浮照片陪伴插件：15/25/45/60 分钟专注计时、喝水与站立提醒、Open-Meteo 天气，以及可一键跳转的会话雷达（运行中、刚结束、等待输入、请求权限）。

items.de: Searches a database of past motor-repair cases by fault description, motor rating and brand, and lets new diagnoses be saved back for future retrieval.
items.dz: 按故障描述、功率与品牌检索历史电机维修案例，支持将新诊断沉淀回写供后续检索。

items.de: Combines historical supplier quotes and service rates into onsite-repair, factory-overhaul, green-remanufacture and replacement options for a motor, then recommends one by total cost of ownership.
items.dz: 组合历史供应商报价与工时，生成现场抢修/返厂大修/绿色再制造/整机更换等维修方案，并按综合持有成本给出决策建议。

items.de: Summarises the case evidence, diagnosis, repair procedure, parts list and cost-option comparison for a motor into a Markdown repair recommendation report with data provenance.
items.dz: 将案例依据、诊断结论、维修工序、配件清单与方案对比汇总为带数据溯源的 Markdown 维修建议书。

items.de: Combines fault knowledge-base symptom-to-cause rules with similar past cases to rank candidate motor diagnoses with evidence terms and suggested extra tests.
