items.de: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting
items.dz: 每花掉 N token,就从 DSH 窗口顶端掉下一碗白米饭:米饭自由落体、落地弹跳,可以拖着扔出去;一个漩涡按钮(带音效)能把它们全部吸走,把某一碗拖上去松手则只吸那一碗。每碗额度、米饭大小、最多摆几碗、落地是否自动回正、米饭图都能在面板里调。

items.de: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
items.dz: 桌面宠物插件，常驻悬浮层养一只龙猫，点击互动并可在待机、睡觉、开心、进食等状态间切换。

items.de: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

items.de: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
items.dz: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

items.de: 21 read-only lifecycle governance tools in one self-contained DSH plugin: task tiering, state/plan/evidence validation, gate precheck and aggregation, release/install audits, context and progress analysis, critical path, resume reconciliation, and a mutation preview that always denies execution. Ins
items.dz: 单包 21 个只读生命周期治理工具：任务分级、状态/计划/证据校验、Gate 预检与聚合、发布与安装审计、上下文与推进分析、关键路径、续跑对账，以及始终拒绝执行的变更预览。npm 包名 @240xu/dsh-tech-lead。

items.de: Connects DSH to timestamped video reading, shared queues/history and Scroll personal Bilibili workflows through an existing Video Reader installation. Windows x64 only: install the core and set VIDEO_READER_ROOT before starting DSH; the bundle does not install Python, FFmpeg, models or Bilibili cred
items.dz: 复用现有的 Video Reader 本地安装，为 DSH 接入带时间戳的视频阅读、通用队列/历史与 Scroll 的个人 B 站工作流。仅支持 Windows x64：需先安装核心并设置 VIDEO_READER_ROOT 再启动 DSH；本包不安装 Python、FFmpeg、模型或 B 站凭据。

items.de: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content o
items.dz: 让 DSH 开口说话：每轮回答先改写成自然口语再朗读，代码、表格与 Markdown 自动处理；系统 TTS 开箱即用，豆包（第三方 API）提供方言与情感演绎，本地 Kokoro 引擎离线运行、内容不出本机；支持 DSH 桌面版与 dsh web。另附工作／完成／提问三种会话状态提示音——会话在跑、跑完了、等你回答各有提示，音色可换、也能上传自己的音频。

items.de: Fullscreen business-app framework for DeepSeek Harness Web with a dark-sidebar workbench bundling a database connectivity tester and SQL query panel, a two-level knowledge base (bill and accounting) with local search and Word document ingestion, metadata environment comparison with alter-SQL generat
items.dz: 构建在 DeepSeek Harness Web 之上的全屏业务应用框架：深色侧边栏工作台，集成数据库连通测试与 SQL 查询、票据/会计二级知识库（本地检索与 Word 文档投喂）、元数据环境比对与变更 SQL 生成、数据字典、Agent 日志检索报告演示、系统测试用例执行、印象笔记风格记事本、常用开发工具与小游戏。

items.de: Web Components support.
items.dz: Web Components 支持。

items.de: A WeCom WeDrive picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a draggable floating window with list, column and gallery views, search, sorting and multi-select inserts selected files, documents and folders as official `@` reference chips. Data comes from a local wecom-cli with the official doc.weixin.qq
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入条添加企业微信微盘选择器：可拖动的浮动窗口提供列表、分栏、画廊三种查看方式，支持搜索、排序与多选，把选中的文件 / 文档 / 文件夹写成官方 `@` 引用 chip。数据来自本机 wecom-cli，缺少 CLI 时回退到官方 doc.weixin.qq.com 选择器；附带 wecom-wedrive-ref 技能，按 id 前缀把 chip 路由到对应的 wecomcli-* 文档技能。

items.de: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable
items.dz: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

items.de: Project autopilot for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3, with scoped authorization, independent verification, editable memories and companion chat, including automatic installation of the compatible desktop pet fork. The bundled pet is a fork of takboo/dsh-coopanion (AGPL-3.0-or-later); do not install t
items.dz: 支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.3，提供范围授权、独立验收、可编辑记忆和伙伴聊天的项目自动推进插件，自动安装配套桌宠 fork。配套桌宠是 takboo/dsh-coopanion 的 fork（AGPL-3.0-or-later），不能与上游桌宠同装。

items.de: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash sta
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的 Windows 计算机操作插件：常驻 PowerShell UIA 后端，对外只有 16 个合并入口（读取/点击/输入/观测/验证）；带加固的策略层（红线拒绝、显式审批、观测绑定、落点归属与前台焦点守卫）与一轮性能优化（后端预热、缓存、像素哈希稳定探测）。fork 自 dsh-computer-use-win。

items.de: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy and supervises the local wb2api gateway, then bundles two protocol bridges onto that same gateway: Responses for OpenAI Codex CLI, and Anthropic Messages for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, which see the gateway models under genera
items.dz: 通过挂载 dsh-llm-workbuddy 注册 workbuddy 模型 provider，托管本地 wb2api 网关，并在同一网关前内置两条协议桥：给 OpenAI Codex CLI 的 Responses，以及给 Claude Code 与 Claude 桌面端的 Anthropic Messages——后两者以生成的 claude-wb-… id 看到网关模型。已在运行或已注册的部分会跳过，并通过状态工具汇报各环节状况。需本机有 wb2api 网关并有 WorkBuddy 账号。

items.de: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
items.dz: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

items.de: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
items.dz: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

items.de: Generates complete AI songs (vocals plus full arrangement) from a theme or from provided lyrics, and instrumental BGM, through a bundled xiapan-music skill and a xiapan_music DSH tool; also queries the Xiapan API balance. Uses a user-supplied Xiapan API key (BYOK), and saves the generated mp3 files
items.dz: 通过内置的 xiapan-music 技能与 xiapan_music 工具，按主题或已有歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲（人声与完整编曲） 以及纯音乐 BGM，并可查询虾盘云 API 余额；使用用户自带的虾盘云 Key（BYOK），生成的 mp3 保存在 DSH 主机上。

items.de: Provides three skills for the Let's Build Robots SO-101 course: yanshifu reads the learner's project files to assess progress and suggest next steps; ask answers questions using four bundled guides; update checks for and installs updates to those guides.
items.dz: 为《一起手搓机器人》SO-101 课程提供三个技能：yanshifu 读取学员的项目文件，判断进度并建议下一步；ask 根据四份配套资料回答问题；update 检查并更新本地配套资料。

items.de: Token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: usage trends, model breakdown and activity heatmap, hand-written SVG, zero chart libraries.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计面板：用量趋势、模型用量与活跃热力图，手写 SVG，零图表库依赖。

items.de: Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.
items.dz: 在消息发送给模型前检测和脱敏敏感文本，支持本地正则、浏览器 BERT 或 ZeroClave API 检测及人工审核。

items.de: Deck-generation skill for the National College Student Career Planning Competition. It takes a contestant's profile, materials and photographs, drafts a page-by-page outline for confirmation, then renders a 15-20 page reading-type PPTX (under 15 pages is flagged as a page-count error) using 17 page
items.dz: 职规赛（全国大学生职业规划大赛）展示 PPT 生成技能：给出选手信息、材料与照片后先出逐页大纲待确认，再渲染成 15–20 页的阅读型 PPTX（少于 15 页会被判为页数错误）（17 种页型、3 套主题，可套学校模板）；生成时审计估算版面（文字溢出、每页字数、评分维度覆盖、素材缺口），导出 PDF 后再复核一遍越界与压字。依赖 Python 3.9+ 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow；PDF 版面复核可选依赖 LibreOffice（soffice）与 pdftotext。

items.de: A sticky-note wall in the DSH sidebar: nine paper colors, categories, search, archive, to-do checklists with stable item ids, and agent read/write tools.
items.dz: 常驻 DSH 侧边栏的便签墙：九种纸色、分类、搜索、归档、带稳定条目 id 的待办清单，并支持 agent 读写。

items.de: In-chat image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: wheel and trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer, two-finger and drag panning, gallery navigation, downloads named from the image description and timestamp, and opening workspace originals in the system default app.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的聊天图片查看器：滚轮 / 触控板捏合以指针为中心缩放，双指 / 拖动平移，支持图集切换、下载按图片说明与时间戳自动命名，以及用系统默认应用打开工作区原图。

items.de: Chinese progress guidance and user-confirmed project or global memory, respecting DSH Full access and reusing host Auto review to reduce repeated prompts.
items.dz: 中文进度规范与经用户确认的项目或全局记忆；遵循 DSH 完全权限，复用宿主自动审查，减少重复确认。

items.de: Adds a delete entry to every session row in the dsh sidebar, including the blank New Session row, plus a settings section for font sizes and per-region colors. The entry archives the session (recoverable from Archive) rather than erasing it.
items.dz: 为 dsh 侧栏的每个会话行增加删除入口（含空白的「新会话」行），并提供字号与分区颜色的外观定制设置页。删除入口调用的是归档接口，会话仍可从归档恢复，并非彻底擦除。

items.de: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
items.dz: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

items.de: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.
items.dz: 把文件或图片拖进 DSH Web 输入框，以一排小卡片展示，发送时以 @path 引用传给模型。

items.de: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
items.dz: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

items.de: Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
items.dz: 本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode、codebuddy、workbuddy、claude、codex、codearts、gemini、cursor、kimi、dsh 等本地日志，查看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用。

items.de: Control tower tools: dispatch a task to a role agent, read its report, verify and accept or send it back. Requires the separate agent-control-tower Python CLI (tower; it is not on PyPI — install it with pip install -e from the same repo) on the DSH process's PATH plus a tower init-ed workspace; with
items.dz: 控制塔工具：把任务分派给角色 agent、读取回执、校验通过后接受或打回。需要先把同一仓库里的 agent-control-tower Python CLI（tower，未发布到 PyPI，需在仓库内 pip install -e）装进 DSH 进程的 PATH，并在工作目录跑过 tower init；否则每次工具调用都会报 ENOENT。

items.de: Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.
items.dz: 把一套会自我进化的开发约束规则库装进项目，通过 constraints 工具和「每会话一次」的提醒交给智能体，并可审计 AI 的 token 成本与上下文占用。

items.de: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.
items.dz: 在一个设置分区里新建与配置 Agent 预设——人格提示词、勾选后注入系统提示的知识库条目清单、四个知识库工具的独立开关、按 Agent 收窄 MCP 连接，以及知识库批量导入。

items.de: Reports DeepSeek Harness session state (working, done, error) to the agent-pet macOS desktop overlay and lets it open sessions or start a chat.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态（工作中、完成、出错）报告给 agent-pet 的 macOS 桌面悬浮宠物，并可从宠物打开会话或开始新对话。

items.de: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页和右侧边栏中以多叉树展示当前会话的智能体工作流，每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用（需挂载 dsh-cost-meter）和运行时间。

items.de: Sanitizes fetched pages before the model reads them: strips hidden text, offsite images and inline data, wraps the rest in canary-tagged untrusted delimiters, and flags prompt injection.
items.dz: 在内容进入模型之前净化抓取的网页：剥离隐藏文本、站外图片与内联数据，其余内容用带金丝雀的不可信分隔符包裹，并标记提示注入。

items.de: Pairs a phone console with the current DSH Desktop conversation. Running /phone shows a one-time QR code; after pairing the phone can send messages, approve tool calls, switch models and stop the task, while the desktop stays the only execution host. Requires AgentBridge running locally.
items.dz: 把手机控制台接到当前这条 DSH Desktop 会话：执行 /phone 出现一次性二维码，扫码后可从手机发消息、审批工具调用、切换模型和停止任务，电脑仍是唯一执行端。需本机运行 AgentBridge。

items.de: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates into the system prompt, and adds six loom_* tools for status, sync, memory search/list/add and skill listing. Requires the agentloom CLI instal
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex 接到共享的 ~/.agentloom：将共享记忆与被上下文预算截断的 AGENTS.md 条目注入系统提示，并提供 status、sync、记忆检索/列出/写入与技能列出的六个 loom_* 工具。需先安装 agentloom CLI 并执行一次 agentloom init；同仓库的七工具 MCP 桥是另一个包，供 MCP 客户端使用。

items.de: Connect DeepSeek Harness to shared AgentsChat rooms over MCP and WebSocket wake bridge for cross-agent messaging, peer code review, proposals, voting, and OKRs.
items.dz: 通过 MCP 与 WebSocket 唤醒桥接将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AgentsChat 共享房间，支持跨宿主多 Agent 通信、代码互审、提案投票与 OKR 协同。

items.de: Installs and opens PM Workbench, a local Electron multi-role project workbench, from a DSH tool. Windows only: the first load bootstraps Node, Electron and the app through a PowerShell installer. It does not embed the workbench UI in DSH.
items.dz: 从 DSH 安装并打开 PM工作台（本地 Electron 多角色项目工作台）。仅支持 Windows——首次加载会通过 PowerShell 安装器准备 Node、Electron 和应用本体；不把工作台 UI 嵌入 DSH。

items.de: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
items.dz: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

items.de: AI-native SDLC as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: task state machine and artifact chain, independent verification with structured verdicts, per-issue rework and re-verification, test freezing, RSI retrospectives, and a read-only dashboard.
items.dz: 把 AI 原生 SDLC 落成 DeepSeek Harness bundle：任务状态机与制品链、带结构化裁决的独立验证、按问题编号的返工与复验、测试冻结、RSI 复盘与只读看板。

items.de: Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.
items.dz: aipx 工具包：技能之外还有 Hub Console 控制台——用约 4 个元工具代理全部 MCP 服务器，含服务器池健康、工具级启停、工具目录，以及直观展示 mcp_search 返回结果的搜索试验场。

items.de: Ships the Alibaba Java coding guidelines, 44 selected rules, as an embedded harness skill, so writing, changing and reviewing Java code or DDL follows the handbook with a numbered self-check before delivery.
items.dz: 把《阿里巴巴 Java 开发手册》精选 44 条做成内嵌技能：写、改、评审 Java 代码与建表语句时按手册约束，交付前按编号自检。

items.de: Drag a folder onto the sidebar workspace list to register it as a workspace and open a new session. The Desktop app supplies the folder path; a plain browser page falls back to the host folder picker.
items.dz: 把文件夹拖到左侧工作区列表，注册为工作区并打开新会话；桌面端直接取文件夹路径，普通浏览器页面回退到宿主的选择文件夹。

items.de: Switches the answer area between default, wide and full width from the session header, and opens in-conversation web links and file references in a dialog with copy, open actions and an in-dialog file preview instead of the side panel.
items.dz: 在会话头部切换问答区宽度（默认、较宽、全宽），并把对话里的网页链接与文件引用改为弹窗打开：显示地址、可复制、可在浏览器或侧边栏打开，文件引用还能在弹窗里预览内容。

items.de: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-dete
items.dz: 把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站；项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果并生成结项清理清单，未结项期间一切保留。清运引擎是 Python 脚本，需 PATH 上有 Python 3（自动探测 python3 / python / py；缺了它清运跑不起来，会明确提示）。

items.de: A floating desktop overlay for Windows that shows which terminal of yours is waiting: it aggregates OpenCode, Claude Code, Antigravity and DeepSeek Harness session state over a named pipe and renders one small always-on-top panel, so you stop tabbing between windows to find out which agent needs app
items.dz: Windows 上的桌面浮窗：把 OpenCode、Claude Code、Antigravity 与 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态经命名管道汇总成一个常驻置顶的小面板，一眼看出哪个终端在等你——不必逐个窗口来回切。点某一行可直接跳到对应终端。对 DeepSeek Harness 会话，面板只显示状态（工作中、等待审批、出错、空闲）并跳到 DSH 窗口，审批仍在 DSH 里完成。

items.de: A local AI voice studio for DeepSeek Harness with nine local TTS engines for voice design, voice cloning, emotional performance, a reference-audio library and audio export. items.dz: 《AI语音》：本地音色工作台，内置 9 个本地 TTS 引擎，支持文字描述造声、参考音复刻、情绪表演、参考音库与音频导出。本插件只注册 /ai-voice/api 接口，界面由 companion-memory 插件的「接入软件」页承载；每个引擎都需要自备 Python 虚拟环境与自行下载的模型权重，插件不打包。

items.de: Import Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Cursor and Trae conversation history into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, with readable titles and one workspace per source.

items.de: Web panel for the DSH AI history importer — a floating button and a three-column wizard to preview conversations, pick which ones to import, and file them into workspace folders.

items.de: Reads local AI session history from 16 AI tools plus Windows recent-file activity, and generates daily or weekly work reports on your machine. Currently Windows x64 only: the plugin ships a bundled Windows sidecar (no Python needed); macOS/Linux are not supported yet.
items.dz: 读取 16 个 AI 工具的本地会话记录，外加 Windows 最近文件活动，在本机生成日报或周报。目前仅支持 Windows x64：插件自带 Windows sidecar，无需安装 Python；macOS / Linux 暂不支持。

items.de: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle s
items.dz: AlphaRSI——三角色自改进闭环，进化 alpha 序列模型的训练配方。Operator 跑 walk-forward、Evaluator 用 OOS RankIC 验收、Refiner 用 TPE 贝叶斯搜索提议超参，只保留严格更优。离线一条命令跑，数据包 sha1 对账分发，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

items.de: AI-native expressions for two-way chat: people see images, while text-only models read fixed meanings; includes a picker, custom expressions, import/export, and two visual styles.

items.de: Anime Garden for DSH: search anime torrent resources from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组 and ANi inside DSH — via chat, a sidebar panel with fansub and type filters, a seasonal calendar, and an in-app floating player.

items.de: Antigravity provider for DeepSeek Harness: resolves the OAuth client from the locally installed official desktop app and supports multiple accounts with quota-based automatic switching.

items.de: Read-only Ascend NPU fleet monitor for DeepSeek Harness: environments are read from envs.json, npu-smi is collected locally or over SSH with one connection per environment, and the sidebar shows each environment's idle/partial/busy occupancy, running processes, per-card and per-chip details, five-mi

items.dz: 把 aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq 移植到 macOS（Apple 芯片）的分叉：同样是住进 QQ 的人设机器人（聊天、语音条、表情包、记忆、翻唱、模块），删掉了 Windows 专用代码。接 OrbStack 或 Docker 里的 SnowLuma 等 OneBot v11 网关，语音兜底用 macOS 自带的 say，超过 30 MB 的文件通过只对本机开放的临时下载口发给容器里的网关，翻唱环境（Applio、audio-separator、uv、Rubber Band、分离模型）按固定版本一键安装。与上游同包名、同插件 id（dsh-aurabot-qq），安装即

items.de: MCP and skill manager as a full sidebar page: add, edit, enable, disable and delete MCP servers, expand a server to its tools and open one for its parameter list, translate skill and tool summaries with a model you pick, and count tool and skill invocations. items.dz: 侧边栏整页的 MCP 与技能管理器：增删改启停 MCP 服务器，展开查看工具、点开查看参数，用自选模型翻译技能与工具摘要，统计工具与技能调用次数；另注册 mcp_service 工具，让 Agent 在对话中经审批安装 MCP。

items.dz: 把已批准的 OpenSpec change 跑到完成，同时让模型只做机械转发：内置 Python CLI 计算票据 DAG 前沿、原子认领任务、为每个 assignment 准备独立 git worktree，并返回确定的 actions。会话用 DSH subagent 派发每个 action，完成后按在干净且已前进的 HEAD 上重跑验证命令得到的哈希绑定回执来 reconcile，子代理口头说“做完了”不算成功。运行中改范围就是直接改 tasks.md。存活可观测而非靠猜：status 返回 relay 判定块（已用时与租约余量、回执是否存在、心跳与活跃时长、建议动作）；abandon

items.de: Bookmark a passage or a whole message in a conversation and jump back to it with one click.
items.dz: 在对话里划选一段话或整条消息打书签，之后一键跳回原位。

items.de: Editable PowerPoint authoring workflow (a DSH-skill adaptation of icip-cas/PPTAgent) with concise Chinese business styling, HTML slide rendering and PPTX export review. Linux/WSL or macOS (Apple Silicon only); install LibreOffice, Chinese fonts, Node.js 22+ and uv first, then run the one-time setup,
items.dz: 可编辑 PowerPoint 制作工作流（基于 icip-cas/PPTAgent 的 Skill 版本改造），包含简洁中文商业风格、HTML 幻灯片渲染与 PPTX 导出复查。仅 Linux/WSL 或 macOS（仅 Apple Silicon）；首次使用需先装 LibreOffice、中文字体、Node.js 22+ 与 uv，再执行一次 setup——它会用 uv 建 Python 3.12 环境并安装 Playwright Chromium。

items.de: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 检索 CCReach 能力目录（数据源、工具、API、MCP、技能与工作流）。

items.de: Closes DeepSeek Harness runner processes that stay alive after their shell command finished on Windows, reclaiming about 140 MB each. A runner is closed only when its shell is gone and it supervises nothing, as a workaround for the runner not exiting by itself.
items.dz: 在 Windows 上关闭 shell 命令已结束、却仍然存活的 DeepSeek Harness runner 进程，每个可回收约 140 MB。仅当其 shell 已不存在且不再监管任何子进程时才会关闭，用作 runner 不会自行退出问题的变通办法。

items.de: Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement.
items.dz: 模型切换、模型能力配置、固定摘要模型、子 agent 角色路由与输入历史增强。

items.de: Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.
items.dz: 可配置的聊天自动滚动——按节定速阅读（停顿时长与篇幅成比例）、平滑跟随、单步与固定模式，支持快捷键与按会话记忆打开位置。

items.de: Turn any DeepSeek Harness answer into a polished PNG share card: click a button under the reply, the answer is re-typeset on a canvas (8 gradient presets, light/dark, three fonts, width 720/880/1080, radius, padding, font size, line height, 1x-3x export, code wrap/highlight/line numbers, custom titl
items.dz: 把任意一条 AI 回答一键变成精美的 PNG 分享卡片：点回复下面的按钮，回答会被重新排版画到画布上（8 套渐变预设、深浅主题、三种字体、宽度 720/880/1080、圆角、内边距、字号、行高、1×–3× 导出倍率、代码折行/高亮/行号、自定义标题与页脚）。纯本地渲染，不联网、不上传、无第三方依赖。

items.de: Local-first task scheduler for DSH. Schedules today's tasks from the current time, splits long tasks around lunch, highlights the current task live, reminds at task start and before the next task, and adds a 7-day calendar plus an exportable virtual timeline.
items.dz: DSH 本地任务排程：今天的自动任务从当前时间开始排，长任务自动绕午休分段，实时高亮当前任务；任务开始和下个任务前弹窗提醒；支持未来 7 天日历与可导出/导入的虚拟时间轴。

items.de: Windows companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The standalone window reuses the Electron binary at %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe (usually installed by dsh-pet) and fails to open when it is missing.
items.dz: Windows 下的 DSH Desktop 独立伴生窗：待办、提醒、实时会话消息、审批接管和快速输入；独立窗复用 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe（通常由 dsh-pet 下载），缺失时打不开。

items.de: Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文防火墙：成功的纯文本工具结果中的凭据在进入模型之前先变成不透明的 ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ 占位符，原值只保存在进程内存的 agent 级保险库中。36 类内置签名（与 cloakpack git pre-push 守卫共享同一引擎）、针对未知格式的键名规则、自定义正则、dry-run 模式、审计日志与 /cloak 命令。

items.de: Decides whether Python code is original or a derivative work: reports the longest identical expression span against an upstream tree, an exemption rationale per finding, and a risk list. Pure stdlib `ast` analysis — offline, no model calls.
items.dz: 判定 Python 代码是原创还是演绎作品：给出与上游最长相同表达片段、逐条豁免依据和风险清单。纯标准库 `ast` 分析——离线运行，不调用模型。

items.de: Turn code flows into source-linked Mermaid diagrams and interactive CodeWalkthrough explainers.
items.dz: 把代码流程变成可跳转源码的 Mermaid 图和交互式 CodeWalkthrough 讲解页。

items.de: Skill bundle that installs the codex-collab skill for driving the local OpenAI Codex CLI as a vendor instead of a consultant: every delegation carries acceptance criteria and a self-test script, the result is verified by running those tests locally, and a failure is handed back with its original err
items.dz: 把 codex-collab 技能装进 DSH 的技能包：把本地 OpenAI Codex CLI 当供应商而非顾问来派活——每次派活附验收标准与自测脚本，本地跑测试验收，失败把原始报错原样丢回去；支持批量派活（本机子进程并行不可用，按顺序执行）与单会话多轮续接。需已安装本地 Codex CLI 与 PowerShell 7+；辅助脚本为 Windows 原生，macOS/Linux 只能部分运行。

items.de: Codex History Rail adds a Codex-style turn rail to the left gutter of a DSH conversation, with hover previews, click-to-jump, and saved favorites.
items.dz: CODEX 历史摘要条 —— 在 DSH 对话左侧留白处加入 Codex 风格回合时间轴，支持悬停预览、点击跳转与收藏。

items.de: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness with all 15 Coding Plan models and per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.

items.de: Reads ComfyUI PNG metadata in a model-facing comfy_png_inspect tool: point it at one PNG or a whole output folder and it reports, per image, the LoRA execution chain with every strength value, sampler settings, base model, CLIP, VAE, latent size, both prompts and bypassed nodes.
items.dz: 以面向模型的 comfy_png_inspect 工具读取 ComfyUI 生成图的 PNG 元数据：可传单张 PNG 或整个 output 目录，逐张报出 LoRA 执行链与每档强度、采样参数、底模、CLIP、VAE、latent 尺寸、正负提示词与被 bypass 的节点。

items.de: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目级本地上下文引擎：对历史、代码、文件、用户偏好和 Agent 轨迹做检索/压缩/优先级排序，为任意 LLM 生成动态上下文窗口。

items.de: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and i
items.dz: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 音色接进 DSH：voice_speak 工具与 /voice 命令朗读，每条助手回复下方有喇叭按钮，设置页可切音色、调合成参数、管本地推理服务，并支持一键安装音色包。仅 Windows；需本机已有 GPT-SoVITS 仓库、训练好的权重与它的 Python 环境。

items.de: Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches
items.dz: 跨会话记忆「错题本」插件：每轮把 ≤2 KB 的记忆索引原文注入提示词；mem_recall / mem_save 模型工具，写入闸要求四段结构 + 可定位引用 + 人工批准才落盘；注册 /memory 命令；所有教训以零依赖 Markdown 条目存放在 .memory/ 目录。

items.de: Bundled registry of 119 computer-science sources (textbooks, official docs, standards, preprints) across the 17 CS2023 knowledge areas, each tagged with an authority tier, evidence type and refresh interval, plus cs_source_find and cs_source_audit tools that look up a source or audit the URLs in a d
items.dz: 内置 119 条计算机信源（教材、官方文档、标准、预印本），覆盖 17 个 CS2023 知识领域，逐条标注权威等级、证据类型与刷新周期；提供 cs_source_find 与 cs_source_audit 两个工具，用于查源和审计草稿中的引用。

items.de: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and registers its 60 accessibility-first window, input, menu, and browser tools with a bundled workflow skill and one-time macOS permission guidance.

items.de: Brings Harness conversations and tasks into a Live2D character on the Windows desktop, with drawer-based memory. The desktop app includes the whale girl 哦鲸鲸 as its default character. The modular design supports optional voice components for voice conversations and custom character voices.
items.dz: 把 Harness 的对话和任务交互集成到 Windows 桌面上的 Live2D 角色中，采用抽屉式记忆设计。桌面程序默认搭载大肥鱼「哦鲸鲸」。角色功能采用模块化设计，语音组件按需安装，支持语音交流和自定义角色音色。

items.de: Per-workspace personal knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each identity gets an isolated local library — import PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, text, HTML and images, auto-chunk and embed into SQLite with FTS5 + vector hybrid retrieval, then ask questions in chat with numbered citations back to the so
items.dz: 按工作区隔离的个人知识库：每种身份一套本地资料库，导入 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、文本、网页和图片，自动切块并生成向量索引（SQLite FTS5 + 向量混合检索），对话里直接提问，回答带编号引用可回溯原文。本地存储，不上传云端；向量化需要本机 Ollama（默认 bge-m3），没有时检索退化为 FTS5 关键词。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.dz: 面向 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ 的防御性智能体编程工作流：包含确定性机器测试、独立审查者与人类终审闸门。

items.de: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply in

items.de: Underground pipeline data quality inspection plugin — checks coverage, edge matching, flow direction, outputs quality score. Default rules follow Chinese standards and a Guangdong guideline (accepted SRIDs: CGCS2000 and 3° zones 38–40; gross-error threshold 5%); override via config JSON.
items.dz: 地下管线数据质量检查插件 — 检测覆盖率、接边精度、流向合理性，输出质量评分。默认规则取自国标与广东省导则（坐标系仅认 CGCS2000 及三度带 38–40 带，粗差率阈值 5%），可用配置 JSON 覆盖。

items.de: Diagnoses how discoverable a DSH plugin is (npm keywords, README install format, GitHub topics, market listing) and drafts fix suggestions; registers diagnose_visibility and boost_exposure tools. Scoring rules are tuned to the author's own @liuhange packages; needs network access (npm, GitHub API, d

items.dz: 固定 DSH Web GUI 的正文列宽度，并在窗口缩放后把阅读位置对回原处。

items.dz: 把内置的全栈开发、前端设计与浏览器自动化三份技能文档注册为四个只读工具，用 focus 参数指定随技能正文一并返回的参考文档。

items.dz: 为第三方模型配置推理强度档位，并在输入栏提供模型与强度选择器。

items.de: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page

items.dz: 显示当前 DeepSeek API 高峰或非高峰计费时段，以及距离下一次切换的倒计时。

items.dz: Typocket 在 DSH 中阅读、编辑和整理本机文档，并预览工作区 Markdown。

items.dz: DeepSeek API 时段价格悬浮窗，联网读取中国法定节假日，显示账户余额与本项目花费估算；含绿/橙 24 小时时间轴和可折叠的模型、计费规则、节假日区块。

items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 把独立 Git 仓库中的站点、工作流和项目组合成一块看板；以 GitHub 作为访问关口。

items.de: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video, or a defect into a traceable feedback video: real screen recordings, edge-tts narration with word-clock subtitles, a self-contained ffmpeg pipeline, and a deterministic quality gate (spec, audio, loudness, black/freeze/silence
items.dz: 把真实运行的功能做成可信交付演示视频，或把缺陷做成可追溯的问题反馈视频：真实录屏、edge-tts 旁白与逐字对齐字幕、自包含 ffmpeg 管线，配一道拒绝放过造假或残次演示的确定性质量闸（规格、音轨、响度、黑帧/冻结/静音扫描），含渲染前预检与成片证据核验。反馈模式带严重级别/阶段徽标、复现步骤浮层，以及按成片 SHA256 绑定的工单级问题报告。需 Python 3.9+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，以及 `pip install edge-tts Pillow`；旁白会调用 edge-tts 公共接口。

items.de: Adds a Trade Desk panel to the DSH sidebar for foreign-trade documents and container loading: quotation, PI/CI/PL/contract/customs documents, carton loading plans and a step-by-step loading animation. The existing offline single-file workbench is served same-origin inside the panel.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏增加外贸工作台入口，用于外贸单证与装柜计算：报价单、PI/CI/PL/合同/报关资料、装柜方案与逐层装柜动画。现有离线单文件工作台通过同源页面嵌入面板。

items.de: Third-party DSH bundle carrying the original deterministic-pixel-art Skill for editable JSON/PNG pixel art, Python rendering and recoloring within declared regions. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (other DSH versions are not claimed compatible) and Python 3.10+ with Pillow.
items.dz: 第三方 DSH bundle，携带原 deterministic-pixel-art Skill，支持可编辑 JSON/PNG 像素画、Python 渲染及声明区域内的改色。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1（其他 DSH 版本未声明兼容）以及带 Pillow 的 Python 3.10+。

items.de: Programmer's almanac for DSH: a right-sidebar tab shows today's Chinese almanac (lunar date, do and avoid items mapped to coding tasks, clash, solar term, lucky hours), a daily horoscope for the 12 signs and a fortune-slip draw. Adds the /almanac and /qiuqian commands and the almanac_today tool. Com

items.de: Configure DMXAPI Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and custom providers; edit models on existing preset routes.
items.dz: 配置 DMXAPI Chat、Responses、Anthropic 和自定义服务商，并直接编辑已有预设服务商的模型。

The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails
items.dz: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

items.dz: 文档工坊：把设备说明书与历史报告变成技术方案、调研报告和投标文件，支持导出 Markdown / Word / HTML / PDF / PPTX。Word / PPTX 导出与文档解析需要 Python 3 及 pypdf、python-docx、python-pptx（在设置页初始化），PDF 导出需要标准 Windows 路径下的 Chrome 或 Edge。

items.de: Splash and exit animations for DeepSeek Harness. Five hand-drawn styles (whale light-sweep, pulse, stardust, typewriter, radar rings) — or drop in your own video / GIF. A settings panel controls speed, particle count, accent colour, wording, mute and fit. The exit animation needs the bundled one-tim
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的开场 / 退场动画：5 套纯代码自绘样式（鲸鱼光扫 / 极简脉冲 / 星尘汇聚 / 打字机 / 雷达环），也可以换成你自己的视频或动图；设置页可调速度、粒子数、主色、文案、静音与画面适配。退场动画需先运行 node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply 给桌面壳打补丁（可回滚）；不打补丁时关闭只隐藏窗口。

items.de: Registers a web-design skill and a compact system-prompt rule set for a three-layer shadcn/ui, Canvas UI and ThreeUI workflow, with Radix UI Colors and strict interface rules.
items.dz: 注册一个网页设计技能和一组系统提示规则，按 shadcn/ui、Canvas UI、ThreeUI 三层体系执行，并强制 Radix UI Colors 与界面细节规范。

items.de: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
items.dz: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

items.de: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
items.dz: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

items.de: Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (engines.dsh pins it exactly). Technical support for Dragonfly 3D World using 2027.1 help documents and read-only searches of a detected local installation, with an explicit help-only fallback.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 精确钉版）。基于 Dragonfly 3D World 2027.1 帮助文档和本机安装源码的只读检索提供技术支持，未发现安装时明确提示仅帮助文档模式。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness tools and a Skill for md-report/1: validate and render Markdown plus declared SQLite/CSV datasets into one offline interactive HTML report or dashboard, with AntV G2 charts (ECharts fallback) and chart/table data and source-SQL views.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 md-report/1 报告的校验与渲染工具：把 Markdown 与声明的 SQLite/CSV 数据集生成单个离线可交互 HTML 报告或仪表盘，图表默认用 AntV G2、复杂图表回退 ECharts，并提供图表/数据/SQL 与数据表/数据/SQL 视图。

items.de: QQ-style attention alerts for the DSH desktop client: one short cue when a session needs you, a notification-area icon that blinks like an unread message, and an unread dock. The blink stops only once every triggering session has been read.
items.dz: DSH 桌面客户端的 QQ 风格提醒：会话需要你处理时响一声短促提示音，系统托盘图标像未读消息一样闪动，右下角还有未读浮窗。只有把触发过提醒的会话全部读掉，闪动才会停止。

items.de: Local kanban boards shared by people, DSH sessions and optional DS Bot, with role permissions, change history and explicit task completion.
items.dz: 人、DSH 会话与可选 DS Bot 共用的本地看板，提供角色权限、变更记录和明确的任务完成操作。

items.de: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message adds one more message to a Session that is still running — the host is asked to splice it into that turn at once, instead of queueing it un
items.dz: 给会话加四个工具：create_session 在指定工作区或任意一个已存在的文件夹里开一个新会话，并把一段提示词投进去；session_message 给一个还在跑的会话再追加一条消息——请宿主立刻把它插进正在跑的那一轮，不再排队到本轮结束；已经闲下来的会话会被拒投，并指向 create_session；read_session_transcript 按会话 id 读回它说过什么、当前这一轮结束没有；list_dispatched_sessions 列出本插件派送过哪些会话、各自此刻什么状态。宿主半边插件，没有界面，调用的是宿主自己的建会话能力。装完需重启 DSH。

items.de: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.
items.dz: 把本机任意文件拖拽或粘贴到 DSH 页面，静默反查真实绝对路径并插入输入框（Spotlight + 大小/时间 + 首尾指纹校验），未找到时内容缓存兜底。

items.de: Rebuilds the sidebar into a workspace / group / session tree: drag sessions between groups, per-session context-usage ring, scheduled-task clock, cost tag, resize handles, 20%/40% context alerts and the balance in the workspace header. Client-only bundle, no host changes.
items.dz: DSH 工作区美化：侧栏改成 工作区 → 分组 → 会话，支持跨分组/跨工作区拖拽归类、会话行上下文用量环、定时任务时钟、单会话花费、两侧调宽把手、20%/40% 上下文提醒，工作区标题栏显示账户余额。纯客户端 bundle，不改宿主。

items.de: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
items.dz: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

items.de: Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the tr
items.dz: 注册 /compact_queue：会话忙时也不丢弃请求的压缩命令——空闲就立刻压缩，忙时把请求排进本会话队列，等这个会话下一次空闲自动补跑；agent 状态事件之外再挂一条 2 秒兜底 tick，避免漏触发，排队最长等 30 分钟，排队中或执行中都可以用 /compact_queue cancel 撤销。命令只注册一次，每个会话各自一份排队状态，完成与失败以折叠 notice 注入、不唤醒模型；ManualCompactionError 除 busy 外一律视为终态、不再重试。只有 Host 半边，核心 /compact 不改。

items.de: A file editor in the DSH web GUI right sidebar: open any text file, edit it, and save in place, with a version gate on every save — if the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The document preview gains an edit button and a two-step delete button, and a sepa
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 右侧栏的文件编辑器：打开任意文本文件即可编辑并原地保存，每次保存都带版本闸——编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖。文档预览多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮；另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制、剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除、拖拽整理。两档文档渲染器共覆盖 107 个纯文本、配置与源码扩展名，其中第二档只作为「打开方式」出现，官方 Markdown 排版与代码高亮仍是默认视图。所有变更都走插件自己的 Host 路由，过连接信任围栏、工作区包含性检查与沙箱策略三道闸。

items.de: EPLAN Electric P8 automation for DeepSeek Harness (Windows): a bundled eplan-mcp server drives the running P8 2025 instance through the EPLAN Remote Client interface, a settings page sets the EPLAN install root, and five skills cover connection and safety, C# scripting, documentation lookup, EEC Pro
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 EPLAN Electric P8 自动化插件（仅 Windows）：内置 eplan-mcp 通过 EPLAN Remote Client 接口驱动正在运行的 P8 2025，设置页配置 EPLAN 安装根目录，五个技能覆盖连接与安全、C# 脚本、文档查阅、EEC Pro 开发与安装排错。五套离线 SQLite 文档索引（P8 2025 API 参考、P8 2025 平台帮助、P8 2026、P8 2027、EEC Pro 2026）可在断网状态下检索，但索引不随仓库提供：需下载 Release 里的索引压缩包，或用自带脚本自行构建；2026 与 202

items.de: Genshin Nicole PV wallpaper skin for the DSH web GUI — 14 subtitle-free frames rotate on a timed crossfade queue with pause and manual switching.

items.de: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing tools, close-line alerts through desktop notification, sound or email (email delivery additionally needs the dsh-qq-email plugin), and an in
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 OKX 永续合约看板插件：BTC/ETH 的 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D K 线、EMA 均线叠加、直线/斐波那契/尺子画线、收线预警（桌面通知/提示音/邮件；邮件通道需另装 dsh-qq-email 插件）与面板内回测。行情来自 OKX 公开接口，不需要 API key。

items.de: Read-only agent checkup with four probes (output repetition, error visibility, tool failure rate, context bloat) over recent local session logs, rendered as an HTML report.
items.dz: Agent 体检：对近期本地会话日志跑重复率/错误可见性/工具失败率/上下文膨胀四个只读探针，输出 HTML 报告。

items.de: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows) with flat-rate support for custom providers like TokenBom.
items.dz: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

items.de: Builds a per-project code wiki: README summary, docs tree, tech stack, git activity and language composition, cached locally and exportable as Markdown.
items.dz: 项目 Wiki 生成器：聚合 README 摘要、docs 树、技术栈、git 活跃度与语言构成，本地缓存并可导出 Markdown。

items.de: Import Codex and Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness: merges same-project sessions into existing workspaces by cwd, offers handoff summaries or full transcripts, and keeps a rollback ledger.
items.dz: 把 Codex / Claude Code 历史会话一键导入 DeepSeek Harness：同路径项目自动归并进现有工作区，支持交接书摘要或全量转录，导入历史可回滚。

items.de: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH

items.de: Project progress panel that scans a configurable root for local projects, infers activity from anchors and git evidence, and exports a self-contained dark HTML report.
items.dz: 项目进度面板：扫描配置根目录下的本地项目，按锚点与 git 证据推断活跃度，支持筛选、锚点标记与自包含深色 HTML 报告导出。

items.de: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.
items.dz: 会话内选中文字即弹出工具条：添加到对话、新开讨论或复制；引用折叠为输入框旁的引用卡片，双击跳回被引用轮次。

items.de: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.
items.dz: 在工作区之间安全移动会话：移动前校验运行中/子代理/离线状态，每次移动自动备份到 ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/。

items.de: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.
items.dz: 会话工具箱：导出 Markdown 与零依赖批量 ZIP、时间线浮层快速跳轮、安全复制会话（自动重写内部身份字段）、侧栏右键菜单扩展。

items.de: Usage statistics settings page computed locally from session logs: 30-day daily list, per-model and per-session tables with provider-aware pricing (DeepSeek peak/off-peak, bundled TokenBom flat rates); skips inherited events of forked subagent sessions to avoid double-counting.
items.dz: 用量统计设置页：全部基于本地会话日志计算（近 30 天条形图 / 模型表 / 会话表），按服务商感知计价（官方峰谷、内置 TokenBom 平价表），并跳过子代理会话继承的历史事件避免重复计费。

items.de: Local-first resume warehouse for DeepSeek Harness: package your work into reusable bullets, import an existing resume into a template, analyse a job description (including the school-tier preference it implies), assemble a tailored Chinese or English resume and export a PDF named position-name-schoo
items.dz: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的表述、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。应用本体随 npm 包发布（server/、web/、skills/、scripts/、requirements.txt，无需 clone 仓库），自带工具负责启动/停止并读取健康状态，首次启动会把依赖装进 app/.venv；需要 Python 3.10+ 与 macOS / Linux（bash）。除你确认过的 LLM 调用外数据不出本机。

items.de: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat c
items.dz: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm dist-tag 通道比较的 dsh 版本/更新提示（只提示、不代升级）。同一插件还用机器名字顶替侧栏品牌区、在输入框下方「性能与用量」行旁加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」，并提供一个即时注册/注销三个 dsh_restart_* 模型工具的开关。零依赖、无构建；所有路由都过官方

items.de: Bundles the 14 obra/superpowers skills for dsh from a recorded upstream tag (v6.3.0), re-syncable with drift reporting; the skills trigger automatically.
items.dz: 把 obra/superpowers 的 14 个技能按已记录的上游 tag（v6.3.0）打包进 dsh，并可用带差异报告的命令重新同步；任务匹配时自动触发。

items.de: Per-workspace DSH conversation status in the Windows system tray, plus native DeepSeek Harness notifications when a conversation needs approval, a choice or free-text input, completes, or fails. Windows 10/11 and DSH Desktop 0.2.3-rc.1+ only. The tray menu and notifications work only after a one-tim
items.dz: 在 Windows 系统托盘里按工作区显示 DSH 对话状态，并在对话需要批准 / 选择 / 输入、完成或失败时，由 DeepSeek Harness 应用本身弹出原生通知。仅支持 Windows 10/11 与 DSH Desktop 0.2.3-rc.1 及以上。托盘与通知必须先一次性安装桌面桥接（用户级、可卸载）：它把 DSH 快捷方式改指向隐藏启动器，经启动时短暂开启的本机回环 Node Inspector 向 DSH 的 Electron 主进程注入钩子；不装桥接则插件只写出 state.json。空闲对话默认不进入托盘；托盘行数、顶部计数、页脚、通知类型、前台免打扰、提示音共 9

items.de: Per-workspace activation control: a dialog opened from the workspace row menu switches individual plugins, MCP servers, and skills on or off, and the host applies the choice in that workspace's own agent scope — a disabled skill leaves the model catalog, an MCP server has its mcp__<server>__ tools d
items.dz: 按工作区开关插件、MCP 服务器与 Skills：工作区行菜单里的弹窗写入选择，宿主机在该工作区自己的 Agent 作用域内应用——关闭的 Skill 从模型目录中消失，MCP 服务器被拒绝其 mcp__<server>__ 工具，插件被拒绝其条目声明的工具名。

items.de: Freezes a six-step repair chain into callable tools — freeze the facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable A/B, a judge that must say OK, delivery gate — plus a zero-dependency boot self-check (path drift, missing files, version sync, crash-log freshness), per-item tunables and a
items.dz: 把排障六步固化成可调用的链：冻结事实→量真形状→最小复现→单变量对照→判定器（没说 OK 不许说修好）→交活闸；另带零依赖开机自检（安装路径漂移、配方缺件、版本三处一致、崩溃日志新鲜度）、逐项说明的微调设置，以及每个动作都留备份的退回账本。

items.de: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

items.de: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

items.de: Minesweeper on a rotating cube surface with cross-edge neighbors, no-guess generation, ghost mode and color themes.
items.dz: 立方体表面 3D 排雷，拖拽旋转、跨棱跨角邻居、无猜生成、透视模式与多套配色。

items.de: Previews GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL and PLY models in the right-sidebar document preview, and parses runtime-built three.js scenes from HTML pages or pasted code to export the full scene or per-object groups as model files.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里预览 GLB、glTF、FBX、OBJ、STL、PLY 模型；也能解析 HTML 页面或粘贴代码中运行时构建的 three.js 场景，支持完整场景导出和按个体分组导出为模型文件。

items.de: Opens STEP/STP/STL/GLB/GLTF models in a sidebar 3D viewer: STEP is tessellated in the browser with OpenCASCADE WASM; the toolbar offers fit/front/top/side/iso orthographic views and a PNG screenshot; inputs are capped at 64 MiB and .gltf files that reference external buffers or textures are rejected
items.dz: 在侧栏直接打开 STEP/STP/STL/GLB/GLTF 模型：STEP 用浏览器内的 OpenCASCADE WASM 转网格；工具条提供适配/前/顶/侧/等轴正交视图与 PNG 截图；输入上限 64 MiB，引用外部 buffer 或贴图的 .gltf 会被拒绝。

items.de: Native WCAG accessibility scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON. Read-only, CI-able.
items.dz: 原生 WCAG 无障碍扫描工具：对本地 HTML / 构建产物 / URL 运行 axe-core，输出规则 id、impact、WCAG 2.1 映射、元素定位与修复建议（Markdown/HTML/JSON），只读可进 CI。

items.de: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task
items.dz: Agent2Agent（A2A）协议桥：内置 A2A 服务端（agent card、message/send、message/stream SSE、任务 get/cancel/resubscribe、input-required 续答）；a2a_discover/a2a_send 等 4 个工具呼叫远端 agent；附 Web 运维面板：实时任务板、一键取消、远端 agent 目录。

items.de: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.
items.dz: 会话生命周期事件（新建 / 运行中 / 完成 / 出错）的 Windows 气泡通知，覆盖所有工作区；还会监听会话存储，捕捉事件从不经过宿主总线的无头与 A2A 派发会话。仅支持 Windows。

items.de: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).
items.dz: 受 A2UI 启发的模型生成应用卡片，提供持久机器目录、SSH 探测及经审阅授权的监控与控制操作。SSH 探测需 OpenSSH（ssh、ssh-keyscan、ssh-keygen）。

items.de: Watches the Agents Anywhere bridge and notifies you when it wedges and leaves your phone offline; a crashed Connector is relaunched by default (guarded), restarting a wedged one is opt-in. Needs the Agents Anywhere bridge plugin; macOS tested, Windows untested.
items.dz: 监测 Agents Anywhere 桥接卡死（进程存活但手机端离线）并弹窗提醒；Connector 进程退出时默认自动拉起（带护栏），卡死时的自动重启需手动开启。需已安装并登录 Agents Anywhere 桥接插件；macOS 已实测，Windows 未测。

items.de: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
items.dz: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

items.de: Repairs domains blocked by SNI filtering on Windows from inside DSH, without any self-hosted server.
items.dz: 在 Windows 上从 DSH 内部修复被 SNI 阻断的域名，不依赖任何自建服务器。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to 127.0.0.2:8843
uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

items.de: Access the DSH Web GUI from your LAN: a listener on the address you set forwards the browser to the loopback GUI with this process's launch token, and 0.0.0.0 answers on Wi-Fi, VPN and wired alike. Address, port, session lifetime and password are edited in an Access section of Settings. The password
items.dz: 在局域网中访问 DSH Web GUI：在设置的地址上监听，通过后把浏览器转发到回环上的 GUI，并带上当前进程的启动 token；地址填 0.0.0.0 则 Wi-Fi、VPN、有线都能进。地址、端口、免密天数与密码在设置的「访问入口」分区里修改。密码默认开启，首次启动随机生成一个；在信任的网络里可以关掉密码直接访问。宿主保存的只是密码的 scrypt 哈希。

items.de: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
items.dz: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

items.de: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话底栏（输入框下方的统计行）显示当前 DeepSeek 账户的剩余余额，定时刷新，并在每轮对话结束后立即更新。

items.de: Customize the Harness sidebar name and avatar with a local crop editor.
items.dz: 自定义 Harness 侧边栏名称与头像，支持本地裁切预览。

items.de: Store account credentials in an encrypted browser-local vault.
items.dz: 在浏览器本地加密保存账号凭据。

items.de: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to portrait.local

items.de: Transparent acrylic window material and layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: the window reveals the desktop wallpaper (Windows Acrylic supplies the blur), the composer is a pane of frosted glass, and chat text is hard-clipped at the composer's top edge. Note: the page styling
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供透明亚克力窗口材质与分层雾面面板：窗口透出桌面壁纸（模糊由 Windows Acrylic 负责），输入栏是一块毛玻璃，聊天文字在输入栏上沿硬裁切。注意：页面样式随插件安装，但「窗口透出壁纸」需要额外运行一次 app.asar 补丁脚本（仓库 Releases 里的补丁包，双击 enable-transparency.cmd），补丁重启后生效，DSH 更新后需重打。只装插件也能用，只是窗口保持不透明。

items.de: Scores sessions and workspaces 0-100% by time since their last activity, then shows that heat as a sidebar icon, a small heat dot before every session title, a heat line in the session hover card, and a filterable sessions/workspaces panel that also totals the turns, steps, tokens and conversation t
items.dz: 按距最后一次活动的时间给会话与工作区打 0–100% 热度分，并在侧边栏图标、会话标题前的小热度圆点、会话悬浮卡片和可筛选的会话/工作区面板中呈现；工作区卡片还汇总该工作区的轮次、步数、Token 与会话时长。

items.de: Version-adaptive tooling for DeepSeek Harness: it reads the running DSH version from the plugin manager, mirrors app-boot plugin-compatibility rules (engines.dsh first, then @deepseek-ai/dsh* peers, prerelease-inclusive comparison, exact-version exemptions) to score every installed plugin, and stati
items.dz: DSH 版本自适应：自检当前运行时版本，按 DSH 自己的规则（engines.dsh 优先，否则检查 @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer；预发布参与比较；精确版本例外）逐条判定已装插件，并用官方 release notes 摘出的规则标出源码里仍在使用 v0.1.6 起已改名/弃用接口的位置。带会话视图面板、agent 工具与 HTTP 状态/重扫/报告入口；只读、离线。

items.de: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
items.dz: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

items.de: Right-click any selected assistant reply and add it to the composer as a removable quote chip. The selected text is delivered to the model as hidden context, so your message bubble keeps only your own words.
items.dz: 选中助手回复中的一段文字，右键即可「加入对话」，以可移除的引用胶囊放进输入框；发送时原文作为隐藏上下文交给模型，消息气泡里只保留你自己的话。

items.de: ADHD-friendly focus soundscape docked under the DSH composer: five procedurally synthesised noise colours (white, pink, brown, rain, fan), a live-waveform orb, a 15-90 minute fade-out timer and a liquid-glass popover. No audio assets and no network requests.
items.dz: DSH 输入框下方的 ADHD 友好专注声景：白/粉/棕噪与雨声、风扇五种程序化合成音色，实时波形声球、15–90 分钟定时淡出与液态玻璃浮层；无音频素材、无网络请求。

items.de: Frontend aesthetics engine as 17 native tools — a 118-palette evidence library matched by register, cross-register whole-page design directions, four mechanical gates (WCAG contrast, color-blind simulation, AI-slop detection, scorecard) with digest-bound verdicts, plus semantic design tokens, existi
items.dz: 前端美学引擎的 17 个原生工具：118 块实证色板按语域选板、跨语域整页方向对比、四道机械检查（对比度、色盲、AI 味、评分）带指纹绑定，另有设计令牌表、页面审计、图表色板、中文字阶、渲染对账与量化叙事。全部本地运行，零联网。需 Python 3.8+。

items.de: Give your agent an external emotion state machine: several axes (0-100) that drift over time and move when you speak to it. Each turn the plugin injects which band you are in plus which tags you may use. The numbers belong to the plugin: the model reads them from the injected prompt and can change t
items.dz: 把 AI 的情绪搬到模型外面：几条情绪轴各 0-100，按你说的话加减、随时间自己漂移，每轮把「现在处在哪一档 + 可用标签」注入系统提示。数值由插件维护：模型从注入的提示里读到当前值，只能通过插件自带的情绪工具调整，不能凭一句自报心情改数。默认空配置，一个轴都不替你定。

items.de: Live done/now/next card above the composer while the agent is still working.
items.dz: 输入框上方的「已做 / 正在做 / 接下来」实时卡片，回答还没出来时就能看到进度。

items.de: Lists Claude Code and Codex sessions in the DSH Workspace browser, where they can be opened, continued, pinned, renamed and archived, with terminal, file and git tabs.
items.dz: 在 DSH 工作区侧边栏列出 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，可打开、继续对话、置顶、重命名和归档，并附带终端、文件和 Git 标签页。

items.de: Bridge a Feishu bot to a DSH session: open a real session in a workspace, run tasks with the existing model and plugins, and report results back.
items.dz: 飞书机器人 → DSH 会话桥：在指定工作区开真会话，用 DSH 现有模型+插件执行任务并回传结论。

items.de: AgentCompare provides A/B workflows for one Vite task in DSH: run two implementations, compare live previews with shared checks, choose blind, and review adoption against current project edits. Requires a root-level Vite project in a Git repository with at least one commit.
items.dz: AgentCompare A/B 对比：同一需求做两版 Vite 应用，在 DSH 主对话中并排体验、统一验收、盲选，再审查采用到当前项目。复用已有模型配置；适用于本地 Git 仓库（至少一次提交）的根目录 Vite 前端。

items.de: One read-only index of every local AI-agent session (Codex, Claude Code, DSH, Trae, or any JSONL source) grouped by project, plus an append-only shared board for decisions and handoffs so switching agents leaves no context gap.
items.dz: 把本机所有 agent 的会话历史合并成一份按项目分组的只读索引，并附一块只追加的共享上下文板，让换 agent 时不丢结论。

items.de: Wraps the separately installed agent-desktop CLI (`npm i -g agent-desktop`) as nine DSH tools (ad_status, ad_list_windows, ad_snapshot, ad_find, ad_click, ad_type, ad_press, ad_launch, ad_close_app) so an agent can list windows, read an accessibility tree, click a snapshot ref, type text, send keys,
items.dz: 把需另行安装的 agent-desktop CLI（`npm i -g agent-desktop`）封装成 9 个 DSH 工具（ad_status、ad_list_windows、ad_snapshot、ad_find、ad_click、ad_type、ad_press、ad_launch、ad_close_app），让 Agent 直接列窗口、读无障碍树、按快照 ref 点击、输入文本、发送按键、启动与优雅关闭应用。插件本身不含自动化逻辑，只做参数校验、调用 CLI、解析 JSON 信封；ref 过期时要求调用方重新快照，不自动重试，避免误点。

items.de: Discovers workspace Markdown commands, skills and path-scoped rules from .dsh and .agents directories.
items.dz: 从 .dsh 与 .agents 目录发现工作区 Markdown 命令、技能和按路径生效的规则。

items.de: Parent-agent dispatch with review: split a task into work orders, hand each to a contractor you picked (its own provider, model, and reasoning effort), then pass or fail every delivery — failed ones are re-dispatched with your feedback.
items.dz: 父智能体派单、子智能体干活的包工头：把任务拆成工单，每张派给你自选的承包商（各自指定 provider、模型、思考等级），交付后逐单验收，打回的单带着你的反馈重新派下去。

items.de: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
items.dz: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

items.de: Advisory permission checks for DSH tool calls: risk tiers, a path sandbox (empty allowed_roots denies every path-like call), a per-minute call limit and a JSONL audit, exposed through gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy and ctx.gate — other plugins or prompts must call the gate; it does not i
items.dz: DSH 工具调用的咨询式权限检查：风险分级、路径沙箱（allowed_roots 为空时一律拒绝）、每分钟调用限额与 JSONL 审计，通过 gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy 与 ctx.gate 提供——需由其他插件或提示主动调用，本身不拦截工具调用。

items.de: Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.
items.dz: 飞书多助手机器人控制台：开启/关闭/重连守护进程、状态与最近动态、直达任务工作区。

items.de: Records a session as a run, replays it in an isolated workspace copy with another model or prompt, diffs the two trajectories side by side, aggregates runs into a task × variant matrix, and gates regressions with task assertions and a CI exit code.
items.dz: 把会话录成运行，在隔离副本里换模型或提示词重放，逐行对比两次轨迹，把多次运行聚合成任务 × 变体矩阵，并用任务断言与 CI 退出码做回归门禁。

items.de: Manage subagents and Agent Teams teammates in DeepSeek Harness: stop running instances, then really remove them by retiring their catalog and roster records with seq-preserving log tombstones and moving their session directories to a recoverable trash; model tools, a conversation-header panel and an
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的子代理和团队队友管理：停掉正在跑的实例，或者真正移除——日志一行不删，只在原位置把记录标记为已移除，子会话目录移入可恢复的回收站；带模型工具、会话头部面板和离线 CLI。

items.de: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
items.dz: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

items.de: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered
items.dz: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

items.de: Auto Mode for DSH: a flash-model router that auto-picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session and executes immediately, no confirmation.
items.dz: DSH 自动模式：用 Flash 模型为每个新会话自动判断最合适的 Agent 预设（标准/PTC/极简/创造）并直接执行，无需确认。

items.de: Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell `Remove-Item` and its aliases, Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`, CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-dele
items.dz: 把 Agent 提交的删除命令（PowerShell `Remove-Item` 及别名、Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`、CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`）改写为 Windows、Linux、macOS 的系统回收站操作，执行脚本前尽力检查其中的同类删除操作，且不提供永久删除兜底。

items.de: Live step pill in the DSH session header: folds the durable session event stream into the agent's current action (tool name plus its argument summary), the step index inside the running turn, the elapsed turn time and the todo progress, polls it every 1.2 seconds, and renders blue pulse while workin
items.dz: DSH 会话标题栏里的实时进度胶囊：把持久化的会话事件流折叠成 agent 当前动作（工具名 + 参数摘要）、本轮第几步、已耗时与待办进度，每 1.2 秒轮询一次；干活时蓝点脉冲、一轮结束转绿、工具调用失败转红，空闲 9 秒后自动收起。在 Windows 上还会打开常驻置顶桌面小窗（设 DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 可关闭）。

items.de: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
items.dz: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

items.de: Mirrors other coding agents' sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable tasks, one workspace per application.
items.dz: 把本机其他 AI 编程助手的会话实时镜像成 DeepSeek Harness 的任务，每个应用一个工作区。

items.de: Mirrors other coding agents' sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable tasks, one workspace per application, with content-fingerprint deduplication.
items.dz: 把本机其他 AI 编程助手的会话实时镜像成 DeepSeek Harness 的任务，每个应用一个工作区，并按内容指纹去重。

items.dz: 换装生图：按发色、服装、配件、表情生成人物形象图并存进本地画廊。对接任意 OpenAI 兼容的图片接口，同时能查到拼好的提示词与后端状态。需要图片接口的 API Key：默认走硅基流动（Qwen/Qwen-Image），在插件配置里填 baseUrl、model 与 apiKey。

items.de: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

items.de: Scan installed Windows apps and launch them from a sidebar launcher above the settings icon.
items.dz: 扫描本机已安装的 Windows 应用，在侧边栏设置图标上方提供一键启动。

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 请求审批、或向你提问时响一声“叮”，人不在窗口前也能立刻察觉。

items.de: Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/dia
items.dz: 为 DSH 的每一次提权审批弹窗加一份由模型生成的注释：这段代码做什么、模型想达成什么、风险多大以及原因、每个选项意味着什么；并提供 /dsh-approval/history 历史授权查询（可搜索、可筛选、记录当时选了什么）与 /dsh-approval/diag 诊断页。

items.de: Graph-first permission preflight for DSH. The model declares a computation graph whose nodes state the semantic operation (download what to where, write what, delete what); the user approves nodes one at a time in a side panel, one approval covers one successful execution, and each node keeps an aud

items.de: Reads a Windows app's window list, UI text and single-window pixels without screen capture, focus stealing or cursor movement.
items.dz: 读取 Windows 应用的窗口列表、界面文本与单窗口像素，不截屏、不抢焦点、不动鼠标。

items.de: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests session

items.de: Select-all cleanup for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: deletes the session log, projection cache, workspace accounting and archive marker, cascades subagent logs, and can also remove unreferenced attachments, the request-image cache, the workspace files a Session wrote and leftovers of already-d

items.de: Validates every tool call against that tool's own parameters schema before it runs, and denies with the exact path and type. The host renders a tool's parameters into the prompt but never checks a call against them, so a wrong-typed value reaches the tool body: a number lands in path.join and the ca
items.dz: 在工具真正执行前，用这个工具自己的 parameters 校验入参，被拒时给出精确的字段路径与类型。宿主只把 parameters 渲染进 prompt，从不按它校验调用，所以类型错误的值会一路走到工具体内：一个数字进了 path.join，调用方拿到的是一句原始 TypeError 而不是回答。本插件挂在 tools/pre-execute 上，取出工具定义， 返回 deny，reason 形如「demo_tool.dir: expected string, got number (123)」。覆盖原始类型与联合类型、 required、enum/const、嵌套 properties、数组

items.de: Controls an existing aria2 JSON-RPC service from DSH with four tools: submit a single HTTP/HTTPS link (optional directory, filename, checksum, per-task proxy), read one task, list tasks, and pause/resume/cancel. A task it submitted that finishes or fails reports back to the session that started it.
items.dz: 连接已有的 aria2 JSON-RPC 服务，提供四个工具：提交单文件直链（可选保存目录、文件名、校验和、任务级代理）、读任务状态、列任务、暂停/恢复/取消；由它提交的任务完成或失败时，回报给发起它的会话。设置页保存主机、端口、密钥与超时，并带一个不保存配置、不创建任务的连接测试；不自带、不启动、不管理 aria2。创建与控制下载仅在完全访问模式（非计划模式）下可用。

items.de: Drives the open-source ArtCraft studio suite (17 apps including PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and PdfCraft) from DeepSeek Harness: agent tools, a same-origin HTTP API, a bundled craft skill pack, and plugins-page status with self-update. The ArtCraft apps are not bundled: install them separately so the plug
items.dz: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动开源创作套件 ArtCraft（含 PhotoCraft、FilmCraft、PdfCraft 等 17 个应用）：提供代理工具、同源 HTTP API、内置 craft 技能包，以及插件页状态与自更新。不含 ArtCraft 应用本体：需另行安装各应用，插件通过自动探测、artcraft.config.json 或 PATH 找到它们的 CLI。

items.de: Article Review page in DSH's native right sidebar: turns Markdown, Word, PowerPoint and PDF articles into sentence-addressable text, lets you comment on any sentence, and hands the open review to the agent as a composer draft. Six agent tools let the model read every comment, revise the article (in
items.dz: 在 DSH 原生右侧栏做逐句文稿批注：把 Markdown、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 变成可按句点选的文本，给任意一句写意见，并把待处理批注作为草稿交给 Agent。6 个 Agent 工具让模型读取每条意见、改稿（Markdown 直接改原文件，二进制格式写同名 .revised.md）、勾销批注，并把反复出现的表达偏好记入长期写作风格记忆、注入之后的提示。DOCX/PPTX 为零依赖解析；PDF 文本提取在本机走宿主 Python + pypdf（或 poppler 的 pdftotext），两者都没有时 PDF 不可用。不联网、无遥测。

items.de: Sidebar artifact shelf that collects the images, videos, files and links sessions deliver, deduplicated by SHA-256 content hash, with five filter tabs and counts, keyword search, video thumbnails, a lightbox, manual link saving, image paste, upload up to 25 MB, one-time backfill of past session logs
