items.de: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file
items.dz: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

items.de: Keeps a turn from closing on an unfinished reply: a stream guard turns silent truncation into an in-step retry, and a completion protocol asks the model to declare how each turn ended.
items.dz: 避免轮次停在「话没说完」或「只写了下一步计划」上关闭：把静默截断的流转成同一步内可重试的失败，并要求模型在每轮结束时声明收尾方式。

items.de: Prepares files before read, read_image and the vision tools open them: downscales images over 2048 px or 8 MB (one retry at 1280 px within the same turn), converts BMP/TIFF to PNG, relabels mislabeled uploads by sniffing their bytes, and turns docx/xlsx/pptx, text-layer PDF, csv/tsv and html into Ma
items.dz: 在 read、read_image 与 vision_* 打开文件之前先处理：长边超 2048 像素或体积超 8 MB 的图降采样（同一轮可降到 1280 再试一次），BMP/TIFF 转 PNG，按字节纠正标错的上传类型，并把 docx/xlsx/pptx、有文字层的 PDF、csv/tsv 与 html 转成 Markdown，不依赖任何外部程序。

items.de: Per-turn reasoning-effort routing that keeps the current provider/model: judges each user message (retry or correction, explicit intent, length, code blocks, errors, task scope) and sets reasoningEffort to a level the model actually declares, so Magpie and other OpenAI-compatible models work too. Sh
items.dz: 按每轮任务自动调节思考强度：判定用户消息（重试或纠正、显式意图、长度、代码块、报错、任务范围）后，从模型真正声明的 effort 列表中选择并设置 reasoningEffort，不切换 provider/model，喜鹊（Magpie）等第三方模型同样生效；输入框旁提供档位胶囊、自动/手动切换与会话内判定记录。

items.de: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact
items.dz: 每日 AI 三报：抓取 10 个信源（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Hugging Face、arXiv、Hacker News 等），语义聚类去重，程序打分加 LLM 打分，每天定时把选出的三条发到邮箱，并附「事实／为什么重要／影响／存疑」四段解读；另提供 4 个对话工具与侧边栏面板，用于预览、立即发送和改配置。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to export.arxiv.org

items.de: Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.
items.dz: 在 DSH 每次注册新工作区时自动 git init 并补一个空提交；已在工作树内的目录会被跳过。

items.de: Automatically resumes active goal sessions after DSH restart; long-running tasks continue without a manual nudge.
items.dz: DSH 重启后自动续跑有活跃目标的会话,无需人工说「继续」。

items.de: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running w
items.dz: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

items.de: A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as proj
items.dz: 延续 simon300000/dsh-auto 的 DSH WebUI 自动审批权限档位：每次审批只走一次单轮模型审查、不再起审查子代理，只自动放行审查通过的动作、其余全部转回人工审批；并会把用户确认过的决定记成项目级与全局级的允许/拒绝名单，右侧栏另有审批时间线。

items.de: Keeps the Auto permission preset across DSH restarts: the auto-review unload migration no longer rewrites a live Auto Session to Full access during application shutdown, and a stored Auto Session no longer fails to open when its integration is absent.
items.dz: 让「自动审批」熬过重启：应用退出时，自动审查的卸载迁移不再把在用的自动审批会话改写成「完全权限」；集成缺席时，存留的自动审批会话也不会打不开。

items.de: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
items.dz: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

items.de: Retry failed model requests automatically: intercepts every request error and replays the same step after a 2s / 5s / 10s / 20s backoff ladder, so gateway blips and rate limits no longer end the turn.
items.dz: 模型请求失败自动重试：拦截每一次请求错误，按 2/5/10/20 秒的阶梯退避后重放同一个 step，中转站抖动与限流不再中断整轮对话。

items.de: Adds Auto-review and Approve for me modes for DSH tool calls.
items.dz: 为 DSH 工具调用提供 Auto-review 和 Approve for me 模式。

items.de: Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.
items.dz: 让会话进入内置的 Auto review 权限预设：新建会话在创建时进入，已有的根会话在重新打开时切过去。

items.de: Routes model and reasoning effort per turn: a cheap classifier reads each request and picks one of five tiers, a supervisor model re-routes on tool errors and checkpoints, and upgrading to the stronger model waits for confirmation.
items.dz: 按每轮请求的实际内容选择模型与推理等级：便宜的分类模型先判档，监督模型在工具报错和检查点中途改档，升到更强模型前会先弹窗确认。

items.de: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).
items.dz: 仅 Windows：在「设置 → 通用」增加一个开关，本次对话完成后按设定延迟（默认 60 秒，可设 5–86400 秒）自动关机，并弹出原生倒计时窗口，点一下即执行 shutdown /a 取消本次关机。

items.de: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job or subagent still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions
items.dz: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务或子代理（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

items.de: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home — sessions, memories, settings and the profile plugin tree — to a private git remote you own, with commits and pushes on a schedule and every failure surfaced in the DSH log.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 home 自动、带版本地备份到自己的私有 git 仓库：会话记录、记忆文件、设置与 profile 插件树都会按计划提交并推送，失败一定会在 DSH 日志里报告。

items.de: Automatic session titles for DSH: names a session from its first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt. Replaces the built-in session-title provider through a bundle patch, adds an "AI rename" entry to the session row menu with a preview dialog, and
items.dz: 给 DSH 会话自动起名：首轮问答结束后用「项目｜具体任务」命名，而不是把提问截断。通过 bundle patch 顶替内置标题 provider，在会话行「…」菜单里加「AI 重命名」（先预览再应用），设置页可改 provider/model、命名规则并查看诊断日志。49 个单元测试。

items.de: Windows-only auto-updater for DSH Desktop: checks the official update feed, downloads and SHA-512 verifies the installer, then force-closes the app via a one-shot Task Scheduler job and installs silently (automatically by default), and after restart reinstalls profile plugins and restores their pre-
items.dz: 仅限 Windows 的 DSH Desktop 自动更新：检查官方更新源，下载并校验 SHA-512 安装包，由一次性计划任务强制关闭应用后静默安装（默认自动），重启后按更新前快照重装插件、恢复设置。

items.de: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
items.dz: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

items.de: Auto-switch the DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand: flash main session switches (A), pro keeps deep reasoning and delegates image reading to a vision subagent (B), subagents always switch, with fatal-failure fallback. No manual model switching.
items.dz: 按需自动把 DeepSeek 路由切到视觉模型：flash 主会话直接切（A），pro 保持深推理并交给视觉子代理读图（B），子代理恒切，含失败回退，无需手动切模型。

items.de: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
items.dz: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

items.de: Persistent concurrent node-graph workflows for DeepSeek Harness with agent, command, HTTP, human, fan-out/join, gate, and subworkflow nodes.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的持久化并发节点图工作流，支持 agent、命令、HTTP、人工、fan-out/join、gate 与子工作流节点。

items.de: Project-less chats for dsh: a session created without a workspace gets its own directory under ~/Documents/DSH/<date>/chat-NN, reused whenever the chat is reopened and left in Ungrouped rather than made a sidebar project; the new-session hero gains a hover clear badge and a "work without a project"
items.dz: 为 dsh 提供无项目聊天：不选工作区创建的会话会获得自己的目录（~/Documents/DSH/<日期>/chat-NN），重新打开会话时复用，并留在「未分组」而不会变成侧栏项目；新建会话的 Hero 上新增悬浮清除徽标与「不在工作区中工作」一行，另有一个仅存在于浏览器端的哨兵工作区，让该 Hero 及其输入框保持可用。

items.de: Compress every idle session's context at a fixed time each morning on DeepSeek Harness: a daily run (08:30 by default), a catch-up run on the next launch after a missed slot, and a /compact-all command for on-demand compaction, with per-session outcomes reported.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 上按固定时间压缩所有空闲会话的上下文：默认每天 08:30 自动执行，错过时间点在下次启动时补做，也可用 /compact-all 命令随时手动压缩，并逐会话报告结果。

items.de: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.
items.dz: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

items.de: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
items.dz: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

items.de: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or interval schedule; a left-rail panel and five agent tools manage the same rule set.
items.dz: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

items.de: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the origina
items.dz: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。一点须知：DSH 桌面端每次启动都会往自己的 profile 里写一份新的身份 cookie，旧的不清理；攒多了会让下一次启动报 HTTP 431 与 Error: desktop welcome: Web authentic

items.de: Creates, runs and monitors persistent research experiment loops from the DSH Web UI.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面创建、运行和监控可持久化的研究实验循环。

items.de: Starts DSH at Windows logon by writing HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, and removes exactly that value when the plugin is disabled or uninstalled. 84 lines, no daemon, no background process, no service — the entry is written through execFileSync so a spaced install path stays quot
items.dz: 写 HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run 让 DSH 在 Windows 登录时启动，插件被关闭或卸载时精确移除那一条。84 行，没有守护进程、没有后台进程、不装服务；通过 execFileSync 写入，安装路径含空格时仍保留引号，登录时确实能拉起。

items.de: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
items.dz: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

items.de: Stops compaction summaries and session titles from burning their output budget on reasoning, by lowering the thinking level and raising the token floor for auxiliary calls only.
items.dz: 辅助调用降级：压缩摘要与会话标题不再被高思考档烧光输出预算，主循环完全不受影响。

items.de: A floating VRM avatar with tool-driven expressions and VRMA animations, plus model and motion asset management.
items.dz: 常驻界面的 VRM 数字人，支持通过工具控制表情与 VRMA 动作，并提供模型和动作资产管理。

items.de: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar foot, directly above the account avatar. The row shows the top-up balance plus any bonus, turns amber with a warning mark below an adjustable threshold and green above it, and refreshes when a task finishes.
items.dz: 在侧边栏底部、账号头像正上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。整行显示充值余额（含赠金），低于可调阈值时变黄并显示告警标记，高于为绿色；任务结束后自动刷新。

items.de: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it at; includes presets, a playback bar with pause and sentence skipping, tone and speed controls, and one-click launching of that service.
items.dz: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并可用系统语音或你自己指定的本地 TTS 服务朗读回复；含预设、带暂停与上下句的播放控制条、语气与语速调节，以及一键启动该服务。

items.de: Startup animation picker with three bundled DeepSeek, Codex and Claude Code themes, local MP4/WebM imports and an in-app community library; optional first-screen install and restore on supported Windows DSH NEXT builds.
items.dz: 启动动画选择器，内置DeepSeek、Codex和Claude Code三套主题，支持本地MP4/WebM导入和插件内社区动画库；已支持的Windows DSH NEXT构建可选安装和恢复首屏兼容层。

items.de: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换字体的插件：99 个界面字体 + 31 个代码字。

items.de: Ultra-lean coding preset for DSH that eliminates orchestration overhead and pre-action chatter for surgical edits and fast tool execution.
items.dz: 专为日常编码打造的极简预设插件：消除编排开销与前置报幕废话，专注外科手术式精准修改与高效工具执行。

items.de: Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件配置，发现并预检 MCP 服务器与斜杠命令，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需启用注册。

items.de: Replace the DSH solid background with a local image, with a draggable editor for fit, blur, veil and interface opacity.
items.dz: 用本地图片替换 DSH 的纯色背景，并提供可拖动面板来调整铺满方式、模糊、遮罩和界面不透明度。

items.de: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the previous turn, and the next step boundary commits that held summary as a checkpoint with zero model calls, so the swap itself takes millisec
items.dz: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact \[消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘要模型，以及连续失败多少次后停止后台生成（熔断打开后按冷却放行一次探针以自愈）。子代理会话、前缀已变动或摘要过期时，回退到内置的同步压缩路径。

items.de: Six switchable background palettes, a custom image, or any solid color for DeepSeek Harness, with adjustable opacity and a dedicated Background settings page.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六套可切换背景、自定义图片或任意纯色，可调节不透明度，并注册为独立的「背景」设置页。

items.de: Back up and restore the whole $DSH_HOME: one-click or scheduled ZIP archives (optional password encryption applies to manual and agent-made backups only; scheduled ones are not encrypted), a settings section, agent tools to create, list, restore and prune backups, and a standalone restorer (Windows
items.dz: 备份与恢复整个 $DSH_HOME：支持一键或定时生成 ZIP 归档（可选密码加密，仅限手动与智能体发起的备份，定时备份不加密）、提供设置页、给智能体的创建/列出/恢复/清理备份工具，并附带无需安装 DSH 也能运行的独立恢复器（Windows .bat 或 POSIX .sh）。

items.de: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
items.dz: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

items.de: A simulated search engine page in the DSH sidebar that queries the local web search API and lists the top 10 results.
items.dz: DSH 侧栏里的模拟搜索页：调用本地搜索接口，列出前 10 条结果。

items.de: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service for file search, file metadata, and storage quota. Requires Baidu account authorization after installation.
items.dz: 百度网盘 MCP 插件，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索网盘文件、查看文件信息和查询容量。安装后需授权百度账号。

items.de: Bailian (DashScope / Model Studio) model catalog in the DSH settings page: lists every model the configured API key can reach, groups them by model family, probes whether a model is actually callable (an unopened model answers 403, which DSH reports as an invalid key), refuses to add models that fai
items.dz: DSH 设置页里的百炼（DashScope / Model Studio）模型目录：列出当前 API Key 可用的全部模型、按模型家族分组，可探测某模型是否真的可调用（未开通会返回 403，而 DSH 会把它显示成密钥无效），探测不通过的模型拒绝加入配置，并显示当前会话的上下文窗口与剩余额度。百炼 sk- Key 没有余额接口，因此这里的额度指上下文额度。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).
items.dz: 把白嫖渠道模型按倍率分成三条 1M 降级链，另加自定义链；按实测吞吐排序，低于吞吐线或错误率过高的模型不进链，账号到期优先并轮流。需 OpenAI 兼容网关（默认 :8326）。
