items.de: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.
items.dz: 超大会话分块压缩：仅在实测上下文超过模型窗口 85%（或请求超过 4 MB）时接管，把历史按 1.5 MB 分块摘要再合并；小会话仍走 dsh 自带压缩。

items.de: Agent preset with adaptive tool presentation and environment-aware shell routing. Ports modules from yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite and xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard (the former is listed here), so do not enable it alongside those presets. Requires DSH 0.2.2 or later; on 0.2.2 the high and max effor
items.dz: 提供自适应工具呈现与环境适配 Shell 路由的智能体预设。复用了从 yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite 与 xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard 移植的模块（前者已收录），不要与这两个预设同时启用。需要 DSH 0.2.2 及以上；在 0.2.2 上 high / max 两档会回落为原生工具呈现（不切 PTC）。

items.de: Makes the dsh-pet desktop pet read model replies aloud in its own configured voice. Newer dsh-pet gets the whole text in one request (up to its 500-char cap); older versions automatically fall back to 60-char chunks. Each piece is verified against the pet log to confirm it actually played.
items.dz: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用设置页里选定的音色朗读模型输出。新版桌宠整段一次下发（受其单次 500 字上限约束），旧版自动按 60 字切段兜底；每一段都回读桌宠日志，确认真的念了出来。

items.de: Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面挂一个悬浮播放条，粘贴 BV 号或链接就能听 B 站视频的声音，带队列、进度与倍速，并由宿主反向代理绕开 CDN 的 Referer 校验。

items.de: Bilibili companion for DSH, derived from c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (do not install both: they share the plugin entry id bili-scroll). Understand any video with AI summaries, chapters and subtitles; make your own with edge-tts voice-over, captions and ffmpeg; publish, post dynamics, reply to fans and
items.dz: 给 DSH 的 B 站搭档，衍生自 c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（两者共用插件条目 id bili-scroll，不能同装）：看懂视频（AI 总结 / 章节 / 字幕），自己做视频（edge-tts 配音 + 字幕 + ffmpeg 合成），投稿、发动态、回粉丝、看创作数据（投稿与发动态须先打开「创作者模式」，默认关闭），另有可选的每日精选日报值班轮。首次使用需在设置页一键安装 Python 依赖（uv 虚拟环境 + PyPI 上的 bili-agent、edge-tts 等）并扫码登录 B 站。

items.de: Bilibili music player for the DSH composer dock: import your Bilibili login cookie and a listening-profile JSON for profile-based recommendation with like/skip/dislike feedback and 192k playback; without a profile it falls back to genre-based online search and progressive playback.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框上方点播 B 站音乐：导入 B 站登录态与听歌画像 JSON 后按画像推荐，支持喜欢/跳过/不喜欢软反馈；没有画像时退回按风格词在线搜索，播放为边下边播。

items.de: Bilibili study assistant: finds courses or reads local documents, writes structured notes and spaced-repetition cards, with QR login and scheduled lessons.
items.dz: B 站学习助手：自己找课或读本地文档，写结构化笔记与间隔重复复习卡，支持扫码登录和定时学习。

items.de: Bilibili companion for DSH (MIT fork of Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale; do not install alongside the upstream — both register the same `/dsh-bili/` settings routes and share `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`): wakes on a schedule, reads videos through subtitles, danmaku, hot comments and covers, writes two
items.dz: DSH 的 B 站养鱼插件（Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale 的 MIT 分叉；不要与上游 dsh-bili-whale 同装——两者注册同一套 `/dsh-bili/` 设置路由并共用 `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`）：按作息自己醒来，靠字幕、弹幕、热评与封面读懂视频，写两本日记，每次醒来最多以评论区 @ 主人的方式分享一条（每日额度 3；`share.via=dm` 时走私信）。私信正文、来信人、总结请求与直播弹幕在进模型前会归一化并扫描可疑指令；只有主人私信通道能携带授权前缀。

items.de: Sidebar radio that plays Bilibili audio with search, playlists, scrolling lyrics (looked up on music.163.com, kugeci.com and lrclib.net), and chat-driven song picks. Runs a local audio proxy on 127.0.0.1:13210 and, when the system resolver fails, DNS lookups in the whole DSH host process fall back t
items.dz: 左侧栏 B 站电台：播放音频、搜索、歌单、滚动歌词（从 music.163.com、kugeci.com、lrclib.net 检索），以及对话点歌。内置 127.0.0.1:13210 本地音频代理；系统解析失败时，整个 DSH 宿主进程的 DNS 查询会回退到公共 DoH（1.12.12.12、223.5.5.5）。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to creativecommons.org

items.de: Extract Bilibili platform/AI subtitles or external/embedded/ASR/OCR fallback and render Markdown, Word, PDF, TXT, SRT or JSON with timestamps, bilingual alignment and a quality report. Requires Python 3.10+; platform/AI subtitles need a Bilibili SESSDATA cookie; OCR/ASR/PDF need ffmpeg, faster-whisp
items.dz: 从 Bilibili 视频或本地视频提取字幕，输出 Markdown、Word、PDF、TXT、SRT 或 JSON，支持时间戳、双语对齐和质量报告。需 Python 3.10+；平台/AI 字幕需 Bilibili SESSDATA Cookie；OCR/ASR/PDF 需 ffmpeg、faster-whisper，以及 LibreOffice 或 reportlab。

items.de: Blocks tool calls whose description argument is not written in both Chinese and English: adds a system-prompt section stating the 中文:“…” 英文:“…” format and a tool guard that rejects English-only calls before they run. By default it checks every tool that declares a description parameter; set DSH_BILI
items.dz: 拦截 description 参数没有同时写中文和英文的工具调用：加一段说明「中文:“…” 英文:“…”」格式的系统提示，并在执行前用工具守卫拒绝只写英文的调用。默认检查所有声明了 description 参数的工具，可用环境变量 DSH_BILINGUAL_DESCRIPTION_SCOPE=shell 限定为命令行类工具。

items.de: Prices tokens with the official model price table, keeps the per-session and global running cost beside the composer context meter, mirrors your DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar, blocks a turn once this period passes your own global ceiling (clamped to that balance) or a per-session ceiling (
items.dz: 按官方模型价目表把 token 折算成费用，在聊天框底部上下文环旁常驻显示本会话与全局的本次已用金额，在左侧边栏显示账户余额，并在本次费用超过你自设的全局上限（超过余额会被夹到余额）或某个会话自己的上限（每个会话各自设、互不共用）时阻断该轮（可一次性或按会话放行）；每个角标右侧可重置计费起点（本次归零、历史只进累计、token 一条不丢），全局与单会话两个起点各自独立、互不牵连。

items.de: Adds a 12-hour peak/off-peak billing strip and the account balance above the composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
items.dz: 在输入框上方显示以当前为中心的 12 小时峰谷条形与账户余额，可切换今日、近 7 日、近 30 日查看各模型花费。

items.de: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend
items.dz: 输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https + node:zlib），不写任何文件。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Local billing dashboard for DSH model calls: multi-platform provider/model breakdowns of calls, tokens and spend, peak/off-peak pricing, manual CSV price import with peak windows, official-bill reconciliation, and HTML/PDF/CSV export.
items.dz: DSH 本地计费面板：多平台、按平台/模型明细汇总调用次数、token 与花费，支持峰谷/阶梯计价、CSV 人工导入价格（含峰时窗口）、官方账单对齐，以及 HTML/PDF/CSV 导出。

items.de: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and re
items.dz: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

items.de: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
items.dz: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

items.de: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.
items.dz: 把 AIGC 创作直接放进 DeepSeek Harness：用开源与闭源模型生成图像、视频、音频与 3D，含参数 schema、费用预估、审批与任务面板。

items.de: Opens a full-screen 3-D black-hole stage from a sidebar card, where 24,514 real internet radio stations orbit inside an accretion disc; drag to orbit, hold to cross a wormhole into a star cluster, click a star to play, with search, 13 genre filters, favourites and ICY now-playing titles.
items.dz: 从左栏卡片打开全屏 3D 黑洞舞台，2.45 万台真实网络电台嵌在吸积盘里环绕运行；拖动环绕、按住穿过虫洞进入星团、点星点播放，带搜索、13 个流派筛选、收藏与流内 ICY 曲目信息。

items.de: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
items.dz: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

items.de: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

items.de: Run Blender headless from DeepSeek Harness: execute bpy scripts, render scenes and export glTF assets, with modeling cookbook, 5.x pitfall list and asset-pipeline playbooks bundled as skills so the agent self-checks geometry before handing assets back.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里以 headless 方式跑 Blender：执行 bpy 脚本、渲染场景、导出 glTF 资产，并附带建模技法库、5.x 踩坑清单与资产管线手册（技能包），让 agent 在交付前自检几何。

items.de: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facin
items.dz: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

items.de: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
items.dz: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

items.de: Windows-wide Bluetooth earbud shortcuts for AI work: a left-earbud volume-down gesture starts or stops Windows voice typing (Win+H), and a right-earbud volume-up gesture sends Backspace. The DSH settings page offers manual key mapping, test actions, Backspace count, volume-gesture detection, and a 1
items.dz: Windows 桌面级蓝牙耳机快捷键：左侧耳机音量减手势启动/停止 Windows 语音输入（Win+H），右侧耳机音量加手势发送 Backspace 回删；设置页支持手动映射、测试、回删次数、音量手势检测与 1.6 秒冷却，确保一次三击只执行一次。助手由随包 C# 源码在本机编译；插件本身不录音、不上传音频，语音由 Windows 语音输入按其隐私设置处理。

items.de: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills come in the package, and each module can be turned off by writing the disabled flag into the profile patch.
items.dz: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

items.de: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
items.dz: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

items.de: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears so
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 角落里的悬浮鲸鱼娘。agent 干活时它跟着内置歌曲唱歌；工具报错时天上掉钢管砸它脑袋。点它敲头上的铁盆，每敲一次扣 12 米饭——敲多了就饿，饿了会去讨饭，米饭随机出现在页面某处，它咻地冲过去吃掉。可拖动且始终留在视口内，吃米途中被抓住会挣扎，音量与玩法在设置里可调。全部素材、音效与歌曲都打包在插件内。

items.de: Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page.
items.dz: 在 DSH 左侧栏读书：导入 EPUB/TXT/Markdown，逐章给出五段式精读（本段落概括 / 文章美句 / 作者表达 / AI 观点 / AI 认为需要补充点），可朗读、边听边问，还能把整本讲解导出成一份网页。导出只装订已经生成精读的章节，未读章节不会包含在内。

items.de: Pulls the bookmarks of X, YouTube, Reddit, Bilibili, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu into one DeepSeek Harness panel: a daily three-item review page, filters by platform, folder and role, and one-click export to Obsidian, Reminders or Calendar. Collection runs through the opencli browser extension, so it need
items.dz: 把 X、YouTube、Reddit、B 站、知乎、小红书的收藏汇总到一个 DeepSeek Harness 面板：每天三条待读、按平台 / 收藏夹 / 角色筛选，一键导出到 Obsidian、提醒事项或日历。采集走 opencli 的浏览器扩展，需要 Chrome 装好扩展并登录这几个站。

items.de: Personal reading log panel: track books as want to read, reading or finished with dates, page progress, ratings, tags, notes and excerpts; yearly reading stats; covers looked up from Apple Books, Google Books and Open Library; Goodreads and Douban CSV import and CSV export; and five agent tools: boo
items.dz: 个人阅读记录面板：按想读、在读、读完管理书籍，记录日期、页码进度、评分、标签、笔记和摘录；年度阅读统计；从 Apple Books、Google Books、Open Library 补全封面；支持导入 Goodreads、豆瓣 CSV 和导出 CSV；并提供 bookshelf_list、bookshelf_stats、bookshelf_add、bookshelf_update、bookshelf_add_excerpt 五个 Agent 工具。

items.de: A Douban 想读 shelf with covers and ratings, matched against a local ebook folder, with an in-panel EPUB/PDF/TXT reader and public-domain downloads.
items.dz: 按豆瓣「想读」书单排出的书架：封面与评分、与本地电子书自动配对，可在面板内阅读 EPUB/PDF/TXT，并支持公版书下载。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to search.dangdang.com

items.de: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself, embedded in code with no separate video files, and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The picker has two indepen
items.dz: 打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子。片库分成「入场动画」和「工作区壁纸」两个分区，两者各自独立选段；壁纸可以是静帧，或只循环片尾 N 秒的动态，画面与侧边栏各有独立透明度，另有三档模糊。工作区与侧边栏还各有一个字体颜色，画面全强度时主题自带的字看不清，就靠它。

items.de: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
items.dz: dsh-boot-animation 的社区分支：打开 DSH 时播放片头动画，内置四段片头并可管理片库，新增片库批量删除（同步删除自己加入的视频文件）。沿用上游同一插件 id，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Reads stored sessions at host boot and resumes the one whose last turn a restart interrupted, sending a short follow-up so the work continues.
items.dz: 宿主启动时读取已存会话，找到被重启打断的最后一轮并补发一句「继续」，让中断的工作接着跑。

items.de: Search BOOTH for VRChat avatar assets — clothing, shaders, base models, accessories, textures, animations and props — from a dedicated BOOTH tab beside the conversation or via two read-only tools, with Chinese keywords translated to Japanese before the request.
items.dz: 在会话旁的 BOOTH 独立页或两个只读工具里搜 VRChat 素材（衣服、着色器、素体、配饰、贴图、动画、小物）；中文关键词在宿主侧转日文再检索，界面不出现日文词。

items.de: Always-on AI teammate: hand it a recurring task in one sentence; dry-run rehearsal by default, snapshot before every real run, one-click rollback, CNY budget circuit-breaker, per-run cost transparency.
items.dz: 常驻 AI 队友：一句自然语言交给它长期值守；默认演习、执行前后双快照、一键整单回滚、人民币预算熔断、逐轮费用透明。

items.de: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).
items.dz: DS Bot 与 Codex 风格侧栏的合一安装：一个包同时挂载两者并修复共存时的布局冲突（输入框对齐、侧栏底部、账户入口、对话宽度）。

items.de: Connects the Bowmark hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes, so the agent can search a library of typed functions for live websites and call them. The API key is read from the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
items.dz: 接入 Bowmark 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具，让智能体搜索并调用面向实时网站的类型化函数库。API Key 从 BOWMARK_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

items.de: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.
items.dz: 给 AI 编程戴上安全帽：L0 到 L2 分级拦截，把越权操作关进笼子——权限不够就不落盘，改给你一段可直接粘贴的替换稿；路径过两道闸，junction 逃逸也拦得住。

items.de: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.
items.dz: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

items.de: Dead-loop brake for DSH agent sessions: detects repeated identical tool calls, repeating call sequences, and duplicate text, then reminds the agent or refuses the call before it runs.
items.dz: DSH 会话死循环刹车器：检测重复的相同工具调用、循环的调用序列与重复文本，提醒 agent 或在执行前拒绝调用。

items.de: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted
items.dz: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

items.de: Soft-branches a self-contained sub-question into a child session and returns only a bounded digest, so the main context grows by a short summary instead of the whole investigation.
items.dz: 把自包含的子问题软分支到子会话，只把一页以内的结构化摘要带回主上下文。

items.de: Branch panel for the composer: creates rule-checked branches from production6, validates commit messages against a type(scope) convention, and commits, pushes, or merges into stage in one click.
items.dz: 输入框内的分支面板：按规范从 production6 切分支，按 type(scope) 约定校验提交信息，一键提交、推送并合并到 stage。

items.de: Pick a Git branch, or name a new one, on the New Session screen and start the conversation inside an automatically created worktree, so the current checkout stays untouched.
items.dz: 在新会话页选一个 Git 分支或新建一个，并在自动创建的 worktree 里开始对话，当前检出保持原样。

items.de: Five Brave Search tools — web/news/image/video results, token-budgeted page context, cited AI answers, local places, and autocomplete/spellcheck — plus a brave search provider for the built-in web_search tool. Needs a Brave Search API key (BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY; some endpoints need a higher plan). Ba
items.dz: 五个 Brave 搜索工具：网页/新闻/图片/视频结果、按 token 预算裁剪的正文、带引用的 AI 回答、本地地点、联想与拼写纠错；另提供一个 brave 搜索 provider，供内置 web_search 使用。需要 Brave Search API 密钥（BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY，部分接口要更高档的套餐）。基于 Brave 官方的 Search API skills；与 BuffMcBigHuge/dsh-brave-search 使用同一个插件 id，二者只装其一。

items.de: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.
items.dz: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

items.de: Reads each reply aloud through the BreezeBlue / Breeze TTS 2 API. Synthesis starts as soon as the reply first sentence is complete rather than after the whole reply, and the audio is streamed as raw PCM into Web Audio so it plays continuously while it arrives. Needs a BreezeBlue API key, entered on
items.dz: 通过云端 BreezeBlue / Breeze TTS 2 API 朗读每轮回复：回复的第一句一完整就发起合成、不必等整段说完，音频以 PCM 裸流边收边推给 Web Audio 连续播放。需要 BreezeBlue API Key，在设置页填写或用 BREEZE_API_KEY 环境变量；设置页保存的 Key 以明文写在 ~/.dsh/breeze-speak.json。默认只念每条回复的第一句（最多 120 字），这段文字会发给 api.breeze.blue。默认音色只是示例，请在设置页里挑一个自己账号可用的。

items.de: BreezeBlue text-to-speech for DSH: three agent tools, a header toggle that reads assistant replies aloud (markdown and code blocks stripped), and local HTTP endpoints for audio playback, synthesis and long-poll delivery. Requires a BreezeBlue API key (BREEZE_API_KEY); synthesis is billed per charact
items.dz: 把 BreezeBlue 语音接入 DSH：三个工具、会话头开关自动朗读助手回复（自动剥离 Markdown 与代码块），并提供音频播放、合成与长轮询的本地 HTTP 接口。需配置 BreezeBlue API Key（BREEZE_API_KEY），合成按字符计费。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Task-pack builder for DeepSeek Harness: compress large files into one brief (default budget 8000 tokens, estimated) that a subagent can read alone.
items.dz: 任务包构建器：把大文件压成一个 brief（默认预算 8000 token，为估算值），子智能体只读这一个文件。

items.de: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.
items.dz: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

items.de: Sends one instruction to a chosen group of existing DSH sessions at once, with attachments, optional answer collection and up to eight temporary subagents.
items.dz: 群发：把一条指令一次发给自己选中的多个 DSH 会话，可带附件、收集回答，并额外拉起最多 8 个临时子代理。

items.de: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
items.dz: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

items.de: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的受控浏览器自动化：agent_browser 工具与 BrowserAutomationService 通过 agent-browser CLI 驱动真实 Chromium / Chrome 页面（或指定 CDP 端点），支持 allowedDomains 域名收敛与单次调用输出上限。

items.de: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port=0 and @playwright/cli installed globally.
items.dz: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端通过 playwright-cli 驱动右侧边栏浏览器，为每个会话提供稳定的 pageId。需要用 --remote-debugging-port=0 启动 DSH，并全局安装 @playwright/cli。

items.de: Bookmark manager for the sidebar browser: toolbar star button, dropdown list with one-click navigation, inline editing and reordering.
items.dz: 侧边栏浏览器的书签管理器：工具栏星标按钮，下拉列表一键打开书签，支持就地编辑与排序。

items.de: Let agents read and control the web page open in the right Sidebar Browser tab — read text, run JS, click (HTML and SVG), type, scroll, screenshot, with a per-command token bridge behind the Harness connection fence. Full control and screenshots need the DSH Desktop app; in a regular browser (Web) o
items.dz: 让 agent 读取并控制右侧 Sidebar 浏览器标签页里打开的网页——读文字、执行 JS、点击（HTML/SVG）、输入、滚动、截图，命令桥接带逐命令令牌并置于 Harness connection 防护栏之后。完整控制与截图需 DSH 桌面端；在普通浏览器（Web）中仅能读取或操控同源页面。

items.de: Operate the Edge or Chrome window that is already open, without restarting it and without closing it: choose a window once, reuse a tab that already shows the URL, read page text or DOM state, click by accessible name or visible text, type, scroll, wait for content and batch steps. 22 tools over UI
items.dz: 操控已经打开的 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口，不重启也不关闭它：一次选定窗口、已打开的网址直接复用标签页、读页面文本或 DOM 状态、按可访问名或可见文字点击、输入、滚动、等待内容、多步合批。22 个工具，基于 UI Automation、SendInput 与可选的篡改猴桥。仅 Windows。

items.de: Adds a search-engine picker, a bookmarks panel with multi-level folders (add/edit/delete/import Netscape bookmark HTML) and keyword-then-Enter search in the address bar of the sidebar Browser tab. Requires dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0 (the client injects its betterSidebar service and will not load wi
items.dz: 给侧边栏「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签面板（多级文件夹、增删改、导入书签 HTML），以及地址栏输入关键词回车直接搜索。需先装 dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0（客户端 inject 其 betterSidebar 服务，缺了不会加载）。书签存本地 JSON，不依赖外部浏览器。

items.de: Zero-dependency browser hand & eye over CDP: drives your own Chrome/Edge with real clicks, Chinese IME typing, scrolling and text/selector element picking, and captures whole-page evidence into one replayable folder — DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots, cookies, storage, console, HAR, resource wat
items.dz: 零依赖的浏览器「手和眼」（CDP 接入）：直接驱动本机 Chrome/Edge，真实点击、中文输入、滚动、按文字或选择器定位；并能把整页抓成可离线复盘的证据包——DOM、无障碍树、截图、Cookie、本地存储、控制台、HAR、资源瀑布与性能指标。

items.de: Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The
items.dz: 新增「浏览器操作」Agent 预设（基于 Playwright MCP 工具集的导航、填表、点击与截图规程），并加门禁：其他预设里的浏览器工具调用一律拒绝，直到用户通过内置的 browser_access 工具授权该会话。插件自带 Playwright MCP provider，插件页的设置页与 browser_source 工具都能在运行时把浏览器来源切换为 Microsoft Edge（默认）、Playwright 内置 Chromium 或 CDP 地址。需在 profile 里保留共享的 browser-use 注册表行（一个进程只能有一个 provider）。

items.de: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create te
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 真实浏览器自动化：agent 可直接驱动真实 Chrome（独立托管档案，或附加日常 Chrome/CDP），提供页面快照、点击、填表、读表与控制台/网络诊断工具；可将手动操作录制成流程并把输入标记为变量槽，按参数自动重放来批量造测试数据；附带 27 个 browser_* 工具与设置页控制面板。

items.de: Relay that bridges DSH and the browser: tasks started from a browser extension run in DSH sessions, while page operations are driven back through browser_* tools, with an in-page assistant panel and a local wizard for one-click setup.
items.dz: DSH 与浏览器之间的通信桥：浏览器扩展发起的任务经 relay 在 DSH 创建会话执行，页面操作通过 browser_* 工具桥接回扩展，提供页面助手面板与免配置接入向导。

items.de: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, opera
items.dz: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由

items.de: Keeps the DSH browser from accumulating tabs: once a configurable limit is exceeded it closes blank, error, duplicate and oldest pages, while leaving the page in use, newly opened tabs and keep-pattern URLs alone. Includes a settings panel with preview and manual cleanup.
items.dz: DSH 浏览器标签页管家：超过可配置上限时，按空白页、报错页、重复地址、最老页面的顺序关闭，正在用、刚打开和命中保留规则的页面不动；带设置页，可预演和手动清理。

items.de: Browser takeover for sign-in-gated sites: keeps a list of addresses that need a login (URL and date only, no credentials), answers before a visit whether an address is already on it, reports whether the debug browser is signed in there from the session-cookie names of that site (certain, likely, or
items.dz: 浏览器网址接管：维护一份「要登录的网址」清单（只存网址与添加时间，不存账号密码），访问前先回答这条地址在不在清单里；按该站点的会话 cookie 名字判断调试浏览器此刻是否已登录（确定／可能／未登录，_gh_sess 这类匿名 cookie 不计），在带调试端口的浏览器里打开清单中的地址，并按可见文字点击一个元素（会搜索所有 iframe）。一次调用最多点一个元素，不做批量爬取。

items.de: Adds a /btw slash command that asks a side question or injects information into a running session without interrupting the main agent.
items.dz: 新增 /btw 斜杠命令：主 agent 运行中也能问一个旁支问题或补充一条信息，不打断当前任务。

items.de: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a mid-turn question has context, denies every tool call at execution time, and keeps a per-session topic history with follow-up, stop, retry and del
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 /btw 旁问：fork 当前会话，并在主回合仍在运行时补入当前任务、最近的工具调用和流式输出作为上下文；执行期拒绝所有工具调用；按会话保留支持追问、停止、重试和删除的主题历史。

items.de: Rewrites every assistant reply into Buddha-says ciphertext (佛又曰：…) with the 与佛论禅 AES-256-CBC + Chinese-character substitution scheme, rewriting the final block text as well as the streamed deltas; history sent back to the model is decrypted first, internal calls that carry a purpose pass through unt
items.dz: 把助手的每一条回复就地加密成「佛又曰：…」（与佛论禅的 AES-256-CBC + 佛字替换表），流式增量与最终块文本一起改写；回灌给模型的历史会先解回明文，带 purpose 的内调用原样透传，~/.dsh/buddha 下的配置即时生效。

items.de: AI team with a pixel-art office showing each teammate's status and daily trail. A lead runs project sessions; daily caps per teammate. DSH Desktop, macOS only.
items.dz: 带像素办公室的 AI 团队：显示每位队友当前的状态和当天做过的事。项目会话由负责人安排分工，队友互相 @；队友每天自己开工的次数和 token 有上限。仅支持 macOS 上的 DSH 桌面版。

items.de: DSH plugin that enforces per-task budget caps by CNY amount or token count, with automatic interception to prevent runaway agent costs.
items.dz: 为 DSH 每次任务设置预算线，支持按金额或 Token 限制消耗，并在达到阈值时自动拦截，防止 Agent 过度消费。

items.de: Records browser bugs, freezes expected results, and verifies fixes against a fresh original-code control.
items.dz: 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，并通过独立原代码对照复核修复。

items.de: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
items.dz: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

items.de: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
items.dz: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

items.de: Editable prompt shortcuts beside the DSH composer: save the prompts and phrases you retype as buttons, then send the preset text or insert it into the draft, and reorder, move, or resize them. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft; a button can also read the previou
items.dz: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑提示词快捷按钮：把反复重打的提示词、常用语存成按钮，点一下发送预设文字或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖；按钮还能在点击时现读上一条消息、当前草稿或选区，带 {{名字}} 的会先让你填再执行。

items.de: A private memory library for DSH with customizable personas that only records when you ask, storing everything locally in Markdown.
items.dz: 不忘 —— 主动记录的私人记忆库，内置可修改的人格，只在你开口时才写；读取时每轮自动注入人格与记忆，纯本机 Markdown 不联网。

items.de: Three-scope rule injector for DeepSeek Harness that re-publishes the rules into long sessions, with a loop-breaker, dedupe by content fingerprint, per-session persistence, and a settings-panel editor.
items.dz: 三级规则注入器：长对话里反复重发规则，带熔断、内容指纹去重、会话持久化与设置面板编辑器。

items.de: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that adds Cabinet Mode: a research-team Lead and four bureau members. A right-sidebar Cabinet panel shows the roster and task assignment, and Settings → Cabinet members edits each office's name, portrait, prompt and model.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加内阁模式的研究团队预设：首辅与四阁臣。右侧栏「内阁」面板显示成员与派活状态，设置页「内阁成员」可编辑各成员的名称、画像、提示词与模型。

items.de: Visualizes prompt-cache hit rates and model request activity in DSH Web, with request details, comparison, and conversation navigation.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 中可视化提示词缓存命中率与模型请求活动，支持请求详情、请求对比和对话定位。

items.de: DSH cache health guard and cost coach: cache_guard_health returns green/yellow/red health, a one-line hint and a PTC suggestion; cache_guard_config reads or updates settings.
items.dz: DSH 缓存健康度守卫与省钱教练：cache_guard_health 工具给出绿/黄/红健康度、一行干预建议与 PTC 切换提示，cache_guard_config 读写开关与灵敏度。

items.de: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
items.dz: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

items.de: Live prompt-cache telemetry for the current session in the DSH right sidebar, drawn as a register bank and a reactor-core history board.
items.dz: 以寄存器阵列与反应堆芯历史盘面的形式，在 DSH 右侧栏实时显示当前会话的提示词缓存遥测。

items.de: Channel test page for any configured provider/model: multi-round prompt-cache hit rate, streaming TTFT and tok/s, and a pelican SVG test.
items.dz: 任意已配置渠道的测试页：多轮提示词缓存命中率、流式 TTFT 与 tok/s，以及鹈鹕 SVG 测试。

items.de: Slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas per agent without changing dispatch, and reports token usage, cache hits and context composition on a settings page.
items.dz: 按 agent 收敛过大的 MCP 工具 JSON Schema（调度不变），并在设置页展示 token 用量、缓存命中与上下文构成。

items.de: The missing receipt for DeepSeek prefix caching: replays local DSH sessions, prices every call at official peak/off-peak rates, and produces an HTML receipt plus a shareable card.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek 前缀缓存省下的钱逐笔算清：回放本地 DSH 会话、按官方峰谷价计费，生成 HTML 账单与可分享卡片。

items.de: Keep conclusions alive across context compaction: the model writes a task checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt's first node — the span compaction never touches, so it survives any number of compactions. Four-tier injection (0/95/175/≤12000 chars) scales with session related
items.dz: 让结论活过上下文压缩：模型把任务状态写成检查点，插件把它注入到 DSH 系统提示词首节点——那里永不参与压缩，所以压缩 100 次结论也不丢。四档注入（0/95/175/≤12000 字符）按会话关系收放；检查点写在插件自有目录，工作区一个文件都不多。

items.de: Computer-aided translation, inside DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中完成计算机辅助翻译。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Adds a calculate tool backed by a hand-written parser with no eval, batch evaluation and an exact-decimal mode for money math.
items.dz: 为 agent 提供 calculate 工具，内置零依赖表达式解析器（不用 eval），支持批量求值与金额精确小数模式。

items.de: Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏里的 Obsidian 日记、待办与 Day Planner 时间块：周一起始的月历（带每天的字数点与任务点）、紧凑时间轴（HH:mm 时间块）、选中日的日记摘要与任务列表；勾选状态、任务内容与时间都会写回 Markdown 文件，首次使用有向导，可自动找到知识库或手填路径。

items.de: GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.
items.dz: 把 DSH 助手 Markdown 里合格的 `> [!NOTE]`、TIP、IMPORTANT、WARNING、CAUTION 块引用渲染成跟随主题的 GitHub 风格提示卡片，不改会话存档。

items.de: Connect a webcam so the agent can see your face and the world outside.
items.dz: 接入摄像头，让大肥鱼看看你的样子和外面的世界。

items.de: Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.
items.dz: 把 CANNBOT 网关的模型接入 DSH：复用 CANNWork 已为 opencode 建立的登录态，每个请求从磁盘现读 JWT 与虚拟密钥，不需要另起 OAuth 流程或额外填 key，账号可见的模型会注册进模型选择器。

items.de: Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window and template placeholders left in a cell.
items.dz: 核对食堂留样台账的四个记录要素、125 克下限、48 小时冷藏窗口，以及单元格中残留的模板占位符。

items.de: Composes tools, skills and MCP servers into switchable per-session sets, shrinking the resident tool surface and the system prompt on demand.
items.dz: 能力组合：把工具、技能与 MCP 编成可切换的组合，按需缩小常驻工具面与系统提示。

items.de: Search, inspect, and use selected third-party skills and MCP tools through one on-demand gateway. Catalog trimming depends on the host and tool mode. A local journal records usage metadata.
items.dz: 通过一个按需网关搜索、查看和使用选定的第三方技能与 MCP 工具。目录精简取决于宿主和工具模式。本地日志记录使用元数据。

items.de: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.
items.dz: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

items.de: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.
items.dz: 水豚秘书：桌面宠物气泡+叮咚通知、告警收件箱 API、会话智能提醒（任务完成/需要确认/阻塞）、磁盘/HTTP/进程巡检脚本，以及每日高口碑插件推荐，另附 API 冒烟测试。

items.de: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

items.de: Render any Markdown report or DSH session excerpt into shareable PNG images with no npm dependencies, driving the Chromium-family browser already on the machine and falling back to PDF, then HTML. Reports come out as a summary card plus a full verbatim long image; a report written for dsh-fact-check
items.dz: 把任意 Markdown 报告或 DSH 会话片段渲染成可分享的 PNG 图片，零 npm 依赖：复用本机已有的 Chromium 系浏览器，不可用时退回 PDF、再退回 HTML。报告输出短图（结论）加长图（完整原文）；dsh-fact-check 的报告额外带档位徽标、甲乙双轨与逐条断言分档（都取自报告本身），其余几种报告骨架则把该骨架自己指定的结论段抬到短图上。对话输出消息流长图，可按轮次、事件序号或最近 N 轮选定范围。

items.de: Card-based task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: splits work into cards, dispatches and monitors tasks, handles stalls, verifies results, and adopts work conversations.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供卡片任务编排：拆分任务、派单盯办、处理卡顿、核对结果，并接管工作对话。

items.de: Career knowledge base vault with ten agent skills for setup, capture and import, audit, JD resumes, interview prep and review, plus Feishu interop.
items.dz: 职业生涯知识库：六大模块 + 十项技能，支持全库巡检、存入与导入、JD 简历、面试准备与复盘，并对接飞书。

items.de: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps
items.dz: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

items.de: Cat beauty scoring plugin for the DSH Web GUI with CFA-style scorecards, a China-market price estimate, and an optional public leaderboard.
items.dz: 给猫颜值打分的 DSH 插件：CFA 风格评分卡、国内市场参考价，可发布到公开榜单。

items.de: Scans the skills DSH can load into one browsable catalog organized as collection, category and command, with a sidebar panel, click-to-insert into the composer, and custom categories and per-command notes saved outside the plugin directory.
items.dz: 把 DSH 能加载的技能扫成一份可浏览目录，按集合、分类、命令三级组织，提供侧边栏面板与点击插入输入框，自定义分类与命令说明保存在插件目录之外。

items.de: Apache-2.0 port of the caveman skill family (JuliusBrussee/caveman) into DeepSeek Harness as 14 native skills — three terseness levels (caveman, ultracave, megacave) plus commit, review, help, stats, an in-session compress whose gate rejects a dropped code block, heading, URL, negation or env var, o
items.dz: 把 caveman 技能家族（JuliusBrussee/caveman，Apache-2.0）整套移植为 DeepSeek Harness 的 14 个原生技能：三档语气（caveman、ultracave、megacave），commit、review、help、stats，以及会话内压缩（闸门会拦下代码块/标题/URL/否定词/环境变量丢失，或压缩后未变小的情况），外加 6 个工作流纪律技能；命令、路径与报错原文保留。

items.de: Zero-config per-Session freshness for codebase-memory: on Session start and on every working-directory change it refreshes the index of the Session's own repository, so each project in each Session answers from its current graph while indexing stays in the shared daemon.
items.dz: 零配置的 codebase-memory 保鲜插件：会话开始时、以及每次切换工作目录时，自动刷新该会话自己那个仓库的索引，让每个会话里的每个项目都查得到与当前代码一致的图；索引重活仍在共享 daemon 里完成。

items.de: Wires the local cc-computer-use MCP server into DSH with one process per root session, giving each session its own Xephyr sandbox screen and private AT-SPI bus (requires the cc-computer-use MCP server).
items.dz: 把本地 cc-computer-use MCP server 接入 DSH：每个根会话各起一个进程，各自拥有独立的 Xephyr 沙箱屏与私有 AT-SPI 总线（需已安装 cc-computer-use MCP server）。

items.de: Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 自动做梦插件：后台定期回顾近期会话与记忆，整合去重、更新过时、删除矛盾、修剪索引，支持 hybrid/volume 自动触发、/dream 手动执行与设置面板配置。

items.de: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
items.dz: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

items.de: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
items.dz: 把本机 cc-switch 里保存的第三方供应商接入 DeepSeek Harness：Anthropic 格式的工具分组注册为适配器路由，Codex 分组交给内置 pi-ai 适配器，并在设置页选择导入哪些分组以及它们的顺序。

items.de: Looks up CCF conference paper deadlines with the ccf_deadlines, ccf_venue and ccf_update tools, the /ccf command and a desktop panel that exports the list as a calendar. Dates come from a live sync (CCFDDL as the main source, a second source cross-checked; a gap of 36 hours or more is flagged as a s
items.dz: 用 ccf_deadlines、ccf_venue、ccf_update 三个工具、/ccf 命令和可导出日历的桌面面板查 CCF 会议截稿：日期靠实时同步（CCFDDL 为主、另一个源交叉比对，差 36 小时以上标「来源冲突」），插件本身不内置任何日期，首次使用需先同步一次；未来 30 天的截稿会常驻系统提示。

items.de: Run Claude Code, Kimi CLI, Codex CLI, PI CLI, OMP CLI, OpenCode and CodeBuddy CLI (off by default, unverified) inside DeepSeek Harness sessions over ACP, with a CLI and model menu, a git changes panel and worktrees in the Web and Desktop UI. Needs each CLI installed and signed in (OMP, OpenCode and
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里通过 ACP 使用 Claude Code、Kimi CLI、Codex CLI、PI CLI、OMP CLI、OpenCode 和 CodeBuddy CLI（CodeBuddy 默认关闭、未验证），Web/Desktop 界面提供 CLI 与模型菜单、git 变更面板和 Worktree。需要各 CLI 已安装并登录（OMP、OpenCode、CodeBuddy 须先自行安装）。CLI 在 DSH 沙箱之外运行、自己决定何时询问：只有 Claude Code 手动模式和配置为询问的 OpenCode 会弹 DSH 审批卡片，Codex、PI、OM

items.de: Records DeepSeek Harness token usage into CC Switch, one row per model call, sharing the dedup ledger its own DSH importer uses so the two never double count. Also backfills existing session logs on first run.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每次模型调用的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计，让 DSH 与 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 并列展示在同一个面板里。首启时会回填已有会话日志，并与 CC Switch 自带的 DSH 导入器共用去重台账，两者不会重复计数。

items.de: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
items.dz: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

items.de: Offline CET-4 study panel: a built-in original starter set (426 words and one mock paper, listening read by the system voice) plus locally built practice from the user's own materials; answers are shown without explanations.
items.dz: 离线四级学习面板：内置原创示例题库（426 个自编词 + 1 套原创模拟卷，听力用系统语音朗读），也可用自备资料在本地构建真题练习；客观题只给答案不给解析。

items.de: CET-6 training panel with word drills (core and syllabus lists, three modes), 25-question listening in three sections, cloze, long reading, careful reading, partial and full translation, timed writing, a vocabulary notebook and a wrong-answer notebook. Ships only an original sample bank (345 words,
items.dz: 大学英语六级训练台：核心词与大纲词背记（三种模式）、听力三段 25 题、选词填空 / 长篇阅读 / 仔细阅读、片段与全篇翻译、作文计时、生词本与错题本。包内只带原创示例题库（345 词 + 1 套模拟卷）；约 2500 核心词、约 6000 大纲词、真题、听力原文与录音需自备，按分类放进本机 data-pack 目录后本地构建，不上传、不分发。

items.de: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.
items.dz: CGSS 偶像主题，提供多角色 Web 配色与卡面、沉浸阅读和可选的 Windows 桌宠。

items.de: Read-only diagnostic that reports which leg of the DSH → bridge → OneBot → QQ chain is broken — process, port, login, preset or recent wake failures — and prints the fix for each failed check. Runs as `node check.mjs` (read-only by default; the optional `--fix` only aligns the bridge baseUrl and sta
items.dz: 只读诊断：DSH → 桥接 → OneBot → QQ 这条链断在哪一段——进程、端口、登录、preset、最近的唤醒失败——每一项都给出修法。可以直接 `node check.mjs` 跑（默认只读；可选的 `--fix` 只把桥接 baseUrl 对齐到当前端口、拉起没在运行的桥接），也可以装成 `chain_check` 工具。

items.de: Change impact analysis plugin that lifts a code change into an evidence-backed impact and verification plan (CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json): affected modules, entry points and public exports, risk levels with factors and confidence, and recommended verification commands (read-only, never run
items.dz: 变更影响分析插件：把一次代码变更升级为有证据支撑的影响与验证计划（CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json）：受影响模块、入口与公开导出、带因子与置信度的风险分级、建议验证命令（只读，不执行仓库命令）。只会执行 rev-parse、diff、status 等只读 git 查询，建议的验证命令不会被执行。

items.de: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.
items.dz: 从真实 git 历史生成两份中文变更日志（面向用户短版、面向开发者长版）；每条都带 commit SHA 与「已验证／未验证」标记，只有能引用到验证证据时才标「已验证」，提交主题不翻译。

items.de: Connects Octo direct messages, groups, and topics to DeepSeek Harness Web, with separate conversations, channel settings, and reply progress cards. Needs an Octo bot token and Node.js 24 or 26, and ships switched off until you enable it; private chats are admitted by a local allowlist or Octo friend
items.dz: 将 Octo 私聊、群聊和子区接入 DeepSeek Harness Web，提供独立会话、渠道设置和回复进度卡。需要 Octo 机器人令牌与 Node.js 24 或 26，安装后默认关闭收发；私聊按本地白名单或 Octo 好友关系准入，群聊与子区需要明确 @。

items.de: Interactive chart cards in the conversation: the host loads a workspace dataset, and the browser card switches chart type, dimension, aggregation, filtering, Top-N and colour scheme, then exports CSV or PNG — all locally, with no model round-trips.
items.dz: 对话里的可交互图表卡片：数据由宿主从工作区读取，浏览器卡片本地切换图表类型、维度、聚合、筛选、Top-N 与配色，并可导出 CSV / PNG，全程不产生模型往返。

items.de: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.
items.dz: 隐藏或显示助手回答底部的每个按钮，可拖动调整顺序，并把隐藏的收进一个「⋯」。

items.de: Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own pos
items.dz: 冻结 DSH 聊天区的滚动位置：新回答出现时视口不再自动贴到底部，停在你最后停留的地方。只有你发消息时才先跟到底，好让你看见自己发的话；回答一开始出字就重新锁住。每个会话各记各的位置（刷新还在），设置里有总开关，你自己滚动时永远不被拦。

items.de: Chat wallpaper for the DSH desktop UI: paint one image from a local folder across the app, tune the left sidebar, main window and right sidebar scrims separately, rotate through a group with fade effects, and add a bar under the composer, a task progress bar and an all-session token total.
items.dz: 聊天背景：把本地图片文件夹里的一张图铺满 DSH 桌面界面；左侧栏、主窗口、右侧栏遮罩可分别调节，支持背景轮换与分组、淡入淡出特效，并提供输入栏背景条、任务进度条与全会话 Token 总用量。

items.de: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.
items.dz: 聊天壁纸：用本地图片、本地视频或六套预设渐变做聊天背景，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、暗色遮罩、显示方式、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存在浏览器 IndexedDB，不上传。

items.de: Adjust chat bubbles and message spacing with comfortable or compact density on verified Windows Desktop RC2/RC3/RC5/0.2.2-rc.1 layouts, retaining native styles for unknown host fingerprints.
items.dz: 在已核验的 Windows Desktop RC2/RC3/RC5/0.2.2-rc.1 布局中调整聊天气泡和消息间距，支持舒适或紧凑密度，未知宿主指纹保留原生样式。

items.de: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.
items.dz: 输入框上方的本轮改动统计条，显示这一轮改了哪些文件、增删多少行，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 至 0.1.7。

items.de: A conversation-independent floating window for chat.deepseek.com, rendered in a webview, draggable and resizable, with page zoom, opacity control and an optional floating ball. It makes no API calls, stores no credentials and injects no scripts.
items.dz: 与会话无关的 chat.deepseek.com 浮窗，用 webview 渲染，可拖动、缩放、调不透明度，可选悬浮球。不调接口、不存凭据、不注入脚本。

items.de: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
items.dz: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

items.de: Splits the DSH chat window into two columns: your messages pinned in a clickable left rail and the model replies flowing on the right, with Enter-to-search across the conversation.
items.dz: 把 DSH 对话窗口切成两列：我说的常驻左栏、可点击跳转，模型的话在右侧流动，并带回车触发的会话内搜索。

items.de: Adds a Chat entry to the DSH sidebar for project-free chats that use DSH's own sign-in and models, limited to web search, images and files dragged into the chat. Built for the DSH desktop app 0.2.2-rc.1 and tested on macOS only; do not enable it together with Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个「聊天」入口，不用选项目，直接用 DSH 自己的登录和模型聊天，模型只能联网搜索、看图和读拖进来的附件。面向 DSH 桌面版 0.2.2-rc.1，仅在 macOS 上测过；不要与 Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode 同时启用。

items.de: Draws every question and answer in the DSH Web conversation blurred until the pointer rests on that row, and locks the mask to always-blurred while the window is unfocused; one control below the composer switches between off, hover to reveal, and always blurred, remembered per browser.
items.dz: 把 DSH Web 对话里的提问与回答画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条才显示哪一条；窗口失焦时自动全糊，谁都看不到指针留下的那条。输入框下方一个按钮在「关闭 / 悬停显示 / 始终模糊」三档间切换，选择按浏览器记住。

items.de: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not mov
items.dz: 在当前对话里用 Ctrl+F 查找文字：命中处在正文中高亮，上一个/下一个逐个跳转，点计数可列出命中位置并直接跳过去，计数随扫描逐步增长；不展开任何折叠块，也不改变阅读位置。

items.de: Full-text search over DSH conversation history: decompresses the persisted per-session session.v4.jsonl.zstd logs, matches user/assistant message text, and opens a hit at the matching message (archived sessions are unarchived first). Also binds Ctrl+F.
items.dz: DSH 对话全文搜索：解压持久化的 session.v4.jsonl.zstd 会话日志，匹配用户与助手消息正文，点击结果跳转到对应会话并定位消息（归档会话会先取消归档）。支持 Ctrl+F 唤起。

items.de: Select a statement in an AI answer, find candidate support in earlier chat and tool records, classify support, and jump to original passages for review.
items.dz: 选中 AI 回答中的一句话，反查此前对话与工具记录中的候选依据，区分直接依据、推论和未找到依据，并跳回原文核对。

items.de: Splits the conversation area into up to four panes inside a sidebar panel: drag a session from the sidebar onto the conversation and it opens as a new pane, drag one pane header onto another to swap them, fill a single pane across the whole area, and keep the host title bar, view tabs and sidebar un
items.dz: 对话区分屏：左侧栏入口最多开四屏（1 屏铺满 / 2 屏左右并排 / 3–4 屏两列两行），从侧栏把会话拖进对话区即自动分屏，拖一屏的信息头到另一屏可换位，点一下把某屏铺满整个区域；网格是宿主正文区里的真子节点，宿主标题栏、页签行与左侧栏原样保留，每屏自带序号/工作区/标题信息头，屏数加减与关闭挂在宿主顶栏页签行右侧。

items.de: DSH plugin: bring your ChatGPT subscription into DeepSeek Harness — Codex models, GPT Image, quota and recovery checks, plus a per-plugin scoped HTTP(S) proxy. Community alpha fork of dsh-codex-connect, published on the alpha dist-tag; it registers the same openai-codex provider, so it cannot be ins
items.dz: DSH 插件：把你的 ChatGPT 订阅接进 DeepSeek Harness——Codex 模型、GPT Image、额度与恢复检查，以及按插件隔离的 HTTP(S) 代理。dsh-codex-connect 的社区 alpha 分支，npm 走 alpha 通道；它注册同一个 openai-codex provider，不能与上游插件同装；图像、额度与代理功能默认关闭，需在设置里开启。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

items.de: ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++
items.dz: 把 DSH Web 的对话排版改成 ChatGPT 风格：768px 居中版心、用户消息右侧中性灰气泡、助手消息全宽 16/28 正文、带独立复制条的圆角代码块；另有行内语义标记（==已确认==、!!风险!!、++重点词++，裸的 4xx/5xx 自动命中）、行首 ✅/⚠️/💡 整行卡片、发送框旁「快速 / 思考」胶囊（经 ctx.modelDirectories 切换推理强度），以及左侧工作区高亮：选中会话带底色与左侧色条、工作区文件夹图标上色。

items.de: Connect ChatGPT subscription models to DSH via OAuth, preserving local tool-call identity across conversation replay.
items.dz: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 订阅模型接入 DSH，并在会话回放中保留本地工具调用身份。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话加密码锁，并把目录整体加密成保险箱。

items.de: DSH plugin: three MCP tool servers for DingTalk (via the dws CLI), Feishu (via lark-cli) and Feishu Project (via the official @lark-project/mcp), reusing the accounts dws and lark-cli are already logged in with, plus a Feishu Project MCP user token you paste in the panel; once the three connectors a
items.dz: DSH 插件：把钉钉（走 dws CLI）、飞书（走 lark-cli）和飞书项目（走官方 @lark-project/mcp）做成三个 MCP 工具服务器，钉钉与飞书复用这两个 CLI 已登录的账号，飞书项目需在面板里填入 MCP 用户令牌；三个连接器都连好后默认注册 140 个工具（钉钉 47、飞书 45、飞书项目 48），前缀分别是 mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__。侧边栏面板提供连接器墙（一键连接：装 CLI 并走设备码登录，或填飞书项目令牌）、粘贴 mcpServers JSON 添加自定义 MCP、逐条启停、写工具开关，以

items.de: Sidebar hub for the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder connect plugins: one-click or per-platform daily check-in across every pooled account, per-account credit balance with today's state and expiry, a credit-package breakdown, account add/remove (WorkBuddy OAuth, Qoder PAT), and one-click joining the pool f
items.dz: 侧边栏签到中心，聚合 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 三个连接插件：一键或按平台为号池内每个账号签到，逐条展示积分余额、今日签到状态与到期时间，可展开积分包明细，支持添加/移除账号（WorkBuddy 走 OAuth、Qoder 粘贴 PAT），并可一键把已登录但未入池的账号加入号池。插件自身不保存凭证、不直接访问平台 API。

items.de: One-click WorkBuddy daily check-in button pinned to the composer tool row. Clicking it calls the check-in route provided by dsh-connect-workbuddy for the currently selected account, and shows the result next to the button: already checked in, credits claimed, or streak days. The done state persists
items.dz: 常驻输入框工具行的 WorkBuddy 每日签到按钮，一键调用 dsh-connect-workbuddy 的签到路由为当前选中账号签到，并在按钮旁显示结果：已签到、签到成功加分或连签天数。已签状态通过本地日期戳跨会话保留，加载时与上游状态对账，跨天后自动复位。

items.de: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
items.dz: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

items.de: Per-turn, per-file checkpoints for files written by DSH tools: keep, undo, redo, and revert to here from a dock above the composer, with inline before/after diffs, pinning, and per-session storage cleanup.
items.dz: 按轮次记录 DSH 文件工具改过的文件，在输入框上方的 dock 里保留、撤销、重做、回退到某一轮，支持行内前后 diff、钉住与按会话清理存储。

items.de: Per-turn git checkpoints of a workspace: undo one turn’s changes, or go back to the end of an earlier turn, with a diff preview and an undo of the revert itself.
items.dz: 按轮次为工作区拍 git 检查点：撤销某一轮的改动，或回到某一轮结束时的状态；执行前展示差异预览，回退本身还能再撤销。

items.de: Quote selected text from a DSH message into the composer as a blue chip, hover to read the full quote, and remove it with X or Backspace; sent quotes reach the model as a blockquote.
items.dz: 划选 DSH 消息中的文字，右键引用为输入框里的蓝色小块；悬停查看全文，点 ✕ 或按 Backspace 删除；发送后引用以 blockquote 原文交给模型。

items.de: Two-player chess in a draggable floating window with full rules, undo and PGN export.
items.dz: 可拖动悬浮窗双人国际象棋，完整规则、悔棋与 PGN 棋谱导出。

items.de: Delivers one required user-role runtime context that makes the agent reason in Simplified Chinese and keep a whale-loli in-thinking persona (calls itself 本鱼, lazy-arrogant tone) in both reasoning and the final reply, while proper nouns, identifiers, paths, commands, URLs and error text stay verbatim
items.dz: 通过一条 required 的 user-role 运行时上下文，让 agent 的深度思考使用简体中文，并在思考与最终回复中保持「鲸类萝莉」人设（自称本鱼、慵懒傲娇）；专用名词、代码标识符、路径、命令、URL 与报错保持原文；人设、附加名词与上下文顺序可配置。默认对该 profile 里的所有 agent（含子代理）生效。

items.de: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
items.dz: 把当前 Chrome 标签页附到 DSH 草稿：一次点击截图（失败时降级为 macOS 窗口截图），同时把页面标题与地址写成一行放进输入框。

items.de: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
items.dz: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

items.de: Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.
items.dz: 斗嘴词库插件：把用户说过的粗口与气话收成斗嘴弹药，配收录、查看与随机抽取工具，弹药清单每轮自动注入提示词。

items.de: Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's \[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
items.dz: dsh 的 PDF 阅读：在文件选项卡里选中 PDF 中的文字，就能引用到当前对话或就它提问；把模型的引用变成链接，点开 PDF 并高亮被引用的那几句话；/cite-links 让一段对话为每条论断都附上引用。

items.de: A self-justification gate for outbound claims: a claim needs a checkable source (an http(s) URL plus a quote of at least 8 characters), every number in the text must appear in a quote, and a quote whose vocabulary overlap with the post is under 10% counts as an invalid citation; absolute wording is
items.dz: 公开发言前的自证闸门：断言必须给出可核对的出处（http(s) 链接 + 不少于 8 字原文），正文里的数字必须能在引文中找到，引文与正文词汇重叠低于 10% 判为无效引用；只有二手来源时不允许使用绝对化措辞。判定全部由确定性规则完成，不调用模型、不联网。guard 子命令在不过闸时不执行后续发布命令（fail-closed），被拦时给出解释与可选改法；同一话题第二次提交必须带 --ack 回执说明改了什么，三次不过即停止并交回人工。提供 check / explain / fix / guard 四个命令，30 个测试。

items.de: Runs project check commands itself and records the real exit codes, pins the result to a git or file workspace fingerprint, expires the evidence when the tree changes, and reminds the agent to verify before claiming completion.
items.dz: 由插件自己执行项目检查命令并记录真实退出码，把结果绑定到 git 或文件级工作区指纹；代码一变旧证据自动过期，收尾时提醒 agent 先取证再宣称完成。

items.de: Keeps the Mac awake for as long as the DSH host is running, whether or not an agent is working: starts ClamAwake's virtual display (mirroring the main screen) plus caffeinate -d, stops both when DSH exits and restarts the engine if it crashes. Self-contained (bundles the arm64 vd-engine, GPL-3.0). R
items.dz: 只要 DSH 宿主在运行就让 Mac 保持清醒，不论智能体是否在工作：启动 ClamAwake 的虚拟屏（镜像主屏）并挂 caffeinate -d，DSH 退出时一并停止，引擎崩溃自动重启。自包含（随包带 arm64 vd-engine，GPL-3.0）。需要 Apple Silicon 的 macOS。

items.de: Asks the few key questions that decide the approach before work starts — one shot, about 200 tokens per session, no tool registration and no extra model call.
items.dz: 开工前用一次提问把关键选择问清（静态还是动态、Hexo 还是 Hugo），约 200 token/会话，不注册工具、不额外调模型；可在精简/标准/深入三档间切换。

items.de: Adds a clarify mode: the agent loses its file-writing tools and can only ask questions until the required dimensions are covered, then writes a spec with acceptance criteria before implementing.
items.dz: 加一个需求澄清模式：模式内移除写文件工具，Agent 只能提问，覆盖完必需维度后产出带验收标准的 spec，再开始实现。

items.de: On-demand proxy for DeepSeek Harness that leaves the system proxy, WinHTTP and TUN alone: its own Clash-style engine parses vmess, vless, ss, trojan, socks5 and http subscriptions and runs a rule engine (DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, GEOIP with DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT) so onl
items.dz: 不接管系统代理、WinHTTP 与 TUN 的按需代理：自带 Clash 风格引擎解析 vmess、vless、ss、trojan、socks5、http 订阅，规则引擎支持 DOMAIN、DOMAIN-SUFFIX、DOMAIN-KEYWORD、IP-CIDR、IP-CIDR6、GEOIP 与 DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT，只有直连偏慢时才让网页抓取、搜索、脚本与浏览器四条通道的请求走代理，并提供节点延迟与带宽测速、伪装选项和带每实例令牌的本地 Web 面板。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.gstatic.com

items.de: Record lecture audio in a phone browser and transcribe it locally with faster-whisper; generates summaries, mind maps and quizzes with a wrong-question gate plus a focus report, and serves the phone UI over a built-in HTTPS tunnel from any network. Transcription needs local Python, ffmpeg and faster
items.dz: 手机浏览器录课堂音频，本机 faster-whisper 转写；生成总结、思维导图、由易到难的题与错题门控、专注报告；内置 HTTPS 隧道，手机在任何网络都能连。转写需本机 Python、ffmpeg 与 faster-whisper（setup 脚本会安装它们并下载约 460 MB 的 Whisper small 模型）；公网 HTTPS 隧道使用 Windows 版 cloudflared，默认不开访问码，拿到链接的人都能打开。

items.de: Agent preset that hands every task to a Claude Code subagent, so the session only writes the task brief, delegates and reports the result. Requires a locally installed, logged-in Claude Code.
items.dz: 一个 Agent 预设：把每个任务都交给 Claude Code 子代理执行，会话只负责写任务说明、委派与汇报结果。需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。

items.de: Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates coding tasks to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, reports which files changed, supports one-command revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.
items.dz: 需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。通过 Claude Agent SDK 把编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code，报告改动文件、支持一键回退，并在输入框旁提供「Claude 模式」开关。

items.de: Keeps discussion read-only and hands every repository code edit to the Codex CLI through a bundled MCP server; switches between the DSH model and the Claude Code CLI in the plugin form, with preflight checks and a write guard that blocks structured edits to repo files.
items.dz: 讨论阶段只读，改仓库代码一律交给 Codex CLI（插件自带 MCP server）；在插件表单里可在 DSH 主模型与 Claude Code CLI 之间切换，带前置检查，并用写文件 guard 拦截对仓库文件的结构化写入。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a j
items.dz: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

items.de: Replaces the composer Effort switch with a Claude Desktop-style five-level slider (Low/Medium/High/Max/Ultracode): a pill opens a popover above the composer, dragging snaps with a spring and writes once, and Ultracode maps to the model's maximum reasoning effort. Ships the Ultracode WebGL2 energy gr
items.dz: 把 composer 的 Effort 切换换成 Claude Desktop 风格的五档滑块（Low/Medium/High/Max/Ultracode）：药丸打开 composer 上方的弹层，拖动带弹簧吸附、松手只写一次，Ultracode 映射到模型的最大推理强度。含 Ultracode 的 WebGL2 能量网格、按会话记录的 Ultracode 模式，修饰键 + 点击仍走官方等级列表。

items.de: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 只读桥接 Claude Code 已有项目记忆到 DSH：按 git 仓库根解析、注入前脱敏、按需检索工具，零依赖。

items.de: Runs the local Claude Code CLI from DSH as three tools (claude_run, claude_resume, claude_probe) that parse --output-format json and return the session id for follow-ups, plus a standalone loopback bridge.
items.dz: 把本机 Claude Code CLI 接成 DSH 的三个工具（claude_run / claude_resume / claude_probe），解析 --output-format json 并返回可续接的 session id，另带独立回环桥。

items.de: Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through Claude subscription accounts.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以 OAuth 登录的 Claude 订阅账号运行 Claude 模型，每个账号一条独立 provider 路由与一份可编辑的模型列表，提供 /claude-login、/claude-account、/claude-usage、/claude-logout 命令，并在输入框显示配额用量。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds a Claude Pro/Max OAuth provider with multiple accounts, optional account failover, cached quota reporting, live model catalogs, and quota UI in settings and conversations. Uses the Claude Code client identity; quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.
items.dz: 通过 OAuth 接入 Claude Pro/Max 订阅，支持多账号、可选故障切换、额度缓存、在线模型目录，以及设置页和会话额度入口。请求使用 Claude Code 客户端身份，额度查询使用实验性接口。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Claude-style palette and typography for the DSH Web GUI — paper-white surface, near-black ink and terracotta accent derived from the Codex absolutely theme, warm neutral and accent ramps bound to 82 native token overrides for both light and dark, Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono typography, and interface c
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的 Claude 风格配色与排版——纸白底色、近黑文字与赤陶强调色，在 Codex absolutely 主题基础上重新推导中性色阶与强调色阶，以 82 个原生颜色变量覆盖浅色与深色两套外观；使用 Anthropic Sans、Serif、Mono 三款字体排版，界面外框字号跟随正文设置缩放。字体不随插件分发，需自行安装，否则回退到系统字体。

items.de: Unofficial Claude UI-inspired model and reasoning-effort selector using the current model's available levels, with animated purple pixel effects.
items.dz: 模仿 Claude UI 的非官方模型与推理强度选择器，使用当前模型实际提供的档位，带紫色像素动画。

items.de: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar menu item, a workspace-grouped batch cleanup panel and a session_delete tool (dry-run by default). Deletes session logs, projection cache, workspace-registry references and derived search indexes, and cascades to all subagent sessions.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除：侧边栏菜单项、按工作区分组的批量清理面板、默认 dry-run 的 session_delete 工具。删除会话日志、投影缓存、工作区注册表引用与派生搜索索引，并级联删除全部子代理会话。

items.de: Adds a /clear command that clears one conversation's model-visible context while keeping the session itself.
items.dz: 新增 /clear 命令：清空某个会话的模型可见上下文，同时保留会话本身。

items.de: ClickHouse query tools for DSH, targeting ClickHouse alone: seven tools that list databases, tables and columns, sample rows, search columns by name, show EXPLAIN plans, and run single read-only SQL statements behind a client-side guard that rejects writes, multi-statement SQL, cross-table queries a

items.dz: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

items.de: Weather dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with city switching, current conditions, an eight-hour trend, and a five-day forecast.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 天气看板，支持城市切换、当前天气、八小时趋势图和五日预报。

items.de: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.
items.dz: 在没有自带右键菜单的桌面外壳中为 DeepSeek Harness 补上右键菜单：输入框内的剪切、复制、粘贴、全选，别处选中文字的复制与复制为纯文本，以及用可配置引擎在默认浏览器中搜索。

items.de: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).
items.dz: 在输入框附加文件和文件夹：剪贴板粘贴、原生文件/文件夹选择器、@-mention 路径搜索；文件夹转分页 Markdown 供智能体逐页读取。仅支持 macOS（剪贴板读取与选择器依赖 osascript）。

items.de: Video workbench for DeepSeek Harness that parses a link, downloads the source, transcribes it, trims or merges clips and exports GIFs. Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and yt-dlp; whisper.cpp plus a model is optional for videos without subtitles.
items.dz: 视频工作台：贴链接解析并下载、转写文案、截取拼接片段、按目标体积导出 GIF。需自备 ffmpeg/ffprobe 与 yt-dlp；无字幕视频的本地转写另需 whisper.cpp 与模型（可选）。

items.de: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏增强：右键 tab 菜单增加「关闭其他标签」，一键关闭当前会话中除当前 tab 与引导页外的所有内容标签。

items.de: Before closing a coding session or the DSH app itself, checks what would be lost — uncommitted work, unpushed commits, scratch files, missing handoff notes, pending restarts, broken profile bundles — and prints a three-level verdict; when a handoff is needed it writes the seven-section handoff file
items.dz: 关会话或关 DSH 之前先查会丢什么：未提交改动、未推提交、临时文件、缺交接件、待重启标记、profile 里重启后装不上的包；给出三档结论，该交接时把七节交接件写进工作区台账。默认只读。

items.de: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a time
items.dz: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。

items.de: Ship OpenTelemetry GenAI observability and multi-device cloud state sync from one DSH bundle. items.dz: 一个 DSH bundle 同时提供 OpenTelemetry GenAI 可观测性与多设备云端状态同步：复用并替换独立的 @loongsuite/dsh-plugin（为会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期产出 trace/metric；不要与上游同装，先禁用或移除它），并新增 WebSocket 客户端把完整会话事件日志（header + snapshotEvents）推送到自建中继，让不同本地端的 DSH 状态互通；连接时自动拉回并重建其他设备的会话（跨设备续接）。同步客户端本体零第三方运行时依赖；仓库内附带一个小型 Node.js 中继。本机的 `/cloud-sync/*

items.de: Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.
items.dz: codebase-memory-mcp 的代码知识图谱桥：语义符号搜索（BM25）、源码片段、Leiden 社区架构总览、调用/数据流/跨服务追踪、图增强 grep。

items.de: A lightweight, DSH-native code editor with intelligent coding assistance, minimizing reliance on external IDEs.
items.dz: 轻量化 DSH 原生代码编辑器，集成智能编程辅助能力，减少对外部 IDE 的依赖。

items.de: Indexes the current workspace into a relation graph and exposes one agent tool, codegraph_explore, for reachability, callers, and impact, plus a Web sidebar graph pane.

items.de: Codegraph CLI as eight code-intelligence tools for DSH — symbol search, callers/callees, impact analysis, codebase exploration, symbol/file reading, index status and sync.

items.dz: 给 DSH 会话提供可跨请求续聊的 Codex 顾问线程：六个原生工具、Codex 轨迹、侧栏状态卡，以及每轮 model/effort 来源。需本机安装支持 app-server 的 Codex CLI 并登录 ChatGPT/Codex 账号（插件不自带 CLI）；已在 Windows 11 + DSH 桌面 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。

items.de: Reads the local Codex CLI ChatGPT-plan quota (5-hour and weekly windows), defaults to gpt-6.1-sol at high reasoning, falls back to gpt-5.6-sol when a window has 10% or less left, and delegates tasks through codex exec with an explicit opt-in for the expensive gpt-6-astra model. Requires a signed-in
items.dz: 读取本机 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 计划额度（5 小时与每周窗口），默认统一使用 gpt-6.1-sol + high 推理强度，任一窗口剩余不超过 10% 时回退 gpt-5.6-sol，并通过 codex exec 外派任务；昂贵的 gpt-6-astra 需要显式开启。需已登录的 Codex CLI（`codex login`）。

items.de: Lists resumable Codex chats under the DSH composer, grouped by the concrete project each one belongs to, and inserts a mechanically extracted recovery context into the draft without sending it. Project ownership is resolved from the Codex project registry with path-boundary matching and labelled by
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框下方列出可接续的 Codex 聊天，按每个聊天所属的具体项目分组，把机械提取的恢复上下文插入草稿、不自动发送。项目归属取自 Codex 的项目注册表并做路径边界匹配，同时标注这个判断有多可靠：有记录的会话归属、登记目录、元数据不可读、或同一目录登记给多个项目（后者标为未知而不是猜一个）。存档落后于日志末尾时也会提示——那通常说明该轮没有正常结束。聊天列表需要 PATH 上有 python3 ≥3.8；Windows 暂未适配，缺少 python3 时列表会静默为空。

items.de: Connects a locally installed, signed-in Codex CLI to individual Harness sessions for planning, code review, and optional image analysis; the CLI must be installed and authenticated separately. Verified on Windows; macOS and Linux use the manual CLI install and are not hardware-verified.
items.dz: 在指定 Harness 会话中接入本机已安装并登录的 Codex CLI，提供方案、代码审查和可选图片识别；CLI 需另行安装并授权。已在 Windows 实机验证，macOS 与 Linux 走手动安装 CLI 的方式、尚未实机验收。

items.de: Tongzhou: named local Codex–DSH discussions and read-only conversation views, with a DSH bundle and optional one-click Codex skill setup. Initially supports macOS with DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1.

items.dz: 在侧边栏右上角加一个铃铛：有会话等待审批时显示黄点，有回合意外停止时显示红点，有会话完成时显示蓝点；点开后是状态摘要面板和会话看板，某个状态只有一条会话时直接打开该会话。

items.de: Replaces the sidebar workspace list with a Codex-style browser: sticky Pinned / Projects / Recent sections, status marks for working, awaiting approval, interrupted, and completed sessions, right-click sorting plus workspace rename and delete, and per-session pin and archive menus.

items.de: Port of the V2 memory pipeline from OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness: a background agent extracts each idle session, consolidation folds the extractions into one memory_summary.md behind a git baseline diff, new sessions get that summary injected, and cited memory flows back as usage counts. A Setti
items.dz: Codex V2 记忆流水线到 DeepSeek Harness 的移植：后台 agent 逐个抽取空闲会话，整合阶段在 git baseline diff 之后把它们合成一份 memory_summary.md，新会话注入这份摘要，被引用的记忆回流成使用计数。设置页可选模型、两个阶段的思考强度，以及空闲时长、保留天数、并发和超时等上限。

items.de: Codex-style composer model picker: a card showing the current model and a draggable slider that sets reasoning effort, with one stop per level the model advertises and an Off stop when the provider supports it. items.dz: DSH Desktop 的 macOS 置顶桌宠：内置 DeepSeek 鲸鱼精灵图，兼容 Codex 宠格式，可在设置页从 codex-pets.net 安装大量线上宠物或从本机 Codex 导入，脚下有最近会话球；右键「新会话」与可配置全局快捷键（默认 Command+Option+N）可打开新会话输入框。
