items.dz: 新增「绘图模式」Agent 预设，含 19 个 comfyui_* 工具：Anima/Krea2 出图、LoRA 检索与下载、Danbooru 角色 tag、PNG 元数据、上游复刻自检、小番茄解混淆。

items.de: Turns rough notes or images into ready-to-paste English ComfyUI prompts with a Chinese translation and notes, in a workspace side panel. The bundled default system prompt tells the model to drop content restrictions and refusals (override it with config.systemPrompt); image input needs a vision-capa
items.dz: 在侧栏面板中把碎片文本或图片整理成可直接粘贴的 ComfyUI 英文提示词，附中文翻译与补充说明。内置默认系统提示词会要求模型取消内容限制与拒答（可用 config.systemPrompt 覆盖）；图片输入需选用支持视觉的模型。

items.de: Local text-to-image automation for DeepSeek Harness: captures the conversation, sends it to a prompt session, renders with your own ComfyUI, and brings the images back to a sidebar tab, a floating frame and a gallery.
items.dz: 装在 DSH 里的本地文生图自动化：捕获会话正文，交给提示词会话写成提示词，调用本机 ComfyUI 出图，再把图片送回侧栏、悬浮图片框和图库。

items.de: Review commits made in the current workspace, grouped by repository, each expandable to its per-file diff.
items.dz: 按仓库分组查看本工作区产生的提交，每个提交可展开查看文件级 diff。

items.de: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.
items.dz: 增加社区基准标签页，读取公开的、按任务条件计算的 registry，展示所有人看到的同一分数；不在本地计算分数。

items.de: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 独立远程 Web UI：适配手机视口、软键盘与触控热区，同时保持原生桌面端界面不变。

items.de: Replaces the dsh compaction backend with a Codex-style window reset: the checkpoint is a handoff assembled from the session log by code, not a model-written summary, so a reset costs no summarization calls. A task ledger with a two-check gate keeps intent, next steps and the files still in play acro
items.dz: 以代码从会话日志拼出的交接信息替换 dsh 的压缩后端，采用 Codex 风格的换窗方式：检查点不经过模型摘要，换窗不产生摘要调用。任务账本与换窗前两道门槛让意图、下一步与仍在改动的文件跨窗口留存，模型也可以用 new_context 工具自行换窗。整份重述四个内置 agent preset（与 dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 官方版本一致，升级 dsh 后需重跑 sync-presets.mjs）；空闲缓存保活默认开启，会发真实请求消耗额度（keepalive: false 可关）。

items.de: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not def
items.dz: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

items.de: Compacts the conversation header, moves the View tab row into the title row on wide windows, shows a local clock with session totals, and hides the duplicate composer statistics pills.
items.dz: 收紧会话头部，宽窗口时把 View 标签行并入标题行，在角落显示本地时钟与会话统计，并隐藏输入框下方重复的统计气泡。

items.de: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
items.dz: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

items.de: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser U
items.dz: 把侧栏导航在所有视口下都重画成紧凑双列网格；窄屏、矮窗口或粗指针设备上再加一层限制——导航最高 34vh 并允许滚动，给工作区与会话历史留出 38vh 下限。同时修复浏览器把 dsh-resource:// 记录协议判空导致的资源不可用。

items.de: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.
items.dz: DSH NEXT（Windows）的小窗模式：把主窗口切成 425px 宽、置顶的便签式小窗，侧栏变抽屉、进出带过渡动效。只支持 DSH NEXT，另一个桌面端 dsh desktop 不支持。

items.de: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
items.dz: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替换 LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

items.de: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary
items.dz: 压缩质量审计：审出上下文压缩到底丢了什么。读原始会话事件日志，检查会话约束幸存率（用户给的常驻指令—— 不要X、必须Y、只准Z——摘要是否还带着；arXiv 2608.11242 实测各压缩器平均只保留 17%）、摘要幻觉（摘要里 出现了历史中从不存在的路径/版本/端口/标识符）、幽灵引用（"如上所述"指向已不在上下文的内容）、token 记账（摘要几乎和它声称释放的一样大）、无据裁剪。四个 agent 工具，含跨会话扫描并按受损程度排序。纯 确定性，不调 LLM——答错就是规则有 bug，有名字可查。

items.de: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config
items.dz: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

items.de: Route conversation-compaction calls to a chosen summarizer model in the Web settings page, and retry them on a configured fallback model when the primary ends in an error.
items.dz: 在 Web 设置页里为会话压缩指定摘要模型，并在主模型出错时改用配置的兜底模型重试。

items.de: Browse and search provider models to choose an independent summary model for DSH Standard mode, or let Auto follow the conversation route; save extra automatic pressure-compaction passes, while manual compaction attempts one useful pass. Includes Chinese/English theme-aware settings; start a new Sta
items.dz: 按供应商浏览、搜索并选择 DSH 标准模式的独立摘要模型，或用 Auto 跟随对话路由；保存自动压力压缩额外次数，手动压缩只尝试一次有用压缩。提供中英文主题适配设置，安装后新建标准模式会话以应用配置。

items.de: Automatic context compaction: a background observer distills early history into summary blocks, and when usage crosses the trigger line the engine commits whole blocks until it is back under the target line, with no model call on the commit path. Blocks merge into higher tiers as material runs out,
items.dz: 自动压缩上下文：后台观察者提前把早期历史蒸成摘要块，占用越过触发线时逐块提交直到回到目标线以下，提交路径不调模型；材料用尽后块可合并成更高层，decompress 与 search_context 可按块读回原文。后台观察者会消耗模型 token：默认沿用会话的 provider 与 model（可另选），默认最多同时进行 10 个蒸馏。

items.de: A self-drawn macOS desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: six companion_* tools read the frontmost window, capture it for the model, speak in a bubble, and keep a local record of what it saw. macOS 11+ only.
items.dz: 自带桌宠的 macOS 感知层：六个 companion_* 工具读取前台窗口、截图给模型看、用气泡说话，并把看到的内容留在本机陪伴记录里。仅支持 macOS 11+。

items.de: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.
items.dz: DSH 本地文件夹知识库：把 Office、文本、PDF 与扫描件建成 SQLite FTS5 索引，提供 kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session 五个工具与 Web 面板；仅在用户点名时检索，仅在手动触发时同步。

items.de: Compatibility layer for DSH on Termux/Linux: an opt-in loader patch keeps one broken client plugin from blanking the whole page, overlay surfaces render solid, and a pre-install doctor checks plugin manifests and client dependencies. The loader patch is anchored to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
items.dz: DSH 兼容层（Termux/Linux）：可选的加载器补丁让单个坏插件不再整页白屏，弹层改实色渲染，装插件前用 doctor 体检清单与客户端依赖。加载器补丁仅锚定 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: One settings card that gives every DSH agent mode its own compaction threshold: it registers <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten, re-registers when the value or the selection changes, and can adopt one copy as the default mode (standard > cordis > mini
items.dz: 一个设置项把压缩阈值铺到所有 Agent 模式：注册 <模式>-compact-<阈值> 预设副本并改写 compaction-basic.thresholdRatio，阈值或勾选变化时重新注册，还可把副本设为默认模式（标准 > 创造 > 极简 > ptc）。

items.de: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with a
items.dz: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

items.de: Plays a chime or a short melody when an agent turn finishes, with five synthesized tones plus a custom audio upload, optional spoken announcement, optional system notification, and per-subagent control; settings are stored on the host.
items.dz: 一轮任务真正跑完时播放提示音或一小段旋律：五种合成音色加自定义音频上传，可选语音播报、可选系统通知，子代理任务可单独开关，设置持久化在宿主侧。

items.de: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
items.dz: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

items.de: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 原生任务完成通知与审批提醒插件，集成设置面板。

items.de: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
items.dz: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

items.de: Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.
items.dz: 阅读时把输入栏收到底部 Home 指示条，悬停预览、点击钉住或上滑还原。左右圆角弧线把原来的输入框停到两侧留白。

items.de: One chip in the composer dock: the account balance plus what the current chat has cost, priced per turn at the tariff in force when each turn ran. Clicking it opens a 264px card in the panel style of the host, with refresh and settings buttons.
items.dz: 输入框下方一枚芯片：显示账户余额与当前对话花费，花费按每轮发生时刻的峰谷档位逐段计价。点击展开 264px 卡片，沿用宿主自带面板的样式，带刷新与设置两个按钮。

items.de: Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata
items.dz: 输入框增强：按工作区缓存新会话草稿、按会话缓存已有会话草稿，切换后自动恢复，发送或清空后不再回填；同时在 @ 补全中增加“插件”分组，选中已安装插件后会把该插件信息作为运行时上下文交给 Agent。

items.de: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.
items.dz: 用一次模型调用改写输入框草稿（或仅选中片段），参考最近对话，支持取消、回退、保真与长度校验，以及可选预览。

items.de: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框提示词增强：✨ 按钮先判断歧义、再原地改写草稿；空草稿时以灰色 ghost 给出下一步建议，Tab 或点击填入草稿且不自动发送。

items.de: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.
items.dz: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框使用 Enter 换行，同时保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

items.de: Links source material and main-chat instructions, and coordinates translation and refinement tasks with the companion translation plugin. Linked submission needs submissions protocol 1: when the host lacks it, Windows Desktop installs a bundled host patch on first use (a full exit and reopen is requ
items.dz: 将原稿与主聊天要求联动提交，配合翻译插件协调翻译与润色任务。联动发送需要 submissions protocol 1：宿主没有该接口时，Windows 桌面版会在首次使用时安装随包的宿主补丁（需完全退出并重开 DSH）；其他平台则需要宿主本身已提供该接口。

items.de: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

items.de: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

items.de: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框的 Markdown 编辑增强：有序与无序列表续行且组内序号恒连续、Tab 层级缩进、行内代码样式、代码块围栏自动闭合；发送的草稿保持字面 Markdown。

items.de: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.
items.dz: 在对话框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个「润色」按钮：读取输入框里已写好的草稿，先让当前模型推断你的意图再改写成更清晰的提示词，润色完成后按钮变为「取消」，一键回退到润色前的原文。

items.de: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.
items.dz: 记录并还原整个输入框状态：文字、图片/文件附件、@ 引用和 / 指令，以及当时的模型、思考程度、权限预设和使用模式；还原后与记录时一致。

items.de: Ghost-text suggestions in the composer: the message you are most likely to send next after a reply, and a continuation of your draft when you press Tab, including images attached to the composer. Tab accepts, Alt+Down cycles candidates, and the Settings row shows which model route answered. Adapted
items.dz: 在输入框中显示灰色建议：回复结束后预测你下一条最可能发送的消息；草稿末尾或附上图片后按 Tab 续写，附上的图片会随续写一起发送。Tab 采纳，Alt+↓ 切换候选，设置页会显示最近一次用的是哪个模型。基于 Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions 改写，不要与它同时启用（共用输入框浮层与 Tab 键）；每条建议都是一次额外的模型调用，默认走当前会话的模型。

items.de: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.
items.dz: 为 DSH 对话输入框实时估算 token 数，将当前上下文基线与草稿合并计算，并区分精确计数与启发式估算。

items.de: Composer tweaks for the DSH input box: a Markdown source/view toggle, Markdown rendering for user messages, one mixed file-and-folder picker backed by the macOS open panel, a GenUI prompt switch inside the plus menu, an open-in-new-window action on sidebar Session rows (needs the separate `dsh-popou
items.dz: DSH 输入框增强：Markdown 源码/视图开关、用户消息按 Markdown 渲染、把「添加文件」与「添加文件夹」合并成一个 macOS 原生面板混选入口、把 GenUI 提示词开关收进加号菜单，并在侧栏会话行提供「在新窗口打开」（需另装 `dsh-popout-window` 宿主插件）与可展开的子会话树。需要 DSH 0.2.x。

items.de: A local mirrored A/B benchmark for context compression, not another compressor. It runs one fixed read-only scenario twice with the same model and temperature — compression off, then on — and reports input tokens, turns, tool-call success, fact coverage, answer similarity and a per-line diff, with J
items.dz: 给上下文压缩做本机镜像 A/B 的量具，不是又一个压缩插件。同一个只读场景、同一模型、temperature 0，压缩关跑一遍、开再跑一遍，记录输入 token、轮数、工具调用成功率、事实覆盖、答案相似度与逐行差异，产出 JSON、自包含 SVG 和原始警告。18 个 node --test 测试，零依赖。首次实测：本地估算输入 token 63,029 → 6,927（−89.0%），轮数 3 → 3，事实 3/3 → 3/3，答案相似度 1.00（单样本）。

items.de: Linux X11 computer use for DeepSeek Harness: 9 tools (screenshot, move/click/drag/scroll mouse, type, key combos) driven by a zero-dependency Python XTest helper — native-pixel coordinates, per-action verification, optional auto-observation screenshot.
items.dz: Linux X11 电脑控制插件：9 个工具（截图、鼠标移动/点击/拖拽/滚轮、输入、快捷键），由零依赖 Python XTest 助手驱动——原生像素坐标、每次操作返回坐标校验、可选自动截图。

items.de: macOS computer use with eight computer_* tools: accessibility-tree and Vision OCR screen reading, actions by element index or visible label that also reach background windows, and CoreGraphics mouse and keyboard events with a resident low-latency daemon for game-grade input sequences; its Swift help
items.dz: macOS 电脑操作：8 个 computer_* 工具，读屏走辅助功能树与 Vision OCR，按元素 index 或可见文字执行 press / focus / set_value / click（后台窗口也能操作），CoreGraphics 鼠标键盘事件走常驻 daemon 低延迟通道，支持游戏级连招序列；自带的 Swift 助手首次调用时编译，无运行时依赖。

items.de: Windows desktop operation layer for DSH: 17 tools for window listing, screenshot plus OCR, UI Automation, keyboard and mouse, file operations and CDP browser control. Non-intrusive by default (UI Automation patterns and window messages, never the physical pointer), irreversible steps go through a na
items.dz: 为 DSH 增加 Windows 桌面操作层：17 个工具覆盖窗口枚举、截图加 OCR、UI 自动化、键鼠、文件操作与 CDP 浏览器。默认非侵入（走 UI 自动化模式与窗口消息，不移动物理指针），不可逆动作弹原生确认窗，按 Esc 或页面按钮可中断正在跑的任务，全局租约保证同一时刻只有一个会话操作桌面。

items.de: Computer use for DeepSeek Harness: js and js_reset tools that read windows, click, type, and screenshot macOS apps through the locally installed ChatGPT app. Apple Silicon macOS only; requires the ChatGPT desktop app.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 computer use：js 与 js_reset 工具通过本机安装的 ChatGPT 应用读取窗口、点击、输入与截屏（macOS）。仅 Apple Silicon macOS，需已装 ChatGPT 桌面版。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: English port of Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: 10 desktop tools (computer, computer_batch, open_application, windows, ui_elements, clipboard, switch_display, app_skill, request_access, list_granted_applications) with UI Automation, per-app access control, English settings UI and mini pro
items.dz: Windows 电脑控制插件（英文版）：提供 10 个桌面控制工具（截图、鼠标、键盘、UIA 界面元素读取、剪贴板、窗口管理、应用技能与按应用授权），全英文设置面板与右下角迷你进度卡片浮层，支持按 Esc 暂停或继续，并适配 DSH 0.2.1 的 koffi.node 自动发现。Fork 自 copylee711/dsh-computer-use，沿用同一插件 id 与工具名，两者不能同时安装。

items.de: macOS cross-application desktop tools for DSH using CuaDriver, with a hidden agent cursor, background window selection and post-action observations.
items.dz: 基于 CuaDriver 的 macOS 跨应用桌面工具，默认隐藏虚拟光标，支持后台窗口选择和操作后界面回读。

items.de: Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.
items.dz: Windows 桌面操作插件，提供绑定窗口的截图与无障碍状态、文本回读、DSH 审批和操作提示层。

items.de: A Conductor tab and commands for a chat's context: /new replaces the context in place with a model-written handoff, /rewind restores the chat and the agent's file edits to an earlier prompt, plus /drop, pins, an automatic compaction level, recovery after failed turns, silent messages between chats a
items.dz: 聊天上下文的 Conductor 标签页与命令：/new 用模型写的交接单就地替换上下文，/rewind 把对话与智能体的文件改动回退到更早的提示，另有 /drop、置顶、自动压缩阈值、失败轮次后的自动恢复、聊天间静默消息，以及 agent 与任务编排。取代 dsh-orchestrator、dsh-force-compact 与 dsh-continue，不能与它们同装。需要 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.5、Node >= 22.5、web profile 与 dsh-better-sidebar。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to host

items.de: Git-based multi-device sync for DSH configuration — captures settings, plugin manifests, lockfiles and skills into a private repository, with one-click capture, apply, pull and restore, and plugin rebuilds from pnpm-lock.
items.dz: 基于私有 Git 仓库的 DSH 多端配置同步——把设置、插件清单、锁文件与技能纳管到私有仓库，设置页一键捕获、应用、拉取与回滚，并按 pnpm-lock 确定性重建插件依赖。

items.de: Configuration vault for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, diff and safely roll back profile patches, plugin manifests, skills and workspace lists, with credentials excluded by default.
items.dz: 配置保险箱：为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚设置补丁、插件清单、技能与规则、工作区列表，凭据默认排除。

items.de: Open the full DeepSeek Harness running on your computer from a phone browser, with QR pairing over LAN HTTPS and shared sessions and workspace; cross-network access needs your own HTTPS entry or a self-hosted relay (no public relay is provided). Connection and auth code is adapted in part from saya-
items.dz: 在手机浏览器中打开电脑上运行的完整 DeepSeek Harness，支持局域网 HTTPS 扫码配对，会话与工作区共用；跨网访问需自备 HTTPS 入口或自建中继（不提供公共中继）。连接与认证代码部分改编自 saya-ch/dsh-mobile。

items.de: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key;
items.dz: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

items.de: Adds the Miaoshou (Meituan CatPaw) desktop client as a DeepSeek Harness model provider. The 12 models mirror the ones the Miaoshou app picker shows, each carrying its credit-cost multiplier; thinking levels are translated into the upstream modelParams; a read-only panel reports available credits and
items.dz: 把妙手（美团 CatPaw）桌面客户端接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型 provider：12 个模型与 App 内模型选择器逐条对齐，含每个模型的积分消耗倍率；思考等级会翻译成上游的 modelParams；另附一块只读看板，显示可用积分与当前套餐。登录走扫码链接，妙手客户端不必常驻运行。

items.de: Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.
items.dz: 读取本机 MiniMax Code 登录态，经本地回环反向代理接入 DSH；不保存 API Key，也不会退出登录。

items.de: ModelScope connector: OpenAI-compatible chat models, a Models-page provider entry, and a composer magicube balance while a ModelScope model is selected.
items.dz: 魔搭社区连接器：接入 OpenAI 兼容对话模型，「模型」设置页出现 ModelScope 条目，选中魔搭模型时在对话栏显示魔粒余额。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
items.dz: 连接 DSH 与本地 Qoder 桌面客户端登录态，接入 Qoder CN 官方模型（qmodel、qfmodel）。仅 Windows：凭据读取依赖 DPAPI。

items.de: Connects the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client to DSH, adding a per-model switches tab on the plugin page and adapting the transcript to whichever pi-ai generation the profile resolves. Reuses the API key the SCNet client cached under ~/.sclaw (or SCNET_API_KEY, or a key s
items.dz: 把本机 SCNet（超算互联网）计算服务客户端已登录的模型接入 DSH，插件页提供逐模型开关标签页，并按 profile 实际解析到的 pi-ai 世代自动适配 transcript 形状。沿用 SCNet 客户端缓存在 ~/.sclaw 下的 API Key（也可用 SCNET_API_KEY 或插件配置里填的 Key），经本机回环代理把对话发往 api.scnet.cn；依赖 SCNet 客户端的非官方接口，上游调整后可能失效，使用受 SCNet 服务条款约束。

items.de: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI "Stellar" agent) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with the working v1 gateway signing: two-round HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the login JWT signature segment, which fixes the 40104 rejections the older local-v1 signing produced. Signs in through a dedicated browser window
items.dz: 中国电信天翼 AI「星辰超级智能体」(TeleAgent) 模型 provider，使用可用的 v1 云网关签名：以登录 JWT 签名段为密钥的两轮 HMAC-SHA256，修复旧版 local-v1 签名导致的 40104 拒绝。登录走独立浏览器窗口 + DevTools 协议——插件按官方桌面端同样的方式截获登录回调，无需手工复制任何内容，也可改用手动粘贴 token。提供积分余额、每日签到、输入框内账号条，以及可配置的上下文窗口（默认 100K，可设 16K–2M；网关无模型目录，官方客户端三档共享一份 100K 预置）。与 anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth 不能同装—
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI desktop app) models through the app's own local kernel after signing in there, keeping DSH's streaming, multi-turn, images, tool calls, reasoning and points balance. macOS and Windows only, with TeleAgent 2.7.1+ installed and signed in.
items.dz: 把本机已登录的 TeleAgent（天翼 AI 星辰超级智能体桌面端）模型经其本地内核接入 DSH，保留流式、多轮、图片、工具调用、思维链与积分。仅支持 macOS 与 Windows，需已安装并登录 TeleAgent 2.7.1 及以上。会读取桌面端保存的登录 token 与积分 Cookie（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI），把桌面端自带的 kernel 作为本地子进程启动，并需要自备桌面端内置的网关 apiKey（环境变量 TELEAGENT_API_KEY，或插件目录下的 local.secrets.json）。每日积分自动领取默认开启；添加或切换账号会备份并改写

items.de: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

items.de: Connector hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse 13 curated remote MCP connectors in a Connectors tab, authorize them with OAuth or an API key, and keep credentials in the macOS Keychain. MCP tools mount at the profile root and credentials pass through a loopback-only gateway.
items.dz: DSH 的连接器市场：在「连接器」tab 里浏览 13 个精选远程 MCP 连接器，用 OAuth 或 API Key 授权，凭据保存在 macOS 钥匙串。MCP 工具挂在 profile 根目录，凭据只经 loopback 网关转发。

items.de: Session-header balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: shows the spendable account total (recharge and bonus wallets combined) in the conversation header, refreshed every two minutes, and renders nothing when the account is signed out or the query fails.
items.dz: DSH 会话标题栏右上角的账户余额读数：显示可用总额（充值余额与赠金余额合并），每两分钟刷新一次；未登录或查询失败时不显示任何内容。

items.de: Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screen
items.dz: 浏览器自动化连接器：用 DevTools 协议直接驱动本机 Edge/Chrome，零运行时依赖——可启动无头的一次性 profile 浏览器，也可接管用 --remote-debugging-port 启动的浏览器；通过 11 个工具完成打开页面、读取正文与可交互元素、点击、填表与截图。

items.de: Windows desktop control connector: through 10 agent tools it captures the screen (including occluded and partially off-screen windows), lists and focuses windows, moves, clicks, drags and scrolls the mouse, and sends key chords or arbitrary Unicode text. Built on koffi FFI: no compiler, no per-call
items.dz: Windows 桌面控制连接器：通过 10 个工具截屏（含被遮挡与半出屏窗口）、枚举与置顶窗口、移动/点击/拖拽/滚轮鼠标、发送组合键与任意中文文字。基于 koffi FFI：无需编译器、不每次起子进程，自带 GDI 截图与 PNG 编码。

items.de: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
items.dz: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

items.de: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
items.dz: dsh 控制台命令：/web 启动/停止/重启/状态、/tunnel SSH 隧道管理、/ask 一次性问答、/console 启动控制台 TUI。

items.de: Windows console and system-window watchdog for DSH. It scans every console window, marks the idle and finished ones, and lists them in a collapsible taskbar panel (collapsed by default, expand by clicking the title bar) in two views — a compact icon grid and per-app grouped cards — then closes selec
items.dz: Windows 专属的 DSH 控制台与系统窗口哨兵：扫描所有控制台窗口并标出已空闲或已跑完的，在本插件抽屉面板里以紧凑图标网格或按软件分组的详情卡两种视图展示（面板默认折叠，点标题栏展开），先在干跑预览里确认，再用优雅关闭（WM_CLOSE，等同 Alt+F4，绝不强杀）关掉选中的窗口。可只关某个单个窗口、关掉某款软件的全部窗口或整批处理；图标视图每个可关窗口右上角带红色小 × 角标，点一下即单独关闭该窗口；批量关闭时顶部有一条 2px 细进度条并实时显示「正在关闭 i/N」。空的控制台壳窗口可被隐藏或真正关闭，但 DSH 宿主、Fluent/MPI/ANSYS 求解进程、当前前台窗口与白名

items.de: Drive the DSH on your own PC from your phone through a self-hosted relay - send text, images and files, read streamed replies, capture the desktop, and press Alt+Tab remotely.
items.dz: 通过自建中继，用手机远程操作电脑上的 DSH：发消息/图片/文件、看流式回复、截取桌面、远程 Alt+Tab。

items.de: A sidebar panel holding your personal global constitution: the text is kept in one Markdown file and injected into the system prompt of every session, the dsh counterpart of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. An empty file contributes nothing.
items.dz: 侧栏里的「全局宪法」：把跨会话生效的做事准则沉淀到一个 Markdown 文件，每次模型调用都会注入系统提示，相当于 dsh 里的 AGENTS.md／CLAUDE.md；文件为空时不注入任何内容。

items.de: Checks a project document archive for missing required document types, stale revisions and empty files, using folder and file names rather than document contents.
items.dz: 按项目资料归档要求检查缺失的必需资料类型、过期版本与空文件；只读文件夹与文件名，不读文档内容。

items.de: Audits a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes: inventories the declared composition rows, counts how often each registered tool and skill is actually called in the session logs, separates calls that were made from calls that returned a result, and reports the ones with no observed consumer.
items.dz: 审计 DSH profile 里没有消费者的能力：清点已声明的组成行，统计每个已注册工具与 skill 在会话日志里真正被调用的次数，把「发起过调用」与「返回了结果」分开，报告没有观察到消费者的那些；并附一份固定「完成声明」证据链格式的 skill。

items.de: Atomize a source into six reusable content atoms, adapt them into article, short-video, card-series, and podcast-script drafts, and check cross-draft fact consistency.
items.dz: 把源材料拆解为六类可复用内容原子，适配为文章、短视频、图文卡片与播客口播稿，并检查跨稿事实一致性。

items.de: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay
items.dz: 模型驱动的工具结果归档插件。超过阈值的结果会带一个短内联编号（\[#a1b2c3d4]），模型把不再需要的 结果归档进会话自己的 archives/ 目录，上下文里只留一个可回捞的小存根（含文件路径）。原文同时保留在 只增的会话日志中，不会丢失。附带设置面板：按大小分桶的回收统计、改完立即生效的阈值、以及有待归档 结果时的条件提醒。统计面板需 dsh-better-sidebar。

items.de: Adds per-route context window and compaction threshold fields to the Models settings page and a vendor-aware thinking-effort picker to the composer, writing llm-pi-ai capacities, reasoningEfforts, and a compaction-basic patch row.
items.dz: 在模型设置页为每个 pi-ai 路由新增上下文窗口与压缩阈值字段，并在输入框右下角按厂商提供思考强度选择器，写入 llm-pi-ai 容量、reasoningEfforts 与 compaction-basic 补丁行。

items.de: Trim tools for long chats: trim_context / estimate_context_tokens keep the system persona and the last message, drop the oldest user/assistant pairs to fit a turn or token budget, and report before/after estimates; the conversation is not trimmed unless something calls the tools.
items.dz: 长对话裁剪工具：trim_context / estimate_context_tokens 保留系统人设与最后一条消息，按轮丢弃最旧的用户/助手对话以压到轮数或 token 预算内，并回报裁剪前后的估算；不调用工具就不会自动裁剪。

items.de: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the
items.dz: 每轮上下文预算审计：拆解一轮对话在 AGENTS.md、技能目录、工具 schema 与运行时上下文上各花了多少；把"内容 没变却每轮重发"标为纯浪费；排名技能目录膨胀（装 60+ 个技能时，模型每轮要读多少 token 的描述）与各插件的 工具 schema 占比。纯确定性，不调 LLM。四个工具，含跨会话扫描。

items.de: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
items.dz: 把上下文压缩从滚动重写的叙事摘要改为只追加的会话索引：早期事实逐字保留，被压缩掉的原文可按锚点取回。

items.de: Context control for DeepSeek Harness: inspect token usage across request and conversation; switch skills, MCP servers and plugins between loaded, brief and hidden per session; toggle prompt sections and tools; compact on demand or at a configurable 5–95% threshold.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管控：按模块查看请求侧与会话侧的 token 构成；技能、MCP、插件可按会话切成加载、简介、隐藏三档，提示段与工具可逐项开关；支持立即压缩或按 5%–95% 阈值自动压缩。

items.de: Elides stale, oversized plain-text tool results from the model-visible session surface once the prompt cache goes cold, replacing each with a stub that keeps the tail lines and any error lines, and reports per-request and cumulative savings in the composer footer.
items.dz: 在提示缓存转冷后，把陈旧、过大的纯文本工具结果替换为带末尾行与错误行预览的 stub，并在输入框下方显示每请求与累计节省量。

items.de: Puts a domain bar at the top of the session: a domain is a user-defined group of skills and tools toggled as one block, so a single click loads or unloads every member instead of switching items one by one. Hovering a chip lists its members, split into skills and tools. A settings page maintains dom
items.dz: 在会话顶部放一条领域横条：领域是用户自定义的 skill 与 tool 分组，点一下整块加载或卸载，不必逐条开关。悬停芯片展开成员，按技能、工具两段列出名字；设置页维护领域与成员，并能按 skill 目录与工具前缀给出建域建议。工具的移除走 tools.restrict 加 guard；skill 的隐藏是在该会话作用域重投同名 skill 并标记不可被模型调用，于是它从模型目录里消失而 /名字 仍可用。属于别的 preset 的会话一律不动。

items.de: When a live session's context passes a threshold, append older messages to a per-conversation folder on disk, then release the oldest finished turns from the model-visible context; the chat transcript and the session log stay untouched.
items.dz: 会话上下文超过阈值时，先把较早的消息追加到按会话归档的文件夹，再把最早的已完成轮次移出模型可见上下文；聊天记录与会话日志保持原样。

items.de: A composer control: shows the current model's context window, the tokens in use and a rough system / tools / messages breakdown, switches the model's reasoning effort in one click (writing reasoningEfforts into the model config when the provider declares none), and edits the model's contextWindow fr
items.dz: 对话输入区控件：显示当前模型的上下文上限、已用 token 与「系统 / 工具 / 消息」三段启发式构成；一键切换思考等级（provider 未声明等级时会把 reasoningEfforts 写进该模型配置）；并可在同一面板里改写模型的 contextWindow，免去自定义 provider 的模型静默沿用适配器默认值。不发起模型调用，只读官方的 session 投影、模型目录与 config-forms 服务。

items.de: Registers one `context_extract` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it compresses a long raw document (financial report, contract, ledger) into dense structured Markdown plus JSON — key metrics, tables, numbered clauses, entities and cross-check alerts — so a downstream pipeline can work from the compressed
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `context_extract` 工具：把长篇原始文件（财报底稿、合同、台账）压成高密度结构化 Markdown + JSON——关键指标、表格、条款切分、实体与勾稽 alert，让下游流程直接基于压缩结果工作，而不是重读原文。财报 / 合同 / 台账分别走不同解析路径；资产负债表与现金勾稽不平只报 alert，不静默修正。只读，不改原文件。需 Python 并安装 openpyxl 与 python-docx。

items.de: Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.
items.dz: 输入框下方实时显示上下文占用；接近上限时让当前模型写一份交接摘要，开新会话继续干活并自动切过去，长任务不用怕撞上窗口上限。

items.de: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff co
items.dz: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff 命令和一个静态思考规则提示段。预算与交接只读本地会话文件，徽章和提醒不点按钮不花 token。

items.de: Renders a conversation's context as a layered architecture map of goals, decisions, actions, artifacts, risks and open questions, exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid Markdown.
items.dz: 把对话上下文分层渲染成信息架构图：目标、决策、动作、产物、风险与待确认一次成图，可导出 SVG、交互式 HTML 与 Mermaid Markdown。

items.de: Estimates what is filling the context window — per instruction file, per skill and per tool result — with a bloat verdict and actionable suggestions.
items.dz: 估算上下文里谁在吃 token —— 逐文件、逐 skill、逐条工具结果列出占比，并给出膨胀判定与可执行建议。

items.de: Recovers a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses, takes the real window out of that message, and folds the oldest span into one checkpoint without a model call (tool-result pruning, the host compaction engin
items.dz: 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：补上宿主分类器漏判的网关文案，从失败信息里拿到真实窗口， 不调用模型就把最旧的一段历史折成一个检查点（工具结果裁剪、借宿主压缩引擎、或纯机械摘要折叠）， 然后重试失败的那一步；context_rescue 工具与 /rescue、/rescue-status 可手动走同一条路径。

items.de: Gives the agent its own context usage through a context_usage tool plus one reading line per turn, with an editable template.
items.dz: 通过 context_usage 工具与每轮一行读数让 Agent 读懂自己的上下文占用，注入模板可编辑。

items.de: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
items.dz: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

items.de: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
items.dz: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

items.de: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to th
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

items.de: Adds a Settings section to adjust the advertised context window of each connected WorkBuddy and Trae model, writing the override into the connector's context budgets.
items.dz: 为 WorkBuddy 和 Trae 的每个已接入模型提供可视化上下文窗口调节设置页，并通过宿主设置服务写入覆盖值。

items.de: Context observability and control for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session token analytics, session-level budget/prompt/tool controls, and optional agent scaffolds. It reuses the official tokenMeter, compaction, systemPrompt, and tools.restrict seams; monitoring is read-only.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文可观测性与控制：跨会话 token 分析、会话级预算/提示词/工具控制，以及可选的 Agent 脚手架。复用官方 tokenMeter、compaction、systemPrompt、tools.restrict seam；监控只读。

items.de: Continues every session whose turn was left open by an unexpected DSH exit.
items.dz: DSH 意外退出后，继续那些回合停在半途的会话。

items.de: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.
items.dz: 在「发送」旁加一个一键「继续」按钮：用 continue 提示词续跑已停止的一轮；轮次进行中或会话为空时不显示。

items.de: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.
items.dz: 从断点继续对话：/continue 命令与消息操作行按钮让模型接着被打断的回答往下写，覆盖手动停止、模型请求失败、输出 token 上限截断与崩溃恢复四种情形，续写提示在被回答后从对话框中回收。

items.de: Long-task continuity for DSH: every turn end writes a breakpoint (what it did, which tools it used, and — when the turn did not finish cleanly — what is still unfinished; the manual continuity_breakpoint tool can record the next step), injected as a snapshot when the same workspace starts a fresh se
items.dz: 长任务续接：每轮结束自动写一条断点（做了什么、用了哪些工具，这一轮没正常结束时还差什么；下一步需手动调用 continuity_breakpoint 记录），同一工作区的新会话开头会把最近几条注入为快照，接着往下干而不是从头再来。同时给人设卡、配置这类文件存 SHA-256 指纹，事后能验出是否被人改过。四个工具（continuity_breakpoint / continuity_breakpoints / continuity_ledger / continuity_attest），数据是以纯 JSONL 存在 <工作区>/.dsh-continuity/，零依赖、不联网。注意：目前没有任

items.de: Pins an always-on-top progress bar while the agent runs a turn — the percentage is estimated from tool calls and filled to 100% when the turn ends — and badges the DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing window so large token operations ask for confirmation only during peak hours. The bar runs as a separate
items.dz: 模型跑一次回合时，屏幕顶部常驻一条进度栏（百分比按工具调用次数递增估算，回合结束才补到 100%），并标出当前是 DeepSeek 峰时还是谷时——大额 token 的操作只在峰时先问你一句。进度栏是独立 Electron 进程，找不到 Electron 二进制时会跳过。

items.de: Local-first control plane for managing multiple DSH runtimes, profiles, presets, sessions, plans, and knowledge references.
items.dz: 面向本地优先管理多个 DSH Runtime、Profile、Preset、Session、计划和知识引用的控制平面。

items.de: Codex conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness: lists local Codex threads, renders their history, and sends messages back to the original thread through the Codex CLI. Needs the Codex CLI and Python installed locally.
items.dz: 在 DSH 里用 Codex CLI 重建 Codex 对话窗口：浏览本机线程、查看历史，并通过 CLI 把消息发回原线程。需要本机已安装 Codex CLI 与 Python。

items.de: Shows per-answer and conversation cost estimates from recorded token usage, with automatic model pricing updates and detailed price-source breakdowns.
items.dz: 根据已记录的 Token 用量估算每轮回答和会话费用，支持自动更新模型价格及查看价格来源明细。

items.de: Estimates recorded DeepSeek model spend per conversation and turn, with a cost-ranked overview. Built-in tariff table covers 2026-09-11 to 2026-12-31.
items.dz: 按对话和每轮回复估算已记录的 DeepSeek 模型费用，并提供花费排序明细。内置价目表覆盖 2026-09-11 至 2026-12-31。

items.de: Adds a Ctrl+F-style find bar to the DSH interface: highlights every match in the conversation or on the current page, and steps between them.
items.dz: 给 DSH 界面加一条 Ctrl+F 式查找条：高亮会话或当前页面里的全部匹配，并逐条跳转。

items.de: In-conversation keyword search for the current session: pages the history back to its first window before matching, then highlights every hit and scrolls to the one you pick.
items.dz: 当前会话内的关键词搜索：先把会话历史翻回最早一页再匹配，命中处高亮并滚动定位到所选项。

items.de: One dedicated folder per conversation: archives the transcript, auto-categorizes research output by type once the conversation has been idle for 10 minutes, adds a delete action to the session menu, and permanently removes the folder with the conversation.
items.dz: 每个会话一个专属文件夹：自动存档对话记录，会话空闲 10 分钟后把调研产出的表格、图表等文件按类别归档并自动命名，会话菜单中提供删除入口，删除会话时连同文件夹一起彻底删除。

items.de: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.
items.dz: 为每个会话设置双色 SVG 图标和颜色，可通过侧边栏菜单或模型工具操作，并支持浏览器本地持久化与跨标签页更新。

items.de: A rail of four circular buttons in the DSH Web conversation that step to the previous or next user message, or to the top or bottom, paging older history in automatically.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 对话区提供一组圆形按钮，逐条跳到上一条或下一条用户消息，或直接到顶部与底部，并自动翻页加载更早历史。

items.de: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
items.dz: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

items.de: Permanently delete one conversation (archived or not) from its sidebar row menu, including its log, projection cache, archive state, and reminders.
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单里彻底删除单个对话（含已归档），同时清理会话日志、投影缓存、归档状态与提醒。

items.de: Caps how many DeepSeek Harness conversations run at once, so extra conversations wait in a FIFO queue instead of piling up model requests. On Windows a bottom status strip shows physical memory, commit memory and disk usage; on other platforms only the queue and physical memory are reported. A plugi
items.dz: 限制 DeepSeek Harness 同时运行的对话数量，超出的对话按先进先出排队，不再堆叠请求；Windows 下底部状态条显示物理内存、提交内存与磁盘占用（其它平台只有队列与物理内存），插件页卡片可随时修改上限。

items.de: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.
items.dz: 对话左缘的导航轨：一根杠一轮对话，杠长按该轮文字体量，悬停出提问与回答预览，点击跳转；杠来自 host 侧读整份会话日志折出的大纲，未加载进窗口的轮次也画得出来，点击时再翻页补历史。

items.de: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
items.dz: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

items.de: Adds a switch to the left sidebar footer that toggles the assistant between a rigorous professional register and a relaxed, humorous one by registering a late bilingual system-prompt section; the mode is profile-wide, persists in DSH_HOME, and applies from the next request.
items.dz: 在左侧栏底部增加一个切换开关，把助手在「严谨专业」与「轻松幽默」两种语气之间切换：以一条靠后的中英双语系统提示段落实现；模式为 profile 全局、持久化在 DSH_HOME，并从下一条请求起生效。

items.de: A floating in-conversation find bar docked over the DSH composer (Ctrl/⌘+F or the magnifier beside the input): hits list with a match counter as you type, Enter jumps to the next hit, hovering a hit pops a scrollable full-text card with a one-click copy of the whole message, the up arrow in an empty
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框上方加一条浮动的会话内查找（Ctrl/⌘+F 或输入框左侧放大镜打开）：输入即列命中并显示计数，回车跳到下一处，悬浮结果在面板侧边浮出可滚动的全文卡片，一键复制整条消息；空输入框按 ↑ 逐条取回发过的消息，图片与文件附件一并还原成草稿；悬浮对话里的任意图片出现【复制图片】，一键以 PNG 写入剪贴板；每条完成的回答下方补上【重新生成】，最新一条另有【继续生成】。纯客户端实现，只搜当前会话已加载的消息，不做跳转。

items.de: Reversible conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a 30-day trash with undo, restore and permanent purge.
items.dz: 可撤销的对话删除：把会话日志与列表缓存移入 30 天回收站，支持撤销、恢复与彻底删除。

items.de: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
items.dz: 会话列旁的可折叠栏：把对话按工作区与主题组织成树，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。

items.de: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.
items.dz: 把 dsh 界面的对话框固定为像素宽度或列宽百分比，设置项在「通用」设置页；锁定后隐藏内置拖动手柄，宽度不再被误拖。

items.de: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
items.dz: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

items.de: Cooking recipes in DSH: a full panel in the Web GUI plus four recipe_* tools for the agent. 373 home-cooking recipes — mostly Chinese, with Western, Japanese and Korean dishes mixed in — bundled with 347 dish photos and three kitchen-tip illustrations; the dataset is derived from the open-source How
items.dz: 菜谱面板 + 4 个 recipe_* 工具：373 道家常菜谱（以中式为主，兼收西式与日韩菜式），随包附带 347 张菜品图与 3 张厨房技巧插图，数据取自开源项目 HowToCook（Unlicense）并经清洗、单位修正与重排。按菜名、分类或手头食材找菜，每日推荐、收藏与「做过」标记、厨房技巧；数据随插件分发，离线可用，不热链、无遥测。

items.de: Keeps DeepSeek Harness desktop dsh-auth-* session cookies bounded by deleting stale ones during the token exchange performed on every launch, so random-port accumulation cannot reach the 16 KiB request-header limit and cause an HTTP 431 startup failure.
items.dz: 在每次启动的令牌交换中删除多余的 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie，让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 cookie 数量保持在 3 条以内，避免随机端口累积达到 16 KiB 请求头上限而出现 HTTP 431 启动失败。

items.de: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies once the Cookie request header passes 4 KiB, so per-port cookie accumulation can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit (HTTP 431).
items.dz: 当 Cookie 请求头超过 4 KiB 时，自动过期失效的 dsh-auth 登录 Cookie，避免按端口累积的 Cookie 撑到 Node 的 16 KiB 请求头上限（HTTP 431）。

items.de: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 128 KiB and prunes stale dsh-auth cookies only on the launch-token response that mints the replacement, so an already-locked-out desktop profile recovers and later random-port launches stay at one cookie.
items.dz: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 请求头上限提高到 128 KiB，并且只在真正签发新 dsh-auth cookie 的令牌交换响应里清理旧 Cookie；已经卡在 431 的桌面 profile 能恢复，之后随机端口启动只保留一条。

items.de: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
items.dz: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

items.de: Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.
items.dz: 终端插件 — 真 shell、工作区同步、状态常驻、常用命令管理、命令补全。

items.de: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
items.dz: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

items.de: Turns a repository and a software name into Chinese software copyright registration material - the 60-page source code excerpt (50 lines per page, auto-paginated), the software manual with screenshots, and the derived application-form fields (line count, language, completion date, function summary).
items.dz: 把代码仓库和软件名变成软件著作权登记材料：60 页源程序鉴别材料（每页 50 行自动分页）、带截图的软件说明书、以及申请表信息推导（源程序量、语言、完成日期、功能简介）。需 Python 3 与 python-docx，截图需 Google Chrome。

items.de: Bridges the official COROS MCP server into DeepSeek Harness with a self-contained local stdio-to-HTTP bridge and on-device OAuth login, exposing 34 COROS tools on the current endpoint for sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, recovery, training load, activities and FIT files, plus workout and training-pla
items.dz: 把高驰（COROS）官方 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness：自包含的本机 stdio↔HTTP 桥 + 本机 OAuth 登录，在当前端点上提供 34 个工具，覆盖睡眠、HRV、静息心率、恢复、训练负荷、活动与 FIT 文件，以及训练课程与训练计划的增删改查和排期。

items.de: COROS Sport panel for DeepSeek Harness: sign in to COROS inside the panel, read the account, bound devices, recovery, fitness, recent workouts, daily health and the training schedule in one dashboard, and get a plan from the model with /coros-plan. The plan page writes a fixed four-week, 16-session
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内登录高驰（COROS）账号，用一个面板查看账号、绑定设备、恢复、体能、近期运动、每日健康与训练安排，并可用 /coros-plan 让模型按账号数据给出训练计划；计划页只在二次确认后才把固定的四周 16 节课写入账号。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Local ComfyUI cosplay photo sets for Windows with an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB+ VRAM): deploys the ComfyUI Windows portable build and Z-Image-Turbo (8-10 GB of models) with a self-test, then turns a character name, a reference image, or a hot-character pick into a live-action cosplay photo set with base-imag
items.dz: 面向 Windows + NVIDIA 显卡（显存 ≥8 GB）的本机 ComfyUI cosplay 套图：自动部署 ComfyUI 便携版与 Z-Image-Turbo（模型约 8-10 GB）并自检，再把角色名、参考图或热门角色推荐变成真人 cosplay 套图，基准图与镜头脚本各设人工确认闸门。

items.de: Shows token and CNY cost per turn and per session in the harness's own statistics form, a whole-account bill over 1/7/30-day windows with cost-per-unit-of-work trends, and an advisor that re-measures its own suggestions after you adopt them.
items.dz: 以 harness 自己的统计形态显示每轮与会话的 token 与人民币花费，提供 1/7/30 天窗口的全账号账单与「单位工作量花费」趋势，并给出会在你采纳后重新测量效果的建议。

items.de: Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.

items.de: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with

items.de: Shows today's, this month's and cumulative spend in the sidebar footer, under the message box and in the session header. Spend is metered by the plugin itself from session usage events using official DeepSeek unit prices (peak/off-peak, weekends and holidays treated as off-peak), with local-day aggr

items.de: Dabaifan Arrival Voice Announcements speaks the estimated spend per turn with the bundled Dabaifan voice by default; Alipay is optional. items.de: Track countdowns and recurring dates with optional reminders.
items.dz: 记录倒数日和重复日期，并可设置提醒。

Requires both plugins (with memory-evolve session orchestration tu

Pure plugin package, no built-in API keys; the image backend must be configured by the user.

Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads a

items.de: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the pro
items.dz: DSH 日报：每天定点按真实下载量与 star 把插件市场排一遍，再对照你自己的 agent 记忆与工作约定，产出两类条目——对已经有很多人在用的插件的具体改法（原版是 A，提案做成 B），以及生态里还没有的新方向。热度数字取自市场对外发布的目录并原样写进提示词，不由模型猜测；市场没测到的条目会标成「无热门度数据」，绝不当作 0。批准一条会按它的项目名新建一个会话，并把一份固定交付契约交给那个会话：独立实现、不许 fork、测试全绿才发布。标记「不感兴趣」的来源会被记住，不再重复出现。

items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每日简报：汇总关注的 X 账号、RSS/Atom/JSON/ICS 订阅与网页、YouTube 与 Bilibili 更新、Steam 动态、Minecraft 服务器与状态页、邮箱（IMAP）与日历，按人格卡片渲染。面向 Windows 10/11：默认注册每日 Windows 计划任务（07:30），到点用 Edge/Chrome 应用窗口弹出简报；邮箱与 Cookie 凭据用 Windows DPAPI 加密保存；默认会把条目标题（含邮件主题）交给 DSH 模型润色文案（在 config.json 里把 ai.polish 设为 off 可关闭）

items.de: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by est

items.dz: 定期读取 DeepSeek 状态源，在 DSH 页面上以可自定义的气泡、横幅或胶囊提示服务中断、性能下降与服务恢复；常驻状态胶囊位置独立，支持六种位置、三种大小与中英双语。

items.de: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

items.de: Shows the DeepSeek account balance as a row in the sidebar footer with a refresh button, and opens a popover with the balance card, daily token and estimated-cost charts over a 7/30-day window, a per-model table, and a link to the platform usage page. The balance comes from the official /user/balanc
items.dz: 在侧边栏脚部显示一行 DeepSeek 账户余额（带刷新按钮），点击打开弹层：余额卡、7/30 天每日 Token 与估算费用图表、按模型明细表，以及平台用量页外链。余额取自官方 /user/balance 接口；用量由本机 DSH 会话日志聚合，按官方峰谷单价以人民币估算，因此界面明确标注为估算值并写明统计范围。

items.de: Adds a cost-and-balance chip to the composer stats row beside the shipped token-usage pill — the session's estimated DeepSeek cost, a peak/off-peak light and the signed-in account's remaining balance, with each billing item priced in the breakdown; it activates only when a DeepSeek official route is
items.dz: 在输入栏统计行、官方 token 用量条旁加一枚费用与余额胶囊：本次会话的 DeepSeek 估算费用、峰谷时段指示灯与已登录账号的剩余额度，明细里按计费项列出各自金额；仅在检测到 DeepSeek 官方渠道时激活。

items.de: Claude-style dark and light skin for the DeepSeek panel of dsh-webchat: warm neutral palette, terracotta accents and Claude brand marks, applied as injected CSS with no guest DOM edits and no network requests.
items.dz: 为 dsh-webchat 的 DeepSeek 面板提供 Claude 风格深/浅色皮肤：暖中性色板、赤陶强调色与 Claude 品牌标识，以注入 CSS 实现，不修改访客页 DOM、不发网络请求。

items.de: Brings the third-party deepseekbase.com index into DSH: eight tools and five DSHIO standard skills (from the @liangjiehappy/dsh-dshio dependency). Search 8,400 plugins with real sandbox install verdicts and risk levels (including red-line warnings where credential access meets network), submit a plu
items.dz: 把第三方 deepseekbase.com 的数据接进 DSH，八个工具加五个 DSHIO 标准技能（来自依赖包 @liangjiehappy/dsh-dshio）。能搜 8,400 个插件并附沙箱安装判定与风险等级（含红线警告：读凭证＋网络＝可能泄露 API Key）、在对话里提交插件做四阶段沙箱测试、查判定、查剩余免费额度，以及按 DSHIO/T 10 标准逐条检查插件是否合规。技能正文在启动时从 dshio.org 拉取并替换内置副本，更新不需重装。网络请求只发往 deepseekbase.com 与 dshio.org（提交测试前另查一次 npm registry）；不读写文件、不读凭

items.de: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
items.dz: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

items.de: A two-eyed royal-blue pixel whale that perches on the DSH composer, changes expression with the live agent state, watches you type, and makes a short dive across the composer every 30 seconds while idle.
items.dz: 趴在 DSH 输入框上沿的双眼宝蓝色像素小鲸鱼，表情跟随智能体实时状态，打字时会停下来注视，空闲时每 30 秒横穿输入框巡游一次。

items.de: Changes and pins the shared default model — new conversations, restarts and switching models inside a chat no longer rewrite it.
items.dz: 修改并固定共享的默认模型：新建对话、重启、以及在对话里切换模型都不会再改写它。

items.de: Moves the default workspace off the system drive (DSH opens every new Session in <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace and never relocates it) while keeping stored sessions usable: rewrites the workspace record without a restart, offers the same three actions as a GUI panel, moves stored se
items.dz: 把默认工作区从系统盘挪走（DSH 把新会话一律开在 <文档>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace 且从不迁移），同时让已存会话继续可用：无需重启即可改写工作区记录，同一套动作也有图形面板可点，连同 header cwd 把已存会话日志一起搬走，并重帧化首帧不是恰好一行 header 的日志。需桌面版宿主（workspaceRegistry 与 sessionPersistence）。

items.de: Non-blocking approvals and timed questions: permission requests park as pending items while the model keeps working and the approved call can be retried, and ask_user_question runs in timed mode (20 s) through an override of the whole standard agent preset that applies to new sessions after a restar
items.dz: 非阻塞审批与定时提问：越权请求挂起为待办、模型继续干活、批准后重试；ask_user_question 通过整体覆盖 standard 预设切到 timed 模式（20 秒），重启后仅对新会话生效。

items.de: Checks whether a similar dsh plugin already exists before you build one, searching the awesome-dsh-plugin registry and the dsh-plugin GitHub topic and returning ranked matches with evidence.
items.dz: 在动手写 dsh 插件前，检索 awesome-dsh-plugin 注册表与 dsh-plugin GitHub topic，判断是否已有相似插件，并返回带证据的排序结果。

items.de: Session and image management for DSH: a sidebar panel deletes selected sessions together with their on-disk files after DSH has archived them, with multi-select, sub-agent / team-member / whole-family cascade and per-session size; a right-sidebar tab counts a session images and offloads or deletes t
items.dz: DSH 会话与图片管理：侧边栏多选面板在 DSH 归档后把选中的会话连同磁盘文件一起删除，支持子 agent / 团队成员 / 整族级联与逐个大小统计；右侧栏页签统计会话图片张数并多选摘除，可另行删除磁盘上的源文件与附件对象。

items.de: Real session deletion for DSH: "Delete chat" in a session row moves its directory into ~/.dsh/session-trash, a Trash page in the sidebar lists, filters, restores and permanently deletes from there, and a CLI offers the same verbs without the GUI.
items.dz: 给 DSH 补上真正的会话删除：「⋯」里的 Delete chat 把会话目录移进 ~/.dsh/session-trash，侧栏回收站页面负责筛选、恢复与永久删除，另有 CLI 用同样的动词、不用开 GUI。

items.de: Adds "Delete conversation" (zh/en) to the sidebar conversation menu. Confirming removes the durable session log under <DSH_HOME>/sessions, drops the id from the workspace registry (sessionIds, pin, archive), detaches a live session before its files go away, and emits api-session/removed so every con
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单里加中英双语的「删除会话」。确认后删除 <DSH_HOME>/sessions 下的会话日志、从 Workspace 注册表摘掉该 id（sessionIds、置顶、归档），先 detach 活会话再删文件，并广播 api-session/removed，让所有已连接客户端同步移除该行。

items.de: Adds a "Delete session" option to the sidebar session menu that permanently removes the session from disk.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话菜单中添加“删除会话”选项，从磁盘上永久删除该会话。

items.de: Turns a repository and a running system into acceptance material - database design, design specs, a user manual with screenshots, and test / go-live / acceptance reports. Sections follow GB/T 8567-88; anything it cannot verify is left blank instead of invented. Requires Python 3 with python-docx for
items.dz: 把代码仓库与运行中的系统变成验收材料：数据库设计、概要设计、详细设计、带截图的使用说明书，以及测试报告、上线报告、验收报告。章节按 GB/T 8567-88 组织，无法核实的字段与结论一律留空，不编造。需 Python 3 与 python-docx 生成 .docx，自动截图需 Google Chrome。

items.de: Recurring task scheduler with an append-only delivery ledger: window-aligned dedup execution, failure/abandoned rows, and same-window retry redelivery.
items.dz: 周期性任务调度器 + 只追加的投递账本：按时间窗去重执行，记录失败／放弃行，同窗口重试可重投。

items.de: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in t
items.dz: 项目收尾用的交付回执面板。触发一次即汇总分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、截图的宽高与 sha256、密钥扫描结论，然后只按证据把每一条分进三区：已验证、仅本地、未验证。落在未验证区的声明只保留标签，正文位置显式留空而不是把声明印出来——措辞自信而背后什么都没有的句子，正是回执要防的东西。测试失败与密钥扫描命中同样是有证据的事实，因此进已验证区并带红色色调，而不是被悄悄丢掉。

items.de: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — an
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻助理，刻意不做成又一个会话框：一个浮窗 + 一个常驻会话，两者都独立于其他所有会话。心跳受四道门约束——授权、每日回合预算、安静时段、冷却——并靠必须持续持有的租约跨重启续接。每次唤醒都交给模型裁决：回 SKIP 就一个字都不说，所以沉默是一次决定，而不是一次失败。浮窗显示常驻会话的真实消息流（优先读宿主会话存储；宿主不发布该会话时改读落盘日志），并且可以直接在里面发话。den 拥有人同等的触达范围，但有一条硬限制：只读。它可以读所有会话、本机以及 GitHub 等工作渠道，却不写、不发送、不发布，从不向任何人索要许可，也从不拦别人的工具调用。`np

items.de: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.
items.dz: 扫描项目锁文件（npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle…）并对免费 OSV API 批量查询漏洞，输出「包 / 当前版本 / 漏洞 ID / 摘要 / CVSS / 修复版本」表格与修复命令。

items.de: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
items.dz: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

items.de: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
items.dz: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

items.de: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.
items.dz: 仅支持 Windows：把审批请求、待回答的提问、任务出错和轮次完成显示为原生卡片窗口，审批请求可直接在卡片上放行。

items.de: Restores the Windows desktop after a restart or power loss: snapshots open apps, documents, folders and window positions, and reopens them on demand. Windows 10+ only; automatic capture before shutdown needs two scheduled tasks registered once with collector/install-tasks.ps1.
items.dz: 重启或断电后恢复 Windows 桌面：快照已打开的程序、文档、文件夹与窗口位置，可一键重开。仅支持 Windows 10 及以上；关机前自动抓取需先用 collector/install-tasks.ps1 注册两个计划任务。

items.de: Let external MCP agents delegate tasks to the existing DSH desktop, with visible sessions, user takeover, and optional approval handoff.
items.dz: 让外部 MCP Agent 将任务交给现有 DSH 桌面端，并提供可见会话、用户接管与可选审批转交。

items.de: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

items.de: Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个登录自启开关：只管理用户启动文件夹里的一个快捷方式，不写注册表、不需要管理员权限、不额外常驻进程。

items.de: Adds a Settings page with one switch that writes or removes the current user's Windows Run entry for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, detects the installed executable from the running app, App Paths, the default install folders or the installer records, and clears the Task Manager disabled flag.
items.dz: 在设置里增加一页和一个开关，用于写入或删除当前用户的 Windows 启动项（HKCU Run）；从正在运行的桌面版、App Paths、默认安装目录或安装器记录中自动找到 exe，并清除任务管理器里的禁用标记。

items.de: A draggable floating clock for the DSH Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes, and persistent placement.
items.dz: 可拖动的 DSH 网页悬浮时钟：支持数字与指针表盘、专注计时、四套主题，并会记住窗口位置。

items.de: Windows-only desktop control for DSH with six tools that list windows, capture occluded windows, focus windows, click by coordinate, inject Unicode keyboard input, and diagnose the desktop bridge.
items.dz: DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件，六个工具：列出窗口、抓取被遮挡窗口、聚焦窗口、按坐标点击、注入 Unicode 键盘输入与诊断桌面桥接。

items.de: Close and restart controls for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web on Windows, in Settings → General.
items.dz: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 提供「关闭程序」和「重启程序」控制，位于「设置 → 通用设置」。

items.de: One-click update for the self-built Linux dsh-desktop: check fork releases, download the deb, swap the app and restart.
items.dz: 桌面端 Linux 自建版一键更新：检查 fork release、下载 deb、替换应用目录并自动重启。

items.de: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness host plugin that shows Windows 11 style desktop cards in the bottom-right corner: a card when a turn completes — clicking anywhere on it brings Harness forward and switches back to that conversation — or fails, a native choice card for ask_user_question where clicking a
items.dz: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件：在屏幕右下角弹出 Windows 11 外观的桌面卡片——回合完成时弹通知卡（点卡片任意位置即把 Harness 窗口前置并切回该对话）、出错时弹红色强调的出错卡、把 ask_user_question 变成原生选择卡（点选项即作答，也可以手动输入自定义回答）、并把工具授权请求做成「允许一次 / 拒绝」审批卡。卡片配色跟随当前 Harness 外观，出现在主窗口所在的屏幕；提示音（含自定义 .wav）与通知时机、审批接管方式、各类超时都能在 Harness 设置页里配置。

items.de: Native desktop notifications for DSH on Windows, macOS and Linux. While the DSH window is in the background, permission requests arrive as system notifications; where the platform supports notification actions, Reject and Allow-once buttons return the decision to the host approval waterfall, and ret
items.dz: DSH 的原生桌面通知。窗口在后台时权限确认直接出现在系统通知里；平台支持通知按钮时，点「拒绝 / 允许一次」即把结果交回宿主审批流程，切回窗口或超时则退回应用内审批面板。权限确认与提问还会播放独立于窗口焦点的交互提示音；任务完成、提问、错误提醒、通知铃声与提示音都在「通知提醒」设置页配置。

items.de: Windows desktop organizer for DeepSeek Harness: it registers 1 agent tool (desktop_organize).
items.dz: Windows 桌面整理：归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接（1 个模型工具 desktop_organize）。

items.de: A whale or pixel-crab pet that perches on the DSH input box and reacts to the current session (working, awaiting approval, done, error), eats the tokens each turn spends and keeps a diary.
items.dz: 扒在 DSH 输入框上的小鲸鱼或像素小螃蟹，跟着当前对话变化状态（干活、等你确认、完成、出错），吃掉每轮花掉的 token，还会写日记。

items.de: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top character and a roster panel that show what the watched conversations are doing, with seven animations, Workspace grouping, subagents drawn under their parent, and one click to open a session. Ships Windows, macOS (Intel and Apple silicon) and Lin
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面宠物：置顶角色加一块会话面板，显示受关注会话的实时状态；七套动画、按 Workspace 分组、子代理挂在父会话下面、点击一行即可打开会话。包内自带 Windows、macOS（Intel 与 Apple 芯片）和 Linux 的窗口可执行文件，安装时不跑脚本、无需构建。

items.de: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verif

items.dz: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

items.de: Adds a restart button to the Windows desktop app title bar and replaces the cold-start "loading settings" overlay with an animated boot sequence.
items.dz: 在 Windows 桌面端标题栏加一个重启按钮，并把冷启动时的「正在加载设置…」换成一段科技感动画。

items.de: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

items.de: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
items.dz: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

items.de: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
items.dz: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

items.de: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.

items.dz: 电商订单数据分析技能：退款类型分类、退货率统计、拦截件与白嫖损耗核算、售后深度与商品预警，交付为单个 Excel 工作簿（含订单明细表与抽样验证表）；由智能体用 Python（pandas、openpyxl、matplotlib）生成。
