items.de: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray backgrou
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 一站式界面增强：提示词库（快选+管理）、两步 AI 润色、预测回复栏（点击直接发送）、MCP 工具管理、定时自动化、智能会话标题、对话宽度可调、AI 回复占满无灰底、超长用户消息自动折叠（带平滑展开/收起动效），以及各面板的场景化入场动效。

items.de: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.
items.dz: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里哪个键发送消息、哪个键换行；默认 Enter 发送、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 换行，两个组合键都可以在设置页里重新录制。

items.de: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
items.dz: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

items.de: Turns the first row of the DSH sidebar entry list into a switch that folds every other entry away, giving the session history more room.
items.dz: 把 DSH 左侧栏入口列表的第一行变成开关，一键收起/展开其余入口，把空间还给会话历史。

items.de: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and moves are saved locally and survive restarts.
items.dz: 拖拽重排 dsh 左侧栏的插件面板条目与会话顶部标签，并能把条目在侧栏与标签区之间搬移（搬过去是真实标签）；顺序与搬移状态存本机，重启后保留。

items.de: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.
items.dz: 代理 provider：每次出网前按类别跑 op 链重塑 payload 再转交上游，使 prompt 前缀在回合之间保持单调、未变的历史不必按全价重付；op 名只表示传输方式（exec / http / inline），可接入用户自定义算法。

items.de: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.
items.dz: 打开工作台时的一次性入场动画：标识逐字擦出，退场时反色色块扫过全屏，深浅主题自动镜像。

items.de: File-based environment registry for DSH: manage environments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings through a panel and model-facing tools.
items.dz: 基于文件的 DSH 环境注册表：通过面板和模型工具管理环境、服务、部署以及操作到 Skill 的绑定。

items.de: Windows environment doctor: audits 30 developer tools, installs the missing ones, manages the user PATH, and exports or imports an environment share code so a team keeps identical setups.
items.dz: 环境体检：审计 30 种 Windows 开发工具，安装缺失的工具，管理用户 PATH，并支持导出/导入环境分享码，让团队配置保持一致。

items.de: Private Windows DSH cold archives and guarded fresh-environment recovery. v0.7.0 adds precise browser-proof diagnostics and restrained, reduced-motion-aware UI feedback; strict dependency, transaction and verify/commit gates remain. Verified ZIP integrity does not certify private business recovery.
items.dz: Windows DSH 私人冷备份与受门禁保护的新环境恢复。v0.7.0 精确区分浏览器证明诊断，精修界面与减少动态效果支持；保留严格依赖、事务及 verify/commit 门禁。ZIP 完整性不代表私人业务恢复认证。

items.de: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理环境变量、.env 文件和凭据，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级环境变量。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.
items.dz: 绘梨衣（Sakura）主题启动加载动画——樱花瓣飘落、头戴樱花的小怪兽、粉色进度条，约 3 秒自动淡出且不阻挡操作。

items.de: Learn an ERP through the browser into private local knowledge, with a desktop Adapt ERP workspace (multi-site sessions, chat in the middle and the official Browser on the right, approvals before writes).
items.dz: 通过浏览器学习 ERP 并沉淀为私有本地知识；桌面端提供「ERP 助手」工作区（多站点会话、中对话+右浏览器、写入前审批）。

items.de: Cross-session error lessons for DSH agents: search past mistakes before handling errors and reuse their verified fixes.
items.dz: DSH 代理的跨会话错误教训库：处理报错前先检索过去踩过的坑，直接复用已验证的解法。

items.de: Lists this session's runtime errors — turn errors, tool failures, command failures and subagent failures — as copyable cards in a conversation tab.
items.dz: 把本会话的运行时错误——回合错误、工具失败、命令失败、子智能体异常——汇总成可复制的卡片，显示在会话标签页里。

items.de: Side panel for DeepSeek Harness that tracks a 15-ETF national-team basket intraday from Eastmoney and Tencent quotes (pure Node, zero dependencies): capital flow, minute-level support pulses and a composite read.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧边面板：纯 Node 直取东财与腾讯行情，盘中跟踪 15 只国家队 ETF 篮子，含资金流、分时护盘脉冲与综合判读。

items.de: EVA cel-shade skin for the Harness Web UI. Overrides the --dsw-* design tokens to give panels square corners, ink outlines, hard offset shadows and CRT scanlines, adds a three-state session rail (running, done, waiting on you), recolours the turn-navigator ticks, and can embed an optional dark backd
items.dz: EVA 赛璐璐风格皮肤。只覆盖 --dsw-* 设计令牌，把面板改成方角、墨线描边、无模糊硬投影和 CRT 扫描线，并加入会话三态状态轨（运行中、已完成、等你回复）、重绘右侧跳转条刻度，可选用一张压暗的底图。

items.de: Agent application development evaluation skill (skill bundle) for DeepSeek Harness: offline/online suites judged from audit side effects, baseline diff with zero tolerance for safety regressions, and mutation tests proving the evaluators themselves catch regressions. Framework-agnostic - needs a cal
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 应用程序开发评测技能（技能包）：以审计副作用为判定依据的离线/在线评测套件、对安全类退化零容忍的基线对比、验证评测器自身有效性的变异测试。框架无关——只要有可调用的对话接口与可查询的工具调用记录即可接入；宿主版本兼容范围刻意未声明。

items.de: Diagnostic evaluation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: freezes the confirmed Harness configuration, runs a benchmark, keeps the full session trace, and attributes failures to model, Harness, benchmark or environment.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的诊断型评测插件：冻结已确认的 Harness 配置，跑一遍基准测试，保留完整会话轨迹，并把失败归因到模型、Harness、基准或环境。

items.de: Event-driven trigger plugin (the doorbell beside dsh-proactive's alarm clock): recursive fs watchers with per-rule debounce windows and glob filters, plus a loopback-only local webhook endpoint with per-rule tokens, fire rules that wake a target session through the host agents service - live session
items.dz: 事件驱动触发器插件（dsh-proactive 闹钟旁的门铃）：递归目录监视按规则防抖合并并支持 glob 过滤，本机回环 webhook 端点按规则 token 鉴权；规则命中后经宿主 agents 服务唤醒目标会话（活会话直接投递，冷会话先恢复再投递），并注入渲染后的 prompt（支持 paths、count、payload 模板变量）。规则文件保存即热更新，无需重启 DSH；每次触发追加 JSONL 审计历史，可通过 trigger_list / trigger_history 工具查询；另提供回环 health 路由报告安装与运行状态。典型用途：下载目录自动整理、CI/监控报警自动诊

items.de: Send DSH event notifications to Gotify, a generic webhook, or ntfy when a task finishes, is interrupted, needs approval, or needs an answer. The message carries only the session title, workspace name and event reason, never the conversation body, and a failed send is logged without interrupting the
items.dz: 在任务完成、任务中断、需要审批、需要回答问题时，把 DSH 事件通知发到 Gotify、通用 Webhook 或 ntfy：通知只包含会话标题、工作区名称与事件原因，不包含会话正文；发送失败只写日志，不会打断会话。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
items.dz: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

items.de: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
items.dz: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

items.de: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
items.dz: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

items.de: An agent preset that adds a working mode to DeepSeek Harness: the mode text has the model analyze requirements and plan before acting, open a gate document, and reply in a fixed three-block shape. The task tree and session-start profile injection are separate companion packages in the same repositor
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个工作模式的 agent preset：模式正文要求模型动手前做需求分析与计划、建关卡文档，回复固定三块。任务树与开场画像注入是同仓库的独立配套包，需克隆仓库后用 scripts/install.mjs 装；装本包只会自动带上术语字典（dsh-term-dict），没有任务树时由模型自己写对齐栏。需要 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 及以上。

items.de: Exa web search and fetch provider for DSH: replaces built-in web search and exposes multi-source research capabilities.
items.dz: 基于 Exa 的 DSH 网页搜索与抓取插件：完全接管内置网络检索，并提供多源深度调研工具。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Renders Excalidraw architecture scenes inside DSH — import a local .excalidraw/.json file or an inline document with no account, or refresh from Excalidraw+ over MCP (refresh needs an Excalidraw+ MCP bearer token in mcpToken or EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN); pan, zoom, select and export SVG/PNG.
items.dz: 在 DSH 里渲染 Excalidraw 架构图：可无账号导入本地 .excalidraw/.json 或内联文档，也可通过 MCP 从 Excalidraw+ 刷新（刷新需在 mcpToken 或 EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN 里配置 Excalidraw+ 的 MCP 令牌）；支持平移、缩放、选中与 SVG/PNG 导出。

items.de: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
items.dz: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。只报告差异，不裁决对错。

items.de: Declarative DAG runtime for DSH tool plans with bounded parallel execution, read-only retries, per-step checkpoints, cancellation, and conservative crash recovery.
items.dz: DSH 工具计划的声明式 DAG 运行时，支持有界并行、只读重试、逐步落盘、取消及保守的崩溃恢复。

items.de: Translates the agent's English execution narration into Simplified Chinese in place; the final answer, tool records and reasoning stay as they are, so the official reasoning-translation plugin keeps working alongside it. Whether a step is narration is decided by a render-time structural signal, not
items.dz: 把 Agent 执行过程中的英文过程叙述原位翻译成简体中文；最终回答、工具记录与思考内容保持原样，因此官方思考翻译插件可同时启用。某一步是否属于过程叙述由渲染期结构信号判定，而非依据英文句式；拿不到该信号时不自动翻译。围栏代码、行内代码、URL 与文件路径在请求前打码。复用宿主的翻译服务（默认 Bing，无需 API Key）。

items.de: Annotates bash results whose exit code 1 is an answer rather than an error (grep with no match, diff with differences, false test) so the agent does not re-investigate them.
items.dz: 为 exit code 1 表示结果而非错误的 bash 输出（grep 无匹配、diff 有差异、test 为假）补充说明，避免 agent 反复排查。

items.de: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless o
items.dz: 为中兴 Nde 桌面定制的 DSH Cordis computer-use provider。npm install 完成后由 postinstall 钩子从 computer-use-linux-zte-nde v0.7.7-nde.3 release 自动下载 musl 静态二进制到包内 bin/，SHA 校验后 chmod +x；cordis patch 里的 command 用相对路径，由 provider 内部 resolveCommand() 依据 import.meta.url 解析为绝对路径，不依赖 dsh web 的 cwd。占用 DSH 一等公民 ctx.computerU
rl: runs code at install time (postinstall)

items.de: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
items.dz: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

items.de: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion o
items.dz: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

items.de: Edits workspace text files in place inside the DSH file preview, with Monaco highlighting and project-typed completion.
items.dz: 在 DSH 的文件预览面板内直接编辑工作区文本文件，基于 Monaco 提供语法高亮与工程类型补全。

items.de: Adds a right-click command "通过 dsh 打开" (open with dsh) to the Windows Explorer right-click menu for a folder, a folder's empty background and any file: it launches DeepSeek Harness on that folder, creates a new session every time, and puts the clicked file into the new draft as an @ reference. Ships
items.dz: 给 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单加「通过 dsh 打开」：文件夹、文件夹空白处、任意文件都能用。点击后在对应文件夹启动 DeepSeek Harness 并新建会话；文件右键会把这个文件以 @ 引用预置进新会话草稿。Win11 新式菜单用打包 COM 组件，经典菜单 用注册表项；首次安装需要点一次证书受信（native/trust-cert.bat）。

items.de: Connects Chrome, Edge and QQ Browser to DeepSeek Harness through a local MV3 extension and loopback bridge, exposing 12 browser tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, typing, extraction and screenshots. The browser extension is loaded manually (MV3, developer mode) and paired with the bridge, and
items.dz: 通过本机 MV3 扩展与回环桥把 Chrome、Edge、QQ 浏览器接入 DSH，提供 12 个浏览器工具用于导航、快照、点击、输入、提取与截图。浏览器扩展需手动加载（MV3、开发者模式）并与桥配对，且会申请 debugger 权限。

items.de: Optional external HTTP API for DSH Desktop, off by default, bound to localhost unless widened, and authenticated with a Bearer token.
items.dz: DSH Desktop 的可选外部 HTTP API，默认关闭、默认仅监听本机，扩大监听范围时使用 Bearer Token 鉴权。

items.de: Host-side HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1:39217 with a Bearer token stored at 0600: external processes can create real DSH Desktop sessions that appear in the workspace sidebar, send prompts (queue or steer), read state and the last assistant reply, list workspaces and sessions, and long-poll until a turn
items.dz: 只在 127.0.0.1:39217 监听的本机 HTTP 桥（Host 半插件），用 0600 落盘的 Bearer token 鉴权：外部进程可创建出现在工作区侧栏的真会话、发消息（queue/steer）、读状态与最后一条助手回复、列工作区/会话，并长轮询到回合结束。零运行时依赖，端口固定，不联网，日志不记消息正文。

items.de: Fairy III (Zenless Zone Zero) H.D.D skin for DeepSeek Harness: boot video, an eye-core dock that can be dragged vertically so it never covers text, and time-of-day greeting voices written by a model every day (5 lines, each <= 20 characters) and synthesized locally with GPT-SoVITS, with a fallback c
items.dz: 《绝区零》Fairy Ⅲ 的 H.D.D 皮肤：开机动画、可沿纵轴拖动（X 轴固定）的常驻眼徽，用来避开正文；每天由模型生成 5 段时段问候台词（每句不超过 20 字），用本地 GPT-SoVITS 合成，取用顺序为「今日 → 最近一份 → 内置语音」，生成失败也有声音。回复可选朗读：末尾标记行优先于字数判断，长回复可先压成一句结论；朗读器对刚念过的句子做 MD5 去重，保证每条只念一次，切换会话保持安静。本仓库是 dsh-fairy-zzz 的个人定制分支，包名、路由与存储命名空间独立，并做了摘要接口限流、引擎启停改 POST、TTS 缓存与问候语定期清理。插件会在自身目录写两份本地诊断日志

items.de: Give your agent a phone: a local incoming-call screen that really rings in the browser, speaks a preset opening line with the OS voice (no API key, fully offline), and can call again if nobody picks up. The first sentence is fixed text rather than model-improvised, because schedules, amounts and add
items.dz: 让你的 agent 给你打电话：浏览器里真的会响铃的来电界面，用系统自带音色念出预置开场白（不需要任何 key、完全离线），没人接还会再打一次。第一句是固定文本而不是模型现编——日程、金额、地址这类内容不能被改写。仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Monthly household budget page in the sidebar: income, fixed and variable expenses, savings, emergency fund, debt and a month-by-month review, with totals, per-item budget differences and a savings, debt or home goal. Bookkeeping only, no investment advice.

items.de: Isolated mother, essence, and fork workspaces for developing and testing DeepSeek Harness plugins.

items.de: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.

items.de: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
items.dz: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

items.de: Curated DeepSeek Harness plugin market with a daily heat leaderboard, bilingual descriptions, 2-3 plugin comparison, compatibility checks and README summaries.
items.dz: 精选 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，提供每日热度榜、双语说明、2–3 款并排对比、兼容性检查与 README 摘要。

Derived from MichengAI/dsh-im-connect (Apache-2.0) with the other IM channels re

items.de: Feishu/Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness through the official lark-cli: a sidebar panel for app setup and QR sign-in, a command console, and agent tools that run any lark-cli command across 18 business domains, 200+ high-level commands and the full OpenAPI; the official CLI is downloaded on firs

items.de: DSH Feishu Client. 1) Users (humans) access remote agents through the UI provided by this plugin; 2) The local DSH accesses remote agents by calling the tools provided by this plugin. Supported remote agents include but are not limited to DSH, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy, Weknora, etc.
items.dz: DSH飞书客户端：1）用户（人）通过本插件提供UI访问远端智能体；2）本地DSH通过调用本插件提供工具访问远端智能体。支持的远端智能体包括且不限于：DSH、OpenClaw、WorkBuddy、Weknora等等。

items.de: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: th
items.dz: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

items.de: Poll Feishu (Lark) group and direct chats through lark-cli, extract candidate tasks with a review workflow, and two-way sync them with the task-board plugin, with a floating browser panel and one-click device-flow authorization.

items.dz: 侧栏文件浏览器与文件预览器：懒加载文件树，面板内预览文本 / Markdown（含表格）/ 图片，可把当前文件送进会话右侧文档预览，或交给系统默认程序打开；只读，路径限定在可浏览根内。

items.dz: DSH Web 界面的环境背景：全窗口 canvas 铺一层暗色灌木林，草叶上的萤火虫呼吸明灭，飞过的光点会照亮猫头鹰或蛾子；在 DSH Desktop 上另有工作台面板，可调亮度、萤火虫密度、猫头鹰频率、季节与界面透明化。

items.dz: 流萤桌宠：透明置顶的桌面伴侣，走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column
items.dz: 流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤。覆盖 74 个 --dsw-alias-* 官方设计令牌（明暗两套），绘制春日橱窗背景与飘落花瓣、萤火；布局两侧各放一张人物立绘，中央用径向聚光遮罩保证文字对比度；在设置里注册分区，提供皮肤与立绘两个开关，选择存在 localStorage。

items.de: First-paint splash for DSH: pushes a branded splash page into the boot HTML as an index-injection row, so the desktop window opens already showing the splash instead of a white/loading flash. Fades out and hands over once the startup-animation plugin starts (checked via `window.__DSH_STARTUP_RUNNING
items.dz: 首帧启动页：把品牌启动页作为 index 注入行写进 DSH 的首帧 HTML，桌面端窗口出现时直接是启动页，而不是白屏或加载态。检测到启动动画插件开始（`window.__DSH_STARTUP_RUNNING__`）后自动淡出让位；默认 6 秒兜底（可用 maxMs 调整），不会把应用卡在启动页里。普通 dsh.bundle 插件，不改宿主、不碰 app.asar。

items.de: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a k
items.dz: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

items.de: A reasoning-style row above the DSH composer with a stock watchlist and a host-backed TXT/EPUB reader; reading progress is shared across browsers.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框上方以思考行样式显示自选股票行情，或阅读 TXT/EPUB 电子书。

items.de: Dreams for the pet in dsh-fish: once she has been quiet long enough, it picks real events from her event stream, follows one of six dream theories, and hands her a dream seed to write out in her own words. Ships three tools (dream_recall, dream_record, dream_now), never calls a model itself, and kee
items.dz: 给 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，从她真实的事件流里挑碎片，按六种梦理论之一拼成「梦的种子」，她自己把梦写完。提供三个工具（dream_recall、dream_record、dream_now），插件自己不调用模型，数据放在 ~/.dsh-fish-dream。梦只能用真实发生过的事重拼，理论只决定怎么拼。

items.de: Records an agent's short notes about what it browsed or thought, and lists them in a sidebar panel.
items.dz: 把智能体浏览、干活时的碎碎念随手记下来，并在侧栏面板里按时间列出。

items.de: A reflection layer for DSH sessions that slowly rewrites a 3-7 entry worldview across value, preference and habit layers, tracks spirit, health and account balance, ingests Bilibili/Douyin videos, and keeps an auditable growth archive. Video intake is optional and needs site cookies; Douyin parsing
items.dz: 给 DSH 主会话的人格反思层：每日把对话与视频素材沉淀成 3–7 条分层原则，跟踪精神、健康与账户余额，并保留可审计的成长档案；视频摄入为可选项，需站点 Cookie，抖音解析另需 Edge/Chrome 与 yt-dlp。

items.de: DSH finish reminder: a cute fish-girl pops up “Done!” on your phone via Feishu, ntfy or Web Push, and plays an animated popup inside the DSH page.
items.dz: DSH 完成提醒：回合结束时肥鱼娘在手机弹出「做好啦」（飞书 / ntfy / Web Push），并在 DSH 页面内播放可爱的弹窗动效。

items.de: A small living fish with its own memory, mood and quiet thoughts. It remembers you between sessions, and the fish itself is one JSON file you can export and carry.
items.dz: 一条养在 Harness 里的小鱼：有自己的记忆、心情和心事，隔天还记得你；鱼本身就是一个能导出带走的 JSON。

items.de: Workout logging plugin: a fitness_log agent tool (log, history, stats, weekly plans) storing data in local SQLite; the repo also ships a separate optional left-rail panel bundle under ui/.
items.dz: 训练记录插件：fitness_log 工具（记录、历史、统计、每周计划），数据存本地 SQLite；同一仓库 ui/ 里另有需单独安装的左侧栏面板包。

items.de: Config snapshot and rollback for DSH: auto-captures before risky changes, ships a standalone restore script that works even when DSH won't boot. Windows only; the restore script is a .bat and needs Node.js.
items.dz: DSH 配置快照与回滚：危险操作前自动留痕，附带独立还原脚本，DSH 起不来时也能救回。仅 Windows；还原脚本为 .bat，需 Node.js。

items.de: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.
items.dz: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

items.de: Character-chat memory layer that keeps persona, voice and relationship state separate from summaries, archives every raw message for retrieval, and ships a SillyTavern card importer plus an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
items.dz: 角色聊天记忆层：人格、语气、关系与摘要分开保存，原文全量归档并按需检索，附带 SillyTavern 角色卡导入和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

items.de: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
items.dz: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

items.de: Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的 DeepSeek API 余额浮窗：角落胶囊显示余额，点击展开总额、赠金与充值明细，双击立即刷新且每 5 秒轮询一次；宿主侧代理 /user/balance，密钥不下发到浏览器。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's
items.dz: 悬浮在 DSH 应用之外的 Windows 状态灯：无边框置顶发光圆灯，背景完全透明——绿灯光晕呼吸表示运行中、橙灯抖动待授权、蓝灯漂浮待你交互、灰灯空闲、暗灰宿主离线；悬停逐行列出各会话正在运行的任务，可拖动记忆位置，插件被关闭后数秒内自动熄灭。

items.de: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
items.dz: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

items.de: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
items.dz: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

items.de: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.
items.dz: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

items.de: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu,
items.dz: DSH 的一组小改动，把日常动作改回直觉——侧栏标题行的定位当前会话按钮（⇧⌘D）、会话行菜单里的复制会话 ID（⇧⌘C）、链接交给系统默认程序打开（含 localhost）、行内代码的打开或复制右键菜单、改动文件卡片用本机 IDE 打开或在文件管理器中显示、Enter 与 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 对调、↑↓ 回填发过的消息，以及把当前工作区名写进标题行「打开」按钮；每一项在设置的「心流」页各有一个开关。

items.de: Right-sidebar flow editor for prompts, model switches, commands, condition branches and loops, executed only at turn boundaries so an in-flight request keeps its model.
items.dz: 右侧栏可视化流程编辑器：把提示词、切换模型、命令、条件分支与循环连成一张图，只在轮次边界执行，在途请求与断连重试保持原模型。

items.de: DIY workflow builder for DSH - compose multi-step prompt workflows with self-check gating, engine-enforced jump rules, agent-driven execution and a live run panel.
items.dz: 流程锻造——在侧边面板编排多步骤提示词工作流，支持自检门禁、引擎执行的跳转规则、主对话 AI 逐步执行与实时运行面板。

items.de: Fluid conversation width for the DSH web UI: the chat column follows the window minus a 64px margin, capped at 1560px and floored at 640px, while the built-in drag handles still override it.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的对话列自适应宽度：随窗口取「列宽 − 64px」，上限 1560px、下限 640px，内置拖拽把手仍然优先。

items.de: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are app
items.dz: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

items.de: Reorganize the home sidebar entries into groups above and below the workspace, toggle each installed plugin entry, and save every change immediately.
items.dz: 把主页侧栏入口按工作区上方和下方重新分组，可逐个开关已安装插件的入口，改动即时保存。

items.de: Cross-session task ledger for DeepSeek Harness: one item per request with a step chain, an accordion strip above the composer, unfinished items injected into every step, staleness review with artifact fingerprints, clickable choices that learn repeated decisions, a grant ledger whose four-mode contr
items.dz: 跨会话焦点账本：每条请求一条焦点（带步骤链），输入框上方条带展开阅读，未收尾项注入每一步，按产物指纹做过期复核，选择题学习重复决策，授权台账的四档控制直接嵌在每张受授权阻塞的卡片里，盲操作附带回填清单，调度器只在新增 AI 回答提到某条时才重新判断。

items.de: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.
items.dz: 自动折叠 DSH 对话中的系统/上下文消息——将思考块、工具调用和工具结果合并为可展开的分组折叠条。

items.de: A fold row is pinned at the top of the sidebar panel list and stays visible when folded, so the Plugins … More column collapses to that one row and the Workspaces section moves up; ⌥⌘P (Ctrl+Alt+P) toggles it too, and the state is kept in localStorage across reloads.
items.dz: 在侧栏面板列表顶部固定一行开关，收起时这一行仍然留着，所以「插件 … 更多」整列（含末尾的「更多」）塌成一行、工作区随之上移；⌥⌘P（Windows/Linux 为 Ctrl+Alt+P）同样能切换，状态存 localStorage，重开保持。

items.de: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders, and add files to the chat as @ references.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的文件夹资源管理器：打开任意本地文件夹、按类型显示彩色图标、重命名/新建/删除/复制文件与文件夹，并可把文件作为 @ 引用添加到对话。

items.de: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

items.de: Adds folders to a running DSH Web workspace from the Windows Explorer context menu and starts dsh web automatically when needed; the menu itself requires a one-time per-user PowerShell installer run from a repository clone (no admin rights).
items.dz: 从 Windows 资源管理器右键把文件夹加入正在运行的 DSH 网页版工作区，并在需要时自动启动 dsh web；右键菜单需先从仓库克隆运行一次按用户的 PowerShell 安装脚本（无需管理员权限）。

items.de: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files
items.dz: 给任意文件夹留下历史时间点并一键回到过去：像 Git 一样有版本历史，但不需要懂 Git，任何文件夹都能用（游戏存档、软件配置目录、散落文档都行）。快照按内容寻址去重，只存真正变化的文件，未变文件不重算哈希；自动存档分两档——实时（fs.watch，最后一次改动静默约 8 秒后存一版，编辑器一次保存或一次构建算一版）与定时（每 N 分钟检查，有变化才存，内容没变不产生空版本）。空文件夹也会被记录，恢复时一并重建（mod 加载器、存档扫描器常要求某个空夹存在）。每次恢复前自动存一个安全还原点，因此恢复本身可撤销；exact 模式只删多余文件与空目录，非空目录一律不动。附带模型工具 folder_

items.de: Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.
items.dz: 监视目录，在文件树安静后投递批量合并、去重的变更清单，并过滤掉本会话自己的写入；投递方式按监视器选择，可起新回合或排队到下一步。

items.de: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
items.dz: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

items.de: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
items.dz: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

items.de: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the regist
items.dz: 在 Harness 侧边栏的每个工作区行加 fork 与删除按钮，并提供 /fork-worktree 命令：fork 创建 git worktree 并注册为新工作区，删除通过 git worktree remove 移除工作区文件夹（丢弃未提交内容前会再确认一次）并移除工作区登记。

items.de: Converts Markdown into .docx with native Word equations (OMML), then exports a PDF to verify every formula renders. Needs Python 3.9+ with lxml, latex2mathml and python-docx; the PDF check also needs pymupdf and Word or LibreOffice.
items.dz: 把 Markdown 转成公式为 Word 原生对象（OMML）的 .docx，并导出 PDF 逐页校验公式渲染。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 lxml、latex2mathml、python-docx；PDF 校验另需 pymupdf 与 Word 或 LibreOffice。

items.de: Multi-pet desktop companion: four MAM status lights watch every active session (approval / running / done-unread / error) and each card click-through to its conversation; four voice groups speak on state changes with duration-timed subtitles; import pets from four sources (folder / zip / Codex dir /
items.dz: 多宠物桌宠系统：四盏状态灯实时监控所有活跃会话（红待审批/黄运行/绿完成未读/深红错误），点卡片直达对应会话； 四组状态语音随事件播报，字幕与音频时长对齐；外部宠物四来源导入（本地文件夹/zip/Codex 目录/Petdex 在线仓库）， 卡片式热切换即时生效，激活守卫自动校验图集与语音完整性；五场景动作绑定、拖拽物理、三档缩放； 内置小狐狸 Foxbell 随包自带，装上即用。

items.de: Adds the Foxy agent preset, sidebar entry, settings page, editable prompt suffix, and a small capability registry to DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Foxy 人设预设、侧栏入口、设置页、可编辑附加提示词和可扩展能力注册。

items.de: Lets Foxy browse Bilibili with daily windows and video limits, filter by interests, comment or remember through an editable prompt, reply to mentions and comment threads, and deduplicate per video. Requires dsh-foxy.
items.dz: 让 Foxy 按每日时段和视频上限浏览 B 站，按兴趣筛选，用可编辑提示词评论或记忆，并回复 @ 与评论楼中楼，按视频去重。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

items.de: Connects DSH Foxy to Foxy Memory for cross-platform recall, with local JSONL fallback, platform filters, and a memory browser. Requires dsh-foxy.
items.dz: 把 DSH 的 Foxy 接入 Foxy Memory，支持跨平台召回、本地 JSONL 回退、平台筛选与记忆浏览。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

items.de: See what a conversation actually costs: how many model requests, how big the system prompt and tool table are, cumulative tokens, estimated spend, and how far you are from automatic context compaction. Reads the local session log only; never calls a model, never adds a word to the system prompt. Tok
items.dz: 看清一场对话到底烧了多少：模型请求次数、system prompt 与工具表各占多少、累计 token、估算花费、离上下文自动压缩还有多远。只读本地会话日志，不调模型，不往 system prompt 加一个字。token 与花费均按字符数估算，不是 provider 用量。

items.de: Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.
items.dz: 给一个调用网址就自动配好模型，体检框架健康度，并修复可自动修复的问题。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

items.de: Free Egg credits panel for the DSH sidebar: WorkBuddy / Qoder account balances, daily budget, check-in state and per-turn spend (WorkBuddy credits priced per input / cache / output token type where rates are known), with one-click switching of the platform whose credits are spent first when new-api
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏看 WorkBuddy / Qoder 账号积分、今日额度、签到状态与每轮消耗（WorkBuddy 已知单价时按输入 / 缓存 / 输出分类型折算）；配置 new-api 后可一键切换优先消耗平台。需本机运行 WorkBuddy2API 或 Qoder 网关。

items.de: Keyless image generation with two tools: generate_image (no API key, one call at a time, bounded rate-limit retries) and list_image_models.
items.dz: 无需 API 密钥的图片生成，含两个工具：generate_image（无需密钥、串行调用、有限次限流重试）与 list_image_models。

items.de: Lightweight fork of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search: multi-engine web search and fetch with automatic fallback, failure cooldown and API key rotation; takes over DSH's default web_search/web_fetch providers. Cannot be installed alongside DDDMUC/dsh-free-search (same package name and bundle row).
items.dz: DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的精简分叉：多引擎网页搜索与抓取，自动回退、失败冷却、API 密钥轮换，接管 DSH 默认的 web_search/web_fetch 提供者；不能与 DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 同装（包名与 bundle 行相同）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Two native tools for key-free Chinese/English search via 360, Bing RSS and DuckDuckGo, and static webpage text extraction, without a browser, Python or MCP subprocess.
items.dz: 两个原生工具，提供基于 360、Bing RSS 和 DuckDuckGo 的免 API Key 中英文搜索与静态网页正文读取，无需浏览器、Python 或 MCP 子进程。

items.de: Connects the OpenCode Zen anonymous free lane to DeepSeek Harness: refresh the model list from upstream, tick which models the opencode provider exposes, test any of them with a real request that ends in one of seven verdicts, and order both the settings card and the model selector by a hand-written
items.dz: 接入 OpenCode Zen 匿名免费车道：可刷新上游模型清单、勾选由 provider opencode 暴露的模型、逐个发真实请求得出七档结论，并用人工 S/A/B/C 评级让设置卡片与模型选择器按能力同序。

items.de: Keyless web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness: Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Exa, and more behind a consensus fan-out.
items.dz: 无需 API Key 的网页搜索提供方：并发查询 Startpage、DuckDuckGo、Exa 等多个来源，再做共识合并。

items.de: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
items.dz: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

items.de: Public chat rooms with quoted replies and opt-in encrypted private text chat inside DeepSeek Harness, using a shared Nostr relay and locally protected identities (macOS Keychain or Windows DPAPI; Linux has no identity store, so posting is unsupported).
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内进入公共聊天室交流，支持引用回复、私聊申请和加密文字聊天，通过共同 Nostr 中继互通，身份保存在本机受保护存储中（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI；Linux 无身份保存适配，暂不能发言）。

items.de: A friend system for DeepSeek Harness: two DSH users see whether the other is online and whether their model is running a task, with an editable signature, mood emoji, pokes, and AES-GCM end-to-end encryption over a public relay.
items.dz: DSH 鲸友好友系统：两台 DSH 互相看到对方是否在线、模型是否在跑任务，支持个性签名、心情 emoji、戳一戳，经公共中继做 AES-GCM 端到端加密，无需服务器与注册登录。

items.de: Floating friends list and one-to-one chat for DSH, with custom avatars and status words. The required friends service is in this repository and runs via npx dsh-friends-service or Docker.
items.dz: DSH 好友浮窗，支持一对一聊天、自定义头像和状态词条；所需好友服务端在同一仓库，可用 npx dsh-friends-service 或 Docker 启动。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Registers a frontend-design skill that asks for a design plan and token system before writing code, and ships Chinese typography rules plus a measured no-screenshot self-check. It provides one skill and no tools, makes no network requests and writes no files.
items.dz: 注册一个前端设计技能：写码前先给设计计划与 token 系统，附中文排版规则和可实测的无截图自检。只提供一个技能，无工具、不联网、不写文件。

items.de: After an agent's own bash or shell command, re-observes the files that session had observed, so FS_STALE_VERSION no longer fires on self-inflicted writes but still fires on writes by others.
items.dz: 在 agent 自己的 bash/shell 命令结束后，重新观察该会话此前观察过的文件：自己改文件不再触发 FS_STALE_VERSION，但其他人写入仍会触发。

items.de: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.
items.dz: 右侧文件或浏览器面板进入完整视图时，将原会话保留为可移动、缩放的聊天小窗，支持紧凑输入条、鲸鱼球恢复入口和返回原来的分栏布局。

items.de: Converts half-width punctuation in AI replies to full-width Chinese punctuation, so copied answers stay publication-ready.
items.dz: 将 AI 回答中的半角标点转换为中文全角标点，让复制的回答可直接用于公文材料。

items.de: Replaces the chat's "Deep diving" waiting label with rotating fun phrases, editable live in Settings.
items.dz: 把聊天裡的「深度求索中」等待提示換成會輪換的趣味短語，可在設置介面即時編輯。

items.de: Reports conflicting DeepSeek Harness plugin composition — duplicate loader names across bundles (install-shadow), one id given two names, enable/disable fights, and config keys silently overwritten by a later layer — then emits a patch with the final merged values. Ships a CLI that runs when DSH its
items.dz: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件装配层的冲突：跨 bundle 重复的 loader 名（install-shadow）、同一个 id 被写成两个 name、一层要开一层要关、以及被后一层静默覆盖的配置键，并把覆盖合成终值补丁。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，另有一个会读运行时 loader 的 fusion_report 工具。

items.de: Fusion 360 for DSH: bridges the MCP server Fusion ships (read, execute, update, electronics) with every upstream schema kept byte-for-byte while the always-on tool surface drops 70 percent, adds an editable endpoint under Settings, and wraps a local hf.py modelling loop as nine hf_* tools (needs Pyt
items.dz: 把 Fusion 360 接进 DSH：桥接 Fusion 自带的 MCP 服务（读取、执行、更新、电子设计），上游 schema 逐字节保留而常驻工具面减少 70%，设置页可改端点，并把本地 hf.py 建模闭环包成九个 hf_* 工具（需要 Python 3.10+ 与 fusion-harness 工作区）。

items.de: Simulated FX trading arena played against an algorithmic whale-chan opponent: a live canvas candlestick chart over five instruments (EUR/TOKEN, GBP/TOKEN, TOKEN/JPY, gold, and Whale/TOKEN, her own coin she never shorts), selectable leverage from 10x to 500x, and two modes — a timed mode with 90s to
items.dz: 和大肥鱼（鲸鲸）对打的 FX 模拟盘：Canvas 实时 K 线，五个品种（EUR/TOKEN、GBP/TOKEN、TOKEN/JPY、黄金，以及鲸元/TOKEN——她自己的币，她绝不做空），杠杆可选 10x~500x；两种赛制——计时赛（一局 90s~500s，到点比权益），以及不限时的「重生之久留美归来」：初始资金 30 万，先摸到 2000 万赢，负债（权益跌破 0，没有维持线强平）即出局。对局跑在模块级引擎里，切到会话不会停表也不会重开。保证金与点差均有建模；行情是本地随机游走加偶发消息冲击，全程零联网、零真钱。

items.de: Run DSH sessions on the local Claude Code (Opus, Sonnet), with Galatea's memory and tools. Pick an auth mode in the profile (Anthropic API key recommended, or your existing Claude Code login). Requires the Galatea framework.
items.dz: 让 DSH 会话跑在本机 Claude Code 上（Opus、Sonnet），带着 Galatea 的记忆和工具；需在 profile 里选登录方式（推荐 Anthropic API key，或沿用本机 Claude Code 已有登录）。需要先装 Galatea 框架。

items.de: Galatea: shape an AI assistant of your own. One assistant with its own persona and long-term memory (git-versioned plain files); long chats hand off to a fresh conversation without forgetting, and it tidies its memory in the background while you are away. It runs on whatever model DSH is set to and
items.dz: 加拉忒亚——塑造专属于你的 AI 助手。一个有自己人格和长期记忆（git 版本化的普通文件）的助手；聊得再久也会自己换到新对话、不失忆，你不在时它在后台整理记忆。会话跑在 DSH 里设的模型上，换模型记忆不丢；各模块都能单独关闭，也能用别的插件扩展。QQ/微信聊天与 Claude Code 会话由另外两个 Galatea 插件提供。预览版，需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Chat with your Galatea assistant from QQ (official bot) and WeChat: the same conversation, persona and memory as on the desktop, only the paired owner's private chat is accepted, replies go back where you wrote, and more chat apps can be added. Requires the Galatea framework.
items.dz: 在 QQ（官方机器人）、微信上和 Galatea 助手聊天：和桌面是同一段对话、同一个人格和记忆，只接收配对本人的私聊，回复发回你说话的地方，可扩展更多聊天软件。需要先装 Galatea 框架。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A panel plugin that keeps mini-games in one place and plays them in the same window. Ships with Tetris: a 10x20 board, seven pieces, a ghost piece and a next-piece preview, line and level scoring, three difficulty levels, and a best score kept in localStorage.
items.dz: 面板插件：把开发的小游戏集中到一处，并在同一窗口内直接游玩。首发俄罗斯方块：10×20 棋盘、七种方块、落点虚影与下一个方块预览、消行与等级计分、三档难度，最高分存在 localStorage。

items.de: Game market and runtime for DSH. While the agent runs a long task, a game fills the main workspace and a small whale in the corner shows the agent state (working, waiting for you, done, error); progress is saved and continues next time. Ships five built-in games, a game SDK and CLI, and a community
items.dz: DSH 的游戏市场与运行时。Agent 跑长任务时，游戏铺满主工作区，右下角的小鲸鱼显示 Agent 状态（运行中、等你、完成、出错）；进度自动保存，下次接着玩。内置五款游戏，提供游戏 SDK 与 CLI，并可从市场安装社区游戏。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to dsh-game.local

items.de: Pushes a notification when a long agent turn finishes, a turn fails, or an approval waits too long, via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, ServerChan, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram or a webhook. Port of @magpie-community/gateway-notify (MIT); the upstream is a magpie API-gateway plugin that does not install in
items.dz: 长任务结束、回合失败或审批等待过久时推送通知，支持 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 与 webhook。移植自 @magpie-community/gateway-notify（MIT）；上游是 magpie API 网关插件，无法装进 DSH，两者不会同装。

items.de: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

items.de: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole re
items.dz: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

items.de: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
items.dz: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next cha
items.dz: 让 AI 在对话中或侧边栏里插入流式生成的 UI，以 TSX 书写——模型的母语之一，不必再教它一套 JSON schema。流式渲染不闪烁，状态跨帧保留、无硬刷新，对 UI 的点击直接驱动下一轮对话。inline 形态流式最重要，side canvas 形态更 agentic。卡片内部同样具备 agentic 能力——执行 bash、curl、调用模型、读写文件。

items.de: Opens the official Genshin Impact site and downloads the official launcher when DeepSeek Harness starts.
items.dz: DSH 启动后自动打开《原神》官网并下载官方安装器。

items.de: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
items.dz: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

items.de: Genspark tools for DeepSeek Harness - web search, crawl, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, X/Instagram/Reddit search and model listing through @genspark/cli, with 17 typed tools and 18 /genspark-* commands. Requires @genspark/cli installed and logged in (gsk login), or GSK_API_KEY set.
items.dz: 将 Genspark 能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：网页搜索、抓取、图片/视频/音频生成、媒体理解、X/Instagram/Reddit 搜索与模型列表，提供 17 个工具和 18 个 /genspark-* 命令。需安装并登录 @genspark/cli（gsk login），或设置 GSK_API_KEY。

items.de: Trims the GenUI card component prompt per global, workspace, or session scope; the built-in presets cut 24% to 61% of the prompt.
items.dz: 按全局、工作区、会话三级裁剪 GenUI 卡片组件提示词；内置预设削减 24% 到 61% 的提示词。

items.de: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64), and run GIS summary/buffer/overlay on SHP/GeoJSON/KML — pure-JS parsing, no GDAL.
items.dz: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

items.de: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the intro but capped by real DSH boot milestones. Any bare key skips it, ten palettes come from Monument Valley and Geometric Islands, and when the
items.dz: 页面级启动开屏：彭罗斯三角在等距菱格海面上旋转受光，取景框本身就是进度计，按开屏节奏平滑推进、以真实 DSH 启动完成度为上限；按任意键跳过，主题坞提供 Monument Valley / Geometric Islands 十套色板。开屏结束后三角留在输入框旁，作为一枚反映当前工作状态的小标记。

items.de: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
items.dz: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/o
items.dz: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

items.de: Git panel with commit graphs, file diffs, branch and worktree management, and AI-assisted commit message previews.
items.dz: Git 面板，支持提交图、文件差异、分支与工作树管理，以及 AI 辅助生成提交说明预览。

items.de: VSCode/IDEA-style Git source control in the DSH right sidebar, with a colour-coded commit graph, branch switching, staging, hunk actions, stash and history filters.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供类 VSCode/IDEA 的 Git 源码管理，含彩色提交图、分支切换、暂存与逐块操作、stash 与历史过滤。

items.de: Shows the repository, branch, working-tree change count and short commit SHA on the composer row, with a searchable branch switcher and a per-file diff pane in the right sidebar.
items.dz: 在输入框那一行显示仓库、分支、改动数与短 SHA；点分支可搜索、切换或新建分支，点改动数在右侧边栏打开逐文件 diff 面板。

items.de: Keep your git workflow inside DeepSeek Harness. A composer chip shows the current branch at a glance; the TRAE-style popup lets you switch or create branches, fetch remotes, commit & push a subset of changes, merge with a clear source -> target flow, and stash / restore partial changes — all without
items.dz: 让 git 操作不离开 DSH 聊天窗口。输入框工具行的胶囊实时显示当前分支；TRAE 风格弹层一键切换/新建分支、同步远端、勾选改动提交推送、按来源 -> 目标流向合并分支、暂存与恢复部分改动。所有面板停靠在输入框上方，不遮挡草稿；菜单打开时预取改动列表；工作区不干净时先确认再操作。非 git 目录自动隐藏。

items.de: A right-sidebar Git tab for DeepSeek Harness that lists working-tree changes with inline diffs and the commit graph, commits (locally or with a push), fast-forward pulls, and switches branches while the working tree is clean.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏 Git 页签：列出工作区改动并内联显示差异、浏览提交树，支持一键提交（仅本地或提交并推送）、快进拉取，并在工作区干净时切换分支。

items.de: Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated commit messages, and line blame. A fork of sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1; install either this or the upstream panel, not both.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

items.de: DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.
items.dz: DSH 斜杠命令 /commit：暂存全部更改，用会话当前模型总结暂存区 diff 后提交；不依赖浏览器界面，模型调用失败时回退到本地规则生成提交信息。

items.de: Floating commit panel for the DSH web UI: it appears when the current session workspace has unstaged or untracked changes, takes a hand-written or AI-drafted commit message (AI drafts follow Conventional Commit), and commits or commits and pushes. Works in the DSH web UI and CLI only; the desktop ap
items.dz: DSH 网页界面的悬浮提交面板：当前对话所在工作区出现未暂存或未跟踪改动时浮出，提交信息可手写或由 AI 起草（AI 起草按 Conventional Commit 生成），支持提交与提交并推送。仅支持 DSH Web / CLI，桌面版无法安装。

items.de: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff
items.dz: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

items.de: Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: staging, commits, branch switching, fetch/pull/push, worktrees, a Cursor-style commit graph and GitHub pull requests (the GitHub card needs a GitHub token). It drives the system git binary, so the panel and the terminal always agree.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏 Git 面板：暂存、提交、切换分支、fetch/pull/push、工作树、Cursor 风格提交图与 GitHub PR（GitHub 卡片需要 GitHub 令牌）。直接调用系统 git，面板与终端状态保持一致。

items.de: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
items.dz: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

items.de: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.

items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码库知识图谱：7 个 graphify_* Agent 工具、/graphify 命令与 Graphify 页面，用本地 AST 解析构建并查询项目图谱（无需 API Key），支持路径 / 解释 / 枢纽节点查询与 wiki、HTML、SVG、GraphML、Obsidian 导出。需先安装 graphify CLI（graphifyy）；只有含文档 / PDF / 图片的完整抽取需要 LLM Key。

items.de: Carve one sentence into a clean text-free background image — 87 illustration, anime and infographic styles, four image APIs wired in, plus prompt expansion that fills in the details you cannot describe.

items.de: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.

items.de: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree snapshots, click by control name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.

items.dz: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 后自动回到最近一次对话；实现方式是在 DSH 数据目录里保存一个指针文件，不修改引擎文件。

items.de: Turns the DSH web UI into the H.D.D Hollow Deep Dive terminal from Zenless Zone Zero: the sidebar and composer are reskinned. Ships a small read-only host half plus the web skin; switch it off and DSH returns to its native light UI.

items.de: A full-frame animated HUD background for the DSH Web GUI — a rotating light ring that mirrors the live session, with token capture and tool beams following the token stream and tool calls. Press C for the settings panel (117 parameters, six palettes, presets, import/export); press H to show or hide

items.dz: DSH Harmony 鸿蒙原生客户端的插件端：通过宿主令牌交换完成原生登录（可选 Pocket ID Passkey），提供会话列表与实时更新、任务概览、按设备设置的通知等级和网页会话定位；以预构建 tarball 发布，无需独立 relay 或常驻网关进程。

items.dz: 会话右上角的「重启 / 注销」电源按钮。

items.de: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
items.dz: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds a Herdr panel to the DSH sidebar that opens a host PTY running the `herdr` command and renders it with xterm.js. The connection list comes from the plugin config (`connections`, or the flat `remote`/`session`/`command` keys; with no config it runs plain `herdr`), so the panel can point at any m
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏新增 Herdr 面板，通过宿主 PTY 运行 `herdr` 命令并用 xterm.js 渲染。连接列表来自插件配置（`connections`，或扁平的 `remote`/`session`/`command`；不配置时只跑 `herdr`），可指向任意机器。启动命令每个终端只发送一次，切换面板或刷新页面不会重复开会话。需要本机已安装 Herdr CLI。

items.de: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
items.dz: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

items.de: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
items.dz: DSH 的任务队列执行端点：需要自行部署独立的 Hermes Agent 网关并编写自己的微信入站脚本；仅在单一环境验证过，需要按你的环境适配。

items.de: A Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: WebSocket inbound messaging, Markdown tables rendered as native Feishu table components, 13 Feishu tools, a web settings page, voice input/output, media upload and a model fallback chain.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 通道：长连接收发消息、Markdown 表格渲染成飞书原生 table 组件、13 个飞书操作工具，带 Web 设置页、语音收发、媒体上传与模型故障转移链。

items.de: Auto-detects whichever memory tool local Hermes uses, then reuses its skills and memory in DeepSeek Harness, with always-available recall. Needs python3 and a local Hermes installation; it only reads from Hermes.
items.dz: 自动识别本机 Hermes 当前使用的记忆工具，把技能与记忆实时接入 DSH，检索始终可用。需要 python3 与本机已装的 Hermes；对 Hermes 只读。

items.de: Custom main-screen headline: replaces the new-session headline with a rotating pool of custom text; plus an independently switchable composer border marquee with glow, band speed, brightness, width, breathing, per-view scope and a focus-only mode in Settings.
items.dz: 主界面标语自定义：把新会话页的标语换成一组自定义文本按时轮换；另含可独立开关的输入框边框跑马灯，色带沿边缘流动、外圈带辉光，速度、亮度、宽度、呼吸、生效范围与仅聚焦可在设置中调节。

items.de: Adds the models of your own GPU Hugging Face Space to the model selector, starts the Space when you send a message, shows its start progress, and pauses it when idle or at a time limit. Requires a Hugging Face account with a GPU Space serving an OpenAI-compatible API, a Hugging Face token stored in
items.dz: 将你自己的 Hugging Face GPU Space 中的模型加入模型选择器，发送消息时启动该 Space，显示启动进度，并在空闲或达到时限时将其暂停。需要 Hugging Face 账号、一个提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 的 GPU Space、在 DSH 凭据库中以 HF_TOKEN 保存的 Hugging Face token，以及 GPU 硬件所需的付费计划；GPU 机时由 Hugging Face 计费。

items.de: Hides the signed-in deepseek-account model group from the model picker and rewrites an already-saved account selection to deepseek-official in prepareCall and stream, so a stale conversation cannot spend on the account; no settings page and no runtime dependencies. Requires an official API key confi
items.dz: 在模型选择器中隐藏登录账号的 deepseek-account 模型分组，并在 prepareCall 与 stream 中把已保存的账号选择改写到 deepseek-official，旧会话不会再扣账号额度；没有设置页，也没有运行时依赖。需先在「设置 → 模型」配置官方 API Key，否则隐藏账号分组后就没有模型可选。

items.de: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
items.dz: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

items.de: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item
items.dz: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

items.de: Select any sentence in a DSH chat session and mark it with a colored highlight (yellow, green or blue). Marks are drawn on an independent overlay so framework re-renders cannot wipe them, are anchored by quote context, stored per session and persist across restarts until deleted individually.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话界面划选任意语句即可标为高亮色块（黄/绿/蓝）。色块画在独立覆盖层上， 框架重渲染冲不掉；按引文上下文锚定，按会话分文件持久保存、跨重启保留，可单独删除。

items.de: Runs Hindsight long-term memory on your own machine: after a one-time uvx --from hindsight-embed@latest hindsight-embed profile create server setup (~450 MB of Python dependencies) and with your own LLM key, the plugin manages the local memory server itself (health probe, start, stop, logs), registe
items.dz: 把 Hindsight 长期记忆放到自己的机器上跑：先用 uvx --from hindsight-embed@latest hindsight-embed profile create 做一次性服务安装（约 450 MB Python 依赖）并自备 LLM key，之后插件自己管理本地记忆服务（探活、启动、停止、看日志），注册 10 个 hindsight_local_* 工具（状态、页面检索、读页、召回、写入、反思），每场会话开始时注入一次知识页索引、轮次结束把对话片段写回记忆库，抽取用你自己的 LLM key。不要与官方 @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-ag

items.de: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a Hindsight memory service using the same conventions as omp: one shared bank, automatic project-tag stamping, project plus global recall, plus tools for mental models, duplicate detection and retrying failed background operations. Requires a running Hindsight server (def
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Hindsight 记忆服务，沿用与 omp 相同的约定：单一共享 bank、自动打项目标签、项目层与全局层同时召回，并提供精神模型、重复检测与失败后台任务重试工具。需要本机已运行 Hindsight 服务（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8888）。

items.de: Hippocampus: renders workspace files, DSH memories and past sessions as a rotatable neuron graph in the sidebar, with Chinese-friendly labels and automatic re-indexing on every start.
items.dz: 海马体：把工作区文件、DSH 记忆和历史会话画成一张可旋转的神经元网络，挂在侧栏随时翻；条目名自动整理成中文短句，每次启动自动重新索引。

items.de: Per-conversation toggle that makes the model answer in classical Chinese (文言 above a —— line, a modern-Chinese translation below) and speak as a blue classical-style fish that eats plain rice; each conversation keeps its own switch, and turning it off restores plain modern Chinese.
items.dz: 按对话独立的文言文开关：开启后模型改用文言行文（上段文言、中间「——」、下段白话译注），并化身蓝色古风、惯吃白饭的大肥鱼；每个对话各自记住开关，关闭即恢复现代汉语并隐去人格。

items.de: Tracks successful DSH plugin installs per device, merges the ledger across devices through a user-authorized Baidu Netdisk account, and supports preflighted batch reinstalls.
items.dz: 按设备记录 DSH 插件成功安装历史，通过用户授权的百度网盘账号跨设备合并账本，并支持预检后的批量重装。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds one agent tool (read-only on your transcripts) that searches Claude Code, Codex and DSH session transcripts and returns each match with its resume command. Needs ripgrep (rg) and zstd (zstdcat) on PATH and keeps a plain-text cache of DSH sessions under ~/.dsh/cache/history-search.
items.dz: 给智能体增加一个检索 Claude Code、Codex 与 DSH 会话记录的工具（不改动原记录），并为每条结果给出恢复命令。需要 PATH 上有 ripgrep（rg）与 zstd（zstdcat），并会在 ~/.dsh/cache/history-search 保留 DSH 会话的明文缓存。

items.de: Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. Each hold takes an optional send time and a choice to queue, wait or steer, and lives on the host with its attachments so a restart does not lose it.
items.dz: 暂缓发送一条消息，直到主智能体空闲、没有子智能体在运行、也没有后台任务，然后再发出。每条暂缓可以设置发送时间，并选择排队、等待空闲或立即插话，消息与附件都保存在宿主端，重启也不会丢失。

items.de: Read-only Home Assistant panel for DeepSeek Harness: a full status overview, a compact right-sidebar card, a system-prompt environment block, one read-only ha_status tool, and optional browser notifications on Home Assistant down/recover. Configure the instance URL and token once; it does not contro
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Home Assistant 只读面板：完整状态总览、右侧栏速览卡、系统提示词环境块、一个只读 ha_status 工具，以及可选的 HA 不可用/恢复浏览器通知。配置一次实例地址与令牌；不控制设备，也不修改 Home Assistant 配置。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to homeassistant.local:8123

items.de: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of
items.dz: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原、蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警，以及可选的 JSONL 替换计数日志（只记来源与类别计数，绝不记录真实值）。

items.de: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
items.dz: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

items.de: Codex-inspired lifecycle command hooks for DSH, with explicit tool-input sharing, pre-tool deny policies, notifications, and local audit examples.
items.dz: DSH 的 Codex 风格生命周期命令钩子，支持工具参数显式共享、执行前拒绝，以及通知与本地审计示例。

items.de: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DSH: block or observe tool calls, and react to completed turns, messages, and title changes with shell commands.
items.dz: 配置驱动的 DSH 生命周期 hooks：拦截或观察工具调用，并对回合完成、用户消息和标题变化执行 shell 命令。

items.de: Left-sidebar panel that browses the filesystem of the machine the Harness runs on: directory listings with sizes and modification times, text and image previews, file downloads, file uploads into the open directory, and folder creation. The panel speaks twelve languages. Reads and writes run with th
items.dz: 左侧边栏面板，浏览运行 Harness 的宿主机文件系统：带大小与修改时间的目录列表、文本与图片预览、文件下载、向当前目录上传文件，以及新建文件夹。面板支持十二种语言。读写操作使用运行 Harness 的账户权限。

items.de: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
items.dz: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

items.de: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).
items.dz: 把桌面壳的文件路径桥接发布为输入框读取的 host-path 接口，让拖入输入框的文件与文件夹变成 @path 引用而不是上传副本（图片仍走原生图片通道上传）。

items.de: Reload a plugin's source the moment a file changes, without restarting the harness. Covers the third-party plugin case the built-in watcher misses because it skips node_modules.
items.dz: 改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DSH。补上宿主内置热重载因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。

items.de: Adds a "Hot restart" row under "Sign out" in the DSH account menu; it reconciles the profile plugin tree in place and reloads the page, without restarting the DSH process or dropping the current conversation.
items.dz: 在 DSH 账号菜单「退出登录」下面加一行「热重启」：原地对账 profile 插件树并刷新页面，不重启 DSH 进程，当前对话不丢。

items.de: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read
items.dz: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

items.de: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence translates it. Ships an offline dictionary: 20,499 entries, 8,960 with bilingual examples, 6,374 with root analysis.
items.dz: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

items.de: Provides a structured, per-session resume editor for DeepSeek Harness with shared chat and sidebar edits, A4 preview, and PDF export.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化简历编辑器；每个会话独立保存草稿，对话与侧栏共用内容，并提供 A4 预览和 PDF 导出。

items.de: HS code classification consistency check: chapter, heading, subheading and code hierarchy.
items.dz: HS 编码归类层级一致性核对：章、品目、子目与商品编号层级。

items.de: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
items.dz: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

items.de: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.
items.dz: HTML 选区模式：点选本机 demo 页面中的任意元素，定位信息（选择器、文本、HTML 片段）自动写入对话输入框，供 AI 精准修改。

items.de: Adds an http_probe tool for endpoint health checks: status code, latency and key response headers, using HEAD with GET fallback; response bodies are never downloaded.
items.dz: 为 agent 增加 http_probe 工具：探测 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟与关键响应头，HEAD 被拒时自动降级 GET，不下载响应体。

items.de: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.
items.dz: dsh划词评论（dsh-huaci-pinglun）：基于 BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 的 MIT 修补分支，提供划词评论与引用对话，修复引用文本框在挂载并可见后测量、补齐边框高度与长文滚动。

items.de: Delete sessions into a searchable recycle bin, then restore them or remove them permanently from the DSH sidebar. Desktop only: install it into the DSH Desktop profile; it supports the Desktop Web GUI only.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话删除到可搜索的回收站，再从侧栏恢复或彻底删除。仅限 DSH Desktop：需装进 Desktop profile，且只支持 Desktop 的 Web GUI。

items.de: Pauses a DSH task at steps that need a human, such as 2FA codes, QR scans, signatures or payments, and shows a native card with done, skip and cancel actions.
items.dz: 人工步骤：在需要人做的步骤（验证码、扫码、签字、付款）弹出 DSH 原生卡片，用户点完成、跳过或取消后才继续。

items.de: Prose review for human-facing writes. The write and edit tools require a human_facing flag; the plugin reviews the text against layered PROSE.md rules in the background, stages annotations, reconciles them against the full file, and merges them through /humanize, /humanize-loop or post-compaction wh
items.dz: 面向人类写入内容的行文审查。write 和 edit 调用需声明 human_facing，插件在后台按分层 PROSE.md 规则审查文本并暂存批注，再按全文核对已有批注，主会话照常推进；用 /humanize、/humanize-loop 或压缩后自动合并批注，/humanize-review 按需批量审查 git 管理的文件。

items.de: An on-demand Chinese editing skill that reduces formulaic phrasing while preserving facts, uncertainty, genre, and author voice.
items.dz: 按需润色中文文本，减少模板化表达，同时保留事实、确定程度、文体和作者声音。

items.de: Three-tier memory (personal, project, session) built on the Hy-Memory engine, with relevant memories injected before each step. Ships seven memory tools (search, add, list, get, update, delete, forget), a settings panel with per-tier lists, editing, change history and duplicate cleanup, real token a
items.dz: 基于 Hy-Memory 引擎的三层记忆（个人、项目、会话），每一步之前注入相关记忆。提供七个记忆工具（搜索、新增、列表、读取、更新、删除、遗忘），设置面板可分层浏览、编辑、查看变更历史、清理重复项；按写入实测统计 token；会话结束时由引擎生成会话摘要；并从最近的记忆中汇总用户画像。支持与 MemHub 互导。首次使用需要 Python 3.11+（或 uv，它会自行下载 3.12）安装引擎；卸载不会删除已存记忆。

items.de: In-app browser for DSH: a dedicated Chromium rooted at a persistent profile so a Feishu or SSO login survives restarts, driven over CDP, exposing seven agent tools (status, open, eval, read, feishu, screenshot, tabs) and mirroring the page live in a right-sidebar panel that tool calls open by themse
items.dz: DSH 内置浏览器：独立 Chromium 配合持久化 profile，飞书或 SSO 登录一次跨重启有效，经 CDP 驱动，提供七个 Agent 工具（status、open、eval、read、feishu、screenshot、tabs），并把页面实时镜像到右侧栏面板——工具调用时面板会自动打开。另可按虚拟滚动回扫把飞书文档转成 Markdown。需本机已装 Chrome / Edge / Chromium 或 Playwright 的 Chromium 构建（不会自动下载）；可用 DSH_IAB_CHROME 指定可执行文件。

items.de: Bridges the official IAR C-SPY MCP server into DeepSeek Harness: build .ewp projects, start simulator or hardware debug sessions, and read variables, registers, memory, the call stack and target output from the conversation. Windows only, and it needs an IAR Embedded Workbench installation. Setup ne
items.dz: 把官方 IAR C-SPY MCP Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness：在对话里编译 .ewp 工程、在模拟器或硬件上启动调试会话，并查看变量、寄存器、内存、调用栈与目标输出。仅支持 Windows，需要本机安装 IAR Embedded Workbench。安装配置需要 Python 3.10+、Git，并能访问 GitHub 与 PyPI。

items.de: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
items.dz: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

items.de: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 JetBrains IDE 桥（Windows）：以 DSH bundle 安装，发布带 token 的 DSH 地址、注册当前 IDE 项目、转发 IDE MCP，并提供带流式输出、审批、Plan/Act、插话、会话切换与归档过滤的精简工具窗口面板；对应的 IDEA 插件附在同一 Release，可由 DSH agent 代装。

items.dz: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

items.de: IFC model quantity take-off with CSV export for quantity checking.

The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.
items.dz: 在右栏新增一个面板，用来并排对比用户自己从工作区挑选的一组图片——每页 1/2/3/4/6 张、每张独立缩放与平移、可把某一张的缩放与显示位置同步到整组、缩略图可拖动排序。图片由浏览器直接加载，不进入模型。

items.de: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
items.dz: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

items.dz: 带提示词自动增强、可切换多个 API 配置，并在 Turn 尾展示不被折叠的图片卡片的生图工具。需自行配置图像 API 地址与密钥，插件不内置。

items.de: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them i

items.de: Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.

items.de: Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, co
items.dz: 同一张图片只在它第一次出现的那一次请求里以 base64 内联；之后的每次请求都携带被标记为 offloaded 的同一个块，由 DSH 自带的图片 offload 投影渲染成带本地只读路径的占位文字。记账键是会话 id、消息 id、内容树路径与 attachment id 的组合，且请求产生第一个 chunk 之后才记账，因此重试不会算作已发送。带 purpose 的辅助请求既不改写也不记账；事后再对同一文件调用 read_image 算一次新的 occurrence 并重新内联一次；插件只改写该次请求的副本，不写回会话。

items.de: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).

items.de: Sidebar image workbench with separate Agnes / OpenAI GPT Image / Grok / OpenAI-compatible keys, text-to-image and up to five reference images, local history, an image_studio_generate tool for /image, and an in-panel GitHub update button.

Replaces the local attachment store;

items.de: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH: eight memory layers, four notebooks, hybrid SQLite FTS5/vector/graph retrieval, agent-driven automatic capture, write lifecycle hooks, optional write audit, project spaces, forgetting and a visual management page. Full FTS5/vector/graph retrieval needs the bun

items.de: DeepSeek Harness port of the Impeccable frontend-design skill: 24 design playbooks covering shaping, critique, audit, polish, layout, typography, motion, accessibility and design-system documentation, driven by the reference files shipped in the skill plus PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md in the project inste

items.dz: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

items.de: Reader-first long-form fiction pipeline: setting and character cards first, 21 gate scripts, a 1000-trope library and 700 theme seeds, at most two tropes per chapter, a self-test for every script; the scripts run on the host's Python 3.
items.dz: 读者优先的长篇小说工序：人物卡与设定卡先行、21 个门禁脚本、1000 条桥段与 700 条主题种子、每章最多两个桥段，每个脚本自带自检；脚本依赖宿主上的 Python 3 运行。

items.de: Daily remote job hunting across BOSS Zhipin, Liepin, LinkedIn and other Chinese job boards, scored against a saved profile and shown in a Harness panel. Requires a local Chrome/Chromium install (the plugin launches its own browser profile) and a BOSS Zhipin account for BOSS results.
items.dz: 每天从 BOSS直聘、猎聘、LinkedIn 等招聘站抓取远程岗位，按求职画像打分并显示在 Harness 面板里。需本机安装 Chrome/Chromium（插件使用独立浏览器配置），BOSS直聘结果需登录 BOSS 账号。

items.de: A dedicated background-job dashboard for the DSH Web UI: merges jobs from every session, shows producer-reported or parsed progress with an honest estimate fallback, groups by status, purpose, session or kind, streams live output, and keeps a local history ledger.
items.dz: 跨会话的后台任务面板：进度按「任务自报 / 输出解析 / 历史耗时估算」三档显示，可按状态、用途、会话或类型分组，支持实时输出、输出内搜索与本地历史台账。

items.de: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

items.de: Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.
items.dz: 可拖动的后台任务浮动卡片：从 wget/curl/apt/pip 等输出解析进度条与百分比，显示耗时、剩余时间（有则显示）和最新一行输出。

items.de: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
items.dz: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

items.de: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
items.dz: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

items.de: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
items.dz: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

items.de: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
items.dz: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

items.de: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzP
items.dz: 通过 MCP 将智能体连接到 JuzPost（社交媒体排程工具）：列出已连接账号、检查各平台限制、上传媒体，并向 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、X、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Tumblr 和 WordPress 起草、排程或发布帖子。注册 mcp__juzpost__* 工具及一个发布前先向用户确认的工作流技能。需要在 JUZPOST_API_KEY 中提供 JuzPost API 密钥；JuzPost 的 API 密钥需付费方案才能创建。

items.de: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

The npm package ships no question-
items.dz: 离线公务员备考学习面板，整合 16 个上游开源题库，提供 SRS 错题本、整卷模考、申论离线评改、可交互知识图谱与白盒可观测，另有花生十三体系方法论视图（25 篇）与 BM25 检索。npm 包不含题库与语料数据：安装后由题库管理用 git 从上游克隆必选包（约 360 MB，需要 git），16 个上游仓库全量约 2.2 GB。

items.de: Makes copying math from DSH chat put LaTeX source ($...$ or $$...$$) on the clipboard instead of rendered KaTeX markup; code blocks and the prompt box keep native copy behavior.
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话里复制含公式的内容时，剪贴板里得到 $...$ / $$...$$ 的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 渲染碎片；代码块与输入框保持原生复制。

items.de: Bundles the kb-curator skill, which keeps a local three-layer knowledge base and refuses to index anything the user has not approved. The L2 retrieval layer needs @kenz1117/dsh-engram installed separately, and the engine runs on Windows only.
items.dz: 捆绑 kb-curator 技能，用本地三层知识库保存资料，未获用户批准前不写入索引。L2 检索层需另装 @kenz1117/dsh-engram，且引擎目前仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Pulls your chat.deepseek.com conversations into a local knowledge base — one Markdown file per conversation, a JSONL transcript and a catalog — and searches them from a control page inside DSH. Daily increments plus a full-history backfill from the official export, an integrity check, and an optiona
items.dz: 把 chat.deepseek.com 的对话抓进本地知识库——每条会话一份 Markdown、一份 JSONL 语料和一个目录，并在 DSH 的控制页里检索。日常增量之外，可用官方导出包全量回填历史，带完整性体检；可选的模型整理步走宿主 llm 服务，JSON 校验通过才落盘。网页端 userToken 从 DSH 凭据服务读取，出网只连 chat.deepseek.com；无安装脚本、无运行依赖。

items.dz: 在任务运行期间通过原生电源断言保持 DSH 主机亮屏与唤醒，并在任务结束后释放。

items.de: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai
items.dz: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

items.de: Per-provider API key pool for DeepSeek Harness with manual switching, background reachability probing and plan-usage adapters for DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Zhipu, OpenRouter and other providers.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分提供商 API 密钥池，支持手动切换、后台可达性探测与 DeepSeek、Kimi、MiniMax、智谱、OpenRouter 等多家服务商的套餐用量适配器。
