items.de: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
items.dz: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

items.de: Pure JavaScript macOS Keychain credentials provider for DeepSeek Harness, replacing plaintext .credentials.yaml storage and fully supporting both refs and records without native builds, signing, or Xcode.
items.dz: 纯 JavaScript 实现的 macOS Keychain 凭据提供器，替换 DeepSeek Harness 的明文 .credentials.yaml 存储，完整支持 refs 和 records，无需原生构建、代码签名或 Xcode。

items.de: Configures from the settings window's General page whether Enter, Shift+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter send the message or insert a line break; the engine default is kept until you change it.
items.dz: 在设置窗口的通用页配置 Enter、Shift+Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 是发送消息还是换行；未改动前完全保持引擎默认行为。

items.de: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer) skin for the DSH Web UI: a night-forest palette applied through the stable token layer, nine rotating wallpapers served by the plugin host, a flame band, and a two-button dock to toggle the skin and change the picture.
items.dz: 《鬼灭之刃》DSH Web 皮肤：通过稳定令牌层应用鬼杀队配色，插件宿主提供的 9 张轮换壁纸、顶部火焰带，右下角两颗按钮分别负责开关皮肤与换壁纸。

items.de: Voice dictation scratchpad: realtime speech-to-text into timestamped, per-session blocks, with one-click insert into the conversation composer. Requires the official DSH voice-input bundle (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle); the speech model downloads on first use.
items.dz: 语音听写文本板：边说边出字，生成按会话隔离的时间戳文本块，一键加入会话输入框。 需先安装 DSH 官方语音输入插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle，语音模型在首次使用时下载。

items.de: Runs loudness normalization, silence trimming, format conversion and batch processing through local ffmpeg, with presets for game sound effects, music uploads and voice cleanup.
items.dz: 本地音频后期：响度标准化、静音裁剪、格式转换，以及游戏音效与音乐平台上传的一键预设，由本机 ffmpeg 驱动。

items.de: Matches each new task against installed skills with deterministic keyword scoring and injects the best one without being asked; records effective operations as per-skill notes for later runs.
items.dz: 按当前任务自动挑选并注入最合适的技能，无需点名或手动插入；同一技能每次会话只注入一次，并可从有效操作中积累经验。

items.de: Windows only: runs a build command through cmd.exe, collects the artifacts with sizes and SHA-256 prefixes, verifies expected outputs, and writes a report for each run.
items.dz: 仅限 Windows：通过 cmd.exe 执行构建命令、收集产物（大小与 SHA-256 前缀）、校验预期输出，每次运行留一份报告。

items.de: Stores provider API keys in one local pool and hands out the least-used enabled key over a loopback-only endpoint, tracking usage counters without proxying requests.
items.dz: 本机 AI 密钥池：密钥只存一处，通过仅限本机的接口按用量轮询借出，统计调用次数但不转发请求。

items.de: Checks a DSH profile manifest for JSON errors and dependency/bundle/patch mismatches, reads recent startup crash logs (Windows DSH Desktop only), and can back up or roll back the manifest files.
items.dz: 校验 DSH 配置清单的 JSON 错误与依赖/打包/补丁不一致，读取最近启动崩溃日志（仅 Windows 桌面端），并支持备份与回滚清单文件。

items.de: Reports how much disk each project’s sessions use, archives old sessions into a dated folder, and deletes only after an explicit confirmation token.
items.dz: 会话打理：看清会话存储涨在哪、安全归档旧会话，只有明确确认令牌才真正删除。

items.de: Runs project checks described in a dsh-checkup.json file (files, syntax, JSON, HTTP health, asset counts, and any node/npm scripts or commands you list) and falls back to auto-detected defaults when no profile exists.
items.dz: 按项目里的 dsh-checkup.json 运行检查（文件、语法、JSON、HTTP 健康、资源计数，以及你列出的 node/npm 脚本与命令），没有配置时回退到自动探测的默认项。

items.de: Extracts chapters, numbered clauses, keyword tables and numeric values from a docx, txt or md rulebook into JSON, and flags duplicate clauses and missing values.
items.dz: 把桌游或跑团规则书（docx/txt/md）抽成结构化 JSON：章节、编号条款、关键词表与数值，并检查缺失数值和重复条目。

items.de: Scans a workspace for plaintext API keys, flags files inside git repositories, and reports findings masked so no full secret is ever printed.
items.dz: 本地密钥审计：找出明文 API Key、检查密钥共享开关，输出打码报告，绝不打印完整密钥。

items.de: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dr
items.dz: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

items.de: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
items.dz: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

items.de: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
items.dz: 提示词场景选择器：下拉选场景即自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送。

items.de: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
items.dz: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

items.de: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
items.dz: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

items.de: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
items.dz: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

items.de: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: imports Word/PPT/Excel/PDF (text or scanned), EPUB and MOBI/AZW3, builds Markdown parts with page anchors, OCR quality/confidence and column-aware PDF reading order; adds an LLM-maintained wiki layer (schema.md rules, auto index.md, append-only log.md
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：导入 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF（文字版或扫描版）、EPUB、MOBI/AZW3，生成带页码锚点、OCR 质量/置信度与 PDF 双栏阅读顺序的 Markdown 分块；并提供 LLM 维护的编译层（schema.md 维护规范、自动 index.md 内容索引、只追加 log.md、带来源与反链的 typed 笔记），支持来源可信度标注（高/中/低）与可信度感知检索、低可信提醒，以及排序检索、跨库查询、精读修订与 md/jsonl/zip 导出。MOBI/AZW3 需 Calibre；旧版 .doc/.ppt 需 Word/PowerP

items.de: A local-first sidebar knowledge base for a DSH workspace: indexes projects, documents and plugins, classifies entries automatically, and provides search, file previews and editable notes. Data stays in the workspace.
items.dz: 本地优先的 DSH 工作区侧边栏知识库：索引项目、文档和插件，自动归类，支持搜索、文件预览和可编辑笔记；数据保存在工作区。

items.de: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
items.dz: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

items.de: Knowledge-point notebook for DeepSeek Harness: turns a Markdown notes folder into a card canvas — folder = chapter, file = section, body = knowledge points — with masked-answer questions for self-testing, KaTeX formulas, Mermaid flowcharts, a mind map view and in-panel editing.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 知识点笔记插件：把 Markdown 笔记目录变成卡片式学习画布，目录 = 章节、文件 = 小节、正文 = 知识点；题目可遮挡答案自测，支持 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 流程图、思维导图与面板内编辑。

items.de: Desktop-pet lab assistant for DSH that keeps experiment records, accumulates per-software notes, and generates Word/Markdown lab reports from real step-by-step evidence. The desktop pet and lab panel require the Windows desktop build of DSH; other profiles get the conversational tools only.
items.dz: 面向高校实验课程的 DSH 桌宠式插件：保存实验档案、按软件累积经验、用真实步骤证据生成 Word/Markdown 实验报告，并提供黄色高框指引与「点一下自动判对错」的教学循环。桌宠与实验助手面板仅在 Windows 桌面端出现，其他环境只有对话工具可用。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Unlock password-protected LabVIEW VI and CTL block diagrams without LabVIEW or Python.
items.dz: 无需 LabVIEW 或 Python，直接解锁受密码保护的 LabVIEW VI/CTL 程序框图。

items.de: Configurable LAN access for the DSH Web GUI: a settings tab binds the server to all interfaces, trusts only the addresses you configure, sets the browser session lifetime or removes the token login, and repairs the settings layer on non-loopback visits.
items.dz: 可配置的 DSH Web GUI 局域网访问：设置页开启后绑定全部网卡，只信任你配置的访问地址，可调整浏览器会话有效期或去掉 token 登录，并修复非回环访问时的设置层。

items.de: Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion
items.dz: DSH 内的离线局域网聊天：同一网络里运行本 harness 的机器之间单聊、群聊与文件传输，带 UDP 自动发现、按网段扫描加联系人、可选访问码（默认未设置）、只在本机生效的联系人备注、单条与整个会话删除，以及可配的单文件上限。宿主半侧为对端另开 HTTP/WebSocket 端口，运行时只用 Node 内置模块。

items.de: Control surface for the dsh-lan-gate LAN gateway: a button beside Settings that shows whether the gateway is running and how many phones or tablets are waiting for approval, opens the loopback-only approval page in one click instead of typing its URL, and starts the gateway through its scheduled tas
items.dz: dsh-lan-gate 局域网网关的控制面：设置图标旁的一个按钮，显示网关是否在跑、有几台手机或平板在等批准；一次点击打开只认回环地址的批准页，省去手敲 URL；网关没在跑时先经计划任务把它拉起。在手机或平板界面上不渲染。

items.de: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
items.dz: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

items.de: SSH-backed remote directories and linked local⇄remote workspaces: read-only remote browsing, an editable linked workbench, bidirectional SFTP transfer, mirroring and a linked_workspace tool. Sidebar pages require the dsh-better-sidebar plugin (v0.24+); without it only the Settings pages load.
items.dz: 把 SSH 连接变成 DSH 远程目录与本地⇄远端联动工作区：远程目录只读浏览，联动工作区可编辑、双向传输、镜像同步，并提供 linked_workspace 工具。侧栏页面需配合 dsh-better-sidebar（v0.24+）；没有它只有设置页可用。

items.de: Link local project directories from a project context menu, with scoped search, source reading and explicit per-session snapshot synchronization. Supports DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 and 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
items.dz: 从项目右键菜单关联本机目录，支持跨目录搜索、源码读取与显式会话快照同步；仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 与 0.2.1-rc.2。

items.de: Control a local Linux desktop from DeepSeek Harness with 19 tools: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, scroll, window, application, display and state-verification control over a native X11 session with XTEST, plus optional AT-SPI accessibility-tree reads and widget value setting. Not for Wayland. Requires
items.dz: 用 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控本机 Linux 桌面，提供 19 个工具：截图、鼠标、键盘、滚动、窗口、应用、显示器与状态校验，基于原生 X11 + XTEST 会话，并可选读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树与直接给控件赋值，不适用于 Wayland。需要宿主安装 xdotool（XTEST 注入）；截图与窗口控制还需 scrot、ffmpeg、wmctrl、xrandr、xprop，AT-SPI 工具另需 python3-gi、at-spi2-core、libatk-adaptor。缺失的软件包可在插件详情页的依赖面板用 sudo 一键补装。

items.de: Gives the web UI the same keyboard shortcuts on Linux that Windows and macOS already get: the host half injects one script into index.html, so a Linux browser reports a Windows platform before the shortcut service reads it, and the built-in table resolves instead of staying empty; a Settings row rep
items.dz: 让 Linux 上的网页端拥有 Windows / macOS 端那套快捷键：宿主半在 index.html 注入一行脚本，使 Linux 浏览器在快捷键服务读取平台之前报告 Windows 平台，内置键位表因此生效而不是空白；设置页额外显示一行，指示映射是否真的生效。

items.de: iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.
items.dz: DSH 的液态玻璃主题：工作区全透明、分层玻璃面板、内置壁纸库，外加一个管工作区与插件的控制中心。

items.de: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
items.dz: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

items.de: Three literature-research skills packaged as one DSH plugin: academic-web-research (lightweight proxy fetch), academic-literature-research (Scholar/IEEE/CNKI/Wanfang/Sci-Hub pipeline), off-campus-literature (campus WebVPN/CARSI access). Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/
items.dz: 三个文献调研技能打包成一个 DSH 插件：academic-web-research（轻量代理检索）、academic-literature-research（Scholar/IEEE/知网/万方/Sci-Hub 全流程）、off-campus-literature（校园 WebVPN/CARSI 校外访问）。安装即把三个 SKILL.md 落到 ~/.dsh/skills/，重启后 agent 可按名调用。内置的 academic-web-research 技能假定本机 127.0.0.1:7897 有 HTTP 代理，环境不同请自行修改。

items.de: Connects litman, a local literature manager driven by the `lit` command, to DSH: a sidebar entry lists your litman libraries and opens one as a workspace in a new session, and a bundled skill, after asking you, installs litman with its official installer and connects litman's own skills.
items.dz: 把 litman（用 `lit` 命令管理的本地文献库）接入 DSH：侧栏入口列出你的 litman 文献库，点一下就在新会话里把它作为工作区打开；自带的 skill 在征得你同意后，用官方安装命令装好 litman，并接入 litman 自己的 skill。

items.de: Local-first AI literature desk for DSH: import and parse PDFs (MinerU APIs or on-device pdf.js), read original/bilingual text with in-margin annotations, ask grounded questions whose citations jump to the page, and build per-paper or library knowledge graphs; eight agent tools expose the same librar
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 AI 文献阅读台：导入并解析论文（MinerU 或本机 pdf.js），原文/双语阅读与页边批注，带引用跳转的 grounded AI 问答，以及单篇/全库知识图谱；八个 agent 工具共享同一文献库。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.
items.dz: 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：遇事不决，一键摇一卦；起过的卦自动存进本机卦例库。

items.de: Six-yao (I Ching) divination for DeepSeek Harness — xiantian bagua backdrop, a Zhouyi opening verse, manual line entry or a simulated three-coin toss, najia charting (six relatives, six gods, void branches, hidden spirits, nayin, seasonal strength, transforming lines), an AI interpretation that cite
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的六爻算卦插件——先天八卦盘背景、周易开场辞、手工输入爻象或模拟三枚铜钱摇卦、纳甲排盘（六亲、六神、旬空、伏神、纳音、旺衰、动变），断卦由模型逐条注明典籍出处，并可对同一卦追问（一卦一断）。零 npm 依赖；所有请求都发往本机 DSH 宿主，不访问第三方网络。

items.de: Adds an UpdateNotify tool and a live progress panel docked above the composer in the DSH Web UI, so the model can narrate what it just did, found, or is waiting on while a turn runs.
items.dz: 为模型提供 UpdateNotify 工具，并在 DSH Web UI 输入框上方停靠一个实时进度窗，让模型在一轮任务进行中随时播报刚做了什么、发现了什么、在等什么。

items.de: Hot-reloads DSH plugin modules without restarting the app (module-cache purge, junction-path matching, bust fallback) and registers a refresh button in the session header so the browser page loads the new plugin bundles.
items.dz: DSH 插件免重启热重载：清模块缓存、按 junction 路径匹配、失败时带版本号重新导入， 并在会话标题栏注册一颗刷新按钮，让页面立刻加载新的插件 bundle。

items.de: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.
items.dz: 可见终端面板：把 agent 的 shell 命令实时显示在应用内终端，并支持 agent 以文本方式截取终端屏幕。

items.de: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted
items.dz: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

items.de: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

items.de: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-catego
items.dz: DSH 内的 LiveBench 能力排行榜：识别官网当前发布的榜单版本，再读取其官方 CSV 与分类 JSON，在由输入框按钮打开的独立同源 iframe 中渲染模型排名。支持搜索、机构／开放权重／推理模型筛选、按能力维度排序、任务级明细、最多 4 个模型并排对比与 CSV 导出；默认每 60 秒同步（可配 30–3600），缓存只写入插件自身的 .cache/rankings.json。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

items.de: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
items.dz: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

items.de: Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.
items.dz: 常驻 Web 席位，背后是独立助理会话：对话、图片、提醒、值班心跳，以及按需只读引用当前任务。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Req
items.dz: 把本地 CC Switch 数据库里的账号接进 DeepSeek Harness：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build 的每个账号在模型选择器里各成一类，列模型与发请求时都会重读 SQLite 数据库，在 CC Switch 里换账号不必重启 DSH。需 CC Switch 与 DSH 桌面端。

items.de: Requires DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0. Declare any number of LLM providers, each with its own endpoint, credential and per-model parameters (reasoning-effort vocabulary, image input, retry policy), across the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire formats, configured f
items.dz: 需要 DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0。在设置页配置任意数量的模型供应商：各自独立设置接口地址、密钥与逐模型参数（思考强度、图片输入、重试策略），支持 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 与 Google Gemini 四种协议。

items.de: Use local MLX-LM or MLX-VLM models in DeepSeek Harness through a loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, with optional DSH-owned server startup.
items.dz: 通过回环 OpenAI-compatible 提供方在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用本机 MLX-LM 或 MLX-VLM 模型，并可选由 DSH 托管模型服务进程。

items.de: Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.
items.dz: 在 DSH 中运行 MoE4All 本地模型，支持引擎自动安装、模型发现与下载、推理参数配置和实时速度监控，也可连接已有服务。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Keeps a model request alive through a dropped connection: transport failures retry until the network returns while real errors still fail fast, and a turn killed by a process crash offers a one-click, state-checking continuation.
items.dz: 断网时不让模型请求死掉：连接类失败会重试到网络恢复，而真正的错误仍然立刻失败；被进程崩溃打断的一轮还会给出一键续跑，先核对状态再继续。

items.de: Unified provider pools for DeepSeek Harness with session-sticky balancing, capability-aware model mapping, and automatic failover.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的统一模型池：会话粘性、能力感知映射与自动故障切换。

items.de: Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.
items.dz: LLM Providers 设置页的挂载 owner：provider 卡片、拖拽排序与 picker 排序。

items.de: Token usage and cost analytics for DeepSeek Harness, with daily token and cost charts, model and workspace rankings, a sortable table with CSV export, account balance and per-session cost.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与费用统计：每日用量与费用图表、模型与工作区排行、可排序明细表与 CSV 导出、账户余额与会话花费。

items.de: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6%
items.dz: 线路层 LLM 检查器：抓取模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，经 llm/stream 瀑布把每次抓取归属到发起它的会话。请求面板把报文渲染成带每节点大小的可折叠树——实测一次请求有 98.6% 是单个 973 项的数组——响应面板则把 OpenAI 风格的 SSE chunk 流重新组装成推理、正文、工具调用与用量。在对话栏标签页与本地查看页展示。

items.de: Per-conversation tool kits for DeepSeek Harness: pick one kit and only its tools reach the model, with three bases (All, built-in only, or a saved kit), add-ons for one-off combinations, and a token ledger estimating what the kit saves.
items.dz: 给每个对话选一套工具（套装），只把用得上的工具投给模型：三档底座（全部 / 仅内置 / 我的套装）、一次性加挂、token 账本估算省下的开销，并可在设置里指定新对话的默认套装。

items.de: On-demand tool loadout for DSH: MCP tools are grouped by server and host plugin tools by prefix; grouped tools hide by default and activate with one call, while tools claimed by no rule stay visible. Ships preset modes (coding / writing / ops / review), a trial zone that promotes new tools after rep
items.dz: DSH 的按需工具装配：MCP 工具按 server 自动分组、宿主插件工具按手工前缀分组，进组的默认隐藏、一句话激活，没被规则认领的始终可见。另带写代码/写材料/运维/只读审阅内置模式、新工具观察区用多了自动转正、敏感组激活要用户点头、读网页当轮切断外发组防提示注入，以及长尾工具的内置搜索和代理调用。

items.de: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different fol
items.dz: 用本地文件夹当 DSH Web 壁纸：默认就用当前用户的「图片」库（C:\Users\<用户名>\Pictures），宿主通过同源 HTTP 提供其中的图片，每 N 分钟轮换一张（0-1440，默认 5），洗牌后一轮内不重复；「插件」页的设置界面可用系统原生文件夹对话框换目录，并可调节背景图不透明度（100%）、压暗遮罩（25%）与面板不透明度（15%），改动即时生效。弹窗、对话框与菜单保持默认不透明底色，字更清楚。直接读取 .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp，用户配置写入 $DSH_HOME，升级不会带上你的目录路径。

items.de: A local-first todo board for the DSH sidebar with Todo/Doing/Done columns organised by project, storing everything in one Markdown file inside a folder you pick on first run. Cards carry due dates down to the minute, a colour stripe, a private blur that hides the title until you reveal it, notes and
items.dz: 本地优先的待办看板：左侧导航里的 Todo/Doing/Done 三列，按项目组织，所有数据都在你首次使用时自己选的文件夹里的一个 Markdown 文件中。卡片支持精确到分钟的截止时间、颜色标记、私密打码（默认遮罩，点击才显示）、备注与项目角色，可在列与项目之间拖拽；agent 另有 kanban 工具，可读写全部卡片（含已打码的）。macOS 上会安装三个 launchd 定时任务，由 /usr/bin/python3 运行并发系统通知（每天 09:00 摘要、每 30 分钟检查 2 小时内到期的卡片、每周一回顾），可在面板「自动化」标签里改时间或停用。

items.de: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-tras
items.dz: 由 DSH web server 直接提供的本地文件管理页：整盘浏览，图片/PDF/音视频/文本/Markdown/JSON/CSV/沙箱 HTML/docx/xlsx 预览，Range 下载与目录 ZIP，拖拽上传、复制粘贴、带冲突检测的文本编辑、新建/重命名/删除（进回收目录），以及 xlsx 单元格编辑另存为副本。

items.de: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.
items.dz: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

items.de: Local full-disk knowledge base: indexes documents from C:/ and E:/ into a SQLite FTS5 trigram index over filename, body, and path, with a searchable DSH sidebar panel, no-keyword browse, usefulness/topic tags, and a token-efficient kb agent tool. Windows only; building the index needs a system Pytho
items.dz: 本地全盘知识库：把 C:/ 与 E:/ 的文档抽取进 SQLite FTS5 trigram 索引（文件名、正文、路径三列可搜），提供可搜索的 DSH 侧栏面板、无关键词浏览、有用度与主题双标签，以及省 token 的 kb 智能体工具。仅限 Windows；建索引需要系统 Python 3 及 PyMuPDF、python-docx（PPTX/XLSX 另需 python-pptx、openpyxl），插件不自带索引。

items.de: Local document library for DSH Desktop (Windows only, installed with the bundled PowerShell script): upload files once, then every conversation can search and read them through four tools (library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save); upload, download and batch download live in the S
items.dz: 本地资料库（仅 Windows，需用随包的 PowerShell 脚本安装）：文件传一次，之后每个对话都能用四个工具（library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save）检索、读取；上传、下载与打包下载在设置页完成。文件只保存在本机——除非你启用可选的视觉模型，它会把图片发到你配置的接口。

items.de: Runs the local llama.cpp Qwen3.5-4B from a Settings page — Windows only, NVIDIA GPU (8 GB VRAM handles the 4B Q4) — with start, stop and restart, launch parameters, deployment paths with a presence check, provider-route and compaction-policy sync in the profile patch, a loopback request-capture prox
items.dz: 在设置页管理本机 llama.cpp 的 Qwen3.5-4B（仅 Windows + NVIDIA GPU，8 GB 显存可跑 4B Q4）：启停与重启、启动参数、部署路径与存在性检测、把模型路由与压缩策略同步进 profile patch、本机请求捕获代理，以及一个按文件路径把翻译/OCR/抽帧杂活交给本地模型的 local_worker 工具。需自备 llama-server.exe（在 b12069 验证）与 Qwen3.5-4B 的 GGUF 量化 + mmproj 文件，视频抽帧另需 ffmpeg。

items.de: Local Markdown notes panel: import any local folder, browse its Markdown tree in the sidebar, edit files with auto-save, and search across every imported folder. Shows read-only Git context for each file — status, diff against HEAD with per-line change bars, and line blame — and exposes six notes_*
items.dz: 本地 Markdown 笔记面板：导入任意本地文件夹，在侧边栏树形浏览其中的 Markdown，就地编辑并自动保存，支持跨文件夹全文检索。为每个文件显示只读的 Git 上下文——状态、与 HEAD 的差异（逐行变更标记）、逐行 blame——并提供 notes_* 六个工具，让 Agent 直接操作同一批文件夹。文件留在原处，插件从不提交、暂存或检出。

items.de: Project-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness that keeps one bank per project and adds a cross-project view; it can also seed a project's memory from its git history without opening a session there.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨项目长期记忆：每个项目各存各的库，另有一次性看遍全部的查询视图；还能不打开会话就直接从项目的 git 历史播种记忆。

items.de: Local-first music player and playlist manager for the DSH Web UI.
items.dz: 面向 DSH Web UI 的本地音乐播放器与歌单管理插件。

items.de: Adds a global document-routing prompt so PDFs, images, and Office files are read with the right tool.
items.dz: 加入全局文档路由提示，让 PDF、图片和 Office 文件自动走正确的读取工具。

items.de: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框中加入知识库选择器与原生附件回形针。

items.de: Automatically groups installed plugins in dsh-market on startup.
items.dz: 启动时自动把已安装插件归入 dsh-market 分组。

items.de: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.
items.dz: 把添加工作区的目录对话框换成路径输入、盘符快捷和系统文件夹选择。

items.de: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
items.dz: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

items.de: Local creation toolbox for DeepSeek Harness. It talks to a ComfyUI instance for image generation and a local GPT-SoVITS service for speech, checks which local services are reachable, and saves generated files into the workspace.
items.dz: 本地创作工具箱：连接本机 ComfyUI 出图、连接本地 GPT-SoVITS 配音，检查服务是否在线，并把生成的文件保存到工作区。

items.de: Embeds a private local Sub2API gateway (Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis via Docker) into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with automatic local login. Windows only, with Docker Desktop and its WSL2 backend already installed; the first start pulls about 250 MB of images and needs local ports 18080 and 18081
items.dz: 把一套本机私有的 Sub2API 网关（Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis，Docker 方式）内嵌到 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，并自动本地登录。仅限 Windows，需已装好 Docker Desktop 与 WSL2 后端；首次启动要从 Docker Hub 拉取约 250 MB 镜像，并占用本机 18080、18081 端口。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to host.docker.internal:8326

items.de: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

items.de: Vietnamese (tiếng Việt) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: hand-translated dictionaries for 61 namespaces (3,477 strings) that take effect when Vietnamese is picked in Settings → Language, plus a /vi-sync command that translates strings added by newer plugin versions through the harness
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加越南语：61 个命名空间、3,477 条人工翻译词条，在「设置 → 语言」里选中越南语即生效；另带 /vi-sync 命令，用 Harness 内置翻译服务补译新版本新增的字符串。

items.de: In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the n
items.dz: DSH 本地通知栏：侧边栏【通知】入口 + 未读徽标、全屏通知中心（级别视觉分级 info/success/warn/error、时间/来源筛选、排序、标题内容搜索、未读已读、删除、详情弹层一键复制、分页），notify_add agent 工具与 CLI 写入本地 JSON 文件（支持自动清理），页面实时刷新，界面跟随 dsh web 语言切换。

items.de: Send files or folders over the local network via the LocalSend v2 protocol, or generate a temporary browser download link that the receiver opens with no software installed.
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话中通过 LocalSend v2 协议把文件/文件夹发到局域网内其它机器，或生成一次性浏览器下载链接（接收方无需安装任何软件）。零配置开箱即用，兼容 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 与 0.1.3-alpha.1。

items.de: A password lock screen for DeepSeek Harness so passers-by cannot see a running session while you step away.
items.dz: 给 DSH 加一道密码锁屏，离开工位时旁人就看不到正在跑的会话。

items.de: Ships a set of /logi commands for project housekeeping: dispatches security, logic-correctness, maintainability, reliability and performance experts to inspect the whole project, then produces one consolidated improvement report.
items.dz: 提供一组 /logi 命令来做项目收尾工作，为你的项目派发「安全/逻辑正确/可维护/健壮/性能」5 位专家深入检查你的项目，并出一份优化总报告。

items.de: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
items.dz: 通过无头运行的 Logseq CLI，把 Logseq 2.0 DB 图谱（含 E2EE 加密图谱）与同步服务器保持同步，提供 11 个 logseq_* 工具用于搜索、查询和编辑，并在设置页里登录和配置同步。

items.de: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether
items.dz: 为输入框加一个写长内容的全屏弹窗：左侧写 Markdown、右侧 marked 实时渲染，中间分栏可拖动并记住比例。确认后写回输入框草稿，指令 token 与 @ 引用 chip 作为固定前缀保留；Esc 关闭前询问「不写回」还是「写回」。

items.de: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.
items.dz: 跨会话长期记忆包：混合检索记忆库（BM25+中文二元分词）、长文切块检索、聊天记录提取精炼，外加上下文总结存档与翻阅，重要记忆与最新总结自动注入提示词。

items.de: Folds a user message whose body renders taller than 360px in the Web chat down to 360px with a fading bottom edge and an Expand/Collapse toggle. Short messages keep their exact original look, and the expanded state is remembered per message while the page stays open.
items.dz: 把 Web 对话里正文高度超过 360px 的用户消息折成 360px、底部渐隐，并给一个「展开全文 / 收起」按钮；短消息外观完全不变，展开状态在页面存活期间按消息记住。

items.de: Daily longevity coach built on the 64 graded population studies in HowToLiveLonger: a sidebar page with three actions for today, a day timeline, nine situation guides, keyword search over all 64 records and a check-in trail, plus five agent tools that make the model state the A/B/C/D evidence grade
items.dz: 把 HowToLiveLonger 的 64 条分级人群证据做成日常教练：侧栏页面含今日三件事、一天时间轴、9 个处境场景、64 条证据检索与打卡轨迹，另有 5 个工具让模型在回答作息、饮食、运动、久坐、保健品问题时先说明 A/B/C/D 证据等级。

items.de: Region screenshot for DSH without a hotkey (Windows only; capture runs through PowerShell + GDI). Hold the left mouse button for 550 ms, the page dims into a crosshair, drag a box, release: the crop is saved to ~/.dsh/longpress-shots and copied to the clipboard, and a preview card can send the same
items.dz: 给 DSH 加区域截图，不用记快捷键（仅 Windows；截图走 PowerShell + GDI）。按住左键 550 毫秒，页面变暗进入十字框选，拖出范围松手即得 PNG，落到 ~/.dsh/longpress-shots 并同时写进剪贴板；预览卡可以把同一份字节直接送进输入框（按钮 / Ctrl+V / 拖拽三条路），不用再翻文件对话框。

items.de: Adds a reversible “Collapse history” toggle to the session header with a light/dark status dot: it unloads the history already rendered by the page and keeps the latest two turns, then shows “History collapsed”; clicking again restores the saved window. A manual restore keeps auto-collapse off for t
items.dz: 在会话标题栏添加带深浅色状态圆点的可逆「收起历史」开关：未收起时点击卸载页面已渲染的旧历史、只保留最近两轮，按钮变为「已收起历史」；再点还原之前的窗口。手动还原后本会话不再自动收起；阈值与请求上限在 设置 → 长会话。

items.de: Splits over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission instead of letting them be rejected: vertical slices overlap so a line of text is never cut in half, and pure-JS codecs avoid native binaries. It wraps the existing attachment store instead of replacing it.
items.dz: 超长截图在发送前自动切成 DSH 可接受的切片，而不是被直接拒收：纵向切片带重叠，不会把一行字劈成两半；纯 JS 编解码，无原生依赖，且只是包住现有附件服务、不顶替它。

items.de: Human-in-the-loop self-improvement loop: one objective becomes an auditable work chain that iterates in child sessions while the main agent stays idle.
items.dz: 人在环的自我改进循环：给一个目标，工作链在子会话里一轮轮迭代，主 agent 始终保持空闲。

items.de: Hard stop for runaway turns: blocks repeated identical tool calls and ends the turn when per-turn step or time budgets are exceeded.
items.dz: 失控回合硬止损：拦截同一工具+同一参数的重复调用，单轮步数或时长超预算即结束本轮。

items.de: Reviews destructive shell commands with a model before they run, asks you to confirm or blocks them, and aborts a running command once it has deleted too many files.
items.dz: 破坏性 shell 命令执行前由模型判断会不会造成不可逆破坏，判定会破坏时询问或拦下；命令运行中删除文件过多时中止。

items.de: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
items.dz: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

items.de: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full
items.dz: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

items.de: Distills daily chats into an updatable character card and a cross-session emotion module that trains the persona.
items.dz: 把每天的聊天过程蒸馏成可更新的角色卡与跨会话感情模块，持续训练角色卡（保留说话习惯与关键记忆）。

items.de: Local-first quick capture: select text in a DSH conversation to save it as a quote with its source (model and session), or jot quick notes from the sidebar; records stay in a local JSON file, with optional sync to a self-hosted service.
items.dz: 本地优先的随手记录：划选 DSH 对话原话存成带来源（模型、会话）的引用，或从侧栏随手记便签；记录只存本机 JSON 文件，可选同步到自建数据服务。

items.de: Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a ra
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一个可拖拽的幸运方块按钮：单击放零成本小表演（弹窗、假蓝屏、今日抽签、冷知识、冷笑话、音乐和一组视觉小演出），长按 1.4 秒挖穿后开新会话随机写论文、读新闻、发明东西或编短篇小说。它还会给模型的问答题选项末尾加一个「幸运方块」随机替你决定，不满意说「回滚」即可撤销。方块外观与事件权重都能在设置里改。

items.de: Prevents macOS idle sleep while DSH Desktop is active, with configurable disabled periods.
items.dz: 在 DSH Desktop 运行时阻止 macOS 空闲睡眠，支持自定义停用时段。

items.de: Computer Use for macOS desktop applications: reads any app's accessibility tree as text with element indices, then clicks, types, pastes, scrolls, drags, selects text and sets values through it, plus screenshots read back as images. Driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL — the agent gets two tools (
items.dz: macOS 桌面应用 Computer Use 插件：以文本读取任意应用的无障碍树与元素索引，并据此点击、输入、粘贴、滚动、拖拽、选择文本与赋值，截图可回传为图片。由常驻 JavaScript REPL 驱动——智能体只拿到两个工具（`js`、`js_reset`），在其中调用 `sky` API，因此状态跨调用保持、能力增长时工具 schema 保持稳定。无障碍树在首次读取后以 diff 返回；动作按索引寻址，过期索引会被拒绝而非错用；输入前等待键盘焦点并回读输入框；粘贴会恢复剪贴板。需 macOS 14.4+、辅助功能权限（截图另需屏幕录制）与 Node 20+；随包提供预编译原生模块，安

items.de: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status
items.dz: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限

items.de: Native macOS Notification Center alerts for DeepSeek Harness when the agent asks for your choice, a task completes, or a task fails, with per-scenario switches, background-job suppression, and click-to-open the session.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 macOS 通知中心提醒：智能体需要你做出选择、任务完成或任务失败时弹出通知，可在配置中分别开关、在后台任务运行时抑制完成提醒，点击通知可直接跳回对应会话。

items.de: Apple on-device Vision tools for text-only dsh models: local OCR (zh-Hans + 30 langs), image classification, face detection, document layout, and a combined describe — 100% offline, no API key, tall-screenshot slicing.
items.dz: 苹果设备端 Vision 工具：本地 OCR（含中文）、图像分类、人脸检测、文档版面分析与综合描述，100% 离线、无需 API key，支持长截图切片。

items.de: Adds a space-key Quick Look preview to DSH deliverable cards. Hovering a card and pressing Space opens the native macOS QLPreviewPanel for the file, which covers docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images and media that the sidebar preview cannot render. The panel zooms out from the card's position, returns focu
items.dz: 给 DSH 的交付卡片加「按空格用 macOS 原生 Quick Look 预览」的入口。鼠标停在卡片上按空格即打开系统预览面板，覆盖侧栏预览渲染不了的 docx、xlsx、pptx、pdf、图片与音视频。面板从卡片位置放大出现，关闭后焦点回到输入框；悬停延迟、关闭后聚焦、双击预览三项可在设置 > 常规里调。

items.de: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
items.dz: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

items.de: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
items.dz: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

items.de: macOS Share menu receiver for DeepSeek Harness: appends shared files, images, text and links to the current thread’s draft attachments (requires the DSH Share app).
items.dz: macOS 分享菜单接收端：把分享的文件、图片、文本和链接追加到 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话的草稿附件（需先安装 DSH Share App）。

items.de: Registers one `doc_ocr_sign_fix` tool for DeepSeek Harness: on macOS it diagnoses and repairs the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of the hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitle
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `doc_ocr_sign_fix` 工具：在 macOS 上诊断并修复内置 Python 因 hardened runtime + Library Validation 拒绝加载 onnxruntime / cv2 / pypdfium2 原生扩展的问题——注入 disable-library-validation entitlement 并 ad-hoc 重签解释器，再验证导入。操作幂等，签名前先备份原二进制。绝不触碰外层 App。

items.de: WYSIWYG Markdown notes editor in the DSH right sidebar, with tabbed documents, table editing, chat integration, assistant read/write tools, and local file export.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏的所见即所得 Markdown 笔记编辑器，支持多标签、表格编辑、对话联动、模型读写与保存到本地文件。

items.de: Drives a local MaaEnd (MXU) client over its loopback HTTP API: 10 maend_* agent tools, a sidebar dashboard panel, and startup-mute / success-gated close-game steps in the task chain. Requires a local MaaEnd install with its MXU service running.
items.dz: 通过本机 MaaEnd（MXU）的 loopback HTTP API 驱动它：10 个 maend_* agent 工具、一个侧边栏看板面板，以及任务链里的启动静音与「全部成功后才关游戏」收尾。需先在本机安装 MaaEnd 并开启 MXU 服务。

items.de: Manage Claude Code, Codex and Grok CLIs inside dsh and dispatch tasks to them as headless subagents, with dsh models, skills and tools bridged into each task, resumable CLI subsessions, and a hierarchical task board in the right sidebar (the board tab requires the separate DSH-better-sidebar plugin;
items.dz: 在 dsh 中管理 Claude Code / Codex / Grok CLI，并把任务派发给它们作为子智能体执行：dsh 的模型、技能与工具随任务桥接，CLI 子会话可回放续聊，右侧栏提供分层任务看板（看板 tab 需另装 DSH-better-sidebar 插件，未安装时不会注册）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: validate, run, and scaffold declarative agents and workflows (YAML).
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) 插件：验证、运行、搭建 declarative agents 与 workflows(YAML)。

items.de: Embeds the original Magpie web UI in the DSH sidebar: downloads the Magpie binary from the yetone/magpie GitHub releases when missing, starts `magpie serve --web` in the background, and serves it through a local reverse proxy that injects the login cookie server-side.
items.dz: 把 Magpie 原版 Web UI 嵌进 DSH 侧边栏：缺 Magpie 二进制时自动从 yetone/magpie 的 GitHub Releases 下载，后台启动 `magpie serve --web`，并经由在服务端注入登录 Cookie 的本地反向代理提供页面。

items.de: See the quota of every AI account connected to your local Magpie gateway at a glance, with usage breakdowns by day/week/month.
items.dz: 一键查看本机 Magpie 网关下全部 AI 账号的额度，并支持按天/周/月查看用量明细。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：将 Magpie 本地网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的配额与用量进度圆环嵌入输入框底部状态栏（与上下文比例并列），支持各会话模型自动跟随嗅探、置顶卡片自动置顶与 5 小时重置倒计时微型面板。

items.de: Post-build patch for the maid-atelier skin, mounted as a bundle: the window backdrop walks six time-of-day bands on the local clock with continuously interpolated sky and interior light, and the figure moves on its own (breath, weight shift, float, blinks, optional hem and hair displacement); applie
items.dz: 以 bundle 形式挂载的女仆工坊皮肤补丁：窗景按本机时间在破晓、黎明、早中、傍晚、晚上、深夜六档连续插值，立绘自带呼吸、重心移动、浮动与眨眼，可选裙摆与长发位移场；对已安装的皮肤生效，卸载即从 client.js.orig 还原。

items.de: Mail for DSH: IMAP, POP3, SMTP and OAuth2 accounts with a reading tab, API senders, scheduled and CSV bulk sends with unsubscribe handling, and mail_* agent tools. The Mail tab appears inside dsh-better-sidebar; the agent tools work without it.
items.dz: DSH 的邮件客户端：接入 IMAP、POP3、SMTP 与 OAuth2 账号，提供侧栏阅读标签页、API 发信、定时与 CSV 批量发信（含退订处理），以及 mail_* agent 工具。阅读标签页需配合 dsh-better-sidebar，未装时 agent 工具仍可用。

items.de: Mailbox for DeepSeek Harness: sessions pass letters through a shared folder, and an hourly randomized scheduler can wake a session on its own (mutual letters between two sessions, or a gentle nudge to the owner). Per-recipient hourly rate limit and a UTF-8 log.
items.dz: DSH 会话信箱：两间会话用文件夹互相传信，另加按小时随机调度——互递信，或主动找主人说话；每个收信人每小时限流，带 UTF-8 日志。

items.de: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.
items.dz: 耗时较长或工具调用较多的任务结束时发邮件到手机，出错、目标完成或目标受阻也发；审批或提问挂起超过设定时间没人处理会另外提醒（正文带问题原文与候选项，提醒不依赖任务档位）。每封新通知会通过 IMAP 删掉收件箱里的上一封，收件箱里最多留一封；其它文件夹不扫描。

items.de: Real AST-based scan of installed plugins for malicious-intent patterns (dynamic eval, cross-plugin writes, exfiltration-shaped network calls), with an optional periodic schedule and auto-quarantine on critical findings.
items.dz: 基于 AST 的已装插件恶意行为扫描：识别动态 eval、跨插件写入、外泄型网络调用等模式，并给出可复核的报告。

items.de: Delete sessions, optionally with the files each session wrote; deletions go to a trash that lists them by time and restores one or many; a session with a running turn is refused and nothing outside that session folder is touched.
items.dz: 删会话，可选择是否带上它写过的文件；删掉的进回收站，按时间列出，可单条或批量还原；正在跑的会话会被拒绝，会话目录以外的文件不动。

items.de: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.
items.dz: 在侧边栏查看曼联 2026/27 赛季赛程，开球时间按你的本地时区显示，已结束比赛带 W/L/D 比分结果。

items.de: A floating whale-girl pet in the DSH web GUI: every hour it takes one article from a bundled 33-essay corpus of Mao Zedong's selected works and puts a cited line with its source link, one of six business angles (customer, project, organisation, cash flow, decision, self-discipline) and a one-line nu
items.dz: DSH 网页右下角的鲸鱼娘桌宠「小毛」：每小时从内置的 33 篇毛选语料里挑一篇，把一句带来源链接的原文、六个落点之一（客户 / 项目 / 组织 / 现金流 / 决策 / 自律）和一句说给你听的具体督促放进不超过 200 字的气泡；另带 maoxuan-pet preset 与 maoxuan-vademecum skill，可以顺着同一份语料问「这一步该怎么走」，四帧立绘，支持免打扰时段与每日上限。

items.de: Copies a text selection anywhere in the DSH conversation as Markdown source on Ctrl+C, restoring headings, lists, GFM tables, fenced code blocks and TeX math.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话中任意选中文本后按 Ctrl+C，把选区还原为 Markdown 源码，保留标题、列表、GFM 表格、代码围栏与 TeX 公式。

items.de: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.
items.dz: 输入框 Markdown 书写辅助：发送内容保持原始 Markdown，同时把列表显示为圆点和复选框，实时呈现粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线、标题、引用与代码块，Shift+Enter 自动续写列表，选中文字可用 Cmd/Ctrl+B、I、E 加格式。

items.de: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
items.dz: DSH Web UI 输入区 Markdown 实时渲染：输入中的粗体/列表/代码块即时成型（CodeMirror 接管卡）；已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 呈现；粘贴富文本转为干净 Markdown。

items.de: Write and read Markdown notes: switch between reading, editing and side-by-side preview, with an outline, three preview themes, math and Mermaid, nested folders, and autosave to local .md files.
items.dz: 随手记、随时读：阅读、编辑、并排预览一键切换，附大纲与三套排版主题，支持公式与 Mermaid，多级文件夹管理，自动存为本地 .md 文件。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

items.de: Turns a repository's README.md and docs/*.png into a publishable market card: bilingual title and tagline, install command, a screenshot wall, capabilities, and an explicit limitations section — as self-contained HTML, a 2400px 2x PNG, a paste-ready card.md, and provenance-rich card.json. It refuses
items.dz: 把仓库的 README.md 与 docs/*.png 变成一张可发布的市场卡片：中英双语标题与一句话、安装命令、截图墙、能力，以及一段必须显式写出的限制声明——输出自包含 HTML、2400px 的 2x PNG、可直接粘贴的 card.md，以及带 provenance 的 card.json。它不编造文案：缺英文就进缺失字段列表，--strict 退出码 2，普通运行会盖 DRAFT 章。PNG 用本机 Chrome / Edge 无头渲染；没有浏览器时仍写 HTML，CLI 退出码 3。48 个 node --test 测试，零运行时依赖。

items.de: Companion for the DSH plugin market: batch-updates every installed npm plugin after DSH quits and relaunches it, rolls back the plugins an update broke when the next boot fails, and checks updates plus keeps snapshots for local link plugins. Windows DSH Desktop only; it is a companion patch for the
items.dz: DSH 插件市场的补丁层：一键批量更新所有已装 npm 插件（退出 DSH 后自动完成并重新打开），启动失败时自动回退肇事插件，并为本地 link 插件提供更新检测与快照回滚。仅支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH；它是对插件市场（dshmarket）的补丁层而非替代品，市场分组需先装 dshmarket。

items.de: HuanJing Stock Board - a pure "slacking-off" stock watcher: read-only delayed quotes for A-shares, HK and US, a flat dot-matrix LED exchange hall, watchlists, candlestick charts, news, financials and price alerts. For market analysis and trading use professional software - professionals do professio
items.dz: 寰镜股票看板：纯粹的摸鱼看股票插件——A股/港股/美股只读延迟行情、平面 LED 灯阵证券大厅、自选、K 线、股市资讯、财报与价格提醒。行情分析和交易请用专业软件，专业的人做专业的事；它就是给散户方便看看自己股票情况的插件，极致简单。

items.de: Writes short plain-Chinese notes for installed dshmarket plugins that have none and shows them on the market cards; hand-written notes are left alone (only entries marked 🤖 may be regenerated with force=ai), and dshmarket is required.
items.dz: 给 dshmarket 里还没有备注的插件自动写一句中文说明，显示在市场卡片上；手写备注不会动（只有带 🤖 标记的条目会在 force=ai 时重新生成），使用时需要先装好 dshmarket。

items.de: Adds a dshmarket entry to the DSH sidebar footer, sharing a row with the Agents-Anywhere remote-control entry and sitting to its right, and opens the market panel in an overlay.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部加入 dshmarket 入口，与 Agents-Anywhere 的「远程控制」同处一行并位于其右侧，点击以浮层打开市场面板。

items.de: Quote board for A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, FX, Chinese and global commodity futures and indices, with watchlists, custom groups, auto-refresh and host-side persistence.
items.dz: A股、港股、美股、外汇、国内外商品期货与指数的行情看板，支持自选、自定义分组、自动刷新与宿主端持久化。

items.de: WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar, built on MarkText's muya engine: open a .md file, edit it as a rendered document, and save back through ctx.fs with a version guard.
items.dz: 基于 MarkText 内核 muya 的右侧栏所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器：打开 .md 按渲染结果编辑，保存走 ctx.fs 并带版本守卫。

items.de: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

items.de: Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML
items.dz: 证明一次局部改图没有动蒙版外的像素。输入原图、生成图和蒙版三张 PNG，输出可 grep 的 `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` 结论、差异热力图、逐通道统计、差异包围盒与最大差异像素，并生成自包含 HTML 报告和 `report.json`；后者包含文件 SHA-256、规范化受保护像素摘要，以及把两者与判定策略绑定在一起的证明摘要。支持 edit / lock 两种蒙版语义、蒙版阈值、容差与忽略 alpha；PNG 覆盖颜色类型 0/2/3/4/6、位深 1-16、五种过滤器和 Adam7。零依赖、纯本地：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

items.de: A project lead for DeepSeek Harness. Opening a session with the dsh-master preset in a folder makes it that project's master: it splits your requests into tasks, dispatches them to member sessions over plugin-delivered messages, collects structured reports and stops at every gate for review. Members
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 配一个项目总管。用 dsh-master 预设在某个目录新建会话，它就是这个项目的总管：把你的要求拆成任务，以插件投递的消息派给执行会话，收结构化回报，每到闸门停下等验收。成员需要你拍板时只经总管代问，问题在原生右侧栏看板上点选作答。带标签的 devlog 会在动到相关文件之前推回上下文；守卫不让模型直接改插件状态和 git 暂存区；安静的巡检加定时保底盯着停滞。每个项目一键暂停，数据都在本机。要求 DSH 0.2.1（暂不支持 0.2.2），目前仅在 macOS 上验证过，界面仅中文。

items.de: Master Duel utility panel for DSH: card lookup with banlist filters and AI-assisted effect search, related cards, rarity badges, favorites, a deck builder with drag-and-drop and a collapsible favorites panel, engine-tested opening hands and hand_odds opening probabilities, deck-type rankings, and de
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的 Master Duel 工具面板：带禁限筛选和 AI 智能查卡的查卡、相关卡片、稀有度徽章、收藏与构建拖放、可收放收藏栏、规则引擎先手实测与 hand_odds 起手概率、卡组类型排行、卡组检查。卡图与卡文在运行时从第三方来源获取，插件不打包卡牌数据；需要单独安装 master-duel-ai-advisor MCP。

items.de: Material library for dsh: collect a folder, file or note from a conversation, keep it in real folders with tags, browse it Finder-style, reopen the source chat's output in one click. Ships a materials_archive tool plus auto-filing rules: file a task's deliverable once, and every later scheduled run
items.dz: dsh 材料库：把对话里产出的目录、文件或笔记收进真实文件夹并打标签，按 Finder 方式浏览，点一下跳回原始会话。内置 materials_archive 工具与自动归档规则：手动收过一次某任务的成品，之后每次定时任务跑完都会自动把新成品收进同一个文件夹。

items.de: SymPy-backed exact computation and independent verification for China's postgraduate entrance exam Mathematics I: 14 tools over 214 operators, exact symbolic results by default, and every result re-checked by a separate mechanism (requires Python 3.10+ with sympy and mpmath).

items.de: Windows only (desktop Word + full MathType 7 + Python 3.10+). Convert LaTeX placeholders in a Word .docx into real MathType OLE equations (Equation.DSMT4), preserving equation numbers, SEQ fields and cross-references.
items.dz: 仅 Windows（需桌面版 Word、完整版 MathType 7 与 Python 3.10+）。把 Word 文档中的 LaTeX 占位符转换为真正的 MathType OLE 公式（Equation.DSMT4），保留公式编号、SEQ 域与交叉引用。

By default (autoProvision) it downloads the MathWorks MCP Server and clones the toolkit on first use, and MathWorks telemetry stays on unless disableTelemetry i
items.dz: 把 MathWorks 的 MATLAB Agentic Toolkit 技能与 MATLAB MCP Server 工具接入 DeepSeek Harness。需要本机 MATLAB R2021a 及以上。默认（autoProvision）首次使用时会下载 MathWorks MCP Server 并克隆工具包；除非设置 disableTelemetry，否则 MathWorks 遥测保持开启。

items.de: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.

items.de: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain inten

items.de: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.

items.de: Minecraft server ops via RCON with static command blocking, pluggable local/Pterodactyl adapters, configurable community voting, and multi-layer process detection for Paper, Forge, Fabric, and vanilla servers. The QQ group surface requires the @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot plugin first; the local adapt

items.de: Brings McDonald's China official MCP (mcp.mcd.cn) into DSH. Paste a token you generated yourself and the plugin handshakes, calls tools/list, and registers every remote tool as a native DSH tool (mcd_ prefix) — upstream additions and removals need no code change, just a restart. Ships four always-on

items.de: Panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. The panel i

items.de: MCP server manager for DSH: nine mcp_manager_* tools, a CLI and a web panel that list, validate, probe, add, edit, enable/disable and remove servers in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, search and install servers from the official MCP Registry, and locate or rotate stored credentials.
items.dz: DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理器：九个 mcp_manager_* 工具、命令行与网页面板，可列出、校验、探测、新增、编辑、启停、移除 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 中的服务器，从官方 MCP Registry 搜索并安装服务器，以及定位或轮换已存凭据。

items.de: Manage DSH MCP servers from the web settings panel: list, add, edit, remove, enable/disable with live status.
items.dz: 在 Web 设置面板管理 DSH 的 MCP 服务器：实时状态、新增、编辑、删除、启用/禁用。

items.de: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, create and continue that instance's own sessions, delegate a turn and collect its result, answer the questions the DSH agent asks, and set how future approval requests resolve.
items.dz: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 实例通过 MCP 暴露出来：外部 agent 可以列出、新建并继续该实例自己的会话，委派一轮并取回结果，回答 DSH agent 提出的问题，并决定后续审批请求如何裁决。

items.de: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.

items.de: Aggregated MCP market for DeepSeek Harness: 26 curated presets plus the official MCP Registry and user-added JSON sources, with search, source filters, connectivity tests and one-click install into the profile.
items.dz: 聚合式 MCP 市场：26 个精选预设、MCP 官方注册表与用户自定义 JSON 源，支持搜索、来源筛选、连通性检测与一键安装到 profile。

items.de: MCP server panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the sidebar lists every @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client row — including rows inserted by other plugins — and derives its connection state from the loader fiber, the mcp__<server>__* tools still registered, a TCP probe of HTTP endpoints and the last conn
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器面板：侧边栏列出每一个 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 行（含其它插件插入的行），用 loader fiber 状态、仍注册的 mcp__<server>__* 工具数、HTTP 端点的 TCP 探活以及最近一次连接测试判断真实连接状态；可展开看该行配置，开关只改补丁文件里对应的一行并触发热重载重连，连接失败后自动再试一次，并把不可用的服务器以 system prompt 摘要 + 调用闸门的方式告知 agent——闸门会拒绝这些服务器的工具调用，而不是让每次调用在传输层失败。

items.de: Dormant-by-default MCP for dsh: one mcp_summon tool; summoning a server registers its tools as real native mcp__<server>__<tool> tools for the rest of the session, and release unregisters them and stops the process.

items.de: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
items.dz: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

items.de: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
