items.de: MCP management console for DeepSeek Harness — a left-sidebar page that lists every configured MCP server, trial-calls its tools in place, restarts a single row when its transport dies or never synced, and probes reachability. A fork of PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel; do not install it alongside the upstrea
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理控制台：左侧栏独立页面列出全部 MCP 服务器，可就地试用工具；传输断开或工具未同步时可单独重启某一行，并探测连通性。基于 PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel 的分支；不能与上游插件同装——两者都注册 /mcp 命令。

items.de: Decides which MCP server tools each workspace can see, keyed by the session working directory; workspaces without a policy see none.
items.dz: 按工作区（会话 cwd）决定哪些 MCP 服务器的工具可见；未配置的工作区默认一个都不显示。

items.de: Manages the MCP servers of a DeepSeek Harness profile: lists each server with its connection state and the tools it registers, preflights a configuration before saving it (a missing executable, an npm package name used as a command, an unexpanded variable that would reach the child literally, a URL
items.dz: 管理 DeepSeek Harness profile 的 MCP 服务：列出每个服务的连接状态与它注册的工具；保存前预检配置（可执行文件缺失、把包名当命令、变量未展开、URL 缺少路径）；粘贴 dsh 配置片段或 Claude Code 的 mcpServers 块即可新增，并自动转换为 dsh 格式。

items.de: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.
items.dz: 在会话标题栏加入「导出 MD」按钮，经系统原生保存窗口把当前会话导出为干净的 Markdown，并提供共用同一渲染核心的命令行与 HTTP 路由；直接读取会话日志（支持 v0、v3、v4 格式），且不声明任何 @deepseek-ai peer 依赖。

items.de: A draggable bubble that picks three dishes at a time from a local 4,423-dish library; the first two are always well-known mains, and picking costs no tokens.
items.dz: 可拖动的悬浮气泡，从本地 4,423 道菜里一次挑三道：前两道必定是常见国民菜；挑菜本身不花 token。

items.de: Adds three session tools — create_image and edit_image over GPT Image or Gemini through the TLPro gateway, and speak for text-to-speech through xAI — plus a viewer in the chat UI for the images and audio they produce. Needs your own TLPRO_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY, and publicOrigin and mediaDir set in
items.dz: 增加三个会话工具——经 TLPro 网关调用 GPT Image 或 Gemini 的 create_image、edit_image，以及经 xAI 的文本转语音 speak——并在聊天界面里提供这些图片和音频的查看器。需自备 TLPRO_API_KEY 与 XAI_API_KEY，并在 profile 配置中设置 publicOrigin 与 mediaDir。

items.de: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

items.de: Local media toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: converts files between 27 video, audio and image formats, trims clips, extracts audio or video tracks without re-encoding, exports embedded subtitles to .srt, compresses images with a before/after preview, reads and rewrites metadata, and encodes or decodes
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的本地多媒体工具箱：27 种视频/音频/图片格式互转、裁剪、不重编码地剥离音轨或画面、导出内嵌字幕为 .srt、带前后对比预览的图片压缩、元数据查看与改写、Base64 编解码——全部走本机已装的 ffmpeg，文件不出本机；同一引擎也注册为 agent 可调用的 media_toolbox 工具。

items.de: All-in-one inline media previewer for mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio fences with streaming playback, ffmpeg transcoding fallback, lightbox, and trust-fenced LAN/mobile access.
items.dz: 全能内联媒体预览插件，支持 mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio 围栏的流式播放、ffmpeg 转码回退、灯箱浏览及信任围栏局域网/移动端访问。

items.de: Pull frames and audio out of a local video with ffmpeg and hand back plain file paths, so the agent can look at the frames with its own vision. Five tools: probe, evenly spaced frames, one frame at a timestamp, scene-change frames (the practical version of frame-by-frame), and audio extraction. No m
items.dz: 用 ffmpeg 从本地视频里抽帧、抽音轨，只返回文件路径，让 agent 用自己的视觉去看。五个工具：探测、均匀抽帧、指定时刻取帧、场景变化抽帧（逐帧分析的实用版）、抽音轨。不碰模型、不上传、不需要配任何 provider，所以不存在路由选错的问题。

items.de: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
items.dz: 在 DSH 聊天记录中自动将本地音视频路径渲染为可播放预览：将路径替换为同源 /api/media-preview/* 路由支持的 <audio>/<video> 播放器，并返回明确的错误状态码。

items.de: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightb
items.dz: 在对话里直接生成图片和视频并发送到会话：generate_image / generate_video / send_media 三个工具，内置 Agnes 免费额度与任意 OpenAI 兼容后端，长耗时生成走后台任务完成后自动推送，内联画廊与视频卡片支持下载、灯箱查看和系统默认应用打开。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
items.dz: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

items.de: Repackages the MedXpert skill collection (zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills, Apache-2.0): twenty-one medical-device regulatory skills for NMPA, FDA, EU MDR, and PMDA workflows. Do not install the same skills twice (do not also copy them into ~/.dsh/skills).
items.dz: 把 MedXpert 技能集合（zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills，Apache-2.0）打包为 21 个医疗器械法规技能，覆盖 NMPA、FDA、EU MDR 与 PMDA；请勿重复安装同一套技能。

items.de: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
items.dz: 依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对病案首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾。列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

items.de: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed
items.dz: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

items.de: A Settings page for the memo plugin suite in DSH Web: edits the memo Host's AI route, archived-session summary language, length, transcript budget, template and prompt, and repository URL, adds a GitHub intake section for the claim label, per-run issue cap, autopilot switch and its working directory
items.dz: DSH Web 里的备忘插件套件设置页：修改备忘宿主的 AI 路由、归档会话总结的语言、长度、正文预算、模板与提示词以及仓库地址，另有一栏 GitHub 接单设置——认领标签、每轮 issue 上限、自动驾驶开关及其工作目录、preset、时区与派发提示词——支持逐字段恢复默认，保存后无需重启即作用于运行中的服务，并带一个检查更新入口：查询 npm registry，并可经部署的插件管理器安装新版本。

items.de: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model, and closes the intake l
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue，也打通接单闭环——按认领标签列出可接的 issue 并逐个派发到新会话，跳过此前已经派发过的 issue，开启自动驾驶后在每个本地日的首次启动时自动跑一轮。

items.de: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, summarizes archived DSH sessions into the week as one entry per session in the language and at th
items.dz: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，并能按读者所选语言与长度把 DSH 已归档会话总结进对应周、每个会话一条，修改非当前周需要显式确认，也能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告，另外会向 npm registry 查询自身是否有新版本，只返回准确的升级命令而不自行安装。

items.de: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry fo
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

items.de: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature
items.dz: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

items.de: Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a
items.dz: 基于 mem0 与本地 Chroma 的长期记忆：画像和相关事实经系统提示注入；会话结束自动捕获；夜间执行去重、近义归纳与矛盾处理；主题图持久化为 Markdown 主题卡；定期导出到 git 仓库；自带全屏记忆页，支持搜索、批量合并、快照与撤销。使用前需自建 Python 虚拟环境并填入 LLM 与 embedding 两组 API Key。

items.de: Run your DSH agents like a company: departments, order dispatch, attempt credentials, an audit ledger and cost accounting on top of ctx.agents/subagents — plus a work board, an org chart and DAG task planning, no native team layer required.
items.dz: 把 DSH 的 agent 当公司跑：部门、派工、attempt 凭证、审计账本与成本核算，叠加工作网看板、组织架构图与 DAG 任务图并行派发，无需原生 team 层。

items.de: Explains Chinese internet memes to an agent: registers a meme_explain tool that returns the meaning, tone, origin and lifecycle of a sticker, which memes can and cannot be combined, occasions to avoid, and both a meme-version and a plain-version reply. Answers come from a local memory store with spa
items.dz: 给 agent 装一双看懂梗的眼睛：注册 meme_explain 工具，返回表情包的意思、语气、出处与生命周期、能一起用与不能混用的梗、该避开的场合，并给出玩梗版与不玩梗版两种回复。结论来自带间隔效应衰减的本地记忆库，未命中时调用用户自配的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（BYOK）。

items.de: Per-workspace memo/todo panel that auto-captures queued and running user instructions, marks preempted tasks as interrupted, and restores them to their previous state with one click.
items.dz: 按工作区记录未完成任务：自动捕获排队/执行中的用户指令，插队自动标记打断，一键按原状态恢复重发。

items.de: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
items.dz: memoria 进阶工具：会话上下文注入（画像+召回）、近期决策、健康报告、命名空间白名单、记忆关系图与实体搜索；dsh-memoria 的伴生插件。

items.de: Local-first, file-backed memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown memories, verified trust, per-turn recall, and optional SQLite FTS5.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本地优先、基于文件的记忆插件：支持 Markdown 记忆存储、可验证的信任机制、逐轮次回忆，以及可选的 SQLite FTS5 全文检索。

items.de: Persistent conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory tab, automatic AI naming, per-AI privacy isolation, sidebar AI names, and automatic experience archiving. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化对话记忆：记忆标签页、AI 自动命名、按 AI 隔离的隐私边界、侧栏显示 AI 名称与经验自动归档。以静态 profile 插件形式在所有预设中常驻，重启不丢。

items.de: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vecto
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

items.de: Layered cross-session memory kept as plain YAML: facts carry a version history instead of being overwritten, a briefing is injected at session start, and a nightly pass consolidates and shards by topic past a threshold. Zero runtime dependencies, so it also runs inside the dsh Android app (verified
items.dz: 明文 YAML 的分层跨会话记忆：事实带版本链而非覆盖，会话开始注入简报，夜间整理并在超过阈值后按主题分片。零运行时依赖，在 dsh 安卓版实测可用。

items.de: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.
items.dz: 基于 pmp tavern 的 RP 记忆库：利用原版压缩机制管理 RP 历史总结，并隔离一般工具会话。完整召回功能需配合下游 anima 插件。需要启用插件注入的角色扮演预设。

items.de: Approval-free memory archiving for DeepSeek Harness: writes Markdown memory files without approval prompts, backs the old file up before any overwrite, marks a revised conclusion as status: superseded in one call, and prunes old backups after 30 days by default (optional size cap). The writable scop
items.dz: 免审批的记忆归档：直接写 Markdown 记忆文件，覆盖前自动备份，一次调用即可把被取代的旧结论标成 status: superseded，旧备份默认保留 30 天后自动清理（可设大小上限）。可写范围硬限制在配置的记忆根内（默认 ~/.dsh/memory）。与 dsh-kb-lite 配套，后者负责索引这些文件并对 superseded 降权。宿主侧插件，无 npm 依赖；需要 Node.js 18+。

items.de: Local three-band memory for DeepSeek Harness: a 24h protection band, query recall and scene replay, injected into sessions without embedding or model calls.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的本地三段式记忆带：24 小时保护带、按话题召回、场景回放，自动注入会话，不调用 embedding 或模型。

items.de: Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.
items.dz: DSH 的本地长期记忆库：面板里浏览、检索（BM25 + 同义词）、编辑；文件夹、归档、回收站；逐会话决定注入哪些；模型写入的记忆需你确认；可导入导出备份；可选同步到自己的 Git 或 WebDAV 实现多设备。

items.de: Layered memory for AI agents: five verbs (wake/work/pit/tomb/close), core layer read every time, archive on demand. Plain markdown, four pages created on first run; survives restarts, model swaps and plugin removal.
items.dz: 守链：给 AI agent 的分层记忆——五个动词（醒来/干活/遇坑/立碑/收工），核心层每次读、档案层按需查；首次运行自动建四页，纯 markdown、无数据库；重启、换模型、拔插件后记忆还在、判断还接得上。

items.de: Visualizes all DSH session memories as an interactive 3D nebula, with a neuron-signal skin, memory-scaled clusters, zoom-driven detail levels and a live write/read activity stream over SSE.
items.dz: 把 DSH 全部会话记忆可视化为可交互的 3D 星云，提供神经元信号皮肤、按记忆量缩放的星云团、缩放分级细节，以及基于 SSE 的实时存取活动流。

items.de: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
items.dz: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

items.de: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.
items.dz: dsh-memory-eternal 的维护版 fork：对话结束自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown 记忆库并按需召回，修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 兼容性。原项目由 EternalNight996 创建并维护（https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal），MIT。

items.de: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connecti
items.dz: 文件型长期记忆：每个会话开始注入你自己的 Markdown 记忆文件，提供带备份与撤销的读写工具，并能查出 DSH_HOME 漂移。默认不读对话；可选开启 autoScan 后，才从本机会话日志里提取你自己的发言交给 agent 归档。不联网。

items.de: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地内存守护插件：监控 host 堆与会话日志体积、拦截超大工具参数，并提供默认 dry-run 的会话瘦身命令。

items.de: Local-first, file-native long-term memory for DSH with per-turn preflight, compact context injection, citations, human-approved writes, manual consolidation, nightly report-only maintenance, and a Web panel that is read-only for knowledge while allowing workspace-config edits.
items.dz: 本地优先、文件原生的 DSH 长期记忆，提供每回合预检、紧凑上下文注入、引用、人工批准写入、手动汇总、夜间只读维护，以及一个知识视图只读、可编辑工作区配置的 Web 面板。

items.de: Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.
items.dz: 跨会话记忆：会话自动导出成能读的 Markdown（带出处），维护一份长期 MEMORY.md，新窗口醒来先看摘要。

items.de: Gives a DSH agent five layers of persistent memory kept as plain Markdown files — persona, speaking-style rules, daily diary, session archive and open loops — rebuilds a system-prompt section from them within a minute of a file change, and adds three tools (memory_read, memory_write, memory_search)
items.dz: 给 DSH 机器人装五层持久记忆（人设、说话规则、日记、会话存档、未了结的约定），全部存成磁盘上的纯 Markdown；文件改动一分钟内自动重建注入段落，配 memory_read / memory_write / memory_search 三个工具，另带一个从旧记忆目录迁移的导入器。

items.de: Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.
items.dz: 按工作区隔离的记忆库，支持按对话手动开启、可编辑规则、三种共用模式和连续遗忘；记忆卡仍是可读的 Markdown。

items.de: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.
items.dz: 面向「纯文件（markdown 卡片 + git）长期记忆库」的只读增强插件：memory_find 检索工具、一小段受预算约束的记忆库摘要注入，以及带概览/健康/开关的设置页。

items.de: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
items.dz: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

items.de: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user
items.dz: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

items.de: Intercepts DSH tool results before the model reads them: dedupe cache for repeated calls, a declarative decision graph that replaces large outputs with structured digests, an injection gate, and an honest token ledger that includes a negative-return account for over-compression. Measured 1400-1600 t
items.dz: 在模型读取之前拦截 DSH 工具结果：重复调用去重、用声明式决策图把大输出换成结构化摘要、注入闸门去重，并记一本含负收益科目的诚实账本（压过头导致重读会记亏损）。实测单次命中省 1400—1600 token；累计净收益目前为负，仓库里写明了原因，也写明了它无法跳过模型回合。

items.de: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
items.dz: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

items.de: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML f
items.dz: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

items.de: Memory for DeepSeek Harness with five sections (memories, tree, profile, graph, inbox), a rule-based capture policy that decides what to keep and what to drop, and hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval over parent and child chunks, backed by twelve agent tools that read and write the same local files.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：记忆、目录、画像、关系、待审五个分区；规则式自动沉淀，明确区分该记与不该记；父子分块的 BM25 + 向量混合检索；12 个工具读写同一份本地数据。

items.de: Sync a git-backed memory folder with a peer machine every time DeepSeek Harness starts — no daemon, no cron, no manual pull.
items.dz: 每次打开 DeepSeek Harness，自动把本机的 git 记忆目录和另一台机器双向同步一次——开机就有最新记忆，不用常驻后台。

items.de: Long-term notes and daily journals kept per workspace in a hot/cold archive, each tier with its own index and rebalanced once a day; read and written through seven memory_* tools, with a settings page for per-workspace options.
items.dz: 按工作空间保存日记与长期要点的冷热归档记忆：热档常驻、冷档下沉，每层各有一份索引，每天自动归纳一次；读写走七个 memory_* 工具，另有设置页可按工作空间调参数。

items.de: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automati
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

items.de: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
items.dz: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

items.de: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: per-turn archival and recall, two-phase consolidation of the per-day scene log (the host prompts every five unconsolidated rounds and the caller confirms with an ackToken), and validity, weight and expiry as three independent functions.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件：每轮自动存档与召回，对按天保存的情景原文做两阶段巩固（攒满五轮未巩固时由宿主提醒，调用方用 ackToken 确认），有效性、权重、过期三个函数各管一件事。

items.de: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 SQLite 长期记忆插件：按分类与标签增删改查、搜索、归档记忆，自动记录对话并分层压缩，带项目维度——检索默认收窄到当前工作区加全局事实。

items.de: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
items.dz: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

items.de: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
items.dz: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

items.de: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; auto
items.dz: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

items.de: Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes t
items.dz: 把随手记和待办写进工作区的 Markdown 文件里：/ml 加一句话就记进当天日志；待办分三种——截止日、睡到某天自动唤醒、随时；/ml view 打几个字母就能模糊打开任意文件。全程零 token，不经过大模型；笔记就是普通的本地文件，git 和任何编辑器都能直接用。

items.de: Lazy Menu for DSH — hide the duplicate DeepSeek account / official API entries in the model picker, in Settings → Models and in the subagent model list, plus sidebar and account-menu items (14 toggles); auto-fill reasoning levels (low / medium / high / max), context window and image input for new mo
items.dz: 懒人菜单：收起模型选择框、设置·模型、子智能体里重复的 DeepSeek 账号 / 官方 API 分组，隐藏侧边栏五项与账号菜单三项（共 14 个开关）；给新模型自动补推理等级（low / medium / high / max）、上下文窗口与图片支持；桌面版可一键给应用外壳 main.js 打补丁，把刷新与重启加进应用菜单（写入前自动备份、可一键还原；需重启应用，DSH 升级后补丁会失效）。

items.de: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.
items.dz: 菜单栏应用不在插件里：需在 macOS 上用仓库 app/ 目录自行执行 swift build -c release 构建，插件只提供宿主桥。

items.de: Renders the seven-layer SQLite store of meow-memory as a live 3D star map, with draggable nodes, layer rings and a click-through detail panel. Requires the meow-memory plugin and Node 22.5+.
items.dz: 把 meow-memory 的七层记忆库实时画成 3D 星图，光点可拖拽、可按层筛选，点开可看全文与元数据；需先安装 meow-memory 插件，并要求 Node 22.5+。

items.de: Renders mermaid code blocks in dsh web chat as diagrams. Each block gets a toggle in its header to switch between the diagram and the source; blocks still streaming stay as code until the message settles. Mermaid loads lazily the first time a diagram is shown. The terminal UI is unaffected.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 对话里把 mermaid 代码块渲染成图：每个代码块头部有切换按钮，可在图与源码之间切换；仍在流式输出的块保持源码，等消息结束后再渲染；首次显示图时才懒加载 mermaid；终端 UI 不受影响。

items.de: Renders mermaid fenced code blocks in the conversation as real diagrams, with the source one click away.
items.dz: 把会话里的 mermaid 代码块直接渲染成图表，源码一键可查。

items.de: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
items.dz: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

items.de: Renders ```mermaid code blocks in DSH Web chat as SVG diagrams, with a diagram/source toggle, light/dark theme following and source-preserving error fallback.
items.dz: 将 DSH 会话消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为 SVG 图形，支持图形与源码切换、跟随深浅色主题，渲染失败时保留源码并显示错误。

items.de: Control your DSH from your phone: opens a port on the mesh/VPN interface from inside the running process, so a phone browser gets the very same instance and session list — no SSH, no second dsh. Also works from another PC, a GUI NAS, or a TV box.
items.dz: 用手机远程控制电脑上的 DSH：在服务进程内部把端口开到组网网卡上，手机浏览器打开就是你在电脑上用的那个界面，同一实例、同一份会话，不用 SSH、不用第二个 dsh。顺带笔记本、NAS、电视盒子也能开。
rl: uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

items.de: Independent DSH plugin: Settings → brand color with preset swatches and a custom color picker; recolors only the sidebar/hero logo mark and favicon, never text. Works with DSH 0.2.0 and 0.2.2.
items.dz: 独立 DSH 插件：设置页「品牌颜色」，预设色卡 + 自定义取色，只给侧栏/首页 logo 和 favicon 上色，不改文字；兼容 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.2。

items.de: Keeps a dsh-mesh server alive across DSH engine restarts by supervising it from inside the host process; resolves the installed dsh-mesh-node package and fails loud when it is missing.
items.dz: 在 DSH 宿主进程内托管 dsh-mesh server，使其在引擎重启后自动恢复；解析已安装的 dsh-mesh-node 包，缺失时明确报错而不是静默失效。

items.de: DSH host-side bridge for a multi-device mesh: exposes local sessions and tools over a token-protected loopback HTTP endpoint so the dsh-mesh server on this machine (separate npm package dsh-mesh-node) can create sessions, prompt them and call tools for paired peers.
items.dz: 多设备 mesh 的 DSH 宿主桥：通过带 token 的本机回环 HTTP 暴露本地会话与工具，供本机另装的 dsh-mesh server（npm 包 dsh-mesh-node）为已配对 peer 创建会话、发消息、调用工具。

items.de: DSH sidebar page for a dsh-mesh network: peer topology, latency, TLS/version health and a delegation list. Resolves the installed dsh-mesh-node package for data.
items.dz: dsh-mesh 网络的 DSH 左侧栏页面：节点拓扑、延迟、TLS/版本健康状态与委托列表；数据来自已安装的 dsh-mesh-node 包。

items.de: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.
items.dz: 用户消息原位编辑与重发插件：在已发送消息气泡下方复制按钮旁提供铅笔编辑图标，点击原位展开圆角内联编辑框，支持从上一轮末尾分叉回退重发或在当前会话直接追发。

items.de: Bookmark a whole assistant reply with the star on its action row, or bookmark any selected sentence with the icon beside the selection; pins are saved as Markdown to a local folder or an Obsidian vault, and the existing right sidebar lists, tags, searches, exports and jumps back to them.
items.dz: 用回答操作行上的星标收藏整条回答，或用选区旁的星标收藏任意句子或段落；收藏以 Markdown 落盘到本地目录或 Obsidian 仓库，在 DSH 现有右侧栏中浏览、加笔记与标签、搜索、导出并跳回原文。

items.de: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each q
items.dz: 把本对话里的任意一条消息引用进输入框：@ 菜单选择，或点用户消息、AI 回复上的引用按钮，也可以选中文字后右键「引用」。引用在输入框里是带序号的芯片，上方浮出摘要气泡；发送后每条引用展开成独立块，模型能分清引用内容与新写内容。

items.de: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
items.dz: DSH 向你提问时在屏幕右下角弹出毛玻璃通知卡片，点击卡片即恢复并置顶窗口、回到发起询问的会话。

items.de: Meteor-night wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: a sharp full-window meteor picture, transparent sidebar and night-only ink.
items.dz: 流星夜色：整窗流星夜空壁纸、透明侧栏、夜间配色，桌面端与 dsh web 通用。

items.de: Microsoft To Do panel: browse lists, add, edit, complete and reopen tasks, and open notes, due date, reminder, recurrence, steps and attachments. Lists can be collected into local groups, and a batch of tasks can be picked into a My Day shortlist. Signs in with the Microsoft device-code flow; the to
items.dz: 微软待办面板：浏览清单，新增、编辑、完成与重新打开任务，并查看备注、截止日期、提醒、重复、步骤与附件；清单可在本机分组，也能挑一批任务放进「我的一天」。用微软设备码登录，令牌缓存由上游 microsoft-todo-mcp 服务持有（版本固定为 0.2.0，经 npx 启动，需要 Node.js 与可访问 npm，子进程只拿到白名单环境变量）；分组与「我的一天」存在本机。「今日」「逾期」「我的一天」以及新设的截止日期和提醒按设备时区计算（可用 DSH_TODO_TZONE 覆盖）。中英双语界面。

items.de: Lists every plugin installed in the current DSH profile, lets you tick the ones to keep, and exports them either as a migration sheet for a new machine or as a self-contained zip (local plugin sources plus a restore script) that a fresh DSH can install in one run. The restore script is PowerShell; a
items.dz: 列出当前 DSH 配置里装过的全部插件，勾选后导出成「迁移单」文本，或直接打包成自包含 zip（本地插件源码 + 恢复脚本），新电脑上跑一次脚本即可还原。恢复脚本是 PowerShell；还原后需重启 DSH，插件页报待安装时还需 pnpm install。

items.de: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
items.dz: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

items.de: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
items.dz: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

items.de: Bridges DSH to the local MimaVault password manager with seven tools for metadata search, entry lookup, clipboard copy, TOTP codes, password generation, domain-restricted API calls and user-confirmed vault clearing. By default it talks to the MimaVault desktop app, which must be installed separately
items.dz: 把本机 MimaVault 密码库接入 DSH，提供 7 个工具用于元数据检索、条目读取、剪贴板复制、动态验证码、口令生成、域名受限的 API 调用与需人工确认的清空请求。默认对接 MimaVault 桌面应用（需另行安装）；可选的内置模式以明文保存条目。

items.de: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
items.dz: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

items.de: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness through Xiaomi MiMo TTS, needs a XIAOMI_API_KEY: a mimo_tts tool that writes audio to a local file, a read-aloud action on each finalized answer, auto-read, and a sidebar panel for built-in voices, voice design by description, or voice cloning from an mp3/wav samp
items.dz: 通过小米 MiMo TTS 为 DSH 提供语音合成，需要 XIAOMI_API_KEY：mimo_tts 工具落盘音频、回答的「播报」按钮、自动播报，以及侧边栏语音设置（内置音色、文字描述生成音色、样本克隆）。与 lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts 包名相同，不能同装。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的小米 MiMo 语音插件：把每段回答念出来、把输入框里的口述变成文字，带 9 个内置音色和一个克隆音色槽位。

items.de: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.
items.dz: MiMo TTS 语音合成——已定稿助手回复的朗读按钮与内联播放器（可拖动进度条）、插件页配置卡片（支持试听）和语音历史设置页。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: View XMind, FreeMind, OPML, KityMinder and VYM mind maps in the sidebar, edit and save all of them except read-only XMind (convert it to .mm first), export to .mm, and read or edit outlines through agent tools.

items.dz: DSH 的网易云音乐整页播放器，改造自 stardream-1/dsh-netease-float（沿用同名包，不能与上游同时安装）：正在播放、全屏歌词、歌单、搜索与账号登录。

items.de: Windows only, needs the NetEase Cloud Music client installed. NetEase Cloud Music player for the DSH Web UI: a mini bar that expands into a liquid-glass card with search, synced lyrics and volume, a click-to-open spinning vinyl view, and it signs in with the local NetEase client account (cookie decr
items.dz: 仅 Windows，需本机装有网易云音乐客户端。DSH Web 的网易云音乐播放器：收起是迷你播放条，点开是液态玻璃卡片（搜索 / 歌词 / 音量），点封面区切换成旋转黑胶视图；自动使用本机网易云客户端账号登录（cookie 仅在本机解密），VIP 曲目可播，并可把客户端正在播放的歌一键拉进来。

items.de: Maintained continuation of dsh-network: authenticated LAN, Tailnet and HTTPS access to a DSH host, with pairing QR and current Web browser-auth support. Replaces the upstream dsh-network (remove it first; both register the same /dsh-network routes); the gateway listens on 0.0.0.0:3081 by default, se
items.dz: dsh-network 的维护续作：为 DSH 主机提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与 HTTPS 接入，含配对二维码并适配新版 Web 浏览器认证。替代上游 dsh-network（先卸载它，两者注册相同的 /dsh-network 路由）；网关默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081，可用 bindHost 限制。

items.de: Network Engineer Assistant preset plus a 12-vendor, 96-document switch/router/firewall command knowledge base skill (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS) with KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor comm
items.dz: 网络工程师助手预设 + 12 厂商 96 篇交换机/路由器/防火墙命令知识库技能（华为/新华三/锐捷/迪普/思科 IOS·NX-OS/Junos/Arista EOS/FortiOS/中兴/VyOS/MikroTik），支持知识库优先检索、跨厂商命令对照、拓扑与 CLI 截图识图、带引用的联网查手册，并对高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；仅回答网络工程主题。是 sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer 的社区延续版（见 NOTICE.md）；两者注册同一个 network-command-kb 技能和同一个「网络工程师助手」预设，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Gives the model in DeepSeek Harness a real new_conversation tool: creates a session in the current workspace, delivers a self-contained handoff as its first user message, optionally attaches a read-only dsh-session: reference to the calling conversation, pins the title, and switches the Web UI to th
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的模型一个真正能用的「新开对话」工具：在当前工作区建会话、投递交接消息、带上一段对话的只读引用，并把 Web UI 自动切过去。

items.de: Ecommerce research for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth into the Nexscope MCP server, marketplace data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Shopee, Temu and 1688, plus a bundled nexscope skill.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的电商研究插件：OAuth 接入 Nexscope MCP，覆盖亚马逊、TikTok Shop、沃尔玛、Shopee、Temu 与 1688 等市场数据，并捆绑 nexscope 技能。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
items.dz: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

items.de: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.
items.dz: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。

items.de: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.
items.dz: 下一步建议：每轮回答结束后，用会话当前模型做一次辅助调用提炼 3 条可点击的后续提问建议，显示在输入框上方，点击任意一条即填入草稿。

items.de: Per-turn next-step suggestions under each reply: a 2x2 grid of up to four clickable actions, projected from that turn's own tool result instead of a shared per-session store.
items.dz: 在每轮回复下方按 2×2 给出最多四条可点的下一步建议；按轮次投影，不会把上一轮的建议带到下一轮。

items.de: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn in the DeepSeek Harness chat: the model proposes a few followup prompts at the end of each turn, they render as clickable cards under that turn, and clicking one sends it verbatim as your next message. Each card stays attached to the turn t
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天的每个已完成的智能体回合下方，都会给出可一键继续的下一步建议：模型在回合结尾提出若干后续提示，它们以可点击的卡片渲染在该回合下，点击即原样作为你的下一条消息发送。每张卡片始终归属于产生它的回合，重载与重启后依然对应；生成语言可在 15 种语言中选择或跟随对话；dsh 设置内还有设置页（语言、每个回合的建议数量、标题显示与内置更新检查）。需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（web profile）与 Node.js 20+。

items.de: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

items.de: Per-session fast-delivery mode from the composer. New conversations start enabled; switching is refused while that conversation is running, and a read-only session-header badge shows on/off during a run. One switch drives three subsystems: a circuit breaker that short-circuits test and build command
items.dz: 按会话独立的极速交付模式，从输入框切换。新对话默认开启；对话运行期间拒绝切换，并在会话头部显示只读开/关徽标。一个开关驱动三个子系统：测试与构建命令断路器（不真正执行，直接返回成功回执）、按 SEARCH/REPLACE 冲突块原子写入的 apply_patch 工具（任一锚点未命中则整次回滚）、以及把终端输出脱水成一句通过或最后 15 行错误的脱水器。

items.de: A handwritten-journal salary timer on the DSH composer dock: set your monthly salary and work hours, then it shows how much you have earned today and this month in real time, plus daily, hourly and per-second rates, progress toward quitting time, hours worked past quitting time, weekday attendance d
items.dz: 挂在 DSH 输入框下方的「牛马费用计时器」手帐小卡——填好到手月薪与上下班时间，实时显示今天已挣多少、本月累计多少，附带日薪/时薪/秒薪、下班进度条、下班后的无偿加班时长、工作日打卡点阵与状态章（打工中、午休中、已下班、无偿加班、休息日）。配置只存在页面 localStorage，不发网络请求。

items.de: Runs DeepSeek Harness bash commands inside the workspace's Nix dev shell whenever a flake.nix is present.
items.dz: 工作区存在 flake.nix 时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的 bash 命令在 nix develop 的 devShell 环境中执行。

items.de: Disables the built-in llm-deepseek-account route so the DeepSeek account model group no longer appears in the picker.
items.dz: 通过禁用内置的 llm-deepseek-account 路由，让模型选择器里不再出现「DeepSeek 账号」模型组。

items.de: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about
items.dz: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

items.de: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
items.dz: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

items.de: Adds a work-without-a-project option to the project picker, creates a dated working directory from the first message, and groups these sessions under a native Recent section.
items.dz: 为不属于任何项目的会话提供「不在项目中工作」选项，按首条消息在 ~/Documents/dsh/<日期>/ 下创建可读的独立工作目录，并在侧栏「最近」分区集中展示。

items.de: Runs shell scripts on cron or interval schedules inside the host with no model call, logging every run and waking the model only when a script's output changes.
items.dz: 在宿主内按 cron 或固定间隔运行 shell 脚本，不调用模型，按次记录日志，只在脚本输出变化时唤醒模型。

items.de: Local Markdown notebook: a three-column vault (rail, folder tree, editor), split live preview, tags, stars and pins, a todo centre that gathers every checkbox in the vault and writes ticks back to the file, full-text search, session-to-note deposit, insert a note into a conversation, save an answer
items.dz: 本地 Markdown 笔记库：三栏布局（导航栏、目录树、编辑器）、双栏实时预览、标签、收藏与置顶、聚合全库复选框并回写文件的待办中心、全文搜索、会话沉淀成笔记、把笔记插入对话、把回答保存为笔记、跳回来源回答的链接、笔记库目录与字号设置，以及四个 note_* 工具。

items.de: Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes in the DSH sidebar with search, tags, backlinks, graph, audio notes with transcription, a paint canvas, OCR (needs tesseract), client-side encryption and notes_* agent tools; the release tarball and the npm package carry a prebuilt Linux x64 daemon, other platforms
items.dz: DSH 侧栏里的 Obsidian 兼容 Markdown 笔记：搜索、标签、反向链接、图谱、带转写的语音笔记、画布、OCR（需 tesseract）、客户端加密与 notes_* agent 工具；release tarball 与 npm 包自带预构建的 Linux x64 daemon，其他平台需用 Go 从源码构建。

items.de: Sidebar sticky-note wall for DeepSeek Harness: capture notes locally, color-code and group them, attach links and images; data stays on your machine.
items.dz: DSH 侧栏便签墙：随手记录灵感，用颜色和分类整理，支持链接与图片，数据只存本机。

items.de: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.
items.dz: 侧边栏记事本：带标题与正文的记事，可插入图片（拒收视频）；点标题把正文复制到剪贴板；输入框里可用 @ 引用某条记事；可选在新会话时自动打开记事本。

items.de: Turns up to 30 uploaded PDF papers into prompt-driven literature reviews, key findings, research ideas and study designs, exported as page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).
items.dz: 把最多 30 篇上传的 PDF 文献变成提示词驱动的文献综述、关键信息提取、研究思路与研究设计，并导出带页码引用的报告（DOCX/PDF）或演示文稿（PPTX/PDF）。

items.de: A page for writing notes inside DeepSeek Harness. · Minimal writing — one page that typesets as you type. · AI completion — a suggestion arrives when you pause, and TAB takes it. · Immersive writing — full screen, with only the page on it. · History — every note listed, searched and edited in place,
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 里的笔记页。 · 极简写 — 一页纸，边写边排版。 · AI 自动补全 — 停笔片刻给出建议，TAB 采纳。 · 沉浸式书写 — 全屏，只有这张纸。 · 历史记录 — 笔记可列、可搜、就地编辑，一键复制标准 Markdown。 · AI 看板 — 数据助手用你的笔记回答，并把图表钉在看板上。

items.de: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.
items.dz: 把笔记存成你选定根目录下按分组组织的本地 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面，并把 AGENTS 等规则 md 作为写作上下文，另有六个 agent 工具。

items.de: Notes workspace in the right sidebar: a notes tree beside a live-preview Markdown editor with tabs, split panes, outline and trash, over plain .md files and a thin per-workspace index. Agents organize it through one `knowledge` tool; `embed` fences render an interactive HTML page in a sandboxed ifra
items.dz: 右侧栏的笔记工作区：笔记树 + 实时预览的 Markdown 编辑器（标签 / 分屏 / 大纲 / 回收站），笔记是普通 .md 文件，索引是按工作区的薄映射，Agent 侧只用一个 `knowledge` 工具整理；`embed` 围栏把可交互网页演示嵌进笔记（沙箱 iframe，脚本可跑、断网、拿不到宿主）。

items.de: A sticky-notes wall pinned to the sidebar: one click opens a full-page wall, notes save as you type, and writing #tags in the text turns them into one-click filter chips. Six paper colors, pinning, search, JSON export and import.
items.dz: 钉在侧栏的便签墙：一键打开整页墙面，边写边自动保存，正文里写 #标签 就会变成可点击的筛选胶囊。六种纸色、置顶、搜索，支持 JSON 导出与导入。

items.de: Sends one system notification when a DSH turn ends: per-outcome switches for completed, error and interrupted, a minimum-duration threshold, silent subagents and unfocused-window-only delivery. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux, delivered through a connected page or a native fallback (PowerShell toa
items.dz: DSH 每轮任务结束时弹一条系统通知：完成 / 出错 / 中断分别开关，可设最短耗时、子任务静默、只在窗口不在前台时提示。Windows / macOS / Linux 通用，页面开着走页面通道，否则回退 PowerShell toast / osascript / notify-send（Linux 原生回退需装 libnotify）；页面 / Electron 通道的通知可点击把 DSH 拉回前台，PowerShell 与 notify-send 的通知点不动。

items.de: Configure automation Hooks for user and project scopes to run commands on session, tool, permission, and context-compaction events. Manage Hook authorization manually in Hooks setting.
items.dz: 为用户和项目配置自动化 Hook，在会话、工具调用、权限请求和上下文压缩等事件发生时运行命令。Hook 授权需在“Hooks 设置”中手动管理。

items.de: Turn-end reminders for DSH 0.2.x — the host folds each session's last completed turn into a projection and the desktop shell shows it as a real Windows toast, with per-outcome filters, background-only gating and a settings page. The Windows desktop shell must register its AUMID once before toasts ap
items.dz: DSH 0.2.x 的完成提醒——宿主把每个会话最后一次 turn/end 折成投影，桌面端再发成真正的 Windows toast；带按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒和设置页；Windows 桌面壳需先注册一次 AUMID，toast 才能弹出。

items.de: Plays a Windows system sound when the agent opens a question dialog, when a tool asks for permission, and when a conversation turn ends, plus a fish_beep tool to trigger a sound on demand. Custom audio folders are supported.
items.dz: 弹出选项卡提问时、请求工具权限时、一轮对话结束时，各播放一次提示音；支持自定义音频文件夹；另附 fish_beep 工具，可随时手动响一声。

items.de: Reminder bubbles beside the input for DeepSeek Harness: any plugin or AI can push reminders (text/link) with chat-style stacking, drag-resize, AI summary, visual customization and random outfit presets. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.
items.dz: 在输入框右边加了一个泡泡窗口，你可以接入插件或者告诉 AI 什么时候使用它。

items.de: Native desktop alerts when dsh needs the human — approvals, questions, plan reviews, turn completion, goals, errors and workflow runs — plus a Settings tab for every option, hot-applied.
items.dz: 当 dsh 需要你注意时发出桌面通知——权限确认、提问、计划审批、回合完成、目标、出错、工作流——并提供设置页「通知」选项卡，改动即时生效。

items.de: Cross-device notifications for DeepSeek Harness. While a long task runs unattended, a finished turn, a pending approval or a question reaches you through the enabled channels: desktop toast, browser tab, ntfy push or Feishu bot.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备通知插件。执行长任务期间无需值守：任务结束、等待审批或等待回答时，通过已启用的渠道发出提醒，可选桌面通知、浏览器标签页、ntfy 推送或飞书机器人。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
items.dz: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

items.de: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness — a web notification while a browser page holds the plugin (turn completion and pending questions), and a native Windows toast from the host for finished turns once the browser is closed.
items.dz: DSH 桌面通知：页面开着时弹网页通知（回合结束与待回复问题），浏览器关掉后由 Host 对已完成的回合弹 Windows 原生通知。

items.de: System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).
items.dz: 系统级桌面通知：回合完成 / 工作流完成横幅，需要审批时弹出模态提醒（macOS osascript / Linux notify-send）。

items.de: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

items.de: Plays a distinct chime when a turn finishes, is interrupted, fails, or asks a question, and can show a Windows toast for questions.
items.dz: 回合完成、中断、出错或 Agent 提问时播放可区分的提示音，提问时可弹 Windows 系统通知。

items.de: A lightweight task completion notification plugin for DSH (dsh-notify-lite). When the agent finishes its work, it delivers Windows native Toast notifications with the first paragraph of the latest reply (40 characters by default). Supports taskbar unread badges, audio alerts, and configurable notifi
items.dz: 为 DSH 打造的轻量任务完成通知插件（dsh-notify-lite）。在 agent 结束工作时，通过 Windows 原生 Toast 弹窗即时提醒，正文取最后一条回复的首段（默认 40 字）。支持任务栏未读角标、提示音与可配置提醒；不常驻托盘或后台服务，聚焦不打扰。MIT 开源，持续跟进 DSH 兼容。

items.de: Routes eight DSH lifecycle events through dedup, quiet hours and digest batching into seven channels. Severity maps to the fields Bark, ntfy, Telegram and webhooks actually support; failed deliveries retry with jittered backoff and survive a restart; per-channel circuit breakers stop hammering a dea
items.dz: 把 DSH 的八类生命周期事件过去重、免打扰、摘要合批三道关后外发到七个通道。严重度映射到 Bark、ntfy、Telegram 和 webhook 真正支持的字段；失败投递带抖动退避重试并可跨重启恢复；单通道熔断避免反复敲一个已死的地址；自检发现中继降级时主动报告而不是静默。

items.de: Windows desktop notifications with selectable sounds: five bundled sound packs (45 clips) plus imported audio, one sound per event, and clicking a notification opens the matching session.
items.dz: Windows 桌面通知 + 可选音效：内置五组共 45 个音效并支持导入音频，可逐事件指定音效，点击通知直接跳到对应会话。

items.de: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
items.dz: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

items.de: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which rai

items.de: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. items.dz: 侧栏底部的一行小徽标：显示 OpenCode Go 额度（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口），切到 DeepSeek 官方模型时显示余额。只读，无遥测。OpenCode Go 额度需要在 DSH 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，或登录 OpenCode Console（会兜底读取其本地凭据文件）；DeepSeek 余额需要在 DSH 中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

items.dz: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。
