items.de: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
items.dz: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

items.de: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.
items.dz: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

items.de: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the arguments you type, and twelve openspec-* skills the model loads on its own.
items.dz: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

items.de: Computer Use for every DSH session: screen capture, mouse and keyboard, app launch, plan and skill replay, an audit log, guards for dangerous actions, a background code agent, and an OCR workflow (text and coordinates) for apps whose accessibility tree is empty. Verified on macOS only: Windows has a
items.dz: 装一次、所有 DSH 会话可用的 Computer Use 插件：截屏、鼠标键盘、启动应用、计划与技能回放、审计日志、危险动作守卫、后台代码代理，以及面向无障碍树缺失应用的 OCR 工作流（文字与坐标）。仅 macOS 已验证：Windows 只有未验证的基础 GUI 后端，Linux 没有桌面后端（调用报 unsupported_platform），窗口/AX/浏览器/剪贴板工具只在 macOS 注册。

items.de: Injects a very short conventions reminder (absolute INDEX path + version) once per session per version; when the conventions version changes, the next turn re-injects it (chat turns included). Optional hard guard: on operation-like turns, write/edit tools are rejected until the session has read the
items.dz: 每会话每版本注入一条极短的「操作约定」门铃（入口清单绝对路径 + 版本号）；约定版本一改，下一轮就重新注入（闲聊轮也算）。可选硬拦截：操作类轮次里未读索引前，拒绝 write/edit 等写类工具（闲聊轮与 shell 默认不拦）。清单可随包自带，也可指向自己的目录；零依赖、路径可配置。用于解决「约定记了但干活时不提就不用」。

items.de: Five-tier reasoning protocol injected into the system prompt — off / light / standard / deep / multi-agent, 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 rules — with the tokens each tier adds per request shown beside it. Alongside it: a claim ledger that marks a load-bearing claim with no evidence or check as unsupported, r
items.dz: 注入系统提示的五档推理协议——关 / 轻 / 标准 / 深 / 多智能体，分别 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 条规则——每档旁边标出它给单次请求增加多少 token。此外还有结论台账（承重结论没有证据或检查就判为不支持）、只读分析员简报、当轮即生效的 JSON 声明式自建工具、一个持久的 PowerShell 会话，以及按可配置的消息间隔重发宿主上下文。0 档不注入任何内容，也不挂工具。衍生自 husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027（MIT），不要与上游同装——两者都会往系统提示里注入各自的推理协议段。

items.de: Per-session control of which skills and MCP tools/servers the model can see (built-in tools are untouched): default shows everything, auto asks the model each turn what to keep, smart picks from your saved groups, or tick groups by hand, with a switcher under the composer and fail-open to full visib
items.dz: 按会话控制模型能看到哪些技能与 MCP 工具/服务器（不碰内置工具）：default 全部可见，auto 每轮由模型判定保留哪些，smart 从你建好的分组里选，也可手动勾选分组；输入框下方可随时切换，任何出错都回到全部可见。默认状态为 auto，每轮多一次模型调用（默认沿用当前会话模型，可用 judgeModel 指定）。

items.de: Acceptance gate for DSH: freeze the acceptance criteria into an oracle ledger before work starts, then honor only real execution receipts — files changed after freezing are refused outright, and a failing hard gate overrides any human pass.
items.dz: DSH 验收闸门：动手前把验收判据冻结成 oracle 账本，之后只认真实执行回执——冻结后被改过的文件直接拒绝执行，硬门失败时人工放行也无效。

items.de: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

items.de: Dispatches coding tasks to local Orca-managed agents and reports completion to DSH; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
items.dz: 将编程任务派给本地 Orca 管理的 Agent 并将完成状态带回 DSH，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

items.de: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

items.de: An Orchestrate tab in dsh-better-sidebar and 14 orch_* tools to spawn, prompt, fork and cancel agent chats, run command, scrape, http and agent tasks on local, ssh or remote runners, show provider status cards, and serve a secret-protected machine API. Requires DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1, Node >= 22.5, the w
items.dz: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 中提供 Orchestrate 标签页，并有 14 个 orch_* 工具：创建、提示、分叉和取消 agent 会话，在本机、ssh 或远程 runner 上执行 command、scrape、http、agent 四类任务，展示各 provider 状态卡片，并提供受密钥保护的机器 API。需 DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1、Node >= 22.5、web profile 与 dsh-better-sidebar。

items.de: Finds process trees whose parent is gone, groups them as high-confidence or review-only, and terminates the selected groups after a rescan.
items.dz: 找出父进程已退出的进程树，按高置信与待确认分档展示，二次扫描后才结束选中的进程组。

items.de: OTA guest-review reply ledger check: content and score, reply deadlines, responder, issue category and duplicate review ids.
items.dz: OTA 点评回复台账核对：点评内容与评分、回复时限、回复人、问题分类与编号重复。

items.de: Gives the model a private glossary: reads 「滚木」 as "none" and 「棍母」 as "doesn't exist", and decides on its own whether to phrase a sentence with those words when expressing that meaning. Registers one system-prompt section and rewrites nothing; word lists ship as per-category YAML (moba/fps/comments/a
items.dz: 给模型一份私密黑话词表：用户写「滚木」按「没有」理解、写「棍母」按「不存在」理解；模型要表达这些含义时，自己判断是否用词表里的词把整句组织得自然通顺。只注入一个 system prompt 段落，不改写输入输出；词表按分类存在 YAML（moba/fps/comments/ai/dev/private），设置页里可开关词表、切换提醒强度、直达词表目录。

items.de: Shows the remaining quota of the current Our Free Model (OFM) channel beside the DSH composer, with a panel listing every signed-in channel; exhausted channels are flagged and switching models switches the channel shown. Requires dsh-our-free-model with at least one channel signed in.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示 Our Free Model（OFM）当前渠道的剩余额度，点开可看全部已登录渠道；余额用尽时红底标注，切换模型会跟着切渠道。需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录至少一个渠道。

items.de: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, r
items.dz: DSH 成果登记：agent 把一次任务的最终成果（报告、网页、文档、表格、图片、数据表）登记进设置页与管理页的同一份清单，只记路径、不搬文件，删除可撤销；独立 CLI（add/list/stats/check/remove/restore）在应用外也能查同一份清单，并核对登记的文件是否还在。

items.de: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
items.dz: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

items.de: Adds an Outlook mailbox and calendar to DeepSeek Harness, with unread badges and AI-assisted email drafts. Sign-in uses the Microsoft Entra app whose client ID you enter in settings; without one it falls back to Microsoft's own Office client ID, which Microsoft can refuse (personal accounts get AADS
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek 助理中接入 Outlook 邮箱和日历，支持未读角标与 AI 邮件草稿。登录使用你在设置里填写客户端 ID 的 Microsoft Entra 应用；不填则回退到微软自己的 Office 客户端 ID，微软可能拒绝（个人账户会报 AADSTS65002）。申请的权限包括邮件读写与发信、日历和 To Do 读写。AI 功能会把邮件内容交给你配置的模型；欢迎页天气会请求 Open-Meteo，使用当前位置时还会请求 BigDataCloud。

items.de: Two split composer controls for output style: a tone switch with its own preset menu, and an output-form switch with its own preset menu; each session's system prompt follows the selections, with a preset settings page.
items.dz: 输出风格：输入框里两个分体控件（沟通基调、产出形态各带独立开关与预设菜单），按会话注入系统提示词，并带预设管理设置页。

items.de: Two-way sync between a local LaTeX folder and an Overleaf project over the Overleaf Socket.IO + OT channel instead of a Git bridge: pull with automatic git init, dry-run-first push, three-way diff, background watch, and conflict copies that never overwrite.
items.dz: 不走 Git 桥接，而是通过 Overleaf 自身的 Socket.IO + OT 通道在本地 LaTeX 文件夹与 Overleaf 项目之间双向同步：拉取后自动 git init、推送默认 dry-run、三方 diff、后台 watch，冲突永不覆盖而是另存副本。

items.de: Serves the OwlCoda RunKit skill in the DSH skill catalog: project-owned objectives, work items, candidate identity, verification receipts, handoffs and recovery stay in project artifacts. Installs instructions only; the project-local owlrunkit CLI is a separate setup step.
items.dz: 把 OwlCoda RunKit 技能加入 DSH 技能目录：目标、WorkItem、候选身份、验证回执、交接和恢复保存在项目工件中。只安装指令；项目本地的 owlrunkit CLI 仍需单独安装。

items.de: Persona 3 Reload style skin: midnight-blue palette, cyan hairlines, skewed blue selection slabs, game-style-like dialogue boxes.
items.dz: Persona 3 Reload 风格皮肤：午夜蓝配色、青色细线、斜切蓝色选中板、类游戏式对话框。

items.de: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.
items.dz: 输入框里的菱形按钮：把草稿改写成结构化提示词，再点一次还原原始输入。

items.de: Mints a fresh remote-web-ui pairing link and shows its QR in the dsh settings page.
items.dz: 在 dsh 设置页直接铸造 remote-web-ui 远程访问配对链接并显示二维码。

items.de: Device-pairing gateway for DeepSeek Harness: by default it listens on 127.0.0.1:3443 over plain HTTP and reverse-proxies the local dsh at http://127.0.0.1:3080, so a loopback-only install works without any certificate. Production, cross-machine and app pairing require TLS: configure tlsCert/tlsKey p
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的设备配对网关：默认只监听 127.0.0.1:3443（明文 HTTP）并把请求反代到本机 http://127.0.0.1:3080，本机安装无需证书即可使用。生产/跨机/App 配对必须配置 TLS 证书（自签即可）与 https 的 publicUrl；若在前置 Caddy/Nginx 终止对外 TLS，网关自身仍须配置 tlsCert/tlsKey，并由代理以 HTTPS 回源。功能：TOTP 授权的扫码设备配对、用户名密码登录、带绝对上限的滑动会话、设备吊销、WebUI 管理面板与审计日志、含 WebSocket 隧道的反向代理。首次初始化在 We

items.de: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.
items.dz: 磁盘审查盘面：Agent 写语义、你做决定，清理前预览、执行后可撤销。

items.de: Fold the sidebar plugin-panel list to three entries, drag them to reorder, and keep every other panel one click away in a More menu — order and pins persist in localStorage.
items.dz: 侧栏插件面板入口压缩：默认只留三个，按住鼠标拖动排序，其余全部收进「更多」菜单（点名字直接打开，✓/＋ 决定去留），选择和顺序记在 localStorage。

items.de: Rearranges the panel entries at the top of the DSH sidebar: drag to reorder or sort alphabetically, hide an entry without unloading its plugin, and split entries into named groups that render as titled separators; group headers collapse on click. A layout guard caps the entry list height and makes i
items.dz: 管理 DSH 侧栏顶部的全局面板入口：拖动排序或按名称排序、逐项隐藏（不卸载插件）、分成命名分组并渲染为带标题的分隔线，分组标题可点击折叠。布局兜底会给入口列表限高并允许滚动，入口变多时不再把会话/工作区列表挤到看不见。可选开关让当前 profile 的默认模型提议分组，模型返回的 id 与组名先经宿主白名单清洗再写入本地。

items.de: Folds the DSH sidebar's global panel launchers into the More button it already renders, so the workspace and session list below regains up to seven 36px rows. A row in the More menu toggles the fold back, and the choice is kept in localStorage.
items.dz: 把 DSH 侧边栏的全局面板入口收进它本来就有的『更多』按钮，下面的工作区与会话列表最多多出七行 36px 的高度；『更多』菜单里一行开关即可还原，选择记在 localStorage 里。

items.de: Hides unused panels in the left rail grouped by origin, and turns the rail More button into an expand/collapse toggle that lays out every panel.
items.dz: 把左侧栏用不到的面板按来源分组收起；「更多」按钮变成一键展开/折叠全部面板的开关。

items.de: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu — the full panel inventory (pinned and unpinned, unpinned open via temporary-pin peek), collapsible group memory, in-menu search with hit hig
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行（含未钉住的，未钉面板临时打开后还原）与第三方插件入口收进一个可搜索的分组「面板」菜单——分组折叠记忆、菜单内搜索带命中高亮与全键盘导航、Alt+1..9 直达第 N 个可见项、悬停钉住/置顶快捷操作。Ctrl+K 命令面板镜像同一清单，附带快捷命令、「最近使用」组（MRU 持久化）与具名布局预设——把整套排布（钉住、置顶、折叠、白名单、仅图标、紧凑底部区）存成预设一键套用。v1.0.0 新增自定义分组：在设置页建组、行内改名、挑选成员，菜单与命令面板中作为一等分组渲染且计数准确。右键上下文菜单（键盘可达）、面板行仅图标、置顶拖拽排序

items.de: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.
items.dz: 为 dsh web 的侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供独立的不透明度控制。

items.de: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control and a Markdown notes vault.
items.dz: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

items.de: Bundles a deep-read paper library and the paper-deepread-html skill: a sidebar panel to browse interactive reading reports, upload PDFs into a managed library, deep-read them with an agent (or through an optional site auto-read worker), and manage or rebuild the library; ships the paper_deepread, pa
items.dz: 把文献精读库与 paper-deepread-html 精读技能打包成 dsh 插件：侧边栏浏览交互式报告、上传 PDF 到托管书库、由 Agent 或可选接入的站点自动精读 worker 精读、管理或重建书库；提供 paper_deepread、paper_deepread_uploads、paper_deepread_reports 三个模型工具。精读摄取与成稿需要 Python 3（内置技能首次会准备 PyMuPDF 解释器；重建索引会退化为纯 python3）。

items.de: Mendeley-style paper library for DeepSeek Harness: import PDFs, read them in the panel with highlights, notes and questions, turn AI answers into note cards, compare 2–6 papers, build a typed relation graph (manual, AI-discovered, or citations parsed from PDF references), and keep everything as plai
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Mendeley 式论文库：导入 PDF、在面板内阅读并做高亮/划线/笔记/提问、把 AI 回答生成笔记卡片、对比 2–6 篇论文、建立带类型的论文关联图谱（手动添加、AI 发现、从 PDF 参考文献解析引用），全部以普通文件存放在可由任意云盘同步的目录里。

items.de: Academic paper reading and citation manager for DeepSeek Harness: left-rail library, original-layout PDF reader, six citation styles, a Word bibliography append, and AI translation/summary/mind-map/term lookup. A derivative of jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader (now dsh-vibe-reading, MIT) that shares its
items.dz: 面向学生与研究者的论文阅读与引用管理器：左侧栏论文库、原样 PDF 阅读器、六种引用格式、Word 文末参考文献，以及 AI 翻译/概括/思维导图/术语。基于 jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader（现名 dsh-vibe-reading，MIT）扩展，默认共用 `~/.paper_reading` 工作目录——不要与上游同装。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar 插件。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Whole-PDF paper translation for DSH on top of a BabelDOC installation you provide (Python CLI, with an OpenAI-compatible API key in its config.toml): bilingual dual-page output, a token cost estimate before running, a per-domain glossary reused across papers, and the server-side thinking overhead di
items.dz: DSH 的整篇 PDF 文献翻译：BabelDOC（Python CLI 及其 config.toml 里的 OpenAI 兼容 API Key）需自行安装配置；输出双语对照 PDF，跑之前先给 token 成本预估，按领域跨论文复用术语表，并关掉翻译环节服务端默认开启的 thinking 推理开销。

items.de: A local literature workbench for Windows x64 with PDF reading and annotations, automatic initial reading, separate per-paper Harness conversations, and a library assistant that searches metadata and shared summaries.
items.dz: Windows x64 本地文献工作台，支持 PDF 阅读与批注、导入后自动初读、每篇论文独立的 Harness 对话，以及按元数据和共享摘要检索的文献库助手。

items.de: Paper-reading workspace for DeepSeek Harness — page-by-page bilingual PDF translation, select-to-translate, paper-aware chat with page citations, notes, diagrams and cloud sync.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的论文阅读工作台：中英整页对照翻译、划词即译、带页码引用的伴读对话，以及笔记、框架图与云同步。

items.de: Fully background browser automation for DSH: an offscreen browser per conversation that never steals focus or pops windows, with real CDP input.
items.dz: 完全后台静默运行的浏览器自动化：每个对话一个离屏浏览器，不抢焦点、不弹窗，提供真实 CDP 输入。

items.de: By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.
items.dz: 默认拦截缺少「验收通过」独立记录、或验收提交与 worktree HEAD 不一致的团队任务完成操作，并提供依赖 DAG 看板与设置页。

items.de: Discourages unnecessary sequential tool calls by guiding the model to batch ready, independent calls, potentially reducing wait time, model round trips, and token use when the runtime supports parallel execution; no scheduler changes.
items.dz: 引导模型将已就绪且互不依赖的工具调用合批，减少不必要的串行调用；在运行时支持并行执行时，有望缩短等待时间、减少模型交互轮次及 token 消耗，不修改调度器。

items.de: Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long text written by other plugins is taken over the same way.
items.dz: 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：悬停看正文与出处，发送时按原位展开；其他插件写入的长文本同样接管。

items.de: Codex-style paste collapse for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a paste of more than 1000 characters becomes a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, a second paste of the same size is numbered `#2`, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model reads it, so the model still receives
items.dz: Codex 同款粘贴折叠：DSH 输入框里超过 1000 字符的粘贴变成 `[Pasted Content N chars]` 占位符，同样长度再粘一次编成 `#2`；模型读到之前宿主把占位符换回全文，一个字符不少。输入框上沿留一枚胶囊显示预览，发出的消息里也是同一枚胶囊，点开在右侧抽屉看全文并复制。全部在内存里：不写磁盘，也不省 token。

items.de: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
items.dz: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

items.de: Pavement design methods as a judgement manual: 76 cards over 9 chapters on method selection, indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion and climate zoning, with the airport chapter recovered by re-OCR of the intact PDF.
items.dz: 路面设计方法判据手册：9 章 76 张卡，覆盖方法选型、指标指派、参数口径、轴载换算与气候分区；第九章机场道面曾整章丢失，已由原 PDF 重扫恢复。

items.de: Asphalt pavement skid resistance: 76 cards over 12 chapters on friction calibers, water film and hydroplaning, texture parameters, tire-road contact and maintenance decisions, each capability carrying its own when-not-to-use bound.
items.dz: 沥青路面抗滑：12 章 76 张卡，覆盖摩擦口径、水膜与滑水、纹理参数、胎路接触与养护决策，每条能力都带「什么时候别用」。

items.de: Pavement structural dynamics as a judgement manual: 59 cards over 8 chapters flagging which chapter name oversells its contents, which formulas break when copied, and which numbers cannot be cross-quoted.
items.dz: 路面结构动力学判据手册：8 章 59 张卡，指明哪章名不副实、哪些式子抄走就错、哪些数不能互引。

items.de: Adds a { } button under each assistant reply in the DSH Web GUI that opens the exact request sent to the model for that reply: model, call parameters, messages, tools, and provider-reported token usage.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web GUI 每条 assistant 回复下方加一个 { } 按钮，点开可查看产生这条回复的那次调用实际发给模型的完整请求：model、调用参数、messages、tools 与 provider 上报的 token 用量。

items.de: Checks a payroll sheet against published social-insurance, housing-fund and individual-income-tax parameters, with pass, pass_with_gaps, review and fail outcomes and parameters that carry their own review date.
items.dz: 按公开的社保、公积金与个人所得税参数核对工资表，结果分为 pass、pass_with_gaps、review、fail 四档；参数本身带复核日期。

items.de: Loopback HTTP bridge that lets a peer machine ping this PC and run shell commands, with an optional ssh reverse-tunnel supervisor.
items.dz: 本机回环 HTTP 桥：让对端机器 ping 并执行 shell 命令，可选 ssh 反向隧道看守。

items.de: Reads local PDFs in the DSH sidebar — jump to any page and page through the whole document.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏里看本地 PDF：跳到任意一页，整本连着看。

items.de: Bilingual PDF reader for DeepSeek Harness that translates paragraph by paragraph: single-page, selected-text and full-document translation with a prompt that asks the model to keep formulas, citations and DOIs, a glossary that forces chosen terms, bilingual / translation-only / source-only views, pe
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的段落级双语 PDF 阅读器：支持单页、选中文本与全文翻译，提示词要求保留公式、引用与 DOI；术语表强制指定译名，提供双语/仅译文/仅原文三种视图，段落笔记带页面高亮，可基于文档提问，并导出 Markdown 与可打印 HTML。

items.de: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half price off-peak), a countdown to the next switch, and a 24-hour schedule bar whose white line marks the current time. Peak windows are 09:00-12
items.dz: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026 年。纯客户端插件，不发任何网络请求。

items.de: A price-aware task runner for DeepSeek: during an off-peak pricing window a batch of prompts goes straight to deepseek-flash; near peak it queues the batch behind a self-held timer and runs it at the start of the next off-peak window. Exposes `peak_run`, `peak_schedule` and `peak_cancel`, with confi
items.dz: DeepSeek 峰谷价感知的任务执行器：平价时段把一批 prompt 直接交给 deepseek-flash；临近峰价时排队并用自持定时器在下一个平价时段开始执行。提供 peak_run / peak_schedule / peak_cancel 三个工具，峰谷时段与提前量可配置。

items.de: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.
items.dz: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时段给输入卡上方那条染色（谷绿峰红），以进度条显示当前时段剩余时长，带六套主题与自定义 CSS。

items.de: Windows-only DSH plugin that stops SnowLuma and local voice services during Beijing weekday peak hours and starts them again off-peak.
items.dz: 仅支持 Windows 的 DSH 插件：按北京时间工作日峰时自动停止 SnowLuma 与本地语音服务，谷时自动拉起。

items.de: Control a DeepSeek Harness session from an Android phone: pair over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, follow the live transcript, send prompts, switch model, mode and permission, browse workspace files, run a terminal and change settings.
items.dz: 用安卓手机操控电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：经 Wi-Fi 或 Tailscale 配对，实时跟随对话、发送指令、切换模型／模式／权限，浏览工作区文件、运行终端、修改设置。

items.de: Draw Mermaid diagrams in DSH conversations through the pele_draw tool, rendered inline as theme-aware SVG cards with zoom and pan plus SVG and PNG downloads.
items.dz: 通过 pele_draw 工具在 DSH 会话中绘制 Mermaid 图表，以内联 SVG 卡片渲染，支持缩放/拖动与 SVG/PNG 下载，跟随明暗主题。

items.de: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
items.dz: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

items.de: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener th
items.dz: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

items.de: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
items.dz: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

items.de: An event-stream driven personality that grows over time, not a configurable character card or assistant. Evolved from ssamurias/dsh-fish and registers the same tools (her_recall, growth_commit and others), so do not install it alongside dsh-fish.
items.dz: 一个由事件流驱动、只能长大不能被设定的人格，而非可配置的角色卡或助手。由 ssamurias/dsh-fish 演进而来，注册同名工具（her_recall、growth_commit 等），因此不要与 dsh-fish 同装。

items.de: Webhook notifications for dsh sessions: a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends, to ntfy, Bark, a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint.
items.dz: dsh 会话的 Webhook 通知：审批被请求或回合结束时发送 POST，可发往 ntfy、Bark、Slack/钉钉/企微机器人地址或任意 HTTPS 端点。

items.de: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature c
items.dz: DSH 界面上的透明性能悬浮窗：三行小字直接浮在界面上显示 CPU、GPU、内存占用率，没有底色也没有边框，可拖动并吸附到最近的窗口角，最大化或改变窗口大小都不会跑位；CPU 封装温度由可选的高权限助手（LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO）读取，插件自身开销不到单核百分之一。仅 Windows。

items.de: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-wat
items.dz: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

items.de: Lean and light? See DSH CPU, memory and UI stalls, broken down by plugin, terminal and MCP server, matched against stall times, and copy a diagnostic report. Windows x64 only.
items.dz: 小而美？看清 DSH 的 CPU、内存与卡顿：按插件、终端、MCP 拆分占用，对照卡顿时刻，复制诊断报告。仅限 Windows x64。

items.de: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
items.dz: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

items.de: Injects a configurable whale-girl persona into every DeepSeek Harness system prompt.
items.dz: 把可配置的鲸鱼娘人格注入 DeepSeek Harness 所有智能体的系统提示词。

items.de: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.
items.dz: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。

items.de: Manage DeepSeek Harness agent presets (personas) from a Settings page: create one on top of a shipped base preset, edit a persona in place, lay it out in a rendered preview, and export or import it as JSON or Markdown. Edits to a hand-written profile patch are applied as text, so comments, quoting a
items.dz: 在设置页里管理 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 预设（人设）：基于官方预设新建、就地编辑人设正文、用排版预览检查效果，并导出或导入 JSON 备份与 Markdown。改写 profile 里手写的预设时按文本替换，注释、引号和 loader 表达式都原样保留。实测环境为桌面版；基于基准预设新建需要随 DSH 发布的 yaml 包。

items.de: Switches the tone of DSH replies from Settings → 人格模式 or the /persona command (/persona catgirl, /persona off), effective from the next turn. Only the active persona is injected, as runtime context, so the system prompt keeps a single stable short strategy; with the mode off the injected persona tex
items.dz: 在「设置 → 人格模式」或 /persona 命令（/persona catgirl、/persona off）里切换回复语气，下一轮对话生效。同一时刻只注入当前这一条（放在运行时上下文里，系统提示词只保留一条约 50 字的稳定策略），关闭时注入 0 字；只改语气，不改事实、代码与工程纪律。

items.de: Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.
items.dz: 把写在 Markdown 里的人设挂载成系统提示词段落：改 `~/.dsh/persona/*.md` 即可改变回答风格，保存后 150 毫秒自动重载而无需重启，项目级 `.dsh/persona/` 下的同名文件覆盖全局配置。

items.de: Persona slot for DeepSeek Harness: each session holds exactly one persona that a later write replaces, a global persona covers every session without its own, a /persona command edits both in conversation, and the Installed page exposes a multi-line panel for the global persona. Persona length is unb
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的人设插槽（支持 0.2.1-rc.2 到 rc.5）：每个会话只保留一份人设，再次设置是覆盖而非叠加；一条全局总人设覆盖所有没有独立人设的会话；`/persona` 命令在对话里改，已安装页提供多行编辑器改总人设。人设字数不限。

items.de: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.
items.dz: 左侧切换供应商，右侧直接选择模型；悬停、聚焦或点击供应商即可切换右侧模型列表。

items.de: Inject a personal rules file into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with silent-step and repeated-action loop guards editable from the settings dialog.
items.dz: 把个性化规则文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示，并提供静默提醒与重复操作循环检测，可在设置弹窗中编辑。

items.de: Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.
items.dz: 跨 DeepSeek Harness 会话与项目共享的持久个人待办：使用 SQLite 存储，提供 Agent 工具、原生侧栏与对话尾部卡片，既可由用户自行管理，也可按需将单条待办交给 Agent 会话执行。

items.de: Android shell patch for dsh-pet that fixes the unfocusable overlay window (keyboard never opens), broken chat requests, and clipped replies. Requires upstream dsh-pet >=0.3.7, a separately installed self-signed shell APK (Android 11+), and a local 3080->38019 proxy.
items.dz: 安卓桌宠社区补丁：需先装上游 dsh-pet（≥0.3.7），另装自签名壳 APK（Android 11+），并在本机常驻 3080→38019 转发；修好悬浮窗无法聚焦导致键盘不弹、聊天发不出去、回复被窗口裁掉三个问题。

items.de: macOS arm64 only; requires dsh-pet installed (the bundled binary is a closed prebuilt). Desktop switch for the dsh-pet pet: one click to show or hide it, and it can start DeepSeek Harness when that is closed.
items.dz: 仅 macOS arm64，需先安装 dsh-pet（自带的是闭源预编译二进制）。桌宠开关：一键开/关桌面上的 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关闭时还能顺手把它启动起来。

items.de: Adds a low-key companion panel with a pomodoro timer, a todo list, drink-water and stand-up reminders, plus lesson explanations and homework tutoring through the installed desktop pet.
items.dz: 给桌宠加一个不惹眼的陪伴面板：番茄钟、待办清单、喝水/久坐提醒，以及借桌宠模型通道的课程讲解与作业辅导。

items.de: A WSLg-compatible DSH desktop pet reacts to agent activity, lets you message the active session, and loads Hatch-Pet v2 atlases or transparent portraits.
items.dz: 兼容 WSLg 的 DSH 桌面宠物会根据代理活动切换动画，支持向当前会话发送消息，并可加载 Hatch-Pet v2 图集或透明肖像。

items.de: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.
items.dz: 用三套内置 Q 版角色提供久坐、喝水、连续工作与深夜关怀，带云朵气泡和轻回弹；页面内显示无需额外下载，可选 macOS 桌面窗口使用单独下载的 Electron 组件。

items.de: Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two
items.dz: 打游戏或全屏应用在前台时，自动把 dsh-pet 的桌宠窗口收起来，退出后原样放回。用「全屏窗口铺满显示器 + 前台进程在游戏目录 + 系统全屏状态」三重信号判定，连续两次采样一致才动作，避免切窗口时闪隐；只切换窗口可见性，不改 dsh-pet 的任何配置，也不动它的安装目录。托盘菜单可暂停、立即恢复、重载配置。仅 Windows。

items.de: Desktop pet fork of dsh-pet that can be installed alongside the original (separate package id, commands and data directory), adding scheduled reminders with custom bubble text and a random show/hide cycle.
items.dz: dsh-pet 的增强分支，可与原版同装（包名、命令与数据目录各自独立）：新增定时提醒（自定义气泡语句）与随机出现/隐藏循环。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.
items.dz: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

items.de: A pet ledger whose achievements come only from real DeepSeek Harness session events: tool-failure streaks, long completed turns, red-to-green test runs, and commit+push success. Every achievement expands into the session id and the actual tool-call evidence (command, result, duration); demo cards ar
items.dz: 宠物账本：成就只从 DSH 真实会话事件里长出来——工具连续失败、长任务完成、测试红转绿、提交并推送成功。每条成就可展开看会话 id 与当时的工具调用证据（命令、结果、耗时）；演示卡片是独立的内存数组，带「演示」水印，不计入成就也不落盘。今日任务按当天真实有效使用时长与实际跑过的命令类型生成，生成后冻结。host + client 双半、零运行时依赖、70 个测试，只写本机 JSON。

items.de: Floating desktop companion for DSH: a draggable character on the overlay — tap to charge energy, blinking and emotes, naps, synthesized WebAudio sounds and particle effects. Bring your own: any photo (pet, portrait, anime art) becomes a 2.5D cutout with hand-marked eyes, and 3D models (GLB, VRM, STL
items.dz: DSH 桌面伴侣：整屏浮层上一只可拖动的角色，轻叩蓄能、眨眼表情、打盹、WebAudio 合成音效与粒子。放什么进去都行——照片（宠物 / 人像 / 动漫立绘）变 2.5D 立绘并可标眼睛；GLB / VRM / STL / OBJ / PLY 用 three.js 渲染成真 3D 转台。大小 30%–300% 无级调节，数据只存本机。

items.de: Counts how many times the microphone is stroked today and writes the number to a local JSON file for a desktop pet to read.
items.dz: 麦克风识别「摸摸」动作，只把今天被摸了几次写进本地 JSON 文件，供桌面宠物读取。

items.de: An enhanced fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (do not install it alongside the upstream dsh-pet): a desktop pet for DSH with schedule reminders, approval and question bubbles you can answer in place, a 20-entry history ledger, double-click corner cycling, a configurable data directory, a step/elapsed pro
items.dz: PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的增强分支，不能与上游 dsh-pet 同装：定时任务到点由宠物提醒，审批与提问可直接在宠物气泡里作答，弹过的事件收进 20 条记录，双击换角落、数据目录可配置、工作气泡带「第几步 · 用了多久」，忙时可「等会儿」或静音一小时；右键菜单的顺序与显隐可在设置页里调（默认「对话」在最前），工作气泡里还有一条任务队列进度条。

items.de: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).
items.dz: 把 dsh 宠物忽略的 todo 与 goal 事件折成宠物气泡上的百分比进度；会话没有任务列表时退化为一行当前活动摘要。需先安装 dsh web pet 插件（@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0）。

items.de: Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: twelve hand-drawn sprites follow the live session state and swap instantly, with a tired slump after a turn, a furious second stage after ten pokes, and idle sword-polishing; repeated states change her line and a voice line plays every five to
items.dz: 美树沙耶香桌宠：把会话状态映射成十二张立绘并啪地直接切换——一轮对话跑完会累倒、连点十下会气炸、闲着会擦剑吹口哨；同类状态连着来她会换话变脸，每种状态每碰 5~8 次播一次语音，台词还配了专属录音。

items.de: Local video understanding for agents: extracts keyframes adaptively based on motion and pauses, inspects any timestamp at full resolution, and aligns visuals with dialogue from embedded subtitles or configured ASR. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe; clips without subtitles also need a transcription engine
items.dz: 让智能体看懂本地视频：根据画面运动与停顿自适应抽取关键帧，支持任意时间点全分辨率定点检视；自动从内嵌字幕或配置的语音转写（ASR）中提取台词并与画面时间轴对齐。需预装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe；无字幕视频要台词另需转写引擎（约 190 MB 本地 whisper 模型、云端 API Key 或官方语音输入模型）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINA
items.dz: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

items.de: In-process crash guard: takes over the fatal-error handlers that would exit DSH, names the responsible plugin from the stack, and disables only that row in the home patch layer, leaving the profile and the provider config inside it untouched. The crash page offers retry, keep-disabled or uninstall,
items.dz: 进程内崩溃兜底：接管本该让 DSH 退出的致命错误处理器，从栈里认出是哪个插件，只在 home 层停用那一行——profile 与里面的供应商配置一个字节都不写。崩溃页给出恢复、保持禁用、卸载三个选择；认不出是谁时，开一个临时的安全模式会话（仅命令行与 web 启动）。

items.de: A Phone tab in dsh-better-sidebar: SMS and calls over Twilio and SIP lines bridged through Asterisk, call audio through your server, Live, Voicemail and Do not disturb modes with live voicemail transcripts, a Telegram account with chats, voice messages and calls, and phone_* and telegram_* agent too
items.dz: dsh-better-sidebar 里的 Phone 标签页：通过 Twilio 与经 Asterisk 桥接的 SIP 线路收发短信和通话，通话音频走你的服务器，提供 Live、Voicemail、勿扰模式与实时语音信箱转写，并可挂一个 Telegram 账号（聊天、语音消息、通话），以及 phone_* / telegram_* agent 工具。需要 dsh-better-sidebar、Node 22.5+、带语音与短信号码的 Twilio 账号、可供服务商 webhook 访问的公网 HTTPS 地址，以及从 checkout 构建的 Go daemon（Telegram 还需自备

items.de: Adds a Phone page to dsh web that shows a QR code; scan it, sign in to OpenTandem on the phone and tap Allow, then send tasks to this computer's dsh from OpenTandem. Installs the OpenTandem command line and a background Runner on first use.
items.dz: 在 dsh web 中新增「手机连接」页并显示二维码，用手机扫码、登录 OpenTandem 并点「允许」后，即可在 OpenTandem 里把任务发给这台电脑上的 dsh。首次使用会安装 OpenTandem 命令行和后台 Runner。

items.de: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
items.dz: 用 adb 查看并打理一台真实的 Android 手机：存储体检、未 root 也能读到的逐应用数据大小（来自 dumpsys diskstats）、只清缓存不动数据的清理、目录统计与截图——共五个工具；读取永不改动任何东西，写入必须显式确认。

items.de: Control a paired Android phone from DeepSeek Harness: read the accessibility node tree, tap by text, type into fields, take screenshots, launch apps, and read or write files over an encrypted WebSocket. Needs the companion Android app (Android 11+; the repo ships its source and no APK is attached to
items.dz: 从 DeepSeek Harness 控制已配对的 Android 手机：读取无障碍节点树、按文字点击、输入文字、截图、启动应用，还能读写手机上的文件；连接走加密 WebSocket。需要配套的 Android App（Android 11+；仓库只带源码、各 Release 均未附 APK，需用 JDK 21 与 Android SDK 36 自行编译），且手机要能连到电脑（同一 Wi-Fi 或隧道；桥默认监听所有网卡）。配对在 DSH 的设置页完成（8 位配对码或二维码、监听端口）；权限开关在手机 App 里，且默认不允许智能体操作桥接 App 自身。

items.de: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network, with no tunnel and no cloud in between. Document mode binarizes locally in the browser (adaptive threshold plus speckle removal and edge crop)
items.dz: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop 工具供助手调用，同一个 CLI 也能脱离 DSH 独立运行。
rl: runs code at install time (postinstall)

items.de: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
items.dz: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

items.de: Mirrors an Android phone or tablet into the DSH right sidebar over adb with mouse and keyboard control, keeping videos, clips and chats next to the desktop instead of in your hand; Opus audio needs Android 11+, Windows only.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧栏通过 adb 投屏并反控安卓手机/平板，视频、短视频和聊天留在电脑上，在工位上不必再拿手机；声音转发需 Android 11+，仅支持 Windows。

items.de: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote
items.dz: DSH 手机远程访问的开箱即用修复套件：把 PWA manifest 的 start_url 改到 /pair-app，解决 iOS「添加到主屏幕」后打开停在 401 的问题；附常驻/守护脚本、自动登录与电源设置说明、中文排错手册。需安装 @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui（/pair-app 由它提供）；守护脚本仅 Windows。

items.de: Host-side dsh plugin that pairs a phone to a dsh instance through a self-hosted relay: one outbound connection carries the session list, streaming chat, approvals, attachments and file previews to a dedicated mobile web shell, and devices pair with a one-time QR link and can be revoked from a consol
items.dz: dsh 的 Host 侧插件：经自托管中继把手机配到 dsh 实例，一条出站连接承载会话列表、流式对话、审批、附件与文件预览，送达专用手机网页壳；设备用一次性二维码链接配对，可在 dsh 网页内的控制台随时撤销。

items.de: Sends photos from a phone into a DeepSeek Harness conversation through a simple LAN service.
items.dz: 通过一个简单的局域网服务，把手机中的照片发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的对话中。

items.de: A DSH workbench for picking photos from local folders on macOS and Windows: local dedupe, filtering and grouping, AI grid triage and scoring with an image-capable model you supply (the plugin bundles no model, credentials or quota), then human review, calibration and export.
items.dz: DSH 本机照片挑选工作台（macOS / Windows）：本地去重、过滤与分组，用你自备的图片输入模型做 AI 网格粗筛与评分（插件不内置模型、凭据或额度），并支持人工复核、校准与导出。

items.de: Interactive physics lab in the DSH sidebar — 24 parameter-driven animations (mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics) grouped by grade, each with a knowledge-point lesson whose steps follow the animation, a quiz with answer checking, and a draggable 3D view for four field models. Pure cl
items.dz: DSH 侧栏里的高中物理动态仿真实验室：24 个可调参数的互动模型（力学 / 电磁 / 光学 / 热学），按高一高二高三分组；每个模型配知识点讲解与跟随动画的分步解说、出题判分，其中 4 个电磁学模型支持拖动旋转的 3D 视角。纯客户端，解析式本地计算，不调模型、不联网、不上报数据。

items.de: Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.
items.dz: 把输入框的模型控件换成 PI-Desktop 风格的选择器：双栏菜单（搜索、按 provider 分组、上下文窗口与能力徽标）、推理强度滑块、↑/↓ 提示词历史回溯，以及带撤销的提示词改写按钮。

items.de: A piano keyboard in the DeepSeek Harness UI: click a key to play it, or hold and drag sideways for a glissando across the keys. Notes are synthesized live with Web Audio — no samples, no network, no third-party dependencies — and the volume and starting octave are remembered between sessions.
items.dz: 在 DSH 界面里弹一条钢琴键盘：点单键出声，按住横向滑动就是刮奏。声音用 Web Audio 实时合成——零采样、零网络、零第三方依赖；音量与起始八度会被记住。

items.de: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools a
items.dz: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

items.de: Requires Python 3.12+; Xiaohongshu reading needs the xiaohongshu-mcp backend and a QR sign-in (ffmpeg/OCR optional). Batch-read Xiaohongshu notes and WeChat public-account articles: per-note body, image text via local OCR, video frame text and comment samples, structured JSON/Markdown output, and th
items.dz: 需 Python 3.12+；小红书需 xiaohongshu-mcp 后端并扫码登录（OCR/ffmpeg 可选）。批量抓取小红书笔记与微信公众号文章：逐篇取正文、图片文字（本地 OCR）、视频抽帧文字与评论样本，输出结构化 JSON/Markdown，每条结果带原文链接。只读，不发布、不点赞、不关注、不评论。

items.de: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
items.dz: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

items.de: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironin
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏拼小拼豆的轻量小游戏，等模型回复的空档拼一张：12 个带引导豆的内置图案、16 色在 12/16/24 格板上自由拼、一句话让模型生成图纸、照片在本机转成图纸（不上传）、拼完熨烫存入最多 60 件的作品墙，并可导出 PNG。

items.de: Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness questions, approval requests, and completed turns. Notification-only: one runtime file, zero runtime dependencies, no custom question cards.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的提问、审批请求与回合完成发送 Telegram 通知。仅通知不改交互：单运行时文件、零运行时依赖、不自建问题卡片。

items.de: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
items.dz: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

items.de: Project document chain integrity check: stage order, completeness and amount parseability.
items.dz: 项目全流程文件链条核对：环节顺序、文件齐备与金额可解析。

items.de: Failure memory for DeepSeek Harness. Captures tool failures as they happen, classifies them with 16 built-in rules into lessons pairing a symptom with a fix, adds session/daily/weekly summaries, and injects a short briefing into later sessions through systemPrompt context. Ships 5 pitfall_ tools and
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的失败记忆插件。运行中捕获工具失败，用 16 条内置规则归并成「症状 + 正确做法」的经验，附带会话/天/周三级总结，并通过 systemPrompt context 把简报注入后续会话。提供 5 个 pitfall_ 工具与 Web 设置页。

items.de: Pixel art editor in a DSH conversation tab: pencil, eraser, bucket fill and eyedropper on a grid canvas that zooms in whole steps around the cursor; up to eight layers with merge, reorder, rename and full undo; a 36-slot palette whose edits move the old colour to a free slot so existing pixels never
items.dz: DSH 会话页签里的像素画编辑器：在网格画布上用铅笔、橡皮、油漆桶与取色器作画，滚轮以光标为中心整档缩放；最多八层图层，支持合并、上下移、改名与完整撤销；36 色可编辑调色板，改色时把旧颜色搬到空闲槽，已有像素不会跟着变；PNG 直接导出到当前会话目录。

items.de: Dark CRT pixel skin for the conversation pane: hard borders, block shadows and bitmap headings, scoped to chat and composer.
items.dz: 会话框的深色 CRT 像素皮肤：硬边框、方块阴影与点阵标题，只作用于聊天区和输入区。

items.de: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

items.de: Turn the Edifier Halo PixelBar desktop pixel display into a DSH tool: push short text, switch scenes, set screen color, ambient light and volume over HID, and restore the clock on demand. USB-connected device only; tested on Windows only; needs Python 3.8+ with hidapi (pip install hidapi).
items.dz: 把花再 Halo PixelBar 桌面像素屏变成 DSH 工具：经 HID 推短文字、切场景、设屏色、调氛围灯与音量，并可按需切回时钟。需 USB 连接设备；仅在 Windows 上验证；需要 Python 3.8+ 与 hidapi（pip install hidapi）。

items.de: Drive an Edifier Halo PixelBar — a 256x32 1-bit dot-matrix screen in a desktop speaker — from DSH over raw USB HID: push custom bitmaps, play GIF animations, render pixel-art walk scenes from sprite sheets and push self-rendered text, with a color-calibration table, a hardware self-check and EQ / vo
items.dz: 在 DSH 里驱动花再 Halo PixelBar（桌面音箱上的 256×32 单色点阵屏）：通过裸 USB HID 推自定义位图、播放 GIF 动画、用精灵图渲染像素角色行走场景、推自绘文字，并带颜色校准表、硬件自检，以及 EQ / 音量 / 氛围灯 / 表情与场景控制；推送后还能自动切回时钟。

items.de: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
items.dz: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

items.de: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
items.dz: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

items.de: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for new
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan / Build 模式切换：在输入框「完全权限」旁常驻一个下拉框，经内置的 /plan 与 /plan off 命令双向切换当前会话；设置 → 通用里另有一行「默认模式」，决定新建会话的起始模式。

items.de: Inline annotations for DSH plan review: select plan text, comment on any passage, and send one structured review back to the agent.
items.dz: 给 DSH 计划评审加选区批注：选中计划原文、逐条写意见，一次性把结构化反馈发回给 agent。

items.de: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
items.dz: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

items.de: Configuration bundle that connects Microsoft's official @playwright/mcp to your running Chrome through the Playwright extension, so the agent can drive your logged-in tabs. Install from a local copy: put your extension token in cordis.patch.yml first (with the token, connections skip the extension's
items.dz: 配置型插件：通过 Microsoft 官方 @playwright/mcp 与 Chrome 扩展，让智能体操作你已登录的浏览器标签页。请装本地副本：先把扩展的 token 填进 cordis.patch.yml（持有 token 时连接不再弹出扩展的批准提示，请勿外传）。需要 Node.js 和 Playwright Chrome 扩展；默认命令是 Windows 形式（cmd.exe /c npx），macOS / Linux 要改成 npx。启动时通过 npx 拉取并运行 @playwright/mcp@latest。

items.de: Read PLC projects inside DSH — decode CoDeSys .project and Delta .dvp (both need Python 3.9+ on PATH) and Siemens S7-200 SMART .smart/.smartlib into readable reports and structured data, plus project diff, address audits, element-level read/write analysis and ladder-logic reconstruction.
items.dz: 在 DSH 里读 PLC 工程——把 CoDeSys `.project`、台达 `.dvp`（两者需本机 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+）与西门子 S7-200 SMART `.smart/.smartlib` 解码成可读报告与结构化数据，另带新旧对比、地址体检、元素级读写判定与连线还原。

items.de: Workspace-scoped MCP server loading for DeepSeek Harness: servers default to dynamic mode, so they are not mounted at boot and the model loads them on demand with mcp_load (set a row to eager to keep boot-time mounting); tools can be filtered with ! globs, and a pack lets one project hide a server w
items.dz: 按工作区控制 MCP 服务器的可见性与加载方式：行默认为 dynamic，启动时不挂载，模型按需用 mcp_load 加载（设为 eager 才保持启动即挂载）；工具可用 ! 通配规则过滤；pack 可让一个工程隐藏某台 server 而不影响别的工程。与 @guowenzhang/dsh-mcp-manager 注册同名的 mcp_load/mcp_unload/mcp_call，二者只装一个。

items.de: Per-workspace model packs: bind a named provider, model and reasoning effort plus the four subagent tier routes to a directory. Applies to new sessions in that directory; a session that has not run a turn yet also follows a pack switch, while sessions that already ran a turn are never changed.
items.dz: 按工作区指定模型：把 provider、model、reasoningEffort 与子智能体四档路由组合成具名 pack 绑定到目录，作用于该目录新建的会话；尚未开过轮次的空白会话在切换 pack 时也会跟随，已开过轮次的会话不受影响。

items.de: Disable plugins per workspace: a disabled plugin stops contributing tools to the model tool list and prompt sections to the system prompt, cutting the per-turn schema cost. A plugin is switched as a whole, with packs evaluated by workspace binding, then default.
items.dz: 按工作区停用插件：停用后该插件不再向模型工具表提供工具、也不再向 system prompt 注入提示词段，减少每轮固定开销。插件按整包开关，pack 按工作区绑定值、再按 default 求值。

items.de: Per-workspace skill visibility: each workspace binds one named switch table, so which skills the model may call on its own follows the project instead of every installed skill being listed every turn. Cannot be installed together with dsh-skill-scope.
items.dz: 按工作区控制 skill 可见性：工作区绑定一张具名开关表，模型每轮能自动调用的 skill 随项目而定，不再每轮列出全部已安装 skill。不能与 dsh-skill-scope 同装。

items.de: Reuse-first plugin authoring workbench: clarifies a plugin need, searches installed plugins, the curated market and GitHub for reusable implementations, then decomposes the remaining gaps and verifies the generated bundle before installation.
items.dz: 复用优先的插件创作工作台：先澄清需求，检索已装插件、市场目录与 GitHub 中可复用的实现，再解构剩余缺口，并在安装前校验生成的插件包。

items.de: Switches to the next healthy model candidate before the next agent step when the current model has been marked unhealthy.
items.dz: 当前模型被判定不可用时，在下一步执行前切换到下一个健康的候选模型。

items.de: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a
items.dz: PLUR 记忆在每次组装时渲染进系统提示词，而非以工具调用形式暴露，因此记忆块是被替换而不是追加，整段会话的上下文长度保持不变。全本地混合检索（BM25 + BGE，RRF 融合）、可直接编辑的纯 YAML 存储、按工作区划分 scope，并提供 /plur-memory 浏览器界面。

items.de: White-box testing workflow skill for embedded C: host-side stub harness, wb.py test driver with gcov coverage gating, and a control-logic study handbook template.
items.dz: 嵌入式 C 白盒测试工作流技能：宿主机打桩 harness、wb.py 测试驱动与 gcov 覆盖率门禁、控制逻辑学习手册模板。

items.de: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers
items.dz: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME 加载的自定义字体，以及带 WCAG 对比度徽标的可拖动 WYSIWYG 预览窗。

items.de: Shows the remaining DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, right after the cache-hit reading, and links to the Platform usage page. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account; API-key-only setups show nothing.
items.dz: 在输入框底部统计行、紧挨「缓存命中」右侧显示账号剩余额度，点击打开平台用量页。需要登录 DeepSeek 账号；仅用 API Key 不显示。

items.de: Ranks DSH plugins by real monthly npm downloads instead of GitHub stars, and names the plugins that star ordering under-rates. It reports the disagreement between the two orderings rather than a single quality verdict, and every number is a live read from npm's public downloads endpoint at call time
items.dz: 按真实 npm 月下载量给 DSH 插件排名，而不是按 GitHub 星数，并点名被星数排序低估的插件。它报告的是两种排序之间的分歧，而不是给一个综合质量结论；显示的每个数字都是调用时从 npm 公开下载接口现读的，不是存下来的快照。第二个维度回答下载量回答不了的问题：读插件在 peerDependencies 里声明的 tools 版本线，和本机实际运行的版本比，因此「很热门但在本机装不上」的插件会被报出来，而不是被推荐。只发只读 GET，自身不注册 HTTP 路由。

items.de: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
items.dz: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

items.de: Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.
items.dz: aflare 工作流工具：通过本地 aflare 二进制生成、校验并执行本地优先的确定性 YAML 工作流 DAG（WAL 崩溃恢复、Saga 补偿），内置 300+ 模板。

items.de: Two-way agent bridge between two DeepSeek Harness hosts: either side can ask the other agent questions and run bounded dialogues over a PSK-authenticated TCP link, with a chat page on both sides and read-only tool posture by default. Both ends need the same shared key and a nodeId configured.
items.dz: 两台 DeepSeek Harness 主机之间的双向 agent 桥：任一侧可向对端 agent 提问并运行有界多轮对话，链路经 PSK 认证；两侧提供聊天页，默认只读工具姿态。两端需配置相同的共享密钥与 nodeId。

items.de: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH. Each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts; a Bot can also be backed by an installed local agent CLI (Codex CLI, Claude Code, ACP agents) using that CLI's own login and models. Unaddressed messages can be triaged
items.dz: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间。每个 Bot 有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话；Bot 也可以直接接管本机已安装的 agent CLI（Codex CLI、Claude Code、ACP agent），沿用该 CLI 自己的登录与模型。未点名消息可由群主判断，群内经验会自动积累，每次回答都是持久运行记录里的一条 run，侧栏面板据此回放。新建 Bot 的权限默认是完全权限（可执行任意命令、修改任意文件，表单会要求勾选风险确认），需要约束时请选「仅查看」或「工作区内」；完全权限的 Codex CLI / Claude Code Bot 会在没有各自沙箱和权限询问的情况下运行

items.de: Organizes multiple live DSH sessions into a collaboration group and relays each round's final output on a shared timeline.
items.dz: 把多个已打开的 DSH 会话组织成一个协作群，只转达每轮最终输出，并按共享时间线合并投递。

items.de: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
items.dz: 提供支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch CLI 交互终端、Codex 委派任务卡片，以及右侧面板中的实时与历史任务输出。需 PATH 上有 agent-switch、至少一个目标编码 CLI，并在插件页放行 node-pty 原生构建；目前只在 Windows 验证过。

items.de: Windows-only DSH sidebar preview and Dart hot reload for configured Starcompanion / Operit2-derived projects; requires the project preview scripts, a prebuilt debug APK, Android SDK, Flutter and scrcpy 3.3.3.
items.dz: 在 Windows 的 DSH 侧栏预览已配置的星伴 / Operit2 衍生工程，操作真实安卓画面并在保存 Dart 后热重载；需要工程预览脚本、预构建调试 APK、Android SDK、Flutter 和 scrcpy 3.3.3。

items.de: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.
items.dz: 在虚拟显示器上启动安卓应用，用读屏、点击与滑动驱动它们，主屏不受影响。

items.de: Native Google Antigravity agents loader and subagent orchestration engine with model selection and Web UI settings integration. Loads agent definitions from ~/.agents/agents and the workspace's .agents/agents; the selected main agent's instructions go into the system prompt, and a matching agent's i
items.dz: 原生 Google Antigravity Agent 规范加载与子代理编排引擎，支持模型选择与 Web 设置界面集成。从 ~/.agents/agents 和工作区的 .agents/agents 读取 agent 定义；选中的主 agent 的指令会写进系统提示，匹配到的 agent 指令还会加到 DSH 自带的 subagent / spawn_teammate 调用的提示词前面；设置写在工作区的 .agents/agents/settings.json。

items.de: Loads Google Antigravity rules from ~/.agents/rules and the workspace's .agents/rules into the system prompt: always-on rules in full, the rest as a catalog the model can load with the antigravity_rule tool, or that activates when a touched file matches a rule's globs. The rules are prompt guidance
items.dz: 把 ~/.agents/rules 和工作区 .agents/rules 里的 Google Antigravity 规则加进系统提示：always_on 规则全文注入，其余以目录形式列出，模型可用 antigravity_rule 工具加载，或在触及的文件匹配规则 glob 时自动激活。规则只是提示词层面的指引，不是强制执行，模型也能用同一个工具把它们关掉。设置写在工作区的 .agents/rules/settings.json。

items.de: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.
items.dz: 在 Web 客户端把 DeepSeek Harness 的权限审批面板本地化为中文：授权原因优先走内置词表翻译，词表未收录的由宿主侧模型路由兜底。

items.de: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
items.dz: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

items.de: Image generation through the Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream API: ark_generate_image for text-to-image, image-to-image and fixed-seed batches, ark_image_gen_status for checking the key, model and output directory. Requires a Volcano Ark API key (ARK_API_KEY).
items.dz: 火山方舟 / 豆包 Seedream 生图：ark_generate_image 支持文生图、图生图和固定 seed 批量出图，ark_image_gen_status 检查密钥、模型与输出目录。需配置火山方舟 API Key（ARK_API_KEY）。

items.de: Workspace artifact manager that sorts files into artifact, process, memory and material roles, with extra workspace roots, 12 file types, a year/month/day timeline, preview, rename, trash, zip archive and optional COS sync.
items.dz: 工作区产物管理器：按「产物 / 过程 / 记忆 / 素材」分层，可添加多个工作区、12 类文件类型、按年/月/日分组的时间轴，预览、重命名、回收站、zip 归档与可选的 COS 同步。

items.de: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
items.dz: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

items.de: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
items.dz: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

items.de: Gives agents the DSH (Cordis) plugin authoring contract and the dsh plugin market submission process, from the bundle manifest and entry module to the pull request.
items.dz: 给 agent 一套 DSH（Cordis）插件编写规范与 dsh 插件市场收录流程，从 bundle manifest、入口模块一直讲到提交 PR。

items.de: Keeps an unattended DeepSeek Harness session moving when nobody answers ask_user_question: it fronts the question waterfall, leaves a human answer untouched, and after a configurable window (120 s by default) submits the option marked (Recommended)/（推荐）, or the configured first/last fallback; plan r
items.dz: 无人值守时没人回答 ask_user_question，也让会话继续走：站在问题 waterfall 前面，有人回答就原样放行；超过可配置窗口（默认 120 秒）后提交标了（推荐）/(Recommended) 的选项，或按 first/last 兜底；计划审批默认仍交给人，需显式开启。

items.de: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you check, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors; upgrades stay inside the major versi
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验与热重载都由宿主负责，安装失败会把旧版本装回去。每轮结果追加到一份 JSON 日志。

items.de: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.
items.dz: DSH 插件更新器：把版本决策交给 dsh CLI，继续受 pnpm 发布年龄策略约束；应用前先快照、可回滚、带锁定清单，用户打开开关后可定时检查或自动应用。

items.de: Makes the Axolotl Minecraft launcher's built-in MCP server usable from DSH: turns its 269 tools into nine domain tools plus status and raw, answers the launcher's 15-second session ping so the control session survives long turns, and returns screenshots as real images instead of files on disk. Needs
items.dz: 把美西螈启动器（Axolotl Launcher）自带的 MCP 服务器接进 DSH：269 个工具收成 9 个领域工具加 status 和 raw；代持常驻客户端应答启动器的 15 秒心跳，让控制会话撑过长任务；截图直接变成图片，不用落盘再读。需要 Axolotl Launcher 1.11.0-beta.2 或更新版本，并启用其 MCP 服务器。

items.de: Moves a DSH profile to another machine with its plugins, not only its files: packs the plugin bundle selection and the whole settings layer into one JSON file, then on restore writes the configuration back, restores local plugin sources and plugin-owned data, and installs the plugin bundles the back
items.dz: 换机迁移 DSH profile，连插件本身一起：把插件包选择与整个配置层打包成一个 JSON 文件，恢复时写回配置、还原本地插件源码与插件数据，并安装备份里记录、新机器缺失的插件包（优先插件管理器，失败回退 pnpm）。

items.de: Optional DSH configuration bundle that connects the existing MCP client to hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit using a user-provided BAIZHI_API_KEY Bearer header; tool calls may incur charges.
items.dz: 复用 DSH 现有 MCP 客户端连接百智云托管工具包的可选配置包，通过用户提供的 BAIZHI_API_KEY 生成 Bearer 请求头；工具调用可能计费。

items.de: Always-visible account topped-up balance pill in the sidebar header, refreshed automatically and showing the same number as Settings → Account.
items.dz: 在侧边栏顶部常驻显示账户充值余额，自动刷新，数字与「设置 → 账户」一致。

items.de: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and unused bonus credit in the session header, refreshing every 20 seconds and whenever the window regains focus.
items.dz: 在会话标题栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与未用完的赠送额度，每 20 秒自动刷新，窗口重新聚焦时立即刷新。

items.de: Turn Bilibili links into b23.tv short links with covers, with a tool, a /bili command, and a share-card panel.
items.dz: 把 B 站链接转成 b23.tv 短链并取封面，提供工具、/bili 命令和分享卡片面板。

items.de: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
items.dz: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

items.de: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
items.dz: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

items.de: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 原生无头及可视化 Chromium 浏览器自动化插件：支持 DOM 树提取、网页截图捕获及内置 SSRF 安全防护。

items.de: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
items.dz: 新增 /btw 与 /side 斜杠命令，在隔离的分叉子会话中回答临时旁问，不污染主会话上下文。

items.de: A settings-tab workshop plus the cordis-plugin-development skill it hands to the agent, for writing DSH plugins against the running host API.
items.dz: 设置页里的插件工坊，附带交给 Agent 的 cordis-plugin-development 技能，基于当前运行的主机 API 编写 DSH 插件。

items.de: Connects dsh to the BulkPublish MCP server (32 tools) to draft, schedule, publish and analyse social media posts, manage media, and handle inbox conversations and comments across 15 platforms, authenticated with a BulkPublish API key sent as a bearer token.
items.dz: 把 dsh 连接到 BulkPublish MCP 服务器（32 个工具），用于草拟、定时、发布与分析社交媒体帖子，管理媒体，并处理 15 个平台上的收件箱对话与评论；以 BulkPublish API Key 作为 Bearer token 认证。

items.de: Read-only tools for cadpop.com: parametric template list, help-center pages and drawing-tools page, plus links to the DFM check and the online editor, across 5 tools. Network-only.
items.dz: cadpop.com 只读工具：参数化模板清单、帮助中心页面与图纸工具页，另提供 DFM 检查与在线编辑器的入口链接，共 5 个工具。仅网络访问。

items.de: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
items.dz: 持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

items.de: Chinese accounting and tax knowledge base for DSH agents, served by the hosted Quaesto service at api.accountingllm.site (needs network access; no account or API key, but your queries leave the machine): answers questions on CAS enterprise accounting standards, the small-enterprise accounting standa
items.dz: 为 DSH 智能体提供中国会计与税务知识库，由托管服务 Quaesto（api.accountingllm.site）提供，需联网、无需账号或 API key，但查询内容会发往该服务：查企业会计准则、小企业会计准则、审计准则与税法的原文条款、判断决策程序、适用性判定与税会差异，通过 10 个 MCP 工具与 china-accounting-standards 技能对外提供。

items.de: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.
items.dz: 仅缩放 DSH 聊天消息和输入区（80%–200%），支持 Ctrl 快捷键、设置调节与本地记忆，不缩放侧栏。

items.de: Fills in a Chinese description for every installed DSH plugin that ships only an English one, at startup and again after each plugin change, and never rewrites a plugin name. Plugins that already export a locale folder show the new text on refresh; the rest are patched too — the in-memory layer show
items.dz: 给只提供英文简介的已安装 DSH 插件自动补上中文简介，启动时以及每次插件变动后各跑一次，插件名称一律不改。原本已导出语言包的插件刷新页面即生效，原本没有语言包导出的也会自动补上：内存注入层即时生效，写入磁盘的语言包需重启一次。

items.de: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or
items.dz: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

items.de: Plugin classes for DeepSeek Harness: installing a plugin is global, so every session sees every tool. This plugin splits installed plugins into mutually invisible classes and registers each composition as an ordinary @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset, so a session mounts only the plugins of the classes
items.dz: 插件管理：DSH 装插件是全局的，每个会话都会看到所有工具。本插件把已安装插件切成互不可见的“插件类”，每个组合注册成普通的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset，会话只挂载它所属类的插件，类在输入框左侧的芯片里切换；删除类只做隐藏（preset 继续注册），已绑定它的会话不会打不开。

items.de: Code graph from tree-sitter: codegraph finds declarations, callers, callees, impact and call paths; codegraph_index builds the index, 18 languages.
items.dz: tree-sitter 代码图谱：codegraph 查声明、调用者、被调用关系、变更影响与调用路径，codegraph_index 建索引，覆盖 18 种语言。

items.de: Local CLI bridge for Codex or terminals to create and continue conversations in the running Harness desktop/Web Host, query progress, wait for output, and cancel tasks. Needs Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 and Node.js 24.9+. Requests travel through a per-user file queue in the Harness home (no network port), an
items.dz: 让 Codex 或终端通过本机 CLI 桥接正在运行的 Harness 桌面/Web Host，创建与续接界面会话、查询进度、等待输出和取消任务。需要 Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 与 Node.js 24.9+。请求经 Harness home 下按用户隔离的文件队列传递（不开网络端口），权限审批和提问仍在 Harness 界面里处理。

items.de: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
items.dz: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

items.de: Local ComfyUI image generation for DeepSeek Harness — discovers or starts the ComfyUI installed on the machine, generates a text-to-image result from a chat request, and attaches it to the conversation.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用本机 ComfyUI 真正生图——自动查找或启动本地服务，在对话里完成文生图并附图。

items.de: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
items.dz: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

items.de: Native DSH support for context-mode (mksglu/context-mode), intercepting large tool outputs with SQLite FTS5 indexing, BM25+RRF search, and session continuity. On by default: tool outputs over 4 KB are replaced with a short preview while the full text is indexed into ~/.context-mode/context.db, and a
items.dz: 原生支持 context-mode (mksglu/context-mode)，通过 SQLite FTS5 拦截工具大输出并提供 BM25+RRF 搜索与会话连续性恢复。默认开启：超过 4 KB 的工具输出会被替换成简短预览，全文索引进 ~/.context-mode/context.db，并在系统提示里加一段说明。其 ctx_execute、ctx_batch 工具以 DSH 自身的权限和环境变量运行 shell / Node / Python / PowerShell / cmd 命令（没有沙箱），ctx_index 可读取任意本地文件路径或抓取任意 http(s) 地址。

items.de: Adds a Delete conversation action to the conversation menu that permanently removes the session log, projection cache, and sidebar entry; refuses while a turn, subagent, job, or reminder is running.
items.dz: 在对话的 ⋯ 菜单里永久删除对话，清理会话日志、投影缓存与侧栏条目；有回合、子代理、后台任务或定时提醒在跑时会拒绝。

items.de: Permanently deletes a conversation, optionally together with the documents and attachments it created.
items.dz: 彻底删除对话，可选择同时删除该对话创建的文档与附件。

items.de: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injecte
items.dz: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

items.de: Scheduled daily toast popups summarizing yesterday's conversations and managing two-tier pending TODOs.
items.dz: 每日定时弹窗推送昨日对话要点提炼与双轨待办事项管理。

items.de: Database structure the agent already knows: dbgraph indexes a remote catalog into local SQLite, answering schema questions offline and fetching data in one query.
items.dz: 把数据库结构提前索引好：dbgraph 将远端库的 catalog 索引到本地 SQLite，结构问题离线回答、取数只发一次查询。

items.de: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 设置中展示 DeepSeek API 余额、余额趋势与每日用量图表。

items.de: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that s
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。

items.de: Delivery workflow preset for DeepSeek Harness: an agent protocol plus seven tools that keep user requests verbatim, record feedback decisions, plan tasks with acceptance criteria, log real verification commands and exit codes, and write completion summaries as per-project JSONL files.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的研发交付工作流 preset：一段工作协议加七个工具，保留用户原话与验收条件、记录反馈决策、拆解带验收的任务、记录真实验证命令与退出码，并以项目隔离的 JSONL 记录完成总结。

items.de: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
items.dz: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

items.de: A Discourse forum management and AI Agent plugin designed for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 而设计的 Discourse 论坛管理和 AI Agent 插件。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Danmaku and live-chat overlays for DSH: stream reasoning and answers as a right-hand chat timeline (bottom anchored, per-row fade, adjustable lifetime) or as Bilibili-style flying bullets across the whole window; mode-specific settings, content filters, and semantic edit announcements while files ar
items.dz: 把大模型的流式输出做成两种可切换的覆盖层：直播模式是右下角聊天时间线（底部对齐、逐条淡出、可调停留时间），弹幕模式是 B 站式全屏飞行弹幕（速度/轨道数可调）；支持内容过滤，并在编辑文件时实时播报「修改文件/新增类名」。

items.de: Requires JDK 11+, the DM JDBC driver and SSH access to the target instance. Inspect Dameng database instances, assess security and recovery conditions, and generate filterable reports with shared evidence.
items.dz: 需 JDK 11+、达梦 JDBC 驱动与目标实例的 SSH 访问。巡检达梦数据库实例、评估安全与恢复条件，生成支持筛选和共享证据的报告。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 8.1.60.80 for network access

items.de: Review AI-generated Word, PowerPoint, PDF and HTML in the official preview: box problems, edit the text in place, and hand the notes to the agent. PDF and images are annotate-only; editing relies on the Harness bundled LibreOffice kit and Python.
items.dz: 在官方预览里审阅 Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 HTML：框选问题、就地改字，再把批注交给 AI。PDF 与图片仅可批注；改字依赖 Harness 自带的 LibreOffice 与 Python。

items.de: Collects every DSH plugin sidebar entry into one collapsible floating dock at the corner of the Web GUI, with a switch that hides the original icon column and a deep-linked list of installed plugins.
items.dz: 把 DSH 左侧栏里所有插件的入口收进一张可折叠的浮动小卡片：顶部开关决定是否收起原侧栏图标列，点一行直达对应面板，另有全部已安装插件的深链列表。

items.de: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
items.dz: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

items.de: Connect the DSHM iPhone/iPad companion to DeepSeek Harness over your local network or Tailscale, with device pairing, session control and file transfers; public TestFlight access to the companion app is pending Apple review.
items.dz: 通过本地网络或 Tailscale，将 DSHM iPhone/iPad 配套应用连接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持设备配对、会话控制和文件传输；配套应用的公开 TestFlight 仍在等待 Apple 审核。

items.de: Dual-brain agent presets for DSH: one model plans the framework and delegates execution to a subagent pinned to a second model. Ships brain-ds (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash plans, MiMo-V2.6-Flash executes) and brain-mimo (the reverse), switchable per session. Needs two providers configured (Xiaomi MiMo and a
items.dz: 双脑协作 agent 预设：主脑先出框架，再把执行步骤委派给锁定另一模型的子代理。内置 brain-ds（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 规划、MiMo-V2.6-Flash 执行）与 brain-mimo（反向），按会话切换。需配置 Xiaomi MiMo 与 DeepSeek 账号两个 provider，主脑须手动选择。

items.de: DOCX to PDF without Microsoft Office, LibreOffice or a network: converts a Word .docx with the dxpdf Rust/Skia engine, repairs the schema-invalid OOXML that WPS Office writes, and restores the blank pages Word inserts at odd/even section breaks. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH with pip install dxpdf lxml.
items.dz: 不依赖 Microsoft Office、LibreOffice 或网络的 DOCX 转 PDF:用 dxpdf(Rust/Skia)引擎转换 Word 文档,自动修复 WPS Office 写出的非法 OOXML,并补齐 Word 在奇偶页节分界处插入的空白页。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并 pip install dxpdf lxml。

items.de: In-place text editing from the right-Sidebar document preview with ⌘S save and an external-change conflict check, plus a workspace Files tab (fuzzy search, create/rename/delete, per-file git status) and a Git changes tab whose baseline is the remote upstream — files that match the remote drop off th
items.dz: 右侧预览里直接编辑保存文本文件（⌘S、外部改动冲突提示），另带一个可模糊搜索、新建 / 重命名 / 删除、并显示每个文件 git 状态的「文件」页签，以及以远程上游为基准的「Git 改动」页签 —— 改回与远程一致的文件会自动从列表消失。

items.de: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
items.dz: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

items.de: Switch installed Rose and Miku themes and customize artwork, background opacity, and phone navigation in DSH settings.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置中切换初音与玫瑰主题，调整人物装饰、背景浓度与手机导航。

items.de: A starter plugin to copy from: one right-sidebar tab with two languages, behaviour tests that mount the real bundle, and CI that runs the manifest preflight.
items.dz: 可直接照抄的入门插件：一个右侧栏标签页、中英两份文案、挂载真实 bundle 的行为测试，以及会跑清单预检的 CI。

items.de: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a ru
items.dz: 飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书机器人；每轮结束推一张卡片，在飞书里授权工具调用、回答结构化提问，并直接用聊天驱动会话（/sessions 列会话、/resume 切换绑定会话、任务进行中可插话引导），还能按对话设置权限模式（只读 / 工作区读写 / Auto Review / 完全权限）。消息以卡片 JSON 2.0 发送，超长内容分页而不是截断。归属绑定：扫码创建时绑定扫码人；手填凭据时由首个发消息的人认领，其余人一律拒绝。

items.de: Annotatable file editor for the DSH right sidebar with a lazy file tree, inline annotations, cross-file annotation navigation, Markdown preview, and composer-draft handoff.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏可批注文件编辑器，提供懒加载文件树、行内批注、跨文件批注导航、Markdown 预览，以及批注加入对话草稿。

items.de: Scaffold DSH local bundles in the dph format from any workspace and keep a pitfall experience library to steer later development.
items.dz: 在任意工作区按 dph 格式脚手架 DSH 本地插件，并维护踩坑经验库持续修正开发。

items.de: Gemini-styled skin restyling the conversation ground, sidebar rows, hero greeting and composer through one stylesheet over the --dsw-* tokens, with light and dark both covered.
items.dz: Gemini 风格皮肤，用一张叠在 --dsw-* 令牌之上的样式表重塑对话区底色、侧栏胶囊行、首屏问候语与输入框，明暗主题都覆盖。

items.de: Packs the third-party plugins installed in a DSH profile into tarballs and pushes them to a GitHub or Gitee repository; another machine pulls the manifest, compares versions and installs only what is missing or out of date. Needs a personal access token with write access to that repository (kept in
items.dz: 把 DSH 配置档里已安装的第三方插件连同源码打包成 tarball 推送到 GitHub 或 Gitee 仓库；另一台电脑拉取清单、比对版本，只安装缺失或过期的插件。需要对该仓库有写权限的个人访问令牌（存于 DSH 凭据服务）；压缩包含各插件已安装的源码，建议使用私有仓库。
