items.de: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.
items.dz: 面向 Agent 的 GitHub 仓库工具：首次调用弹窗绑定账号，之后把仓库克隆到工作区并读写文件、精确替换、提交与推送，写远端默认关闭。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
items.dz: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。Beta.2 支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

items.de: Adds a /grill-me slash command that switches the session to plan mode and prompts the agent to ask 3 to 20 structured questions about your goal, each with a recommended option and alternatives, through ask_user_question before it plans.
items.dz: 添加 /grill-me 斜杠命令：把会话切到计划模式，并提示 agent 在规划前通过 ask_user_question 就你的目标提出 3 到 20 个结构化问题，每个问题带推荐选项和备选项。

items.de: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
items.dz: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

items.de: Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.
items.dz: 给插件页「已安装」列表加一行分类 Tab（全部 / 界面与外观 / 用量与账户 …），记住选中的分类；在可编辑对照表里登记的补丁插件会缩进挂在它修的插件下面。纯显示层，不写任何文件。

items.de: DSH Desktop plugin safety guard: self-repairs plugin load crashes and runs 8 core safety checks (2 optional: deep-config & smoke), prompting you when a plugin changes. Non-commercial source-available.
items.dz: DSH Desktop 插件安全防护：崩溃后自我修复 + 8 项核心安全检查（另有 2 项可选：深度组合校验、业务冒烟），写完插件自动提示。非商业源可用。

items.de: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that i
items.dz: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

items.de: Write, illustrate and hand off WeChat and short-video content from one workbench, with per-image versions and draft push.
items.dz: 在一个工作台里写稿配图、留存每版出图，并把草稿推进公众号。

items.de: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
items.dz: 在回答里标出任意一段文字、写上备注，再把引用放回输入框当作带上下文的指令发出。

items.de: Feishu (Lark) bot for DSH remote control — messages become session turns, results return to the chat, and ask-mode approval requests can be approved or denied in Feishu.
items.dz: 飞书机器人远程控制 DSH 会话——消息进入会话，回合结果回到飞书，ask 档的审批可以在飞书里批准或拒绝。

items.de: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
items.dz: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

items.de: Inspects a plugin's declarative patch entries and installed code files on its Plugins page.
items.dz: 在插件详情页查看插件的声明式 patch 与安装后的代码文件。

items.de: Install, update and remove DSH plugins from a tab in the Plugins page. Installs call the profile's in-process pluginManager service, so a plugin can be added while the desktop app is running instead of only through the CLI. Updates are delegated to dsh-market's public update API v1 (required for tha
items.dz: 在插件页的一个标签里安装、更新和卸载 DSH 插件。安装直接调用 profile 进程内的 pluginManager 服务，因此桌面端运行中也能装，不必只靠命令行。更新委托给 dsh-market 的公开 update API v1（该区需要装 dsh-market），把市场报告的阶段、百分比与已下载字节显示成进度条，市场提供恢复点时给出一键回滚。卸载被「插件正在使用中」拒绝时，先停用该组合包，再从 profile 清单里摘除，并把残留文件记入 profile 下的待清理队列，下次启动后自动清扫。

items.de: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
items.dz: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

items.de: Live streaming diffs for DSH file edits: a floating panel and an edit/write transcript card render the change while the model is still emitting the tool call, and the same reading is painted behind the whole app as a frosted-glass backdrop with liquid-glass refraction, pointer light and an in-app ap
items.dz: DSH 文件编辑的实时流式 diff：悬浮面板与 edit/write 对话卡片在模型还在输出工具调用参数时就开始渲染改动；同一份读数还画在整个应用背后，做成可调的磨砂玻璃背景（含液态玻璃折射、鼠标光效与应用内外观面板）。依赖 DSH 内部客户端接口并替换内置 edit/write 工具卡片；仅在 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 与桌面端 0.2.1-rc.5（Windows）上验证。

items.de: Manages local llama.cpp servers and GGUF launch profiles on Windows and exposes the profiles in the DSH model picker.
items.dz: 在 Windows 上管理本地 llama.cpp 服务和 GGUF 启动配置，并将已配置的模型登记到 DSH 模型选择器。

items.de: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
items.dz: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

items.de: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.
items.dz: 反向代理域名访问 dsh web 时恢复设置页的 Host 持久化：将页面连接标记为宿主可信，设置与模型页正常加载，不再报 "settings are unavailable in this browser"。适用于 dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x。

items.de: Connects DeepSeek Harness to LRC's local structured memory: distills conclusions every 8 turns, drops near-duplicates by character-level Jaccard similarity (≥ 0.85), and writes them to a local LRC store. Five tools — lrc_recall, lrc_forget, lrc_remember_now, lrc_handoff and lrc_status — cover on-dem
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 LRC 的本地结构化记忆：每 8 轮提炼一次结论，按字符级 Jaccard 相似度（≥ 0.85）去重后写入本地 LRC 库。五个工具 lrc_recall / lrc_forget / lrc_remember_now / lrc_handoff / lrc_status 分别负责按需召回、撤回错误条目、立即写入、会话交接与状态行。首次运行会按平台下载 LRC 二进制（win32-x64、darwin-arm64、linux-x64，带 SHA256 校验）并启动隔离实例，因此无需先装 LRC 桌面端；数据默认写在 $DSH_HOME/cache/

items.de: Native macOS tools for DeepSeek Harness agents, with 21 local tools for notifications, clipboard, screenshots, speech, keep-awake, dark mode, Spotlight, Shortcuts, AppleScript and Safari tabs. Zero dependencies.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的 21 个 macOS 原生工具，涵盖通知、剪贴板、截屏、朗读、防休眠、深色模式、Spotlight、快捷指令、AppleScript 与 Safari 标签页，零依赖。

items.de: IMAP mail triage and cleanup for DeepSeek Harness: incremental read-only scan, a hard-protection rule layer plus optional local-model classification, a Markdown report and a hashed manifest, an explicit approval card, and only then a move to the Trash mailbox — no expunge.
items.dz: IMAP 邮件分拣与清理：增量只读扫描，先过硬保护规则层、再走可选的本地模型分类，产出报告与带哈希的清单，人工批准后才移动到回收站——全程不 expunge。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
items.dz: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

items.de: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by stars, downloads, name or date added. Three tabs show all, installed and updatable plugins, with a separate count when update status cannot be d
items.dz: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用 DSH 提供的包管理器一键安装和更新，保留其他插件的停用状态。支持通过 HMR 重载 profile，不可用时提示重启。各 profile 的安装状态独立，安装与重载互斥，分页保持已提交的搜索条件。目录与安装状态快照过期时先显示本地内容并在后台刷新。未指定版本的 npm 安装先解析

items.de: A Plugin Market entry in the DSH settings sidebar that opens dshmarket.com, the community plugin market for DeepSeek Harness, in a new tab. The light-weight alternative to installing the market itself, for people who only want the button.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置侧边栏加入「Plugin Market」入口，点击即在新标签页打开 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件市场 dshmarket.com。是安装市场本体之外的轻量选择，适合只想要一个按钮的人。

items.de: A plugin-market panel in the sidebar and in settings: browse the dsh-plugin.org directory, filter and sort it, and install / enable / disable / remove bundles into the current profile through the official plugin manager. The curated catalog and the full sitemap index are merged, so plugins missing f
items.dz: 侧栏与设置里的插件市场面板：浏览 dsh-plugin.org 目录、按分类与 Star/更新时间筛选排序，经 Harness 官方插件管理器安装、启停、卸载到当前 profile。精选目录与 sitemap 全量索引合并显示，目录里被漏掉的插件也能搜到。

items.de: Adds a plugin market entry button to the left sidebar that opens the installed market in a main panel.
items.dz: 在左侧栏添加插件市场入口按钮，点击后在主面板打开已安装的插件市场。

items.de: Self-hosted plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness with accounts, groups, permissions, artifact storage, and install statistics; run the server with Docker and install this client bundle in DSH.
items.dz: 面向团队的 DSH 自托管插件市场：账号、权限组、制品存储与安装统计；服务端用 Docker 运行，DSH 安装此客户端组合包。

items.de: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的长期持久记忆：以 JSON 保存事实／偏好／实体／规则／经历等分类条目，注册为 memory_remember 与 memory_recall 两个 agent 工具；召回按关键词重叠、重要度与访问频次排序。

items.de: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
items.dz: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

items.de: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
items.dz: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

items.de: Read-only page lookups for mfgabc.com: standards pages, industrial city guides, process clusters and cross-border compliance across 5 tools; each returns the page status, title and link, not full text. Network-only.
items.dz: mfgabc.com 只读页面查询：标准页、产业带城市指南、工艺集群与跨境合规，共 5 个工具；每个只返回页面状态、标题与链接，不含正文。仅网络访问。

items.de: Read-only tools for mj7.cn: search standards, products and materials, plus HS-code lookup, Incoterms, trade documents and CNY rates across 6 tools. Network-only, no local writes.
items.dz: mj7.cn 只读工具：检索标准、产品与材料，另有 HS 编码联想、Incoterms、贸易单证与人民币汇率，共 6 个工具。仅网络访问，不写本地。

items.de: Mobile UX fixes for the DSH web shell — narrow-screen layout, iOS keyboard and viewport handling, one-tap session switching.
items.dz: DSH Web 壳层的手机端体验优化：窄屏布局修复、iOS 键盘与视口跟随、侧边栏单击切换会话。

items.de: Scheduled model-news radar: collects official release announcements from LLM vendors through RSS, Hugging Face and GitHub organisation APIs and changelog pages (a 6-vendor sample list is bundled, a user-maintained list is read from ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json), deduplicates them into daily,
items.dz: 模型资讯雷达：按厂商官方来源清单（RSS、Hugging Face 与 GitHub 组织接口、变更页；自带 6 家示例清单，完整清单读 ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json）定时采集大模型发布资讯，去重后写成日报 / 周报 / 月报，并起一个 DSH 会话写摘要。只读，不登录任何平台，无第三方依赖。

items.de: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock, or pop them out into their own browser window.
items.dz: 话分两头：把 AI 对话从「切来切去」变成「并排开火」——每个会话一枚原生小窗，贴着主对话随开随用；一键平铺所有窗口（顶对齐·同高·紧贴），最小化到带实时状态灯的底部停靠条（转圈=工作中·绿色=刚完成·黄色=待审批·灰色=空闲），真浏览器里还能把会话弹出成独立浏览器窗口。

items.de: Windows-only stealth lyrics readout: reads the desktop Netease Cloud Music client through Windows SMTC (song, artist, play state), fetches its LRC and translation from the public Netease API, and renders the currently sung line directly beside the DSH activity line ("深度求索中，用时 X s") with font, size a
items.dz: 仅 Windows 的摸鱼歌词插件：通过 Windows SMTC 读取桌面网易云音乐客户端的歌名、歌手与播放状态，从网易云公开接口拉取 LRC 与翻译，并把当前演唱的那句歌词直接渲染在 DSH 状态行（"深度求索中，用时 X 秒"）右侧，字体、字号、颜色经 computed style 从状态行实时克隆，看起来只是那句话变长了。进度由宿主秒表推算，暂停停表、切歌归零；状态行不在时歌词整体隐藏；anchorText 配置可适配非中文界面；1.0.5 起搜索被限流时自动切换备用端点。需在网易云设置中开启"开启SMTC"开关。

items.de: Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话中运维 Nexterm 托管的 SSH 机群：6 个 agent 工具（密码/TOTP/设备授权码登录认证、机群清单、单机执行、批量并行执行、预设健康检查、CPU/内存/磁盘监控），全走 Nexterm REST API，附极简设置页；DSH 机器上无需任何 SSH 私钥。

items.de: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
items.dz: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

items.de: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
items.dz: ！警告！这会移除认证步骤！警告！注册一个登录入口路由（默认 GET /__dsh_login），把进程里的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问不用带 ?token=…。

items.de: Translates the English reasoning text of DSH sessions into Chinese on this machine, using a local Marian NMT model (ONNX, about 108 MiB) that you download once from the plugin panel (Hugging Face or the hf-mirror.com mirror). No API key and no network request at translation time; identifiers, code s
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话里的英文思考内容在本机翻成中文：本地 Marian NMT（ONNX，约 108 MiB）需在插件面板里点「下载」一次（来自 Hugging Face 或 hf-mirror.com 镜像）；翻译时不需要 API key、也不发任何网络请求；标识符、代码片段与链接会被掩码保护，译文里原样还原。

items.de: Local Ollama worker tools for DeepSeek Harness: model inventory, a single unverified ask, and a batch runner that chunks long text, checks every item deterministically, returns a small verbatim sample for review and can optionally write the labelled result inside the session workspace.
items.dz: 本机 Ollama 工具：模型清单、单次（未校验）问答，以及跑长文本的批处理——分块并发、逐条确定性校验、回传一小段抽样原文供复核，结果可选择写入会话工作区。

items.de: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status, page listing, search and page content.
items.dz: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

items.de: One-line notice at the top edge of the DSH window with your DeepSeek balance, the ChatGPT/Codex five-hour and weekly remaining quota and their reset times, and how many quota-reset cards are left plus the nearest expiry; the reset-card part links to the ChatGPT usage page in your browser.
items.dz: 在 DSH 窗口顶部边缘用一行提示显示 DeepSeek 余额、ChatGPT/Codex 五小时与每周剩余额度及其重置时间、剩余额度重置卡数量与最近到期时间；重置卡那一段是链接，会用浏览器打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: OpenCode Go subscription usage beside the composer: the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows each as a small ring with the used percentage (amber at 70%, red at 90%). Clicking the meter opens a detail card with per-window progress bars, reset countdowns and a refresh button, and when it is not
items.dz: 在输入框旁边常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐用量：5 小时滚动、每周、每月三个窗口各一个圆环与已用百分比（70% 变黄、90% 变红）；点击整条弹出详情卡，含每个窗口的额度进度条、重置倒计时与刷新按钮，不点击时不会在对话上悬浮任何东西。API Key 只留在 Host 进程里，不进入浏览器。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.
items.dz: 右侧边栏的会话面板：按轮次与步骤列出全部 Skill、MCP 工具调用与文件读写，并展开每次失败的报错详情。

items.de: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, a
items.dz: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

items.de: Strips AI-flavor from LLM text with local density scanning and deterministic fact/strength/safety checks; a rewrite that fails verification falls back to the original.
items.dz: 把大模型生成的文本改成读起来像人写的：本地密度扫描 + 事实/强度/安全确定性校验，改写不达标自动回退原文。

items.de: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
items.dz: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

items.de: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with AI, check health and toggle plugins, so nothing gets lost in clutter.
items.dz: 本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。

items.de: Two columns for the dsh Plugins page, Minecraft resource-pack style: the left column holds the packs running together, the right holds packs that are installed but switched off, with arrow or drag moves between them, custom tags, search, scope filters, batch toggling and undo. Tags and display names
items.dz: 在 dsh 插件页加「插件包」标签：左栏是正在一起用的包、右栏是装好但未启用的，支持箭头或拖拽在两栏间搬包、自定义标签、搜索、范围筛选、批量启停与撤销。标签与中文名存在 DSH_HOME 下的 packs.json 里而不是浏览器存储，换浏览器或清站点数据都不丢。

items.de: Searches medical and life-science literature by topic, keyword or DOI through Europe PMC, PubMed, OpenAlex and Crossref; decides open-access status through Unpaywall/OpenAlex/Europe PMC; downloads the PDF when an OA route exists (verified by magic bytes and page count) and otherwise writes a decisio
items.dz: 按领域、检索词或 DOI 检索医学与生命科学文献（Europe PMC / PubMed / OpenAlex / Crossref），用 Unpaywall 等源判定开放获取状态，能拿到 OA 全文时自动下载并通过文件头与页数校验；拿不到时生成决策卡，写清自动下载失败的具体原因，并给出科研通互助、Sci-Hub、SciDown、X-MOL 四条人工通道的直达链接，人工取回后用一条命令登记入库。随包 Python 工具仅依赖标准库。

items.de: Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).
items.dz: 在 Web 输入框补全 @ 路径引用：输入 @（可继续输入 ./src/ma）即列出匹配的文件与目录，用上下键选择后草稿得到 @./相对路径引用（路径含空格时自动加引号）。

items.de: Connects Penpot to DSH across two independent channels with 9 tools: 5 MCP tools (execute_code, high_level_overview, api_info, export_shape, import_image), 2 browser-free REST tools (penpot_read and penpot_write to create files, pages and shapes or edit attributes without an open tab), plus penpot_s
items.dz: 把 Penpot 接进 DSH，提供两条独立通道与 9 个工具：5 个 MCP 工具（execute_code、high_level_overview、api_info、export_shape、import_image）、2 个免浏览器的 REST 读写工具（penpot_read 与 penpot_write，无需打开网页即可建文件、加页面、加图层与改属性），外加 penpot_status 与 penpot_control；支持官方托管、本地构建与自部署三档及从 DSH、Codex、Claude、Cursor、Gemini、.mcp.json 自动识别与迁移配置，附带独立 profile

items.de: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas
items.dz: DSH 人格管理器：人格库存于一份 JSON，可按会话绑定人设、可为未绑定的会话指定默认人格，切换可选立即生效或下个会话生效；Web 端提供「模型人格」设置页与输入框旁的人格切换条，模型侧另有 persona_list / persona_switch / persona_create 三个工具可自行列出、切换与创建人格。

items.de: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.
items.dz: 在会话行菜单加入 Pin/Unpin，并在侧边栏列表上方提供可折叠的 Pinned Sessions 分组：主机端持久化、悬停快速取消置顶、折叠状态记忆与实时运行状态点。

items.de: Reusable experience for DeepSeek Harness: save a successful task as a structured playbook, recall it later as a native skill, and gate deliveries behind user-confirmed checks that require objective evidence before write actions are allowed.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的经验复用与交付闸门：把成功任务沉淀为结构化 playbook，同质任务自动作为原生 Skill 召回；交付闸门经用户确认后，写文件前必须逐项拿到客观证据，否则动作被硬拦截。

items.de: Moves DSH plugins between machines and profiles: export a migration bundle where local plugins keep their source and remote ones reinstall by version, restore it elsewhere with the bundle's own restore.mjs, copy plugins to another profile, or pack the whole environment (config, memory, sessions, att
items.dz: 把 DSH 插件搬到另一台机器或另一个 profile：导出迁移包（本地插件带源码、远程插件按版本重装），用包自带的 restore.mjs 在别处恢复，一键复制到其他 profile，或把配置/记忆/会话/附件/插件源码打成带校验分卷并附恢复脚本。

items.de: Export installed DSH plugins with their dependency closure and docs to removable media, then scan and install or update them offline in an isolated intranet.
items.dz: 将已安装的 DSH 插件连同依赖闭包与文档导出到移动介质，在隔离内网中扫描目录并离线安装或更新插件。

items.de: Starts chats without selecting a project folder, with a persistent per-chat working directory and native Harness session storage.
items.dz: 无需选择项目文件夹即可开始对话，为每次聊天分配持久工作目录，并沿用 Harness 原生会话存储。

items.de: Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.
items.dz: DSH 运行时可切换的出站 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理，带网页设置卡片。

items.de: Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. Requires a QQ official bot ap
items.dz: 把 QQ 官方机器人接到 DSH 进程内：QQ 里发消息直接开一轮真实会话（工作目录是已登记工作区时，桌面端左侧能看到、能续聊），结果以文本、图片或文件回传 QQ。需一个 QQ 官方机器人应用（AppID + AppSecret）。

items.de: Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.
items.dz: 在输入框旁增加已安装插件选择器：把插件名拖到提示词的落点插入，双击入口在右侧边栏打开可拖动插件栏，并可在设置中选择显示哪些插件、填写备注。

items.de: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
items.dz: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

items.de: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
items.dz: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

items.de: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
items.dz: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

items.de: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.
items.dz: DSH Web 远程访问网关：登录鉴权 + 到本机服务的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，无需 --trusted-host。

items.de: One-click restart for the DSH desktop app that keeps the window position, size, maximized state and display, with an optional resume of the sessions the restart interrupted (not only the one you had open). The entry is an icon at the right of the sidebar footer account row plus a /restart-desktop sl
items.dz: DSH 桌面版一键重启：保留窗口位置、大小、最大化状态与所在显示器，可选在重启后自动续上被打断的会话（不只你当前打开的那个）。入口是侧栏底部账号行右侧的图标按钮，另有 /restart-desktop 斜杠命令；账号行认不出来时自动回落到 sidebar.footer.action 座位，按钮不会凭空消失。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

items.de: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
items.dz: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

items.de: A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each pinning a `position:fixed` panel; ships a `rightbar-tab` skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.
items.dz: DSH 网页端的共享右栏——别的插件往 `rightbar.tab` 槽位注册标签页，不必各自 `position:fixed` 抢位置；随包附带给 agent 用的 `rightbar-tab` skill，另有一个默认关闭的让位模式把老面板挪开。

items.de: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
items.dz: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

items.de: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
items.dz: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

items.de: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
items.dz: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

items.de: Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.
items.dz: DSH 插件生态体检评分卡：同步 dsh-plugin 目录，对任意插件做质量与安全审计（0-100 分、A-D 等级、安全一票否决），榜单、搜索与历史评分曲线（目录持久化）。

items.de: Adds an "Add model" entry to the model menu for third-party providers, plus a management dialog that switches the model of the current conversation, edits or removes entries, and highlights the one in use.
items.dz: 在模型菜单底部增加「添加模型」与「管理已添加模型」：接入第三方服务商并写入 DSH 模型配置，可编辑 / 删除条目，并一键切换当前对话的模型、高亮正在使用的那一行。

items.de: Selection comments on assistant output plus an independent side-chat window in the DSH Web GUI: annotate model output with floating comments, send those comments with the next message, and continue a question in a separate forked conversation that stays out of the sidebar.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面中为大模型输出添加划词评论，评论可随下一条消息一起发送；并可在独立浮动的分支会话窗口中继续提问，该会话不会出现在侧边栏。

items.de: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.
items.dz: 启动时打印 DeepSeek Harness 插件树中每一行的状态（失败的附异常内容），并检查依赖版本漂移、配置文件合法性、端口可达性与已注册工具。

items.de: Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话标颜色：悬停侧栏会话行即可选色（12 色），被标色行显示同色竖条，宿主侧持久化。

items.de: Browse, sort, group, toggle and batch-update every DSH plugin you already installed — with groups, filters and resumable updates.
items.dz: 已安装 DSH 插件的书架：按名称/安装时间/大小排序，自由分组与一键启停，批量检查并可断点续装的自动更新。

items.de: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
items.dz: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

items.de: Reskin the whole DSH interface with colour themes, illustration wallpapers, custom cursors and a desktop pet.
items.dz: 给整个 DSH 界面换肤：配色主题、插画壁纸、自定义光标与桌面桌宠。

items.de: Pre-upgrade snapshots, one-step rollback and static diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness profile plugins.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供升级前快照、一键回滚与静态体检。

items.de: Sound alerts for the DSH web UI: a chime when an answer completes and a three-tone prompt when your approval or question is pending, with optional custom WAV stored only in the local browser (pure client-side, zero assets).
items.dz: DSH 网页端提示音：回答完成播放提示音，需要授权或向你提问时播放三连音；支持自定义 WAV（仅存本机浏览器），纯客户端零资源。

items.de: Compose two skill contracts into a traceable, unverified draft with declared gaps and preserved constraints; the composition engine runs locally with no model call.
items.dz: 把两个技能契约本地组合成可追溯的未验证草案，列出缺口并保留双方约束；组合引擎在本机运行，不调用模型。

items.de: Highlight DSH Web replies while reading and save them with their user questions.
items.dz: 阅读 DSH Web 回复时划线，并连同对应的用户问题一起收藏。

items.de: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
items.dz: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

items.de: Appearance suite for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, startup authentication sequence, and a sidebar toggle for borderless windows.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。

items.de: Plugin Steward adds a plugin panel to the chat composer for managing the installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list them, switch them on or off, edit a plugin's settings, hide one plugin's tools or MCP servers from a single conversation, and have the model write short Chinese labels for installed plug
items.dz: 插件管家：在对话输入框上加入插件面板，用来管理本机已装的 DSH 插件——列出全部插件、全局启停、逐个编辑插件设置、把某个插件的工具或 MCP 服务器只在这一个对话里对模型隐藏，还能让模型读插件自身的 README 与包信息生成中文标签。面板可拖动并记住位置。

items.de: Plugin steward for DeepSeek-Harness: checks every installed plugin for newer versions and installs them, snapshots the profile first and rolls back automatically when the post-update health check regresses. Also scans plugin code for risky behaviour before you install (eval, reverse shell, credentia
items.dz: DeepSeek-Harness 插件管家：查出所有插件的新版本并直接升级，升级前自动建快照，升级后重新体检，结果变差就自动还原。装任何插件前先静态扫描代码（动态执行、反弹 shell、翻密钥都会标出来），内置 8489 个插件的市场目录并带兼容性判定，装完/卸完/停用完自动重启宿主，不需要手动关软件。界面文案全白话，不写术语。

items.de: Storage and dependency inspector for the DSH Web UI: scans disk use per workspace, session and file class, lists the largest folders and files, and deletes the build, dependency, archived-session and cache folders you select behind a path allow-list (cleanup candidates also include top-level Desktop
items.dz: DSH Web UI 的存储与依赖检查器：按工作区、会话与文件类别统计磁盘占用，列出最大目录与文件，并可在路径白名单校验后删除你勾选的构建、依赖、已归档会话与缓存目录（清理候选还包括桌面上的一级文件夹）；只读的第二个页签跨工作区比对 package.json、.nvmrc、.node-version 与 npm 锁文件，标出版本与 Node 主版本漂移。

items.de: Integrated control plane for the local strata model stack: manage the strata-hop :8080 model-switching router (status/models/warm/logs), stream live model-switch and load state into the web GUI status chip and the strata_status tool, preload a model engine the moment it is selected, edit run-config
items.dz: 本地 strata 模型栈的一体化控制面：管理 strata-hop :8080 模型切换路由（status/models/warm/logs），把模型切换与加载状态实时送进 Web GUI 状态芯片和 strata_status 工具，选中模型即预热引擎，GUI 调参面板/strata_params 编辑 run-config 与共享聊天设置，并自带把聊天路由到路由器的 dsh provider 补丁（含 Effort 档位映射）。对推理只读：从不发 prompt、不消耗 token；需自备运行中的 strata 与 strata-hop（默认 :8080 路由、:8756 监控）。随包的补

items.de: Project control plane with durable tickets, replaceable DSH sessions, a project matrix, and bidirectional UI navigation.
items.dz: 项目控制台，支持持久化任务、可替换的执行会话、项目卡片矩阵和 DSH 双向切换。

items.de: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served
items.dz: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin

items.de: Sidebar supervisor for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: health, DSH compatibility, updates, usage frequency, per-plugin token cost, and local version backups with rollback.
items.dz: DSH 已安装插件的侧栏监管面板：集中展示健康状态、DSH 兼容性、更新、使用频率与逐插件 Token 成本，并在更新前自动本地备份、支持回滚。

items.de: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs curated plugins from a Discover tab.
items.dz: 在侧边栏面板里一键启停已安装插件，按来源分组（官方自带、市场安装、本地导入），标出需要重启 Host 才生效的改动，并在「发现」页一键安装精选插件。

items.de: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom forward-chain engine. Business records stay on the machine; rule generation sends field names and rule text only.
items.dz: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

items.de: Back up and restore DSH plugins through your own private GitHub repository — list, versions, configuration and local sources included.
items.dz: 插件一键备份，换机一键还原：清单、版本、配置与本地插件源码存进自己的 GitHub 私有仓库。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows a diff first: version conflicts default to the newer side, entries only the Gist has stay by default, and entries only the local machine has
items.dz: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

items.de: Sets a CNY spending cap for each DeepSeek Harness turn (¥5 by default) and stops the run before the next model request once the cap is reached; the switch and amount sit at the right end of the composer dock.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 每一轮对话设人民币花费上限（默认 5 元），到上限就在下一个模型请求发出前停下；开关与金额在输入框下方最右侧。

items.de: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
items.dz: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

items.de: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
items.dz: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

items.de: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

items.de: Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.
items.dz: Codex 风格对话文字批注：选中原文加注释、引用进对话、发送后以「N 条注释」胶囊展开。

items.de: Checks thesis formatting in .docx and .doc files against a YAML spec, covering fonts, line spacing, margins, heading numbering, captions and references. Includes one built-in spec for Bengbu College of Technology and Business, and custom specs are supported.
items.dz: 按 YAML 规范检查 .docx 和 .doc 毕业论文的格式，包括字体、行距、页边距、标题编号、图表题注和参考文献。内置蚌埠工商学院的一份规范，也可使用自定义规范。

items.de: Floating Token Burn Dock for DSH that aggregates provider usage across every session: the collapsed capsule shows the live tokens/sec rate with an inline 60-second sparkline and today's total, while the expanded panel adds a large live-rate hero, per-model and per-hour breakdowns on a real left axis
items.dz: DSH 的悬浮 Token 燃烧指数 Dock：汇总全部 session 的 provider usage。收起时是一枚胶囊，显示实时燃烧速率（含 token/s 单位）、内嵌近 60 秒速率曲线和今日总 Token；展开后是完整面板，含大号实时速率 Hero、按模型 / 按小时两种粒度、带真实左侧纵轴的柱状图，以及按真实星期对齐的近 30 天热力图。火焰是 16 帧程序生成的序列帧动画，只在真的有 Token 在烧时播放、速率为 0 时熄灭；日 / 小时分桶按浏览器时区（客户端把 UTC 偏移传给 Host），31 天记录先加载再原子落盘，重启不会再把历史覆盖清空。

items.de: Live token spend for the current DSH session beside the composer, pricing the four server-reported token buckets with the profile's own table and showing both the peak and off-peak rate.
items.dz: 在输入框旁实时显示当前会话的 token 花费：用服务端上报的四个 token 分桶乘以本 profile 的价格表，并同时列出高峰与空闲价格。

items.de: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
items.dz: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

items.de: Dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots the live Cordis plugin/service topology into a zoomable browser panel with graph-theory metrics, plus a graph.render tool for the model.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

items.de: An isolated translation pipeline where each module is its own model call carrying only its own prompt and its own input — no session history, no tool schemas, no other module's content. Build chains from draggable cards, edit any module's prompt in place, override the model per module, or start from
items.dz: 隔离式翻译链路：每个模块都是一次独立的模型调用，只携带自己的提示词和自己的输入——不带会话历史、不带工具定义、不带其他模块的内容。用可拖拽卡片编排链路，就地编辑任意模块的提示词，按模块覆盖模型，也可直接套用两套精译预设。同一条链路还以 translate_flow 工具的形式提供给智能体。

items.de: Read-only audit of whether a DSH plugin's HTTP routes are actually fenced, discovering the registered routes by reading plugin code and probing loopback only.
items.dz: 只读审计 DSH 插件的 HTTP 路由是否真的做了鉴权栅栏：读插件代码找出真正注册的路由，仅对回环地址发起探测。

items.de: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

items.de: A DSH-native plugin update center: check and update installed plugins from the sidebar with snapshots, rollback, queued updates and uninstall-leftover cleanup.
items.dz: 尊重 DSH 原始风格的插件更新插件：在侧边栏检查、排队更新已安装插件，支持快照回滚、安装后校验、卸载残留清理与离线恢复。

items.de: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with not
items.dz: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

items.de: Helps keeping tracked updates from plugins added from github with a simple usability UI.
items.dz: 通过简单的可用性 UI 帮助跟踪从 github 添加的插件的更新。

items.de: Notify-only update checker for the plugins in a DSH profile: classifies each dependency by its specifier and offers only releases the running DSH core can load, in a plugin_updates tool and an Updates sidebar tab (the tab needs dsh-better-sidebar; the tool and settings work without it).
items.dz: 面向 DSH profile 内插件的只提醒更新检查器：按依赖写法（specifier）分类，只列出当前 DSH 内核能加载的版本；提供 plugin_updates 工具和 Updates 侧栏页（侧栏页需装 dsh-better-sidebar，不装时工具与设置仍可用）。

items.de: Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
items.dz: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

items.de: Local-first usage analytics for DSH: subscribes to session events and aggregates tool calls, turns, errors, latency and capability usage into daily tables, shown in a sidebar panel (6 KPIs, 14-day trend, top tools, capability breakdown) and served over a fenced local HTTP API with 18 JSON-RPC method
items.dz: 本地优先的 DSH 用量分析：订阅会话事件，把工具调用、回合、错误、耗时与能力使用聚合为日表，在侧栏面板展示（6 个 KPI、14 日趋势、Top 工具、能力分布），并通过受围栏保护的本地 HTTP 接口暴露 18 个 JSON-RPC 方法。运行时零依赖，local 模式零出站，不采集任何消息正文。

items.de: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
items.dz: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

items.de: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable r
items.dz: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

items.de: A versions tab on the plugin page: every installed bundle with its current version, the newest published version and a status (update available, up to date, follows the harness version, or not updatable from a registry). A row opens the official bundle page, where the update button lives; check resu
items.dz: 插件页新增「版本一览」标签页：列出每个已安装组合包的当前版本、最新发布版本与状态（可更新、已是最新、随 DSH 版本更新、来源不支持更新）。点一行跳到官方组合包页，更新仍在官方页面完成；检查结果会缓存，并按缓存时间从旧到新重新核对。组合包页另加「到底部」与「回到顶部」两个按钮。

items.de: Drives Cadence Virtuoso from the host: VM lifecycle, SKILL execution through the bridge, window capture, Calibre DRC parsing and a write-confirmation gate, in 12 host-only tools.
items.dz: 从宿主机驱动 Cadence Virtuoso 画版图：虚拟机生命周期、经 bridge 执行 SKILL、窗口截图、Calibre DRC 解析，以及写入确认闸门，共 12 个宿主侧工具。

items.de: Cleans a Wallpaper Engine workshop folder against a screenshot of your subscriptions: it finds the blue check badges, OCRs the tile titles, matches them to each project.json title, and moves non-subscribed wallpapers to the Recycle Bin. Ships a settings page and a floating modal, and is Windows-only
items.dz: 对照“我的订阅壁纸”截图清理 Wallpaper Engine 工坊文件夹：识别蓝色勾选、OCR 磁贴标题并与 project.json 匹配，把非订阅壁纸移入回收站；带设置页与悬浮模态框，仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Windows WeChat 4.x chat export toolchain shipped as a skill: discovers SQLCipher shards, decrypts, exports and merges them; conversion, stats, AI relationship analysis and HTML reporting delegate to the locally installed she-love-me skill. Requires Python 3.9+ for the analysis stages.
items.dz: Windows 微信 4.x 聊天导出工具链技能：自动发现、解密、导出并合并 SQLCipher 分片；转换、统计、AI 关系分析与 HTML 报告委托给本机已装的 she-love-me 技能。分析阶段需要 Python 3.9+。

items.de: Bundled LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷) typeface plugin: switches the Web GUI interface and conversation text to the kai-style font with no configuration, using a system-installed copy when present and otherwise serving the packaged offline web font.
items.dz: 内置霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）字体的插件：零配置把网页界面与对话文字切换为楷体风格，优先使用系统已安装字体，未安装时按需加载包内离线字体。

items.de: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archiv
items.dz: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

items.de: Split view for the Web UI: tiles 1-3 columns x 1-3 rows of live sessions from several workspaces in one grid, with draggable dividers, sidebar-follow routing, an in-pane file preview and an in-pane changes review.
items.dz: Web 界面里的多工作区分屏视图：用 1–3 列 × 1–3 行的网格同时显示多个工作区的实时会话，支持拖动分栏、侧边栏会话进入格子、格内文件预览与改动评审。

items.de: Writing council: parallel multi-model drafting, judge consensus & critique synthesis, AI prompt refinement, visual concept illustration, and Markdown file preview.
items.dz: 写作工作台：引入多模型针对同一命题独立盲写，追加主审裁判交叉评审与去糟取精，支持 AI 命题扩写、视觉总览配图与 Markdown 文件预览导出。

items.de: Adds a structured TextIn xParse tool and document parsing skill to DeepSeek Harness, supporting document parsing, cached-content navigation and durable multi-document tasks, with AppKey or Device OAuth authentication, paid-operation approval and bundled cross-platform CLI binaries.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化的 TextIn xParse 工具与文档解析 Skill，支持文档解析、缓存内容导航和持久化多文档任务，并集成 AppKey 或 Device OAuth 认证、付费操作审批及跨平台内嵌 CLI。

items.de: A YAPI documentation panel for DeepSeek Harness with search, multi-tab, field tree, and copy features. Needs your own YAPI server and account.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 YAPI 接口文档面板，支持搜索、多标签、字段树与勾选复制。需自备 YAPI 服务与账号。

items.de: E-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness — product search, comparison and checkout across Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo, via the yuantoutao Streamable HTTP MCP server.
items.dz: 电商插件——一个 MCP 给你的 AI 加上商品搜索、比价与购买能力，覆盖淘宝/京东/拼多多，商品目录由源头淘 MCP 服务提供。

items.de: YuShe, a Dafeiyu (big fat fish) virtual pet for DSH: a guided visual setup hatches an AI fish girl with her own personality (15 species, 16 poses each, 200 stat points you allocate), who chats with you, answers in the workspace you bind her to, browses Bilibili on her own account and grows from what
items.dz: 鱼社 · 大肥鱼虚拟养成系统：可视化引导一键领养一条有性格的 AI 鱼（15 种鱼、每位 16 个姿势、200 点五维由你分配），她陪你聊天、在绑定的工作区里替你干活，用自己的 B站号刷视频、学东西、按经历成长，每天写打算和日记、写信、配好生图 API 后拍照片回来；她对外发的每句话都先过本地闸门。

items.de: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.
items.dz: 把已安装插件的显示名与描述变成简体中文：启动时用 DSH 自带的模型服务翻译缓存尚未收录的插件，再投影 { en, zh } 元数据供 resolveText() 渲染——不改 DOM，也不调用第三方 API。

items.de: Knowledge-planet (zsxq) knowledge base toolkit: sync posts and attachments, extract docx/PDF text and images, rebuild an index, search, and self-check — pure JS, no Python. Requires a Knowledge-planet subscription and its Cookie, pasted into config.json.
items.dz: 知识星球知识库工具集：同步帖子与附件、抽取 docx/PDF 正文与图片、重建索引、检索与自检，纯 JS 无需 Python。需要知识星球订阅账号，并把订阅 Cookie 写进 config.json。

items.de: Stock workspace for eight markets: watchlists with groups and price marks, quotes, K-line charts and a floating ticker; default data source needs no account. Needs @mzzsfy/dsh-session-manager installed (it loads the shared client library).
items.dz: 股票工作台:八市场自选(分组/置顶/价格标记)、行情、K 线图与悬浮盯盘;默认数据源免注册,页面状态不随会话切换销毁。需同时安装 @mzzsfy/dsh-session-manager(代挂公共 client 依赖)。

items.de: Turns every .pluginlet file under a repo's .dsh/pluginlets/ (directories configurable) into its own sandboxed Conversation View tab, gated by a capability grant bound to the file content hash.
items.dz: 把仓库 .dsh/pluginlets/（目录可配置）下的每个 .pluginlet 文件变成独立的沙箱会话视图标签页，权限按内容哈希绑定。

items.de: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
items.dz: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

items.de: Plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar catalog tab plus agent tools (mp_search, mp_similar, mp_details, mp_install, mp_trending) backed by dsh-plugins-mp.com.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 内的插件市场：侧边栏目录标签页加一组代理工具（mp_search、mp_similar、mp_details、mp_install、mp_trending），数据来自 dsh-plugins-mp.com。

items.de: Manages reusable agent role templates (job prompt, model and reasoning effort, tool allowlist, skills) and starts role members through the native Agent Team interface to delegate and continue tasks.
items.dz: 管理可复用的智能体角色模板（职责提示词、模型与思考强度、工具白名单、Skills），并通过原生 Agent Team 接口按角色启动成员来分发任务和继续对话。

items.de: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
items.dz: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

items.de: Native DeepSeek Harness panel for local CLIProxyAPIPlus with Qoder and Codex authentication, quota views, automatic provider and model catalog sync, YAML editing, service control, request trends, and runtime logs.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理本地 CLIProxyAPIPlus，支持 Qoder、Codex 认证与额度查询，自动同步模型供应商及模型列表，并提供 YAML 编辑、服务启停、请求趋势和运行日志。

items.de: Windows-only sidebar panel that watches the CPU and IO of your AI desktop apps' process trees and shuts the machine down once all of them have been idle for a configurable time, with a cancellable countdown, a dry-run mode and an activity log; requires Python 3.10+.
items.dz: 仅 Windows 的右侧栏面板：按整棵进程树的 CPU / IO 判断 AI 桌面工具是否还在工作，全部安静指定分钟数后关机，带可取消倒计时、演练模式与活动记录；需要本机 Python 3.10+。

items.de: AlertManager panel in the DSH sidebar: reads multiple AlertManager HTTP API v2 instances in parallel, aggregates their alerts into severity-colored cards filterable by search, state, severity and instance, and dispatches any selection into a new session in a chosen workspace; the instance-grouped al
items.dz: DSH 侧栏的 AlertManager 告警面板：并行读取多个 AlertManager HTTP API v2 实例，把告警聚合为可按搜索 / 状态 / 级别 / 实例筛选的严重度卡片；勾选任意告警并选择工作区后一键新建会话，把按实例分组的告警作为首条消息发给 agent 立即处理。支持每实例独立鉴权与 TLS、自动刷新，以及可配置的派发提示词。

items.de: Adds a pin button to the left of the Windows caption buttons that keeps the DSH window always on top of the desktop.
items.dz: 在 DSH 标题栏右上角的最小化键左侧新增图钉按钮，点击后窗口始终置于桌面最顶层。

items.de: Approval reminder: an in-page card with Allow once / Reject when a session waits for permission, plus optional desktop notification, sound and phone push through PushPlus, ServerChan, ntfy, WeCom or a custom webhook.
items.dz: 审批提醒：会话等待权限时在页面右下角弹出提醒卡，可直接「允许一次」/「拒绝」，并可发桌面通知、提示音，或通过 PushPlus / Server酱 / ntfy / 企业微信机器人 / 自定义 webhook 推送到手机。

items.de: External @ file references: extends the Web GUI `@` completion so it can browse and reference absolute-path files and directories outside the workspace, level by level (`@/`, `@~/`), inserting the absolute path (quoted when it contains spaces) for the model to read. Toggleable in Settings; when off,
items.dz: @ 文件引用增强：扩展 Web GUI 的 `@` 补全，使其可逐级浏览并引用工作区外的任意绝对路径文件 / 目录（`@/`、`@~/`），选中后插入绝对路径（含空格时自动加引号）供模型读取。可在「设置 → 插件」中开关，关闭后与原生补全一致。默认开启，模型对这些路径的读取不受沙箱限制；只支持 POSIX 风格的绝对路径（不支持 Windows 盘符）。

items.de: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.
items.dz: DSH 对话结束提示音：内置网络热梗原声（你干嘛哎呦、鸡你太美、神鹰哥等），设置面板可试听/切换/随机，支持自定义音频目录。

items.de: Talk to DeepSeek Harness from Feishu / Lark. A chat maps to a DSH session, messages become turns and answers are pushed back as cards; questions, permission requests, model switches and conversation switches are interactive cards, and inbound files and images are downloaded into the workspace.
items.dz: 在飞书里跟 DeepSeek Harness 对话。一个会话对应一段 DSH 会话，消息变成一轮对话、回答以卡片推回；提问、权限审批、切模型、切会话都是可点卡片，入站的文件与图片自动下载到工作区。

items.de: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.
items.dz: 按 Ctrl+I 把光标送回会话输入框；可在设置里改键，桌面端窗口内任意区域都生效。

items.de: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
items.dz: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

items.de: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
items.dz: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

items.de: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible relay that forwards DSH chat requests to grok.online, exposing its two chat models in the model picker without an API key.
items.dz: 在本机跑一个 OpenAI 兼容反代，把 DSH 的对话请求转给 grok.online，无需 API key 即可在模型选择器里用它的两个对话模型。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to 1.1.1.1:8000
uses literal IP 3.3.3.3 for network access

items.de: Talks to the two public Hugging Face Spaces (MiniMax-VL-01 and Llama-2-7B-Chat) that grok3ai.org only embeds in an iframe, presenting them as OpenAI-compatible models.
items.dz: 直连 grok3ai.org 仅用 iframe 嵌进去的两个公开 Hugging Face Space（MiniMax-VL-01 与 Llama-2-7B-Chat），当作 OpenAI 兼容模型使用。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to 1.1.1.1:8000
uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

items.de: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
items.dz: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

items.de: Signs in to ima.qq.com (Tencent IMA) with a WeChat QR code and runs a localhost OpenAI-compatible relay in front of its SSE chat endpoint, so the four models behind it appear in the picker.
items.dz: 微信扫码登录 ima.qq.com（腾讯 IMA），在本机起一个 OpenAI 兼容反代，把请求翻译成它的 SSE 对话接口，让背后的四个模型出现在模型选择器中。

items.de: LAN access for the harness process: writes the authenticated links for the harness port, one per local IPv4 address, to a token file and registers DSH_LAN_LINK in the shell environment, and can run a gateway on a fixed LAN port that holds the browser session on this machine, so devices need no token
items.dz: 把当前 harness 进程的局域网访问交给其他设备：把 harness 端口的已认证链接按本机 IPv4 地址写进一个 token 文件，并在 shell 环境注册 DSH_LAN_LINK；可选的网关在固定局域网端口上对外服务，会话凭据留在本机、设备不需要 token，转发时重写 Host 与 Origin 以通过宿主的同源校验，并注入主机声明让页面按完整桌面界面渲染而不是远程访客模式。设备按 CIDR 放行，可选 Basic 认证。

items.de: Signs in to LightVela by WeChat QR code, reads the model gateway key from your own instance and writes the gateway into llm-pi-ai so its models appear in the picker.
items.dz: 微信扫码登录 LightVela，从你自己的实例里读出模型网关凭据并写进 llm-pi-ai，让套餐里的模型出现在模型选择器中。

items.de: Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.
items.dz: 把 DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ 内置的 MCP 服务器注册进 DSH，让 agent 能通过 Resolve 的脚本 API 操作达芬奇。

items.de: Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.
items.dz: 把 FilmLight 官方的 FLAPI MCP（flapi-dev-mcp）注册成 DSH 里的 MCP 服务器，让 agent 能编写并运行 Baselight / Daylight 的 FLAPI 脚本。

items.de: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
items.dz: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

items.de: Backup and restore for dsh-mnemon: pick any of its three memory components (memory spaces, project documents, runtime memory) and archive them to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV, then browse the archives and restore a chosen subset. Live SQLite databases are copied through node:sqlite backup() so a
items.dz: 给 dsh-mnemon 做备份与恢复：它的三类记忆组件（记忆空间、项目档案、运行时记忆）可任选，打包到 S3 兼容存储或 WebDAV，之后可浏览备份列表并只恢复选中的部分。SQLite 库经 node:sqlite 的 backup() 在线复制，写入方同时写也不会撕开副本；每个文件带 SHA-256，上传前校验一次、恢复前再校验一次；恢复默认只做预览，写回数据库前会先删掉残留的 -wal/-shm。备份文件名是 mnemon-sync-<设备名>-<时间戳>.zip，多台机器备份到同一目录也能分辨来源。定时器只有一个，间隔从每小时到每周；凭据存在 DSH profile 之外的 0600

items.de: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

items.de: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
items.dz: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

items.de: Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
items.dz: 给工作区会话行补一个手动「标记为未读」；官方支持同能力后自动退休。

items.de: Adds a Print action next to Copy that opens a preview and prints the assistant message.
items.dz: 在复制按钮旁增加打印操作，预览后调用系统打印助手消息。

items.de: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connec
items.dz: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

items.de: Windows only; needs PowerShell and the bundled install.ps1. Adds an interface menu to the left of the model selector with three actions that run immediately: reload the interface, restart DSH, and close DSH. The Windows build ships no built-in reload or restart entry, so this adds one.
items.dz: 仅 Windows，需 PowerShell 与附带的 install.ps1。在模型选择左侧加一个「界面」菜单：刷新界面、重启 DSH、关闭 DSH，三项都即点即执行；Windows 版 DSH 没有内置的重载或重启入口，这里补上。

items.de: Literature search tools for DeepSeek Harness: four model-facing tools — paper_search, paper_get, paper_citations and book_search — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall.
items.dz: DSH 学术检索工具：四个模型可用工具 paper_search / paper_get / paper_citations / book_search，覆盖 OpenAlex、arXiv、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed 五个库，并用 Unpaywall 解析开放获取 PDF。

items.de: Adds three actions to the sidebar session row menu: open the workspace location, move the session to another workspace, and delete the session to the Recycle Bin.
items.dz: 给侧栏会话行菜单补上三项操作：打开工作区位置、移动到其它工作区、删除会话（进回收站，可撤销）。

items.de: Displays DeepSeek and MoonShot API balances, Codex remaining quotas, and estimated local daily API spending in the DSH sidebar.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏显示 DeepSeek、MoonShot API 余额、Codex 剩余额度及本机今日估算消费。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.
items.dz: DSH Web 侧边栏布局修正：给插件动作区限高并允许滚动、缩小内联配对二维码、收紧品牌行——底部插件变高时，工作区与会话列表依然点得到。

items.de: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
items.dz: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

items.de: SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.
items.dz: DSH 的 SSH 主机管理插件：浏览 ~/.ssh/config，保存 AES-256-GCM 加密密码，执行批量命令与 SFTP，并在可保持的侧边栏标签页中打开交互式 PTY 终端。

items.de: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
items.dz: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

items.de: Injects your own text into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt as real system sections from a sidebar editor: each section lands after the persona, after the tool docs, or at the very end of the prompt, can be switched on or off, and can resolve {{variables}}; a preview runs the host's own assemble a
items.dz: 把你的文字作为真正的 system 段落注入 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：侧栏编辑器里为每段选择落点（人格之后、工具说明之后，或提示词最末尾），逐段启停，可解析 {{变量}}；预览调用宿主真实的 assemble 与 render，看清下一个请求实际发出的提示词，并标出空段、重复行、未知变量与超长段落。

items.de: iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.
items.dz: 面向 macOS Apple Silicon 上 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 iOS 远程控制插件，支持配对、审批通知与设备撤销。

items.de: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

items.de: A switchable WebGPU black-hole theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that retains the built-in Dark palette and animates only the new-session background.
items.dz: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的可切换 WebGPU 黑洞主题：沿用内置深色配色，仅在新会话页面显示动态背景。

items.de: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_
items.dz: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

items.de: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leav
items.dz: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

items.de: One stylesheet plus two small DOM patches that line third-party sidebar entries up with the host: matching row height, padding and icon size, one consistent active background, and mutual exclusion so the cron panel and the host panels never overlap.
items.dz: 一张样式表加两个很小的 DOM 补丁，把第三方侧栏入口拉回与宿主一致：行高、内边距与图标尺寸对齐，选中底色统一，并让定时任务面板与宿主面板互斥、不再互相覆盖。

items.de: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
items.dz: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

items.de: Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.
items.dz: DSH 会话任务结束后自动把结果原文推送到微信（iLink 直发，真实校验送达，失败如实报错）。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程——一个需要另外安装并扫码登录微信的独立进程。

items.de: Continue an existing PC DSH session from WeChat: polls WeChat iLink messages, injects into a running session via followup or resumes a closed one, and sends the reply back. Supports /会话 to list/bind sessions and /新会话 to unbind. Requires the wechat-acp daemon; only allowlisted WeChat senders are hand
items.dz: 用微信继续 PC 端未完成的 DSH 会话：轮询微信 iLink 消息，运行中的会话直接注入、已关闭的自动续接，回复原文发回微信；支持 /会话 列出与绑定会话、/新会话 解绑。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程；仅处理发送者白名单内的微信用户，未配置白名单时拒绝所有人。

items.de: Adds a per-session Standard/Fast switch; when the administrator fills in provider, source and target URLs, a loopback proxy injects service_tier priority into matching Responses requests and forwards them to that target.
items.dz: 提供会话级 Standard/Fast 档位切换：管理员填齐 provider、源地址与目标地址后，由本地回环代理为匹配的 Responses 请求注入 service_tier priority 并转发到该目标。

items.de: Sends DSH task summaries and host event alerts (approval, question, plan confirmation) to a saved Feishu recipient, with an enable switch, quiet hours, and status/test/configure tools.
items.dz: 把 DSH 任务摘要和宿主事件提醒（审批、提问、计划确认）发送到已保存的飞书接收方，提供启用开关、免打扰时段以及状态查询、测试与配置工具。

items.de: Adds a sidebar music browser with multiple public sources, persistent background playback, queue advancement, and reviewed MusicFree-compatible source extensions.
items.dz: 提供多公共音源的侧栏音乐浏览、持续后台播放、队列续播，以及经审核安装的 MusicFree 兼容音源扩展。

items.de: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds CodePen, Pinterest, Z-Library, and GitHub data cards to the native @ reference menu, with Pinterest pagination and Z-Library sorting.
items.dz: 在原生 @ 引用菜单中提供 CodePen、Pinterest、Z-Library 与 GitHub 数据卡片，并支持 Pinterest 分页和 Z-Library 排序。

items.de: Right-sidebar Reference Links tab that collects every http(s) URL from a conversation, with pins, per-link turn counts and a click-through list of the turns that mentioned it, search, manual renaming, single-link or whole-host hiding, and a Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L shortcut. Titles come only from the conver
items.dz: 右栏「参考链接」标签页：汇总对话里出现的全部 http(s) URL，支持置顶、每条链接的轮次统计（可点开查看具体轮次并跳转）、搜索、手动改名、隐藏单条或整个主机，以及 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L 快捷键。标题只来自对话本身（Markdown 标签、联网搜索结果的标题、抓取到的页面标题），不做远程标题抓取，也不调用模型。

items.de: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
items.dz: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

items.de: Turns a stated rule into a checkable intake card and writes it into the right AGENTS.md, and keeps project plans, a rule ledger, project records, handoffs, a change log and a timeline.
items.dz: 把一句话的要求做成可核对的规则卡并写进对应的 AGENTS.md，同时统管项目档案、计划、交接、改动账本与时间线。

items.de: Slims PTC SDK tool definitions to plugin-level summaries and tool names, then returns the full visible tool pack when the model calls unwrap with an exact plugin ID, without changing scope or permissions.
items.dz: 在 PTC 会话中把工具定义精简为插件级简介与工具名，模型以精确插件 ID 调用 unwrap 时返回当前可见的完整工具包，不改变作用域与调用权限。

items.de: A-share holdings contribution card for DeepSeek Harness: today's P&L and portfolio return next to the Shanghai Composite, the top five contributors by P&L with each stock's strength versus the index in pp, and a 15:00 close-summary PNG export with the contributor list, intraday chart and a numbers-o
items.dz: 给 DSH 的 A 股持仓贡献卡：今日盈亏与组合涨跌幅和上证指数并排，按金额列出贡献前五并标出个股相对上证的强弱（pp），15:00 后可一键导出含贡献榜、上证分时图与只陈述数字的自动摘要的收盘小结 PNG。持仓读本地 holdings.csv/holdings.json，行情取自腾讯公开行情接口，不读 Cookie、不碰券商凭据。要求 DSH 0.2.x；浮卡与导出都有 CI 跑的测试覆盖。

items.de: Mirrors a zero-valued Desktop release-age setting into profile policy and removes its Host environment alias to avoid unknown-policy update holds.
items.dz: 将桌面端零等待发布观察期同步到 profile 策略，并移除 Host 环境别名，避免市场更新被未知策略挂起。

items.de: A deliberately small phone remote for a running desktop DSH: allowlisted session read/write, message send and permission approval, host-rendered pages with no build step, QR pairing, and tunnel-URL recovery.
items.dz: 把桌面 DSH 的电话面做成克制遥控器：白名单透传会话读写、发消息与权限审批，页面由宿主直接产出、无构建链，扫码配对，隧道地址变了自动推回手机。

items.de: Patched build of dsh-pocket for DeepSeek Harness: the access password is embedded in the QR code so the phone signs in with one scan, a read-only /dsh-pocket/entry.json endpoint lets the app re-sync the current public URL and password from the LAN, and LAN / Tailscale / Cloudflare routes fail over a
items.dz: dsh-pocket 的增强版：访问密码直接写进二维码，手机扫一次即可登录；新增只读接口 /dsh-pocket/entry.json，手机 App 在局域网时就能同步当前公网地址与密码；内网 / Tailscale / Cloudflare 三条链路按顺序探测、断线自动切换。这是 shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的补丁版，请替代上游安装，不要与上游同装。

items.de: Ports jcode's auto-poke so an idle agent keeps working while its session still has incomplete todos.
items.dz: 把 jcode 的自动催办搬了过来：会话里还有未完成待办时，空闲的 agent 会被推着继续做。

items.de: Read-only linter for AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and plugin prompt files that reports conflicting rules, duplicates, vague qualifiers and dangerous commands with file and line suggestions.
items.dz: 策略体检：只读扫描 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 与插件提示，列出规则冲突、重复、模糊限定和危险命令，并给文件行号与修改建议。

items.de: Pomodoro timer with a sidebar workspace, independent desktop widgets, task tracking, focus statistics, and WebDAV/S3 backups. Desktop widgets require a separate Electron runtime.
items.dz: 番茄钟侧栏工作台与独立桌面悬浮窗，支持任务、专注统计和 WebDAV/S3 备份。桌面悬浮窗需另备 Electron 运行时。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
items.dz: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

items.de: Adds a collectible blind-box layer to a composer-dock pomodoro timer: each finished focus session opens one of 15 items across four rarity tiers, tracked in a 5x3 gallery.
items.dz: 在输入框下方的番茄钟上加一层藏品盲盒：每走完一个专注段开一个盲盒，15 件藏品分四档稀有度，进度记在 5x3 图鉴里。

items.de: Pomodoro timer for the right sidebar: a draggable edge handle whose floating card follows it, one-shot or full cycle counting, and four synthesized alerts including a spoken airport-style announcement.
items.dz: 右侧栏番茄钟：可拖动的边缘把手，浮卡随把手移动；支持单次倒计时与番茄循环两种模式；四种内置提示音可切换，其中机场播报会用语音念出提示。

items.de: Floating Pomodoro dial pinned to the bottom-right of the Harness UI: custom focus, short-break and long-break lengths, a long break that can be switched off entirely, a round counter, and five Web Audio-synthesized alarm sounds with preview, volume and ring duration. No audio assets and no network r
items.dz: 常驻右下角的番茄钟圆盘：专注/短休/长休时长自定，长休可单独关闭，带轮次计数；闹铃为五种 Web Audio 实时合成的音效，支持试听、音量与响铃时长。无音频资源、无网络请求，计时状态刷新后继续。

items.de: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose tasks.
items.dz: 番茄钟搭配四象限任务：专注轮次可绑定任务，桌宠随经验成长并解锁成就，Agent 可开始专注或提议任务。

items.de: A pomodoro timer docked below the composer in DeepSeek Harness, with focus/short/long cycles, a resumable countdown, chime, optional system notifications and bilingual settings.
items.dz: 输入框下方的番茄钟：专注/短休息/长休息循环、可恢复倒计时、提示音、可选系统通知与中英双语设置。

items.de: Session-completion reminders for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar bell with an unread dot, plus system notification, in-app toast and a two-tone chime, each switchable. The toast can be dragged anywhere, subagent sessions can be muted, and the last 24 completions stay one click away.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话完成提醒：侧栏铃铛带未读圆点，系统通知、应用内浮层与双音提示音可分别开关；浮层位置可拖动，可忽略子代理会话，最近 24 条完成记录可一键回到对应会话。

items.de: Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.
items.dz: dsh 原生右侧栏页签：列出本机监听的端口及占用它的进程，并可对每个端口执行打开、复制地址、定位工作目录或结束进程。

items.de: Read-only Linux port, service and Caddy route map: listening sockets with their owning unit or container, a reverse service view, and reverse_proxy liveness checks. Requires iproute2 (ss); docker and a Caddyfile are optional.
items.dz: 只读的 Linux 端口、服务与 Caddy 路由地图：监听套接字及其所属 unit 或容器、反向服务视图，以及 reverse_proxy 存活检查。需要 iproute2（ss），docker 与 Caddyfile 可选。

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 本地凭据脱敏网关的控制面板：网关与小模型健康状态、审计指标、泄密探测沙箱、豁免白名单、加密密钥管理、凭据保护模型入口与部署控制。
