items.de: Rewrites the model-visible copy of system, developer, user, assistant and tool messages into stable HMAC placeholders before a request leaves the machine, while local session logs, the chat transcript and restored tool calls keep real values.
items.dz: 请求离开本机前，把 system/developer/user/assistant/tool 五类消息的模型可见副本改写为稳定 HMAC 占位符；本地会话日志、对话记录与还原后的工具调用仍保留真值。

items.de: Windows-only (Windows 10/11 with PowerShell/WMI) process manager for DeepSeek Harness: monitor child process trees, detect lingering orphan services, diagnose plugin/command attribution, and kill process trees to release file and port locks; DSH core processes are protected.
items.dz: 仅支持 Windows 10/11（依赖 PowerShell/WMI）的 DeepSeek Harness 进程管理：监控子进程树与残留孤儿服务，诊断插件/命令归属，终止进程树以释放文件与端口占用；DSH 核心进程受保护。

items.de: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.
items.dz: 在每条回答旁加「进程」抽屉，用简体中文流式讲解该回合 agent 的思考、工具调用与报错。

items.de: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_mo
items.dz: 只读的 DSH profile 医生：配置树七检（patch 丢字段、死 patch、工具重名、装了没挂载、停更、树 diff、组成解释）加八项生态检查——pnpm store 版本冲突（`dsh plugin add` 报 ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE 的根因）、patch insert 指向不存在的包、断裂的 junction、重复能力插件、孤儿 backup 目录、GitHub 源依赖、npm 发布权限提示、minimumReleaseAgeExclude 缺口。四个 agent 工具，每条 finding 都带修复文案。

items.de: Backs up a DSH profile's text configuration to an unlisted secret GitHub Gist, and syncs it back on another machine: a settings page with three buttons (status / upload / sync), a config_backup agent tool, a reversible merge-style restore, and credential stores, binaries, lockfiles and local usage c
items.dz: 把本机 DSH profile 的文本配置备份到不公开列出的 secret GitHub Gist，并在另一台机器上同步回来：设置页只有三个按钮（状态／上传／同步），另有 config_backup 工具；恢复是合并式的、可撤销；凭据库、二进制文件、锁文件与本机用量计数不进入备份，并在界面上逐项列明。需要带 gist 权限的 GitHub 令牌（DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN、GITHUB_TOKEN 或已登录的 gh CLI）。文件按原文上传、不做脱敏，写进 cordis.patch.yml 或 .npmrc 的密钥会进入 Gist，任何拿到链接的人都能读。

items.de: Exports selected DSH plugins as one pasteable share code, applies the delta on another machine, and reports which credentials still need configuring.
items.dz: 把勾选的 DSH 插件导出成一条可粘贴的分享码，在另一台机器上应用差量，并列出仍需补齐的凭据。

items.de: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touch
items.dz: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

items.de: Makes the agent narrate progress during long tool chains instead of staying silent until the final answer: a standing system-prompt rule that travels with every request, plus a notice injected after every N tool calls. A panel on the plugin page tunes the cadence, the reminder budget, and both texts
items.dz: 让 agent 在长工具链中途说明进度，而不是一路静默到最终答复：一条随每次请求下发的常驻系统提示词规则，加上每 N 次工具调用后注入的一条提醒。插件页内的面板可调整步频、提醒上限与两段文本，保存即热生效。

items.de: A right-side panel that tells you in plain words what a long-running task has finished, what it is doing right now, and what it will most likely do next — read-only, never touches your session, and you can ask it a question or just chat with it while the task keeps running. Requires the dsh-better-s
items.dz: 在右侧栏用大白话告诉你长任务做完了什么、现在手头是什么、接下来大概要做什么：不是复述思考链，而是攒一段时间或几件大事压成两三句；工具名和报错码都翻成人话。只读不写会话，跑着的时候也能随时问一句，或者随便聊两句。 需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar（面板借用它的右栏）。

items.de: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next model-request boundary, so a long silent tool loop reports what it has done before continuing. A Settings page adjusts the silence threshold
items.dz: 统计「只调用工具、没有向用户输出文字」的助手轮数，在下一次模型请求的边界把一条简短的过程汇报提醒作为可见的用户消息插入，让长时间沉默的工具循环先汇报已完成的工作再继续。设置页可调整沉默阈值（默认 10）、提醒文案、文案语言（en / zh-CN / zh-TW）、是否每再积累一个阈值就再次提醒、是否统计子代理会话，以及启用智能体团队时只提醒 Lead 还是所有成员。

items.de: Host-side progress checkpoints for long DSH tasks. After N minutes or M tool calls the model is nudged to post a one-line progress note and keep working, so you can correct it before it runs far off course.
items.dz: DSH 长任务进度检查点——到点由宿主侧提示模型一边干活一边补一行进度，跑偏能及时纠正；汇报间隔与步数兜底都能在设置页里调。

items.de: Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
items.dz: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

items.de: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
items.dz: 把多个文件夹与会话收纳为「项目」，共享 PROJECT.md 记忆与 AGENTS.md 指令并注入每个会话，附带项目树侧边栏。

items.de: Project Atlas: a local-first DSH workbench that gives every project a readable name and one-sentence intent, merges duplicate project folders after confirmation, and tidies stale projects without deleting files.
items.dz: Project Atlas：本地优先的 DSH 项目工作台。给每个项目一个看得懂的名字和一句说明；重复项目确认后合并；久未活动项目一键收起，不删文件。

items.de: A numbered tag wall of recent projects in the sidebar: each project is a colored tag with a type logo that unfolds into date, summary, hours, cost and next steps on hover.
items.dz: 侧栏里的项目标签墙：每个项目是一枚带编号和类型图标的彩色标签，悬停展开日期、摘要、工时、费用与后续计划。

items.de: Floating cockpit panel (draggable, resizable, default 400x600) with five tabs — orchestration, matching, cost, signal, graph — aggregating four engines into unified /__dsh/project-cockpit/* webServer routes. Opens via a built-in launcher button; dsh-icon-grid icon is an optional extra entry.
items.dz: 右下角浮动驾驶舱面板（可拖拽、可缩放，默认 400x600），含编排/选题/成本/信号/图谱五个页签，整合四大引擎为统一 /__dsh/project-cockpit/* webServer 路由。内置悬浮按钮即可打开，dsh-icon-grid 图标为可选入口。

items.de: Static codebase analysis for onboarding: scans a project, builds a dependency graph, and writes evidence-cited architecture, module, key-flow and getting-started docs, plus project-level Q&A over a local retrieval index (no network or LLM by default; LLM narrative is optional and off unless enabled)
items.dz: 项目罗盘 — 静态扫描代码库并构建依赖图，生成带 path:line 证据引用的架构、模块、调用链与上手指南，并基于本地检索索引提供项目级问答（默认不联网、不调用 LLM，LLM 叙事为可选项，需手动开启）。

items.de: An agent preset that turns a one-line idea into requirements, tech plan and maintenance baseline — every step is restated and confirmed by you before proceeding. No scenario presets: 73 atomic skills (6 master skills + a verify dispatcher + 66 sub-skills) load by context.
items.dz: 「想法落地」agent preset：一句话想法 → 需求规格 → 技术方案 → 维护基准；每一步先复述、你确认、再继续。无场景预设：73 个原子 skill（6 主 + verify 调度 + 66 子）按上下文加载。

items.de: A project kanban in the dsh sidebar. Every project gets its own section with four fixed columns (todo, in progress, feedback, done); add, rename, recolor, reorder and delete projects and tasks, advance a task with one click, reorder by drag and drop or with the card menu, undo a deletion, and collap
items.dz: dsh 侧边栏里的项目看板。每个项目一个区块，固定四列（待办 / 进行中 / 待反馈 / 已完成）：新建、重命名、换色、排序、删除项目和任务，点一下把任务推到下一列，拖拽或卡片菜单调整顺序，删除可撤销，项目可折叠。点开项目还有一个「数据与结果」页：左边数据树、右边结果树，可拖拽整理、合并成章节、连线看出结果来自哪份数据；节点可加星标并「只看星标」，让结果之间互相关联，按类别给节点和连线着色，支持撤销 / 重做（Cmd+Z）。颜色、圆角和阴影取自 dsh 主题变量，跟随浅色 / 深色，宽度不够时从四列变两列再变单列。

items.de: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

items.de: Discover and run project tasks through Harness Jobs, inspect run receipts, and check project configuration with an Agent tool.
items.dz: 通过 Harness Jobs 发现和执行项目任务，检查运行回执，并使用 Agent 工具诊断项目配置。

items.de: Low-code project workspace for the DSH web UI. A multi-level file tree with a push-status ledger, in-panel source view and edit, pre-push static checks, and a scaffold for an empty workspace. Requires the MagicalCoder platform and a server profile (address + designer account) for push/pull.
items.dz: 把低代码工程目录搬进 DSH Web 侧栏：多级文件树与推送状态账本、面板内源码查看与编辑、推送前静态校验，以及空白工作区一键铺脚手架。推送/拉取需 MagicalCoder 平台与服务器配置（地址 + 设计师账号）。

items.de: Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live colored output, and keeps every run's log on disk where the agent can read it.
items.dz: 分组运行面板：在真 PTY 里一键启动项目服务，实时彩色输出，每次运行的日志落盘，代理可直接读取。

items.de: Beta: a project supervisor for DeepSeek Harness — standing rules plus a Web panel (three switches, dispatch modes) that splits a goal into parallel teammate dialogs, checks engineering baselines, interviews new-project requirements and protects beginners. The standing rules come from the repo kit in
items.dz: 测试中：DSH 项目主管——常驻规则 + 「主管」面板（三开关、派发模式），把目标拆成并行对话框，做工程底线自检、新项目需求追问与零基础保护。常驻规则由仓库的 kit 安装器另行写入工作区，是独立的可选步骤。

items.de: Project workspaces for multi-session collaboration, conversation handoffs, searchable chat records, and editable shared memory; automatic memory curation and handoff judgment require two background models (memoryModel and sessionManagerModel) configured in the plugin config.
items.dz: 为跨会话协作提供项目空间、会话接力、可查询的聊天记录与可编辑的共享记忆；自动记忆整理与接力判断需在插件配置里分别指定 memoryModel 与 sessionManagerModel 两个后台模型。

items.de: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
items.dz: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

items.de: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/p
items.dz: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

items.de: Prompt enhancement for the DSH composer, with a model picker that lists the models the host actually offers: a Boost button beside the composer sends the current draft to a model on the Host, shows the rewrite in a before/after overlay, and replaces the draft only when you confirm. While boosting, t
items.dz: DSH 输入框的提示词增强，并带一个列出宿主实际可用模型的下拉选择器：输入框旁的「增强」按钮把当前草稿交给宿主侧的模型改写，以原文/改写对照的浮层预览，只有确认后才替换草稿。增强过程中按钮图标变为旋转的圆弧；替换草稿后同一个按钮就地变为「撤销」，点击即恢复原始草稿并回到初始状态。设置页含启用开关、以分组下拉框呈现的提供商/模型选择（选项来自实时提供商列表，含尚未配置但可激活的提供商，而非自由文本输入）、温度、输出上限、超时与可选的自定义指令。模型返回空内容或只返回推理时给出真实原因而非笼统失败；宿主接口只响应本机同源请求。

items.de: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version
items.dz: 输入框右侧加一个「优化」按钮：把一句话的口语需求改写成结构化产品简报——一句话定位、3–6 条核心功能、视觉参考、设计规范（配色/尺寸等令牌），左右并排对照原文，可接受回填输入框、重新生成一版，或取消保持原文；不占布局、没有设置页，直接调用你已配置的模型渠道。

items.de: Adds a lightning-button menu in the composer tool row that inserts saved prompts at the caret; the four defaults can be edited and stay in the browser.
items.dz: 在输入框工具行加一个闪电按钮菜单，点击即可把常用提示词插入光标处；四条默认提示可自行编辑，只保存在浏览器里。

items.de: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grou
items.dz: 把每次都得重打的那几句话做成输入框上方的胶囊。它们按使用次数自动重排，带 {{占位符}} 的会先弹框让你填，填完才插入草稿。点击是追加而不是替换，写到一半的草稿不会被冲掉。抽屉里可以搜索、分组、编辑，数据存在 Host 侧 JSON 文件里，可以直接手改。

items.de: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
items.dz: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

items.de: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.
items.dz: DSH Web 聊天就地编辑历史提示词：在目标轮次干净分叉会话历史，原样保留图片与附件，并自动归档旧会话。

items.de: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card s
items.dz: 模型选择器左侧的 ✨：把草稿原地改写成可执行的提示词（对标 WorkBuddy），调用在宿主侧完成；多层撤销最多保留 8 版，逐字差异卡标出新增与删除、改动处数与净增字数；增强跟随会话当前模型，草稿为空时自动置灰，调用前做浏览器会话 Cookie 校验。

items.de: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.
items.dz: 在输入框动作行的模型选择器左侧加一颗增强芯片：用当前会话已选的模型就地改写草稿，五种风格，可一键撤销，另有 /enhance 斜杠命令。

items.de: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer: it rewrites the draft into a clearer, more complete task brief, replaces it in place with one-click undo, offers five rewrite styles, and greys out while the draft carries file/command chips.
items.dz: 在输入框的模型选择器左侧加一个星标按钮：把草稿改写成目标明确、细节完整的任务说明并就地替换，可一键撤销；提供五种改写风格，草稿含文件引用 / 命令芯片时自动置灰。

items.de: Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites defa
items.dz: dsh-prompt-enhance 的维护分支，已适配 DSH 0.1.7——此前的版本在当前宿主上甚至无法加载（InputState.imageIds 已更名为 attachmentIds，输入框按钮会让整个输入区崩溃；settings.get() 已被移除；/enhance 读取了 agent 不再暴露的会话 id）。改写默认使用 reasoningEffort off：实测同一段草稿为 252 输出 token，而模型自身默认档要 2897；并内置覆盖全部 17 个字段的设置页。已在真实的 0.1.7-rc.2 宿主上验证：插件激活、真实 HTTP 增强请求、GUI 中 /enhanc

items.de: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
items.dz: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

items.de: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer toolbar: one click rewrites the draft in place through the host and briefly offers an undo that restores the original text. A Prompt Enhancement settings section picks the lane — the conversation model (the provider/model the next mess

items.dz: 一个可折叠的侧边栏组件，纵向堆叠 OpenCode GO、Command Code 与 GLM Code Plan 的套餐窗口，含重置倒计时、充值余额、插件设置页和 /provider-usage 命令。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Domain-routed proxy for DSH fetch traffic: hosts on a force-proxy list always go through the proxy, every other host tries direct first and fails over to the proxy within a second, the first channel to answer is pinned for the session, connections are reused for 120 seconds, and each attempt is logg
items.dz: 按域名分流的 DSH 代理插件：列入「强制走代理」的域名（含子域名）永远走代理，其余域名先直连、1 秒内不通再换代理，先答上的通道在本会话定格，连接复用 120 秒，每次尝试都记录；可让插件安装用的 pnpm/git 子进程也走代理。

items.de: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
items.dz: 启动前与运行时的 HTTP 代理控制：把代理写入 DSH 用户级 .env，让启动器和任何插件加载前的请求也走代理，并在「插件」页用开关同步该文件。

items.de: DSH plugin: a local egress proxy bridge. Hands a credential-free HTTP(S) proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and injects the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed by default: if the upstream fails, traffic is refused rather than falling back to a direct connection. Zero bui
items.dz: DSH 插件：本地出口代理（egress）桥——把只接受无凭据 HTTP(S) 代理地址的消费方，接到需要账号密码的上游代理上，凭据只在需要的那一跳注入；默认失败即断联，绝不降级为直连。零构建、零运行依赖。

items.de: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
items.dz: 把回环 HTTP 中继设为 DSH 的进程级代理路由，让 web_fetch 在 Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip 下正常出网；上游代理不可用时，同一请求内改走直连，1.5 秒探活发现代理恢复后自动切回。
rl: uses literal IP 223.5.5.5 for network access

items.de: Start a local mihomo proxy core on demand and shut it down when idle — no always-on port, no leftover process, no change to the Windows system proxy. Routes through an existing proxy when one is already running. Needs a Clash/mihomo config (subscription, imported FlClash config, or pasted in); the f
items.dz: 按需拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲后自动关闭：不常占端口、不留后台进程、不改 Windows 系统代理设置。已有代理在跑时直接借道它的出口。需要自备 Clash/mihomo 配置（订阅、导入 FlClash 配置或手动粘贴）；首次运行会自动下载约 61 MB 的 mihomo 内核到插件目录。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to connect.rom.miui.com

items.de: Imports a proxy subscription, supervises a local mihomo core (proxy-provider plus a url-test group), and fetches direct-first with automatic proxy fallback and per-host routing memory; exposes one proxy_router tool (status, start, stop, test, fetch, routes, forget).
items.dz: 导入代理订阅并监督本地 mihomo 内核（proxy-provider + url-test 组），取回时直连优先、失败自动切代理并按主机记忆路由；对外只有一个 proxy_router 工具（status/start/stop/test/fetch/routes/forget）。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to cp.cloudflare.com

items.de: Fixes web_fetch failing with "non-public IP address" while Clash, Surge or v2rayN runs in TUN/fake-IP mode: finds your local HTTP proxy by itself, sends web_fetch through it while the proxy is on and directly when it is off, and adds an Auto/Proxy/Direct switch to the sidebar. Model calls are left a
items.dz: 修复开着 Clash / Surge / v2rayN（TUN、fake-IP）时 web_fetch 报 non-public IP address 的问题：自动找到本机 HTTP 代理，代理开着走代理、关了直连；侧栏可一键切换「自动 / 走代理 / 直连」。默认只接管 web_fetch，不影响模型调用。
rl: uses literal IP 192.0.0.170 for network access

items.de: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
items.dz: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

items.de: Lets the DSH Web UI run behind an authenticating reverse proxy, with separate controls for trusted hosts, login bypass, cross-site navigation, local-page trust, and an optional network listener.
items.dz: 让 DSH Web UI 可在带身份验证的反向代理后运行，并分别控制受信任主机、跳过登录、跨站导航、本地页面信任和可选的网络监听器。

items.de: Grades every PowerShell command an agent is about to run before it runs: deletion, overwrite, network download and credential access are four required classes, plus dynamic execution, system and privilege changes. Verdicts are a pure deterministic rule function — no model call, no network, sub-milli
items.dz: agent 要跑的每条 PowerShell 命令，执行前先分级：删除 / 覆盖 / 网络下载 / 触碰凭据四类必测，另加动态执行、系统改动、权限改动。判定是纯确定性规则函数——不调模型、不联网、亚毫秒，另有一条组合升级（下载+执行、凭据+外发直接判高危）。高危会停住这次工具调用等一次确认（面板队列或原生审批），拒绝或超时即不执行；中危只记录不拦。每条命令和它的判定（含脱敏后的命令原文）都追加到本地 JSONL 审计日志。引号里的危险字样当数据不当命令，-WhatIf 尊重空跑，-EncodedCommand 先解码再分析。host + client 双半、零运行时依赖、55 条规则、136

items.de: Ports the pstack agent workflow system to dsh: 58 pstack skills, 23 playbooks, four native tools and five agent presets, with skill routing, role-based model configuration and role-routed subagents.
items.dz: 将 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh：58 个 pstack 技能、23 个 playbook、4 个原生工具与 5 个 agent preset，附带技能路由、按角色分配模型与按角色路由的子代理。

items.de: Community fork of l246804/dsh-pstack (cannot be installed alongside it: same plugin ids and tool names) that ports the pstack workflow system to dsh: 58 skills, five presets, a bundled script runner that works without node on PATH, a doctor for script prerequisites, and a translation layer for the r
items.dz: l246804/dsh-pstack 的社区 fork（与上游不能同装：插件 id 与工具名相同），把 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh 并补齐可用性：58 个技能、5 个 preset、不依赖 PATH 里 node 的脚本运行器、脚本前置检查，以及 Cursor 词汇的翻译层。

items.de: PTC agent preset whose tools.guard refuses tool calls until the session holds an active goal and an in-progress todo.
items.dz: PTC 模式 agent preset：用 tools.guard 拒绝工具调用，直到会话里有进行中的目标和待办。

items.de: Normalizes an omitted or undefined first argument to {} for TypeScript PTC run_code calls, so no-argument tools such as tools.job_list() stop failing with "binding arguments must be lossless JSON".
items.dz: 把 PTC run_code（TypeScript function-body）中省略或为 undefined 的工具首参归一化为 {}，tools.job_list() 这类无参调用不再报 binding arguments must be lossless JSON。

items.de: Adds the parse error line number and code frame to run_code errors.
items.dz: 为 run_code 解析错误补充行号和代码定位框。

items.de: Picks PTC or native tool presentation per task and switches it at runtime for the model or the user.
items.dz: 按任务自动选择 PTC 或标准工具呈现，并支持模型或用户在任务中随时切换。

items.de: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
items.dz: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

items.de: Measured /pua for DeepSeek Harness: every pressure message gets a receipt comparing the last N completed model steps with the next N — tool calls, verification-class steps, repeated-call peak, failed calls and text volume — with a three-way verdict (changed approach / merely restated / no change) an
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 /pua 加效果回执：每次施压都对比前 N 个完整模型步与后 N 个完整模型步的工具调用、验证类步骤、重复调用峰值、失败调用与文本量，判定「改变了做法 / 只是重述 / 无变化」，并按话术排出「今天哪句话真的推动了工作」。带对话视图「回执」面板、/pua 的 list/status/receipts/rank/off 子命令、本地追加式 JSONL（不保存工具参数、内容或 session id）、38 个 node:test 测试与零依赖构建。只报告前后差异，不宣称因果。灵感来自 MichengAI/dsh-pua（代码独立）；注册同名 /pua 命令

items.de: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (m
items.dz: 给插件作者用：写完插件后跑一遍，自动体检整条发布链路，然后给出 GitHub + npm + 市场三步的可照抄命令。 DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM

items.de: Publish any local directory to GitHub from inside a DSH session with a /publish slash command — git init, gh repo create, commit and push. Never force-pushes, never deletes.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话中用 /publish 把本地目录发布为 GitHub 仓库——自动完成 git init、gh repo create、提交与推送；绝不 force-push，绝不删除。

items.de: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.
items.dz: 用拖拽代替点击发送。按住输入框向上拉即武装：松手发送，拖回输入框取消，拖出对话区当场取消。仅响应鼠标与笔。

items.de: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
items.dz: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

items.de: Community fork of kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge (do not install both - both register the same `dsh-purge` row as the `dsh-purge-community` package): the community '破甲' (unrestricted-mode) control for DeepSeek Harness - host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, verified updates, and l
items.dz: kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge 的社区分支（不要与上游同装——两者都以 `dsh-purge-community` 包名注册同一个 `dsh-purge` 行）：DSH 的社区「破甲 / 无限制模式」控件——宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、校验更新与本机备份回滚，另加引擎层/代码层/提示词层三层 bootstrap 安装器及自带验证流程。

items.de: Adds permanent delete to the session menu: removes the session log files from disk, or deletes a whole workspace together with all of its sessions through the host registry. Also ships a /purge command. Unrelated to the prompt-patching dsh-purge plugins also listed here, but it uses the same dsh-pur
items.dz: 在会话菜单中加入彻底删除：把会话日志文件从磁盘移除，或经宿主注册表删除整个工作区及其全部会话；另提供 /purge 命令。与本列表中其他同名 dsh-purge（提示词补丁类）插件无关，但使用相同的 dsh-purge 行 id 和 /purge 命令，请勿同装。

items.de: Multi-channel push notification plugin supporting Bark (iOS) and ntfy (Android/iOS/Web/Desktop) for turn completion, approvals, questions, and quota halts.
items.dz: 多渠道推送通知插件，支持 Bark (iOS) 与 ntfy (全平台)，覆盖回合结束、操作授权、交互提问及额度耗尽异常停机。

items.de: Privacy guard for git workflows: before git commit, git push or gh repo sync it scans the content that would enter git (local paths, user info, API keys, private keys, connection strings) and blocks anything not approved in the DSH approval UI; approved items go into a manageable, masked whitelist.
items.dz: DSH 提交/推送前隐私检查：在 git commit、git push、gh repo sync 前只读扫描将要进入 git 的内容（本地路径、用户信息、API Key、私钥、连接串等），未授权内容不会上传；命中时通过 DSH 审批面板授权，授权项进入可管理的掩码白名单。支持原生 DSH Config（设置页热改开关）、首次推送全仓扫描、fail-closed，零 npm 运行时依赖。

items.de: Phone push for DeepSeek Harness: hooks the question seam in-process so a pending question reaches your phone through an ntfy relay; an answer sent from the phone is fed back to the agent as a user message, which requires `tool-ask-user` to run in `mode: timed` — with the shipped default (`mode: lega
items.dz: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

items.de: Counts the prompts you send in the Web GUI and turns them into a push-up debt, shown as a chip under the composer with one-click pay-off, partial payments and a day streak.
items.dz: 统计你在 Web 界面中发送的消息并换算成俯卧撑欠账，在输入框下方以计数器显示，支持一键结清、部分还款和连续天数记录。

items.de: Manage Proxmox VE through conversation: 116 read + 116 write tools covering VMs, containers, storage, nodes, clusters, backups and firewalls, with API-token or username/password (ticket) auth.
items.dz: 通过对话管理 Proxmox VE：116 个只读 + 116 个写工具，覆盖虚拟机、容器、存储、节点、集群、备份与防火墙，支持 API Token 或用户名密码（ticket）鉴权。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so
items.dz: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

items.de: Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.
items.dz: 接管你桌面上已有的浏览器 PWA 快捷方式（保留原图标），双击即静默拉起 dsh web 并以应用窗口打开界面；网页右上角提供重启与 dsh 自助升级（失败自动回滚）两个控件。仅 Windows。

items.de: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption
items.dz: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

items.de: Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.
items.dz: 质控套件：agent 编辑 TypeScript 后自动回喂 tsc --noEmit 诊断，另含 /code-review 命令（五镜头并行审查 + 置信度评分）；吸收合并 dsh-code-check 与 dsh-command-code-review。

items.de: Nine model-facing tools over the qBittorrent WebAPI v2, with confirm-gated mutations and an orphan-torrent diagnostic.
items.dz: 基于 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 的九个模型侧工具，写操作需显式 confirm，并提供孤儿种子诊断。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.
items.dz: 将 QBoson Kaiwu 的 Ising 矩阵求解能力作为 solve_ising Agent Tool 接入 DeepSeek Harness。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a more executable prompt in place. Ships four built-in presets spanning light polish to aggressive expansion, accepts user-defined presets, and switches preset, prompt model and reasoning effort directly from the button without leaving
items.dz: 输入框旁的按钮：把当前草稿原地改写成更可执行的提示词。内置四档预设，从轻润色到激进扩写，并支持自定义预设；预设、提示词模型与思考强度都能直接在按钮上切换，不用离开输入框。草稿有内容时按钮才出现，增强期间在按钮上计时，失败会显示原因并可重试。

items.de: Unofficial QQ bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (requires a NapCat/OneBot v11 endpoint): editable persona, per-user memory with condensing, session rotation with summaries, image and Bilibili video understanding, sticker library, slang and catchphrase learning, favorability, group management, reminder
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方 QQ 机器人插件（需要 NapCat/OneBot v11 端点）：可编辑人设、按人记忆并自动压缩、会话轮换带摘要、看图与 B 站视频理解（字幕/逐帧画面/弹幕/热评）、表情库、黑话与口头禅学习、好感度、群管理与定时提醒、跨群发消息，以及内置网页控制台。默认全拒：配置 QQ 用户/群白名单前不回复任何人。基于 dsh-onebot 衍生，不能与 dsh-onebot 同装（都注册 /onebot/api 并抢同一个 NapCat 的消息）。视频逐帧画面需本机装有 ffmpeg。
rl: uses literal IP 0.0.0.1 for network access

items.de: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.
items.dz: 把乾元 MCP 服务器挂进 DeepSeek Harness：一个纯配置层 bundle 带来 15 个 agent 记录工具（坑库、成果缓存、身份、任务板），注册为 mcp__qianyuan__*。不含运行时代码；读匿名，写用 ed25519 签名。

items.de: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server, a shared record of pitfalls other agents already hit and results they already produced, plus capability lookup. Exposes 13 tools named mcp__qianyuan__*. Reads are open and need no key.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入乾元 MCP 服务器——其中存着其他 Agent 已经踩过的坑与已经跑出的结果，并提供能力检索。共暴露 13 个工具，名为 mcp__qianyuan__*。读取开放，无需密钥。

items.de: Qingshi diary and family-tree assistant: reads and writes career records, resolves relatives by kinship term, and drives the real H5 pages in a desktop window.
items.dz: 青史日记与族谱助手：读写生涯记录、按称谓倒推亲属关系，并在独立窗口里操作真实 H5 页面。

items.de: CNC (NC/CNC/G-code) toolpath recognition, 3D display and a large editing view with quote-to-composer for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 数控程序（NC/CNC/G-code）刀路识别、三维显示与大界面编辑，支持代码引用到对话框，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

items.de: QMS NCR, CAPA and 8D tracking with batch and impact assessment.
items.dz: QMS 不合格品、CAPA 与 8D 闭环跟踪。

items.de: Connects Qoder CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with zero user interaction: decrypts local OSCrypt credentials, signs requests with the COSY scheme against the CN gateway, and lists 14 models with free-tier badges.
items.dz: 将 Qoder CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零用户交互：解密本地 OSCrypt 凭据，以 COSY 签名对接国内网关，14 个模型含免费额度标注。

items.de: Connects Qoder models to DeepSeek Harness through the official Qoder CLI over native ACP stdio (no reverse-engineered model API), with qoderclicn (China) having a verified real ACP tool loop; qodercli (international) is selectable but its real inference path is not yet verified. Requires Node.js 22.
items.dz: 通过官方 Qoder CLI 以原生 ACP stdio 接入 Qoder 模型（无需逆向模型 API）；qoderclicn 中国版已通过真实 ACP 工具链路验证，qodercli 国际版可选但真实推理路径尚未验证。需 Node.js 22.18+，并在同一台机器上安装并登录所选 Qoder CLI；插件不安装 CLI、不管理账户。

items.de: Qoder-style workspace mode and branch chips on the session row; picking a branch arms it, and the first message creates a dedicated git worktree and moves the session into it. Windows only: the write grant runs PowerShell Set-Acl; elsewhere Worktree mode reports an error and stays in the main checko
items.dz: Qoder 风格的工作区模式与分支 chip，选择分支即挂起意图，发送第一条消息时自动创建独立 git worktree 并把会话迁入其中。仅 Windows：放行写入依赖 PowerShell Set-Acl，其他平台进 Worktree 会报错并留在主检出。

items.de: Bridges a OneBot QQ bot into DSH: the owner's direct messages open a session on the same home, answers go back to QQ, and files named with \[SEND_FILE: path] are delivered. Needs a OneBot v11 implementation with a forward WebSocket (such as NapCat) and ownerId set in the config, otherwise every mess
items.dz: 把 QQ 接成一条能进来的路：主人私聊一到就地开一个会话（读同一个家、同一份起床包），答完发回去；正文带一行 \[SEND_FILE: 绝对路径] 能把文件送到手机上。需另行运行带正向 WebSocket 的 OneBot v11 实现（如 NapCat），并在配置里填 ownerId，否则所有消息一律忽略；所谓「同一个家」由另装的 dsh-wakeup 提供。另外它会在 127.0.0.1:3002 开一个无鉴权、允许任意跨域的本机状态口，返回主人 QQ 号、登录二维码和最近日志（含来信前 60 个字符）。

items.de: Sends a QQ direct message through a local NapCat (OneBot) instance when DeepSeek Harness asks for permission, after verifying the bot QQ; requires owner/bot QQ ids plus the NapCat endpoint and token, and falls back to a Windows notification when NapCat is unreachable.
items.dz: 通过本机 NapCat（OneBot）在 DSH 弹出权限申请时给主人发 QQ 私信，先校验机器人 QQ；需要配置主人/机器人 QQ 号与 NapCat 地址、token，NapCat 不可用时回退 Windows 通知。

items.de: Local searchable archive of DSH chat history: decodes the multi-frame zstd session logs (thousands of concatenated frames), extracts user and assistant text into SQLite, and exposes sync / search / stats tools. Idempotent imports, no external service, nothing leaves the disk.
items.dz: 把会话日志归档成本地可检索的聊天库：逐帧解码几千帧相接的 zstd 日志，抽取 user/assistant 文本入 SQLite，提供同步/检索/统计三个工具。幂等导入，不依赖外部服务，数据不出本机。

items.de: DSH plugin (fork of sj244/dsh-qq-bridge, MIT) that connects DSH sessions to QQ through OneBot/NapCat. Whitelist stays closed until filled in; @-mentions, nicknames and pokes always wake the model; other messages wake at a configurable probability. Cordis id remains qq-bridge. It keeps the upstream C
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat）的插件（fork 自 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，MIT）。白名单默认全关；被 @、叫到昵称或被戳一定叫醒，其余消息按可调概率抽样。Cordis 插件 id 仍是 qq-bridge。它沿用上游的 Cordis id（qq-bridge）：安装前须先卸载 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，两者不能同装；白名单为空时谁都不会被叫醒。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Bridge QQ (via NapCat) into DeepSeek Harness, turning private and group chats into session prompts and sending replies back to QQ.
items.dz: 把 QQ（NapCat）接入 DeepSeek Harness：私聊和群聊消息变成会话提示词，回复按行发回 QQ。

items.de: QQ bridge for the dsh-memory-agent (Echo) companion: OneBot 11 plus an optional official QQ text transport, bounded group context, file handling and delivery auditing. Requires dsh-memory-agent; the OneBot path also needs a OneBot 11 client such as NapCat or SnowLuma, and the official transport is a
items.dz: dsh-memory-agent（Echo）的 QQ 桥：支持 OneBot 11 与可选的官方 QQ 文字通道、有限群聊上下文、文件处理和投递审计。需先安装 dsh-memory-agent；OneBot 通道另需 NapCat 或 SnowLuma 等 OneBot 11 客户端，官方通道是同仓库里需单独安装的可选包。

items.de: Adds a DSH settings panel for QQ proactive-message dice rolls, showing per-conversation progress, hit statistics and quiet/guarantee countdowns, with editable parameters that apply immediately. Reads from an auto-detected local bridge, a custom HTTP status endpoint, or a built-in demo engine.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置里显示 QQ 主动消息投骰进度：逐会话计数、命中统计、安静与保底倒计时，参数可改并立即生效；数据源支持自动探测本机桥接、自定义 HTTP 接口或内置演示引擎。

items.de: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other DSH plugins.
items.dz: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

items.de: QQbot, QQ机器人 — watches chosen QQ groups over OneBot 11, batches messages by a count threshold, summarizes each batch with a model already configured in DSH, and sends the per-group report to chosen friends as a QQ private message. Messages can be filtered by keyword and by sender; ships a settings p
items.dz: QQ机器人、QQbot：通过 OneBot 11 监听指定 QQ 群，按消息数阈值分批，调用 DSH 已配置的模型总结每批消息，再按群私聊投递到指定好友；支持按关键词与成员过滤消息，带设置页、本地网页控制台与总结归档。

items.de: QQ hub for DeepSeek Harness: private and group chats over OneBot v11 (SnowLuma/NapCat), with per-chat scoped memory, per-chat persona routing, a vision helper that narrates images for text-only models, multi-platform link parsing (large videos sent as group files, image galleries sent inline or as m
items.dz: 把 QQ 接入 DeepSeek Harness：经 OneBot v11（SnowLuma / NapCat）接私聊与群聊，按会话隔离记忆、按会话分流人格，文本模型收图时由辅助模型转述，多平台链接解析（大视频转群文件，图集以图片或合并转发发出），并提供网页管理面板。改自 aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Run shell commands on the host instead of inside DSH, triggered by exact-match QQ messages through NapCat, and DM the result; requires EviMing/dsh-napcat-tools. plus Python 3.10+ for napcat_api.
items.dz: 目的是能远程运行 Shell 命令，而不是让 DSH 运行，适用于需要重复工作或托管行为但不能直接给权限到 DSH 的情况。原理是通过 NapCat 进程与 QQ 进行交互，当 QQ 发送特定消息，判断是否完全相等与哪个键的字符串，并执行对应的 Shell 命令。执行 Shell="执行 Shell 命令：\n文本"。添加新的键值对="增加 Shell 命令：\n{"文本": \["Shell 命令", "使用哪个 Shell (例如 cmd，或 PowerShell) 运行 Shell 命令"]}"，最终会被拼接为 "Shell 命令" 的格式被系统运行，依赖前置插件 "EviMing/ds

items.de: QQ protocol backend for DeepSeek Harness on Linux: boots LinuxQQ and NapCat with the engine (first run installs them, about 250 MB) and exposes a standard OneBot 11 endpoint.
items.dz: 给 DSH 提供 QQ 协议端（仅 Linux）：随引擎启动 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat（首次运行自动安装，约 250 MB），对外提供标准 OneBot 11 接口。

items.de: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin l
items.dz: 给 QQ 那一条线单独装一张嘴：把口径文件挂成那段会话的系统提示段，只挂 QQ，别的线一个字不动；改 md 就生效，不必重装插件。须把 home 指向放有口径文件（默认 QQ线口径.md）的目录才生效；应挂进 QQ 的 preset，而非全局插件列表。

items.de: Waifu mode for QQ: splits every reply into several short chat bubbles with a human-like typing delay, drops trailing periods, and keeps tables and code blocks intact. Works by patching @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot in the desktop profile: run node outbound/apply-patch.mjs once, set im-qqbot streaming:
items.dz: 让 AI 在 QQ 里一句一句发消息：把每条回复拆成几个气泡、按字数给打字停顿、句末不留句号；表格和代码块整条不切。做法是给 desktop profile 里的 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 发送链打补丁：先手动运行一次 node outbound/apply-patch.mjs、把 im-qqbot 的 streaming 设为 false 并重启；在此之前只有 waifu_* 工具可用。

items.de: Read-only QQ Mail over IMAP: list, search, and read messages; the settings page verifies the account before saving. Needs IMAP enabled on the mailbox and its 16-character authorization code (not the QQ password); the server is fixed to imap.qq.com.
items.dz: 通过 IMAP 只读访问 QQ 邮箱：列出、搜索、读取邮件；设置页在保存前会先验证账号。需要在邮箱里开启 IMAP，并使用 16 位授权码（不是 QQ 密码）；服务器固定为 imap.qq.com。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Reads the local NTQQ (QQ 9.9.x) message database on Windows and Linux and exports group and private chat history to txt, csv, json, md, html or sqlite. Ships sixteen model tools: qqnt_status and qqnt_doctor for environment and blocker checks, qqnt_extract_key, qqnt_index to build or inspect the side
items.dz: 读取 Windows / Linux 本机 NTQQ（QQ 9.9.x）消息库，把群聊与私聊的聊天记录导出成 txt、csv、json、md、html 或 sqlite。包含十六个模型工具：qqnt_status 与 qqnt_doctor（环境体检与排障）、qqnt_extract_key、qqnt_index（建立或查看侧车索引）、qqnt_list_groups、qqnt_list_chats、qqnt_search、qqnt_stats（总量与月度统计）、qqnt_export_group、qqnt_export_chat、qqnt_export_batch（可以直接用用户说的名字指代

items.de: Floating phone-pairing QR button for the DSH WebUI. One click opens the dsh-remote-link pairing QR (image + 6-digit code + TTL) in an in-app overlay — works in both browser and DSH Desktop (same-origin img, no iframe).
items.dz: DSH WebUI 右下角悬浮「手机连接」二维码按钮：点击在应用内弹层显示配对二维码、6 位短码与倒计时，浏览器与 DSH 桌面端通吃（同源 img 渲染，无 iframe）。

items.de: Four-quadrant todo manager in the DSH sidebar with month and week calendar views, per-period completion statistics, system notifications and Feishu notifications (the latter needs the DSH Feishu integration), and recurrence rules including Chinese statutory workdays and the Ebbinghaus curve. Derived
items.dz: DSH 侧栏的四象限待办管理器，带月/周日历视图、周期完成率统计、系统通知与飞书通知（飞书需已装 DSH 飞书集成），以及中国法定工作日和艾宾浩斯记忆曲线等重复规则。基于 Natte/dsh-sidebar-todo 0.2.3 大幅改写；不要与上游同装——两者注册同一个 /todo/api 路由并共用同一份 todos.json。

items.de: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure out
items.dz: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed with one command: the bundle installs the settings panel and mounts the engine out of the same package, so both halves come up together. A separate judge call scores the draft against the numbered criteria (0-10 each); any criterion under 6 fails th
items.dz: 动手回合前先过第二个模型的质检，一条命令装完：bundle 同时装上设置面板和同一个包里的引擎，两半一起起来。一次独立判官调用按编号判据逐条打 0-10 分，任一条低于 6 分即判不合格并打回重写，默认最多回炉 3 轮。出厂是演习模式，只把判定写进审计日志、不打回，看过日志再在面板里关掉。Web 面板编辑判据、阈值与判官提示词。

items.de: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice. Observational only; local by default, with optional Jev review.
items.dz: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

items.de: Tracks manufacturing quality issues and 8D improvement projects, analyzes process capability and SPC control charts, and exports reports from a local SQLite database.
items.dz: 管理制造质量问题和 8D 改进项目，分析过程能力与 SPC 控制图，并从本地 SQLite 数据库导出报表。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only in type: book repositories; requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
items.dz: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步章节写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。仅在 type: book 仓库加载；需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

items.de: QUASAR — a space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness: an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk rendered behind the app, with frosted-glass panels. Motion is canvas-driven and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
items.dz: QUASAR — DeepSeek Harness 的太空主题皮肤：侧栏里一颗墨色黑洞，应用背后实时渲染吸积盘，配合磨砂玻璃面板。动效由 canvas 驱动，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。

items.de: Lets a DSH agent ask the user a structured question without blocking the turn: the ask_interactive_question tool returns a pending batch id at once, the answer arrives later as an ordinary user message, and pending batches sit in a browser inbox panel with optional system notifications.
items.dz: 让 DSH agent 提问而不阻塞回合：ask_interactive_question 工具立刻返回待答批次号，答案稍后以普通用户消息送回会话，待答批次显示在浏览器内的待答面板，可选系统通知。

items.de: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

items.de: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes it the current parent, so later selections nest there, Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, dou
items.dz: 对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，右栏问题树就多一个节点，问题直接写在节点下；单击别的节点就把它设为当前节点，之后再划取默认挂在它下面，「Alt + 树形提问」新开根节点，「Ctrl + 树形提问」把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换。划取后点「添加到对话」则把引用以 chip 形式插进输入框，不建节点。节点只存在 localStorage，不进提示词。

items.de: Pressing Enter with an empty composer steers the first queued message into the running turn while the agent is busy.
items.dz: agent 正在处理任务时，输入框空着按回车，队列第一条消息就会插话送进当前回合。

items.de: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering,
items.dz: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

items.de: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
items.dz: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

items.de: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent
items.dz: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

items.de: Context ring gauge in the DSH composer toolbar: view usage, open a breakdown panel, and run /compact from the panel, with a fireworks animation.
items.dz: DSH 输入框工具栏的上下文小环：查看用量，打开面板查看构成并执行 /compact，带烟花动画。

items.de: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框的两个操作：斜杠菜单里的 /new 新建对话且不向模型发送任何内容，对话区按 Shift+Tab 切换计划模式。

items.de: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的悬浮便签本，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片和本地持久化。

items.de: macOS companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The first open downloads Electron 43.3.0 to ~/.dsh/electron; after installing or updating, press ⌘Q (Command + Q) to quit DSH completely and reopen. macOS only. Tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.
items.dz: macOS 下的 DSH Desktop 独立伴生窗：待办、提醒、实时会话消息、审批接管和快速输入；首次打开自动下载 Electron 43.3.0 到 ~/.dsh/electron，安装或更新后需按 ⌘Q（Command + Q）完全退出 DSH 再打开。仅 macOS。已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1、macOS 27 arm64 上验证。

items.de: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
items.dz: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

items.de: One-click page refresh for the DSH Web UI: purges the rebuildable caches (Cache Storage, service workers, /plugins/** bundle bytes) and reloads the page, so a hot-injected client plugin appears without restarting the app.
items.dz: DSH Web UI 的一键刷新：先清掉可重建的缓存（Cache Storage、Service Worker、/plugins/** 的 bundle 字节）再重载页面，热注入的客户端插件立刻生效，无需重启应用。

items.de: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop account menu, with confirmation, progress and failure reporting.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版账号菜单中加入「重启」项，带二次确认、进度与失败原因提示。

items.de: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching your draft.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框底栏放一排可自定义的快捷语按钮：点一下发送「请继续」等快捷语，把卡住的 agent 一键叫醒，且不覆盖你写了一半的草稿。

items.de: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachme
items.dz: 悬浮在任意 DSH 页面上的一键截图按钮（输入框工具行里另有一个）：用宿主侧工具截取 DeepSeek Harness 窗口（按住修饰键可截整个桌面），并把 PNG 放到用得上的地方——直接作为附件落进输入框草稿，没有输入框时放进剪贴板。Windows 实测，另带 macOS/Linux 后端；零依赖、无构建步骤。

items.de: Shortcut buttons in the composer row that send preset text into the current conversation in one click. Button label, size, opacity, shape and payload are editable in place, and the whole group moves left or right of the context meter by right-click dragging, persisted in localStorage. The group take
items.dz: 在输入框一行放一组快捷按钮，点一下把预设文字发进当前对话。每个按钮的名称、大小、透明度、形状与发送内容都可就地编辑；右键拖动整组可在上下文进度左右换位，选择保存在本地。按钮组只占自身宽度，不会挤压上下文进度与用量区域。

items.de: Sidebar panel for background local services: start, stop, restart, remove and inspect each task (status, port, PID, uptime, live log). Tasks are described in the plugin config, so any local service can be managed, and removing a task also drops it from that config. In the default attached mode the m
items.dz: 左侧栏「后台任务」面板：管理需要后台运行的本地服务，一键启动/停止/重启/删除，查看状态、端口、PID、运行时长与实时日志。任务在插件配置里描述，任何本地服务都能接管，删除任务同时把它从配置里移除。默认 attached 模式下 DSH 退出即停服务；另提供对话入口，新会话里预填插件维护说明，由 agent 接手新增服务。

items.de: Translate between Chinese and English without leaving DSH, using your configured models with no extra API key: streaming output, a customizable prompt, and local history to revisit and re-translate.
items.dz: 不离开 DSH 就能中英互译：复用已配置的模型，免填 API Key；译文边生成边显示，提示词可自定义，历史自动存在本地，可随时回看重译。

items.de: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
items.dz: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

items.de: Adds a delete row to the menu of an archived conversation only, and after a confirmation removes the session log directory, its projection cache, the archive and pin marks and the workspace booking together.
items.dz: 只给已归档对话的菜单加一项删除，确认后把会话日志目录、投影缓存、归档与置顶标记、工作区记账一起清掉。

items.de: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
items.dz: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

items.de: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
items.dz: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

items.de: Sidebar video player for DSH: it registers its own right-sidebar tab type, so any video opened through the harness — the Files tab, a chat file reference, another sidebar plugin's file tree — lands in this player. Bytes stream over a Host HTTP Range route (with a tokenized loopback source so the pro
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏视频播放器：注册自己的右侧栏页签类型，因此无论从文件页签、对话里的文件引用，还是其它侧边栏插件的文件树打开视频，都会落到这里。字节走宿主的 HTTP Range 路由流式下发（桌面端另有一条带令牌的回环源，进度条在桌面端也能拖得动），并提供滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、逐帧步进、倍速与音量弹出条，以及覆盖全部控件的内置说明。

items.de: Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows o
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的注意力闸门：把运行事件分成「卡住 / 终态 / 中间进展」三级，只对前两级提醒；专注块内的非阻塞事件一律攒着，块结束时一次性交付。提醒只闪任务栏按钮——不弹通知、不出声、不抢焦点。仅 Windows。

items.de: Compaction backend that replaces the default compaction-basic: it summarizes the conversation with a configurable pool of low-cost models, sizes each chunk to the chosen model's context window, and merges all digests in one call, with per-route cooldown and session-model fallback.
items.dz: 压缩后端，替代默认的 compaction-basic：用可配置的低成本模型池压缩对话内容，按所选模型的上下文窗口切块，并将所有摘要一次归并，支持逐路由冷却与会话模型兜底。

items.de: Edit Markdown in place in the right sidebar and send inline comments to the agent, which resolves each one it handles.
items.dz: 在右侧栏直接编辑 Markdown，把行内评论发给 Agent，处理完自动标记解决。

items.de: Clears four kinds of idle-only system notices (approval policy, working directory, plan mode, plugin changes) that DeepSeek Harness counts as active work, so quitting with no running tasks no longer warns about interrupted work.
items.dz: 清除四类被 DeepSeek Harness 误算为“有任务”的空闲系统通知（审批策略、工作目录、计划模式、插件变更），让没有任务运行时退出不再弹出“任务将会中断”的警告。

items.de: AI quota and usage monitor for DSH: per-window balances, reset countdowns and burn rate for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity (including the Gemini 4 Argon pool) and OpenCode-Go.
items.dz: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：按额度窗口展示 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity（含 Gemini 4 Argon 独立额度池）与 OpenCode-Go 的剩余额度、重置倒计时与消耗速率。

items.de: Persistent bottom bar showing remaining Codex and Gemini quota (weekly and 5-hour windows with reset countdown) and the DeepSeek platform wallet balance. Codex and Gemini values come from accounts already signed in through the dsh-codex-subscription and dsh-gemini-pool plugins; each source can be sw
items.dz: 在主界面底部常驻一条额度状态条：显示 Codex、Gemini 的周 / 5 小时剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 平台账号的钱包余额。Codex / Gemini 的数值来自 dsh-codex-subscription 与 dsh-gemini-pool 里已登录的账号；三个来源可分别关闭，关掉的来源不再发起任何请求。

items.de: Shows ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok Bot remaining usage with reset countdowns plus the DeepSeek balance in a compact card above the sidebar account row; thresholds, refresh interval and per-provider HTTP proxies are configurable. Needs existing sign-ins: Codex CLI login for ChatGPT, an Antigravity token
items.dz: 在侧栏登录名上方以紧凑卡片显示 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok Bot 的剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 余额；可配置阈值、刷新间隔与每个 provider 的 HTTP 代理。需事先具备各家登录态：ChatGPT 需 Codex CLI 登录（codex login）、Gemini 需 Antigravity 登录令牌、Grok Bot 需 Cursor 用户 API Key（CURSOR_API_KEY）、DeepSeek 余额需在 DSH 内登录账号；缺哪项，对应行只显示登录提示而不是数字。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Quota monitor for GLM, MiniMax, Kimi and DeepSeek coding plans — per-window usage, reset countdowns and manual refresh in the Web GUI.
items.dz: GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek 编程套餐额度监控——Web GUI 内显示各窗口用量、重置倒计时并支持手动刷新。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Animated desktop pets, one mascot per coding-plan provider (GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo). Poses follow the running session; moods follow quota usage read from dsh-quota-hub.
items.dz: 动画桌宠，每家编程套餐一只吉祥物（GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek、MiMo）。动作跟随会话运行状态，心情跟随 dsh-quota-hub 的额度用量。

items.de: Quota takeover for DeepSeek Harness on top of Our Free Model: compiles your platform order and pinned model tiers into one ordered fallback chain, skipping platforms that lack the model, sit in cooldown or are out of quota, writes the result back as Our Free Model combos, and after a quota or rate-l
items.dz: 额度接力：在 Our Free Model 之上按你设定的平台顺序与模型档编排一条有序接力链，缺该模型、平台冷却、额度耗尽的格子自动跳过，结果写回 OFM 的 combos；因额度或限流中断后重新编排并向中断的会话补一条「继续」，让回合在下一个平台接着跑，链尾可选聚合渠道兜底模型或 DeepSeek 官方额度。

items.de: Multi-provider quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek official balance, jojo code, SCNet and Ark Coding Plan usage windows in the sidebar footer, with 90 days of local history and trend charts.
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏额度面板：聚合 DeepSeek 官方余额、jojo code 订阅窗口、SCNet 超算用量与方舟 Coding Plan 用量，本地保存 90 天历史并绘制趋势图。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
items.dz: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

items.de: Select any passage in a DSH conversation to annotate it in place; the quoted text, the turn it came from and your comment are folded into the message on send, so the model can tell exactly what each remark refers to.
items.dz: 在对话里划选任意一段文字即可就地批注：原文高亮并带编号角标，发送时把原文、出处（谁说的、第几轮）和你的批注一起折进消息，模型能对上每一句指代。

items.de: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an AstrBot-style management page and a SnowLuma / OneBot v11 QQ channel. Needs Node.js 22.13+; QQ sync needs a running SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP gateway, whose address and access token the plugin looks up in local SnowLuma and qq-bridge co
items.dz: 本地收藏、检索并随机回放群聊语录，自带管理页，可通过 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 通道采集与回发。需要 Node.js 22.13+；QQ 同步需要运行中的 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP 网关，插件会从本机 SnowLuma 与 qq-bridge 的配置文件里查找网关地址和访问令牌。

items.de: Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; the quote waits in a Chat quotes chip on the composer (never inside the draft), expands on hover into selected text and your comment, and folds into the message only when you send.
items.dz: 聊天引用：选中消息文字即可引用或评论；引用收在输入卡顶部的「聊天引用 N」芯片里，悬停展开所选文本与用户评论，发送瞬间才进入消息正文。

items.de: Quote and reply the way Claude Code does it: select text, answer it in a popover, stack the pairs as blocks above the composer, send them as one message.
items.dz: 选中对话里的文字就地引用回复，问答变成输入框上方的方块，一次发出。

items.de: Select text in the chat transcript, right-click, and quote it into the composer. The quote travels as an atomic chip and renders as a collapsible card, while the model receives the full block with message role, turn, block index and character range.
items.dz: 在对话里框选文字后右键引用：引用以原子标签进入输入框，发送后显示为可折叠的引用卡；模型拿到的始终是带消息角色、轮次、段落与字符区间的完整引用块。

items.de: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里选中文字，点鼠标旁的「引用」胶囊，选区就变成输入框里的迷你引用条；悬停引用条可看被引用全文。

items.de: Shows your Alibaba Cloud cash-coupon balance - the credit that pays for Qwen and DashScope calls - in the DSH sidebar, with an AccessKey form that keeps the key on your machine.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示阿里云代金券余额（抵扣千问 / 百炼调用的那笔钱），AccessKey 只保存在本机。

items.de: Qwen mode for DSH: manages local GenieX and Alibaba Cloud QwenCloud providers, normalizes thinking and sampling, detects model capabilities, and shows per-turn latency and decode speed. Its bundle patch replaces the permission plugin's preset table with reply-only, read-only, workspace-write and dan
items.dz: DSH 的 Qwen 模式：管理本机 GenieX 与阿里云百炼 QwenCloud 提供商，归一化思考与采样参数，识别模型能力，并显示每轮首字延迟与解码速度。随包补丁会整体替换权限插件的预设表：新增 reply-only 和 read-only，并照原样重列 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access，已有的自定义预设会被覆盖。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Archives the QQ Zone posts you published yourself into a local library, auto-sorted into three columns — thoughts, dreams and reviews (book/film recommendations) — all three of which can be corrected by hand, one column at a time, and undoing a correction never disturbs the other two. Ships a privat
items.dz: 把你本人发过的 QQ 空间说说收进本地库，自动分成「思考/感想」「梦记」「介绍/推荐」三栏，三栏都能人工纠正 —— 逐条改，一条只动它自己那一栏，撤销也不会连累另外两栏。配一个可用口令锁住的私人网页查看器，会把被上游接口截到前 500 字左右的长说明确补回全文，按年月统计字数，并把配图备份到本地离线可读。Cookie 只存在本机。

items.de: Per-project long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a panel to browse, search and edit what each project knows, and a pointer injected after the first user message telling the agent to read the handoff pack. The memory store itself is a local MCP server (Python + SQLite) in the same repository; insta
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层按项目分类的长期记忆：面板可浏览、检索、编辑每个项目记得什么，并在会话第一句后注入一条「去读 handoff pack」的指针。记忆库本体是同仓库里的本地 MCP server（Python + SQLite）；插件从 npm 安装，之后按 README 克隆仓库并配置 MCP，插件会通过 DSH_RAG_ROOT 或常见安装位置找到仓库。上下文包按「稳定基线在前、事实追加在后」排序，用来复用 prompt 缓存。

items.de: Narrow 40px icon rail for the DSH sidebar: panel icons move into a single column so the session list gets the full width, session titles gain a three-level hierarchy, and the DeepSeek account balance sits just above the sidebar footer with today and cumulative spend accounted from balance deltas, pl
items.dz: 把面板图标收进 40px 窄栏、把宽度还给会话列表，会话标题分三级明暗；侧栏底部栏上方常显 DeepSeek 余额，并按余额差值记录今日与累计消费（按数值变色）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, b
items.dz: 轮次导航导轨的系统声音可视化：导轨实时跟随默认播放设备正在渲染的声音律动，提供频谱 / 脉动 / 摆动 / 行波四种运动方式，宿主端用 2048 点 FFT 切出 16 段对数频谱，灵敏度、强度、低频冲击与波速均可实时调节。音频走宿主端 WASAPI 回环采集，因此没有授权弹窗、不用麦克风、不录屏。浏览器半只添加一个属性、一张样式表、若干 CSS 变量和侧栏一行控件，绝不 patch 官方组件；关闭时移除属性、样式表与变量，导轨完全恢复默认样式。仅 Windows。

items.de: Grades free physical and commit memory and refuses heavy tools (shell, workflow, subagent) before the machine thrashes. Also shows in the composer how much of the machine dsh itself is using, including whole-machine CPU.
items.dz: 按可用物理内存与提交内存分级，到线就拦重活（shell、workflow、subagent）。并在输入框旁显示 DSH 自己占用了整机多少资源，含整机 CPU 占比。

items.de: Adds three tools that hand DeepSeek Harness downloads to the Rayburst aria2 engine — rayburst_download, rayburst_wait and rayburst_status. Requires the Rayburst desktop app (aria2-next) installed and running on the same machine; the plugin reads its aria2.conf for the RPC port and secret.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的下载交给 Rayburst（aria2 引擎），提供 rayburst_download、rayburst_wait、rayburst_status 三个工具。需先在本机安装并运行 Rayburst 桌面端（aria2-next），插件会读取它的 aria2.conf 获取 RPC 端口与密钥。

items.de: Resident multi-connection download engine for DeepSeek Harness: seven rdm_* agent tools plus a sidebar download panel, with resumable, SHA-256-verified and bandwidth-limited transfers that survive a kernel or DSH restart.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的常驻多连接下载引擎：七个 rdm_* 智能体工具加侧边栏下载面板，支持断点续传、SHA-256 校验与限速，内核或 DSH 重启后仍可续传。

items.de: Folds REA's 207 reverse-engineering tools (Ghidra / Hopper / IDA backends) into 3 commands plus 6 read-only domain entries: about 5 KB of resident tool text instead of 757 KB. Ships no engines; rea-agents, Ghidra 12.1.x and JDK 21 are installed separately.
items.dz: 把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具（Ghidra / Hopper / IDA 后端）折叠成 3 条命令加 6 个只读域入口，常驻约 5 KB。不代装引擎，需自行安装 rea-agents、Ghidra 12.1.x 与 JDK 21。

items.de: Fork of kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4 (cannot be installed alongside the upstream capability catalog / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea): a REA-focused MCP gateway with three fixed search, describe and call tools, cached schemas, session controls and native DSH result handling. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.
items.dz: 派生自 kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4（不能与上游能力目录 / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea 同装）：为 REA 提供按需 MCP 网关，通过三个固定的检索、参数查看与调用入口访问缓存工具定义，支持会话开关并复用 DSH 原生结果处理。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 或 0.2.2-rc.1，以及能运行 REA 的 Node/npm 环境。

items.de: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the c
items.dz: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏或通过 rea_mcp_toggle 工具开关 rea-mcp 服务器：不用逆向时，170 个 mcp__rea__* 工具 schema 不再随每次请求发送（tools payload 由约 722 KB 降到约 95 KB），REA 子进程同时退出；选择存入 profile 级状态文件，重启后由行级 disabled 表达式恢复。

items.de: One switch that takes an MCP server's tool schemas and its instructions block out of the model context for every agent, live and without a restart, built for the 207 tool schemas REA registers whether or not a task is reverse engineering. A pill in the composer dock, /rea on|off|status|toggle, and G
items.dz: 一个开关，实时把某个 MCP 服务器的工具 schema 与说明块从每个 agent 的模型上下文中移除或放回，无需重启——针对 REA 在任何任务下都会注入的 207 个工具 schema 而做。输入框下方胶囊、/rea on|off|status|toggle 与 GET/POST /rea-toggle/state 三种驱动方式；位置跨重启保持，子智能体在第一步之前就被覆盖。

items.de: Four read-only tools over nine public channels — web, GitHub, V2EX, YouTube, Bilibili, Xueqiu, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter — with reach_search, reach_read, reach_run and reach_channels, and per-channel notes on which paths work without a login. YouTube needs yt-dlp on PATH.
items.dz: 用四个只读工具覆盖九个公开渠道——网页、GitHub、V2EX、YouTube、Bilibili、雪球、LinkedIn、Reddit 与 Twitter——提供 reach_search、reach_read、reach_run、reach_channels，并注明每个渠道哪些路径无需登录即可读取。YouTube 渠道需 PATH 中有 yt-dlp。

items.de: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every
items.dz: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

items.de: Search four free libraries from one window: Project Gutenberg through its OPDS catalog, Shuge through its WordPress search plus the s.shuge.org short links on each book page, and NCPSSD through its Solr-backed endpoint. The Chinese Text Project is deliberately link-only, because its terms forbid aut
items.dz: 一个窗口同时搜四家免费图书馆：Project Gutenberg 走 OPDS 目录，书格走 WordPress 检索再取每本书页面上的 s.shuge.org 下载短链，国家哲学社会科学文献中心走它的 Solr 检索接口。中国哲学书电子化计划刻意只给链接——它明令禁止程序化抓取。两个工具：readbook_search 与 readbook_open，后者给 Gutenberg 和书格的真实下载地址，NCPSSD 只给页面链接。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to opds-spec.org

items.de: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.

items.dz: 长会话阅读层。每条回答的操作行（用量图标左边）常驻一个放大按钮，点开是两栏阅读视图——左栏列出本会话全部轮次（未加载的点了自动补载）并带一个「只填充、不发送」的输入框，右栏把选中的提问与回答放大到 80%–300% 阅读。公式、表格、代码保持真实渲染结果，超宽公式自动缩小、渲染失败安静降级，被截断的轮次会标注「输出被截断，无回答」。

items.dz: 把插件仓库里已有的截图排成一条 6 秒无声循环首屏短片：VP9 webm（保留真 alpha）、压平垫底的 gif、封面帧，外加记录每幕停留与 sha256 的清单。时间轴按构造即精确（整数停留 + 转场之和等于 durationMs，最后一幕转场回第一幕，t=0 与 t=结束同一帧）。零运行时依赖：PNG 编解码基于 node:zlib，自写 SDF 卡片合成器，唯一外部程序是运行时发现的 ffmpeg。带对话视图面板（选图、排序、生成、复制 README Markdown）与一条接受 storyboard.json 的 CLI。

items.dz: 为自定义路由或中转站上手动添加的模型提供按厂商匹配的推理等级选择：根据模型 id、显示名或接口域名识别 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包或 MiMo，只填入该厂商接受的档位，并补上对应请求格式所需的 pi-ai compat 字段，再写回 profile 配置，让「设置 → 模型」里的推理开关自动打开。你手动改过或关掉的模型不会被改动，可在模型设置页的卡片上一键交回插件。

items.dz: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

items.dz: 在 harness 浏览器里做可视化评审：选中任意元素添加评论、实时调整样式并可回滚、在自由画布上批注草图，然后作为结构化上下文随下一条消息发送；每个标注附局部截图，画布批注则合成进整个可视区域的截图（不含滚动区域外的页面）。
