items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

items.de: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own t
items.dz: 只读的 Cordis Inspect provider，让 agent 能看见自己正在驱动的界面：outline() 报告运行中的壳实际渲染了哪些 UI 区域，含占用、几何与当前/历史失败状态；snapshot() 按 slot key 或 CSS 选择器返回某区域的渲染节点树（标签、角色、aria-label、自身文本、几何、计算样式）；failures() 保留「哪些区域渲染失败过、是否已恢复」的历史。寻址用壳为每个 slot 已写好的锚点，无需区域清单，也覆盖以后新增或其他插件贡献的区域。无界面、无工具、无依赖、不发网络请求。

items.de: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memo
items.dz: 本地关系记忆工作台，一切 AI 写入先过确认闸门：AI 提取的记忆与新建的联系人都先进入待确认队列，由用户在界面拍板收录；素材逐字存档，AI 提取时逐条校验原话摘录溯源；已确认记忆聚合为联系人时间线、礼赠时机与往来视图。内置「关系记忆」agent preset 支持对话录入；默认 JSON 存储、可选 SQLite 后端，零生产依赖。

items.de: Adds a relay_check tool that runs relaycheck against an LLM API relay to detect model swaps, misreported usage, truncated context and injected prompts; keys are read from environment variables.
items.dz: 提供 relay_check 工具，用 relaycheck 检测 LLM API 中转是否调包模型、虚报用量、截断上下文或注入提示词；key 只从环境变量读取。

items.de: Reload a plugin or skill you just installed without restarting DSH. reload_plugin clears that plugin's own module cache, unloads the old instance and re-imports it, restoring the previous module if the new code throws; reload_skill forces skill directories to be re-discovered. Ships both as tools an
items.dz: 不用重启 DSH 就能重载刚装好的插件或技能。reload_plugin 清掉该插件自己的模块缓存、卸载旧实例再重新 import，新代码报错时自动换回旧模块；reload_skill 强制重新发现技能目录。工具与 /reload-plugin、/reload-skill 两个命令都有。

items.de: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.
items.dz: 为 DSH 会话提供 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 接口与手机面板：读会话、浏览文件、发送或排队消息，并在手机上处理审批与提问。

items.de: Exposes a DSH Harness Desktop Web GUI to another machine's browser through a Cloudflare quick or named tunnel, an SSH reverse tunnel, or a custom command, and hands out a tokenised link to open it; a settings panel and CLI start, stop and print the link. Needs DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 or later and a c
items.dz: 把 DSH Harness Desktop 的 Web GUI 通过 Cloudflare quick/named 隧道、SSH 反向隧道或自定义命令暴露给另一台机器的浏览器，并给出可直接打开的带令牌链接；设置面板与 CLI 可启动、停止并打印链接。需要 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上，以及 cloudflared。

items.de: Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: expose this machine's DSH Web GUI through an SSH reverse tunnel and a QR gate — scan and enter. Requires your own Linux server with root SSH access plus nginx, openssl and qrencode; it rewrites that server's nginx config, and the QR link is a one-year login secret
items.dz: 远程接入插件：把本机 DSH 经 SSH 反向隧道映射到服务器并生成二维码，手机扫码直进本机 dsh。需自备可 root 登录的 Linux 服务器，并装好 nginx、openssl、qrencode；插件会改写该机 nginx 配置，二维码链接本身是一年有效的登录凭据，请当作密码保管。

items.de: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.
items.dz: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

items.de: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
items.dz: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

items.de: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).
items.dz: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

items.de: Source-filtered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket gateway for using the DSH Web UI behind an authenticated reverse proxy, with loopback trust adaptation, in-app host directory selection, and an allowlisted health endpoint.
items.dz: 带精确来源 IP 白名单的 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 网关，让 DSH Web UI 在带认证反向代理后保持设置、插件与宿主机目录选择功能，并提供白名单健康检查。

items.de: Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.
items.dz: 提供安全的反向代理，使DeepSeek Harness可以远程访问，随时随地和AI对话。

items.de: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.
items.dz: 在会话顶栏显示 dsh-remote 所连服务器还有几张空闲显卡，右侧边栏面板展示每张卡的利用率、显存、温度与占用用户，并提供返回同一快照的 remote_gpu 工具。

items.de: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.
items.dz: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

items.de: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness over an outbound Huawei Cloud DevBridge tunnel: a sidebar seat and a standalone control page start and stop the tunnel and show its public URL, QR code and logs. The plugin's own gateway stays on 127.0.0.1, checks a rotatable access token or HMAC session cookie, r
items.dz: 把本机 DSH 的 Web 界面经华为云 DevBridge 出站隧道交给远端设备远控：侧边栏席位与独立控制页负责开启、停止隧道，并显示公网链接、二维码与日志。插件自带的鉴权网关只监听 127.0.0.1，转发前校验可轮换的访问令牌或 HMAC 会话 Cookie、限制失败次数并剥离外部身份头，因此不开放任何入站端口。隧道默认关闭，令牌与状态只留在本机 ~/.dsh。需要华为云账号与 devbridge CLI v0.2.x。中继会终止公网 TLS，能看到到达网关的明文 HTTP——这是访问控制，不是端到端加密。

items.de: Tunnels the local DSH web panel to a phone or the internet through frp, with QR pairing, TOTP 2FA, device management and an IP blacklist. Windows 10/11 only (macOS/Linux need your own matching frpc); the default hosted mode needs a free account at remote.ymzcc.com and relays traffic through that ser
items.dz: 通过 frp 隧道把本机 DSH Web 面板暴露到手机或外网，带扫码配对、TOTP 两步验证、设备管理与 IP 黑名单。仅支持 Windows 10/11（macOS/Linux 需自备同版本 frpc）；默认官方托管需在 remote.ymzcc.com 免费注册账号、流量经该服务器中转；Windows Defender 可能拦截包内 frpc.exe，需先运行附带的 fix-antivirus 脚本。

items.de: Remote Linux server manager in the Harness Web UI: browse and edit files, inspect host status, start/stop/restart Docker containers, inspect images, configure Docker registry mirrors, manage firewalld/ufw rules, switch apt sources, and detect developer tools or install/upgrade them with apt.
items.dz: 在 Harness Web UI 中管理远程 Linux 服务器：通过 SSH 浏览和编辑文件、查看主机状态、启动/停止/重启 Docker 容器、查看镜像、配置 Docker 镜像加速源、管理 firewalld/ufw 防火墙规则、切换 apt 软件源，并探测常见开发工具或通过 apt 一键安装/升级。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to archive.ubuntu.com

items.de: Sidebar status chip that follows the visible session and shows local or remote with machine name, plus hover diagnostics; never modifies workspace titles.
items.dz: 侧边栏底部状态芯片：跟随当前显示的会话显示「本地」或「远程 · 机器名」，悬停显示诊断信息，绝不改动工作区标题。

items.de: SSH/SFTP remote sites and workspaces: manage connections and remote directories like local workspaces.
items.dz: SSH/SFTP 远程站点与远程工作区：像本地工作区一样管理远程连接与目录。

items.de: Remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick an SSH host in the sidebar, mount a server directory over SFTP as a workspace, then read, write and edit those files with the normal file tools. Remote watch is polled so the file tree refreshes, image/binary previews work through byte-range reads, and re
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的远程工作区：在侧栏选 SSH 主机，通过 SFTP 把服务器目录挂载成工作区，随后用普通文件工具直接读写远端文件；远端 watch 用轮询实现（文件树自动刷新），图片/二进制预览走字节区间读取，remote_exec / remote_search / remote_git 分别提供远端命令、搜索与 git 查询；可选补丁把 agent 自己的 bash/pwsh 命令也路由到服务器；远端写入与命令都遵循会话的 sandbox 模式与审批策略；主机凭据由插件自带的「主机」库维护（密码、私钥或 SSH agent）。

items.de: Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制与移动端覆盖层：局域网与公网（cloudflared）隧道 + 二维码接入、768px 以下的手机端界面，附局域网反向代理 CLI。

items.de: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Renor memory MCP server over Streamable HTTP, using a Renor API key from RENOR_API_KEY, so the model can call Renor's recall and save tools. It is a configuration bundle with no code of its own.
items.dz: 通过 Streamable HTTP 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到托管的 Renor 记忆 MCP 服务器，使用环境变量 RENOR_API_KEY 中的 Renor API Key，让模型能调用 Renor 的检索与保存工具。这是纯配置包，自身不含代码。

items.de: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and junctions under a profile, dead or duplicated plugin rows, and the upgrade path. The scripts are diagnostics first; the rebuild helper only writes
items.dz: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

items.de: Repair order settlement check: item amounts, labour/parts totals and grand total.
items.dz: 维修工单项目金额、工时配件与结算总额核对。

items.de: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
items.dz: 手动重置 AgentRouter Responses 旧回放状态，处理旧会话续聊时的上游资源绑定报错，保留聊天历史；支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.
items.dz: 通过系统提示词强制模型全程使用指定语言回复（默认中文简体），可用工具随时切换。

items.de: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
items.dz: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

items.de: Requirement-to-evidence audit for DSH sessions: maps each requirement to tool calls, files and commands, records per-requirement verification, and sends missing items back to the agent.
items.dz: DSH 会话的需求-证据审计：把每条需求对应到工具调用、文件和命令，逐条记录验证情况，并把缺失项退回给 agent。

items.de: Caps every image sent to a model at a per-side pixel limit (default 2000 px) by wrapping attachments.readImageRequest, which fixes Anthropic many-image request errors without touching stored images.
items.dz: 把发给模型的每张图片按单边像素上限（默认 2000 px）压缩：通过包装 attachments.readImageRequest 实现，修复 Anthropic 多图请求报错，且不改动已存储的图片。

items.de: Standalone rescue for a broken DeepSeek Harness profile: a CLI that runs without DSH diagnoses the crash logs (six classified causes, from real incidents), pre-flights the profile for command-name collisions and files plugins read at construction time, arms a safe mode that loads only official bundl
items.dz: 在 DSH 打不开时救回配置：不依赖 DSH 的命令行工具，把崩溃日志归类（六类原因，全部来自真实事故），启动前预检命令名冲突与插件构造期读取的文件，布防安全模式（只加载官方 bundle，启动正常后自动还原），并保留清单快照供回滚。另有一个常驻守护进程，用操作系统文件事件盯着崩溃日志目录——空闲零开销，加载器一死几秒内写出自检报告，每次崩溃只覆盖一份文件。仅限 Windows：崩溃日志读自 %APPDATA%，守护进程经 Windows「启动」文件夹自启。

items.de: Local-first research toolkit for DSH: registers kb_grep, kb_list, and kb_save model tools. kb_grep searches the markdown knowledge base with ripgrep when present and falls back to grep, while kb_list and kb_save go through the scoped ctx.fs filesystem service; the KB defaults to ~/dsh-kb. The repo a
items.dz: 面向 DSH 的本地优先研究工具包：注册 kb_grep / kb_list / kb_save 三个模型工具。kb_grep 用 ripgrep（没有时回退 grep）搜索 markdown 知识库，kb_list / kb_save 则经由作用域化的 ctx.fs 文件系统服务读写，知识库默认 ~/dsh-kb；仓库另附两个 skill（local-first-research 与 session-memory），需自行复制到 DSH 的 skills 目录，插件包不会安装它们。插件为纯 Node ESM、无 npm 运行时依赖，附无框架的 node 测试。通过 plugin_manage

items.de: Research workflow suite that registers 10 domain skills and 15 tools, curates 450 bundled research skills into 103 capability cards with an auditable per-skill ledger, and takes over research requests automatically through a system-prompt section. Tools cover real R/Python execution (off by default,
items.dz: 科研全流程插件：注册 10 个领域技能与 15 个工具，把随包 450 条科研技能整理成 103 张能力卡并附 444 条可审计的判定账本，并通过系统提示段自动接管科研任务。工具覆盖真跑 R/Python（默认关闭，先预览再确认）、数据闸门、图片与 docx 核验、按中文期刊体例生成 .docx、PubMed 真检索、DOI 逐字段核对、跨会话项目记忆。

items.de: Adds a Restart button beside the permission control in the composer toolbar that relaunches DSH in one click, so freshly installed plugins apply without closing and reopening the app.
items.dz: 在对话框工具栏「完全权限」右侧加一个「重启」按钮，点击即重启 DSH，装完插件不用再手动关掉重开。

items.de: Hands DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol: preflight snapshot, pre-restart maturity gate (no pending approvals, free disk, cooldown), restart, health check, and interrupted-work recovery, with the result delivered back to the requesting session.
items.dz: 把 DSH 重置请求经带版本的 JSON 协议交给外部运维 agent：预检快照、重启前成熟度门禁（无待审批、磁盘充足、冷却期）、重启、健康检查与业务恢复，结果投递回发起会话。

items.de: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.
items.dz: 让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动边和角改变大小、按住顶部横带移动位置，并记住尺寸。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness sidebar for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于 LiteLLM 虚拟钥匙、动态模型注入、MCP 转发与花费统计。

items.de: Compact macOS strip above the composer showing CPU, GPU, RAM, swap, memory pressure and local Ollama model ON/OFF status. Tested on Harness 0.2.1-rc.5.
items.dz: 输入框上方的 macOS 资源指标行：显示 CPU、GPU、RAM、交换空间、内存压力及本地 Ollama 模型 ON/OFF 状态。已在 Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。

items.de: Windows resource monitor for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: samples CPU, memory and clock speed once a minute, keeps a 30-day history and draws separate 24h / 7d charts for CPU and memory (with 85% / 90% alert lines) plus a frequency chart that marks load-time throttling. Reports sustained CPU
items.dz: DSH 侧栏的 Windows 资源监控：每 60 秒采集 CPU、内存与主频，保留 30 天历史，CPU 与内存各一张 24 小时 / 7 天独立曲线（带 85% / 90% 告警线），另有一张频率曲线标注有负载时的降频，并判定 CPU 持续 ≥ 85%（10 分钟）、内存持续 ≥ 90%（10 分钟）、有负载时频率 ≤ 最高频率 70%（5 分钟）三类异常。

items.de: Adds a restart button to the macOS DSH desktop sidebar that fully quits and reopens the app; on other platforms the button hides itself.
items.dz: 在 macOS 版 DSH 桌面端侧栏添加重启按钮，一键完全退出并重新打开应用；其他平台按钮自动隐藏。

items.de: Adds a Restart page to the DSH Web settings panel. The page shows the PID, port, start time and uptime of the running host and restarts it through a detached helper that waits until the port stops answering before replaying the same launch invocation; the page reloads itself once the replacement hos
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 设置面板里增加一个「重启」页：显示当前宿主的 PID、端口、启动时间与运行时长，重启由分离的 helper 完成——等端口不再应答后再按同一启动命令拉起新进程；替代宿主返回新的 boot id 后页面自动刷新。

items.de: Adds a Restart button to the DSH Desktop sidebar. It opens the same native confirmation dialog as the tray Exit item and, once approved, shuts the app down gracefully and relaunches it. This plugin only draws the button: it also needs the companion shell patch shipped in shell-patch/ in the same rep
items.dz: 给 DSH Desktop 侧边栏底部加一个「重启」按钮：弹出与托盘「退出 DeepSeek Harness」完全相同的原生确认框，确认后优雅关闭并重新拉起。注意：本插件只负责画这个按钮，必须同时应用同一仓库 shell-patch/ 里的外壳补丁，且该补丁要在 DSH 关闭时由 DSH 之外的脚本执行。单独安装插件时按钮为禁用状态，悬停提示会说明原因。配套外壳补丁仅支持 Windows，会改写已安装的 app.asar。

items.de: Restarts the running DSH process from a model tool or a bottom-right GUI control, with launchd KeepAlive detection, a detached-supervisor fallback that aborts the exit when its handshake fails, a macOS desktop restart path, and JSONL restart records correlated by arm id, pid and profile so a restart
items.dz: 用模型工具或右下角 GUI 控件重启正在运行的 DSH 进程：探测 launchd KeepAlive，无托管时派 detached supervisor 兜底（握手失败即取消退出），桌面版走 macOS 应用重启路径，每次重启写入按 armId、pid 与 profile 关联的 JSONL 记录，使一次重启能与日志里的无关活动区分开。

items.de: Adds a Restart button to the Windows titlebar of the desktop app: a click opens a confirmation dialog that says how many sessions a restart would interrupt, and confirming quits and reopens the app.
items.dz: 给桌面端 Windows 标题栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下先弹出确认框（并说明有几个会话会被中断），确认后退出并重新打开应用。

items.de: One-click plugin updates and restart from the sidebar: see every plugin's current and new version with publish dates, update them through the profile's own launcher, and keep the Desktop window where you left it across restarts. Windows desktop only.

items.de: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the same PID (a thin wrapper parent on Windows or Node < 22.15), so whatever started dsh needs no supervisor config (verified on Linux; Docker, macO
items.dz: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux 实测，Docker、macOS、Windows 尚未实机测试）；新 boot id 响应后页面自动刷新。

items.de: A restart button in the window title strip, right of the sidebar toggle, that stops every process the desktop app owns (Electron shell, Host, renderers and tool subprocesses) and starts the executable again, then reloads the page once the new instance answers. Windows desktop app only, and it hides
items.dz: 窗口标题栏左上角、收起侧边栏按钮右侧的重启按钮：一次点击停掉这个桌面应用的全部进程（窗口外壳、宿主、渲染进程与工具子进程），再重新拉起可执行文件，新实例就绪后自动刷新页面。仅支持 Windows 桌面版，其它宿主里按钮自动隐藏。

items.dz: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

items.de: Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new proces

items.dz: DSH 界面上一小框：一键重启宿主、一键刷新页面。重启会先问「立即 / 30 秒 / 60 秒 / 2 分钟 / 取消」，倒计时可撤回；小框需长按 320ms 才能拖动（避免手一抖就粘住），拖到边缘自动吸附，窗口缩放时跟着走。刷新前会真正确认插件包能加载（文件时间戳 + 取回 bundle + 语法编译三重检查），任何一项拿不到就不刷——宁可多点一次，也不把应用刷成起不来的样子。重启仅 Windows（PowerShell 5.1）；界面与刷新功能全平台可用。

items.de: A restart button at the sidebar foot, just above the account entry, for the DSH desktop app on Windows: two clicks stop the app and bring it back, with no console window.
items.dz: DSH Windows 桌面端侧栏底部的重启按钮，就在账号入口上方：点两次即结束应用进程并自动重启，全程不弹命令窗口。

items.de: Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send

items.de: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the Windows system tray menu and the account menu of the DSH desktop app: the plugin prepares a patched resources/app.asar at startup, a detached helper backs up the original and swaps it in after a normal exit, the patch is re-applied after each deskto

items.de: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
items.dz: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

items.de: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and installers — the full 170-tool catalog by default — but only inside sessions that select the preset; other presets load nothing. Ships an install-tim

items.de: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.

items.de: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
items.dz: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

items.de: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.
items.dz: 一种代码审查工作流，用于审查未提交的更改、相对于基础分支的更改、单个提交、GitHub Pull Request 或某个文件。

items.de: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
items.dz: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

items.de: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
items.dz: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

items.de: Markdown preview and rendered side-by-side compare for the changes-review tab.
items.dz: 评审页的 Markdown 预览与渲染态双栏对比。

items.de: Evidence-gated acceptance for research reports: claims, citations, data scope and method limits each need a tick plus written evidence before a deliverable can pass, with same-artifact revision history and a standalone SHA-256 receipt that says when the bytes moved.

items.de: Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per s

items.de: Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. items.de: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
items.dz: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

items.de: Rewrites pwsh and bash tool commands through `rtk rewrite` and executes the compact equivalent; falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent, and ships a checksum-verified `/rtk install` downloader.
items.dz: 把 pwsh / bash 工具命令经 `rtk rewrite` 改写后执行，让 rtk 的压缩输出进入上下文；rtk 缺失或无等价命令时原样执行，并提供带 SHA256 校验的 `/rtk install` 下载。

items.de: Rewrites bash tool calls through `rtk rewrite` on the `tools/execute` hook, so it applies to any provider route. Zero dependencies and no build step: a single ESM module that adopts exit codes 0 and 3, runs the original command otherwise (no equivalent, deny rule, missing rtk, spawn failure), restor
items.dz: 在 `tools/execute` 钩子上把 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，因此对任意 provider 路由生效。零依赖、无需构建：单个 ESM 模块，退出码 0 与 3 时采纳改写结果，其余情况（无等价命令、命中拒绝规则、rtk 缺失、启动失败）原样执行，执行后还原原始参数；`RTK_PREFIX_ONLY` 直接改为 `rtk <cmd>`，`DSH_RTK_BIN` 用于指定二进制。

items.de: Restart DSH and find out whether it actually came back. Windows has no external way to make Electron quit cleanly (WM_CLOSE just minimises the window), so this plugin does not pretend: it terminates the host, relaunches it with retries, then polls the host port until it really serves again, and repo
items.dz: 重启 DSH 并告诉你到底成没成。Windows 上没有「从外部让 Electron 干净退出」的通道（发 WM_CLOSE 只会最小化窗口），所以这个插件不装优雅：强制结束宿主、带重试地重新拉起、再轮询宿主端口确认它真的在服务，最后把结果写进本地文件，并在 desktop profile 配好 qq-notify 凭据（appId/clientSecret/openid）时发一条 QQ 消息。2026-11-08 端到端实测通过。

items.de: Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constra
items.dz: 让「同级或更窄的 sandbox_permissions」不再让工具调用直接失败。会升级的工具（pwsh、bash、write、edit）都广告完整的 sandbox_permissions 枚举，但 DSH 只接受严格更宽于当前生效级别的请求——其源码自称这是「deliberately not a schema constraint」。于是反射式带上该参数的模型往往填它已经在的那个级别，调用在执行前就死掉："sandbox escalation to \"workspace-write\" is not strictly wider than this call's current \"wo

items.de: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on e
items.dz: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 学术研究 preset 与 download-paper 技能：知网、arXiv、PubMed、Semantic Scholar 四路检索，知网空间链接在服务端换算为主站 kns.cnki.net 链接，并按交付契约把一个专题整理成同一目录下的离线 HTML 索引、XLSX 总表、BibTeX、RIS 与 arXiv 下载脚本。 需要 DSH 0.2.x、uv（知网、arXiv、Semantic Scholar 三个 MCP 源经它启动）与 Node.js（PubMed 源经 npx 启动）。

items.de: Skill bundle for tiered multi-agent science campaigns in math, physics, astronomy, engineering, and biomedical evidence: a shared blackboard, independent verifier and red team, wolf-pack and flanking tactics, token and time budgets, known-answer evals, a four-agent pendulum pilot, and a six-agent fo
items.dz: 面向数学、物理、天文、工程与生物医药证据的分层多智能体科研战役技能包：共享黑板、独立验证与红队、群狼与迂回战术、token/时间预算、已知答案评测、四智能体单摆 pilot，以及一次抓到并修正评测答案键错误的六智能体四阶 pilot。不宣称解决开放难题。

items.de: Light neumorphic theme with pale glass cards and a fish watermark, plus a dark sci-fi boot animation.
items.dz: 浅色拟态主题：白色玻璃卡、大肥鱼水印、品牌渐变 logo，附带深色科技启动动画。

items.de: Adds the scihub_pdf and scihub_batch model tools that resolve a DOI or article URL through Sci-Hub mirrors, download the paper PDFs into the session workspace and report per-DOI status honestly; the mirror list is configurable at runtime without a restart.
items.dz: 为 DSH 注册 scihub_pdf 与 scihub_batch 两个模型工具：按 DOI 或文章 URL 经 Sci-Hub 镜像解析并下载论文 PDF 到会话工作区，逐条如实返回下载状态；镜像列表可在运行时配置，修改后无需重启。

items.de: SCNet provider for DSH. Reads the desktop client's stored credential when present, or logs in with a phone SMS code from the settings page so no client is needed; registers the free models found in the client catalog (SCNet-Max) and can toggle free-only filtering at runtime.
items.dz: DSH 的 SCNet 模型接入。有客户端时直接读其已落盘的凭据，没有客户端也能在设置页用手机短信验证码登录；注册客户端目录里的免费模型（SCNet-Max），并可在运行时切换「只显示免费模型」。

items.de: Scope manager for DeepSeek Harness: binds presets, persona cards, tools, skills and MCP connections to global / workspace / session layers, with a sidebar.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的作用域管家：把预设、角色卡、工具、技能与 MCP 连接按「全局 / 工作区 / 会话」三层作用域绑定，带侧边栏。

items.de: Opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins, with native address and port settings. Exposes scopedHttpProxy for explicit callers, applies address changes to subsequent requests, and leaves system proxies, environment variables and global network dispatchers unchanged.
items.dz: 供 DSH 插件显式调用的独立 HTTP 代理服务，提供原生地址和端口设置。通过 scopedHttpProxy 服务接入，地址修改对后续请求生效，不修改系统代理、环境变量或全局网络连接器。

items.de: Bundles the official Scrapling agent skill into a DeepSeek Harness profile: anti-bot bypass, stealth browsing, the spiders framework, adaptive parsing and JavaScript rendering, discovered through the host skill catalog.
items.dz: 把官方 Scrapling 技能包进 DeepSeek Harness profile：反反爬绕过、隐身浏览、spiders 框架、自适应解析与 JS 渲染，通过宿主技能目录发现。

items.de: A configuration-only DSH bundle that connects the MCP server shipped with Scrapling to DeepSeek Harness over stdio, exposing its HTTP fetch and stealth-browser scraping tools for page extraction, browser actions, screenshots and network inspection. Requires Python 3.10+ with scrapling\[ai] (scraplin
items.dz: 纯配置型 DSH bundle，通过 stdio 把 Scrapling 自带的 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，暴露其 HTTP 抓取与隐身浏览器抓取工具，用于页面提取、浏览器操作、截图与网络请求检查。需要 Python 3.10+ 装好 scrapling\[ai]（scrapling-mcp 在 PATH 上）以及 Chromium 兼容浏览器（scrapling install）。

items.de: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.
items.dz: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

items.de: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
items.dz: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

items.de: Mirrors an Android phone screen to a Windows PC over USB or Wi-Fi with scrcpy, and exposes start, stop, status, connect (reconnect after a phone reboot) and screenshot as an agent tool and a /mirror command. Requires scrcpy and adb installed on the host (winget install Genymobile.scrcpy); the plugin
items.dz: 用 scrcpy 把安卓手机画面投到 Windows 电脑（USB 或无线），并把启动、停止、状态、connect（手机重启后重连）、截图暴露为智能体工具与 /mirror 命令。需在本机装好 scrcpy 与 adb（winget install Genymobile.scrcpy），插件不打包这两个可执行文件。

items.de: Edge glow for DeepSeek Harness: blue while it drives your mouse and keyboard, amber while it asks a question, red while it waits for approval, plus a top banner naming the current action. Desktop only: the overlay is a separate Electron process (auto-detected from the DSH desktop app or dsh-pet; ove
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加光：模型接管键盘鼠标时屏幕四边亮蓝光、提问时琥珀、等你批准时红色，并在屏幕中上方显示正在做什么。仅桌面端：覆盖层是独立 Electron 进程（从 DSH 桌面版或 dsh-pet 自动查找，可用 DSH_ELECTRON_PATH 覆盖），没有 Electron 时不会亮。

items.de: Ctrl+Tab switcher over every visited screen — Sessions, Settings sections and plugin pages — shown while Ctrl is held; release to switch, Esc to stay. Browsers reserve Ctrl+Tab for their own tabs, so use it in the desktop app or in a browser that delivers the shortcut to the page.
items.dz: Ctrl+Tab 切换器：按住 Ctrl 时列出访问过的页面——会话、设置分区和插件页——松开即切换，Esc 取消。浏览器会把 Ctrl+Tab 留给自己的标签页，所以请在桌面端使用，或在能把该快捷键交给页面的浏览器里使用。

items.de: Windows screenshot overlay: highlights the window, screen or taskbar under the cursor and dims the rest, then annotates (shapes, arrows, pen, text, mosaic) and drops the image into the composer without sending it.
items.dz: Windows 截图覆盖层：自动高亮光标下的窗口、整屏或任务栏并压暗其余区域，随后标注（形状、箭头、画笔、文本、马赛克），确定后把图片放进会话输入区，不自动发送。

items.de: Snipping tool for the composer: freeze the screen, drag a region, annotate it, and drop the result into the message box. Windows only; the selector is a bundled WinForms binary (rebuilt from the included C# source if missing) and uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x.
items.dz: 输入框旁的截图标注工具：冻结屏幕、拖框选区、就地标注，完成后直接插入输入框。仅 Windows；选区器为内置 WinForms 程序（缺失时用随包的 C# 源码重建），依赖系统自带 .NET Framework 4.x。

items.de: A camera button in the DSH composer toolbar that opens the OS screenshot tool (Windows Snipping Tool; macOS screencapture and Linux GNOME Screenshot / Spectacle / scrot are untested, and scrot needs wl-copy or xclip) and leaves the shot on the clipboard for Ctrl+V; the host route only accepts reques
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入面板工具行加一个相机按钮，点击调起系统自带截图工具（Windows 截图工具已实测；macOS screencapture、Linux GNOME Screenshot / Spectacle / scrot 未实机验证，scrot 需 wl-copy 或 xclip），截图进剪贴板后按 Ctrl+V 粘贴；宿主路由只接受 Host 为本机回环地址的 POST。

items.de: One-click screenshot for the DSH composer: a scissors button (Shift+click hides the window first) opens a native full-screen crop overlay with window detection, drag-to-move and 8-direction border resize, then attaches the cropped PNG through the composer paste pipeline. Windows only, DSH desktop ap
items.dz: DSH 输入框的截图插件：剪刀按钮（Shift+点击先隐藏窗口）唤起原生全屏裁剪遮罩，支持窗口识别、选区拖动与八向边缘缩放，裁剪结果经输入框粘贴管线自动附为图片。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端（0.2.1 及以上）。

items.de: WeChat-style screenshot and annotation for the DSH composer, with a system-wide hotkey that captures without raising the DSH window. Windows only; on first use it compiles its helper executables from bundled C# source with the built-in csc.exe.
items.dz: 微信式截图标注，直接插进 DSH 输入框；系统级热键截图时不会把 DSH 弹到前台。仅支持 Windows；首次使用时用系统自带的 csc.exe 把随包的 C# 源码编译成辅助可执行文件。

items.de: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.
items.dz: 微信式截图：点一下冻结桌面，框选区域或单击窗口，截图直接进输入框。Windows 专用的 Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot 衍生版，请勿与原版同时安装。

items.de: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
items.dz: 微信式界面内截屏按钮：拖动框选、8 个手柄微调，Enter 确认截取、Esc 取消；PNG 自动编号保存，\[Shot N HH:mm] 标记自动写入输入框。仅 Windows，已在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 实测。

items.de: Adds a screenshot tool that captures the Windows desktop to PNG and hands the path to the model, plus a composer camera button that previews, downloads or copies the capture.
items.dz: 在输入框加相机按钮（预览、下载、复制截图），并提供一个截图工具，把 Windows 桌面截成 PNG 交给模型读取。

items.de: Turns the right edge of the chat scroll area into a theremin-style strip: the vertical mouse position picks the pitch (higher up, higher note), and blue ticks mark your own messages so you can click one to jump to it. Includes a draggable on/off pill and volume slider.
items.dz: 把聊天区右边缘变成一条特雷门琴式的竖条：鼠标纵向位置决定音高；你发过的每条消息在对应位置有一根蓝杠，点一下跳到那条消息。左下角是可拖动的开关胶囊与音量滑块。

items.de: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
items.dz: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

items.de: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
items.dz: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

items.de: Read-only observer of native DeepSeek search model calls: appends each call token usage to a JSONL file so accounting plugins can price it. Requests and responses are not modified.
items.dz: 只读观察原生 DeepSeek 搜索的模型调用，把每次调用的 token 用量追加到 JSONL 文件，供统计类插件计价；不修改请求与响应。

items.de: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.
items.dz: 在「新建会话」的工作区下拉里直接搜索：中文支持拼音首字母与全拼，英文支持任意位置子串与忽略分隔符匹配。

items.de: Adds a system-prompt rule that makes DSH agents look for existing work before they build.
items.dz: 给 DSH 代理加一条系统提示规则，让它动手前先找现成方案，而不是闭门造车。

items.de: Right-sidebar file-preview enhancement built on `dsh-better-sidebar` (required — without it the plugin stays inert): a floating find bar for any text file (Ctrl+F, literal or regex, case-sensitive, match counter, next/previous) plus a collapsible Structure panel that lists classes, methods and file-
items.dz: 基于 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的右栏文件预览增强（必须先装它，否则插件静默不生效）：为任意文本文件提供漂浮查找条（Ctrl+F，字面量或正则、区分大小写、命中计数、上一个/下一个），并在代码右侧提供可折叠的「结构」面板——Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python 列出类/方法/文件级变量，HTML（含 .vue/.svelte）给元素大纲，点条目跳到对应行。只读，不注册独立页签。

items.de: SearXNG web search with a managed local runtime, external instance support, Web settings, and an optional DSH process proxy.
items.dz: 提供 SearXNG 网页搜索，支持托管本地运行环境、连接已有实例、Web 设置及可选的 DSH 进程代理。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Self-hosted SearXNG search provider: the bundled installer sets up and supervises a local instance on macOS/Linux/WSL (needs git and Python 3.11+), key-less and tracking-free; it probes the engines your network can reach and applies the recommended set in one click.
items.dz: 自建 SearXNG 搜索源：随包脚本在 macOS/Linux/WSL 上安装并守护本地实例（需 git 与 Python 3.11+），免 API Key、无追踪；实测本机各引擎的可达性与延迟后，一键应用推荐集。

items.de: Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatch
items.dz: 把成品回答里的每条断言，和同一回合工具实际读到的内容对照：引用能在输出里找到的矛盾会在同一回合触发一次纠正；输出不支撑的断言则写进会话日志与 stderr。先跑一遍绝对化措辞与对不上数字的免费扫描，整回合没调用工具的就不进模型。

items.de: Agent-asked secrets for DeepSeek Harness: a masked card stores API keys and tokens in the local credential store without them entering the chat, then injects them into one command.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供向用户索取密钥的插件：遮罩卡片把 API 密钥和令牌存入本地凭据库，不进入聊天记录，并只在单条命令中注入。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Collects passwords through a card instead of the conversation: terminal prompts, the DSH sidebar browser, and Ego Lite, with multi-field forms and live strength rules.
items.dz: 通过卡片向用户索取密码，而不是让值进入对话：终端提示、DSH 侧边栏浏览器、Ego Lite，支持多字段表单与实时强度校验。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
items.dz: 把密钥和个人信息交给 agent，却不进入它的上下文；带校验位的字段抽取与掩码内容分类。

items.de: Cross-project session grouping for the DSH sidebar: define named sections, assign sessions from any project into them, then collapse, rename, archive or move a whole project in one action; a toggle in the Sections panel swaps the host session browser for the section tree and restores it on demand, a
items.dz: 把不同项目的会话收进左侧边栏里可折叠的自定义分组：会话行与项目行各有菜单，可加入分组、移出分组、重命名、归档，或把整个项目一次性移入某个分组；分组面板里的开关可把宿主侧栏切换成分组树、随时恢复，行尾还会提示会话正在跑或跑完还没看过。

items.de: Runtime security guard for DSH: loader import confinement, HTTP Host header validation, and source patch for VM sandbox escapes (4 CVEs). AI-assisted.
items.dz: DSH 运行时安全守卫：配置加载导入约束、HTTP Host 头校验、附带 VM 沙箱逃逸源码补丁（4 个 CVE）。AI 辅助制作。

items.de: DSH plugin security guard: 28-rule static scanner, risk scoring, whitelist/blacklist policy, local web dashboard and in-DSH risk popups.
items.dz: DSH 插件安全卫士：28 条规则静态扫描、风险评分、白名单/黑名单、本地 Web 仪表盘与 DSH 内风险弹窗。

items.de: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after
items.dz: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别正在做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审其安全防御措施与所采用的代码安全防御架构，推荐程序需要的架构（一种或多种）并检查架构之间是否冲突；连续不合格会进入教学模式要求重做；在面板授予评审权限后，未通过评审的代码任务不能算完成（未授权时只读观察）。

items.de: Lets a text-only agent watch a live screen or camera feed: every frame is scored by how much the picture changed, only the ones that matter are packed into one numbered sheet with an audio envelope, so the model looks at what actually changed instead of a screenshot every few seconds.
items.dz: 让只有文字的智能体「看」实时屏幕或摄像头：每帧按画面变化量打分，只把真正变了的帧拼成一张带编号、带音轨条的宫格图——看视频、看演示、看游戏都行，token 只花在变了的地方。

items.de: Copy a user message together with its images and files, then paste it into any session: the text lands in the composer and each attachment is rebuilt through the official createDrafts/addAttachments path, so it uploads and sends like a normal draft.
items.dz: 复制用户消息时连同图片与文件一起捕获，粘贴到任意会话：文字进入输入框，每个附件经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道重建为真实草稿，可正常上传并发送。

items.de: Select text in a conversation and park it as a quote card above the composer; the input box keeps only your question, and the quoted text rides along with the message you send. Package name: dsh-quote-tray.
items.dz: 在对话里选中文字，选区变成输入框上方的一张引用卡片，输入框里只写问题；发送时引用原文自动跟在消息后面，模型能读到完整内容。包名 dsh-quote-tray。

items.de: Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.
items.dz: 选中聊天回复中的任意文字，浮出「追问/复制」气泡：一键把选中内容作为引用填入输入框（问题由你输入），或一键复制。另附安装与实现文档。

items.de: Copies selected assistant text to the clipboard and shows a Comment chip that opens the inline comment box in DeepSeek Harness; the right-click quote menu and Cmd+L still work.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的助手消息里选中文字即自动复制，并弹出「注释」浮框，点开才是评论框；右键引用菜单与 ⌘L 仍然保留。

items.de: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

items.de: Asks which provider and model to use before each in-process subagent starts, listing the models from your configured LLM providers; if nothing is chosen within 60 seconds the subagent keeps the DSH default route.
items.dz: 在每个进程内子代理启动前询问要用的 provider / 模型，候选列表来自你已配置的 LLM Provider；60 秒内不做选择则子代理沿用 DSH 原本的路由。

items.de: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skil
items.dz: 有界自管的长期记忆（Hermes 式 MEMORY.md / USER.md，硬字符上限 + 写入前安全扫描）；每轮结束后自动复盘，用大白话写笔记、或把新知识合并进已有技能而不堆出雷同技能；curator 找出会被加载器静默丢弃的技能并外科式修复；跨会话搜索历史消息；输入框上方的学习卡片只在有新闻时出现，删改记忆前必须先问你。

items.de: Four-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the memory design of NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge (MIT) with the QQ channel removed: an append-only dialogue log, a weighted long-term fact store with decay and one-way archiving, self-notes the agent writes about itself, Chinese bigram recall over the
items.dz: DSH 四层记忆插件（记忆设计移植自 NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge，MIT，去掉了 QQ 通道）：只增不改的原文库、带权重衰减与单向归档的长期事实库、智能体自己写的自我认知、原文库上的中文 bigram 检索，以及增量 AES-256-GCM 加密同步到只存密文的私有 git 仓库。会话归档后不再参与检索，但历史仍在库里。

items.de: Turns "restarting the host" into one interrupt that many sessions can share. Several sessions queue onto the same restart (8 by default, configurable, joinable at any time including mid-wait); the host is closed once and relaunched once; then each waiting session is woken separately with its own rea
items.dz: 把「重启宿主」变成一次中断、多个会话共用：若干会话可以排进同一次重启（默认上限 8 个、可配置，任意时刻都能加入，等待途中也行），宿主只关一次、只拉起一次，随后按名单逐个唤醒，每个会话拿回自己写下的理由并各自开工，互不等待。每个会话独立决定要不要续接，某一条投递失败不影响其余，某个会话也能只摘掉自己而不作废别人的重启。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

items.de: Adds a restart_self tool and /restart command that replace the DSH host process with the same command line and port, then deliver a message into the calling session so the agent picks the work back up by itself.
items.dz: 新增 restart_self 工具与 /restart 命令：以相同命令行与端口替换 DSH 宿主进程，重启完成后向发起会话投递一条消息，让智能体接着自己跑。

items.de: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
items.dz: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

items.de: Three ledgers for a model that loses context between restarts. Self-note: what I have become — capped at 40 entries, and every eviction first leaves a one-line crease recording which entry was dropped and why. Judgment ledger: record a claim together with how to verify it, come back when it is due,
items.dz: 给会断片的模型三本账，各解决一件事：自我笔记（我变成什么样了——上限 40 条，挤掉最旧的一条之前必须留一句折痕，记下删的是哪条、为什么）、判断账本（记下自己做的判断和验证方法，到期回头核，错了进错册，防止一直觉得自己是对的）、交接条（这一轮停在哪、下一轮先看什么——是接力棒不是记忆）。三个工具各带 action 参数，不拆成十几个省 prompt；数据存 ~/.dsh/*.jsonl，与同名命令行脚本共用同一份，零依赖。

items.de: Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.
items.dz: 把聊天框里连发的几条短消息缓冲合并成一轮再唤醒模型：停手若干秒后才回复一次；长消息和附件不延迟。

items.de: Delay-send for the DSH chat composer: a clock button beside the send button schedules a message into the current session via 10-minute, 30-minute, 1-hour and 5-hour presets or an exact date and time, with the default continue prompt freely editable; delivery runs through DSH's official schedule auto
items.dz: 聊天输入框的延时发送：发送按钮旁的时钟按钮按 10 分钟 / 30 分钟 / 1 小时 / 5 小时预设或指定日期时间，把一条消息（默认「继续」，可自由修改）排程进当前会话；投递依托 DSH 官方自动化任务（schedule），待发送重启不丢，可在面板待发列表与「自动化任务」页查看或取消，附本会话角标计数、带边界的安全继续片段与最近一条自定义文案，且已装 dsh-quota-watch 时指定时间自动预填 GLM 五小时窗口恢复时刻加两分钟余量。

items.de: Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.
items.dz: 为端点不返回模态元数据的中转路由补上图片输入声明，让本来就能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本拒收；声明为纯文本的路由同样会被覆盖。

items.de: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.
items.dz: 在输入框工具栏加一个「时间戳」开关：开启后，你提交的每条消息后面会跟一条隐藏的上下文消息，携带发送时刻的本地时间，模型因此知道你是什么时候发的；开关按会话分别记住。

items.de: Replaces keys, tokens and passwords with <SG_> placeholders before they enter model context; plaintext stays in a local AES-256-GCM vault, revealed by a click-to-reveal lock in Settings and in user messages.
items.dz: 把密钥、令牌与密码在进入模型上下文前替换为 <SG_> 占位符，明文以 AES-256-GCM 加密保存在本地保管库；设置页与用户消息里可点小锁临时查看。

items.de: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API
items.dz: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

items.de: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
items.dz: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

items.de: Windows serial debug console in the DSH right sidebar: port settings, ANSI color logs, an in-log Linux command line, editable command buttons, keyword log search, multi-port tabs and log export.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏的 Windows 串口调试台：串口设置、ANSI 彩色日志、日志内 Linux 命令行、可编辑命令按钮、日志关键字搜索、多串口标签页与日志导出。

items.de: Serial-port toolkit for DSH - 9 tools plus a web UI where an AI agent and a human share one UART line, with auto port matching, hex/text frames, timestamps, scheduled sends, rule-based auto-recovery and appearance themes. The serial engine runs on Python 3.8+ — DSH's bundled interpreter is used when
items.dz: DSH 的串口工具箱：9 个工具 + 网页版，人与 AI 共用一根串口线；自动匹配端口、文字/十六进制、逐帧时间戳、定时发送、规则自动处置、外观主题，已真机验证 CH340 与 HC-05。串口内核是 Python 3.8+，默认用 DSH 自带的解释器，找不到时用 PATH 上的 python / py -3。

items.de: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone
items.dz: DSH 服务器面板：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU/内存/磁盘/网速与趋势图，点卡片进入 xterm.js 终端并支持 SFTP 上传下载；提供 server_box_hosts、server_box_exec、server_box_upload、server_box_download 对话工具，可导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为右侧栏页签或独立抽屉。

items.de: In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monito
items.dz: 在 DSH 内直接打开服务器监控窗口，经 SSH 隧道读取内存、交换分区、负载、磁盘、各容器占用与 QQ 登录状态，并提供清理缓存与重启容器按钮，以及内嵌 VNC 的 QQ 客户端供手动扫码登录或退出账号。守护 agent 随仓库提供（server/monitor.py），需要你自己部署。

items.de: Adds a Resources tab to the right sidebar with live CPU, RAM, swap and disk usage on Linux, macOS and Windows, plus rankings of the top processes, folders and files; read-only, no dependencies, requires dsh-better-sidebar.
items.dz: 在右侧边栏新增“资源”页，在 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上实时显示 CPU、内存、交换区和磁盘用量，并列出占用最多的进程、文件夹和文件；只读、无依赖，需要 dsh-better-sidebar。

items.de: Two-way bridge to a Server酱³ Bot (not SendKey push): messages sent in the app drive a DSH session, question and approval cards can be answered from the phone or the web, and agent plus scheduled output is pushed back to the chat. Pairing is trust-on-first-use: while the allow list (allowChatIds) is
items.dz: 与 Server酱³ Bot 的双向通道（不是 SendKey 单向推送）：在 App 里发消息即可驱动 DSH 会话，问题与批准卡片可在手机或网页任一端作答，Agent 与定时任务的输出再推回聊天。配对采用首次信任：allowChatIds 为空时，第一个给机器人发消息的聊天会被信任，请设置 allowChatIds 把它限定在你自己的聊天上。

items.de: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

items.de: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
items.dz: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

items.de: Floats conversations that are currently running to the top of their workspace session list, and keeps them there after they finish.
items.dz: 把正在运行的对话浮到所在工作区会话列表的最上方，运行结束后仍保留在该位置。

items.de: Adopts DSH sessions created outside the running window (IDE/ACP clients, other processes) into their matching Workspace, and imports local sessions from other agent harnesses (pi) as native, resumable DSH sessions with sidebar sync/import actions and idempotent re-import.
items.dz: 把在运行窗口之外（IDE/ACP 客户端、其他进程）创建的 DSH 会话归入对应工作区，并把本机其他 Agent Harness（如 pi）的会话导入为可续聊的 DSH 原生会话，提供侧边栏同步/导入入口与幂等重复导入。

items.de: Badges the installed app icon with the number of finished, unread sessions, and pops an in-app badge or a Windows notification when a session fails or waits for your answer; each state has its own chime.
items.dz: 会话干完活时在应用图标上显示未读数字角标；会话报错或等待回答时弹出红色感叹号角标、黄色问号角标或 Windows 通知，三种状态各有提示音。

items.de: A right-sidebar tab listing the files DSH Sessions produced, newest first, with the Session in view expanded on top: a click copies a row's full path, a double click previews it in the sidebar, and a file can be pinned in one Session or in all of them.
items.dz: 右栏标签页：把各个 DSH 会话产出过的文件列成一列，当前会话置顶并默认展开；单击复制文件完整路径，双击在侧栏预览，文件可以单独置顶到本会话或全局置顶。

items.de: Settings card that lists sessions whose history references attachment objects missing from the local attachment store, then backs the log up and replaces those dangling references with text placeholders so the session can send again. The repair script needs Node 22.15 or newer, and the card has been
items.dz: 在设置页列出历史引用了本地附件库中已丢失对象的会话，先备份日志、再把悬空引用替换成文本占位，使这些会话能重新发送消息。修复脚本需要 Node 22.15 及以上；设置卡片目前仅在 Windows 上验证过。

items.de: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.
items.dz: 会话在后台跑完、或在等你审批、计划审阅或回答时，弹出系统通知、标题加红点并点亮 PWA 任务栏徽标；回到窗口自动清除。

items.de: Archives sessions that have gone unused for longer than a set number of days (5 by default); any single session can be marked as not archived.
items.dz: 把长期没动过的会话自动归档（默认 5 天），单个会话可以标成不归档。

items.de: Adds an Auto-rename row to each Session sidebar menu: the model reads the Session log, weights recent user messages higher (exponential decay, 3-day time constant), and writes a title of at most 10 CJK characters into the Session title. Also opens that Session menu on right-click, and exposes the sa
items.dz: 在每个会话的侧栏菜单里新增「自动重命名」：模型读取会话日志，按时间衰减给用户消息加权（τ = 3 天，越新权重越高），写出不超过 10 个汉字的标题并写入会话名。同时支持右键会话呼出该菜单，并把同一操作暴露为 session_auto_rename 智能体工具。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

items.de: A status bar for the DSH sidebar. While a session runs, its row becomes a green card with a progress bar driven by an estimate of how long the turn will take (drifting dotted track), plus a live percentage on the leading edge that switches to elapsed mm:ss once the estimate is exceeded. When the tur
items.dz: 侧栏会话状态条：会话跑起来时整行变成绿色卡片，底部一条带流动小点的进度条按估算时长推进，行首直接显示完成百分比，超时后改显示精确到秒的已用时长；跑完后整行转橙并一直亮着，直到你点开那条对话才熄灭。不用切过去看，瞄一眼侧栏就知道每条会话在干嘛。

items.de: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
items.dz: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

items.de: Gives an agent tools to open foreground sessions, prompt them in queue or steer mode, read the transcript back, cancel a turn, and get the authenticated URL of the local web app.
items.dz: 给 agent 一组工具：打开前台会话、以排队或插队方式发提示词、读回转录、取消回合，以及拿到本机 Web 应用带认证的地址。

items.de: Draggable session cards on a board inside the session canvas, with grid, matrix and freeform layouts, a per-card composer, and native floating windows.
items.dz: 把会话做成卡片桌布：网格 / 宫格 / 自由布局、卡片内直接发消息、可弹出原生浮窗。

items.de: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only ar
items.dz: 把互相交接的對話自動聚成一條鏈：從交接提示詞自動判定、場次編號、就地改名、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、把鏈置頂、把鏈封存進面板裡的封存庫（側欄不再顯示，有新場次也留在封存庫）、本場上下文與請求數讀數，以及可調的交接門檻（達到可自動交接：寫提示詞→開新對話→貼上→切換）。

items.de: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

items.de: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again throug
items.dz: 从侧栏会话菜单删除整个会话；聊天里划词右键弹出「复制 / 引用 / 提问」：引用把 Markdown 引用块插入输入框，提问把选区与问题交给同一个复用的可继续子智能体（label `ask`，宿主重启后经子智能体目录找回），回答在右侧栏流式显示。

items.de: Batch session cleanup for DeepSeek Harness — pick a workspace, see which sessions are archived, and permanently delete logs, projection caches and workspace records.
items.dz: 按工作区批量清理会话：查看归档状态，把会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记录一起彻底删除。

items.de: Tiered cold storage for DSH sessions: idle sessions move out of the live root into an on-disk cold tier instead of being deleted, an FTS5 index over that tier keeps them searchable, and a restore path moves a session back into the live root. Dry-run by default: nothing moves until you turn it off in
items.dz: DSH 会话的分层冷存储：闲置会话移出实时根目录、转入磁盘冷层而不被删除；冷层上的 FTS5 索引让它们仍可检索，需要时可将会话恢复回实时根目录。默认为演练模式，在设置页关闭后才会真正移动会话。

items.de: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinnin
items.dz: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

items.de: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.
items.dz: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

items.de: Sends a macOS native notification when a root DSH session turn completes normally: the title is the session title and the body a sanitized, truncated preview of the reply. Subagents, cancellations and errors are skipped by default and no conversation text is stored.
items.dz: 主会话每轮回复正常完成后发送 macOS 系统通知：标题为会话标题，正文为脱敏截断的回复摘要。默认跳过子代理、取消与错误，不保存会话内容。

items.de: Sets a per-root-session inference limit of 1–10; at 1, queues native subagent dispatches and runs child branches serially while the parent waits.
items.dz: 按根会话设置 1–10 路推理并发；设为 1 时排队原生子任务派发、按分支串行执行，并让父 Agent 等待结果。

items.de: Session Console: a sidebar dashboard over every conversation that shows run state, token spend, cache hit rate, context pressure and a heat score, resolves a plain-language sentence such as "how is the example project going" to the matching session, and dispatches that sentence as a queued task into
items.dz: 会话总控：给侧栏加一个覆盖全部对话的仪表盘，显示运行状态、token 消耗、缓存命中率、上下文压力与热度分数；说一句“示例项目怎么样了”即可定位到对应会话，并把这句话作为任务派发进去。同时提供 5 个 agent 工具（overview / find / tail / dispatch / cancel），与界面共用同一套数据。

items.de: Context profiles for new sessions: pick which tools and which system prompt each new conversation receives. Deferred tools stay as name+summary placeholders, keeping the tool list and the prompt prefix cache stable.
items.dz: 为新会话选择注入的工具集合与系统提示词：档位表逐组切换工具、system 段逐项开关，被延迟的工具保留名字与功能摘要占位，工具表和前缀缓存保持稳定。

items.de: Exact per-session spend for DeepSeek Harness, billed request by request at the peak or off-peak rate in force when that request was sent.
items.dz: 在会话状态栏精确显示本会话累计花费：按每次请求各自的时段价与所用模型分别计费。

items.de: A cost bar for DSH relay users: current-session and today totals under the composer (today includes already-closed sessions), a peak/off-peak dot, and no call to the official balance API. Click for a per-model breakdown; narrow windows keep the money line first. Derived from KIDLi1412/dsh-session-co
items.dz: 给走中转站的 DSH 用户做的费用条：输入框下方常驻本次与今日花费（今日累计含已关闭的会话），峰谷时段一眼可辨，不查官方余额接口。点开看分模型明细，窄窗口优先保留费用读数。改自 KIDLi1412/dsh-session-cost（MIT），与原版使用相同的插件 id 和 /api/session-cost/summary 路由，不能与原版同装。

items.de: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏的每个工作区内把会话按日期分组、标注具体日期，并保留运行中状态灯与按日期搜索。

items.de: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
items.dz: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

items.de: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu: its log and replay cache go to the Recycle Bin on Windows (a local trash folder elsewhere); a live session is queued for removal on the next start.
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单里删除会话：日志与投影缓存移入回收站（Windows；其它平台移到本地回收目录）；正在使用的会话排队到下次启动时删除。

items.de: Session management for DeepSeek Harness: list every stored session with its on-disk size, search by title, session id, kind tag, workspace or agent preset, and group them by age or by workspace. Permanently delete one or many at once — the log artifact, the workspace account entry and the search ind
items.dz: DSH 会话管理：列出全部会话并显示各自的磁盘占用，可按标题、会话 ID、类型标签、工作区或 agent preset 搜索，并按时间或工作区分组。支持单个或批量永久删除——同时清除日志文件、工作区账目与搜索索引，删除前两步确认、删除后复验；可按需显示子代理会话，侧边对话线程始终隐藏，本次启动中活动的会话会被拒绝直到重启。

items.de: Adds "move to trash" and a session trash to the sidebar: restore removed sessions or delete them for good.
items.dz: 为侧栏增加「移入垃圾箱」与会话垃圾箱：删掉的会话可在工作区侧栏里恢复或彻底删除。

items.de: Deletes a DSH session from the session menu, and lists the workspace files that session touched so you choose which ones to remove with it. Deletion is permanent (no undo), and files written through shell commands are not tracked.
items.dz: 在会话菜单里删除 DSH 会话，并列出该会话碰过的工作区文件，由你勾选哪些一起删掉。删除是永久的、无法撤销；通过 shell 命令写出的文件不在追踪范围内。

items.de: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this
items.dz: 在侧栏会话“…”菜单的“归档会话”下方新增红色“删除会话”行，永久删除该会话的日志与工作区账目（走 workspace registry 自己的持久化写）。第二次点击确认后该行立即从列表消失；当次启动使用过的会话会先从内存停用再删（不会复活）；正在跑任务的会话会再显示一次警告，点下去先停止任务再删除。

items.de: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookk
items.dz: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents Anywhere 同步的手机 App）持有 各自副本、需在其 App 内管理。中英双语界面，本地回环路由带信任栅栏。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

items.de: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, with a confirmation dialog and the host operation that permanently removes the session log.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话菜单里新增「删除会话」，带确认弹窗，并由宿主动作彻底移除会话日志。

items.de: Permanently delete a session from the session row menu — archives the id, removes the log directory and drops the row at once, with a Delete shortcut; built only on shipped extension points, and a session that was merely opened stays deletable.
items.dz: 在会话行菜单中永久删除会话：先归档、再删除日志目录并立即移除该行，带 Delete 快捷键；只使用官方扩展点，仅打开过、未在运行的会话依然可以删除。

items.de: Permanently deletes one session from its sidebar context menu after a confirmation dialog: the log directory under the DSH home, the projection-cache thumbnail, its id in every workspace.json, and its archived and pinned entries. Sessions resumed since launch are detached from both the sessions and
items.dz: 在会话右键菜单里永久删除一个会话（先弹确认框）：DSH home 下的日志目录、投影缓存缩略图、每个 workspace.json 里的会话 id、以及归档与置顶列表里的条目。本次启动后 resume 进内存的会话会先从 sessions 与 agents 两个 store 里摘除，删掉的会话不会以幽灵条目的形式回到侧边栏。会话正在跑一轮对话时拒绝删除；工作区目录本身不受影响。

items.de: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话菜单里二次确认后删除会话：移除会话日志目录、投影缓存记录与工作区/置顶/归档记账；所有注册表调用带超时保护，工作区注册表卡住也能完成删除。

items.de: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除」项，经二次确认后硬删除该会话。

items.de: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除会话」，永久删除该会话的本地记录；正在运行的会话会被拒绝。

items.de: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
items.dz: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

items.de: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark ke
items.dz: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

items.de: Retrospective agent-session evaluation — grades the sessions that already happened: deterministic grade cards, regression diffs, /eval-history trends, and /eval --report straight from exported artifacts; no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
items.dz: 回溯式会话评测——给已经发生的会话打分：确定性评分卡、回归对比、/eval-history 趋势，/eval --report 直接从导出产物评分；不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

items.de: Export a DSH session tree (lead plus subagent fleet) to two Markdown files from one frozen snapshot: a readable narrative summary and a complete raw archive. Target directories are checked against the session file policy, and a blocked location falls back to the workspace exports folder.
items.dz: 把一次会话及其智能体编队从同一份冻结快照导出为两份 Markdown：可读叙事摘要与完整原始存档。导出位置按会话文件策略校验，不可写时自动改存工作区 exports 目录。

items.de: Evidence-grade reports beyond a plain export: /transcript writes styled HTML/Markdown/JSON with Mermaid lineage, editor diffs and a turn timeline; /stats prints a cost-aware card; /archive packs the raw JSONL with a metadata manifest, while /transcript --manifest and /bundle add the SHA-256 evidence
items.dz: 不止导出，而是证据级报告：/transcript 生成带 Mermaid 血统图、编辑器 diff、回合时间线的 HTML/Markdown/JSON；/stats 输出成本感知统计卡；/archive 打包原始 JSONL 并附元数据清单，SHA-256 证据清单由 /transcript --manifest 与 /bundle 提供——全历史、任意后端。

items.de: Adds a cross-workspace activity sidebar for running, waiting and unread sessions, with search, optional pinned and scheduled-delivery groups, local read tracking and confirmed archiving.
items.dz: 跨工作区聚合运行中、待回复和未读会话，支持搜索、可选的置顶与定时交付分组、插件本地已读记录，以及经确认的归档操作。

items.de: Literal full-text search across every DSH session log (Chinese sentences work, where the built-in FTS5 tokenizer fails), as a right-sidebar panel that scrolls to the matching line, plus a session_find model tool.
items.dz: 跨全部会话日志的字面检索（内置 FTS5 分词搜不到中文整句）；右侧栏面板可双击跳转并滚动到命中那一行，另提供 session_find 模型工具。

items.de: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sideb
items.dz: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

items.de: Groups sidebar conversations into collapsible folders that reorder by drag, decorating the shipped session list instead of replacing it.
items.dz: 将侧边栏工作区里的会话进行会话分类并可折叠，便于会话的分类收纳。把侧边栏对话收进可折叠、可拖动排序的文件夹，只装饰官方会话列表而不替换它。

items.de: Share a DSH conversation without making the recipient install anything — copy a 24-hour LAN link, export a self-contained web page they can open offline, or import a .dshchat file as a real resumable session when both sides run the plugin.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话转发给别人：复制 24 小时有效的局域网链接、导出对方双击即读的自包含网页，或两边都装插件时用 .dshchat 文件导入成一条可继续对话的真实会话。

items.de: Turn on the built-in session full-text search backend (session-query-sqlite, SQLite FTS5) that dsh ships disabled by default, so the sidebar magnifier searches message bodies with snippets instead of titles only.
items.dz: 开启 dsh 内置但默认关闭的会话全文搜索后端（session-query-sqlite，SQLite FTS5），侧边栏放大镜即可搜索消息正文并附摘要，而不只是标题。

items.de: Merges the work done in a forked session back into the session it came from: /merge turns the branch's session log into a digest without a model call (each turn's prompt and reply, files changed, commands run, choices you made, to-dos and the final answer) and delivers it with your next message, or
items.dz: 把分叉会话里做完的工作合并回原会话：/merge 直接从分支的会话记录整理出摘要、不调用模型（每轮的提问与回复、改动的文件、执行的命令、你做的选择、待办和最终结论），随你的下一条消息交给 agent，或用 --wake 立即处理；同一分支再次合并只带新增的轮次。另有 /branches、带合并状态的右侧栏分支地图、输入框上方的未合并提醒，以及供 agent 使用的 session_branches / session_branch_merge 工具。

items.de: Literal substring search across every conversation in the workspace, from a search box in the conversation header. The built-in index tokenizes with unicode61 and only matches whole tokens; this plugin scans the local session logs directly, so mid-token fragments and two-character Chinese words matc
items.dz: 在对话页顶栏按字面文字搜索工作区内全部历史会话。内置索引按 unicode61 分词、只匹配整词，这个插件直接扫描本地会话日志，因此句中片段与两字中文词也能命中；默认只搜用户与助手正文（工具输出需手动开启），结果按会话轮转，避免单个长会话占满列表，点开后滚动定位并高亮命中。只读本地会话日志，零网络请求。

items.de: Adds a display-only session group section to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: user-defined multi-level nested groups, drag sessions into groups, and a panel height you can adjust. Host workspace membership and session ownership are not modified.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏新增一个纯展示的会话分组分区：支持自定义多层嵌套分组、把会话拖进分组、调整分区高度；不修改 Host 的工作区归属与会话所有权。

items.de: A free-form grouping layer for the DSH sidebar: nest sessions from different workspaces into draggable groups without changing workspace membership or logs.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏官方工作区管理之上增加一层独立自由分组：不同工作区的会话可归入同一多层分组，支持拖拽、搜索、恢复和可选 AI 控制，不改变原工作区归属与日志。

items.de: Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.
items.dz: 预防并发写导致的会话损坏：在会话开始及每一步获取按会话的咨询锁，第二个 dsh 进程会明确报错而非写出重复 seq 断层；死进程持有的锁自动接管。

items.de: Sidebar search across every past Session: literal substring matching that works for Chinese, results grouped per Session with highlighted snippets, and one click to reopen the conversation.
items.dz: 侧栏全局搜索历史对话：字面子串匹配（中文可用），结果按会话分组并高亮命中片段，点一下跳回那个会话。

items.de: Shows a six-character session id badge next to the conversation title in the DSH web UI; clicking it copies the full session id and shows a short confirmation.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 界面的对话标题旁显示 6 位 session id 徽标，点击即复制完整 session id 并给出短暂提示。

items.de: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
items.dz: 在会话行的「⋯」菜单里补上复制会话 ID，以及永久删除会话（日志、投影缓存与工作区引用），删除前有二次确认。

items.de: Compact top tools, untitled inbox and lower Working/Settled shelves; native menus, search highlighting, keyboard navigation, metadata backups and an original-layout switch. Chinese UI. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: macOS Desktop verified; Windows Desktop checked for cold starts, compact/original layouts at 128
items.dz: 顶部工具区与原布局切换，上方直接查看会话，下方收纳工作中与已整理；支持原生菜单、搜索高亮、键盘操作及整理备份。中文界面。DSH 0.2.1-rc.5：macOS 桌面版已验证；Windows 桌面版已检查冷启动、1280×820 与 1471×1200 下的紧凑/原布局、搜索、项目筛选和原生会话菜单。Linux 及任意第三方插件组合仍未验证。

items.de: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
items.dz: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

items.de: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).
items.dz: 零 UI 侵入的 DeepSeek Harness 会话意图自动分类命名插件，新会话自动生成前缀图标与主题（优化、修复、功能、探索等 8 类意图）。

items.de: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.
items.dz: 在侧边栏页面里列出 DSH 的会话记录与归档缓存，删除先移入可恢复的回收站，最近 10 分钟仍在写入的会话会被拒绝。

items.de: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

items.de: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
items.dz: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

items.de: DSH session workflows for packaging verifiable capsules, evaluating reusable Skills, and comparing controlled session trajectories.
items.dz: 用于打包可验证会话、评测可复用技能和对比受控会话轨迹的 DSH 工作流。

items.de: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.
items.dz: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

items.de: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

items.de: Live preview inside the sidebar session hover card: what the session is doing right now (running tool with elapsed time, thinking, last tool duration), an attachment thumbnail with click-to-enlarge, the latest user prompt and assistant reply with injected system scaffolding stripped out, a recent-to
items.dz: 侧边栏会话悬停卡片里的实时预览：这个会话此刻在干什么（正在跑的工具与已运行时长、思考中、上次工具耗时）、附件缩略图点击放大、剥掉注入壳子后的最近一问一答、最近工具图标条、轮数 · token 合计 · 模型名一行概况，外加一个写入 profile 的 12 项设置页。

items.de: A lock button on every sidebar session row; archiving a locked session through the client-side workspaces.archiveSession — the ⋮ menu, or another plugin calling the same client method — is refused with a notice, the lock list is persisted on the host, and a host route bulk-archives inactive sessions
items.dz: 侧栏每个会话行上的锁按钮：锁定的会话经客户端 workspaces.archiveSession 归档时（⋮ 菜单，或其它插件调用的同一方法）会被拦下并提示；锁清单持久化在宿主侧，另有批量归档不活跃会话的宿主路由，永远跳过已锁定的会话。直接打到宿主注册表的调用不在拦截范围内。

items.de: Agent-to-agent mail between DSH sessions on the same host. `send_session_message` delivers after the target's turn or injects into the running one, stamps the sender id itself and rejects forged From headers; every message carries an id, so replies quote it with replyTo, a thread stops the same task
items.dz: 同一宿主内 DSH 会话之间的代理传话。`send_session_message` 可等对方回合结束再送达、也可插进正在跑的回合；发信方 id 由插件自己写，伪造的 From 抬头会被拒；每条消息带 id —— 回信可用 replyTo 引用、thread 防止同一件事排队两次、supersedes 撤回尚未投递的旧消息。`read_session_info` 只读地看对方：标题、最后一轮回复、最后一次 present 的文件、以及忙闲与队列深度。

items.de: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.
items.dz: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，并在一个控制台里集中管理：单条删除、可筛选的批量清理与维护清扫。

items.de: Session manager and session settings for the DSH sidebar: sessions grouped by workspace with archive filters, title search, batch archive and a read-only transcript preview; global and per-workspace name, occupation and instructions injected into the system prompt; optional recent-only and hide-work
items.dz: DSH 侧栏的会话管理与会话设定：按工作区浏览会话，支持归档筛选、标题搜索、批量归档与只读预览；全局/工作区两级的称呼、职业与长期指令可注入系统提示；另有「只显示最近工作区」「隐藏工作区」两种侧栏过滤。

items.de: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.
items.dz: DSH Web 会话管理插件：在设置页查看全部与已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）、二次确认删除与对话内容预览。

items.de: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The canvas is reachable from a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs, and from a conversation tab that is off by default; it starts on the current session's own tree, gro
items.dz: 会话图谱：把 DSH 会话画成一张 fork 树画布，另在设置里加了一个「从 Git 克隆」页——填仓库地址、选存放目录（会记住上次选择、带原生目录选择器），按需打开浅克隆，克隆完自动添加为工作区。画布可从会话头部开关和右侧栏两个标签页打开，对话标签页默认关闭；默认只铺开当前会话所在的那棵树、自上而下生长，支持滚轮平移与 Ctrl/⌘ 滚轮缩放、隐藏子代理会话，另有一个会话概览页列出轮次、步骤、模型耗时、工具耗时、输出 token 与运行状态。

items.de: Adds a "Delete session" item under "Archive session" in the sidebar session menu: it detaches the session from memory, deletes its on-disk record and projection cache, and removes the row from the sidebar immediately. Permanent - there is no trash bin.
items.dz: 在侧边栏会话三点菜单的「归档会话」下面加一项「删除会话」：先把会话从内存里摘掉，再删磁盘记录与投影缓存，并立刻移除左侧那一行。永久删除，没有回收站。

items.de: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fi
items.dz: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

items.de: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话整理成一张自包含的交互式 HTML 脑图（主题、结论、决策、待办、未决问题），并给出与上一次生成相比的变更。

items.de: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subag
items.dz: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

items.de: Read-only monitor for local DSH sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im. Requires Python 3 with the zstandard package; IM push additionally needs the dsh-im plugin.
items.dz: 只读的本机 DSH 会话监视器：实时任务看板、会话事件尾随、阻塞等待回复、Markdown 导出，可选配合 dsh-im 推送 IM。需要 Python 3 与 zstandard 库；IM 推送需另装 dsh-im。

items.de: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting
items.dz: 在 Web UI 中把会话移动到其他文件夹、永久删除，或进行 AI 重命名——支持把会话行拖到文件夹标题上，也可从会话菜单操作。移动会重写会话头的 cwd、迁移持久化日志并更新工作区账目，历史随会话一起走；删除会先停止运行中的 agent，再移除日志、投影缓存行与工作区账目。同样提供三个 agent tools：workbench_session_move、workbench_session_delete、workbench_session_rename_ai。

items.de: Drags a session in the sidebar onto another project group to change the project it belongs to. It rewrites the workspace membership ledger and projects the read side (file tree, open folder, working directory) onto the new project, while the session's JSONL log, header and attachments stay in the or
items.dz: 把侧栏里的对话拖到另一个项目分组上，即可修改这段对话的所属项目：插件改 workspace 归属账本，并把读取侧（文件树、打开文件夹、工作目录）投影到新项目；会话的 JSONL 日志、header 与附件仍留在原项目目录，因此改动可逆、不碰档案。

items.de: Classifies each session from its first user message and prefixes the title with an emoji category (explore, research, fix, build, design, docs, config, qa, tidy), falling back to a local keyword rule when the model call fails.
items.dz: 根据会话首条消息判断任务类型，为标题加上「emoji + 分类」前缀（探索、研究、修复、研发、设计、文档、配置、问答、整理），模型调用失败时自动降级为本地规则。

items.de: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.
items.dz: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转；悬浮弹出/移出平滑关闭。

items.de: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JS
items.dz: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

items.de: Sidebar badge and desktop notification when a background session finishes while you are working in another project.
items.dz: 你在别的项目里工作时，后台会话跑完会在侧边栏显示角标并发出系统通知，点角标可直接跳到该会话。

items.de: One recency-sorted list of recent sessions across all workspaces, with color-coded workspace badges, a collapsible sidebar section, and the built-in session row actions on right-click.
items.dz: 把所有工作区的最近会话排成一个列表，用彩色底标标明所属工作区，侧栏可展开显示最近会话，右键支持原生会话操作。

items.de: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
items.dz: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

items.de: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at
items.dz: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

items.de: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

items.de: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool full-text searches past session logs with cwd-scoped authorization, a CJK substring fallback and a degraded raw-scan; every hit carries the sessionId plus the newest exported-report path, closing the loop with the export and eval pl
items.dz: 确定性跨会话转录检索：`recall` 工具全文搜索历史会话日志，带 cwd 授权边界、CJK 子串回退与降级直扫；每条命中携带 sessionId 与最新导出报告路径，与 export、eval 插件闭环。
