items.de: Checkpoint-and-resume for interrupted runs: when a conversation reaches a key step — two consecutive successful file writes/edits, or one successful test command — it appends a lightweight record (timestamp, step type, tool, ≤200-char argument summary, result status) to a local JSONL file, keeping t
items.dz: 中断续跑：对话走到关键节点时（连续两次成功的文件写入/编辑，或一次成功的测试命令），向本地 JSONL 追加一条轻量记录（时间、步骤类型、工具名、≤200 字参数摘要、结果状态），只保留最近 50 条并在 24 小时后过期。DSH 重启后，session_recovery 工具列出未完成的会话，恢复时新建会话，系统提示只携带最后三个检查点（≤500 字），而不是整段历史。

items.de: Adds two entries to the DSH web sidebar above the settings row: a batch picker that groups sessions by workspace, filters them by a search box and moves the selected ones into a recycle bin, and a recycle bin that restores sessions one by one or all at once, or permanently deletes them. The recycle
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏、设置按键上方加两个入口：「批量删除」按工作区分组并支持搜索，勾选后把会话移入回收站；「回收站」可逐个或全部恢复，也可逐个或清空彻底删除。回收站名录存在浏览器存储里，通过外包宿主的会话可见性判断来隐藏行，因此不复用侧边栏自带的归档；移入后会话日志仍在磁盘上，彻底删除才调用宿主的删除接口。正在运行的会话会被拒绝移入并在面板里说明。

items.de: Delete a conversation record from the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a trash bin to restore or purge it. Both this and zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里真正删除会话记录：带可恢复、可彻底清除的回收站。本插件与 zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

items.de: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.
items.dz: 可回滚的 DSH Desktop 会话引用体验补丁安装器——@ 菜单当前工作区优先、标题优先展示、两行布局，以及侧边栏拖拽会话到输入区形成引用。

items.de: One main session coordinates several root sessions: a /relay command and 15 peer_* tools for batched status reports, a version-line notice, task-board claims, handoff and wake, repository watch, read-only session inspection, and a web panel. Phone notifications need the DSHA device bridge.
items.dz: 由一个主会话协调多个平级会话：/relay 命令与 15 个 peer_* 工具，支持合并汇报、版本线公告、任务看板认领、交接与唤醒、仓库守候、只读查看会话，并带 Web 面板；手机通知需要 DSHA 设备桥。

items.de: Gives the model a rename_session tool, so the agent can retitle a session from inside the conversation.
items.dz: 给模型一个 rename_session 工具，让 agent 在对话中直接重命名会话。

items.de: Adds one agent tool that renames the current session, keeps the title across resume and paging, and stops automatic titles for it.
items.dz: 给智能体增加一个为当前会话改名的工具，标题在恢复与翻页后保留，并停止自动生成标题。

items.de: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
items.dz: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

items.de: Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.
items.dz: 为 DSH 增加重启和停止控制、基于令牌的重连，以及用于恢复中断 Web 会话的策略。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.
items.dz: 在每次 DSH 成功 Compact 后轮换对外 LLM 会话 ID，而不创建新的 DSH 会话。

items.de: Turns the buttons at the end of each sidebar session row into a configurable row: every action of the official "…" menu can be ticked as a hover button and reordered by dragging, and right-clicking a row opens the official "…" menu (pin / rename / fork / archive / copy session ID). The hover-button
items.dz: 把侧栏会话行悬停时行尾那排按钮变成可配置的一排：官方「…」菜单里的动作都能勾成悬浮按钮并拖动排序，在行上右键直达官方「…」菜单（置顶 / 重命名 / 分叉 / 归档 / 复制 Session ID）；悬浮按钮与「更多菜单」两个列表各自独立排序，配置在本插件自己的页面里。

items.de: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt; exposes an agent tool and a standalone panel. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
items.dz: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

items.de: Agent-facing keyword search over local DSH session logs: session_search returns matching sessions with timestamps and excerpts, session_read dumps one conversation, and both skip injected context such as memory snapshots; no index is built.
items.dz: 面向模型的历史会话关键字检索：session_search 返回命中的会话、时间与上下文片段，session_read 导出单个会话的对话，两者都跳过记忆快照等注入内容；不建索引。

items.de: Session bus for DSH: independent sessions in one project message each other by session id or registered name and wake the target, with a sidebar inbox, unread badges, a roster verification tool, and a per-project switch that stays off until .dsh-bus.json opts in.
items.dz: DSH 会话总线：同一项目里的独立会话按 session id 或自注册名互相发消息并唤醒对方，带侧栏收件箱、未读标记、名册校对工具，以及默认关闭的项目级开关（由 .dsh-bus.json 开启）。

items.de: Names sessions as a category plus a short topic. A sidebar action reads the conversation, asks its model for the pair, and pre-fills an editable title; a smart_rename_session tool gives the same naming to the agent, which renames the session it runs in when the topic moves on.
items.dz: 把会话命名成「分类 · 主题」：侧边栏菜单读对话、让会话所用的模型给出分类与主题并预填可编辑的标题；另有一个 smart_rename_session 工具，让 agent 在话题切换时自己改名。

items.de: Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.
items.dz: 在每个回合边界为会话滚动保留校验过的备份：提升快照前先确认日志仍可加载，回合结束时若已损坏则绝不覆盖上一份好副本，dsh 启动不了时也能一条命令恢复。

items.de: Adds a decode-speed reading to each reply action row, right of the usage control: open it for the turn time breakdown, first-token latency, decode output, prefill, speed ranges and total usage. A setting can keep every message action row visible.
items.dz: 在每轮回复的操作行里增加显示解码速度（用量右侧），可以显示这一轮回复的时间构成与速度：回答耗时、首字延迟、解码输出、预填充、速度区间与总用量等。设置 → 通用 另有「始终显示消息操作行」开关，可以始终显示所有对话消息的操作行。

items.de: A status rail in the DSH title bar that lists the sessions needing you, ordered red (failed) > yellow (waiting for your answer) > green (unread) > blue (running) > gray (not started, meaning an unsent draft sits in that session's composer); one click jumps to the session. State changes raise Windows
items.dz: DSH 标题栏里的一条状态栏，按「红（失败）> 黄（等你回答）> 绿（未读）> 蓝（运行中）> 灰（未开始，即该会话输入框里有未发送草稿）」列出需要处理的会话，点一下直达；状态变化时弹 Windows 通知，打开该会话或回答提问后通知自动消失；任务栏按钮再用红黄绿状态点（ITaskbarList3.SetOverlayIcon）标出状态，窗口最小化或被遮住时也看得见。

items.de: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
items.dz: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

items.de: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
items.dz: 双向同步网页版与 DSH Desktop 桌面版之间的会话、工作区、设置与插件。

items.de: Browser-style Session tab bar for the DSH Web GUI - one tab per Session in a full-width strip at the top of the window, Sessions grouped per Workspace in collapsible boxes, tabs created only for the Sessions you actually open.
items.dz: 给 DSH Web GUI 的浏览器式顶部会话标签栏：窗口顶部一条整宽标签，一个标签对应一个会话，会话按工作区收在可折叠的方框里，只有真正打开过的会话才会成为标签。

items.de: Deletes a whole DSH session or one completed turn from the session log: confirmation dialog, live-agent teardown, path and identity checks, pre-rewrite backup, and later turns renumbered.
items.dz: 删除整个 DSH 会话，或只删除会话中某一轮已完成的对话：带二次确认、运行中 Agent 安全停止、路径与身份校验、改写前备份，后续轮次自动顺延。

items.de: Wall-clock session and turn timing for the DSH Web GUI: a timer chip in the session header shows the session total, every finished turn shows its own duration above the action row, and a sidebar panel totals today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days or all sessions. The numbers are folded from turn/s
items.dz: 给 DSH Web GUI 的会话与轮次墙钟计时：会话标题栏的计时胶囊显示会话累计耗时，每轮结束后在操作行上方显示本轮耗时，侧边栏「会话耗时」面板按今天、近 7 天、近 30 天或全部汇总。数字由会话日志里的 turn/start 与 turn/end 折叠而来，翻页、压缩上下文、重启都不影响。

items.de: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
items.dz: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

items.de: Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
items.dz: 把 DSH 当前会话的对话记录重组成带大纲、章节层级和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档，而不是按时间顺序原样导出。三种入口：模型工具 session_to_doc、输入框按钮、仅回环的 Web 接口。

items.de: Shows a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, and stays quiet while a DSH window is focused.
items.dz: DSH 会话每轮结束时在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知；DSH 窗口在前台时自动跳过，避免打扰。

items.de: Floating todo panel for DSH sessions with server-side cross-device persistence and pending-task badges in the session list.
items.dz: 会话内悬浮待办面板，支持服务器端跨设备持久化及会话列表未完成任务图标。

items.de: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
items.dz: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

items.de: Adds delete and multi-select batch delete to the sidebar session menu, removing session chat logs with an automatic backup and one-click undo while leaving workspace files untouched.
items.dz: 在侧栏会话菜单新增删除与多选批量删除，连聊天记录一起删除（删前自动备份、可一键撤销），不改动工作区项目文件。

items.de: Lists every session stored in the local DSH profile with its title, workspace, last-modified time and size, then moves the selected ones to a 90-day trash you can restore or purge; deletion detaches the live session first, so the sidebar updates without restarting the app.
items.dz: 列出本地 DSH 配置中保存的全部会话（标题、工作区、最近修改时间、大小），把选中项移入保留 90 天的回收站，可随时还原或彻底删除；删除前会先摘掉宿主内存中的会话，侧栏无需重启应用即可刷新。

items.de: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
items.dz: 侧栏会话树 - 原生子代理树,外加可选的组织汇报层级;折叠分支计数,孤儿/环路防御。

items.de: Idle-time context truncation for a single DeepSeek Harness session. After a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped without a summary, so one long-lived session cannot leak one task into the next; it ships a per-session toggle, a tab next to the chat, and a /truncate comm
items.dz: 单个会话的空闲定时上下文截断：可配置空闲多少小时后整段丢弃较早的对话（不生成摘要），避免长期存活的会话把上一个任务带进下一个；带每会话开关、会话上方的「上下文截断」选项卡，以及 IM 桥接可直接驱动的 /truncate 命令。

items.de: Composer attach button for DSH Web: multi-file picks become inline draft capsules, files are stored under the workspace uploads root with an auto-extracted UTF-8 .txt sidecar (txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt, zero dependencies), and sent messages carry only the file name — never a raw path.
items.dz: DSH Web 输入框附件按钮：多选文件以内联草稿胶囊形式插入；文件存储到工作区 uploads 目录并自动生成 UTF-8 .txt 提取件（txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt，零依赖），任何纯文本 Agent 都能直接读取；发送消息只带文件名，不泄漏路径。

items.de: Session-first DSH sidebar: pinned, active and recent sections, workspace grouping, focus groups, search and a session trash bin.
items.dz: DSH 的会话优先左侧栏：置顶、活跃、最近分区，工作区分组，专注模式，搜索与会话回收站。

items.de: Adds an Open in new window action to the DSH session menu when paired with the repository's native Desktop shell patch.
items.dz: 配合仓库的原生 Desktop 壳补丁，为 DSH 会话菜单添加“在新窗口中打开”。

items.de: Gives each new DeepSeek Harness conversation started from the default workspace its own workspace directory and sandbox root (manually added project workspaces stay shared unless mode is set to all), with a composer toggle for the next conversation.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 默认工作区里新建的每个对话自动拥有独立工作区和沙箱根（手动添加的项目工作区默认保持共用，设 mode: all 才全部隔离），并在输入框旁提供临时开关。

items.de: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
items.dz: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

items.de: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
items.dz: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

items.de: Moves Settings out of the sidebar footer account menu into its own row at the top of the sidebar, hides the 新会话 new-session button, and hides the sidebar footer: the account launcher, the footer settings cell, and the plugin-runtime badge. Cmd/Ctrl+N still starts a session and Settings is still reac
items.dz: 把侧边栏「设置」从底部账号菜单移成顶部独立一行，隐藏「新会话」按钮，并隐藏侧边栏底部：账号菜单、底部设置单元与插件运行时条。Cmd/Ctrl+N 仍可新建会话，设置仍可打开。

items.de: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
items.dz: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

items.de: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
items.dz: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

items.de: Resize the Settings dialog and set its transparency from three sliders in General settings; the choice persists across restarts.
items.dz: 在「通用设置」里用三个滑动条调节设置弹窗的宽度、高度与透明度，重启后仍然保留。

items.de: Show or hide sidebar panel entries and add shortcuts to Settings sections.
items.dz: 控制侧边栏功能菜单的显示，并为设置页面添加快捷入口。

items.de: Backs up and restores the whole DSH profile through a private Git repository: profile configuration, per-plugin settings, skills, installed plugins and MCP servers, with one-click backup and restore and a restore point written before anything is overwritten.
items.dz: 通过一个私有 Git 仓库备份与恢复整个 DSH profile：profile 配置、各插件设置、技能、已装插件与 MCP 服务器，提供一键备份与恢复，并在覆盖任何内容之前先写一个还原点。

items.de: Exports the plugin profile together with selected $DSH_HOME files and browser localStorage into one JSON, imports it back after a per-file preview, and can run pnpm install to reinstall the listed plugins; the format is interchangeable with the dsh-market profile backup.
items.dz: 把插件清单与 profile 配置、选定的 $DSH_HOME 文件、浏览器 localStorage 导出成一份 JSON，按文件预览后导入，并可在 profile 目录执行 pnpm install 重装清单里的插件；格式与插件市场的 profile 备份互通。

items.de: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in
items.dz: 节点式 GLSL 工作台：在画布上连节点图并实时预览，编译成 Shadertoy 兼容的 GLSL（支持 BufferA–D 多 Pass 反馈与热重载），可跨编译导出 HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V，并在本地工作区管理项目、材质、快照与资源（图片 / 音频 / 歌词）。内置 57 个节点、8 个自带示例与 11 个 agent 工具，无运行时依赖。

items.de: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

items.de: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
items.dz: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

items.de: Serves this harness instance's Web GUI on a fixed port with device pairing and Cloudflare Access verification.
items.dz: 把当前实例的 Web 界面固定在一个端口上共享，支持设备配对与 Cloudflare Access 校验。
rl: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

items.de: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto Log trail, task=<id> routing, continuation re-injection, a compaction guard with clear-required alerts, and read-only subagent handling — all
items.dz: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份 .agents/state/,一个仓库多代理共享交接。

items.de: Team shared knowledge base: one member runs a zero-dependency Hub, everyone else installs this plugin and joins with one invite code. Uploads are filed into ten categories with a summary, confidence and points; 15 agent tools let members upload, search, recall, comment and read them. Important items
items.dz: 团队共享知识库：一个人在自己电脑跑零依赖 Hub，其他人装插件后粘一个邀请码即可加入。上传素材按十类归档，带摘要、置信度与要点；15 个 agent 工具支持上传、检索、聚合回顾、评论与阅读。标为重要的资料必须手写推荐语，并置顶到每位成员读过为止；每个账号还各有本地私有库、收藏夹、每周简报与版本对比。

items.de: Recurring Excel template fill and reconciliation review: declare the file, sheet, header row, match key and amount columns once, preview every cell write before it lands, compare amounts as exact two-decimal values, list the unmatched rows as exceptions, and export a filled template copy with an HTM
items.dz: 周期性 Excel 模板填充与对账复核：一次声明文件、工作表、表头行、匹配键与金额列，写入前逐格预览，按精确两位小数比较金额，把未匹配行列为异常项，最后导出填好的模板副本并附 HTML 报告与可回溯到源行的 JSON 轨迹。

items.de: An agent-writable spreadsheet editor inside DeepSeek Harness with formulas, formatting, CSV/Excel import, and export.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 里可由 agent 直接写入的电子表格编辑器：支持公式、格式、CSV/Excel 导入与导出。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Adds a sidebar panel that browses the 设记 Design Memory component library by asset type, with live previews, design tokens, and copyable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Component pages ship with the plugin; fonts and images load from the public library site.
items.dz: 在侧边栏增加设记 Design Memory 组件库面板：按资产类型浏览，支持实时预览、查看设计参数并复制 HTML/CSS/JS。组件页面随插件打包，字体与图片从公开资源库站点加载。

items.de: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose tra
items.dz: 在输入框用 /cmd <命令> 执行当前会话工作目录里的 shell 命令，把命令与输出作为一条 user 消息交给模型，并把这次输入渲染成带退出状态、可展开输出与复制按钮的终端卡片；裸 /cmd 则打开交互终端，Ctrl+Enter 把整段终端内容发给模型。默认以终端自身权限（danger-full-access）执行，设 `useSessionPolicy: true` 改用会话沙箱。

items.de: One DSH tool that runs a command on any execution surface the machine has -- WSL, MSYS2, Git Bash, PowerShell, nushell, interpreters, throwaway containers, ssh, real terminal windows and a real console -- and reports the version each one gives and the capabilities it has.
items.dz: 把机器上的执行面收成一个 DSH 工具：WSL、MSYS2、Git Bash、PowerShell、nushell、各语言解释器、一次性容器、ssh、真实终端窗口与真实控制台；每个面报出自己能给的版本，并标出它具备的能力。

items.de: Public-username checks over a pinned 481-site Sherlock manifest; six states, random negative-sample verification for claimed results, default core 41, all capped at 120, NSFW off by default.
items.dz: 基于固定 481 站点 Sherlock 清单检查公开用户名，返回六态结果，对 claimed 做随机负样本校验；默认 core 41，all 单次最多 120，NSFW 默认关闭。

items.de: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for
items.dz: 项目收尾时生成一张可公开的交付回执。`ship_receipt` 工具自己测量能测的、记录被告知的，再把每一条硬性分进三区：已验证（本次采集到、且能在别处复现的证据——真跑过的命令与退出码、已入版本库文件的哈希、确实扫到文件的扫描、本地记录的远端里存在的 git 引用）、仅本地（只在这台机器上成立——未提交改动、未推送提交、别人看不到的产物）、未验证（没有证据，包括人写的任何一句话）。没有证据的声明只留标签、正文留空，而不是把声明照原样印出来；回执里含分支与 commit、产物的字节数与 sha256（PNG 附带宽高），以及推送前三步检查的结论。

items.de: Evidence-first frontend release checks: real-browser content, accessibility, runtime, network, and baseline regression reports with screenshots.
items.dz: 证据优先的前端交付验收：用真实浏览器检查内容、无障碍、运行时错误、网络失败与结构基线，并保存截图报告。

items.de: A top-down arena shooter that lives in the DSH sidebar: an autopilot AI plays the blue whale-fish hero for you while the dsh-pet desktop pet narrates each wave out loud, and combos, boss waves every fifth wave, in-run upgrade choices, a local leaderboard, achievements, skins and a floating desk widg
items.dz: DSH 侧栏里的俯视角生存射击：AI 托管替你把蓝鱼主角打起来，dsh-pet 桌宠逐波解说并念出声；连杀倍率、每 5 波 Boss、局内三选一强化、本机排行榜、成就与皮肤，切面板后还能缩成右下角的小鱼挂件继续打——点一下摸摸它，双击展开画面。

items.de: Keyboard-driven quick switching for DSH — model palette with colored provider tags, suffix tags and pins, a two-column session palette with per-question prompt preview and archived-session restore, recency-ordered session cycling, find-next-answered jump, composer focus, and configurable permission
items.dz: 键盘驱动的快速切换：模型面板（彩色提供方标签、后缀与推理标签、置顶）、两栏会话面板（提问预览、归档会话恢复）、按活动时间顺序的会话循环、查找下一个已回答的会话、聚焦输入框、可配置的权限循环，侧栏控制面板统一管理开关与改键。

items.de: Download watermark-free Douyin and Xiaohongshu videos, transcribe them with local or cloud speech recognition, proofread the text against a term list, and export Markdown, DOCX, SRT, VTT and other formats from a settings panel or agent tools. Needs Python 3.10+ with pip packages (playwright, python-
items.dz: 下载抖音和小红书无水印视频，用本地或云端语音识别转成文字、按术语表校正，并从设置面板或 agent 工具导出 Markdown、DOCX、SRT、VTT 等格式。需自备 Python 3.10+（pip 安装 playwright、python-docx、numpy，默认的本地 SenseVoice 引擎另需 sherpa-onnx 并在首次使用时下载约 228 MB 模型）、PATH 中的 ffmpeg，以及 Chrome 或 Edge。

items.de: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option
items.dz: 会话全部结束、后台任务也安静下来后自动执行电源动作（关机 / 重启 / 休眠 / 睡眠 / 锁定 / 注销）：插件每秒采样进程内会话，运行中的会话始终算「在忙」；后台任务检测是可配置项 considerJobs（默认开启，设置页直接显示当前计数）；确认窗口后进入可取消倒计时，右下角浮窗卡片显示当前阶段与剩余秒数并支持拖动；开关不会随宿主重启保留（重启后一律回到关闭），任何会话新启动或点取消都会中止倒计时；拿不到 agents 服务时一律按「在忙」处理，绝不触发。仅支持 Windows（使用系统自带 shutdown / rundll32），其他平台除 none 外均降级为 none。

items.de: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. Selecting part of an answer opens that conversation side chat with the passage quoted: the quote waits as a
items.dz: 在右侧边栏打开一个临时侧边对话，复用宿主原生会话界面，回答的 Markdown 渲染、工具步骤、用时与 Token 用量都与主对话一致；在主对话里选中一段回答，即可唤起该对话的侧聊并把选中内容作为引用胶囊停在输入框内，随下一条消息一起生效，并计入侧聊上下文。侧聊运行在独立的内存会话上：主对话快照只作为参考上下文，不写入会话日志。

items.de: Side chat for the DSH Web GUI with a /side slash command, forked from @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 0.7.0 and adding a host /side command, an open-request bridge, and approval pinned to never. It cannot be installed alongside the upstream @flyer103/dsh-side-chat — both register the same routes and side-ch
items.dz: DSH 网页版的侧聊面板与 /side 命令，基于 @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 0.7.0 的分支，新增宿主侧 /side 命令、开放请求桥接，并将审批固定为 never。不能与上游 @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 同装——两者注册相同的路由与侧聊标签页类型。

items.de: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
items.dz: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

items.de: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.
items.dz: DSH Desktop 侧栏余额行——在「版本 / 检查更新」下面显示账户余额与「充值」按钮，每 10 分钟或窗口重新聚焦时刷新，未登录与读取失败都有明确状态。

items.de: Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.
items.dz: 为 DSH 提供网页与小程序元素注释、折叠注释附件及源码定位。

items.de: Adds Notion-style auto-hide to the left and right DSH sidebars: hover the matching window edge to expand, move away to collapse, and click the sidebar button to pin it open.
items.dz: 为 DSH 左右侧边栏加上 Notion 式自动收起：指针移到窗口对应边缘时展开，移开后收起，点击侧边栏按钮可固定展开。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
items.dz: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Native agent control for the DSH right-sidebar browser: semantic snapshot with stable refs, clicks/typing/key presses, shadow DOM and same-origin iframes, recorded JS dialogs, full-page screenshots, back/forward, viewport resizing, and native large-file download/upload through the Electron webview.
items.dz: DSH 右侧栏原生浏览器的 Agent 控制：语义快照与稳定 ref、点击/输入/按键、Shadow DOM 与同源 iframe、JS 对话框记录、整页截图、前进/后退、视口尺寸调整，以及基于 Electron webview 的原生大文件下载/上传。页面内容操作需 DSH Desktop（Electron 原生 webview）；Web 版只能管理标签页。

items.de: Controls the Browser panel DSH renders in the right Sidebar: numbered refs from a snapshot, click/type/press/select/scroll, query-scoped reads and change diffs, up to 12 steps in one call, and multi-tab focus/close.
items.dz: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照返回编号控件，支持点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动，按问题检索阅读与变化对比，一次调用最多 12 步，并可切换和关闭多个标签。

items.de: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
items.dz: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

items.de: Docks the workspace and session list to the left, right, top or bottom edge, optionally folding it into a 5px edge band that expands on hover, with the reveal zone and the left rail width adjustable in Settings → General; the plugin rail, brand row and settings button stay where they are.
items.dz: 把工作区与会话记录列表停靠到左、右、上、下任意一边，可收成 5px 贴边细条、鼠标靠近再展开，触发范围与左栏宽度都能在设置里的通用项中调整；插件图标条、品牌行和底部设置钮留在原位。

items.de: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spin
items.dz: dsh 网页端侧边栏整体增强：长按拖拽重排面板图标栏，一个箭头即可整栏折叠；面板列表与置顶区都按整行限制高度（占侧栏 30%，向下取整行）；置顶会话区镜像原生行的实时状态（转圈、待回复、相对时间）；顶部会话视图标签可拖拽换位；归档会话按时间新到旧沉到每组末尾；分叉出的子会话自动跟进父会话所在的置顶区；并把任意插件注册在侧栏底部的入口提升到同一栏内。每个子系统各自带启动守卫，单个失败只返回 null，不影响整个插件挂载。

items.de: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
items.dz: 按实际运行状态排序与折叠 DSH 左侧栏：有会话开跑的工作区浮到最前，会话跑完仍留在原位，只有最近活跃的 N 个工作区保持展开；六个开关加一个数量控制各条规则。

items.de: Folds every panel row in the sidebar (slot-registered and plugin-injected alike) into one Plugin Hub entry, giving the workspace list its vertical space back.
items.dz: 把侧边栏里所有面板行（slot 注册与插件直接注入两类）折叠成单独一行「插件大全」，把被挤掉的工作区高度还给会话列表。

items.de: Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.
items.dz: 在侧栏面板图标上方加一行可折叠的标题。点一下收起图标，再点一下展开，选择会记住。折叠是纯 CSS 做的，所以你以后新装的插件图标也会一起收进去。不依赖任何其它插件。

items.de: Fold the DSH left sidebar's plugin entries into a single 「插件列表」 row with grouping and custom ordering, giving vertical space back to the workspace and session list; expanding restores the full entry list.
items.dz: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，支持按组归类与自定义顺序，把纵向空间还给工作区与会话列表；展开即恢复完整入口。

items.de: Stacks the sidebar footer actions into one full-width row each, and lines their icons up on one left edge.
items.dz: 把侧边栏底部的动作按钮改成一行一个、铺满整行，并让各行的图标落在同一条竖线上。

items.de: A sidebar plugin wall with local automatic grouping, drag-and-drop organization, search, and configurable compact footer components. Replaces the built-in sidebar.
items.dz: 提供本地自动分组、拖动整理、搜索与可配置紧凑底部组件的侧栏插件墙。会替换内置侧栏。

items.de: Make the right sidebar Start page scroll when its tool cards overflow.
items.dz: 右侧栏「开始」页的工具卡片超出可视区域时让页面可滚动，并按需显示滚动条。

items.de: Adds a Home panel to the sidebar for choosing a workspace; focus mode then shows only that workspace's sessions and folds the other workspaces below, and exiting focus restores the shipped sidebar.
items.dz: 在侧栏新增「主页」面板用于选择工作区；进入专注后侧栏只显示该工作区的会话，其他工作区折叠在底部，退出专注即恢复原生侧栏。

items.de: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
items.dz: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

items.de: Turns the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel entries and footer entries into one row of icon-only squares with hover names, adds four icon-size presets, per-entry show/hide switches and up/down ordering, and puts a Settings shortcut in the footer row.
items.dz: 把 DSH 侧栏的面板入口与底部入口改成只显示图标的并排方块，悬停显示名称；提供四档图标大小、逐项显隐开关与上下排序，并在底部加一个设置入口。

items.de: Sidebar panel that lists every plugin installed in the current profile and gives each one an enable/disable switch.
items.dz: 侧边栏面板：列出当前 profile 已安装的插件，每行带一个启用/停用开关。

items.de: Turn the seam between the sidebar panel list and the workspace list into a divider you can drag, snapping one row at a time, with the panel list scrolling when squeezed.
items.dz: 把左侧栏「面板列表」与「工作区」之间的交接做成按行磁吸的可拖动分隔条，面板列表被压小时自动出滚动条。

items.de: Shows the mode (agent preset) each Session runs under as a colored pill in the left sidebar, with a settings page for per-mode dot colors.
items.dz: 在左侧栏的会话行显示该会话运行的模式（agent preset）胶囊，并可在设置页按模式配置圆点颜色。

items.de: Fold the left sidebar panel entries into a More menu, freeing height for the workspace and session list; entries can be opened from the menu, restored in one click, and the choice persists across reloads. First install folds Taskboard, QQ Bot, Context Insights and SSH, and newly installed plugins fo
items.dz: 把左侧栏的面板入口收进「更多」菜单，给下方工作区与会话列表腾出高度；入口可从菜单打开、一键全部还原，选择跨刷新保留。首次安装默认收起任务看板、QQ 机器人、上下文洞察与 SSH，之后新装的插件也默认收进「更多」（可关）。

items.de: Let the model read the current session's sidebar: the active tab, open tabs, terminal screens and browser page text (page text is desktop only; the terminal channel needs DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2).
items.dz: 让模型按需读取当前会话的侧边栏：当前选中标签、打开的标签、终端屏幕与浏览器网页正文（网页正文仅桌面端；终端通道需 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2）。

items.de: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
items.dz: 在桌面版侧边栏底部、「设置」旁边新增一个「重启」按钮，重启应用，并在页面重连后加载到刚安装的插件包。

items.de: Shares sidebar navigation scrolling with Projects lists; supports native workspace scroll handoff and legacy outer scrolling (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1).
items.dz: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 侧栏共享滚动：功能菜单与 Projects 列表共用滚动区，工作区支持原生滚动接力或旧版外层滚动。

items.de: Recent-first session sidebar with user groups, workspace tree, archive bucket, status dots and drag reorder.
items.dz: 最近优先的会话侧边栏：自定义分组、工作区树、归档、状态点与拖动排序。

items.de: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.
items.dz: 在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前新增「设置」一行，点击即打开原生设置面板。

items.de: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows, plugin-injected entry rows (own and third-party alike), and bottom entries — into a single menu button whose secondary menu triggers each entry
items.dz: 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方被各插件塞满的入口行——全局面板行、插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）、底部入口——统统收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；想常驻的加名称白名单即可，侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮自动变纯图标。

items.de: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
items.dz: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

items.de: Hides the sidebar's global panel navigation (Plugins / Market / Schedules / More) and gives the vertical space back to the session list; three modes, switchable in Settings → Sidebar.
items.dz: 隐藏侧栏顶部的全局导航（插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 更多），把垂直空间还给会话列表；三档模式，在 设置 → 侧栏 里切换。

items.de: Keeps DeepSeek usage and account balance in a bar at the bottom of the window.
items.dz: 在窗口底部常驻显示 DeepSeek 用量与账号余额。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A right-Sidebar video player with a folder playlist (first-frame thumbnails, duration badges, sort by name/duration/modified/size, fullscreen, and a context menu for rename/copy/delete/refresh when the folder is opened with write access), live playback telemetry (buffered range, decoded FPS, dropped
items.dz: 右侧栏视频播放器：文件夹播放列表支持首帧缩略图、时长、按名称/时长/修改时间/大小排序、全屏，以及写权限文件夹下的重命名/复制/删除/刷新右键菜单；同时显示缓冲区间、解码帧率与丢帧，并只读解析 MP4/MOV 的编码档次/级别、精确帧数、每轨码率与旋转；不注册智能体工具，文件写入仅在用户以写权限选择文件夹后通过浏览器 File System Access API 执行。

items.de: DeepSeek balance and today's spend from the official usage export, in one line at the right end of the DSH sidebar account row; hovering opens a card with requests, tokens and the peak/off-peak countdown.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏账户行最右端一行显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日消费（官方用量口径），悬停展开请求数、token 与峰谷倒计时卡片。

items.de: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.
items.dz: 调整 Web UI 左侧会话列表栏宽度：调低 264px 拖动下限，可选调整拖动上限与展开默认宽度，启动时自动修补 ui-layout bundle。

items.de: Temporary side conversations seeded from the main context, with quoted questions, main-task status updates, and replies returned to the main draft.
items.dz: 继承创建时主线上下文的临时侧聊，支持引用提问、主线状态提醒与回复回传草稿。

items.de: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.
items.dz: 从主会话分叉独立侧聊，支持原生会话渲染、划选注释和结论回流。

items.de: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面的 Codex 式右侧面板——会话产物浏览（文件树、扫描收录、预览、访达定位）+ 继承当前会话上下文的侧聊，支持模型选择器、拟人化定时调用、发送吸顶与智能滚动。

items.de: Right-sidebar browser for DSH Web: renders public sites over CDP, local/dev pages through a same-origin proxy, emulates desktop and phone viewports, and turns element picks into chat annotations. Fork of zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser (MIT), install one or the other — both add their own right-side
items.dz: DSH Web 的右侧栏浏览器：经 CDP 渲染公开网站，本地/开发页面经同源代理访问，可模拟桌面与手机视口，并把元素点选转成聊天批注。fork 自 zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser（MIT），两者二选一安装——都会新增自己的右侧栏浏览器标签页并驱动各自独立的 Chromium。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 至 0.2.x、Node.js 22.19+，以及宿主机上的 Chromium 系浏览器（自动检测，或设置 chromePath）。

items.de: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer tha
items.dz: 界面角落里的一只小宠物，读的是真实事件流而不是猜：空闲时慢慢飘，agent 思考时动得更快，每个正在运行的工具调用拉一条流动的连线，出错时变红、抖一下并显示错误摘要，跑超过十秒的回合结束时庆祝。它同时就是那个一眼可见的忙碌/出错指示器，不用再盯着转圈。宿主半区把真实 harness 事件折叠成快照，客户端半区只负责画；它不做内容识别，并且会主动避开输入框，不会趴在你正在打字的地方。

items.de: Imports SillyTavern AI presets as switchable, editable prompt layers: preserves the raw JSON, edits prompt order and sampler parameters, previews the injected System Prompt, exports back to SillyTavern-compatible JSON, and archives or permanently deletes presets with confirmation. Applies temperatur
items.dz: 把 SillyTavern 的 AI 预设导入为可切换、可编辑的提示词层：保留原始 JSON，编辑提示词顺序与采样参数，预览最终注入的 System Prompt，导出为 SillyTavern 兼容 JSON，并支持归档或经二次确认永久删除。仅把 temperature 与最大输出 token 应用到 Harness 请求；其余采样字段只保留并随导出保存。

items.de: Folder-style session panel: organize sidebar sessions into your own folders with drag-to-assign, per-session aliases and archived dimming. Display-only — it never touches DSH grouping.
items.dz: 文件夹式会话面板：把侧栏会话装进自建文件夹，支持拖拽归类、会话别名与归档变淡；只做显示，不改 DSH 自己的分组。

items.de: Shows account balance, current peak/off-peak token price and today's spend in the dsh sidebar; today's spend is read from the local dsh-cost-meter ledger (~/.dsh/.dshw-usage.json), so it shows a dash until dsh-cost-meter is installed.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏显示账户余额、当前时段单价与今日已用金额；今日已用读自本机 dsh-cost-meter 账本（~/.dsh/.dshw-usage.json），未安装 dsh-cost-meter 时该项显示为「—」。

items.de: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.
items.dz: 在侧边栏账户区上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前会话累计花费与逐轮费用，并对超出 token 阈值的单轮提供一键 AI 分析。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.
items.dz: 只用一个插件就可以手机访问 DSH——需本机与手机都装好并连上 Tailscale，没有额外设置。

items.de: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
items.dz: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

items.de: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Git Worktree，提供分支删除控制和指定工作区管理。

items.de: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.
items.dz: Web 界面清理：清理模式下悬浮元素右键即可移除，刷新后依然生效，设置页中可原样恢复。

items.de: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
items.dz: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

items.de: Talk to DeepSeek Harness through Siri and iPhone Shortcuts: a bearer-key POST /siri endpoint on your computer answers each spoken request for Siri to read aloud, with a settings page (key, port, workspace, model, Agent Preset, rate limit, allowed addresses), optional DS Bot routing, and a ready-made
items.dz: 用 Siri 和 iPhone 快捷指令对话 DeepSeek Harness：电脑上的 POST /siri 接口（Bearer 密钥鉴权）回答每一句语音请求并交给 Siri 朗读，附设置页（密钥、端口、工作区、模型、Agent Preset、限频、来源地址）、可选的 DS Bot 路由和现成的快捷指令。

items.de: Browser bridge for DeepSeek Harness: captures page markup (DOM with boxes and computed styles, selector candidates checked for uniqueness) and the site's own xhr/fetch calls with headers and bodies, redacting credential-shaped values on ingest, into workspace files — then drives the page with truste
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器桥接：把页面结构（带盒子与计算样式的 DOM、经过唯一性校验的选择器候选）与站点自身的 xhr/fetch（含请求头与请求体，凭据形态的值在写入时脱敏）抓取为工作区文件，再用可信 CDP 输入驱动页面验证抓取结果。包含 11 个工具与使用浏览器自身会话的 MV3 扩展。需 Chrome/Edge 125+，扩展需手动加载并用本机 token 配对。

items.de: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
items.dz: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

items.de: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text
items.dz: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

items.de: Skill and plugin audit console for DeepSeek Harness. It scans local skill folders and installed DSH plugins, checks the packaging rules that commonly break installation, scores each asset, and exports a Markdown fix report.

items.de: Skill cockpit page in the DSH app-level nav (sidebar.panellist seat): lists every skill this machine actually exposes across all six skill-root kinds, explains why a skill is invisible (dropped reason, missing root, or disabled), and toggles one skill by renaming only its entry file (SKILL.md and SK
items.dz: DSH 应用级导航里的「技能中心」页（sidebar.panellist 席位）：列出本机实际暴露的全部技能（覆盖六类技能根），说明某技能为何不可见（被丢弃的原因、根目录缺失、已停用），只改入口文件名（SKILL.md 与 SKILL.md.disabled）即可单独启停；项目级技能根保持只读。

items.de: One-shot DSH skill (SKILL.md) generator: capture intent, draft, validate, package and distribute skills from inside a DeepSeek Harness session (skill_new / skill_validate / skill_package / skill_improve_description).

items.de: Invoke DSH skills with a $name gesture instead of /name, with a composer picker and the same blue text-reference decoration as /name.
items.dz: 用 $name 手势调用 DSH skill（与 / 命令不冲突），带输入框候选菜单，并让 $name 获得与 /name 相同的蓝色文本引用高亮。

items.de: Skill dossier + work report for DSH: browse, search and archive each skill (direction, scope, boundaries, scenarios), review or delete it, and roll daily briefs into daily, weekly and monthly reports.
items.dz: DSH 技能档案与工作汇报：浏览、搜索并为每个技能建档（方向/使用范围/能力边界/应用场景），复审与删除技能，并把每日简报汇成日报/周报/月报。

items.de: Folds the DSH skill catalog prompt surface with KV-cache-stable rendering, BM25/bge-m3 hybrid skill search, and optional auto route hints.
items.dz: 折叠 DSH 技能目录提示面：KV 缓存稳定渲染 + BM25/bge-m3 混合技能检索 + 可选自动路由提示。

items.de: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gestu
items.dz: 输入框技能分组选择器：🧩按钮弹出按场景分组（科研、办公、数据、写作、媒体、开发）的技能面板，新装技能自动分类，中文说明、搜索与双层下钻，点选即插入 /技能名 手势。

items.de: Group skills into named sets, toggle any combination, drag to reorder, and preview each group catalog token cost.

items.de: Skill usage history rebuilt from local session logs, with per-day counts, session drill-down and custom groups.
items.dz: 从本机会话日志回填的技能使用历史：按天计数、下钻到会话、自定义分组。

items.de: Skill center: browse and manage local Agent Skills, and search, preview and install skills from the ClawHub, ModelScope and QwenPaw marketplaces in one merged view with source and category filters; ships a `skill_hub` tool so the agent can install skills itself.
items.dz: 技能中心：浏览与管理本地 Agent Skills，并在同一视图中搜索、预览、安装 ClawHub、ModelScope、QwenPaw 三个市场的技能，支持来源与分类筛选；同时提供 skill_hub 工具，让 agent 也能自助安装技能。

items.de: Skill manager with content-addressed version history: snapshots, per-file and line-level diff, rollback, zip export and import, and per-skill enable or disable.
items.dz: 带内容寻址版本历史的技能管理器：快照、逐文件与行级差异、回滚、zip 导入导出、按技能停用或启用。

items.de: Skill manager panel for DeepSeek Harness: scans the six workspace and user-level skill roots, files every skill into fifteen built-in type cards (and any types you create yourself), and lets you move a skill between types without editing its files. A model you pick writes a one-sentence Simplified C
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的技能管理面板：扫描工作区与用户级共六个技能根目录，把全部技能归进十五个内置类型卡片（也可自建类型），并能在不改动技能文件的前提下把技能改归到别的类型。可选指定模型为每个技能写一句中文说明，也能根据类型名与该类型下的技能为自建类型画图标；另外给出技能之间的正文引用关系，并用 SkillHub 与上游 git 源检查已安装版本。

items.de: Standalone Skills page for dsh: lists every skill with an enable switch at global, project or session scope, keeps unchecked skills out of the model catalog, and sorts them into named categories.
items.dz: dsh 技能管理页：列出全部技能，按全局、本项目、本会话三级开关，取消勾选的技能不进模型目录，并可按自建分类整理。

items.de: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; s
items.dz: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

items.de: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from settings: list, search, view rendered docs, copy content, open the folder, soft-delete to a recoverable trash, and try a skill out.
items.dz: 在设置中管理 DSH 已安装技能：列表、搜索、查看渲染后的文档、复制内容、打开文件夹、软删除到可恢复的回收站、立即试用。

items.de: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile
items.dz: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

items.de: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.

items.de: Skill management panel inside DeepSeek Harness settings: lists global and per-project skills, marks whether the running DSH actually loads each one, offers one switch that controls both model and slash-command invocation, previews and edits SKILL.md with the chat UI markdown renderer, and creates, i

items.dz: 输入框旁的技能面板：把已安装的技能按中文分类列出，可按名字或用途搜索，并根据你正在写的草稿推荐最多三个相关技能。

items.de: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, appends the selection to the composer in one click, and can pin skills and prompts as always-on context injected through the system prompt.
items.dz: 在右侧栏列出当前会话可用的 Skill，支持搜索与标签，可与自存提示词组合后一键追加到输入框；还能把 Skill 与提示词设为常驻，经系统提示注入每个新对话。

items.de: Skill quick-pick panel for the composer: lists the session's skills by source, inserts /name into the draft without sending it, and can disable, uninstall or track usage per skill. items.de: Skill usage radar for DeepSeek Harness: records every skill hit from the skill tool and /name gestures into a local JSONL ledger, ranks skills by hits in the last 7 days, greys out zero-hit skills with an archive suggestion, and expands a row into time, session, trigger and prompt. Ships a conversat
items.dz: 给 DSH 的技能面板加一列「命中记录」：从 skill 工具调用与 /name 手势记下每次命中的时间、会话、触发词与提示词到本地 JSONL，按最近 7 天命中数排序，零命中的技能灰显并标「建议归档」，展开行可查看命中明细。带会话视图「技能雷达」面板、frontmatter 模型调用开关、新建技能、以及走 .trash 的可恢复归档。52 个零依赖测试；只监听 loopback，无外部网络。

items.de: Adds SKILL.md bundles from nested subfolders of the standard DSH skill roots to the catalog, with settings for depth, watching, and extra roots.
items.dz: 把标准 DSH 技能根目录下嵌套子文件夹中的 SKILL.md 技能包加入目录，并可在设置中调整深度、监听和额外根目录。

items.de: Skill routing for DeepSeek Harness: embeds skills and each user task with a local model, keeps the clearly-relevant skills with a gap-based selection rule, and auto-injects their full bodies into the prompt.

items.dz: 用唯一 kebab 片段解析斜杠 skill，例如 /oneshot 可加载 game-package-oneshot。

items.de: Codex-compatible Skill Studio with a left-sidebar page for browsing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and invoking SKILL.md skills; bridges ~/.codex/skills and project .codex/skills into DSH and supports $skill-name invocation in chat.

items.de: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.

items.de: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by
items.dz: 给 dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的技能卡片加中文说明：展开卡片时显示一句话中文速览、分类标签和几条要点，面板原本渲染的英文描述折进「原文」按钮。手写映射表里没有的英文技能，由宿主用你当前的默认模型按需现场生成并落盘缓存，缓存按原文哈希失效，所以新装的技能不用再手工补条目。技能自带描述已是中文的自动跳过。

items.de: One page for every skill on your machine: lists what DSH, WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Codex and Doubao have installed, imports any of them as a DSH skill, and discovers more on GitHub or the ClawHub directory (sorted by real downloads). Experts can be attached per session with a per-turn avatar header.

items.de: Manage local skills across AI agents with version comparison, shared-directory consolidation, and recoverable migration and deletion.
items.dz: 管理多个 AI Agent 的本地技能，支持版本比较、合并到公用目录，以及可恢复的迁移和删除。

items.de: Shows what each installed skill costs in the model context and hides a skill from the catalog without deleting it. Lists every skill found on disk with the exact catalog line the model receives (description normalized and truncated at the catalog cap), its body size and token estimate; previews the
items.dz: 显示每个已安装 skill 在模型上下文中占多少，并能在不删除文件的前提下把它从目录里摘掉。按 DSH 的渲染规则给出模型实际看到的那一行（介绍归一化并按目录上限截断）、正文体积与 token 估算；可逐字预览模型将收到的目录消息，与会话里已发布的那份比对，并列出来自磁盘却进不了目录的 skill（frontmatter 无效，或被更高优先级的同名 skill 覆盖）。隐藏会写入 disable-model-invocation 并保留文件，skill 仍可通过 /名字 调用。同时支持从 ClawHub、Skills.sh 与 GitHub 链接导入，以及卸载用户目录下的 skill。

items.de: DSH composer UI for searching current-session user-invocable skills and inserting the verified slash command into the draft without sending.
items.dz: DSH composer 界面：搜索当前会话可手动调用的 Skill，并将宿主可识别的斜杠命令写入草稿，不自动发送。

items.dz: 荧光绿的深空主题：双角色立绘、九宫格对话框外壳，黑底配荧光绿描边。
