items.de: Interface theme and wallpaper plugin: preset skins, gradients, image wallpapers, and local video wallpapers with a playlist, prev/next buttons and fullscreen playback. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; videos whose audio Chromium cannot decode need ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH, otherwise they play silently.
items.dz: 界面换肤与壁纸插件：预设皮肤、渐变、图片壁纸，以及本地视频壁纸（播放列表、上一个/下一个、双击全屏，自动为 Chromium 解不了的音轨生成 AAC 侧车）。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1；视频里 Chromium 解不了的音轨需要 PATH 里有 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe，没有时视频无声。

items.de: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.
items.dz: /new 指令：在当前工作区打开空白会话（已有空会话可直接复用），并把原会话的权限预设与 Agent 预设带入新会话，开新会话不会悄悄改变代理的可用权限。

items.de: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it tha
items.dz: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

items.de: Counts down to 23:30 on workdays in a strip under the composer of the DSH web UI, turning yellow under one hour and red under ten minutes, plays a three-chime alert at the deadline with snooze and dismiss buttons, and a mute toggle persisted in localStorage.
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页端输入框下方显示工作日 23:30 的睡觉倒计时:不足 1 小时变黄、不足 10 分钟变红,到点播放三组钟声提醒,可再等 10 分钟或关闭,喇叭按钮可静音,设置存于 localStorage。

items.de: Creates and edits presentations in DeepSeek Harness and exports editable PPTX files.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中生成和编辑演示文稿，并导出可编辑的 PPTX 文件。

items.de: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
items.dz: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

items.de: Two small macOS features in one plugin. keepAwake stops the display and system from sleeping while dsh runs (caffeinate tied to the host process). taskNotify posts a system notification when a top-level conversation finishes its turn, with the outcome (completed, error, blocked, output cap) and the
items.dz: 一个插件里的两个 macOS 小功能。keepAwake：dsh 运行期间不让屏幕和系统休眠（caffeinate 跟随宿主进程，dsh 退出即解除）。taskNotify：主对话一轮结束时发系统通知，写明结果（完成、出错、被拦截、输出达到上限）和用时；点击通知会切回 DeepSeek Harness。点击切回需要 Xcode Command Line Tools 构建通知助手；没有工具链时仍会提醒，但点击打开的是「脚本编辑器」。子智能体和 Agent Teams 成员不提醒，你手动停止的任务默认不提醒。两个功能可以分别关闭。

items.de: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.
items.dz: 缓存优先的上下文压缩，提供可选的自适应经济策略，默认仅观察，不保证缓存命中或费用节省。

items.de: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
items.dz: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

items.de: Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.
items.dz: 根据对话场景选择模型，并在请求失败时按候选链进行回退。

items.de: DSH SMOOTH: config-only bundle for a lighter DSH UI - compact transcript and usage views, 16 px font and 200 ms job polling out of the box - plus a troubleshooting SKILL.md and opt-in recipes (appended by hand to your own cordis.patch.yml or the profile) to remove the Agents-Anywhere "Reconnect" but
items.dz: DSH 顺滑包：纯配置 bundle，装上即把对话与用量视图精简为 compact、字号 16、任务轮询放缓到 200ms；另附排障 SKILL.md 和需手动启用的可选配方（追加到自己的 cordis.patch.yml 或手改 profile）：去掉 Agents-Anywhere 的「重新连接」按钮、精简工具表、移除不兼容的旧子代理、让压缩阈值真正生效。用户自己的 patch 优先，移除 bundle 即回滚。

items.de: Layered global and workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, with a web panel to browse entries and tune distillation and consolidation, an index kept in context with records loaded on demand, and a per-session choice of layer.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层的全局与工作区记忆：Web 面板中查看、控制条目并调整记忆整理与整合设置；索引常驻上下文、详情按需加载，每个对话手动选择要加载的记忆层。

items.de: Hangs a clothesline of polaroid photos under the DeepSeek Harness message composer, on the session page and the new-session home screen; photos from a local folder refresh within seconds and clicking one opens a lightbox preview.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 消息输入框下方挂一条拍立得照片晾衣绳（会话页与新会话首页都会出现）；可换成自己文件夹里的照片，几秒内自动刷新，点击照片打开灯箱预览。

items.de: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
items.dz: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

items.de: Manages CSS and JS snippets for the DSH web GUI, injecting enabled CSS as style elements and running enabled JS in the page, with a sidebar-footer quick toggle, its own page in the Settings navigation, and optional folder or Gist sync.
items.dz: 管理 DSH Web 界面的 CSS 与 JS 代码片段：启用的 CSS 注入为 style 元素，启用的 JS 在页面内执行；提供侧栏底部快捷开关，并在设置导航里有自己的页面，并可选本地文件夹监听与 Gist 同步。

items.de: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating note
items.dz: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

items.de: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 个性化设置：9 种回复风格、自定义指令、人设卡、会话级切换、带审计的长期记忆。

items.de: Persona, mood, long-term memory and per-person ledgers for a DSH agent, with a portable soul pack for moving between machines.
items.dz: 给 DSH 里的 AI 装上人设、心情、长期记忆和按人账本，并支持把整套灵魂打包迁移到另一台机器。

items.de: Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes; synthesized inside the page in two selectable styles with a volume setting — no popups, no OS notifications, no audio files, no network — and one bundle that covers DSH 0.1.7+ (des
items.dz: 会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音；页面内 Web Audio 现场合成，两种可选风格与音量可配，无弹窗、无系统通知、无音频文件、无网络请求，同一包同时支持 DSH 0.1.7+（桌面版/新版 Web）与 0.1.0-rc.6。

items.de: Plays a chime when any session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.
items.dz: 当任意会话的回复完成（上升音调）或提出问题/请求（下降音调）时播放提示音，带点击静音徽章。

items.de: Plays a sound when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches.
items.dz: 在 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权时播放提示音，并提供分类开关。

items.de: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categoris
items.dz: 双 MediaPlayer 守护进程（$think 思考循环 + $fx 一次性音效）支持音量闪避、情绪感知音效（连续成功/失败/长时间运行自动触发 smooth/struggle/deep_think）、15 种正弦/方波合成内置音、51 个工具分类映射、自定义 WAV/MP3 直替自动转换，以及完整设置页含深色模式修复。

items.de: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull
items.dz: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

items.de: Replaces the composer model picker with a compact panel for provider-to-model navigation and an adaptive reasoning-effort slider, with a Default stop and no slider for models without adjustable efforts.
items.dz: 将输入框的模型选择器替换为紧凑面板，支持来源到模型的逐级选择和自适应思考强度滑块，保留 Default 档位，不支持调节的模型隐藏滑块。

items.de: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard: appends user-held adjudication to the system prompt tail, redacts credentials and hidden carriers in tool results, and vetoes irreversible actions before they run. Applies to every agent preset.
items.dz: 宿主面主权条款与内容守卫：在系统提示词末节注入「用户裁定」条款，清洗工具结果里的凭据与隐蔽载体，按可逆性前置拦截不可逆操作。对全部 agent preset 生效。

items.de: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.
items.dz: 侧栏里的每个任务磁盘占用账本，可勾选回收无主垃圾；会话日志绝不被裁剪。

items.de: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alon
items.dz: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

items.de: Spanish practice panel for DeepSeek Harness: six locally graded drill types (verb conjugation across 11 tenses, noun gender, plurals, vocabulary recognition, sentence cloze, ser/estar and subjunctive grammar points) plus a model-graded scenario-writing tab, 8-level spaced repetition, and four agent
items.dz: 西语练习面板：六类本地判分的练习（11 个时态的动词变位、名词阴阳性、复数、认词、句子填空、ser/estar 与虚拟式语法专项），外加模型批改的情景造句、8 级间隔重复，以及四个 agent 工具；答案在插件内重算并判分，模型只用来讲解。

items.de: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh
items.dz: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to spark-scope.local:8787

items.de: Self-media workbench plugin: 8-tab dashboard (daily brief, narrative lines, topics, drafts, knowledge-card distill review, sources, publish, advice) with hard guards (48h window, event dedup, card/line existence, read-only advice) and a read-only intel module following the four red lines.
items.dz: 自媒体工作台插件：8 tab 看板（今日简报/叙事主线/选题/草稿/知识卡蒸馏审核/信息源/发布表现/系统建议），五守卫硬执行，VAULT 数据与代码分离，intel 模块只读接入并遵守四条红线。

items.de: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2—2020 control-chart constants.
items.dz: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图控制限与 CPK。

items.de: Strips AI phrasing and stock openers: adds a style section to the system prompt of every session (on by default, switch it off with deslop_mode), four deslop_* tools (scan, rewrite, mode, voice) and four skills that are copied into the DSH skills folder at startup, overwriting same-named SKILL.md fi
items.dz: 删掉 AI 腔与套话：在每个会话的 system prompt 里加一段风格层（默认开启，可用 deslop_mode 关闭），附带 deslop_* 四个工具（扫描、改写、档位、声音画像）和四个 skill，启动时会复制到 DSH 的 skills 目录，同名 SKILL.md 会被覆盖。

items.de: Point at one window and the AI reads only that window -- text, layout and small print. No full-screen fallback, and it still works when that window is covered by others. Windows 10/11 only.
items.dz: 只读你指定的那一个窗口：读字、看版式、看清小字；被别的窗口盖住也照样能读，绝不回退整屏。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

items.de: See the whole screen clearly: a 146-token overview map first, then 1:1 blocks up to 1400x900 so text is pixel-legible; a single sight_see tool with an on-screen eye toggle, measured against a 1600px host shrink limit. Windows only (it uses PowerShell); capture stays off until you click the eye.
items.dz: 一眼看清：先给一张 146 token 的整屏缩略地图，再按块 1:1 看清（单块上限 1400x900，字按原像素读），一个 sight_see 工具，界面上有一只眼睛随时开关；判据来自实测的 1600px 宿主缩图线。仅支持 Windows（依赖 PowerShell）；不点眼睛就不会截屏。

items.de: Adds a Speed setting (Standard, Fast, Ultrafast) for OpenAI and Codex models on a patched dsh build: the pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 web client needs the Model / Effort child-slot patch, the host pi-ai must be 0.87.1 or 1.1.0 (other versions refuse to load), and the terminal controls need a patched dsh
items.dz: 为 OpenAI 与 Codex 模型增加 Speed 设置（Standard／Fast／Ultrafast），但需要打过补丁的 dsh 构建：钉住的 dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web 客户端要加上 Model / Effort 子槽补丁，宿主 pi-ai 必须是 0.87.1 或 1.1.0（其他版本会拒绝加载），终端控制还需打过补丁的 dsh-TUI。满足条件后它会出现在 Model / Effort 菜单；在 dst 里 /speed 可打开选择器或直接设置，底栏显示当前档位。选择按会话、供应商和模型分别保存，并作为请求的 service tier 发送。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Chrome-style spell check for the dsh composer: the misspelled word under the caret gets a suggestion strip, and Tab accepts it. Local only — no network, no LLM, no telemetry.
items.dz: 给 dsh 输入框做像 Chrome 那样的拼写检查：光标所在的错词上方出现建议条，按 Tab 直接接受；错词下画蓝色波浪线，右键可看完整候选。完全本机运行，不联网、不调用模型。

items.de: Right-click menu inside the message composer: for the word under the cursor it checks a bundled English frequency dictionary of about 30,000 words plus a curated list of 182 common misspellings, and offers corrections ranked by edit distance and then word frequency. The same menu keeps add-to-dictio
items.dz: 输入框右键菜单：对光标处的单词，用内置的约三万个英文高频词表加一份 182 条常见拼错清单做检查，按编辑距离、再按词频排序给出候选；同一个菜单保留加入词典、剪切、复制、粘贴、全选、撤销、重做。词表与菜单全部在本地，不联网。

items.de: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
items.dz: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

items.de: Full-screen HAAVK-themed boot animation for DSH, rewritten from dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 (which is listed separately): an intro video, a cold-blue console board and a five-step access sequence with recorded voice lines and a looping background track. Text and two accent colours are editable in DSH s
items.dz: 哈夫克风格的全屏启动动画：开屏视频、冷蓝控制台底板、五步访问流程，配预录人声与循环背景音乐；文字与两处主色、开屏视频和背景音乐的开关可在 DSH 设置页调整，替换素材需覆盖 lib/assets 下的同名文件。本包由 dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 改写，两者共用启动配置和设置区，请与上游二选一安装。

items.de: Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.
items.dz: 把任意会话作为第二个完整对话开在右侧栏（独立记录与输入框），主区对话保持不动；右栏分栏后最多可同时对话 3 个会话。

items.de: Splits a long QQ reply into separate messages sent a second apart, instead of one wall of text. Works only with the QQ channel streaming output turned off (im-qqbot streaming: false); with streaming on, replies bypass this plugin.
items.dz: 把 QQ 那边整段回复按标点拆成几句，隔一两秒一条条发出，而不是一次糊一大段。仅在 QQ 频道关闭流式输出（im-qqbot 设 streaming: false）时生效；流式开着时回复不经过本插件。

items.de: Splits the DSH main area into vertical columns, one live conversation per parallel task, with mouse-wheel paging past four columns, draggable dividers, a split toggle on every session-list row, a progress-only compact view and a one-click exit.
items.dz: 把 DSH 主区域竖着分成多列，每个并行任务一列实时对话；超过 4 列用鼠标滚轮整页翻，分隔线可拖拽调宽，侧边栏会话行可直接加入或移出分屏，另有只显示进度与当前步骤的极简视图，并可一键取消分屏。

items.de: Multi-column tabbed workspace for the DSH main area: up to four sessions side by side, each with its own tab strip, composer and host view switcher. Cannot be enabled together with luckybilly's dsh-split-view; installs as the package dsh-multipane.
items.dz: 把 DSH 主区换成多栏标签工作区：最多四栏会话并排，每栏自带标签条、输入框和宿主视图切换条。不能与 luckybilly 的 dsh-split-view 同时启用；安装的包名是 dsh-multipane。

items.de: Tiles several workspaces side by side or stacked in the Web UI, one conversation per pane, with draggable splitters and pane swapping.
items.dz: 在 Web UI 主面板里把多个工作区并排或上下平铺，每个窗格一个会话，支持拖拽分隔条与交换窗格。

items.de: Adds drag-to-split conversation panes and horizontal draggable tabs to DSH, preserving each tab’s reading position and restoring the layout after refresh or restart.
items.dz: 为 DSH 提供拖拽分屏和横向会话标签，保留每个标签的阅读位置，并在刷新或重启后恢复布局。

items.de: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.
items.dz: 居中全局搜索弹窗：提供类似 Spotlight 与 IntelliJ 的会话及聊天消息实时检索与上下文预览。

items.de: Spring Boot admin toolkit: EasyExcel batch import/export code generation and Thymeleaf + LayUI template safety guard.
items.dz: Spring Boot 后台开发套件：EasyExcel 批量导入导出代码生成与 Thymeleaf + LayUI 模板安全守卫。

items.de: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rat
items.dz: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

items.de: Adds a squeeze tool: the agent hands a long web page, a batch of pages, a text file or a text PDF (via pdftotext) plus one question to a helper model and gets back only the answer, so the material never enters the chat. A settings page picks up to three helper models from the DSH model list, each wi
items.dz: 新增 squeeze 工具：Agent 把长网页、多个网页、文本文件或含文本层的 PDF（借助 pdftotext）连同一个问题交给辅助模型阅读，只把答案带回对话，原文不进入上下文。设置页可从 DSH 模型列表选择最多三个辅助模型，各配昵称、固定思考强度与“何时使用”说明，支持可选的回退，并按各模型的上下文窗口自动计算体积上限。

items.de: Live remote SSH workspaces with a resident Python RPC agent, remote shell/glob/grep execution, SSH port forwarding, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump, and conflict-safe three-way cache sync.
items.dz: 基于常驻 Python RPC 代理的实时远程 SSH 工作区插件，支持远程执行命令与 Glob/Grep 搜索、SSH 端口转发、~/.ssh/config 一键导入、跳板机链及三方缓存同步。

items.de: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。

items.de: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
items.dz: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode per project. Manage shared full-backend connections together, keep lightweight connections independent, and selectively sync local Skills with
items.dz: 在当前 DSH 窗口的原生侧栏中管理 SSH / WSL / Docker 项目。目录按环境归组，每个项目独立选择全量远程后端或本机 Agent 轻量模式；共享全量连接统一管理，轻量连接独立控制，并可比较、选择性同步本机 Skill。主要面向 Windows 桌面客户端与装有 Python 3、Bash 的 Linux / WSL / Linux 容器远端（macOS / Linux 本机未实机验证）；轻量 SSH 需已有 SSHFS 挂载，Docker 尚未在真实守护进程上验收。

items.de: SSH workspaces for Linux/macOS with SSH config import, remote folder selection, and file tools, Bash and persistent remote terminals following native DSH session permissions.
items.dz: 面向 Linux/macOS 的 SSH 工作区，支持导入 SSH config、选择远端目录，文件工具、Bash 与持久远程终端沿用 DSH 原生会话权限。

items.de: Map a remote server directory over SSH and SFTP into a controlled local cache workspace, so the model, agent, session and memory keep running on the local machine.
items.dz: 通过 SSH 与 SFTP 把服务器目录映射为受控的本地缓存工作区，模型、Agent、会话与记忆仍在本机运行。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep context lean. Ships 29 skills (plan loops, review loops, TDD, unsticking, PR watching) plus a turn guard that pushes back when a turn edits file
items.dz: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

items.de: Pre-execute hook that denies writes under a read-only result zone of protected roots; every other path passes through.
items.dz: pre-execute 钩子：拒绝写入受保护根下只读的成果区，其余路径放行。

items.de: Watches the turn endings of the models you select and asks a second model whether the turn was actually finished: if the assistant stopped after text with no tool call, a three-way verdict of continue, finished or uncertain is recorded and shown in a sidebar panel. In suggest mode it only reports; i
items.dz: 监测你所选模型每一轮的收尾，交给另一个模型判断这一轮是否真的结束了：如果助手说完话却没有工具调用就停了，会记录 continue / finished / uncertain 三态判定并展示在侧边栏面板。suggest 模式只报告，auto-continue 模式在本轮真正 idle 后调用 agent.followup() 发送续跑消息，且受每轮次数上限约束。单步收尾始终复查，监测模型支持精确多选与不区分大小写的正则匹配，续跑文案可自定义。

items.de: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the tool result, so the agent retries from another mirror instead of waiting on a dead one. Timeouts are set per kind of work, and acting versus
items.dz: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

items.de: Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.
items.dz: 通过内置 pi-ai 适配器将 Standard Compute 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，包含 standardcompute 路由模型和两个直连模型；仅配置，无代码。

items.de: Tired star-man, it can show your real-time revenue and tell you what time to go home!
items.dz: 困困星人：陪你度过每一个不美好的牛马日子，它可以显示每秒收入，告诉你几点下班！

items.de: DSH plugin for Blind Whale Farmer, a SMAPI mod in the same repo that turns Stardew Valley into a text game state so an AI can play it through MCP tools: farming, fishing, mining, gifts, festivals and marriage, plus LAN co-op on the same PC where you chat with her in Chinese (F6). A config card on th
items.dz: 大肥鱼种白饭（Blind Whale Farmer）的 DSH 插件。同仓库里的 SMAPI 模组把星露谷的游戏状态转成文字，让 AI 通过 MCP 工具来玩：种地、钓鱼、下矿、送礼、过节日、恋爱结婚，也能和你在同一台电脑上联机一起玩，按 F6 用中文聊天。插件在插件页的配置卡片里调整每次游玩的天数和时长、思考时冻结时间、联机模式、给 AI 的额外要求和攻略，自动推送到游戏；可选会话预设或单个 stardew 入口工具（默认都关闭），会话因工具调用中断时会自动发“接着玩”。需要先在游戏里装好模组。

items.de: Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
items.dz: 星露谷物语主题·组件替换版：走 dsh 官方客户端主题机制，在完整保留的官方 React UI 上叠加奶油纸面 alias token 层、缝合像素字体与山谷壁纸。npm 包名 dsh-theme-stardew-valley。

items.de: Right-click a dash in the conversation's right-edge turn rail to bookmark that turn: the dash grows to the rail's full width and takes the accent colour so it stays easy to find, and right-clicking again unbookmarks it. Bookmarks are scoped per conversation, keyed by the selected Session id, and per
items.dz: 在对话右侧轮次导航条上右键收藏某一轮：该短横线变为导航条满宽并换成强调色，便于之后一眼找到，再次右键取消。收藏按对话隔离（取当前选中会话 id）并持久保存，刷新后仍在；不引起布局跳动，导航条保持固定间距。

items.de: Dark-only starry-sky theme for the Web UI: both Light and Dark resolve to one deep-space night palette with a twinkling click-through starfield and four constellation figures, and the appearance preference is pinned to Dark while the plugin is enabled.
items.dz: 深色星空主题：浅色与深色外观统一为同一套深空配色，带闪烁星点和四组星座连线；插件启用时外观固定在深色。

items.de: Beginner starter pack for DeepSeek Harness: welcome flow, 0→1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations and a self-check checklist, paired with the dsh-handbook-zh Chinese tutorial repo.
items.dz: DSH 新手入门包：欢迎语、从 0 到 1 学习路径、按场景推荐插件与新手自查清单，联动 dsh-handbook-zh 中文教程仓库。

items.de: Cold-start boot animation for DeepSeek Harness, with an unlock gate in front of the workspace: PIN, Windows Hello or an authenticator code, all local.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的冷启动动画，工作区前加一道解锁门：PIN、Windows Hello 或验证器动态码，全部本地运行。

items.de: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
items.dz: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

items.de: Runs enabled PowerShell, CMD, Bash and Python presets in a user-defined order when DSH starts, shows live output for the selected preset in a left-sidebar page, and ends each managed process tree on stop, restart, disable, delete, or exit.
items.dz: 在 DSH 启动时按用户设定的顺序运行启用的 PowerShell、CMD、Bash 与 Python Preset，在左侧边栏页查看所选 Preset 的实时输出，并在停止、重启、停用、删除或退出时结束对应进程树。

items.de: Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.
items.dz: 启动时播放视频开场，每段素材可独立调节播放片段、速度、亮度、画面适配、影院模糊填充、展示比例与淡出时长，并按应用浅色/深色外观自动选择对应版本。

items.de: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
items.dz: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

items.de: A cross-session project board for managing projects, plans, tasks, and external document references in the DSH web UI and agent tools. Verified on Windows 11 x64 only.
items.dz: 在 DSH 网页界面和 agent 工具中跨会话管理项目、计划、任务和外置文档引用。仅在 Windows 11 x64 上验证过。

items.de: Makes DSH's OpenAI Responses calls stateful: after the upstream confirms it stored a response, each turn sends only the newly added input items plus previous_response_id, and a stateless upstream is detected on the first response so every later request falls back to the full history.
items.dz: 让 DSH 的 OpenAI Responses 调用走上有状态续接：上游确认保存响应后，每轮只发送新增的 input item 加 previous_response_id；首个响应即可判定上游是否存储，不存储时后续请求自动回退到全量历史。

items.de: Configurable static launch token for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI across restarts and reverse proxies.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 配置固定的静态启动令牌，方便跨服务重启和反向代理访问。

items.de: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session ch
items.dz: 内容区右上角的常驻状态卡片：一行写清本轮时间去向（模型/工具/等你），另列可折叠的任务与进度条、会话目标（可编辑/暂停/继续/清除）、已提交计划（可点开在右栏预览）、本次变更文件、带 token 与耗时数字的子智能体行，以及本会话的后台任务（运行中的行带两段确认的终止按钮，已结束的收进一行计数、默认收起）；内容区收窄时正文向左让位，推到极限自动收成一颗圆钮。

items.de: Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay,
items.dz: DSH 状态变化时读出一句简短提示——本轮完成、本轮出错、后台任务结束、后台任务失败、目标完成、目标受阻、等待批准、等待你回答——中文（默认）与英文各八条预录语音。音频由宿主进程播放（ffplay，或系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 播放器），不依赖浏览器 Web Audio。仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.
items.dz: 在输入框停靠区加一个会话状态胶囊，点开是一块面板，显示回合、token、性能与上下文读数。

items.de: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.
items.dz: 在输入框底栏显示当前阶段、阶段已耗时、本步 token 数与无进展告警的状态条（纯日志投影，不轮询宿主），点击可展开详情面板。

items.de: Reads a few lines of a txt or epub novel inside the sidebar bottom panel, styled to pass for scratch notes; pages with Ctrl+Alt+J/K and keeps progress locally. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.26+ - the reader exists only as a tab in its bottom panel.
items.dz: 把 txt / epub 小说藏进侧栏底部面板，一屏只显示几行、看着像随手记的草稿；Ctrl+Alt+J/K 翻页，进度存在本地。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 0.26 以上，阅读器只存在于它的底部面板里。

items.de: Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.
items.dz: 为 DSH 桌面端加入 Steam 大屏幕风格的 6 秒 Canvas 开屏，粗细渐变的终端标志变为 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，支持可选双声道音效、音量设置、预览、Esc 跳过及减少动态效果。

items.de: Inject steering or correction into a running session while the model is thinking, or cancel the current turn, from a floating browser panel.
items.dz: 在模型思考过程中随时向当前会话注入纠偏/引导信息，或打断当前回合。

items.de: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max), while a procedurally rendered micro-universe contracts and collapses into a black hole as effort rises. Levels go through the DSH model-selectio
items.dz: 在输入框上方加一条推理强度滑轨：拖动或用键盘预览并提交当前模型支持的档位（Off 到 Max），滑轨背后由程序实时渲染的微缩宇宙随档位收缩、坍缩成黑洞。档位通过 DSH 自身的模型选择接口提交，显示的是 DSH 确认后的等级；插件只写入 $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/。

items.de: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
items.dz: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

items.de: Keeps a local sticker dictionary keyed by content hash so an image already described is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the whole animation is visible.
items.dz: 维护一本按内容哈希索引的本地表情包字典，看过的图直接复用描述而不再重复识图；同时把 GIF 均匀抽帧拼成一张联系表，让视觉模型看清整段动作。

items.de: A tiled sticky-notes board for the DSH sidebar (a notes plugin): per-row density, colours, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
items.dz: DSH 左侧栏的彩色便签墙（便签插件 / 记事贴）：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

items.de: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar: six paper colors, pin and search, up to six images per note, local backups, and an agent tool that lets a session or an IM bot add a note without opening the browser.
items.dz: 侧栏便利贴墙：六种纸色、置顶与搜索、单条最多六张图片、本地备份，并提供模型工具，会话或 IM 机器人无需打开浏览器就能贴一条。

items.de: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

items.de: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar with pasted images and text, due reminders, done state, shortcuts, a pin-on-top floating window, appearance skins, and a native always-on-top Windows desktop window.
items.dz: 左侧栏便签墙：粘贴图片与文本、到期提醒、完成状态、快捷键、可置顶浮窗、外观皮肤，以及 Windows 桌面置顶窗口。

items.de: Sticky notes on a wall, with five paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of pin, tape or clip.
items.dz: 侧边栏里的便签墙：五种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，图钉或胶带或回形针固定，随手记下自动保存。

items.de: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or OAuth access token.
items.dz: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

items.de: Adds a ticker strip above the DeepSeek Harness interface that scrolls right to left, with a customizable watchlist of CN, HK and US stocks and indices, a configurable refresh interval and alert threshold, and a click-through quote card.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面顶部加一条从右向左滚动的股票行情条，可自定义 A 股、港股、美股与指数的自选列表、刷新频率与涨跌提醒阈值，点击条目查看行情详情。

items.de: Arms an explicit per-session scope contract from a `$stop-that-shit` directive and audits every tool call against it; unarmed it is inert. A DSH bundle wrapping lennney/stop-that-shit (MIT). Do not install it alongside the upstream lennney/stop-that-shit DSH bundle.
items.dz: 用 `$stop-that-shit` 指令显式开启每会话范围契约并逐个工具调用审计；未开启时不干预。基于 lennney/stop-that-shit（MIT）的 DSH 封装。不要与上游 lennney/stop-that-shit 的 DSH bundle 同时安装。

items.de: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them, and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Deleting to the system Recycle
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF 防护，不联网。

items.de: Restaurant store operations expert: reconcile a POS export, locate the gap, split volume vs price, measure discount efficiency, and open a single-file local-data dashboard.
items.dz: 餐饮门店经营分析专家：对账体检、找差距、量价拆解、算让利效率，并交付一个数据本地的单文件经营看板。

items.de: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

items.de: End-of-chat visual storyboard: a storyboard tool renders a self-contained HTML card (inline SVG diagram, numbered flow, facts grid, timeline) from a JSON spec, writes it under ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ and opens it in the sidebar; a system-prompt section and a /storyboard command trigger generati
items.dz: 对话收尾可视化故事板：storyboard 工具把 JSON 规范渲染为自包含 HTML 卡片（内嵌 SVG 流程图、编号步骤、事实网格、时间线），写入 ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ 并在侧边栏打开；系统提示词段落与 /storyboard 命令触发生成。纯服务端、零运行时依赖。

items.de: Layered context management: at each turn end older tool output becomes a deterministic card, the model can fold older ranges into its own summaries in up to three tiers (compress), and every original is archived locally for decompress and search_context. Works alongside DSH-Mem0: superseded runtime-
items.dz: 分层上下文管理：每轮结束时把较早的工具输出替换成确定性卡片；模型可以用 compress 把较早的范围折叠成自己写的摘要，最多三级；所有原文都存在本地，可用 decompress 和 search_context 取回。可与 DSH-Mem0 同时使用：过期的运行时上下文快照（比如召回的记忆）不存档、不切卡、不折叠；在前缀缓存已经失效、清理的收益超过缓存损失，或上下文超过窗口 75% 时，于轮末换成一行占位；为其他上下文插件提供 strataBudget 服务（pressure、allowance、countTokens）和 strata/fold-landed 事件；DSH 自动压缩没有启用

items.de: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

items.de: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.
items.dz: 让 AI 自己玩《杀戮尖塔 2》：截图＋鼠标键盘工具、本地牌表速查，还有一份能读的游玩日志。需 Windows 与 Python 3.10 及以上版本并安装 Pillow。

items.de: Passive recorder that replays the main agent and every subagent on one timeline, flags repeated calls, loops, recurring errors and truncated output, and writes an AI cause-and-effect review on demand.
items.dz: 被动记录器，把主 agent 与所有 subagent 放在同一条时间线上回放，标出重复调用、循环、反复出现的错误和输出截断，并可按需生成 AI 前因后果复盘。

items.de: Design studio with MasterGo MCP node inspection, built-in implementation prompts and Reborn UI references. Needs the MasterGo desktop app with Vibe MCP enabled, and the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
items.dz: 设计工作室，提供 MasterGo MCP 节点检查、内置实现提示词及 Reborn UI 参考。需本机 MasterGo 桌面端并开启 Vibe MCP，且先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

items.de: Local fitness studio recording workouts, exercise duration and training volume within the DSH workspace, stored in the browser. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
items.dz: DSH 工作区内的本机健身工作室，记录训练、运动时长与训练容量，数据存于浏览器本地存储。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

items.de: Learning-plan tracker with local progress, notes and JSON progress backup. Ships one original six-node example roadmap; adding your own roadmaps means editing roadmaps.ts and rebuilding the plugin. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-l
items.dz: 学习计划追踪：本机进度、笔记与 JSON 进度备份，附带一条原创六节点示例路线；添加自己的路线需编辑 roadmaps.ts 并重新构建插件。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

items.de: Shared studio runtime serving plugin pages and connecting locally configured applications to DSH sessions.
items.dz: 工作室共享运行时，提供插件页面资源及本地应用与 DSH 会话的连接。

items.de: Collapsible project drawer, split workspaces and session console for DSH studios, adapted from Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable under the same package name dsh-worktable, so the two cannot be installed together.
items.dz: 工作室的可折叠项目抽屉、分屏工作区与会话控制台，基于 Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable 开发，包名同为 dsh-worktable，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

items.de: Learning-mode agent preset for DSH with a topic knowledge base: answers retrieve from your own stored cards and cite the card they came from, mark anything not found as unverified, and only go online when verification is required. The sidebar panel browses topics, searches and edits cards, and every
items.dz: 学习模式 agent 预设 + 主题知识库：回答先从你自己存的卡片里检索，命中就标出处，查不到标「未验证」，必须查证才联网；侧边栏面板按主题浏览、搜索、编辑卡片，每张卡可 AI 校验补充、核实、回退和看版本；卡片之间可以用 `[[标题]]` 互链，面板里能看到「它连着谁」和「谁引用了它」；新卡片先出预览，确认后才入库；主题名和卡片名都能在界面里改。知识库是本地普通文件，不做后台自动抓取。

items.de: Saves opt-in conversations as structured Markdown study notes with topic folders and a maintained index.
items.dz: 按对话开启学习笔记，自动整理问答，按分类保存并维护 Markdown 索引。

items.de: Fork selected text into contextual learning branches, continue native DSH chat in each session, and navigate the branches in a tree.
items.dz: 划词派生继承上下文的学习分支，在每个会话中继续原生 DSH 聊天，并用树状导航切换分支。

items.de: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

items.de: Reskins the whole app from a sidebar panel with five skins — pixel arcade, midnight terminal, neon cyber, paper study and aurora glass — changing the palette, type and texture, with one click to restore the default look.
items.dz: 从侧边栏面板用五套皮肤换掉整个应用的配色、字体与质感——像素街机、午夜终端、霓虹赛博、纸感书房、极光玻璃——一键恢复默认外观。

items.de: Interface and code typography, three-color themes, and named presets for DeepSeek Harness, tested on Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供界面和代码字体、三色主题及命名外观方案；已在 Windows 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 验证。

items.de: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
items.dz: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

items.de: Route native DeepSeek Harness subagent_fork child sessions onto your Google AI Pro (Antigravity) subscription (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-OSS 120B) with zero API cost, live SSE streaming, full tool calling, prefill cache warm-up gating, ~200ms HTTPS quota checks, and a
items.dz: 将 DeepSeek Harness 原生 subagent_fork 子智能体会话路由至 Google AI Pro (Antigravity) 订阅（支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-OSS 120B）：零 API 费用、实时流式输出、完整工具调用、并行前缀缓存预热、200ms HTTPS 配额查询，以及聊天栏右上角配额按钮与侧滑模型/推理强度设置面板。

items.de: Windows x64 bundle with the official Antigravity ACP runtime included. Delegates one-shot text tasks with selectable authentication, model and thinking level; uses host peers for Harness 0.2.1 from rc.3 and 0.2.2 from rc.1, including subsequent RCs and stable releases within both series.
items.dz: 内置 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP 运行时的 Windows x64 完整包，委派一次性文本任务，支持选择认证方式、模型和思考强度；复用宿主依赖，支持 rc.3 起的 Harness 0.2.1 系列和 rc.1 起的 0.2.2 系列，包含各系列后续 RC 及正式版。

items.de: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
items.dz: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

items.de: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
items.dz: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

items.de: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
items.dz: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

items.de: One-shot OMP subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness — each delegation spawns the local `omp --print --mode json` CLI running with the user's own ~/.omp configuration and model bindings, and delegations are serialized so a single-session local engine is never oversubscribed. Requires the OMP (oh-my-p
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的一次性子代理提供器——每次委派都会启动本地 `omp --print --mode json` CLI，沿用用户自己的 ~/.omp 配置与模型绑定运行，且委派串行执行，单会话本地引擎不会被并发压垮。需本机已安装 OMP（oh-my-pi）CLI，并要求 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

items.de: Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护可复用的命名子代理配置，并按配置的模型、推理强度和 Agent 预设运行子代理。

items.de: Delegates a one-shot task from DeepSeek Harness to a locally installed Reasonix over the Agent Client Protocol, reusing Reasonix's own model, credentials and sandbox settings; exposed as the `subagent_reasonix` tool. Auto-approves every Reasonix permission request.
items.dz: 通过 Agent Client Protocol 把一次性任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机已安装的 Reasonix，沿用 Reasonix 自己的模型、凭据与沙箱设置，对外暴露为 `subagent_reasonix` 工具。自动批准 Reasonix 的全部权限请求。

items.de: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token cap, agent preset, tags, plus a "when to use" line the model reads to pick it, so a delegation names only the alias. Adds five tools (delegat
items.dz: 给子智能体配命名模型路由：每个别名绑定子智能体代理、模型与可选的思考档位、令牌上限、Agent 预设、标签，并写清「何时使用」供模型选路，委派时只写别名。插件提供委派、查目录、改配置、等后台、释放五个工具，在设置页完成全部配置（两级下拉、逐项校验），在子代理会话头部显示其实际运行的路由，界面元素均可单独停用；配置存于本地 JSON，不需要改任何 YAML。

items.de: Fills in a cheaper sibling route for subagent calls that name no provider, model or effort (for example Opus to Sonnet 5.5 at medium, Qwen max to Qwen flash); explicit choices and subagent_fork are left alone. Requires the subagent-model-selection policy to be enabled with the target route in its al
items.dz: 为未指定 provider/model/effort 的 subagent 调用补上更便宜的同类路由（例如 Opus → Sonnet 5.5 @ medium、Qwen max → Qwen flash）；显式指定的选择与 subagent_fork 保持不动。需在设置里启用 subagent-model-selection 且目标路由在其 allowedModels 中，否则插件不产生任何效果。

items.de: Adds a Settings page to pin one OpenAI-compatible subagent model (or follow the main model), writes the official subagent-model-selection allowlist, reminds the parent to pass that route, and optionally runs one-shot tasks through an isolated Pi CLI provider.
items.dz: 在设置里为子代理单独指定一个 OpenAI 兼容模型（或不选则跟随主模型），写入官方 subagent-model-selection 白名单，并在仅有一条路由时提醒主代理显式传参；可选提供与 DSH 进程隔离的 Pi CLI 一次性子代理。

items.de: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
items.dz: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

items.de: Tells the parent agent when a subagent died from an upstream failure instead of finishing: it listens to agent/error on every agent, waits a short settle delay, and if the child is still not running delivers a followup turn to the parent carrying the child id, the failure and the options the parent

items.de: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
items.dz: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

items.de: Reads what a message means beneath its literal wording in everyday chat, then steps aside the moment work starts.
items.dz: 日常对话里读字面底下那一层，一进工作就自动让位。

items.de: Sidebar page that removes burned-in subtitles from a video with a local video-subtitle-remover checkout: frame preview with a start/end range, drag-drawn regions (up to six), automatic region detection reviewed by a DSH chat model, live before/after comparison, and open-file/open-folder on the resul
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏里调用本机 video-subtitle-remover 引擎擦除视频硬字幕：画面帧按开始/结束时段预览、拖拽框选最多六个区域、自动识别字幕带并由 DSH 模型复核、处理中实时前后对比，成片可一键打开或定位到文件夹。需预先准备 video-subtitle-remover 仓库（含模型）与装有 torch、paddle、OpenCV 的 Python 环境。

items.de: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.
items.dz: 根据会话生成下一条消息建议并优化草稿，支持候选翻页、快捷键录制和配套 MCP 工具。

items.de: Write each session's summary as a Markdown file in its workspace, with a page to browse, regenerate and delete them.
items.dz: 把每个会话总结成工作区里的 Markdown 文件，并提供一个浏览、重新生成和删除的页面。

items.de: Generates images in parallel with two configurable OpenAI Images-compatible or ComfyUI backends, compares the candidates, and optionally fuses them. Visual comparison needs a vision-capable model in DSH; without one the candidates are listed unscored.
items.dz: 通过两个独立配置的 OpenAI Images 兼容或 ComfyUI 后端并行生成图像，比较候选图并可选择融合。视觉比较需要 DSH 中有支持图像输入的模型；没有时候选图只列出、不打分。

items.de: Desktop-bundle fork of the DeepSeek Harness team's dsh-superagent research prototype: turns requests from allowed people on GitHub issues or Feishu into tickets worked by isolated DSH sessions, with a panel for sources, setup, prompts and run history. By default only people on a source's allowed lis
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 团队 dsh-superagent 研究原型的桌面 bundle 分支：把名单内的人在 GitHub issue 或飞书里提出的请求变成工单，交给相互隔离的 DSH 会话处理，面板里管理来源、部署、提示词与运行记录。默认只有来源名单里的人能发起工作。GitHub 来源需要 git 2.32+ 与 gh CLI；飞书可选，需要 lark-cli。

items.de: Fork of dsh-superagent for local use: each sidebar workspace gets a main session that turns a request into a ticket and has a worker session do the work inside that workspace's directory. Cannot be installed alongside upstream dsh-superagent: both use the package name dsh-superagent and mount the sa
items.dz: dsh-superagent 的本地版：每个侧栏工作区各有一个主会话，把需求转成工单，并由 Worker 会话在该工作区目录内执行。不能与上游 dsh-superagent 同时安装：两者包名同为 dsh-superagent，挂载的插件 id 也相同。

items.de: Adds a shared Sup composer switch on Windows to start or gracefully stop a separate Super-agent process and release its memory. Requires a working DSH NEXT install with Node 24+, the standalone DSH CLI and an already-configured independent Super-agent profile (verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.4/rc.5); the b
items.dz: 在 Windows 输入栏添加全局 Sup 开关，按需启动或正常关闭独立的 Super-agent 后台进程，关闭后释放其占用的内存。前置条件：已装好 DSH NEXT、Node 24+、独立 DSH CLI，且 Super-agent 已在独立 profile 中配置好（已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.4/rc.5 验证）；还需在 Super-agent profile 中注册包内的 bridge.js——只安装桌面包并不能完成整套安装。

items.de: Super input suite — model and effort picker, prompt enhancer, follow-up suggestion chips, a full cost engine with daily heatmap and Coding Plan quotas, voice-input light effects and transcript cleanup (needs the built-in voice-input bundle enabled), prompt templates, selection reference chips with c
items.dz: 超级输入框套件——模型与推理强度选择器、提示词增强、跟进建议 chips、带每日热力图与 Coding Plan 配额的完整费用引擎、语音输入光效与转写清理（需先启用官方语音输入包）、Prompt 模板库、划选引用与评论 chip、压缩圆环和设置总览。已并入作者原独立插件 dsh-cost、dsh-power-picker、dsh-prompt-enhancer、dsh-followup、dsh-siri-voice、dsh-compaction-control，安装前请先卸载它们。

items.de: Cross-session long-term memory backed by Supermemory: pre-step semantic and chunk recall with per-session deduplication, debounced transcript upload, background LLM fact extraction (add/update/delete) with bigram and semantic deduplication, memory_search / memory_save / memory_forget tools, global o
items.dz: 基于 Supermemory 的跨会话长期记忆：在 pre-step 按需执行语义与历史对话片段召回（同会话去重、首轮附带静态画像），回合结束后防抖上传脱敏对话并由后台模型提炼增删改事实（字面二元组与向量语义双层查重），提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具，支持全局或按工作区分库，并内置插件设置页管理 API Key、增删改查记忆、预览召回结果与查看活动日志。需自备 Supermemory API Key（有每月免费额度），对话片段会上传到 Supermemory 云端。

items.de: Runs Superpowers as an agent preset and gives each skill its own subagent model from a Settings table, so TDD, debugging and verification no longer all inherit the parent model.
items.dz: 把 Superpowers 作为 Agent 预设运行，并在设置表里为每个技能单独指定子代理模型，测试、系统调试与收尾验证不再全部沿用父会话的模型。

items.de: Native terminals for DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 on macOS, with local terminal AI sessions, SSH terminals that reconnect to the same remote task, bounded Terminal Group discussions, and handoffs with acceptance and rework.
items.dz: 面向 macOS 上 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 的原生终端，支持本地终端 AI 会话、可接回原任务的 SSH 远程终端、有限轮次群讨论，以及任务交接、验收与返工。

items.de: Neutralizes lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool output before they reach the session log, preventing permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST errors.
items.dz: 在工具输出写入会话日志前中和落单的 UTF-16 代理字符，避免会话永久 400 无法继续。

items.de: Renders SVG code fences in chat as theme-aware inline figures with source, copy, download and zoom.
items.dz: 将聊天中的 SVG 代码块渲染为跟随主题的内联图形，支持源码、复制、下载与缩放。

items.de: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
items.dz: 在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

items.de: Swap Enter and Shift+Enter in the chat composer: Enter inserts a line break and Shift+Enter sends. Works with no configuration; menu-open, IME composing, read-only and modifier-key presses are left to the app.
items.dz: 交换聊天输入框的 Enter 与 Shift+Enter：Enter 换行，Shift+Enter 发送。无需任何配置；菜单打开、输入法组合中、只读状态以及带修饰键的按键仍交给系统原有处理。

items.de: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.
items.dz: 把 cc-switch 的供应商与模型在保存的瞬间镜像进 DSH，并在输入框和设置卡片里显示各供应商的套餐窗口、账户余额或自定义用量脚本的结果。

items.de: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

items.de: Move an entire dsh installation to another machine and check it item by item. Three layers go across: the declaration layer (settings, credentials, plugin declarations and vendored link: sources), the state layer (sessions, storages, skills, attachments) and, optionally, the workspace project code.
items.dz: 把整台机器的 dsh 搬到另一台并逐条核对。三层一起走：声明层（设置、凭据、插件声明与 link: 插件源码）、状态层（会话、storages、skills、附件），以及可选的工作区项目代码。会话只改写 zstd 首帧，工作区路径按显式映射改写，最后核对 14 项检查（I1–I13，另含 I6b）并给出 PASS / FAIL / WARN。另可局域网配对直传；merge 模式把 bundle 与「已经在用的机器」逐项比对，分歧未决议就停在写盘之前。

items.de: Synchronize DSH sessions, settings, attachments and project files using a user-configured private HTTPS Git repository or SFTP, with safe-scope online application, offline restore plans and user-confirmed plugin updates. Requires Node.js 24+; the SFTP path also requires OpenSSH (ssh/sftp).
items.dz: 通过用户自行配置的私有 HTTPS Git 仓库或 SFTP 同步 DSH 会话、设置、附件及工程文件，支持安全范围在线应用、离线恢复计划和经确认的插件更新。需 Node.js 24+；SFTP 路径还需 OpenSSH（ssh/sftp）。

items.de: Inventories installed DSH skills and profile plugins, checks their upstream sources for newer versions, applies the updates, and installs skills from a searchable catalog.
items.dz: 盘点已安装的 DSH 技能与 profile 插件，检查上游是否有新版本并执行更新，还能从可搜索的目录里安装技能。

items.de: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.
items.dz: 通过 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 自带的 Lua 脚本 API 把它接入 Agent，提供自动发现、常驻桥、演唱创作、音符编辑与 DAW（VST3/ARA + MIDI）集成五个工具。仅 Windows 10/11；需安装 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ 并打开工程。

items.de: Parse PRDs and PDFs, ask clarifying questions in batches, consolidate a BRIEF.md system brief, and package deliverables for upload.
items.dz: 解析 PRD/PDF、分批追问澄清目标系统并沉淀 BRIEF.md，最终打包可上传交付物。

items.de: CPU, GPU and memory load in the DeepSeek Harness Session header: three compact cells with a percentage and a 2 px bar, coloured at 75 % and 90 %; CPU from os.cpus() deltas, GPU from nvidia-smi (Windows counter fallback).
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话顶栏实时显示 CPU、GPU 与内存占用：三个小格各带百分比和 2 px 细条，75 %、90 % 变色；CPU 取 os.cpus() 差值，GPU 优先 nvidia-smi（Windows 下可退回性能计数器）。

items.de: System guard for DeepSeek Harness (Windows-first, protected actions via UAC/sudo): classifies core system files and runtime junk, keeps a hidden SHA-256 backup of core files on the largest free disk, patrols integrity and restores damaged files, and asks for administrator rights only to protect the
items.dz: 系统守护（以 Windows 为主，保护类操作走 UAC/sudo）：分析并分类系统核心文件与运行时垃圾，把核心文件隐藏备份到剩余空间最大的硬盘、定期巡查完整性并从备份修复损坏文件；守护权限只用于保护系统。macOS/Linux 上只做分类与哈希（不删垃圾，修复仅给出人工步骤），且该路径未在真机验证。

items.de: Per-conversation system prompt studio for DeepSeek Harness. Append text, shadow-replace one named first-party prompt section, or replace the whole system prompt; changes apply on the next model request without a restart. Overrides persist per session and are inherited by forked conversations along t
items.dz: 按对话管理 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：追加文本、按名替换某一第一方段落，或整段替换，保存后下一次模型请求即生效，无需重启。覆盖按会话持久化，fork 出的对话会沿父链继承上游规则，并可用「在此固定」把继承结果固化成本地规则。面板会列出真实的装配段清单，并对未保存的修改做保护。

items.de: On Windows (PowerShell 5.1), snapshots whitelisted registry keys, hosts, user environment variables, services, firewall rules and scheduled tasks, diffs changes, and restores only registry, hosts and user environment variables.
items.dz: 仅 Windows（依赖 PowerShell 5.1）：改动系统前记录白名单注册表、hosts、用户环境变量、服务、防火墙和计划任务，可对比；只恢复注册表、hosts 和用户环境变量。

items.de: Connect multiple decision providers and models through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef via Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya, and compatible custom providers. Agents and plugins can classify content, filter candidates, score against criteria, or locate objects in
items.dz: 用同一接口接入多种决策提供商与模型：在线可选 TypeSafe 提供的 Jev、Cloudflare 提供的 Clef、Nace 提供的 Drex、meraGPT 提供的 Decider 1；本地可连接 Laya，也支持兼容的自定义 provider。Agent 和插件可用它进行内容分类、候选筛选、按标准评分或图片定位，再用结构化结果继续自己的流程。

items.de: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout
items.dz: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

items.de: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip,
items.dz: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

items.de: Predicts the next user message as composer ghost text using the configured DSH model; Tab fills the draft without sending, with time-aware context and cached suggestions.
items.dz: 使用 DSH 已配置模型预测下一句，在输入框显示灰字，Tab 仅填入草稿；结合当前时间理解旧对话，并缓存建议。

items.de: Tab to toggle plan mode on/off.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 输入框中按 Tab 键开/关 plan 模式。

items.de: Draws a bar chart under Markdown tables whose columns are mostly numeric, with no tool call or server.
items.dz: 在数值列为主的 Markdown 表格下方自动绘制条形图，无需工具调用或本地服务。

items.de: Adds a hover toolbar to every Markdown table in DSH Web: one button copies the table as Markdown, the other copies a 2x PNG of it taken with the current theme background.
items.dz: 给 DSH Web 里每张 Markdown 表格加一条悬停工具条：一个按钮把表格复制成 Markdown，另一个按钮把它按当前主题背景截成 2 倍图 PNG。

items.de: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.
items.dz: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。

items.de: Project and session board in the native right sidebar, a floating session list, a keyboard-first command palette over sessions, projects and settings, and task notifications.
items.dz: 在原生右侧栏提供项目与会话看板，另有悬浮会话列表、键盘优先的命令面板（可搜索会话、项目与设置），以及任务通知。

items.de: Adds an index of every installable plugin tagged dsh-plugin on GitHub or npm to Plugins → Discover, rebuilt daily. On first run it also switches on the experimental Custom plugin index.
items.dz: 把 GitHub 和 npm 上所有打了 dsh-plugin 标签、可以安装的插件，作为索引源加入「插件 → 发现」，每天更新。首次运行时会同时打开实验性的「自定义插件索引」。

items.de: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
items.dz: 当工具结果包含不可信内容时将代理标记为已污染，对随后的高权限调用进行拦截，并在所有模式下拒绝将凭据传递给可联网的工具。

items.de: A conversation-view tab for turning one local reference video into a human-curated shot list. ffmpeg scdet finds shot boundaries, each shot gets one timecoded thumbnail, you untick what you do not need, and the export writes frames.csv (UTF-8 BOM), shots.json, numbered JPEG frames and a labelled con
items.dz: 把一段本地参考视频变成人工策展过的镜头清单：ffmpeg scdet 找镜头切点，每镜一帧带毫秒时间码的缩略图，勾掉不要的帧后导出 frames.csv（UTF-8 BOM）、shots.json、编号 JPEG 和一张带时间码标签的联系表。全程本机处理、不上传，零运行时依赖，39 个 node --test 测试（含真实 ffmpeg 集成用例）。需自行安装 ffmpeg 5.1+（含 ffprobe）。

items.de: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
items.dz: 从 Tako 公开模型目录把聊天模型接入官方 llm-pi-ai，实时刷新并按尺寸标签写入上下文窗口，支持浏览器一键登录，把 cr_ 密钥存入 DSH 凭据。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, l
items.dz: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。

items.de: Choose three cards from a shuffled 78-card tarot deck, reveal source-linked meanings, and refine the reading through follow-up questions.
items.dz: 从洗乱的 78 张塔罗牌中亲选三张，查看带来源链接的牌义，并通过追问细化解读。

items.de: Tarot readings with a dealt card table, a reading tool, and a reviewable history.
items.dz: 塔罗占卜：可发牌翻牌牌桌、抽牌工具，以及可复盘的历史记录。

items.de: Tarot page for the DSH Web GUI with 78 public-domain Rider-Waite-Smith cards, four spreads (single, three-card, relationship, Celtic cross), shuffle and deal animation, local reading history, and an in-page AI reading streamed from the model configured in the user's DSH profile. Registers no model-f
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的塔罗牌整页：78 张公版 Rider-Waite-Smith 牌面、四种牌阵（单张、三张、关系、凯尔特十字）、洗牌与翻牌动画、本地历史记录，以及只存在于页面内的 AI 解读（走用户 DSH 配置的模型）。不注册任何面向模型的工具、skill、slash 命令或系统提示。

items.de: Scheduled Agent tasks for DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 with per-task models, workspaces, independent or persistent sessions, run history, and file artifacts.
items.dz: 面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的定时 Agent 任务，支持按任务配置模型与工作目录、独立或持续会话、运行记录和文件产物。

items.de: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
items.dz: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

items.de: Collects the open questions of each AI turn into a right-side panel; you answer them, add notes, and send the decisions back to the conversation in one message.
items.dz: 把 AI 每轮回复里的待决问题收进右侧边栏，选完选项、写完备注后一次性提交回对话。

items.de: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provid
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 任务详情侧边栏：每个已结束任务的最下方显示「查看任务详情」，点开后从右侧边栏打开可拖拽调宽的面板，列出该任务的输入文件、中间产物、输出文件、所用工具与 skill、推断出的语言、按步骤组织的流程时间线，以及模型提供方与 Token 用量、缓存命中率。

items.de: Dispatch a task to a real DSH session by workspace path or session id; results land in a persistent task ledger that can be queried without triggering the model. It serves HTTP on 127.0.0.1:7391 with no authentication unless a token is configured, so any local program can dispatch tasks into your se
items.dz: 按工作空间或会话 id 给真实的 DSH 会话派发任务；结果写入持久任务台账，查询时不会触发模型。它在 127.0.0.1:7391 提供 HTTP 接口，不配置 token 就不需要认证，本机任何程序都能向你的会话派发任务、读取台账；任务结果以 JSON 文件存在 ~/.dsh/relay/tasks，可选的 notifyUrl 会收到每个完成任务的结果。

items.de: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
items.dz: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

items.de: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
items.dz: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

items.de: Adds custom task groups and an activity bell to the sidebar: drag sessions into or out of a group, reorder them by hand, collapse groups, and see running, waiting and unread sessions in one place.
items.dz: 给侧边栏加上自定义任务分组和活动铃铛：把会话拖进拖出分组、手动排序、折叠分组，并在一处集中查看运行中、待确认和未读的会话。

items.de: TAPD + ZenTao task hub for DSH: list assigned work in the sidebar and dispatch an agent on a branch you name.
items.dz: DSH 的 TAPD 与禅道任务中心：在侧边栏查看分配给自己的需求或任务，并在手动指定的分支上派发 Agent。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Task Instructions button beside the input box pins reusable task requirements to a session, and the instruction survives context compression.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框旁的「任务指令」按钮，把可复用的任务要求固定到整场会话，压缩上下文也不变形。

items.de: Task ledger: a dsh plugin that has the agent create, claim, advance and close tasks, writing each step straight into a plain-text ledger in the workspace so the owner, the current state and the next step stay on record; no cloud service is involved, single-user and multi-user both work with Git sync

items.de: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
items.dz: 跟随 Agent 每一次工具调用（读、写、改、搜、运行、规划、子代理、等待、出错）实时切换动作的网页吉祥物，并在对话中显示对应步骤卡片；内置两套可切换角色包。

items.de: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes, with the final assistant reply as the notification body, plus optional approval and question alerts and synthesized or imported sounds. items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 任务结束时弹出系统级通知，正文是本轮最后一条回复；另可开启审批与提问提醒，并支持合成提示音或导入自定义提示音。本插件派生自 ltao0829/dsh-task-notify；与上游插件不能同装——两者占用同一个 task-notify bundle 行。

items.de: Sends desktop notifications when a DSH turn finishes or fails, and sends 继续 automatically after the model-retry budget is exhausted.
items.dz: 任务结束或失败时发送桌面通知；模型请求重试预算耗尽时自动发送「继续」让 Agent 接着执行。

items.de: Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.
items.dz: 任务完成时弹出 Windows 原生系统通知（通知中心横幅）：目标完成或 Agent 结束一轮。

items.de: Automatically orchestrates complex DeepSeek Harness requests. It detects when delegation is useful, builds a dependency-aware plan, assigns bounded researcher, architect, backend, frontend, tester, and documentation workers, collects structured evidence, and sends the results to a final reviewer. Th
items.dz: 自动编排复杂的 DeepSeek Harness 请求：判断任务是否适合委派，创建考虑依赖关系的计划，分配受数量限制的 researcher、architect、backend、frontend、tester 和 documentation worker，收集结构化证据，并将结果交给最终 reviewer。该 bundle 会一起启用工作流引擎和面向模型的 subagent 工具；关闭插件时也会同时关闭完整的工具组。

items.de: Task alerts for DSH: a system toast when a turn finishes, or when an approval, question or plan review is waiting; a chime rendered on the Windows communications endpoint so the system ducks other media by its own setting and restores it afterwards, without anyone's volume being written; and an opti
items.dz: DSH 任务提醒：每轮对话结束、或出现待审批 / 待回答 / 待确认计划时弹系统通知；提示音走 Windows 通信播放端点，由系统按「通信活动」自动压低其他媒体并在结束后恢复，不写任何应用的音量；可选再用 SMTP 发一封邮件到手机（465 隐式 TLS，或 STARTTLS 且仅在升级后才发送凭据）。无运行时依赖：声音助手是 PowerShell 脚本，邮件客户端是纯 Node 实现。

items.de: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for its
items.dz: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

items.de: Adds a Task Progress tab to the conversation view, next to the Context tab, with a progress bar for the session's todo list and completed items ordered by completion time.
items.dz: 在会话顶部“上下文”标签右侧增加“任务进度”标签页，用进度条显示已完成与未完成的任务，已完成项按完成顺序排列。

items.de: Tiered task queue as the single source of truth for DSH↔Hermes work (reset > approve > review): enqueue tools for all submission paths, lease/claim model with concurrency 1, priority aging against starvation, atomic busy mutex, and a Hermes-side consumer (cron */1 + monitor gating) that drains tasks
items.dz: DSH↔Hermes 协作的缓存梯队任务队列（reset > approve > review，queue.json 唯一真相源）：全部提审路径入队、租约/认领模型并发 1、优先级 aging 防饿死、原子忙锁；Hermes 侧消费端（cron */1 + monitor 门控）出队执行、单槽检查写审核请求、调用重置 agent。

items.de: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session
items.dz: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

items.dz: 任务看板卡片结算后，把标题、成败、耗时与下一步排队送进发起该卡的那个 DSH 会话；成功卡按可配置窗口合并（默认 30 秒），失败卡立即发送。卡片执行中提问时，问题也送回同一个会话，再由它把回答交回卡片。

items.de: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a chime the moment DSH needs you to step in: an approval request, a question, or a plan confirmation. Three independent switches and sound pools,
items.dz: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

items.de: Task-complete and question notification sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a soft chime when the agent finishes a turn, a ding-dong when it asks you something (questions, plan reviews, approvals). Synthesized Web Audio, zero assets, mute toggle and volume slider in the session header and settin
items.dz: 任务完成与提问提示音：Agent 完成回合时播放一声轻快提示音，向你提问（普通提问/计划评审/权限确认）时播放叮咚声。Web Audio 实时合成、零资源零网络，会话头部带静音开关，设置页可调音量。

items.de: Host-side long-task detection for small-context local models: long outputs are scaffolded into a parts skeleton (one part per reply, then assemble), and multi-step work into a PLAN.md ledger with notes/ (plan first, one step per reply). Detection is heuristic and host-side, so it does not depend on
items.dz: 面向小上下文本地模型的宿主侧长任务识别：长产出自动拆成分段骨架（每轮只写一段，最后拼装），多步骤任务自动建立 PLAN.md 台账与 notes/（先立计划、每轮执行一步）。判定在宿主侧用启发式完成，不依赖模型自己判断极限。

items.de: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch i

items.de: Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.

items.de: Flashes the DeepSeek Harness taskbar button on Windows when an approval, a question or a plan review is waiting, or when a turn finishes.

items.dz: 回合运行中在 Windows 任务栏显示进度条，等待审批或提问时变成琥珀色并闪烁，回合失败后保持红色。Joker2377/dsh-taskbar-status 的分支，打包上的改动是把 koffi 改成可选的 peer 依赖，使其在 DSH Desktop 上安装时不再需要原生构建脚本授权；不要与原版同时安装。

items.de: A client-side panel for DeepSeek Harness: it stacks the epic cards of a dsh-taskboard project in their epic:children order, shows the position, code, name and version of every module along the arc, and marks the start, middle and end modules. The order can be changed by drag or by buttons, and the n
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的客户端面板：把 dsh-taskboard 项目里的总任务卡按 epic:children 顺序堆叠展示，标出每个模块在弧线上的位置、代号、名称与版本，并区分起点/中间/终点模块。顺序可拖拽或用按钮调整，新顺序通过 taskboard 自身的公开更新 API 写回，因此会持久化并对该项目的所有查看者共享。需要先安装 cloader/dsh-taskboard 插件。

items.de: Registers one native DeepSeek Harness skill, design-taste-frontend — an MIT port of tasteskill v2 — for designing, redesigning and reviewing landing pages, marketing sites, portfolios, product pages and app screens (dashboards, admin, settings, inboxes). items.dz: 把一个原生技能 design-taste-frontend 注册进 DeepSeek Harness——tasteskill v2 的 MIT 移植——用来设计、重设计与评审落地页、营销站、作品集、产品页与应用界面（仪表盘、后台、设置、收件箱）。方向由脚本发牌而不是模型即兴：从 20 个研究过的艺术方向里发 3 个供选择，再按选中的方向发下首屏构图、分节蓝图、字体系统、配色、摄影参考与动效配方——它们来自含 58 种首屏构图、185 条分节蓝图、44 套字体系统、56 套配色、19 组摄影参考与 18 条动效配方的库——并记住最近用过的方向，连续项目不会趋同。硬规范靠测量而非声明——静态 li

items.de: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/e

items.dz: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

items.dz: 腾讯智能体邮箱（Agent Mail）客户端：侧边栏面板浏览收件箱与发件箱，HTML 正文在沙箱内渲染并默认拦截外链图片，支持写信、回复、转发、附件收发、搜索与永久删除，可调字体与界面透明度；另注册 5 个工具（mail_health、mail_list、mail_read、mail_search、mail_send），发信走已授权的 agently-cli 账号。需腾讯账号（设备码授权），面板可一键安装 agently-cli；仅在 Windows 上实测。

items.de: Evidence-gated teaching-material workbench with a Web UI: page model, per-page handout and slide editing, PAEG Chinese language checks, layered gates, checks center, version history, handout/deck/storyboard/Manim-script export and rights audit.

items.dz: DSH Web GUI 的智能体团队管理：查看任意会话的成员，删除角色及其持久会话（目录移入回收站，可恢复），在 0.2.2-rc.1 之前的旧版团队上回收释放的成员名额，让已删除成员不再出现在子智能体选择器与团队面板，并在 0.2.2-rc.1+ 恢复会话页头的只读成员面板；新旧两版智能体团队实现都能用，不需要改 DSH 源码。

items.dz: 在输入框上方渲染 Agent Teams 泳道看板：队长居中、成员在下，任务按最长依赖路径分泳道排列，四类连线用 SVG 虚线绘制（任务依赖是上游卡片右缘到下游卡片左缘的三次贝塞尔，另有队长总线、成员同级总线、成员到任务的 tether）。卡片是绝对定位 DOM，连线是一层 SVG，两者共用同一组几何常量。布局常量与路径算法移植自 cc-haha。数据读当前会话实时的 agentTeam 投影（名册、共享任务、依赖边、执行态）；会话没有团队时回退到本会话的工作清单。团队消息暂不在投影里，通讯面板显示空态。主体配色走宿主主题 token；八名成员的身份色是刻意的例外——色相固定，饱和度与明度用
