items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于团队技能、MCP 和提示词管理与同步。

items.de: Adds a model picker to teammate (continuable subagent) sessions: switch a quota-exhausted teammate to a model that still has quota and let it continue, without rebuilding it or touching the Lead session.
items.dz: 给队友（continuable subagent）会话加一个模型选择器：队友额度用完时直接换个还有额度的模型让它继续跑，不用重建队友，也不影响主线会话与全局默认模型。

items.de: Adds contextual guidance for explaining technical misconceptions in conversations.
items.dz: 为对话添加上下文指导，以简短方式解释技术误解。

items.de: Registers two LLM account pools as model providers: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI; paste a token once) with a daily 09:00 UTC+8 full-pool check-in — currently check-in, balances and model listing only, since its chat is blocked by the client signing key — and AutoClaw (Zhipu desktop, Windows), who
items.dz: 把两个 LLM 账号池注册为模型提供方：TeleAgent（中国电信天翼 AI 星辰超级智能体，需手工粘贴一次 token）支持每天 09:00（UTC+8）全量自动签到，目前提供签到、余额与模型目录，对话仍被客户端签名密钥挡住；AutoClaw（智谱桌面端，Windows）的 token 由本机 DPAPI 保护的凭据解出，对话经桌面端桥接流式返回。两个号池都能查询积分余额与模型目录；额度耗尽时会自动在本地桌面端实例之间转移，切换 AutoClaw 账号则需在设置中开启（默认关闭）。设置页与左侧边栏均有面板。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Installs a TeleAgent skill-authoring standard as a DSH skill: the full spec, a validator that reproduces the platform checks (and fails on .pyc bytecode), a scaffolder, a packer and a TeleAgent installer.
items.dz: 把 TeleAgent 技能制作规范装成 DSH 技能：规范全文、复刻平台校验的校验器（含 .pyc 直接判失败）、脚手架、打包器、TeleAgent 安装器。

items.de: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.
items.dz: DSH 页面悬浮的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼小精灵：点击打开可拖动、可最小化的临时聊天浮窗，支持跟随会话模型或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点实时流式输出。

items.de: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
items.dz: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

items.de: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
items.dz: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

items.de: Adds a Temporary tasks section above the workspace list, where one click creates a timestamped folder, workspace and session; tasks support search, sort, pin, rename and archive, can be moved into a regular workspace, and tasks that never receive a message are cleaned up automatically.
items.dz: 在工作区列表上方增加独立的「临时任务」区：一键创建带时间戳的文件夹、工作区与会话；支持搜索、排序、置顶、重命名与归档，可把任务移入普通工作区，未发过消息的任务会自动回收。

items.de: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's
items.dz: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

items.de: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
items.dz: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

items.de: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.
items.dz: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。

items.de: Keeps terminology in two-level plain-text glossaries and injects a term's meaning the first time it appears in a session.
items.dz: 把约定俗成的称谓存成两层纯文本字典，某个词第一次出现时自动把它的口径注入上下文；带查／写／体检三条工具与设置面板。

items.de: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
items.dz: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

items.de: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

items.de: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.
items.dz: 在触屏设备上补齐手机软键盘缺少的按键（Esc、Tab、回车、Ctrl-C、方向键），以半透明按键列浮在活动终端旁。

items.de: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
items.dz: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

items.de: Installs and runs Android native command-line tools from inside DSH: fetches aarch64 bionic packages from the Termux repository, unpacks them in pure JS and runs them through /system/bin/linker64, with no root, no Shizuku and no external package manager.
items.dz: 在 DSH 内部安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库取 aarch64 bionic 包、纯 JS 解包，再经 /system/bin/linker64 执行，无需 root、Shizuku 或外部包管理器。

items.de: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.
items.dz: 可拖动的浮动 TES 陀螺挂件：点击抽一下就会转，转速按恒定摩擦线性衰减（转得越快停得越久），用滑条调转速，播放内置歌曲并同步滚动 LRC 歌词；位置与转速会被记住。

items.de: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm), extracts the file, line and assertion of each failure, and stops the loop when failures with an identical signature repeat. Output is decoded so Wi
items.dz: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

items.de: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unre
items.dz: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

items.de: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
items.dz: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

items.de: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model dec
items.dz: 在 DSH 对话里划词即得大白话解释，浮窗显示，并自动带上这段话所在的那条完整消息作为语境。三档讲解深度（小白 / 通识 / 专业），切换后当场重讲；可选联网搜索与本地文件查找（默认交给模型自己判断，也可一键强制查一次，查完只补充新内容而不复述）；可继续追问；还能把整段问答「待命式」交接给一个新会话——背景放好即止，不唤醒模型、不耗额度。设置保存在宿主侧 settings.json，不点保存不落盘。仓库内另含一个 OpenAI 兼容端点与一个浏览器扩展（源码）。

items.de: Highlights keywords and key sentences in DSH messages with the CSS Custom Highlight API (no DOM rewrite, survives streaming), and swaps the UI / message font in one click. Config lives in a small floating panel; code blocks and KaTeX are left alone.
items.dz: 用 CSS Highlight API 给 DSH 消息里的关键词和关键句上色（不重写 DOM，流式输出也不掉），再一键换掉界面/正文字体；配置在小浮窗里，代码块和公式不受影响。

items.de: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置页左侧栏新增「文字注入」分区：独立 Markdown 文件中的文字块可注入系统提示词（每轮生效）或会话上下文（关键词门控、去重），支持热加载与自动历史备份。

items.de: Breaks a STEM textbook into a four-level card map (book, chapter, section, knowledge point) in a sidebar panel, where each point names the defect of the previous approach it fixes and each chapter keeps its remaining gap as the motive for the next; marks key points with a star, shows theorems as car
items.dz: 把理工科教材拆成「全书、章、节、知识点」四层卡片知识地图（侧边栏面板）：每个知识点写明它修复了前方案的什么缺陷，每章用「仍存短板」作为下一章的动机；重点知识点标 ★，定理以卡片呈现（结论／适用条件／符号说明），推导过程可折叠，并可将同一张地图导出为离线自包含 HTML、Word 或 PDF。内置 textbook-parser 技能与 textbook_archive 工具（save_book／save_chapter／list_books／get_book／delete_book），附带《信号与系统》12 章示例（116 节、263 个知识点、601 道例题）。零运行时依赖、不联网。

items.de: Quiet Carl the hedgehog easter eggs after a finished turn, plus local water, meal and rest reminders. Fully local scheduling with no model calls and no chat messages.
items.dz: 任务结束后偶尔让卡尔从屏幕边缘探头，并提醒喝水、吃饭、休息；完全本地调度，不发送聊天消息、不调用模型。

items.de: Wandering Earth 550C control-room palette for the DSH Web UI, with dim 2px frames and amber selection states.
items.dz: 流浪地球 550C 控制台配色的 DSH 界面皮肤，含暗色 2px 边框与琥珀选中态。

items.de: Six material skins for the DSH Web GUI — Ink Jade, Terracotta, Aurora, Abyss, Sakura Mist and Paper — painted with CSS only: one engine derives the 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per appearance, Alt+K cycles skins, and the choice is remembered in localStorage. No images, no host rou
items.dz: 六套材质皮肤：墨玉、赤陶、极光、深海、樱雾、素笺。纯 CSS 绘制，一套引擎由六个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换，选择记在浏览器本地；不含图片，不注册宿主路由。

items.de: Three photograph skins for the DSH Web GUI — River Night (三江夜), Lingyun Dusk (凌云晚照) and Emei Mist (峨眉夜雾). Each paints its Leshan photograph across the window and the conversation column under an appearance-keyed scrim; one engine derives the other 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per
items.dz: 三套乐山照片皮肤：三江夜、凌云晚照、峨眉夜雾。照片同时铺在窗口和对话画布上，按明暗外观压罩层；每套皮肤由 6 个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换皮肤，选择记在浏览器本地。

items.de: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
items.dz: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

items.de: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
items.dz: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

items.de: Eight Material-family colour themes for DeepSeek Harness (Palenight, Ocean, Darker, Lighter, Catppuccin Latte, Vitesse, Snazzy and GitHub Gray), each with light and dark palettes, switched from a row of colour cards in Settings → General → Theme.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 做的八套 Material 系配色（夜紫、幽蓝、墨灰、素白、奶咖、青苔、霓光、灰阶），每套含深浅两版，在「设置 → 通用 → 主题」里点色卡切换。

items.de: Global cyber-terminal theme: a click-through full-screen Matrix code-rain overlay, phosphor-green UI styling, a sidebar one-click toggle, and adjustable speed, density, opacity and glow with three palettes.
items.dz: 全局赛博终端主题：可点击穿透的全屏 Matrix 代码雨叠加层、荧光绿 UI 配色、侧边栏一键开关，以及可调的雨速、密度、透明度与发光和三套配色。

items.de: Matrix-style binary (0/1) digital rain for the Harness interface: columns spawn only while a task is running, fall off screen when it stops, and leave a blank canvas; frosted-glass token layer with adjustable digit and panel opacity.
items.dz: 黑客帝国式二进制数字雨（字形只有 0 与 1）：仅任务运行时生成数字，任务停止后停止生成并让已有数字落出屏幕、画面归空；配磨砂玻璃 token 层，数字与面板透明度均可调。

items.de: Neumorphism skin for the DSH web UI that re-keys 72 design tokens to a cool-grey palette with a steel-blue accent in both light and dark mode, and adds soft shadows to the composer, cards, floating surfaces and session rows.
items.dz: DSH 网页界面的新拟态皮肤：把 72 个设计 token 重写成冷灰底、钢蓝强调色，浅色与深色同时生效，并给输入区、卡片、浮层与会话行加上柔和阴影。

items.de: Manage native themes and installed theme plugins from a right-sidebar panel and a Settings page, with only one theme active at a time. Listing and toggling installed theme plugins requires dshmarket; the right-sidebar tab requires dsh-better-sidebar (otherwise the panel appears only in Settings).
items.dz: 主题管理器：在右侧栏面板与设置页里管理原生主题和已安装的主题插件，同一时间只生效一个主题。管理已安装主题插件需 dshmarket；右侧栏页签需搭配 dsh-better-sidebar（未装时只在设置页出现）。

items.de: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web GUI 的主题选择中加入 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa、Rosé Pine 十一套配色预设，与内置的浅色/深色/跟随系统正交叠加。

items.de: Nine single-ink print palettes — sage linen, kraft paper, lead type, cyanotype, risograph, CRT tube, phosphor screen, punch card, floppy disk. Each palette carries its own paper grain, type pairing, corner shape, section rule and a whale mark redrawn in its ink, plus a letterpress pass (paper tooth,
items.dz: 复古油墨主题：九套单色油墨配色——鼠尾草、牛皮纸、铅字、蓝晒纸、孔版、显像管、荧光屏、打孔卡、软盘。每套自带纸张质感、字体搭配、圆角与直角、章节线，以及按自身油墨重画的鲸鱼标记；另有一层可关掉的凸版压印（纸齿、纸不匀、墨的压痕）。每套都配浅色与深色两套 token。

items.de: Strinova theme: light/dark modes, a Cielle character illustration on the new-session screen, a corner character randomly picked on each page load with a matching composer placeholder line, and floating particles.
items.dz: 卡拉彼丘主题：日夜双模式；新会话页展示汐的角色立绘，右下角角色与输入栏台词按页面加载随机轮换，并点缀漂浮粒子。

items.de: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

items.de: Coastal light and dark palette for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, built as a token-only ThemeRuntime overlay covering all 107 official alias tokens.
items.dz: 海岸线明暗双色主题，只通过 ThemeRuntime 的 token 层叠加，覆盖全部 107 个官方 alias token。

items.de: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
items.dz: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

items.de: Zenless Zone Zero inspired dark theme for the Harness Web UI, with a pointer-following hollow background.
items.dz: 《绝区零》风格的 Harness Web 深色主题，包含随鼠标移动的空洞背景。

items.de: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into a
items.dz: DSH Web 右侧栏的思维链面板：把每个会话的实时思考折成 turn → step 分组，每一步带该步的思考原文与工具调用。默认只展开最新一轮，更早的轮次收成一行；步骤按本地规则合并成阶段块，正在等工具的那一步单独标出，工具失败显示原因，思考原文按步按需取回，全轮目录在本地搜索轮次标题、用户原话与轮号，整轮可用一次模型调用生成中文标题。

items.de: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
items.dz: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

items.de: Skill that switches the displayed reasoning to Simplified Chinese: it enables the built-in experimental reasoning translation, pins provider bing and target language zh, then verifies and troubleshoots the result. The same repository also ships an optional one-install preset plugin for users who wan
items.dz: 把思考过程切换成简体中文显示的技能：启用内置实验性思考翻译、固定 bing + zh，并给出验证与排障步骤；同一仓库另提供可选的一键预设插件，供不想逐步操作的用户直接安装。需要带实验性思考翻译包的 DSH 0.2.1 线以及 Web/桌面 GUI；默认 provider 为 bing，展开的思考正文会发送给 Bing。

items.de: Replaces the composer model picker with a model + thinking-effort picker and an Auto level; Auto scores each turn by how far the conversation has drifted from the main objective and by repeated failures (one extra small judge call per turn), picks the effort from that score, and labels every finishe
items.dz: 用「模型 + 思考强度」选择器替换输入框的模型选择器并新增 Auto 档；Auto 依照对话偏离主要目的的程度和重复失败次数给每轮打分（每轮多一次小模型判分调用），据此选择思考强度，并在每轮结束后标出该轮发送的档位。

items.de: A Claude Desktop-inspired composer slider for adjusting model reasoning effort with click, drag, or keyboard controls.
items.dz: 借鉴 Claude Desktop 的思考强度滑块，在输入框中通过点击、拖拽或键盘调整模型推理档位。

items.de: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / ita
items.dz: 统计思考行里的关键词并在展开后按词标红；标题行上每个词一个计数徽章，点徽章即单独开关这个词；每个词可设底色、文字颜色、字号（10-22px，与宿主正文尺寸同一区间）、字体、加粗/斜体/下划线与「完整词」匹配；插件有独立的设置分区。

items.de: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob
items.dz: 把输入框右侧的「推理等级」从菜单点选换成可拖拽滑条，并接管官方那枚「模型 · 推理等级」chip。拖动中连续跟手，松手吸附到最近档位，且一次拖拽只提交一次会话更新。轨道内自绘填充、刻度点与白圆钮，只有最高档（xhigh/max/ultra）才铺品牌色流动渐变，两端标出最低与最高档名；同一张卡片可展开官方模型清单。方向键移动一档、PageUp/PageDown 移动两档、Home/End 跳到两端，每次移动都会提交。目录对象上的世代计数器丢弃迟到的响应，prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭动画。数据全部取自官方 modelDirectories，不新增任何能力。

items.de: Reasoning-effort slider that replaces the composer model seat: one rail over the levels the current model declares (off/low/high/max on DeepSeek), with a 241-frame portrait that evolves frame by frame as you drag and a per-model choice that survives restarts. Uninstall restores the shipped picker.
items.dz: 替换输入框模型座位的推理档位滑杆：一根滑杆覆盖当前模型声明的档位（DeepSeek 为 off/low/high/max），拖动时 241 帧人像逐帧演变，按模型记忆所选档位且重启保留，卸载即恢复官方选择器。

items.de: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

items.de: Adds an independently toggled native file explorer beside the conversation, with local and SSH file operations, fast remote @ completion, and native previews in the right sidebar.
items.dz: 在聊天左侧显示可独立开关的原生文件栏，支持本地和 SSH 工作区的文件操作与远程 @ 补全，文件继续由右侧原生侧栏预览。

items.de: Turns the composer send button into a tomato button while a task is running and the draft is empty. One or two taps hand the model a hidden note on its next step asking it to reflect on the approach and to finish by asking the user how to continue; three taps within a second stop the run first and s
items.dz: 任务运行中且输入框为空时，把发送键换成番茄键。点一两下会让模型在下一步收到一条不对用户显示的提醒，要求它反思做法并以提问用户如何继续收尾；一秒内连点三下则先停止任务，再发同样的提醒。丢番茄特效与音效可在设置中关闭，设置页同时显示累计扔出的番茄总数。

items.de: Algorithm field guide for graphics, animation, physics and AI work — 219 entries with tradeoffs and links to existing implementations, exposed as 10 agent tools and a sidebar page. AI-assisted tools require DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
items.dz: 图形/动画/物理/AI 算法的可查询天书——219 条术法，带取舍说明与现成实现链接，提供 10 个 agent 工具与侧栏页面。AI 工具需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www-sop.inria.fr

items.de: Corner card that watches Tibo (@thsottiaux) on X, shows new posts and replies with a Chinese translation, and marks reset-related posts; extra JSON sources can be added. Reads the third-party tiboreset.com text mirror rather than X itself (a few minutes behind, text only); translation goes through t
items.dz: 右上角卡片：盯 Tibo（@thsottiaux）在 X 上的新帖与回复，自动配中文译文，重置类消息加标；支持追加 JSON 数据源，Host 侧抓取与翻译，不消耗对话 token。数据来自第三方文字镜像 tiboreset.com 而非 X 本身（有数分钟延迟，仅文字）；翻译走宿主翻译服务，帖子文字可能经公共翻译服务商，把 translate 设为 false 可只留本地。

items.de: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is c
items.dz: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

items.de: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
items.dz: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

items.de: Peak/off-peak and balance pill for the DSH composer, forked from xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge. Unlike the original, the conversation cost is priced from that session's token usage (uncached input, cache-read, cache-write and output tokens) against the official price table, so other conversations a
items.dz: DSH 输入框下方的峰谷计费与余额药丸，基于 xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge 修改。与原版不同的是：本次对话花费按本会话的 token 用量（未命中 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出）乘官方价目表计算，而不是余额差值，因此同账号的其他对话与 API Key 消耗不会被算进来。它与上游同包名，装上会替换 npm 上的上游版本，两者不能同时安装。

items.de: Sidebar DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing hint with a Beijing-time countdown, Chinese public holidays and make-up workdays, daily pricing-rule refresh, official top-up offer status, and your account balance converted to input tokens (read with the DeepSeek platform sign-in already stored in DSH).
items.dz: 侧边栏 DeepSeek 峰谷计费提示，显示北京时间倒计时、中国法定节假日与调休、每日定价规则刷新、官方充值优惠状态，以及按当前时段折算成输入 tokens 的账户余额（使用 DSH 里已保存的 DeepSeek 平台登录凭据读取）。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds two rows to the DSH general settings section. Version update asks the npm registry for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, installs it as a background job and streams the install output into the row; restart DSH stops the running process so its supervisor can start a fresh one. A second restart request i
items.dz: 在 DSH 通用设置里加两行。版本更新到 npm 注册表查 @deepseek-ai/dsh 的新版本，以后台任务安装并把安装输出实时回显到设置行；重启 DSH 会停掉当前进程，交给它的守护进程重新拉起。重复的重启请求会被拒绝，systemd 单元取不到主进程时宁可拒绝执行，也不在旁边另起一个实例。设置行还会显示进程已运行时长与身份标识，用来区分「页面重连」和「服务真的重启了」。

items.de: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
items.dz: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

items.de: Manage DSH plugins per client, workspace and session, with independent enable/disable controls, separate configurations, inherited defaults and reuse of original plugin settings pages.
items.dz: 按客户端、工作区和会话分层管理 DSH 插件，支持独立开关、不同配置、逐级继承及复用原插件的设置页面。

items.de: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
items.dz: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

items.de: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.
items.dz: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

items.de: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
items.dz: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

items.de: Timed send for the chat composer: pick a moment and the host delivers the message then. Inside an existing conversation tasks join that conversation; from the new-session screen each task gets its own pre-created session.
items.dz: 聊天输入框的定时发送：选好时刻到点由 Host 真正发出。已有对话内任务排进当前对话；新会话界面每条任务各建一个独立会话。

items.de: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with bl
items.dz: 把英文有声读物（MP3）和英文文档（PDF / Word / EPUB / 网页 / TXT）变成听力课：用 DSH 语音输入已下载的模型在本机识别每一句（缺失时首次使用自动下载约 241 MB；需 ffmpeg）、用你选的大模型逐句校对翻译讲解，再以精听、间隔复习、磨耳朵练到一听就懂；支持中文配音导出与离线 Kokoro 语音，提供右侧栏面板和 4 个 AI 工具。

items.de: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
items.dz: 给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀，会话列表平铺展示时不必点开就能看出它属于哪个项目；你自己手动改过的标题保持原样。

items.de: Windows Desktop only. Adds a 重启 item to the DSH window caption menubar next to 应用 and 编辑; the second click stops the app and starts the same executable again through a WMI-spawned PowerShell helper.
items.dz: 仅 Windows 桌面版。在 DSH 窗口标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）后加一个「重启」项，连点两次即由 WMI 拉起的 PowerShell 脚本结束应用并重新启动同一个可执行文件。

items.de: Read EPUB, PDF, DRM-free MOBI/AZW3 and TXT in the DSH sidebar. WeChat Read style typography with TOC, bookmarks, highlights and progress memory; select any passage to translate it into Chinese; the Ask-the-Book AI answers only from passages retrieved from the open book. Books and progress stay in lo
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧边栏阅读 EPUB、PDF、无 DRM 的 MOBI/AZW3 和 TXT。仿微信读书排版：目录、书签、划线、进度记忆，选中文本一键翻译成中文，AI 问书只依据书中检索到的段落作答。书籍与进度保存在本地 IndexedDB，不上传。支持四种主题（含豆沙绿护眼底色），PDF 纸色跟随主题。

items.de: Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time acro
items.dz: DSH 侧边栏页脚的 Token 用量组件，同时跑两路数据源而不是二选一：DeepSeek 平台账号的用量/金额接口（账号全部设备、仅官方通道），本机会话日志（仅本机、含所有供应商、实时、无金额）。两路逐日合并——官方通道取较大值（同一次调用两路都会记），平台看不到的供应商再叠加；历史月份从平台回补，供应商按通道而非模型名判定，日桶跟随平台口径（UTC）；平台数字默认复用 DSH 已登录账号，不用粘贴 token。数字出现在紧凑条、展开面板，以及含日历/图表/模型/供应商/年/月/当月按天页签的详细数据弹窗，口径为总消耗/当前项目/今日/当周/当月/近 7 天/近 30 天。

items.de: Declares two model routes in the llm-pi-ai settings section — a TLPro gateway and Z.ai's GLM-5.3 endpoint — with per-model context windows, output caps and reasoning-effort ladders, so the stock model picker can select and tune them. Requires your own TLPRO_API_KEY and a Z.ai coding-plan ZAI_API_KEY
items.dz: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节声明两条模型路由——TLPro 网关与 Z.ai 的 GLM-5.3 端点——逐模型给出上下文窗口、输出上限与推理档位，让自带的模型选择器可以选中并调节它们。需自备 TLPRO_API_KEY 与 Z.ai 编程套餐的 ZAI_API_KEY；该补丁会整体替换 llm-pi-ai 行的配置。

items.de: Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS Time Machine are auto-approved and automatically snapshotted; network access, package installs, process/system management, and reads of sensit
items.dz: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

items.de: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3),
items.dz: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：被 Android 杀掉后约 2 分钟内由 dsh 进程内看门狗复活，守护进程持续不在时由 dsh 自己兜底清理；设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理或演练。清理工具随包自带（bin/tmp-clean，Python 3），装好即用。

items.de: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
items.dz: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

items.de: To-do list in the session header: the button cycles through unfinished items and is tinted red, amber or green by due time, and the floating panel adds, edits and ticks off tasks with an optional deadline, with a collapsible done section. Items persist in localStorage and follow the DSH theme.
items.dz: 会话标题栏里的待办清单：按钮轮播未完成事项，按截止时间以红、黄、绿整块着色；浮动面板可新增、编辑、勾选待办并设置截止时间，已完成收进可折叠区域；数据存 localStorage，跟随 DSH 主题。

items.de: Keeps a repository's task ledger as a resident prompt section with eleven native tools, plus a sidebar panel and a floating window for browsing the queue and signing off review tasks.
items.dz: 把仓库里的任务账本做成常驻提示段与十一个原生工具，另有侧栏面板与浮动窗，可浏览队列并签收待复核任务。

items.de: A to-do list that lives in the right sidebar instead of the conversation: add an item, tick it off, delete it, and drag rows to reorder them. Items are kept only in the browser's localStorage, and the plugin registers no model-facing tools; a button in the conversation header opens the panel.
items.dz: 放在右侧边栏、不进入对话的待办清单：添加、勾选完成、删除，拖动行即可排序。数据只保存在浏览器的 localStorage 里，插件不注册任何给模型用的工具；会话头部有个按钮可打开面板。

items.de: A three-scope TODO board for DeepSeek Harness (user, workspace and session) with nested folders that can reference one item from several places, T0–T9 priorities, drag reordering, batch actions, a floating panel that also opens as a right-sidebar tab, Markdown preview windows that can stay open with
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的三区 TODO 便签（用户 / 工作区 / 会话）：支持嵌套文件夹与同一条目多处引用、T0~T9 优先级、拖动排序、批量操作、可浮动也可作为右侧栏页签打开的面板、可保留且自动保存标题与正文的 Markdown 预览，以及智能体读工具与每次写入都经 DSH 审批的写工具。

items.de: Todo plugin that records when each task is created and completed, with table, kanban, gantt and calendar views over the same data, categories, priority and type, @workspace-file links, JSON/CSV import and export, and a todo_time_log agent tool with /todo commands.
items.dz: 待办插件：自动记录每条待办的创建与完成时间，表格 / 看板 / 甘特图 / 日历四视图共用同一份数据与筛选，支持分类、优先级、类型、@工作区文件、JSON/CSV 导入导出，以及 todo_time_log 智能体工具与 /todo 命令。

items.de: To-do list panel for DeepSeek Harness: large task cards in collapsible sections, hour-precision due times, per-task reminder lead times, and DingTalk notifications through a group robot webhook or an enterprise-app work notice. Each task can bind to a workspace session and jump to it on click.
items.dz: DSH 待办清单面板：可折叠分组中的大卡片任务，截止时间精确到小时，可按任务设置提前提醒，并通过钉钉群机器人 Webhook 或企业应用工作通知推送；任务可绑定工作区会话，点击直达。

items.de: Durable workspace Plan/Backlog todos for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar board, agent tools, and /todo commands.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的持久工作区待办面板：Plan/Backlog 两层、侧边栏看板、Agent 工具与 /todo 命令，跨会话不丢。

items.de: Work todo reminders in a sidebar panel with four stage tabs (not started, in progress, overdue, done) plus separate recurring and paused filters, priority derived from the end time in real time, pinning that survives overdue, and enable/disable for recurring tasks. Recurrence covers workdays (follow
items.dz: 侧边栏「工作待办」面板：未开始 / 进行中 / 已超期 / 已完成四阶段页签 + 循环任务与已暂停独立筛选，优先级按结束时间实时派生，置顶任务超期也不下沉，循环任务可随时启停。循环规则覆盖工作日（跟随中国法定节假日与调休）、指定星期、每月指定日期（月末顺延）与 5 段式 cron；单次任务在开始与结束两个时间点各提醒一次。提醒以页面浮层呈现，可选浏览器系统通知，支持稍后提醒与免打扰。提供 12 个 Agent 工具，支持周报/月报、自然语言快速新建与跨视图搜索；数据为本地单个 JSON 文件，已完成任务按季度归档。

items.de: Shows the DeepSeek account balance (recharge plus bonus) in the DSH composer dock and refreshes it automatically.
items.dz: 在 DSH 输入框下方状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（充值 + 赠送），并自动刷新。

items.de: Cross-session token dashboard for DSH: daily spend as bars, trend or cumulative views plus a GitHub-style annual activity calendar, model and workspace splits, cross-filtering between day, model and workspace, and a per-turn timeline that also covers web-search and auxiliary model calls.

items.de: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plug
items.dz: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar 没有中央索引，所以遍历必须跟踪「有没有走到归档结束标记」—— 少了这一步，一个被截断的文件校验和照样正确、照样被读成完整。

items.de: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendere
items.dz: 打开页面、按页面真正需要的方式等待、抽出可读正文、截图。Playwright 是可选依赖：没装时退回静态抓取并在结果里明确说明，因为「JavaScript 从未执行」的页面意味着的东西和渲染过的不同。正文靠给候选子树打正文密度分来选，而不是相信标签名，所以容器不会因为「包含的文档更多」而赢过它里面的正文。

A dim room no longer comes back black — brightness, gamma, contrast, sharpen and an auto-level pass run inside the c
items.dz: 从本机摄像头抓一帧实时画面，以图片形式交给 agent，让它真正从摄像头看见画面——不用打开相机应用，也不要求窗口在前台。暗光房间不会再拍成一片黑，亮度、伽马、对比度、锐化和自动拉伸都在抓帧时一次做完。首次使用时自动下载 ffmpeg，配套还有一个工具用于列出可用采集设备。

items.de: Model-classified tool compass for DeepSeek Harness: the agent sees functional categories and pulls specific tools on demand.

items.dz: 为自定义的一组智能体预设隐藏或禁用特定工具，例如其他插件添加到所有预设的工具。隐藏的工具会从工具列表中移除，不占用 token；拒绝的工具调用会被拒绝。还可以清空其他插件添加的系统提示词。通过 YAML 配置。安装后需在 YAML 里加一行配置才会生效。

items.dz: 给失败的工具结果追加可执行提示（如路径不存在时给出最近的已存在目录）。

items.de: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
items.dz: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

items.de: Per-project tool gating for the harness: before each step, the session looks for `.dsh/tool-gate.json` in its working directory and up to 32 parents, then filters the tool set handed to the model — allow or deny lists with `prefix*` wildcards, `off` when no rule file is found. A single `tool_gate_st
items.dz: 按项目控制工具可见性：每一步装配前，会话从工作目录向上最多 32 层查找 `.dsh/tool-gate.json`，据此裁剪交给模型的工具集 —— 支持 allow / deny 名单与 `prefix*` 通配，找不到规则文件时为 off；另有 `tool_gate_status` 工具报告当前模式、规则文件来源与被隐藏的工具。

Reading a schema or running a tool does not change the model-visible tool list, so the pr
items.dz: 把延迟加载的 MCP 工具定义以索引形式发送——按服务器分组的名称、参数签名和一行摘要；tool_details 按需返回完整 schema，call_tool 运行真正的工具。读取 schema 或运行工具不会改变模型可见的工具列表，因此不会使提示缓存失效。

items.de: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.

items.de: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads t
items.dz: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

items.de: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annota
items.dz: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run 重新合并，内容本身含反引号时自动加宽围栏。每一步有损转换都会报出来，而不是默默吞掉。

items.de: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
items.dz: 从图片或 PDF 中抽取文字，电子版直接读文字层，扫描件自动转交已配置的 OCR 引擎。

items.de: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what
items.dz: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive 并说明其线上格式后果；audit 能发现 protoc 接受但审查者不该放过的隐患——重复或非法字段编号、与 reserved 区间冲突、类型无法解析，以及高水位线以下未声明的空洞。

items.de: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
items.dz: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。

items.de: Score a GitHub repo's contribution-friendliness from live merge and maintainer evidence.
items.dz: 用活的合并与维护者证据，给一个 GitHub 仓库的对外贡献友好度打分。

items.de: Give the agent a priority-ranked, coverage-honest map of any codebase before it edits.
items.dz: 让 agent 在动一个陌生仓库之前，先拿到一份按优先级排序、覆盖率老实的仓库地图。

items.de: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
items.dz: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

items.de: Cross-session messaging: deliver a user message to another DSH session by session id. Every message carries the sender session id and a reply hint, so windows can authenticate each other and hand work over. One tool, no extra DSH dependencies; mode "steer" injects into a running turn instead of queu
items.dz: 跨会话发消息：按 session id 把 user 消息投递到另一个 DSH 会话，消息自动附带发送方 Session ID 与回信提示，方便多窗口互相认证与接续任务。单一工具、不依赖额外的 DSH 包；mode 取 "steer" 时插入正在运行的一轮，而不是排队成新一轮。

items.de: Rolling-window batch scheduler for DeepSeek Harness subagents: one subagent_batch call carries a queue of independent subtasks plus a user-owned concurrency window, a settled child's slot is refilled immediately, and the call returns every child's final answer, stop reason and child id as one accept
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 子智能体的滚动窗口批量调度器：一次 subagent_batch 调用携带一队互相独立的子任务和由用户掌握的并发窗口，任一子智能体一结束就立刻补位，结束时把每个子智能体的最终回答、停止原因与子会话 id 作为一份验收报告一并返回。async 模式让整个池子在后台运行、用 subagent_batch_status 收取结果；并发窗口来自配置、DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY 或硬件推荐值。

items.de: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.
items.dz: 读写互转 SRT/WebVTT/ASS 三种字幕并校正时间轴，出片前体检过长或读不过来的 cue，还能用已配置的识别引擎把音视频转成字幕。

items.de: Toolbox panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a right-side drawer (full screen on phones) with connection information (Wi-Fi details and gateway ping need a Windows host), one-click diagnostics, a speed test with server-side timing, a quality monitor, history and auto patrol; the host registers th
items.dz: DSH Web GUI 工具箱：右侧抽屉（手机全屏），含连接情况（Wi-Fi 详情与网关 ping 需 Windows 宿主）、一键体检、测速（服务端计时）、质量监控、历史与自动巡检；宿主注册 /api/toolbox 路由。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

items.de: A @-file reference tool for DSH: registers an at_file_read tool that injects workspace-file contents into the session, with traversal protection and a 50KB truncation cap (MIT).
items.dz: DSH 的 @ 文件引用工具：注册 at_file_read 工具，把工作区内文件内容注入会话，含目录穿越防护与 50KB 截断（MIT）。

items.de: Deny-only tool blacklist per agent preset. Tick a tool off in Settings and it leaves that mode's tool schema and its calls are rejected; nothing is ever enabled or whitelisted, and tools nobody denied are left alone. Each row expands to that tool's own description, and rules live in one JSON file ou
items.dz: 按 Agent 预设（模式）管理的工具黑名单，只做禁用：在设置页勾掉一个工具，它就从该模式的工具 schema 里消失、调用也会被拒；不设白名单、不负责启用，没被点名的工具一概不碰。每行可展开看工具自己的描述，规则存在 profile 之外的单个 JSON 文件里。

items.de: Embed the Toonflow infinite canvas as a dsh sidebar panel. Companion plugin: requires you to self-host and run Toonflow locally (default http://127.0.0.1:6017). Configurable URL, connect / reload / open in new window.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏内嵌 Toonflow 无限画布面板。伴侣插件：需本机自备并运行 Toonflow（默认 http://127.0.0.1:6017）。支持地址自定义、连接/重载/新窗口打开。

items.de: Splits a session into turns and incrementally clusters them into named topics and stages, with per-topic token / tool / time stats, a workflow view, a turn timeline, a relation graph and per-turn AI analysis.
items.dz: 把会话按轮次聚合成话题与阶段，按话题统计 token / 工具 / 耗时，提供工作流、时间线、关系图谱三种视图和单轮 AI 分析。

items.de: Account-based access to the ToTonAI gateway inside DeepSeek Harness: sign in or register in the settings panel, use 65 mainstream models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Doubao, Grok, GLM), and pick a plan then pay by QR code in the same panel. Upstream API keys stay on the server.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用账号接入 ToTonAI 中转站:设置面板里登录或注册,使用 65 个主流模型(GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、豆包、Grok、GLM),并可在同一面板选档位、显示收款码、付款后申报开通。上游 API Key 只留在服务器上。

items.de: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
items.dz: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

items.de: A webfetch tool for full-text web/Toutiao articles: 3-tier strategy (direct fetch → resident Edge CDP headless browser → dump-dom fallback), with automatic Toutiao anti-bot challenge handling plus a bundled experience skill.
items.dz: 读网页/头条文章全文的 webfetch 工具：三级策略（直连 → Edge 常驻无头浏览器 CDP → dump-dom 兜底），自动识别头条反爬质询页，附 toutiao-reader 实战经验技能。

items.de: Training Lens opens a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard with selectable metrics, explicit improvement direction, optional EMA smoothing and Chinese/English UI; requires an existing Python environment with TensorBoard.
items.dz: Training Lens · 训练视窗通过 DSH 工具打开本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页面，支持指标选择、改善方向、EMA 平滑和中英文界面；需要已有的 Python 与 TensorBoard 环境。

items.de: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

items.de: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
items.dz: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

items.de: (UI enhancement) Frosted-glass background for the whole app: one slider blends from a genuinely blurred, milky frost to a fully transparent page, and every region, control and expanded page moves as a single sheet painted on body::before; the settings page has its own independent slider, and an opti
items.dz: （UI 增强）整页磨砂背景：一条滑杆从真实模糊的磨砂过渡到完全透明，所有区域、组件与展开面板作为画在 body::before 上的同一张纸一起变化；设置页有独立滑杆，另有可选的鲸鱼粒子图层，随鼠标推开与拖动。浏览器里插件会自绘一层深色背景垫在磨砂之下。桌面端的效果直接画在应用窗口上：dsh 的 Windows 主窗口历来不透明（只有 macOS 才有 vibrancy 透明窗口），所以 Windows 上看到的是窗口自身的底色而不是你的壁纸，macOS 则仍是原生透明窗口。适用于所有 dsh 版本（已核对到 0.2.2-alpha.3）。

items.de: Moves a conversation into another workspace: long-press its sidebar row, drop it on the target workspace, and the session log with its full history is relocated and re-pointed. A plain drag still does the sidebar's own reorder inside one workspace.
items.dz: 把一段对话搬到另一个工作区：长按侧栏里的会话行，拖到目标工作区松手，会话日志与全部历史一起迁移并改指到新目录。直接拖动仍然是工作区内的原生排序。

items.de: Travel expense reconciliation: ingest orders, invoices and card lines, deduplicate, run the three-way match and a read-only policy check, then export — 5 `travel.*` tools.
items.dz: 差旅费用核对：导入订单、发票与卡流水，去重、三单匹配与只读政策校验后导出——5 个 `travel.*` 工具。

items.de: Travel wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: pick one of three built-in characters (DeepSeek whale girl, GPT dragon girl, Claude young lady) or upload your own reference photo, or observe a world without any character; choose a world and one of 20 art styles, and the plugin assembles the image prompt, gen
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的旅行壁纸：三个内置角色（DS大肥鱼、GPT 龙娘、Claude 大小姐）任选其一，也可上传自己的参考图，或选择「观察世界」不启用角色；选一个世界和 20 种画风之一，插件整理画面提示词，经你自己配置的生图渠道（ChatGPT 或 Google 订阅、兼容 OpenAI 的 API、Gemini、火山 Seedream，或本地 ComfyUI/MOSS）生成壁纸，并设为 Windows 桌面或锁屏。角色旅行会得到世界见闻和角色来信，回信会影响下一幕；观察世界只写世界见闻，没有角色来信。旅行记录保留在可浏览的档案里，支持导出图片或 ZIP。另有每日壁纸、立即盲盒
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Blinks the Windows notification-area icon the way QQ and WeChat do for an unread message — the app's own icon alternating with a fully transparent frame — and flashes the taskbar button, when a turn finishes or a session waits for an approval or an answer.
items.dz: 任务完成、或有会话在等你审批/回答时，让 Windows 通知区域的图标像 QQ、微信收到消息那样一闪一闪（原图标与全透明帧交替），同时闪任务栏按钮。

items.de: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.
items.dz: 在 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单中只增加一个“重启 DeepSeek Harness”项，做法是原位修改已安装的 app.asar 并在桌面端每次更新后重打补丁；需要 DSH 安装目录可写，不添加其他托盘操作。

items.de: Adds Restart App and Host, Reload Page and Force Quit items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update.
items.dz: 给官方桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘加「重启应用与 Host」「刷新页面」和「彻底退出 Harness」三项（原位修改 app.asar），并在桌面端每次更新覆盖后自动重打补丁。

items.de: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the
items.dz: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

items.de: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
items.dz: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

items.de: Event-source plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cron, webhook, file watch, and deterministic procedures, with a ledger, console, and concurrency limits.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的事件源插件：cron、webhook、文件监听与确定性 procedure，带账本、控制台和并发上限。

items.de: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
items.dz: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

items.de: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel
items.dz: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带 npm 依赖，未装兄弟插件也能工作，缺失的通道仅显示未安装。

items.de: Incrementally sync Tsinghua Learn course materials through a companion browser extension, with local file checks and per-run logs.
items.dz: 通过配套浏览器扩展增量同步清华网络学堂课程资料，校验本地文件并记录每次同步结果。

items.de: Text-to-speech service with Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers and a user-chosen voice; the agent speaks through tts_service_say, split into segments with an optional tone each, and other plugins can reuse ctx.ttsService.
items.dz: 多平台语音合成服务：豆包语音 2.0、阿里云百炼和 OpenAI 兼容接口，音色由用户选；助手用 tts_service_say 说话，可按语气分段、每段带一句语气描述，其他插件可复用 ctx.ttsService。

items.de: Expose local listening ports as public HTTPS URLs via Cloudflare Tunnel, with automatic DNS management and one-click token template authorization.
items.dz: 通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 将本地监听端口暴露为公网 HTTPS 预览链接，支持自动管理 DNS 记录与一键模板创建 API Token。

items.de: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answe
items.dz: 拿你自己的模型配置当对手玩的社交推理游戏。一张桌子有 N 个座位（默认 6 个，其中一个是你的），其余若干座位由绑定了不同 provider、model、temperature、system prompt 与伪装参数的 agent 扮演；你通过提问和交叉印证，判断哪些座位不是人。座位身份与每个 agent 的模型配置在判定前都不出现在 host 状态里，判定后才揭晓伪装参数。每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录，同一 seed 加同一份操作脚本可复现出逐字节相同的对局，于是换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度的几局可以直接 diff。

items.de: Blocks the end of a turn while temporary files from that turn are still lying around: it registers a listener on the serial agent/turn-stopping hook and, if anything is left, steers the model with the file list and two ways out — delete them, or justify each one and move it somewhere deliberate. Can
items.dz: 临时文件没清完，这一轮就结束不了：在串行的 agent/turn-stopping 钩子上挂一个监听器，发现残留就把文件清单 steer 回模型，并给两条出路——删掉，或者逐条说明理由再挪到明确位置。候选有两处很窄的临时件来源，另有一条默认开启的备份保留通道：本轮碰过的 .bak 副本超过 keep 份会被列出。第一处是会话 cwd 下的 .agent-tmp/ 约定目录：留在里面的文件一律直接报出，因为这个目录的存在意义就是装可丢的东西。第二处是本轮经 fs/write-intent 钩子真实写入的路径，这些还要同时满足：在那个 cwd 之下、不落在 .git / node_modules

items.de: Renders the chat turn navigator as a clock-like half dial: one graduation per turn, a purple graduation every fifth turn, and a blue needle on the current turn.
items.dz: 把对话右侧的轮次导航画成带刻度的半轮盘：一轮一根刻度，每第五根是紫色，细蓝色指针指向当前轮次。

items.de: Shows elapsed time, tokens, tokens per second and a shrinking countdown estimate in the chat header for the running turn, and estimates output tokens, context size, cost and duration above the composer before you send.
items.dz: 对话头部实时显示本轮耗时、token、速度与只减不增的倒计时预估；发送前在输入框上方预估产出 token、上下文大小、费用与耗时。

items.de: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overri
items.dz: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

items.de: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 对话轮次导航轨，支持 mixed / DeepSeek / Codex 三种视觉风格。

items.de: Sends Windows system notifications when DSH session turns end, with session titles, elapsed time when observed, optional foreground suppression and subagent filtering. Click a notification to focus the DSH window. DSH must remain running to deliver notifications.
items.dz: 在 DSH 会话本轮运行结束时发送 Windows 系统通知，显示会话标题及可观测的运行耗时，支持前台免打扰与子代理过滤。点击通知可将 DSH 窗口拉回前台。接收通知需要 DSH 保持运行。

items.de: Quote an earlier turn of the current conversation into the composer from the @ menu — by turn, not by selected text — so a chat that drifted can be re-anchored on what was actually asked.
items.dz: 在输入框用 @ 按轮次引用本次对话前文（不是选中文字），把跑偏的对话重新锚回当初的需求原文。

items.de: Turn rail on the left edge of the conversation: one tick per user message, hover to preview, click to jump (auto-loads earlier pages when the turn is unloaded), plus an active-turn highlight and a scroll-position indicator.
items.dz: 对话区左缘的轮次刻度滑轨：每条真实提问一根短横线，悬停预览、点击跳转（目标未加载时自动翻页），带当前位置高亮与滚动进度条。

items.de: Auto-titles conversations after the first user+assistant exchange, with a chat header button to update or manually edit titles.
items.dz: 在首轮完整对话（提问+回复）后自动生成会话标题，并在聊天顶部工具栏提供更新/编辑标题按钮。

items.de: Adds deliverable-file buttons to the end of each agent turn (opens files with the OS default app) and a floating dot rail for jumping between conversation turns.
items.dz: 在每轮对话末尾添加产出文件按钮（用系统默认程序打开），并提供可在轮次间快速跳转的悬浮圆点导航栏。

items.de: Per-turn cost in CNY, with 本轮 / 今日 / 会话 totals shown above the composer. Tokens are priced by model and by the moment they were spent (peak hours and holidays); native DeepSeek search spend can be folded in when the optional audit plugin is installed.
items.dz: 按轮显示本轮花费（人民币），输入框上方常驻「本轮 / 今日 / 会话」合计；按模型与花费时刻计价（含峰谷与节假日），装了可选的搜索审计插件后可并入原生 DeepSeek 搜索费用。

items.de: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.
items.dz: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

items.de: Per-turn cost meter and tool-loop guard for the DSH web GUI. It records model, tool and idle time for every turn, blocks runaway tool calls with a dynamic step gate, a retry breaker and a slow-command block, and renders the breakdown as a card under each reply plus a ledger view.
items.dz: DSH 网页版的每轮成本计与工具循环护栏。记录每轮模型、工具与空转耗时，用动态步数闸门、重试熔断和慢命令拦截限制失控的工具调用，并把拆分显示为每条回复下的卡片与账本视图。

items.de: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
items.dz: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 \[turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

items.de: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student panel using the current DSH session model; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, Python 3.11+, and Python runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

items.de: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
items.dz: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

items.de: English, Chinese and Cantonese typing practice with Pinyin and Jyutping hints, timed or passage modes, local conversation excerpts and local records.
items.dz: 英文、中文和粤语打字练习，提供拼音与粤拼提示、限时或按篇练习、本地对话语料和本机记录。

items.de: Bilingual Chinese and English typing practice with timed passages, IME-aware scoring, per-character feedback, and locally stored records.
items.dz: 中英双语打字练习，提供计时短文、输入法友好评分、逐字反馈和本地记录。

items.de: Unreal Engine 4/5 (UE4, UE5) asset browser and exporter for Windows x64: browse, preview and export cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse, with 3D mesh preview, animation playback and a searchable asset index. Oodle-compressed archives need Epic's oo2core DLL, which is not bundled but
items.dz: 虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine 4/5，UE4/UE5）资产浏览器与导出器，仅 Windows x64：通过 CUE4Parse 浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的烘焙资产，支持模型 3D 预览、动画播放与可搜索的资产索引。Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core DLL，包内不含，可在设置页一键下载。

items.de: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.
items.dz: UFO 档案终端：检索官方与民间记录，落到本地档案馆，离线可读。

items.de: A tidying pass over the stock UI that keeps its overall look: smaller radii, tighter spacing and a more orderly layout, for a calmer, more professional and more efficient interface. Most changes have their own switch in Settings.
items.dz: 在保持原版 UI 大风格不变的情况下，进行减小圆角、紧凑化、秩序化、整洁化改进。使 UI 视觉更加冷静、专业、高效。多数改动可在设置中单独开关。

items.de: Renders a ui-blocks file named by a ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: line in a sandboxed canvas, and turns an element token into a composer chip that serializes back to the token verbatim.
items.dz: 把 ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: 指向的 ui-blocks 文件渲染到沙箱画布，并把元素标记变成输入框 chip，回写时原样还原为标记。

items.de: Declares a UI layout contract, measures pages in headless Chrome or Godot scenes and declared layouts, and audits overlap, occlusion, overflow, clipped text, undersized targets, dead controls, spacing drift and z-order traps, with a breakpoint matrix and a sidebar panel. Page measurement needs Chrom
items.dz: 为 UI 开发声明布局契约，在无头 Chrome、Godot 场景或声明式布局中测量，并审计重叠、遮挡、溢出、文字截断、过小目标、死交互、间距漂移与层级倒置，附断点矩阵与侧边栏面板。页面测量需要 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium，并要求 DSH profile 能解析到 puppeteer-core；Godot 场景与声明式布局都不需要。

items.de: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows. Theme gallery of eight minimalist themes, each defining one palette for light and one for dark and applied through a single theme-to
items.dz: 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加。包含 8 套极简主题的画廊（每套为浅色与深色各定义一组配色，通过单一主题变量层整套换色）、把侧栏面板行收成一个「面板」入口的收纳功能（点开是两列启动面板，带搜索与键盘操作），以及侧栏底部的刷新/重启按钮。 各项功能按当前运行环境自动判断：当前版本做不到的会置灰并写明原因，探测不出来则保持可用。侧栏的刷新/重启按钮从已收录的 MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart 移植而来，装本插件前请先卸载它；两者同装会在侧栏底部出现两套按钮。

items.de: Restyles the DeepSeek Harness welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 欢迎区和输入栏换肤，并提供工作区、模式与技能快捷入口。

items.de: Drives a plugin page in the running DeepSeek Harness UI — opens the panel, reads real DOM and computed styles, clicks, types, waits for async effects, collects console errors, then returns to the original conversation.
items.dz: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 界面里驱动插件页面做验收：打开面板、读取真实 DOM 与计算样式、点击、输入、等待异步生效、抓取控制台报错，结束后自动回到原对话。

items.de: Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.
items.dz: 侧边栏底部一个按钮，点开是 0-90% 的滑块，用来调整整个 DSH 窗口的透明度，数值自动记住。只设置窗口 alpha，不改样式、不加面板、不影响其它功能。仅支持 Windows。

items.de: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.
items.dz: Ctrl+滚轮整页缩放（60%–180%，记住比例），右下角常驻「设置」入口可打开宿主设置面板，Ctrl+0 复位。

items.de: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes
items.dz: 管理 DSH 的 um-genai provider 所連的本機 UM GenAI 反代（127.0.0.1:8788）的生命週期：llm/stream 請求進來時按需喚醒、閒置一段時間後關閉、提供健康檢查與唯讀狀態端點。另附 DSH 設定頁（埠號、常駐模式、閒置分鐘、解譯器與路徑、UM 帳號、代理金鑰），以及一顆按鈕：把 providers.um-genai 寫進 profile patch 並補上模型清單（全新 profile 沒有這段設定，模型選單本來會是空的）。續期看門狗在上游 token 過期時於隱藏 Windows 桌面完成校園 gateway 登入。反代本體是 um_openco

items.de: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
items.dz: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

items.de: Turn-level file undo for tool writes and edits: each file is snapshotted before the write lands, and the model (an undo tool), the human (a /undo command) or a button in the assistant message action row can roll back every file a turn changed. Snapshots are written in-process rather than by shelling
items.dz: 按轮次回退工具写入/编辑造成的文件改动：落盘前先快照，模型（undo 工具）、人（/undo 命令）或助手消息动作行里的按钮都能一次退回一整轮改动过的所有文件。快照在进程内写入、不 fork shell，因此在 workspace-write 这类受限会话里无需额外权限放宽。

items.de: Writes one model and reasoning effort into every session at once from a control beside the composer model picker, since the shipped picker only changes the session you are in. Sessions that already match are skipped, subagent sessions follow their parent instead of being written, and the same select
items.dz: 在输入框模型位旁加一个控件，一次把同一个模型与思考程度写进所有会话——官方模型选择器只改当前会话。已一致的会话会跳过，子代理会话跟随父会话而不被单独写入，也可把同一选择钉为新建会话的默认值。

items.de: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference
items.dz: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

items.de: Unity 2022.3 editor control for the agent: 20 tools that read the scene hierarchy, create and edit GameObjects, components and serialized properties, drive Play mode, capture screenshots, evaluate C# inside the editor and start player builds.
items.dz: 让 agent 直接操作 Unity 2022.3 编辑器：20 个工具可读写场景层级、增删改 GameObject 与组件及序列化属性、控制 Play 模式、截图、在编辑器内执行 C#、发起打包构建。

items.de: Unity-MCP bridge for DSH: dormant from boot, /unity-mcp-tools connects the Unity editor MCP server (com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp) and registers the tools currently enabled on the Unity side; ships a per-plugin-version command catalog plus /unity-mcp-install and /unity-mcp-check, and re-fetches tools/lis
items.dz: Unity-MCP 桥接：开机即休眠，/unity-mcp-tools 才连接 Unity 编辑器的 MCP 服务端（com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp）并注册 Unity 侧当前已开启的工具；随包发布按插件版本生成的命令目录与 /unity-mcp-install、/unity-mcp-check 两个技能，工具集变更后桥接自行重拉 tools/list。

items.de: Session-row unread mark for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu gains Mark unread and Unmark, pinning a red dot before the session title that survives reload and opening until cleared, both entries disabled while the built-in green finished-unopened dot is present.
items.dz: 会话行未读标记：会话菜单新增「标记未读」「取消标记」，在会话标题前钉一个刷新与点开都不会消失的红点（与系统绿点区分），绿点存在时两项禁用，标记经服务端持久化。

items.de: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
items.dz: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

items.de: Checks installed plugins against a DSH update before you install it, and reports the shared UI members and host services they use that the new version no longer exports — the case where an update installs cleanly but leaves plugins failing to load. Includes a read-only diagnose command. Windows only
items.dz: 在装 DSH 更新之前，把已装插件用到的共享 UI 成员和宿主服务，与新版本实际导出的逐项比对，列出新版本不再提供的那几个——也就是「更新装上了、插件却加载不起来」那种。附一个只读 diagnose 命令。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，需要 Node.js 18+。

items.de: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the
items.dz: DSH Desktop 桌面控制中心：更新中心（侧栏版本号 + 进度条弹窗 + 一键装好 + 断点续传），外加「技能 / MCP / 智能体 / 导入」四个设置页——可从 Codex、Claude Code、TRAE、WorkBuddy 导入智能体预设与历史对话，按源地址联网搜索，侧栏笔记可多选插入聊天输入框。

items.de: Auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness — checks and updates a git-checkout or npm-global dsh plus integration repos, with ff-only pulls, automatic rollback, cancel, and an optional idle-aware auto-apply mode.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 自动更新插件：检查并更新 git checkout 或 npm 全局形态的 dsh 本体与 integrations 仓，仅快进合并、失败自动回滚、可随时取消，可选空闲感知自动应用。

items.de: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm
items.dz: 跟踪 DSH 官方版本并一键更新：读取 npm dist-tags 与 GitHub 更新说明，列出当前版本到目标版本之间每一个版本的更新点，给出分级风险清单（预发布、破坏性变更措辞、本机多份安装与 PATH 不一致、插件 dsh.engines.dsh 兼容性、备份与回滚可用性），再把安装交给分离助手——用 rename 原子备份当前安装、执行 npm、校验落地结果、用原命令重启，新版本起不来就自动回滚。

items.de: Adds an 'Upgrades' tab to the DSH Plugins page: npm update checks for all installed plugins, engines.dsh compatibility preflight before upgrading, and one-click in-place upgrades that bypass pnpm's 24-hour release-cooling gate. Also refreshes the npm dependency families pulled in by GitHub-sourced b
items.dz: 在 DSH 插件页新增「升级」标签：集中检查全部插件的 npm 新版本，升级前预检 engines.dsh 兼容性，一键原地升级并绕过 pnpm 的 24 小时发布冷却期； 支持刷新 GitHub 来源插件内含的依赖全家桶，并可检查 DSH 本体是否有新版。

items.de: Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 升级后自动巡检已安装插件的兼容性，修复或禁用不兼容插件；宿主启动失败时由宿主外 supervisor 救援，必要时回滚到上一个宿主版本。

items.de: Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.
items.dz: 允许将任意文件上传给 DSH，按工作区与会话隔离。输入框内置文件库，服务端生成缩略图，右键菜单可打开、复制、重新下载或删除。

items.de: Resolves the original local path of files uploaded to .dsh-uploads by matching file name, size, and sha256.
items.dz: 通过文件名、大小和 sha256 反查上传到 .dsh-uploads 的文件在本地原始位置的绝对路径。

items.de: When enabled, exchanges the running process's launch token for a browser-session cookie at a configurable public URI (default /trustme), so a first visit needs no ?token= in the URL.
items.dz: 开启后，在可配置的公开 URI（默认 /trustme）上把当前进程的 launch token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，首次访问无需在 URL 里带 ?token=。

items.de: Model quota and account balance gauges with quota grouping and configurable usage thresholds. A fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage that keeps its plugin row id and /api/deepseek-usage route, so it cannot be installed alongside the upstream.
items.dz: 模型额度与账户余额表盘，支持额度分组和自定义用量阈值。基于 dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的分支，沿用上游的插件行 id 与 /api/deepseek-usage 路由，不能与上游同装。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 168.63.129.16 for network access

items.de: Reports DSH session token usage from the local session logs as a host-side tool: totals, input, output and cache-read split, a per-day timeline, usage grouped by day or session and optional cost estimates.
items.dz: 以 host 侧工具统计 DSH 会话 token 用量，数据取自本地会话日志：总量、输入、输出与缓存读取拆分、按天时间线、按天或按会话分组的用量，以及可选成本估算。

items.de: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to nas:19347

items.de: Sidebar card that prices this session's tokens in RMB at official peak/off-peak rates and splits context share by source, with per-turn pricing and a Markdown/CSV history report.
items.dz: 侧栏常驻卡片：按 DeepSeek 官方价目（含峰谷与缓存差价）把本会话 token 折算成人民币，并按来源拆开上下文占比；逐轮计价，另附 Markdown/CSV 历史报告。

items.de: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.
items.dz: 本机跨会话用量汇总：把 qfmodel 这类不透明路由键解析为真实模型名，含逐请求明细表与可编辑的四桶价格表（无公开单价的模型标为未计价而非猜测），趋势柱状图按日历日补齐、数值仅在悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示。

items.de: Usage statistics inside Settings: a GitHub-style one-year conversation heatmap of your own daily messages, token usage totals by model and by day/week/month with stat cards, and a per-day list of files written or edited via write/edit tools. All computed locally from session history with incremental
items.dz: 设置面板内的使用统计：GitHub 风格一年对话热力图（按每天本人消息数着色，自动排除子代理与注入上下文）、按模型与按天/周/月汇总的 Token 用量（统计卡片 + 表格）、以及每天通过 write/edit 工具产出或修改的文件清单（日期选择）。全部本地扫描会话历史完成、增量更新，数据不出本机。

items.de: Usage and balance dock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: today's spend next to a Beijing-time peak/off-peak pricing band, today's tokens and cache hit rate, and a plain balance row that opens a detail panel. The panel lists the balance account, an eight-week activity heatmap where any day can be sel
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的用量与余额悬浮卡：今日花费配北京时间峰谷计价带、今日用量与缓存命中率，以及一行余额入口。面板里有余额账户明细、近八周活跃热力图（可点选任意一天），以及当天的用量、命中率、峰谷费用和按会话拆分的明细（每个会话带自己的成分条）。用量只读本机会话日志；唯一的对外请求是用 DSH 里已配置的供应商 base URL 查询余额。基于 Aisland-SJL/dsh-usage 大幅改写的分支，使用相同的插件 id（usage），两者只能安装其一。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
items.dz: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

items.de: Shows how much of your Claude and Codex plan limits you have used: a line above the prompt in dst with 5-hour and weekly windows, percent used and time to reset, and a ring meter beside the context meter in dsh web that opens a panel listing every window.
items.dz: 在 DSH 中显示 OpenAI 与 Codex 的用量配额：Web 端用环形表与面板展示 5 小时 / 7 天窗口，dst 端在状态行显示同样的窗口。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Compile a video link into timestamped Markdown knowledge cards with back-links to the exact moment. Requires your own Python 3.10+ and yt-dlp (ffmpeg + faster-whisper only for videos without subtitles; Bilibili login cookies for members-only subtitles).
items.dz: 把视频链接编译成带时间戳、可回跳原片时刻的 Markdown 知识卡。需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 yt-dlp（无字幕视频另需 ffmpeg + faster-whisper，B 站会员字幕需登录 cookie）。

items.dz: 下载视频链接、从中抽帧，并用 Groq Whisper 转写语音，让 agent 能回答视频内容相关的问题；过长音频会切成 15 分钟片段以符合上传上限，没有 key 时仍会返回抽帧，只有转写需要该 key。需 PATH 中有 ffmpeg、ffprobe 与 yt-dlp。

items.de: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.
items.dz: DSH 网页客户端的越南语界面（全部 2,615 条核心文案）、浅色与深色各三套越南风配色，以及来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮播背景（逐张标注作者与许可）。

items.de: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
items.dz: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

items.de: Ask a vision-capable model about a local image from any session, including sessions whose own model is text-only. On the default path the plugin calls the host's route in-process with ctx.llm.stream(), so the host's credentials stay inside its provider adapters; only the optional direct/custom OpenA
items.dz: 任意会话都能让视觉模型读本地图片，包括会话本身用的是纯文本模型的情况。默认路径下插件通过 ctx.llm.stream() 在进程内调用宿主路线，宿主凭据留在 provider 适配器里；只有可选的 direct/自定义 OpenAI 兼容路线会读取密钥（来自插件配置或 apiKeyRef 指向的 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml）。

items.de: Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.de: Lets the agent drive Windows by sight: Windows OCR turns on-screen text into clickable targets, then clicks, drags, scrolls, types and presses keys, verifying each action with a per-pixel diff and an OCR text delta; F6+F7 is a separate emergency stop.
items.dz: 让 Agent 看着屏幕操作 Windows：用 Windows OCR 把界面文字变成可点目标，再执行点击、拖动、滚轮、键入与按键，每步都用逐像素差分和文字增删复核；F6+F7 由独立进程急停。

items.de: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page
items.dz: 面向视觉回归的像素级截图比对。输入两张本地 PNG，第一行是可机器判定的结论（`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`，可以直接 grep 当断言），随后是差异比例、差异区域包围盒、最大通道差与平均绝对误差，并生成一份自包含的 HTML 对照页。可用绝对或比例坐标声明忽略区，排除时钟、光标这类每次渲染都会变的部分。它刻意不做内容识别——只回答「变没变」，因为这一步可以做成确定性的。全部本地完成：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

items.de: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.

items.de: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0
items.dz: 让纯文本模型也能看图：发图自动用视觉模型描述（默认提示词），描述不足时对话模型自动生成更具体的提示词重新解析；系统模型/自定义双模式 + GUI 可视化配置、Key 脱敏安全、针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 的宿主小补丁（见仓库 README）。

items.de: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
items.dz: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

items.de: Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
items.dz: 为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

items.dz: 给 AI 加上声音：带情绪的语音合成（有 ChatTTS 用 ChatTTS，否则回退 edge-tts）和唱歌模式，生成 mp3 并可用 ffplay 本机播放。需本机安装 Python 3.10+ 与 edge-tts（ChatTTS 及其模型缓存可选）、ffmpeg/ffplay，并把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 pythonPath/ffmpegPath/ffplayPath 改成你自己的安装路径。
