items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动式 VS Code 风格工作台，包含 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 面板、内容搜索与 SSH 终端。

items.de: Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.
items.dz: 把 DSH 对话界面改成 Visual Studio Code 编辑器风格：14px 常驻滚动条、扁平半透明滑块，并在右侧加上 VS Code 式 Minimap（小地图）：高度不超过半屏、悬停才显示滑块、点击/滚轮即可跳转滚动，同时自动展开“加载更早”的过往对话。

items.de: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and per
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

items.de: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
items.dz: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

items.de: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
items.dz: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

items.de: Keeps a root turn open until the child agents and current-turn background jobs it started settle, then asks for one self-contained final answer in that same turn. It observes job settlement without consuming job output, never cancels children, and does not decide task success. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-
items.dz: 让根轮次等自己启动的子智能体和本轮的 background job 都结束后，才在同一轮里要求模型产出完整、自洽的最终回答。只观察 job 是否结束、不消耗 job 的输出，不取消子智能体，也不判定任务成功。仅在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 上验证；其他宿主版本下插件保持未激活、只写一条警告，轮次按原生方式收尾。回复之后每到一批结果会多一次模型调用，普通问答不增加。

items.de: Resumes a dormant DSH session on demand: when a session is not currently live, it is resumed from disk with the provider/model route it last used, so external integrations (chat bridges, schedulers, webhooks, other plugins) can deliver into it instead of failing with "that session is not alive". Exp
items.dz: 按需叫醒休眠的 DSH 会话：当前没活着的会话会带着它上次用的 provider/model 路由从磁盘 resume 回来，让 QQ 通道、定时任务、webhook、别的插件这类外部集成能正常投递，而不是撞上「那间会话现在没活着」。提供 HTTP 端点、wake_session 工具和 ctx.wakeUp 服务；resume 只把历史读回内存，本身不消耗模型请求。

items.de: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

items.de: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: One image behind the whole DSH shell. The image layer sits at z-index -1 and the shell's two --dsw-* tokens are repointed at translucent tints, so the picture shows through the frame, sidebar and composer. Ships a bundled default picture so it works with zero configuration, plus a floating panel wit
items.dz: 给整个 DSH 外壳铺一张背景图：图片层挂在 z-index -1，并把外壳的两个 --dsw-* 令牌改成半透明色，让背景透出侧栏、中栏和输入框。内置一张默认图，装完零配置就有；右下角浮动面板提供五个滑杆、预设档、上传与带 SSRF 防护的链接导入，改动写进本地 settings.json，样式表被 SPA 顶掉时会自动重画。

items.de: Photo wallpaper for the DSH Web UI, with local image uploads and live mask, blur, saturation and panel translucency controls.
items.dz: DSH Web 图片壁纸插件：本地上传图片，实时调节遮罩、模糊、饱和度与面板透明度。

items.de: Shows the local desktop wallpaper behind a translucent DeepSeek Harness window: the image is pixel-aligned with the desktop (edge-snaps, partially off-screen and maximized windows included), follows wallpaper and slideshow changes, and adapts the readability veil to the image brightness; dialogs, me
items.dz: 把本地系统壁纸显示在 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口背后并逐像素对齐桌面（贴边、移出屏幕、最大化都适用），跟随壁纸与幻灯片切换，按壁纸明暗自动调节可读性蒙层；对话框、菜单、内嵌浏览器、输入框与搜索框保持原本不透明配色。

items.de: Per-wallpaper offset for dsh-dream-skin - nudge the current wallpaper along X and Y in pixels from Settings, remembered separately for each image, URL or gradient.
items.dz: dsh-dream-skin 的壁纸位移插件：在设置里按像素微调当前壁纸的 X 与 Y 偏移，图片、URL、渐变三类壁纸各自记忆。

items.de: Applies the Naihuangxin appearance preset with settings backup and restore. A preset for elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0; that plugin and the local Naihuangxin wallpaper (Workshop 3808236079) are required.
items.dz: 应用奶皇新外观预设，支持设置备份与恢复。它是 elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0 的预设，需先装该插件并备好奶皇新壁纸（工坊 3808236079）。

items.de: Security review for DSH plugins: reads the manifest, install hooks, native dependencies and source for network egress, dangerous APIs and credential paths, cross-checks the curated market registry, and returns a 100-point verdict with itemised findings. Read-only — it never executes the audited code
items.dz: 装插件前的安全体检：读 package.json、安装期脚本、原生依赖与源码，扫外联域名、危险 API、凭据路径，再交叉核对市场的能力声明与红线，给出 100 分制评级与逐条发现。只读，不执行被审计代码。

items.de: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. It hooks `tools/pre-execute`: a local regex pass over destructive commands (`rm -rf`, `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `DROP TABLE`, `format`, disk writes) and sensitive paths (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `.ssh`, `.git/`, `$DSH_HOME`) runs first with no latency,
items.dz: 工具调用的对抗式审查门。它挂在 `tools/pre-execute` 上：先用本地正则零延迟筛破坏性命令（`rm -rf`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`DROP TABLE`、`format`、写盘）和敏感路径（`.env`、`id_rsa`、`.ssh`、`.git/`、`$DSH_HOME`），只有命中才升级给一次审查模型调用，返回 allow / deny。普通读取与普通写入完全不进这条路径，日常工作没有额外延迟；每次判定都在 Web GUI 里实时显示。

items.de: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout. Palettes are switched under Settings → General.
items.dz: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。在「设置 → 通用」中切换配色。

items.de: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
items.dz: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。

items.de: An always-on-top desktop pet (a washing machine) that renders session state as washing actions: four switchable skins, multi-session counters, and proactive done / stuck / approval alerts on macOS and Windows, plus a detail panel with recent turns and timings.
items.dz: 常驻桌面的桌宠（桌面宠物）：一台滚筒洗衣机，把会话状态渲染成洗衣动作，四套皮肤（精密家电 / 复古奶油 / 工笔重彩 / 太空舱）可切换，多会话计数、洗完 / 卡住 / 等你确认主动提醒；macOS 与 Windows 均可运行，详情面板可看最近几轮与耗时。

items.de: Continue DeepSeek Harness conversations on an Android watch and install the watch app with a desktop wizard.
items.dz: 在 Android 手表上继续 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持通过电脑端向导安装手表应用。

items.de: Watch a video together with a text-only agent: with ffmpeg and the bundled browser extension reporting your real playback position (not a timer), it hands over one segment at a time just before that segment ends. It ships no TTS engine — it emits timed speech events, and speaking them aloud needs yo
items.dz: 和只有文字的智能体一起看视频：需要 ffmpeg 和浏览器扩展上报真实播放位置（不是定时器），在每段结束前把画面和台词交到它手上。插件不带 TTS 引擎，只按时间轴发台词事件，要出声需自行配置语音/TTS。

items.de: Wayland desktop control for GNOME/Mutter sessions: screenshot, OCR with screen coordinates, click by text, and batch input actions. Needs a Python 3 backend with python3-gi and GStreamer; OCR needs Tesseract.
items.dz: GNOME/Mutter 下的 Wayland 桌面控制：截图、带坐标的 OCR、按文字点击，以及批量输入动作。后端为 Python 进程，需 python3-gi 与 GStreamer；OCR 需 Tesseract。

items.de: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies a
items.dz: 把 DSH 与本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端接起来，分四块：读写与搜索 WorkBuddy 的记忆、技能、计划和日志；经本机 CodeBuddy CLI 跑任务，带四档权限；通过 CDP 驱动正在运行的 WorkBuddy 窗口（打开会话、以清洗后的富文本读取回复、代打字并发送、切换按账号计费的模型、端口缺失时带调试端口重启它）；再加一个侧栏面板，把同样的对话界面放进 DSH。一个插件里共 25 个工具、15 条 HTTP 路由。

items.de: A wb_archive tool that turns a single Weibo post link (m.weibo.cn/status/...) into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: long posts are fetched in full, images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, and resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest
items.dz: wb_archive 工具：把微博单条链接（m.weibo.cn/status/…）经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——长文取全文、图片转存不裂链、删博后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

items.de: Annotate elements, blank positions or dragged regions in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab; each batch is saved as screenshots plus report files and attached to the next message as text. Does not replace the official Browser, Chat or Layout providers.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右侧边栏 Browser 中批注元素、空白位置或框选区域；每批保存截图与报告文件，并以文本形式附加到下一条消息。不替换官方 Browser、Chat 或 Layout 提供方。

items.de: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
items.dz: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

items.de: Human-only browser panel that opens as a full page in the DSH main content area: multiple tabs, an address bar, a context menu, a homepage with pinned shortcuts, and a history page stored in IndexedDB. Pages render in the webview bridge that ships with DSH Desktop, and the current page can be opened
items.dz: 只交给人操作、不在 AI 侧注册任何工具的浏览器面板：在 DSH 右侧主内容区整页打开，提供多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、带钉住快捷入口的主页与 IndexedDB 永久保存的历史页。页面在 DSH Desktop 自带的 webview 桥里渲染，当前页可交给本地 Chrome 打开。

items.de: Manage a LAN or Tailscale reachable dsh web instance from inside DSH. dsh web listens on loopback by default; this adds a Settings > Web access panel that detects the machine's Tailscale and LAN addresses, starts dsh web bound to the one you pick, and shows the token URL to open on a phone or anothe
items.dz: 在 DSH 内管理一个可被局域网或 Tailscale 访问的 dsh web 实例。dsh web 默认只监听回环地址，本插件新增「设置 → Web 访问」面板：自动探测本机的 Tailscale 与局域网地址，选定后启动绑定到该地址的 dsh web，并给出可直接在手机或另一台机器上打开的带 token 地址。同时支持停止、重启、查看子进程日志、持久化绑定地址与端口，并注册两个智能体工具（dsh_web_control、dsh_web_config）。零运行时依赖。能访问该绑定地址并拿到带 token 地址的人，就拥有你 dsh 的全部权限（文件与命令）；局域网模式是明文 HTTP，Tai

items.de: Exposes Chrome DevTools Protocol to the agent through 17 tools for page summaries, element locators, activity timelines, console, network, storage and downloads, reading either a browser the plugin launches on its own or the tab the user is currently browsing through a small browser extension.
items.dz: 通过 17 个工具把 Chrome DevTools Protocol 接给 agent，提供页面概览、元素定位、操作时间线、控制台、网络、登录态与下载，读取对象可以是插件自带的专用浏览器，也可以经浏览器扩展读取你当前正在浏览的标签页。

items.de: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.
items.dz: 把内置 web_fetch 工具的抓取后端换成 Decodo Web Data API：默认返回 Markdown，并把 fetchProvider 固定为 decodo，可配置单进程抓取上限；需要 Decodo API Key，web_search 不受影响。

items.de: Password-protected LAN gateway for DeepSeek Harness, letting a phone browser on the same Wi-Fi drive the desktop DSH; DSH's own files are untouched, but a small compatibility polyfill is injected into the pages served to the phone. Plain HTTP, trusted LAN only.
items.dz: 带密码的 DSH 局域网网关，手机连同一个 WiFi 就能用浏览器打开电脑上的 DSH；不改 DSH 自身文件，但会向发给手机的页面注入一小段兼容 polyfill。明文 HTTP，仅限可信局域网。

items.de: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settin
items.dz: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

items.de: Password gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that also removes the 403 a reverse proxy causes, with revocable sessions, an admin page and zero dependencies.
items.dz: 给 DSH Web UI 加密码登录，同时修掉反向代理导致的 403，带可吊销会话、管理页和零依赖。

items.de: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
items.dz: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

items.de: Material 3 Expressive theme layered over the built-in light/dark/system preferences, mapping every host alias token to colour roles generated from the official M3 colour library, plus expressive shape, motion, M3 menu surfaces and touch-browser ergonomics.
items.dz: 叠加在宿主浅色/深色/跟随系统偏好之上的 Material 3 Expressive 主题：把宿主全部别名 token 映射到官方算色库生成的颜色角色，并补上方圆轮廓、动效、M3 弹层菜单与触屏适配。

items.de: Adds an element and region picker to the DSH Desktop built-in browser: hovering labels the element under the pointer, a click records that element, a drag records a rectangle, and each pick opens a small note box beside the pick. A batch is then inserted into the composer draft, never sent automatic
items.dz: 在 DSH 桌面版内置浏览器里加一个元素 / 区域选取层：悬停显示所指元素，点选记下元素、拖框记下矩形，每条当场在选取框旁弹小卡片写说明；整批会写成一段文字插进对话输入框，并把每条裁剪截图作为附件挂上，不会自动发送，检查、改完再自己按回车。仅桌面版可用：Web 版浏览器是 iframe，选取层不会出现。

items.de: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
items.dz: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

items.de: Turn a logged-in DeepSeek web account into an OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoint, with tool calling, image input, an account pool and a local admin console. First use needs a one-time `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs` in the installed plugin directory to download DeepSeek's PoW runtime from the
items.dz: 把已登录的 DeepSeek 网页账号包装成 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口，支持工具调用、图片输入、账号池与本地管理台。首次使用需在插件目录手动运行一次 `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs`，从 DeepSeek 官方 CDN 拉取 PoW 运行时；未拉取时反代能启动，但所有上游请求都会失败。

items.de: Three-party collaboration protocol for dsh: Step List state machine, five-tier review chain (Gemini/web/Claude Code/dialog/manual), alternatives adjudication, cross-restart resume with heartbeat, and capability persistence.
items.dz: dsh 三方协作协议插件：Step List 状态机、五级审核链（含本地 Claude Code 混合审）、alternatives 裁决、无介入续跑与能力持久化体系。

items.de: 9router-backed web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness. Enabling the bundle automatically routes native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router; disabling it restores the remaining provider configuration.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 9router 网页搜索与抓取。启用插件包后自动接管原生 web_search/web_fetch，停用后恢复其余配置层的提供方选择。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Exa search provider for the dsh-web seam: the web_search tool sends queries to Exa's /search API and returns the results as sources, in dsh web, dsh-TUI and headless runs. Needs an Exa API key (EXA_API_KEY, the credential store or a key file read on every search). web_fetch is unchanged and there is
items.dz: dsh-web 接缝的 Exa 搜索提供方：web_search 工具把查询发送到 Exa 的 /search API，并把结果作为来源返回，适用于 dsh web、dsh-TUI 和 headless 运行。需要 Exa API key（EXA_API_KEY、凭据存储，或每次搜索时读取的 key 文件）。web_fetch 不变，没有界面。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: A WebSearchProvider that falls back across backends instead of relying on one: Exa, then Bing HTML, then DuckDuckGo HTML, and only then the quota-limited SerpAPI, so the free tiers carry routine searching.
items.dz: 多后端自动降级的 WebSearchProvider：依次尝试 Exa、Bing HTML、DuckDuckGo HTML，都失败后才动用有额度的 SerpAPI，日常搜索由免费档承担。

items.de: Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
items.dz: 联网搜索的「搜索洞察」：记下 Agent 查了什么、搜回哪些网页，并统计每轮与整个会话的搜索次数、返回网页数、被引用数与被打开读过的页数；这些数字在回答下方的引用入口和右侧栏面板里随时能回看。

items.de: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
items.dz: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Drop-in web_search provider that follows the session's routed model: a runtime-editable priority chain with three wire dialects (Anthropic web search, OpenRouter online, Zhipu bigmodel), per-route endpoints and credentials, a Settings UI panel, local JSONL call audit, and built-in official fallback.
items.dz: 替换内置 web_search 的 provider：按会话当前路由的模型选择端点与凭据，运行时可编辑的优先级链支持 Anthropic web search、OpenRouter online、智谱 bigmodel 三种方言，设置 UI 面板可视化编辑，本地 JSONL 调用审计，链全失败回退内置官方方案。

items.de: Adds a Tavily search provider to the DSH web search seam, keyless by default so it works without an account or API key.
items.dz: 给 DSH 的网页搜索接缝接上 Tavily，默认免注册、免 API key。

items.de: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
items.dz: 为 ctx.web 接缝注册 Tavily 搜索 provider 并把 web_search 切到它；apiKey 支持逗号分隔多 key，遇到 401/403/429/5xx 与网络错误自动轮换。

items.de: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
items.dz: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
items.dz: 右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

items.de: Claude-styled terminal panel for the DSH web GUI: agent shell commands run in a persistent real PTY with a genuine prompt, echo and exit codes, auto-open in the right sidebar and are scoped per conversation; optional live_terminal_* tools for reading, searching and screenshotting. Fork of Lancang-hz
items.dz: DSH 网页版的 Claude 风格终端面板：agent 的 shell 命令跑在常驻真终端里（真提示符、真回显、真退出码），右侧栏自动弹出并按会话隔离；可选 live_terminal_* 工具用于读取、搜索与截屏。本项目是 Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal（MIT）的衍生版，沿用同一套 live_terminal_* 工具与右侧栏面板，不能与上游插件装在同一 profile。

items.de: Tavily, Exa and Firecrawl behind one normalized web_search and web_fetch seam: a failing vendor falls through a cooled-down chain, and the row is a host Config form the desktop page and dsh-go both edit.
items.dz: 把 Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl 归一到同一层 web_search 与 web_fetch：厂商失败时按冷却链回退，配置是宿主的一段 Config 表单，桌面与 dsh-go 读写同一处。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.
items.dz: 在设置页新增「查看 URL」：显示当前会话的临时访问地址，以及一个长期不变、局域网内其他设备也能直接打开的固定地址。

items.de: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
items.dz: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

items.de: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Ki
items.dz: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

items.de: Syncs DSH model providers and models across computers through any WebDAV server: the backup is sealed with a passphrase before it leaves this machine, so a new machine opens with the same model list.
items.dz: 通过任意 WebDAV 服务在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的模型供应商与模型：备份离开本机之前先用口令封好，新机器打开就是同一份模型清单。

items.de: Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与页面抓取：包含 Search provider、支持 Tavily Extract/Firecrawl/本地 HTTP 的 Fetch provider，以及设置卡片。需要 Tavily API key，Firecrawl 可选。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
items.dz: 省 token 的网页阅读：底层是真 Chrome/Edge（CDP），一次调用读完多个页面、按相关性筛掉不相关的，只回一段带账本的摘要（实测省 80–98% 上下文）。真实搜索链接、登录态、截图、三档代理。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to www.gstatic.com

items.de: Fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth adding a deny-by-default allowlist route gate over resources, plugin bundles, /api and WebSocket upgrades; password and OIDC/SSO login with an SSO-only mode; server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies plus a per-browser session list and selective revocation; an OAuth 2.
items.dz: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，新增默认拒绝的白名单路由闸门（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 升级）；密码与 OIDC/SSO 登录及「仅允许 SSO」模式；服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie，浏览器会话列表与单条吊销；面向 App/CLI 的 OAuth 2.1 设备授权（RFC 8628），设备会话独立、仅主动吊销失效；核心会话桥在服务端换取 launch Cookie，不向客户端暴露 launch token。 本插件是 Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，不能与原版同装——安装前请先从 profile 的 bund

items.de: WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over Tencent's iLink bot channel: one session per contact, inbound text/images/files, and WeChat's native typing indicator while a turn runs.
items.dz: 基于腾讯 iLink 机器人通道的微信桥：每个联系人一个独立会话，支持入站文本/图片/文件，并在整轮运行期间显示微信原生“正在输入”。

items.de: Two-way WeChat bridge: reads incoming messages from the local WeChat database and sends replies through Windows UI automation, so you can talk to a local DSH session from your own WeChat. Outsiders who can message this WeChat account can chat with the local session by default (they cannot run comman
items.dz: 微信双向桥：读微信本地数据库收消息、用 Windows 界面自动化发消息，用你自己的微信和本机 DSH 会话对话；默认允许任何能给这个微信号发消息的联系人与本机会话聊天（他们不能执行命令或读写文件）；可配置入站白名单限制谁能对话。

items.de: WeChat-style light theme with a dark icon rail, grey conversation list and green chat bubbles.
items.dz: 微信风格浅色主题，包含深色图标栏、灰色会话列表和绿色聊天气泡。

items.de: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
items.dz: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

items.de: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a ses
items.dz: DSH 的持久微信桥：一个微信用户对应一个持久智能体会话，走官方 iLink 通道，上下文与用户→会话映射在重启后保留。没有发送者白名单——任何能给所配对微信号发消息的人都能发起对话并获得拥有工具权限的会话，工作目录默认是用户主目录；请使用专用账号并设置 WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD。

items.de: Forward WeChat chat records into DSH sessions: a Windows share target captures the merged-forward ZIP, an in-GUI overlay picks the destination workspace and session, and the ZIP arrives as a file-attachment user message the agent unpacks and reads. Media entry extensions are normalized by magic byte
items.dz: 把微信聊天记录转发进 DSH 会话：Windows 分享目标接收合并转发的 ZIP，GUI 浮层选择目标工作区与会话，ZIP 以文件附件用户消息到达，agent 解压并读取。按魔数纠正媒体扩展名（微信常把 PNG/HEIC 字节命名为 .jpg），投递失败时批次保留可重试。需 Windows 10/11 并开启开发者模式，先运行仓库安装脚本注册分享目标。

items.de: WeChat-style skin for the Harness web UI: grey chat list, green outgoing bubbles, white incoming bubbles, a green send button, and a 已归档 tag on archived sessions.
items.dz: 把 Harness 界面换成微信风格：灰白配色、绿色气泡、绿色发送键、微信字体，已归档会话带「已归档」标签。

items.de: Turns your local WeChat group chats into a followable todo board: a three-column kanban (todo / doing / needs you) with LLM summaries, automatic flagging of messages that @-mention or reply to you, drag-to-change status, and local-only storage. Needs a local Python 3 with sqlcipher3 and zstandard, p
items.dz: 把本地微信群聊变成可跟进的待办看板：三栏（待办 / 进行中 / 需要你）配模型总结、自动标出 @ 你或回复你的消息、拖拽改状态、仅本地存储。需本机 Python 3 并装好 sqlcipher3 与 zstandard，且已有 rion-wechat-reader 的 config.json 与 keys.json（插件不负责取密钥）；总结时会把群聊原文发给所选模型。

items.de: WeCom smart bot over the official long connection (Bot ID + Secret, no public callback): persona, sender identity tags, three-layer memory with a forgetting curve, reminders, opt-in proactive chat, owner-only work mode guarded by tools.guard, auto-steer, image input and a wecomSoulBot host service;
items.dz: 企业微信智能机器人官方长连接接入（Bot ID + Secret，无需公网回调）：人设、发送者身份标记、带遗忘曲线的三层记忆、提醒、可选主动搭话、由 tools.guard 拦截的仅主人工作模式、运行中自动插话、图片输入和 wecomSoulBot 宿主服务；群聊 @ 时回复。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Report generator that follows your own style: pick DSH sessions by time window and slice each one to the turns inside it, optionally merge Git commits from several repositories filtered by author, then a new session reads the evidence with read-only collector scripts and writes a daily, weekly or mo
items.dz: 按你给定的样例风格生成日报/周报/月报：按时间窗口挑选 DSH 会话并只取窗口内的回合，可选合并多个仓库中按作者过滤的 git 提交，再由新会话用只读采集脚本读取证据写出 Markdown 报告；成品进入本地报告库。

items.de: WeChat bridge and native Web settings panel with QR scan login, live token health probe, and credential management.
items.dz: 微信双向通道与原生设置管理面板，支持扫码登录、实时连通性与过期探测、单实例选举锁及凭证管理。

items.de: Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话归档进自建 WeKnora 知识库，含提取、总结与增量去重。

items.de: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.
items.dz: 闲置一段时间后回到会话时，在该会话里显示它的上一条消息，并提供断点恢复。

items.de: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
items.dz: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

items.de: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.
items.dz: 提取抖音、B站、快手与 YouTube 短视频的文案与字幕，并带标题、作者、话题与互动数据；抽取器以 Python 随包提供。

items.de: Long-form manuscript verification team for DSH: installs 10 skills that run a read-only content/structure check, three-tier revision proposals, a human-selection gate, exact replacements and a final re-check; it never edits the manuscript by itself and requires Agent Teams to spawn teammates.
items.dz: 长篇/设定集文稿校验团队：安装 10 个技能，跑「只读校验→三档建议→作者勾选→定点替换→逐字复核」六步流水线；不自动改稿，需要 Agent Teams 组队。

items.de: WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader: QR or Cookie login, store search, resume reading, and weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter agent tools.
items.dz: 微信读书右侧栏书架与章节阅读器：支持扫码或 Cookie 登录、书城搜索与续读，并提供 weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter 工具。

items.de: Digital Study: a private WeRead study in the DSH sidebar, in a calm light-green paper palette. The shelf folds into ten categories and carries a slightly deeper paper tint of its own; highlights and thoughts page through, copy per item, and export as front-matter Markdown (one file per book or a cro
items.dz: 数字书房：把微信读书搬进 DSH 侧栏的私人书房，清爽的浅绿纸感配色。书架折叠成 10 大类并自带一层略深的纸色；划线与想法可分页、可单条复制，也能勾选导出成带 front-matter 的 Markdown（一本书一个文件，或跨书批量），存到你指定的目录；整间书房还能一键备份与恢复成一份 JSON。想法页按手记排版：行距更松、来源书名完整展示、长内容可一键展开，并能在卡片里展开同章的划线作参考。五档阅读热力图只画到今天，数据收在网格下方一行；上方是可切换年份的统计表盘。同步是增量的：靠本地账本与每本书的计数比对，数据没变化时 2~3 秒就完成，不用整库重拉；进度提示条会在完成后 8 秒自动消

items.de: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same
items.dz: 在 DSH 里组织《新版一夜狼人杀》：确定性发牌、夜序、换卡、投票与结算，自带房间界面与夜间私聊提示。包内是 baixianger/dsh-chat 与 baixianger/dsh-bridge 的修改版快照；请先卸载这两个上游插件，同时启用会重复注册 dshChat / dshBridge 服务。

items.de: One install for a whale-girl boot animation, a cyber code-eye video background and a holographic dark theme. The skin and background video (CC BY-NC-SA) are downloaded from the upstream repo on first launch; the boot animation is only installed when @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation is already present.
items.dz: 一次装好鲸鱼娘开机动画、赛博代码眼动态视频背景与全息暗色主题。皮肤与背景视频（CC BY-NC-SA）在首次启动时从上游仓库下载；开机动画仅在本机已装 @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation 时才生效。

items.de: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plu
items.dz: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性

items.de: Weather care for DeepSeek Harness: turns a forecast into one sentence you can send — clothing and umbrella advice from feels-like temperature, humidity and air quality, adjusted for how cold-sensitive the user is and how they commute. Also a switchable daily care push, extreme-weather alerts and rem
items.dz: 天气关心：把预报变成一句能直接发出去的话——按体感温度、湿度、空气质量给穿衣与带伞建议，并照顾对方怕冷怕热、骑车还是开车。另有每日主动关心（可开关）、极端天气预警与提醒，在 agent 醒来时评估，可由 qq-bridge 这类宿主定时唤醒；偏好只存本机。

items.de: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面里的两分钟小游戏：抓到的数字累加到身上，比自身大的鱼会掉一颗心，白饭回血，鲸元券让下一钩无视大小。单文件 HTML，不联网，无数据上报。

items.de: A talking whale desktop pet for the DSH web UI — persona-driven chat with persistent memory, plus scheduled autonomous web browsing that brings back a summarized message telling you what she found. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (its art and animations are reused under the upstream non-commercial ter
items.dz: DSH Web 界面右下角的会说话的鲸鱼桌宠：可配置人设与持久对话记忆，还会按间隔自己随机上网，把见闻总结成消息带回来告诉你。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的二次创作（沿用其形象与动画素材，素材不可商用），请替代 dsh-pet 安装，不要与上游同装。
rl: uses literal IP 198.18.0.0 for network access

items.de: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
items.dz: 会话内读 B站与抖音：B站走 WBI 签名接口，全部请求共用一个限速器（默认 4 请求/秒，吃 412 后按主机冷却），覆盖视频、热门、搜索、UP主、评论、弹幕、字幕；抖音则通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 渲染，读热榜、视频、推荐流与搜索。

items.de: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count repo
items.dz: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女孩桌宠，手写 SVG + CSS 动画（无图片/音频素材，零运行时依赖）：任务运行中游泳，调工具时吐带标签的泡泡，等待审批时贴屏幕敲玻璃并伴随琥珀色脉冲，完成时跳一下并汇报本轮耗时与工具数，失败时下沉，闲置或深夜戴睡帽打盹。单击戳一戳，双击摸头涨好感，拖拽后记住位置，右键菜单可喂食/静音/回默认位置/隐藏，悬停显示等级、称号、经验条与本轮统计。`whale_say` 工具让 Agent 借她说话或做动作，作为轻量可见通知。只读会话与工作区，仅写入 ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json。

items.de: A pixel whale-girl desktop pet for DSH on Windows: live agent state from real session events, poke and tickle, Ctrl-drag, 72-480 px resize, and a transparent always-on-top Electron window with 22 bundled animations.
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话状态变成 Windows 桌面上的像素鲸娘：按真实会话事件实时换动作，可戳脸、挠痒、按住 Ctrl 拖动，72–480 px 缩放，独立 Electron 透明置顶窗，随包附带 22 个动作。

items.de: Reads local DSH session logs to show real token totals, session count, estimated cost and budget, a 14-day usage timeline, per-session breakdown and CPU monitoring, plus a draggable token/cost status window and a whale-girl who eats rice as tokens are spent.
items.dz: 读取本机 DSH 会话日志，展示真实 Token 总量、会话数、估算成本与预算、14 天消耗时间线、逐会话明细和 CPU 监控，并提供可拖动的 Token/成本状态小窗，以及随 Token 消耗干饭的鲸鱼娘。

items.de: A greeting card that speaks — 156 prebuilt voice clips with a one-click mute — plus per-turn completion reports, long-run companionship notes and a takeover approval panel in the DSH conversation area.
items.dz: 会说话的问候卡（156 句预生成语音，卡角一键开声/静音）、每轮任务的完成报告、长跑时的陪伴提示，并在需要授权时接管输入框请示。

items.de: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severiti
items.dz: 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与全部祖先进程链），bash 命令预检（pkill 自匹配、sudo -S 抢 stdin、rm -rf / 等），以及可扩展规则库（block / warn / hint 三档）。

items.de: Diary and narrative memory for companion agents: daily first-person entries scoped per group or private chat, refs that can be checked against that day's messages, and a read-only journal page where hand-drawn doodles and photos follow the sentences they belong to.
items.dz: 给陪伴型 agent 的日记 / 叙事记忆：按天、按 scope 写「自己视角」的话，每条尽量能回指到当天的消息；附带只读日记页（简笔画 / 照片跟着句子走）与接地审计。

items.de: Object memory for DSH: each object is broken into fourteen kinds of smallest elements (shape, material, state, part, function...), observed links are stored apart from inferred ones, and analogies stay as questions until the user answers.
items.dz: DSH 元素记忆库：把物体拆成十四类最简元素（形状、材质、状态、部位、功能等），观察到的边与推断出的边分开存放，猜想只作为问题等待用户回答。

items.de: She keeps the questions your chats left unanswered, then goes and looks them up later. A line she asked you that ended in "?" and never got an answer is stored as a hanging question; on a schedule inside a daily window (08:00–23:00, five a day by default; an optional mouse/keyboard-idle gate is off
items.dz: 让她自己补上那些你没答、她也没懂的问题。聊天里她问出口、以问号结尾、又没等到回答的话，被记成一条「悬着的问」；到点（默认 08:00–23:00、每天最多 5 条，可选的键鼠空闲闸默认关闭）她挑最久的那条自己去查——搜网页与 B 站，只读真正读得进来的页面，提炼成两三句，在你桌上留一张纸条。问的是我们自家插件的事就跳过，留给你答。全程只读她的经历：不写她的记忆、不动她的成长，也不需要改 dsh-fish 一行代码。需已装大肥鱼人格插件 @ssamurias/dsh-fish 提供经历，并配本地 ollama 模型；搜索 API 可选。

items.de: What it does while she sleeps, in one card. Two things: (1) tidy the element memory — merge synonyms only when the model agrees, trim descriptions, prune weak links, propose analogies for the user to confirm, with a backup before every write and a 15%-of-library cap per pass; (2) dream — stitch her
items.dz: 她睡着时的两件事，装在同一个设置页里。① 睡眠整理：模型点头才合并同义词，压短描述，剪掉弱边，把元素组合成猜想请用户确认；每次写入前先备份，单次改库不超过全库 15%。② 潜意识梦：拿她自己经历过的旧事（加上元素库里的"道具"）拼成 3–6 句的小故事，在桌上留一句并标明「是梦，不是发生过的事」。梦只存在自己的文件里，不进她的记忆，也不进她的人格提示词。需已装 @ssamurias/dsh-fish（提供经历）与 dsh-memory-brain（元素记忆库）；模型复判与做梦还需要本地 ollama（或付费 API）。

items.de: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the art
items.dz: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

items.de: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell
items.dz: 为 DSH Web 界面加的一层动态鲸鱼背景：由鲸鱼剪影采样出的粒子场，加上一层点阵网格，两者都是挂在 shell.overlay 上的全屏点击穿透 canvas；粒子加载时聚合、空闲时呼吸、指针靠近时被推开，网格点靠近指针会放大，配色跟随页面明暗主题。

items.de: Animated pixel-art blue and white whale pet that sits on top of the composer in a new session.
items.dz: 在新会话中，一只蓝白相间的像素风小鲸鱼趴在输入框上方游动。

items.de: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, ques
items.dz: 鲸港 WhaleHarbor 大白鲸娘桌面窗宠：13 个 AI 生成零件以 CSS 纸片人方式驱动（呼吸、眨眼、呆毛摇摆、汗滴、蹦跳与抖动），八种状态实时反映 DSH 工作情况——空闲、忙碌、审批、提问、出错、庆祝、打盹、子代理分身——支持戳一戳、拖动、三档尺寸、托盘开关与气泡实时统计。需 WhaleHarbor 桌面壳（当前提供 Windows 构建）。

items.de: Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.
items.dz: 针对 DSH 思考模式鲸鱼尾巴的动画，丰富成 4 种动画。

items.de: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.
items.dz: 给 dsh-whale-widget 换图的插件：内置抠图流水线把任意图片替换成小鲸鱼，另有会话头部重启按钮、浏览器心跳，以及默认关闭的挂件补丁自愈（需显式开启）。

items.de: Provider-agnostic text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: synthesize speech to local audio files, manage preset, cloned and designed voices, configure providers in a bilingual settings card, and read assistant replies aloud with optional auto-read.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用语音合成：把文本合成为本地音频文件，管理预置、克隆和设计音色，在双语设置卡里配置 provider，并可用朗读按钮或自动朗读播报助手回复。

items.de: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
items.dz: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

items.de: Quote books in the conversation header: one markdown file per chat, with search, a random pick, line and favourite counts, a keep button under every reply, and a trash with restore. The agent gets four tools (append, list, remove, merge) and a system-prompt guide, so by default it may save up to a l
items.dz: 会话头部的「鲸语」：每个对话一本 markdown 语录，带搜索、翻一句、句数与收藏计数、每条回复旁的一键收入，以及能恢复的回收站。agent 有增、查、删、合并四个工具，系统提示里也带一段记录指引，所以默认每个对话它最多自己记一两句；记什么可按对话或全局设置。全部只存本地。需要 DSH 0.2.1+（0.3 以下）。

items.de: Whale-themed desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with a local todo list: click the pet to add or edit tasks inline, get reminders that get more frequent as a due date approaches, and optionally append one short AI-written next step to a reminder. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); artwork keeps the u
items.dz: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的蓝发桌宠「鲸事本」：点一下弹出待办面板，可点击编辑、到期渐进提醒；开启「待办建议」后，提醒还会按概率追加一句 AI 生成的简短下一步建议。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），素材沿用其非商用条款。请替代 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 安装，不要与它同时安装。

items.de: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.
items.dz: 命令解析取证：一条命令实际会跑哪个文件、PATH 哪一条胜出、遮蔽了谁、有多少重复与死条目，以及同名副本报的版本是否一致。

items.de: Shared editable Excalidraw whiteboards with per-session multi-board management, quick navigation, incremental AI edits, curves, polylines, and image exports.
items.dz: 人机共享的可编辑 Excalidraw 白板，支持同会话多白板管理、快速跳转、AI 增量编辑、曲线折线和图片导出。

items.de: A per-command sandbox allow-list for the bash tool: a rule names a CLI and the writable roots it gets, so allow-listed programs such as lark-cli and gh run inside the kernel sandbox with the workspace plus those roots appended. Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writab
items.dz: 按命令生效的 bash 沙箱白名单：一条规则指定一个命令和它可用的可写根，命中的 lark-cli、gh 等在保留工作区的前提下于内核沙箱内直接执行。与「替你回答授权弹窗」或「对所有命令统一放宽可写范围」的做法不同，这里放行的只有命中的那条命令，工作区仍可写，其他命令行为完全不变。匹配依据是命令的「写足迹」而不是命令字符串，因此 `2>&1 | tail -N` 这类不写文件的管道仍能命中；规则可在设置页或插件行里编辑。macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap / Landlock，Windows 则退回把可写根换成 $HOME 的旧行为。

items.de: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
items.dz: 把 DSH Web 客户端对话列宽度设为其自身宽度的百分比（40–100，默认 100 即铺满整列），取代内置的 680–920px 阅读宽度，并在「设置 > 插件」中提供可折叠的调整卡片。

items.de: Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu.
items.dz: DSH 原生 macOS 桌面小组件中心：管理任意多个 widget 实例——行情小窗（5 源 fallback、交易时段感知节流）与便签，每实例一个独立 NSPanel+WKWebView 窗口（detached 独立进程、任意拖动、类型感知右键菜单）。实例以三层视图（列表 / 类型选择 / 详情）在 DSH 设置页卡片式配置；market_quote 模型工具供任意会话拉标准化行情；Type Studio 一键创建「创造模式」空会话并预填 issue-template 模板，起草新的 widget type。

items.dz: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

items.de: Long-term memory about the owner: extracts schedule, likes, dislikes, emotional triggers, current focus, promises and tone preferences from each turn, injects a short digest into every prompt, speaks up on a schedule or slips a caring line into replies, learns wake/work/sleep times from short messag
items.dz: 只记关于主人的长期记忆：每轮抽出作息、喜好、雷点、情绪触发、在忙什么、约定与说话方式，把很短的摘要注入每轮提示；会按点主动开口或在回复里顺口关心一句，从短句里学作息，记忆攒多了自动整合——带有插件来源与对外发送动作识别、未核实记忆降权与一键撤回。

items.de: Windows-native computer use for DeepSeek Harness: two tools drive and read any desktop app. One batch call runs find, click, type, key, read, wait and screenshot steps in a single engine pass, so a task whose steps are known up front costs one model round trip; reading returns window text rather tha
items.dz: DSH 的 Windows 原生电脑操控：两个工具即可驱动并读取任意桌面应用。一次批量调用把找控件、点击、输入、按键、读取、等待、截图放进同一次引擎请求，步骤可事前确定的整件事只花一轮模型往返；读取返回窗口文本而非图像，输入与抓取优先走 UIA 模式、Win32 消息与 PrintWindow 离屏抓取，用户的焦点与鼠标全程不受打扰。

items.de: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的 Windows 桌面控制：窗口与 UI Automation 自动化、本地 Windows OCR、通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直读浏览器 DOM 并执行 JS、拟人化鼠标键盘、浏览器标签页管理，以及一个实时控制面板。首次启动自动探测本机能力并写入配置，缺失的能力自动降级而非报错。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

items.de: Windows host rules for DSH agents: one skill with nine individually switchable rules (UTF-8/BOM, CRLF-LF per file type, build output, SmartScreen, _scratch isolation, screenshot privacy gate, teardown, shared-doc lock, local trust marks) and six bundled dependency-free scripts.
items.dz: 为 DSH Agent 提供 Windows 宿主规则：一个九条规则、可逐条开关的技能（UTF-8/BOM、按文件类型的 CRLF/LF、构建产物、SmartScreen、_scratch 隔离、截图隐私门禁、临时产物清理、共享文档锁、本地信任标记），附带六个零依赖脚本。

items.de: Adds a Windows system-proxy switch to DeepSeek Harness: toggles the HKCU Internet Settings proxy with a WinINET refresh, together with the git, npm and pip proxy settings, from chat, the /proxy command or a Settings page.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统代理开关：写注册表并通知 WinINET 重载，同时切换 git、npm、pip 的代理配置，支持对话、/proxy 命令和设置页三个入口。

items.de: Registers one `wind_finance` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it routes a financial question to the right Wind data domain, executes it over the Wind meta-router MCP endpoint (or the per-domain CLI in batch mode), and keeps a per-day receipt so the same dataset is not pulled twice against one shared daily
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `wind_finance` 工具：把金融问题路由到正确的 Wind 数据域，经 Wind meta-router MCP 端点（或批量模式下的分域 CLI）执行，并用按日回执避免同一份数据在共享日额度下被重复取数。认证、额度与网络失败如实返回错误码，不换数据源兜底。凭据只从环境变量读取，不随插件分发。

items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的窗口关闭行为——可选询问、最小化到托盘或完全退出，记住选择并可在设置中修改，还能把会话或工作区开进独立窗口。仅限 Windows：需要 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5+，并用 PowerShell 脚本给应用壳（resources/app）打补丁；每次升级 DSH 后需重跑，未装壳扩展时关闭行为仍是 DSH 默认。

items.dz: 记住 DSH 桌面窗口的位置、大小与最大化状态，下次启动回到上次离开的地方。窗口逻辑放在独立的 PowerShell 脚本里，不依赖客户端版本；插件外壳只负责安装、自启和开关。

Remembers the DeepSeek Harness main window's size AND position: restores both on every launch (re-asserted during a grace period to beat the default layout), saves stable manual moves/resizes as the new lock, never records minimized/ma
items.dz: 仅限 Windows（用 koffi 绑定 user32.dll，macOS/Linux 上不生效）。记住 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口的尺寸与位置：启动时恢复上次的位置和大小，并在宽限期内反复断言以压过默认布局；手动移动或调整窗口后自动保存为新锁定；最小化/最大化/全屏状态不会被记录；DSH 自行放置的默认矩形永远不会被采纳，应用自身的布局重置无法污染锁定；更换显示器时自动防屏外。兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+。

items.de: Minimizes or closes only the windows the agent opened during a task, using a baseline snapshot; pre-existing user windows and shell processes are left alone. Windows only.
items.dz: 清场：任务收尾时只收 AI 本次新开的窗口，默认最小化，不碰用户原有窗口；仅 Windows。

items.de: Windows computer use for DSH built on a native C# engine: text-only DeepSeek models can read UI Automation controls and fill forms in verified batches without screenshots, stale control refs can be re-found by unique identity, CAPTCHAs and verification codes are refused and handed back to you throug
items.dz: Windows 电脑控制插件（C# 原生引擎）：纯文本 DeepSeek 模型也能读取 UI Automation 控件、批量填表并逐项回读，不需要截图；控件重新渲染后可按唯一身份找回；遇到验证码和动态码拒绝代填，通过 DSH 审批框交给你处理；随时按 Esc 停止。本项目基于 Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win 改造；请勿与上游插件同装，两者会争抢同一张桌面。

items.de: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
items.dz: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

items.de: Windows native toasts for DeepSeek Harness: pops a toast when a session needs you (approval, question, error, optional turn end), click to return to DSH, answer approvals with Allow/Deny buttons on the toast, plus a notify_user tool and an HTTP API.
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Windows 原生通知：会话需要你操作（要权限、提问、出错、可选回合结束）时弹 Toast，点通知回到 DSH，通知上可直接「允许/拒绝」审批，另提供 notify_user 工具与 HTTP 接口。

items.de: A slim tool strip beside the conversation: one-line notes into a sticky note, a follow-up or a reminder (the sticky-note and follow-up modes need the dsh-sticky-wall and dsh-followup plugins installed); selected text quoted, saved or handed to the model; saved prompts into the composer in one click;
items.dz: 挂在对话旁的贴边工具条：一句话记成便签、跟进或提醒（便签、跟进两种需另装 dsh-sticky-wall 与 dsh-followup 插件）；选中文字可引用、留存或交给模型；常用指令一键插回输入框；总结当前或上一个会话；只读面板看上下文占用、本轮 token、子代理和未完成跟进；设置里还能加自定义入口（打开路径或运行命令）。

items.de: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
items.dz: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.dmtf.org

items.de: Five agent tools that administer a WordPress and WooCommerce site over the REST API - posts, pages and custom post types; media uploads with alt text; products, variations, orders, coupons, customers and reviews; plugins, themes and block-theme templates; classic menus need the companion dsh-bridge
items.dz: 通过 REST API 管理 WordPress 与 WooCommerce 站点的五个 Agent 工具：文章、页面与自定义内容类型；带替代文本的媒体上传；商品、变体、订单、优惠券、客户与评价；插件、主题与区块模板；经典菜单需另装配套的 dsh-bridge WordPress 插件。工具描述与错误提示支持中英双语。

items.de: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their relations from your notes, and hands tasks to separate assistant sessions. Ships its own WeChat bot channel (scan to log in; private chat onl
items.dz: 微信工作助理：把你交代的事记进 SQLite 任务账本，按紧急度排序，到点提醒，从笔记里抽取人物与关系，并把任务分派给独立的助手会话。自带微信机器人通道（扫码登录，仅私聊）与整页仪表盘。

items.de: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
items.dz: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

items.de: A draggable sticky note that counts today's and this month's earnings in real time from your work hours, with an optional photo, GIF or video background.
items.dz: 可拖动的桌面提示贴，按上下班时间实时计算今日与本月收入，支持照片、动图或短视频背景。

items.de: Work-review loop for an Obsidian-style vault: writes a day's Dream with a numbered T/G plan, executes only the items marked routine (read-only by default, local commits only with --live), folds seven days into an ISO-week routine, and shows every day and week in a read-only sidebar panel.
items.dz: 面向 Obsidian 风格 vault 的工作回顾闭环：每晚生成当天 Dream 与编号 T/G 计划，只执行标记为「常规」的条目（默认只读，--live 才本地 commit），把七天汇总成 ISO 周周报，并在只读侧栏面板里展示日报与周报。

items.de: Open source links from DeepSeek Harness conversations at the referenced line, review Git diffs beside the chat, inspect paused variables, and turn explanations into searchable Markdown memory cards. The workbench also shows Python class relationships (beta). Go and Java navigation require language s
items.dz: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对话点击源码链接，直接跳到指定行。在右侧工作台查看 Git 差异和断点变量，也可以把讲解保存为可搜索的 Markdown 记忆卡片。支持 Python 类关系图（Beta）。Go 和 Java 跳转需要语言服务器，断点调试需要调试适配器。

items.de: Agent Studio for DSH Web: configure models, prompts, per-plugin tool bindings and Skills; trial-run with editable tool results and run history; preserve session capability snapshots; export standalone presets; draft Agents with a guided creator preset.
items.dz: DSH Web Agent 工作室：配置模型、提示词、按插件绑定的工具与 Skills；支持编辑工具结果的试运行和运行历史，保留会话能力快照，导出独立 Preset，并通过引导式创建预设生成 Agent 草稿。

items.de: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the Xunlei engine needs its own SDK and API key. Built mainly for Windows.
items.dz: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。

items.de: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; the port card works on Windows only and the GPU card needs nvidia-smi.
items.dz: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量的卡片，可放大到整页；端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

items.de: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).
items.dz: 为 DSH 会话首屏的品牌标识与工作区选择器换上 Wordless 风格的着陆视图。原生输入框保持不变；选择器仍可在弹窗内添加新工作区（本条目像原生选择器一样自带 directory-flow 子槽位）。

items.de: Claim WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy CN / WorkBuddy global) daily check-in credits and benefit bonuses from a composer-dock card and an agent tool, using the official web OAuth login — no desktop client or third-party plugin needed. If another WorkBuddy plugin has already saved a login in ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vau
items.dz: 输入框工具行卡片与 agent 工具一键领取 WorkBuddy 每日签到积分与福利积分；走官方网页 OAuth 登录，无需桌面客户端或第三方插件。若本机其他 WorkBuddy 插件已在 ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault 里保存了登录态，会直接复用，不再让你重新授权。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Reusable workflows: orchestration scripts saved as files under .dsh/workflows, discovered from the project, and run by name with arguments, so they live in git and can be shared. Four tools: list, show, run, save.
items.dz: 可复用的工作流库：编排脚本存成 .dsh/workflows 下的文件，从项目中自动发现，按名字带参数运行，可进 git、可团队共享。四个工具：list、show、run、save。

items.de: Step-by-step workflow map for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into one step list, labels where each percentage came from rather than reporting a bare number, and queues a prompt for the next step with revoke before it is claimed.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 分步工作流地图：把会话折叠成一条分步列表，给每个进度百分比标注来源而不是只报一个数，并支持把提示词排入下一步队列、被取用前可撤回。

items.de: Read-only workflow panel for DSH: overview, six gates, milestones, org template, task flow and roster - project data from a project.json file, roster from the live DSH state, ledger presence from the ledger directory. Ships as a Cordis bundle with two GET-only routes and writes nothing to the projec
items.dz: 只读的 DSH 工作流面板：概览、六道门、里程碑、组织模板、任务流与人员卡——项目数据来自 project.json，人员卡来自 DSH 实时状态，台账只读其目录。以 Cordis bundle 形式安装，只注册两条 GET 路由，不写入项目文件或 DSH 状态文件。

items.de: Configurable serial agent-team workflows with a Manager, role Actors, an independent Judge, and a visual workflow editor.
items.dz: 可配置的串行 Agent 团队工作流，提供 Manager、角色 Actor、独立 Judge 和可视化工作流编辑器。

items.de: Preset workflow template library: 12 reusable orchestration script templates with wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate tools and static template validation.
items.dz: 预置 Workflow 模板库：12 个可复用编排脚本模板，提供 wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate 工具与模板格式静态校验。

items.de: Show workflow stages and subagents on a timeline, configure model and concurrency for each stage, and reopen subagent conversations from the panel. Run names and stage settings persist under ~/.dsh.
items.dz: 在时间线中查看工作流阶段和子代理，为每个阶段配置模型与并发，并从面板打开子代理对话。运行名称与阶段设置保存在 ~/.dsh。

items.de: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons f
items.dz: 对话内工作流运行时间线：横向轨道 + 阶段站 + 子代理药丸 + 循环弧线 + 并行带，替换官方 workflow 工具卡与 workflow-run 聊天节点。客户端脚本扫描让计划站在开跑前全部渲染；状态点与图标对齐 DSH 官方 primitives。

items.de: Four agent presets for the default plan-native workflow in DeepSeek Harness: plan plans and delegates, work coordinates execution, code owns implementation changes, and review performs independent read-only audits. Each role has a defined tool-permission matrix. Works with the sibling l2-protocol bu
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个 Plan 原生工作流角色预设：plan 规划与分派、work 协调执行、code 负责源码修改、review 独立只读审核。每个角色具有明确的工具权限矩阵，可配合 l2-protocol 执行显式启用的受控轮次。

items.de: Plan-native multi-agent workflow for DeepSeek Harness: plan directs, work coordinates, code writes, and review audits read-only. Ordinary tasks need no authorization card or budget form. Includes 14 chain_* tools for explicitly authorized controlled rounds, with a frozen T0 baseline, layered evidenc
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan 原生多 Agent 工作流：plan 负责规划、work 负责协调、code 负责写入、review 负责只读审核。普通任务无需授权卡或预算表单。提供 14 个 chain_* 工具，支持显式授权的受控轮次，包括冻结 T0 基线、分层证据和阻塞式关轮门禁。支持按角色配置模型，需同时安装 l1-presets。

items.de: Installs the whole role-chain toolchain in one step: four agent presets (plan, work, code and review) plus fourteen chain_* tools for evidence-bound rounds, with a settings card. It ships the protocol runtime itself, so no sibling package is needed. It replaces the separate l1-presets and l2-protoco
items.dz: 一步装齐角色分工工具链：四个智能体预设（plan、work、code、review）与十四个 chain_* 工具，用于证据可追溯的受控轮次，并带设置卡片。协议运行时随包提供，无需另装同级插件；它取代原先分开的 l1-presets 与 l2-protocol 两条，启用前需先移除那两条。

items.de: Cross-session development worklog for the agent: worklog_add appends one line (optional tag) to today's file, worklog_list reads a day back or lists the days on record. Entries are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/worklog, so the next session can pick up where the last one stopped.
items.dz: 给 agent 的跨会话开发日志：worklog_add 往当天文件追加一行（可带 tag），worklog_list 按天回读或列出有记录的日期。条目是 $DSH_HOME/worklog 下的纯 JSON，下一次会话能接上上一次停在哪。

items.de: Turns DSH session logs into Markdown work reports for a day, an ISO week or a month, grouped by working directory. Each session lists its requests, changed files, tool counts and interruptions, and a closing section names the most-changed files, generated documents and key commands. Adds the /worklo
items.dz: 把 DSH 的会话日志还原成 Markdown 工作台账：日报、周报（ISO 周）或月报，按工作目录分组。每个会话列出需求、改动文件、工具用量与中断次数，末尾附「产物」清单：改动最多的文件、新生成的文档、关键命令。提供 /worklog 命令、worklog_generate 工具，以及一个设置页，用来调整存放目录、跨天合流、产物清单与每周定时生成。

items.de: Registers one `workpaper_gate` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it audits a workpaper set for completeness, covering both the target design or template itself and the instance-versus-template structure, with the rule list, template list and core-table list all configurable in one spec file. Findings come
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `workpaper_gate` 工具：审核底稿完整性，既审目标（设计层/模板）自身，也审底稿实例与模板的结构一致性；规则清单、模板清单与核心表清单全部配置化在同一个 spec 文件里。结果按 blocker / warning / info 分级，底稿只读不改。需 Python 与 openpyxl。

items.de: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.
items.dz: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

items.de: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify t
items.dz: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

items.de: A right-sidebar gallery of every image and video in your workspace, newest first, with thumbnails, type filters, search, and a lightbox.
items.dz: 在右侧栏把工作区里所有图片和视频按时间倒序铺开，带缩略图、类型筛选、搜索和灯箱查看。

items.de: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
items.dz: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

items.de: Batch-archive or restore all conversations of a workspace from a sidebar panel or its row menu, hide a workspace from the sidebar once every conversation in it is archived, and pin workspaces to the top. Hiding never deletes logs, moves directories, or changes membership.
items.dz: 在侧栏面板或会话行菜单里批量归档/恢复整个工作区的全部会话；工作区会话全部归档后从侧栏隐藏，恢复任一会话即重新出现；并支持工作区置顶。隐藏不删除日志、不移动目录、不改会话归属。

items.de: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.
items.dz: 替换出厂侧边栏工作区浏览器，补上最近会话、可添加额外源文件夹的项目编辑器，以及置顶、重命名、派生和归档行操作。

items.de: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running
items.dz: 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单中新增「技能与 MCP」，按工作区勾选可用的技能与 MCP 服务器；取消勾选的技能从会话技能目录、`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 中消失，取消勾选的服务器其 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话禁用，已在运行的会话从下一轮起生效。

items.de: A sidebar panel that moves, rebuilds, merges, renames and deletes whole workspaces: a move re-publishes each session log with the new directory in its header, repairs the workspace record, refreshes the cached title, and every card shows whether its sessions are running or only open.
items.dz: 侧栏里的工作区面板：迁移、重建、合并、重命名、删除整个工作区——迁移会用新目录的 header 重新发布会话日志，修复工作区归属并刷新标题缓存，每张卡片标明会话是在运行还是仅被打开。

items.de: Windows x64 preview that detaches workspace/session navigation into a separate .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen window, with grouped trees, overview/focused modes, logical drag-and-drop, activity/manual ordering and a resizable focused-view preview; no DSH Core patch and no Better Workspace
items.dz: Windows x64 预览版：将工作区与会话导航分离到独立的 .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen 窗口，支持分组层级、总览与聚焦模式、逻辑拖放、活动或手动排序，以及可调整高度的聚焦预览区；不修改 DSH Core，不运行时依赖 Better Workspace。衍生自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace，不能与上游同装。

items.de: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.
items.dz: 在可拖动、透明度可调的目录面板中显示当前对话的工作目录与文件列表。

items.de: Adds extra working directories to a workspace, each read-write or read-only, from a folder button next to the composer or the `/add-dir`, `/remove-dir` and `/dirs` commands; the model sees them in its runtime context, and `write` and `edit` calls into read-write directories skip the sandbox escalati
items.dz: 为工作区添加额外的工作目录，可设为读写或只读，可通过输入框旁的文件夹按钮或 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` 命令管理；模型可在运行时上下文中看到这些目录，对读写目录的 `write` 与 `edit` 调用默认免去沙箱提权确认，终端命令仍会询问。

items.de: Extra folders registered for a workspace become real workspace roots: the session runtime context lists them, a workspace_roots tool reports each root top-level entries, git branch and AGENTS.md/README/manifests, and file tools read, write, patch, move and delete inside them without approval prompts
items.dz: 为某个工作区登记的额外文件夹会被当作真正的工作区根目录：会话运行时上下文会列出它们，workspace_roots 工具给出每个根目录的顶层结构、git 分支与 AGENTS.md/README/清单文件，文件工具在这些目录里读写、打补丁、移动、删除都不再弹审批。入口是侧栏工作区行的悬停按钮或设置页。Windows 上系统沙箱无法给进程追加可写目录，因此 pwsh 仍限制在工作区内。

items.de: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
items.dz: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

items.de: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
items.dz: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。
rl: runs code at install time (postinstall)

items.de: Adds per-workspace icons and a default session icon to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. The workspace icon is picked inside the existing rename-workspace dialog; sessions without an IM channel get a default icon drawn with the same title pseudo-element the IM plugin uses, so the two stay aligned, while
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加逐工作区图标与默认会话图标。工作区图标在原有的「重命名工作区」弹窗里选取；没有 IM 渠道的会话显示默认图标，画法与 IM 插件同源的标题伪元素一致、两者对齐，已有渠道 logo 的会话保持原样。会话行相对工作区多缩进一级并带一条竖直引导线。图标来自 73 个内置 Lucide 图标、上传的 SVG，或从官方目录关联的 Iconify 图标库；配色跟随主题，不提供自定义调色。

items.de: Sorts the DSH sidebar workspace list: the workspace you last sent a prompt in rises above the first non-running one, with pin, drag-to-reorder, name filtering and one-click tidy; also removes empty workspaces and relocates a workspace folder to a new path while carrying its conversations over.
items.dz: DSH 侧栏工作区排序：刚发过消息的工作区升到「第一个非运行工作区」之上，另有置顶、拖拽排序、按名称筛选与一键整理；并可清理空工作区、把工作区文件夹连对话一起迁到新路径。

items.de: Workspace manager in the sidebar: a workspace-to-session tree table with name and path search, column sorting, unarchived-session counts, batch archive, session and workspace rename, workspace removal that keeps files and logs, and extra source folders per workspace passed to the agent as context wi
items.dz: 侧栏工作区管理：工作区→会话树形表格，支持按名称与路径搜索、按列排序、未归档会话计数、批量归档、会话与工作区重命名、移除工作区（保留文件与会话日志），并可为每个工作区添加额外源文件夹——作为上下文提供给 AI，不授予文件访问权限；同一套操作也以 workspace_manager 工具暴露。

items.de: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
items.dz: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

items.de: Moves a workspace to another folder from its right-click menu: renames the folder, carries its nested workspaces and sessions along, rewrites their records, rolls back if anything fails, and can be undone in one click. Developed on Windows; macOS and Linux share the same code path and are exercised
items.dz: 在工作区右键菜单里把整个工作区搬到另一个目录，顺带重命名：嵌套工作区与会话一起迁移并改写记录，失败自动回滚，移动后可一键撤销。在 Windows 上完成开发；macOS 与 Linux 走同一套代码路径，并在 CI 里用真实 Harness 实例跑通移动与撤销。

items.de: Restrict the file access of agents in any sandbox mode (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto) to the session workspace, and ask the user to rule on cross-border access. Each session can also use the gear selection box next to the composer to relax the cross-border gate to 「 read-o
items.dz: 把任何沙箱模式（read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto）下代理的文件访问限制在会话工作区内，越界访问一律请用户裁决；每个会话还能用 composer 旁的档位选择框把越界门禁放宽为「工作区外只读」或「完全放开」。

items.de: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.
items.dz: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

items.de: Replaces the sidebar workspace folder picker with a name box (type a name, get a same-named folder and a new workspace), adds a Move to workspace action that clones a session into another workspace and archives the original, and optional per-workspace memory that opens a continuation session after c
items.dz: 把侧栏的工作区文件夹选择器换成命名框（输入名称，自动建同名文件夹并新建工作区）；会话菜单新增「移动到工作区」（把会话克隆到目标工作区并归档原会话）；可按工作区开启的记忆：压缩后自动开续接会话，并提供 workspace_memory 检索工具。

items.de: Deletes a whole workspace together with its conversations in one pass - session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations - and optionally sends the workspace folder to the Windows Recycle Bin (on other platforms deletions are permanent).
items.dz: 整块删除工作区及其对话：会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记一次清掉，可选把工作区目录移入回收站（仅 Windows；其它平台直接永久删除）。

items.de: Replaces the DSH sidebar list with a workspace rail: pinned chats and folders, projects that are folders with their own AGENTS.md and files, a virtualized Recents list ordered by the last finished turn, a project_search tool, unread markers, a collapsed icon column with an unread count and a live br
items.dz: 用工作区栏替代 DSH 侧栏列表：置顶会话与文件夹；项目即带自有 AGENTS.md 和文件的文件夹；Recents 为按最后一次完成 turn 排序的虚拟列表；提供 project_search 工具、未读标记、带未读数的折叠图标栏，以及随会话实时更新的浏览器标签标题。

items.de: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
items.dz: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

items.de: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.
items.dz: 侧边栏「工作区」与导航之间的可拖动分隔条，上拖把高度让给会话列表，双击恢复默认。

items.de: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a session; the file stays out of git.
items.dz: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

items.de: Renders a workspace's own sessions above its nested workspace folders in the sidebar's Workspace Tree.
items.dz: 把侧栏工作区树里每个工作区自身的会话排在它嵌套的子工作区文件夹之前。

items.de: Shares one right-sidebar across every conversation in the same workspace, so you don't have to reopen it when creating or switching conversations, with a switch in Settings → General.
items.dz: 让同一工作区内的所有对话共用同一份右侧边栏，不用新建或者切换对话时候重新打开，并在「设置 → 通用」提供开关。

items.de: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three
items.dz: 工作区切换成本量化：量每个工作区的冷启动开销（AGENTS.md + 技能目录 + 工具 schema + 运行时上下文）、稳态值、 几轮到达稳态，然后横向对比并归因。归因需要至少三个工作区，不到就明说数据不够而不是拿两个点编一个相关性； 在所有工作区之间没有差异的因素被标注为 profile 的属性而非项目的属性。按"进入成本 × 访问频率"给出常驻/ 归档建议。纯确定性。

items.de: Sync workspaces, session history and automations to your own cloud folder (any folder-synced backend), so a new machine picks up where you left off. The cloud folder holds plaintext session logs; workspaces hidden or locked by dsh-workspace-vault are not uploaded.
items.dz: 把工作区、会话记录与自动化任务同步到你自己的云端目录（网盘同步文件夹，后端可扩展），换机器登录后拉取即见。云端目录里是明文会话日志；被 dsh-workspace-vault 隐藏或加锁的工作区不会上传。

items.de: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row green.
items.dz: 为每个工作区分配稳定的暖到冷色调，把工作区名设为分组标题并把会话缩进其下，同时在会话完成未读时整行染绿。

items.de: Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.
items.dz: 按工作区规则为新建根会话自动应用 Agent 预设与权限预设（设置 - 工作区默认设置），仅使用官方扩展点。

items.de: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
items.dz: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

items.de: Pin workspaces and tasks in the sidebar, with a password-protected hidden space and a workspace access lock. The lock only hides items in the interface and does not encrypt session files on disk; dsh-workspace-sync skips hidden and locked items.
items.dz: 在侧栏置顶工作区和任务，并提供密码保护的隐藏空间与工作区访问锁。锁只在界面上隐藏内容，不对磁盘上的会话文件加密；dsh-workspace-sync 会跳过隐藏和加锁的内容。

items.de: Packages a working style into a versioned pack of rules, skills and presets injected into the system prompt at global, project or session scope, distills local agent sessions into aggregate reports and suggested rules you can adopt or undo, exports the pack as a tarball a teammate can install, and s
items.dz: 把工作方式打包成可版本化的规则、技能与预设包，按全局、项目或会话作用域注入系统提示；可蒸馏本机 Agent 会话生成聚合报告与建议规则，供采纳或撤销；导出 tar.gz 供同事安装；并附带含 40 个技能的 FDE 参考包。

items.de: Codex-style location, worktree and branch switchers on the New Session screen of DSH; all git work runs in the host half.
items.dz: 在 DSH 新建会话页提供 Codex 风格的工作位置、worktree 与分支切换器，git 操作全部由 Host 半执行。

items.de: Session-header environment and branch chips: Local git-switches the checkout; Worktree creates an isolated git worktree under .agents/worktrees, registers it as a workspace, and offers merge, squash, delete, and auto-cleanup.
items.dz: 在空白会话加入环境与分支 chip：本机切换当前检出，Worktree 在 .agents/worktrees 下创建隔离 git worktree 并注册为工作区，会话头部提供合并、压缩提交、删除与自动清理。

items.de: Git worktree management for dsh — group workspaces by repository, create and switch worktrees, and browse their changes, commit history and file diffs.
items.dz: dsh 的 Git worktree 管理——按仓库聚合工作区，创建与切换 worktree，并查看变更、提交历史与文件差异。

items.de: Adds a one-click Worktree switch beside the composer that moves an empty session into a new git worktree, and removes worktrees idle for three days.
items.dz: 在输入框分支标记旁提供一键 Worktree 开关，让空会话进入新的 git worktree；三天无活动的 worktree 自动清理。

items.de: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
items.dz: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

items.de: WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: run Linux commands, manage distros, convert paths, and copy across the Windows/Linux boundary.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 的 WSL(Windows Subsystem for Linux)桥接：跑 Linux 命令、管理发行版、路径转换与跨系统复制。

items.de: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
items.dz: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

items.de: Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.
items.dz: 为 WSL2 上的 DSH Landlock 沙箱追加 /dev/dxg 与 /proc 的读写授权，使受限的 agent bash 会话中也能使用 CUDA。

items.de: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
items.dz: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

items.de: WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness. A sidebar W button lists installed distros and registers a Linux folder as a host workspace addressed by a UNC path, and the sidebar terminal opens a real Linux pty inside the distribution for WSL sessions. A persistent zero-dependency agent running in the distro
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 WSL 工作区：侧栏 W 按钮列出发行版并把 Linux 目录注册为宿主工作区（以 UNC 路径表示），WSL 会话的侧栏终端在发行版内打开真实 Linux pty。发行版内常驻一个零依赖 agent，通过 JSON-lines 管道响应文件、shell 与搜索请求，空闲时没有轮询计时器触碰发行版，/mnt 盘符也保持可达；grep 与 glob 在发行版内调用自带的 ripgrep。附带 wsl-standard 等 WSL 孪生预设，替换 shell 与 fs 工具。本插件是 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace 的重写版，不能与上

items.de: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
items.dz: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

items.de: Search offline AI events around Wudaokou and Tsinghua, retrieve source pages, and keep local search history.
items.dz: 搜索五道口、清华附近的 AI 线下活动，读取来源页面并保存本地检索历史。

items.de: Adds a 无界画布 page to the DSH left sidebar with a bundled front-end, local workbench status/start, and DSH Agent tools that read and edit the open canvas; the canvas has no built-in Agent. Requires a local 无界工作台 installation with ComfyUI; the plugin bundles neither ComfyUI, CUDA, models nor API keys.
items.dz: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入无界画布页面：内置画布前端、本机工作台状态与启动，并让 DSH Agent 通过工具读写当前画布；画布不再内置 Agent。需本机已安装无界工作台与 ComfyUI；插件不打包 ComfyUI、CUDA、模型或 API Key。

items.de: Puts a WuwaTappo desktop pet's bubbles to work: shows the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and a per-turn cost bubble, and keeps an amber reminder bubble up while the agent waits for an answer or an approval. Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.
items.dz: 把 WuwaTappo 桌宠头顶的气泡用起来：显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用与每轮消耗，Agent 等待回答或授权时挂一个琥珀色常驻提醒气泡。通过 CDP 与桌宠通信，首次使用会给 WuwaTappo.exe 打一个可还原的等长字节补丁来开启调试端口。

items.de: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.
items.dz: 在 DSH 右边栏预览原生微信小程序，提供本地运行时与 WXML 源码定位。

items.de: An x_archive tool that turns an X (Twitter) post link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, and refresh forces a refetc
items.dz: x_archive 工具：把 X（Twitter）推文链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——图片转存不裂链、删帖后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度、带 PAT 可 refresh 强制重抓。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

items.de: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
items.dz: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

items.de: A credit meter for XD Pool (WorkBuddy) accounts that shows each account's remaining credits and package breakdown, measures today/month/all-time consumption from balance snapshots, and warns about credits expiring within 3, 7 and 30 days. It reads its data from the XD Pool plugin (XDTrees/dsh-xdpool
items.dz: XD Pool（WorkBuddy）积分计费面板：显示每个账号的剩余积分与积分包明细，按余额快照差值实测今日/本月/累计已消耗积分，并按 3/7/30 天分档预警即将过期积分。 数据来自 XD Pool 插件（XDTrees/dsh-xdpool）的本地路由，未安装该插件时面板显示「数据源不可用」，本插件不自行实现上游协议。

items.de: Adds a four-part reply-formatting contract to the system prompt, so every answer is laid out like a Xiaohongshu post: a conclusion-first hook, a star-rated comparison table, emoji-headed bullets with four to six concrete steps or numbers each, numbered sections grouped by entry threshold, images tha
items.dz: 把一份四段式回复规范注入系统提示词，让每条回答按小红书图文排：结论钩子开场、星级对比表、emoji 分点且每条写到 4-6 条可执行步骤或数值、按门槛分组的编号小节、配图逐张写图注并一图一来源链接，另附一份屏蔽称呼词、感叹烂词与营销话术的黑名单。代码、命令、路径与对外文档保持原格式。纯 host 侧静态提示词小节：无配置项、无前端 UI、无依赖。

items.de: Sakura theme, companion notifications (approval/job/answer), message read-aloud, and voice settings for the DSH web GUI.
items.dz: DSH Web 界面的樱花主题与陪伴功能：审批/任务/回答提醒、消息朗读、语音设置。

items.de: Knowledge-base browser panel: tree browsing plus drag-to-cite (path-only or full content) into the composer.
items.dz: 知识库浏览器面板：目录浏览，支持把节点拖进输入框生成引用（仅路径或附全文）。

items.de: Tree-shaped Markdown knowledge base for DSH agents: kb_list/kb_read/kb_write tools, tree/node HTTP routes, and a browser panel companion.
items.dz: 树状 Markdown 知识库：为 DSH Agent 提供 kb_list/kb_read/kb_write 工具、目录/正文 HTTP 接口，并配套浏览器面板。

items.de: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.
items.dz: 单文件持久陪伴记忆：把兴趣、偏好、任务与过往作品摘要注入系统提示词，提供读取与更新工具。

items.de: Daily rotating anime companion persona: deterministic date pick from JSON character cards, roster/reroll tools, and a voice-map route.
items.dz: 每日轮值二次元陪伴角色：按本地日期从 JSON 角色卡确定性选角，支持换角/重抽工具与 voice-map 路由。

items.de: Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.
items.dz: 把 Host 进程的 undici 请求统一路由到本地 HTTP(S) 代理，同时保持 localhost 与国内可达 API 直连。

items.de: Persistent persona memory for DSH with a unified recent, long-term and archive timeline, bounded context loading, memory retrieval and isolated task delegation.
items.dz: 为 DSH 提供持续人格记忆，统一短期、长期与归档时间线，支持有界上下文加载、记忆检索和独立任务委派。

items.de: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: XiaoShuang desktop pet for DSH: six-layer memory, persona injection, mood-driven video avatar, manual emotion menu, and TTS replies.
items.dz: 小双桌面宠物人格：六层记忆、人设注入、跟随 agent 状态的视频形象、手动表情菜单与 TTS 语音回复。

items.de: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
items.dz: 复用已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理（仅限 Windows），其模型直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 中，无需单独 API Key。
