items.de: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then
items.dz: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

items.de: Runs shell commands on machines you have paired with eXe, over its relay, and reads images back from them as image blocks for the model: three model tools (device list, shell, image — take a screenshot with the shell tool, then read the file), plus a sidebar page that shows the caller address of thi
items.dz: 在你已与 eXe 配对的机器上跑 shell，并把设备上的图片作为图片内容块交给模型，往返经 eXe 中继：三个模型工具（设备列表、shell、图片——截图需先用 shell 工具生成再读回），外加一页侧边栏——本机调用方地址、可改名的设备与受信调用方清单，以及按设备一键测量一次真实调用的往返耗时。那些机器上需运行 eXe 客户端，本机需有 `exe mcp init` 生成的调用方键。

items.de: A draggable square-cake mascot that runs while a turn is in progress, sleeps when it finishes, and gets angry on errors.
items.dz: 一只可拖拽的方糕萌宠：对话进行时奔跑、完成时睡觉、出错时生气。

items.de: A cosmic reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Off, Low, High, and Max each have their own starfield and aurora, with smooth cross-fades and real per-session model selection.
items.dz: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的推理强度滑轨做成一片小宇宙。Off、Low、High、Max 各有专属星场与极光，档位之间平滑过渡，并绑定真实的当前会话模型选择。

items.de: Deterministic, zero-LLM compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness: the checkpoint is compiled locally from the session log with no summarizing round-trip, and dropped tool traffic becomes seq reference lines the model can restore with recall, which helps on small context windows. Ships as two packages:
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性、零 LLM 压缩引擎：直接从会话日志在本地编出检查点，不走摘要往返；被丢弃的工具往返变成 seq 引用行，模型可用 recall 取回，对小上下文窗口尤其有用。由 dsh-fast-compact 与 dsh-fast-compact-preset 两个包组成：需都安装并加入 profile 的 bundles，再选「Fast Compact (standard)」预设并新开会话；要求 dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0。

items.de: Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.
items.dz: 工具流水线上的诚实性护栏：阻止编码 agent 弱化测试、吞掉错误、用桩替换类型检查或通过 shell 删除测试——九个确定性 hook，每个都配有植入失败的测试，证明该护栏确实会触发。

items.de: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
items.dz: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

items.de: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.
items.dz: 磁盘持久化的执行规划插件：以 .trail 目录承载里程碑/步骤状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要，提供 dsh 工具、CLI 与技能三种接口。

items.de: A draggable floating card for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that combines a Pomodoro timer, an off-work countdown, and focus statistics. Each launch opens on a fresh focus phase; phase completion triggers a chime, card shake, and particle burst. Includes today's pomodoros, focus minutes, streak and a
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness Web 的悬浮卡片，集成番茄钟、下班倒计时与专注统计。每次启动默认进入专注时段；阶段结束有提示音、卡片抖动与粒子动画。含今日番茄数、专注时长、连续天数与近 7 天柱状图，下班收尾与护眼节律提醒，并可选系统通知、标签页倒计时、自动开始下一阶段、+5 分钟与自定义长休轮数。

items.de: Foggy Java data-analysis integration for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Runtime, CLI, Launcher, onboarding Skills, and semantic-layer workflows.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 Foggy Java 数据分析 Runtime、CLI、Launcher 与 onboarding/语义查询 Skill，支持数据库接入和语义层建模。

items.de: Measures how much a short clip changed and when — changed-area share, displacement, cumulative drift — returning one labelled key-frame image plus the number behind each event; it does not pick shots for a storyboard. Needs Python 3.10+ with numpy and Pillow; reading mp4 also needs ffmpeg and ffprob
items.dz: 测量短片段里「变了多少、何时变」——变化面积占比、位移、累积漂移，返回一张标注代表帧与每个事件的数值；不做分镜选帧。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python 3.10+；读取 mp4 另需 PATH 中有 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe。

items.de: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a na
items.dz: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

items.de: Codex-style right-edge workspace for the dsh web UI: file tree with preview tabs (Markdown/source), an embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and a side chat streaming from the host LLM — all as switchable tabs in the native details column.
items.dz: Codex 式右侧工作区：文件树 + 预览页签（Markdown/源码）、嵌入式浏览器（直连/代理 iframe）、侧边聊天（直连 host LLM 流式对话），全部收敛为原生 details 右栏的页签，可开关多开。

items.de: Furina (Genshin Impact) theme for the DSH Web GUI: three palettes, switchable wallpapers, translucent glass, an in-Settings theme page, a themed startup splash and a replaceable Furina agent preset. Supports DSH 0.2.0–0.2.x (verified on 0.2.2).
items.dz: 《原神》芙宁娜主题：三套配色、可独立切换的壁纸、半透明玻璃，设置页内切换皮肤/壁纸/玻璃强度，并附带主题化启动动画与可替换的芙宁娜人格预设；适配 DSH 0.2.0–0.2.x（已在 0.2.2 实测）。

items.de: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects — spec, build, verify, ship, learn — with one artifact and one gate per phase, so an agent always knows the single next action. Role policy, project templates and deployment sit behind explicit ports: swap the implementation without rewriting th
items.dz: 面向 agent 工程的五阶段循环：规格、施工、验证、发布、收口，每个阶段一个产物、一道门，agent 每次只知道当前该做的一件事。角色策略、工程模板与部署方式都在显式端口后面，换实现不用改循环本身。版式生成器负责工程的内部结构：`init --layout {none,webapp,service,plugin} --stack {python,node,none}`，九层结构抽自三个互不相关的真实生产项目——入口文档、OpenSpec 计划面、spec 真值层（INDEX、一域一文件、TESTING、CONSTITUTION）、knowledge/progress/runbook 三分的

items.de: Windows-only game crash diagnosis from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps, with a diagnose_game_crash tool and an optional background notifier.
items.dz: 仅限 Windows：从事件日志、WER 报告和崩溃转储诊断游戏崩溃，提供 diagnose_game_crash 工具和可选的后台通知。

items.de: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).
items.dz: Gaussian 16 计算辅助插件：SMILES→3D 建模、输入生成、串行任务管理、输出解析，以及 Multiwfn/VMD 后处理（轨道/ESP/RDG 出图）。

items.de: Runs the agent through GEML workflows: work items move through flow steps, practices are recorded at the step they belong to, and a board tab in the right sidebar shows where each item stands. Also mounts the GEML MCP server and skills; when the project has a fixed workflow, a supervisor gates tool
items.dz: 用 GEML 流程带 agent 干活：工作项按流程一步步走，做法记在它所属的那一步，右侧栏的看板页签显示每件事走到哪了。同时挂上 GEML 的 MCP 服务和技能；项目里有固化流程时，监督器按流程当前状态把关工具调用。需要 Node.js 22+；GEML MCP 服务器在会话启动时经 npx（@geml/geml）获取。

items.de: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
items.dz: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

items.de: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
items.dz: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

items.de: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版和 Web 的 Saber（Fate）主题，提供冰蓝浅色、深色配色、每五分钟随机切换的 30 张按需加载聊天背景，以及右侧对话索引下方的任务关注浮层，兼容 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.2。

items.de: Audits and evolves agent context at four scopes: a single repository, a group of related repos, a knowledge hub, or the whole machine. Discovers projects, instruction files, skills, tools, knowledge, project state, evidence and credential references; reports drift, duplicate facts, broken pointers,
items.dz: 按四个层级审计与治理 agent 上下文：单个仓库、一组相关仓库、知识中枢、整台机器。发现项目、指令文件、技能、工具、知识、项目状态、证据与凭据引用；报告漂移、同一事实多个家、断链、正文里不可验证的裸路径、预算超限、未索引知识、过期状态与未登记凭据；每个层级只算属于它的维度；并把问题转成可复核的迁移计划，每个文件移动前先备份。指标背后的格式契约落成了版本化规范（CTX 规则、markdownlint 式稳定编号），并遵循开源惯例——指令文件用 AGENTS.md 标准、索引用 llms.txt 形态链接列表。还能生成一个刻意保持精简的 Hub，承载长期知识与项目状态。包含零依赖 Python

items.de: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.
items.dz: 把跑在本机的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 HarnessMate 平台：手机 / 浏览器即可对话、收发文件、审批工具调用。

items.de: System One decision runtime for dsh. Ships fast non-generative tools (choice, score, screen, gate) on a local or hosted System One gateway, and — without the model calling anything — prunes oversized tool output segment by segment, refuses repeated identical calls once System One confirms stagnation
items.dz: 面向 dsh 的 System One 决策运行时。提供不消耗生成 token 的快速工具（选择、评分、安全筛查、完成度核验），并在模型不调用任何工具的情况下自动干预：把超长工具输出逐段交给 System One 判定取舍后裁剪、在确认停滞时拒绝重复调用、用真实工具证据核验完成声明、对反复失败的重试给出纠正。npm 包为 dsh-harness-reflex（插件）与 harness-reflex（核心，同时是 stdio MCP server）。

items.de: Skill that reviews your coding-agent session transcripts (Claude Code and Codex only; DSH's own transcripts are not supported) over the last two weeks and reports which skills, hooks and rules work, need attention or go unused. Requires Python 3.
items.dz: 技能：回看最近两周的编程助手会话记录（仅 Claude Code 与 Codex，不支持 DSH 自身会话），报告哪些技能、钩子和规则有效、需要关注或从未使用。需要 Python 3。

items.de: Adeptus Mechanicus amber CRT skin for DeepSeek Harness, themed on Warhammer 40,000: a gear-and-skull emblem replaces the brand mark, the new-session slogan is written as a machine-cult verse, 14 theme tokens and 23 static palette entries are overridden, a monospace font stack covers the UI outside K
items.dz: 以《战锤 40,000》机械神教为灵感的琥珀 CRT 风格皮肤：以齿轮骷髅圣徽替代默认品牌标记，新会话口号改写为机械神教偈语，覆写 14 枚主题令牌与 23 枚静态调色板色值，在 KaTeX 公式之外统一全站等宽字体，叠加扫描线与屏幕暗角，并把模式选择器加长 10%。

items.de: Bidirectional bridge between Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness: dispatch_task with UI-visible sessions in the DSH sidebar, session mirroring, and 10 DSH-to-Hermes tools.
items.dz: Hermes Agent 与 DeepSeek Harness 的双向桥：派单任务以 UI 可见会话出现在 DSH 侧边栏，支持会话镜像与 10 个 DSH→Hermes 工具。

items.de: Imports skills from a local Hermes Agent installation into DSH. It scans the Hermes home directories and each profile below them, lists every skill with its description, file count and size, and copies a selected skill into the DSH global skills root or into one project, keeping the original folder
items.dz: 把本机 Hermes Agent 安装里的技能导入 DSH：扫描 Hermes 家目录及其下的各个 profile，列出每个技能的描述、文件数与体积，并把选中的技能复制到 DSH 全局 skills 目录或指定项目，目标目录名保持原样。只有 DSH 不接受的 frontmatter name 才会被改写，遇到同名技能必须先做选择才会写入，多个技能可以批量导入并给出逐项结果。

items.de: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
items.dz: 免密钥上网 MCP server：web_search、基于双 CDP Chrome 的 JS 渲染抓取（代理自动互备），以及 7 个隔离上下文真实浏览器 page_* 工具。

items.de: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
items.dz: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

items.de: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.
items.dz: DSH 插件管理系统：插件清单与 AI 用途解读、变更日志、更新提醒、一键升级、自动备份与回滚，附带崩溃恢复。

items.de: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
items.dz: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

items.de: IDEA-style Git workbench for the Web UI: commit graph with lanes and ref labels, log filters, commit details, split and unified diffs with per-hunk staging, a fine-grained zero-context mode, local changes with amend and sign-off, rename-following file history, per-line annotate, stash, branch operat
items.dz: IDEA 风格的 Git 工作台：提交图（泳道与引用标签）、日志筛选、提交详情、并排与统一差异、按 hunk 暂存、零上下文的细粒度模式、本地更改（含修补与 sign-off）、跟随重命名的文件历史、逐行注解、Stash、分支操作、比较、标签、交互式变基与冲突解决。按活跃会话盖上 Assisted-by trailer 记录提交由哪个模型产生，并把已有的 trailer 渲染成标签，让 AI 参与的历史可追溯。

items.de: Configurable, provider-agnostic image generation: mounts the bundled MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__image_generation__image_generate and mcp__image_generation__image_config_status, and registers the bundled image-generation skill. Needs baseUrl and apiKey; without them the MCP server mou
items.dz: 可配置、与供应商无关的图片生成:把随插件分发的 MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,提供 mcp__image_generation__image_generate 与 mcp__image_generation__image_config_status,并注册 image-generation 技能。需要配置 baseUrl 与 apiKey，否则 MCP 服务器不会挂载。

items.de: Search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse for real photos, download them, and verify provenance, magic bytes and dimensions before they reach your agent.
items.dz: 在 Wikimedia Commons 与 Openverse 搜索真实照片，下载后校验来源、魔数与尺寸，再交给 Agent 使用。

items.de: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
items.dz: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

items.de: Per-Bot memory for Tobs Bots (requires DeepSeek Harness with @botharness/core; it ships off with no Bots listed, and after you list a Bot and set mode to on it works with no other service): a read-only local full-text index of that Bot's own past conversations (Chinese words found inside sentences),
items.dz: 给 Tobs Bot 的按 Bot 隔离的记忆（需带 @botharness/core 的 DeepSeek Harness；插件默认关闭、不列任何 Bot，在配置里列出 Bot 并把 mode 设为 on 后无需其它服务）：只读地把该 Bot 自己的历史对话建成本地全文索引（中文词在整句里也能搜到），可导入从别的 AI 工具继承来的记忆，带状态工具、可选的自动召回（只在真人发言时）和给其他插件用的接口。安装时还可以选更立体的后端（先报价、每天有上限）：公开的事实库（memv2 精简版）、Graphiti 官方图谱，或两个一起，都从 Bot 自己的对话里抽取。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Jimu (积木): domain-based orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — domain_plan confirmation, per-domain sub-agents with hand-off, and automatic LLM audit.
items.dz: 积木：DSH 分域编排插件，domain_plan 分域确认 + 按域编排子代理（手递手）+ LLM 自动审计。

items.de: Registers the justSkill design skill in DSH, adds a workbench that lists design files across workspaces, and opens a file's live canvas in the session's right sidebar. The agent edits a validated HTML file one operation at a time while the user reviews and adjusts on the canvas.
items.dz: 在 DSH 中注册 justSkill 设计技能，提供跨工作区的设计文件工作台，并在会话右侧栏打开实时画布：Agent 逐条修改受校验的 HTML 文件，用户在画布上审阅调整。

items.de: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
items.dz: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

items.de: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

items.de: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 飞书桥（衍生自 dsh-im-bridge）：长连接免公网、审批卡片、群聊仅 @ 回复、流式卡片打字机回显、/stop 中断任务。

items.de: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says when a rule is drawn by a package rather than by the body, which is where naive locating is wrong), diffs a page against the previous build so

items.de: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
items.dz: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

items.de: Manages game automation scripts from dsh on Windows. Installs and updates scripts such as MAA, runs them in scheduled pipelines, watches their logs and hands failures and stalls to an agent, and tracks game events.
items.dz: 在 dsh 里管理游戏自动化脚本（仅 Windows）：安装和更新 MAA 等脚本，按定时流水线运行，监看日志并把出错和卡住交给 agent 处理，还会记录游戏活动。

items.de: Drive the NI Multisim 14.3 install on a Windows machine through nine msim_* tools: open and save .ms14 designs, read and edit component values and circuit parameters, run DC operating point, AC sweep, single-frequency AC and transient analyses, export schematics, BOM and netlists. A Win32 channel dr
items.dz: 在 Windows 上把本机的 NI Multisim 14.3 变成可编程对象：九个 msim_* 工具可开关 .ms14 设计、读写元件值与电路参数、跑直流工作点/交流扫频/单频交流/瞬态分析、导出原理图与 BOM/网表；Win32 通道驱动可见窗口操作分析对话框并截取 Multisim 自己的电路视图与波形图；SPICE 命令文件引擎处理没有探针的设计；离线解析器完全不启动 Multisim 就能读出 .ms14 内容。需要 Windows、NI Multisim 14.3，以及装好 pywin32 的 32 位 Python 3.11-3.13。

items.de: Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.
items.dz: Windows NapCat部署指南与本机端口只读检查，附用户手动运行的管理员启动入口。

items.de: Right-click a sent message to edit or withdraw it. The running answer is stopped first, then that message and everything after it are replaced in the conversation: withdrawing leaves a short withdrawn marker and stops there, while editing asks the model again with the new text.
items.dz: 右键已发出的消息即可修改或撤回：先停住正在生成的回答，再把这条消息及其之后的内容替换掉——撤回只留下一条「已撤回」标记并就此停下，修改则按新正文重新提问。

items.de: Illustrated desk theme with an adjustable desk lamp (warm, white or rainbow light, beam size), plants, and pets, including a cat that tucks away beside the composer and a sleeping Westie on the new-session screen.
items.dz: 插画风桌面主题：可调节的台灯（暖光、白光、彩虹光，光束大小）、绿植与宠物，含可收进输入框旁的猫和新会话页上睡着的西高地。

items.de: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
items.dz: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and
items.dz: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

items.de: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permi
items.dz: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

items.de: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when th
items.dz: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

items.de: Deliver-and-align mode: the agent hands over one block at a time through an align_deliver tool, each block lands on disk immediately so you can edit it in place, and the agent re-reads your version before continuing.
items.dz: 交付对齐模式：AI 通过 align_deliver 工具一次只交付一块，每块直接落盘、你可以就地在文件里改，AI 重读你的版本后再继续；方向错了可带时间戳备份安全返工。

items.de: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: eleven specialist roles usable as one-shot consults or as team members, a team plane with a plan, a shared board and a dependency graph, a durable workmate library, a memory engine, and a verification plane that refuses a PASS unless a different agent records the ve
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件包：十一个专家角色，可作单次咨询或团队成员；团队平面带计划、共享看板与依赖图；另有可长期积累的 Workmate 库、记忆引擎，以及一个验证平面——除非由另一个 agent 带上 gate 证据记录裁决，否则拒绝 PASS。以单个包加 dsh.bundle 补丁安装，同时提供原生 dshGo 面板接口与钉在 dsh-Go 协议 v1 规范提交 d5ad25c 的一致性检查。

items.de: A 3D poker roguelike opened from a DSH session: pick 1–5 cards to score chips × mult, with 20 jokers, 6 antes of small/big/boss blinds and a shop between rounds.
items.dz: 从 DSH 会话打开的 3D 扑克 Roguelike：每手选 1–5 张牌按筹码 × 倍率计分，20 种小丑牌、6 层底注与小/大/BOSS 盲注，过关后进商店。

items.de: A single-window video editing workbench opened from a DSH session: multi-video import, magnetic timeline with trimming and skimming, audio roles with ducking, local silence-detection rough cut, script-based captions, nine color looks, and MP4 export (WebM where the browser cannot record MP4).
items.dz: 从 DSH 会话进入的单窗口视频剪辑工作台：多视频导入、磁吸时间线修剪与掠视、音频角色和自动闪避、本地静音检测粗剪、脚本字幕、9 种调色与 MP4 导出（浏览器不支持 MP4 录制时回退 WebM）。

items.de: ✨ One-click prompt polisher for the DSH composer — an agent refines your rough draft in a side chat over multiple turns, and you copy the result back when you're happy.
items.dz: DSH 主输入框旁的 ✨ 一键提示词打磨：点击后 Agent 在侧边对话多轮改写草稿，你满意后再手动回填。

items.de: Derived from WolfGenerals/ncm-player (ncm-player4 1.3.1 lineage, baseline published on the repo's baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 branch); cannot be enabled together with ncm-player2/3/4, because they all register the /ncm/api prefix. Floating NetEase Cloud Music player in the DSH web UI: search, playlis
items.dz: 衍生自 WolfGenerals/ncm-player（ncm-player4 1.3.1 一系，基线源码公开在仓库的 baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 分支）；不能与 ncm-player2/3/4 同时启用，它们都占用 /ncm/api 前缀。DSH Web 界面里的网易云音乐浮窗播放器：搜索、歌单、专辑、逐行同步歌词与翻译、队列持久化，可收起为迷你条，右下角音符按钮可拖动并随低频鼓点跳动；无版权或已下架的歌曲会自动跳过并播放下一首。

items.de: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two
items.dz: 本地表情包库：从文件、文件夹或工具导入，在待识别队列里由你确认后才打标签，分组管理，再让 agent 按情绪检索发图。功能设计参考 Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers，代码自写、工具名不同，可与上游并存。

items.de: Task-completion notifications: desktop alerts via macOS Notification Center and Windows Toast, plus mobile push through Bark, ntfy, ServerChan or any webhook when an agent run goes idle, errors or blocks.
items.dz: 任务完成通知推送：代理转入空闲、出错或阻塞时，经 macOS 通知中心、Windows Toast 及 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、通用 Webhook 发送系统通知。

items.de: Run AI commands in real NyaTerm terminal sessions, reusing saved groups, jump hosts and local terminals, with a per-workspace allowlist; commands stay visible and auditable in NyaTerm.
items.dz: 在 NyaTerm 的真实终端会话里执行 AI 命令，复用已配置的分组、跳板机和本地终端，按工作区限制可用范围；命令与输出留在 NyaTerm 中，便于查看和审计。

items.de: Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.
items.dz: 整个应用背景铺设动态海浪特效，一条鲸鱼在页面后面游泳，界面各层变为半透明。

items.de: Adds an `ocsr` skill and an `ocsr_dispatch` tool that run headless `opencode run` as fresh-context, cross-vendor worker backends, with a Python driver for watchdog timeouts and per-worker output files. Windows only (Windows PowerShell): requires the OpenCode CLI, Python 3 and a model allowlist at `~
items.dz: 提供 `ocsr` 技能与 `ocsr_dispatch` 工具，把 headless `opencode run` 当作 fresh-context、跨厂商的 worker 后端；超时看门狗与每 worker 产物文件由 Python driver 负责。仅支持 Windows（需 Windows PowerShell）；需本机安装 OpenCode CLI、Python 3，并在 `~/.ocsr/allowed-models.json` 配置模型白名单。

items.de: Agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness with eleven selectable presets, planning, delegation, review gates and durable project state.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排插件：11 个可选 preset、规划、委派、评审门与 .omd 持久状态。

items.de: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
items.dz: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: Realtime ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness, rebuilt from d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7 under MIT. Wave height follows the live session load, the sky comes from a local NOAA ephemeris, the star field is a real 2851-star HYG subset with 88 constellations, one boat per running subagent, plus a searchable
items.dz: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的实时海洋皮肤，基于 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7（MIT）重新构建。浪高跟随会话负载，天色来自本地 NOAA 星历，星空是 2851 颗真实恒星的 HYG 子集与 88 个星座，每个运行中的子智能体一艘船，另有可搜索的 11 组设置面板与三档画质。已以 open-sea-skin-dsh 发布到 npm；bundle id 仍与上游相同，安装前须先卸载 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin，两者不能同时安装。

items.de: Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.
items.dz: 给不具备多模态能力的模型一双眼睛:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image,把图片交给 StepFun step-3.7-flash 并返回详细描述。

items.de: Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.
items.dz: 走 NVIDIA NIM 的视觉能力:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image,用 7 个托管视觉模型之一(默认 MiniMax-M3)描述图片,并支持多 Key 轮换。

items.de: Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.
items.dz: 本地 OCR,不把文件发到云端:把 PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP 服务器(PaddleOCR + ONNX Runtime CPU)挂成 mcp__ppocr__ocr_image 与 mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf,识别图片和多页 PDF。

items.de: Image generation through TokenRhythm: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python stdio MCP server as mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image, producing images with qwen-image-2.0 or wan2.7-image and saving them to a directory you choose. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY.
items.dz: 用 TokenRhythm 生成图片:把无 npm 依赖的 Python stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image,用 qwen-image-2.0 或 wan2.7-image 生成并存到你指定的目录。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY。

items.de: Full-screen boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: a wave sweeps the screen, a whale assembles from particles inside three breathing dot rings, and a four-language salute lands over a segmented progress bar; ships an 18-second cut and 3.8-4.5-second short cuts, a language picker in settings, and a fou
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画：水波扫过、粒子聚成鲸鱼、三层呼吸点阵圆环与四语问候落在分段进度条上；含 18 秒完整版与 3.8-4.5 秒简版、设置页语言选择与四语连播预览。

items.de: Paste an article link to get a structure mind map, bolded key points, a section-by-section reading and a written critique, keep any sentence as a draggable polaroid note, and copy the whole reading as Notion-ready Markdown; the interface and every digest can switch between Simplified Chinese, Tradit
items.dz: 贴一个链接，把文章读成结构导图、加粗要点、逐段精读与读后评论；任意一句可收成拍立得便签（可拖动、缩放、改字），全文可一键复制成 Notion 版，简/繁/英三种语言可随时切换。导图图片依赖本机 Edge/Chrome，Windows、macOS、Linux 都会自动识别（装在别处可设环境变量 DSH_MINDMAP_BROWSER），不影响其余功能。

items.de: Evidence-aware research writing skills for DeepSeek Harness: academic paper revision against supplied experiment records and references, rebuttal preparation, and presentation storyboarding, each with bundled Python tools that package the evidence and check the edits locally.
items.dz: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的科研写作技能包：依据提供的实验记录与文献修订论文、准备逐条 rebuttal、生成汇报 storyboard；每个技能内置 Python 工具，用于打包证据并在本地校验修改。

items.de: Format checker for theses and lab reports: verifies body font size, first-line indent, line spacing, Chinese font, header student ID and name, page margins, and figure/table caption numbering against a JSON rules preset, then reports each problem with its paragraph location and the concrete fix. Rea
items.dz: 论文 / 实验报告格式体检：对照 JSON 规则预设核验正文字号、首行缩进、行距、中文字体、页眉学号姓名、页边距、图题表题编号，逐条给出段落定位与具体修法。只读、零依赖（纯 Python 标准库），实际执行的检查项为 0 时拒绝判通过。需要 PATH 中有 Python 3.8 或更高版本。

items.de: Lightweight rule-based tools for street-level industry ecosystem work (party-building scenario): format enterprise profile cards, match supply and demand by category and quantity, normalize policy record fields (no raw-text parsing), and map grievance priority to an assignee role and estimated days.
items.dz: 面向党建引领街道产业生态场景的轻量规则工具：生成企业画像卡片、按品类与数量匹配供需、规整政策记录字段（不解析原文）、按优先级给出诉求处理人角色与预计天数；不调用任何外部系统。

items.de: Retro pixel CRT overlay for DSH showing the DeepSeek account balance and live token usage.
items.dz: 复古像素 CRT 的 DSH 浮层，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与 Token 用量。

items.de: Pixel Whale: a hand-drawn pixel-art whale pet swimming in a small aquarium in your DSH sidebar. It cruises around, bobs, blinks and blows pixel bubbles; click the water to drop food and watch it swim over to eat (pixel hearts), click the whale to pet it. Pure client-side, zero network, zero config.
items.dz: 像素小鲸鱼桌宠：DSH 侧边栏的小水族箱里住着一只手绘像素鲸鱼，自主巡游、眨眼、吐像素泡泡；点水面投食它会游过去吃掉（冒像素爱心），点它摸摸会开心摇摆。纯前端、零网络、零配置。

items.de: A mandatory 7-step plan on every request, each step with a binary acceptance criterion, executed through worker subagents and validated by independent memoryless verifier subagents that report PASS or FAIL with evidence.
items.dz: 每个请求都必须走完 7 步计划,每步都有可判定的验收标准,执行交给 worker 子代理,完成情况由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理带证据判定 PASS / FAIL。

items.de: A plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: install, update and enable DSH plugins, aggregate plugin index sources, and install from a git branch. Also publishes a subscribable format-1 plugin index.
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：安装、更新与启停 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的格式 1 插件索引。

items.de: Files the settings entries your installed plugins add below the ones dsh ships, behind a divider with a live count, and keeps up automatically as plugins come and go.
items.dz: 把已安装插件添加的设置入口统一收纳到 dsh 自带设置的下方，用带计数的分割线分区，插件增减时自动更新。

items.de: Provides a PMNote skill for finding public resources on game project management, careers, and AI tools.
items.dz: 提供 PMNote 技能，查阅游戏项目管理、职业发展和 AI 工具的公开资料。

items.de: Adds a local phone pairing, gateway control, and diagnostic panel for Pocket Bridge in DSH Settings.
items.dz: 在 DSH 设置里为 Pocket Bridge 提供本机手机配对、网关控制与诊断面板。
rl: uses literal IP 2.5.4.10 for network access

items.de: Pocket Harness: the phone side of DSH. Continue the same DSH session from your phone, with the same history, projects, goal, queue and pending questions, connected over your LAN, your own domain or a relay you run (no author-run server, no account). Needs the Android companion app (APK from the repo
items.dz: Pocket Harness：DSH 的手机端。在手机上接着用电脑里的同一份 DSH——同一条会话、历史、项目、目标、队列和待确认提问，可经局域网、自建域名或自建中转连接（不经作者服务器、无需账号）。需要配套的 Android App（仓库 Releases 里的 APK），扫码配对；可选的像素鲸鱼娘桌宠会听会说，神经语音与本机识别也是可选件。原名 dsh-pet-voice。

items.de: A personal-agent community with a desktop companion and owner-approved social actions. Needs a Podwhale community account token to connect (without one it is a read-only local demo); built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
items.dz: 个人 Agent 协作社区，提供桌宠聊天、阅读社交和主人审批。需要鲸群社区账号的受限 AI 令牌才能连接（未连接时仅为只读本地演示）；按 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 构建。

items.de: PortWrench panel for DSH: view local listening ports, see which app owns each one, and close the target process tree. Requires PortWrench (Windows) to be installed and running.
items.dz: 在 DSH 内嵌端口扳手面板：查看本机监听端口、识别归属、关闭目标进程树。需先安装并运行 PortWrench（Windows）。

items.de: Give it one URL and it traces the whole chain itself — DNS, reverse proxy, upstream, container, host and dependencies — then reports a root cause with evidence, so incident triage and routine operations run without anyone reciting where the machines or logs are. items.dz: 把需要你处理的会话收进网页端侧栏底部的一块坞：正在跑的、卡在等你审批 / 计划待审 / 等待回答的，以及跑完但结果还没打开过的。按最近更新时间排序，点一行就把主视图切过去；复用官方 useSessions 与 useSessionStatus 两个 Hook，不新增数据源、不轮询、不落盘、不改任何会话。头部状态点在有会话运行或等待时脉冲，只剩「已完成」提醒时收成静止圆点；没有这类会话时收成一行细字，侧栏折叠成 56px 时换成 36px 计数圆片而不是摊开列表。坞注册在侧栏底部动作区，是布局里的真实一块、不盖住对话列表，原有底部入口照旧排在它下面。

items.de: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.
items.dz: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

items.de: Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.
items.dz: 樱色午后主题皮肤：浅色/深色各配一套柔和的樱色令牌配色，全屏飘落樱瓣与柔光晕（点击穿透），会话头部的樱瓣开关与「通用设置」里的皮肤总开关。

items.de: Cost display for AiSpot (sapi) relays: crawls the provider's group list from its public pricing endpoints instead of hardcoding it, lets you pick the active group from a dropdown in the conversation header, and shows a per-turn cost at the end of each turn plus a session total that recurses through
items.dz: AiSpot（sapi）中转站的费用显示插件：从供应商的公开价格端点动态爬取分组列表而非硬编码，在会话标题栏的下拉框里选择当前分组，在每轮对话结束处显示本轮费用，并在标题栏显示递归合计所有子代理子树的会话总额。切换分组会即时重算全部历史金额，因为宿主只发布 token 桶、由浏览器按实时价目表计价。

items.de: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill creators. Needs git, bash and python3, and network access to gitcode.com (the creators and reference data are pulled from there); the creator ru
items.dz: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

items.de: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
items.dz: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

items.de: Measures one university department's research output: matches author affiliation strings against a college's known name variants (detecting same-named departments at other universities), backfills papers that only name the university by faculty author IDs, classifies each paper by journal tier (CAS
items.dz: 统计某一所大学某个学院（二级单位）的科研产出：按作者单位串匹配学院的各种英文写法（并检测其他高校的同名院系），对只写到校名一级的论文用教师作者 ID 反查补全，再按期刊层级分类（中科院分区含 Top 标记、JCR 分区、CCF、经知网导出合并的中文核心），区分教师与学生一作，输出含看板页、可筛选论文清单、教师-方向矩阵和教师个人统计的工作簿。学生身份由单位与教师名单推定，未与学籍核对。需 Python 3.9+ 与 pandas、openpyxl（pip install -r requirements.txt）；题录走 OpenAlex 接口（按 IP 计的免费额度有限），中文期刊需人工从知网

items.de: Native DSH plugin that renders structured data as inline charts directly inside the conversation, with zero runtime dependencies.
items.dz: 原生 DSH 插件：把结构化数据渲染成对话流内联图表，零运行时依赖。

items.de: Memory center for sedimem, a local cross-client memory layer: one sidebar entry opens the read-only observer as a full page — today's changes, a hand-rotatable 3D memory graph, and 30-day hygiene trends, with a scope picker. The host reuses an already-running observer when observerUrl points at one
items.dz: sedimem 记忆中心：把本地跨客户端记忆层 sedimem 的只读观察台装进 DSH——侧边栏一行进入中列整页（今日变化 / 可手转 3D 记忆图谱 / 卫生趋势三页，可切分库）。宿主优先复用已在运行的观察台（observerUrl 指向即纯代理、零新进程），探测不到才 spawn 内嵌副本兜底，数据始终是同一份 ~/.memo；只读、仅回环，路由再叠一层防跨站栅栏。记忆写入链路（MCP memory_* 工具）与 DSH/Codex/Claude Code 三端共用配置不受影响。零依赖。

items.de: Publish an HTML document as a shareable link that opens in one tap and previews as a card in chat apps; publish, update, and export to PNG/PDF/Word.
items.dz: 把 HTML 文档变成一键打开、在聊天里显示预览卡的分享链接;支持发布、更新,以及导出 PNG/PDF/Word。

items.de: Session-specific sticky cards with optional, explicitly authorized agent follow-ups. Targets the DSH desktop/web profile (protocol 0.2.2-rc.1); installed from GitHub.
items.dz: 会话专属便签卡片，可选择明确授权智能体按顺序处理便签。面向 DSH 桌面/Web 配置（协议 0.2.2-rc.1），从 GitHub 安装。

items.de: Local Qimen business-timing workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with nine palaces, deterministic scoring, future-window ranking, and direction advice.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中本地完成奇门排盘、商务评分、未来择时和方位建议。

items.de: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/Dee
items.dz: DSH 桌宠「深深」：跟随任务状态切换待机/敲键盘/思考/庆祝/失败，支持点击挥手、拖动左右奔跑，并保留 API 余额、本机用量记账、角色、气泡与音效设置。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）；请勿与上游同时安装，否则会出现双角色与重复请求。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: DSH host bundle for the ShyPie privacy-first workflow: extracts attached images and PDF/Office files locally before they enter the session log (requires poppler pdftotext/pdftoppm on PATH and a local OCR engine — Windows OCR on Windows, optionally tesseract; without them attachments are rejected, no
items.dz: 面向 ShyPie 隐私优先工作流的 DSH 主机插件：在写入会话日志前本地提取附件图片及 PDF/Office 文件（需 PATH 中有 poppler 的 pdftotext/pdftoppm 和本地 OCR 引擎，Windows 用系统 OCR、可选 tesseract；缺少时附件会被拒绝而不是转发）；默认 filter 模式保留本地文本（可选用本地掩码）；阻断无法掩码的媒体/BLOB；提供本地 privacy_extract、privacy_ocr、privacy_scan、privacy_rehydrate 工具；拒绝 read_image 及 allowPaths 之外的二进制/文

items.de: Strict verification for every task: plan 2-7 steps, execute them with worker subagents, verify each deliverable with an independent memoryless verifier subagent, and fix in at most three cycles before reporting honestly.
items.dz: 给每个任务加上严格验证:把任务拆成 2-7 步,用 worker 子代理执行,每个交付物都由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理验证,最多修 3 轮后如实汇报。

items.de: Rejects foreground waiting in DSH agents: waiting commands (sleep, wait, tail -f, watch, ping without -c, infinite loops), blocking wait tools (wait_agent, job_output with wait: true), progress polling (the same check command repeated within a window) and commands that need human input/confirmation
items.dz: 禁止 Agent 前台等待：sleep / wait / tail -f / watch / ping 等等待型命令、wait_agent 与 job_output(wait) 等阻塞等待工具，用反复 check 代替等待的轮询（同一条命令在窗口内重复出现），以及需要人输入/确认的命令（sudo 不加 -n、ssh 不开 BatchMode、登录流程、交互式编辑器、docker -it）都会被拒绝，并给出改用后台作业或结束本轮等唤醒的可执行指令；等待预算与轮询窗口可配、文案跟随系统语言（中/英）、零运行时依赖。

items.de: Slumber Pavilion physically moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into ~/DSH-Archive, and ships archive, read, restore and delete tools for them.
items.dz: 沉眠阁把 DSH 里已归档会话的日志与投影记录真正搬出加载路径，并提供归档、读取、还原、删除会话的工具。

items.de: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
items.dz: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

items.de: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s o
items.dz: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

items.de: Bundles 61 specialist workflows and a Chief of Staff coordinator in one plugin, with local intake, delivery, recovery, and evidence tools.
items.dz: 把 61 套专家工作流与一个 Chief of Staff 协调器打包成一个插件，内置本地需求受理、交付、返工与证据工具。

items.de: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-clic
items.dz: DSH 网页界面的代码管理面板，五步搞定 Git 日常：① 环境检查自动检测 git/gh/ssh，缺工具一键安装（gh 支持镜像下载源加速，Windows 也可用）并带检查更新；② SSH ed25519 密钥生成/连接测试 + 一键写 443 配置绕过 22 端口封锁，Gitee 私人令牌在此配置；③ 查看仓库状态、并排 diff、暂存提交、切换分支、查看/回滚历史，一键新建仓库并推送，自动忽略超 100MB 文件；④ 列出账号名下所有远程仓库一键克隆；⑤ 五步发布 npm 包。支持 GitHub / Gitee 双平台，界面中英文跟随 DSH 设置实时切换。

items.de: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.
items.dz: 把托管的 SpecStream MCP 服务器注册到 harness 的 MCP 管理器，并把 API Key 存入凭据库。该服务器以结构化行返回实时网页数据，每个值都附来源 URL；只有报价上限获批后才会开始运行。

items.de: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite storage, automatic extraction, semantic recall, corrections, reliable forgetting, and an in-app summary dialog.

items.de: Image generation and editing with configurable APIs, reference images, and an on-demand annotation canvas. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible image API endpoint and key.

items.de: Stock research tools for US, China A-share and Hong Kong stocks via the stockproof MCP server (Python 3.10+; install with pip install "stockproof\[mcp,cn]" — A-share/HK data needs Python 3.11+): news, earnings and announcement reads with cited sources, explanations of price moves, a whole-market A-s
items.dz: 通过 stockproof MCP 服务（Python 3.10+，需先 pip install "stockproof\[mcp,cn]"；A 股/港股数据需 Python 3.11+）为 DSH 提供美股、A 股、港股研究工具：带出处的新闻、财报和公告解读，涨跌原因解释，全市场 A 股选股，用不偷看未来的历史数据回测想法的量化实验室（近两年数据锁定），持仓体检和本地网页看板；共 23 个工具。

items.de: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
items.dz: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

A top-level model drafts a decomposition plan — subtasks, the model for each, an acceptance figure with tolerance, and dependency order — and dispatches only after the user confirms that plan; each subtask then goes to a lightweight ex

items.de: Provides 15 Superpowers skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering test-driven development, debugging, planning, and code review.

items.dz: 接入 Tabby 串口 MCP 桥接服务并注册 tabby-serial 技能：agent 可以列出、新建、读写 Tabby 里已经打开的串口，同时你还能在同一个终端里继续敲键盘。需要在 Tabby 里安装 tabby-serial-mcp 插件。

items.de: Seven shared engineering skills, a read-only project dashboard with amendments, options, stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.
items.dz: 七个共享工程技能、支持修正里程碑、可选项、阶段及 SQLite 审计浏览的只读项目仪表盘，以及 DSH 工作流请求预览。

items.de: Skill for building a game design brief into a playable, publishable TapTap Maker project: it picks the browser workspace or local MCP route, extracts the five elements of the brief, writes a first-round prompt for a minimal core loop, iterates in the official order, checks preview and release materi

items.de: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea pool, and daily/weekly/monthly reviews that only a human can write.
items.dz: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

items.de: Agent-team task workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar board and requirement view track tasks across backlog, execution, review and done, dispatch work to coding agents, and run multi-role team orchestration on a local SQLite store.

items.de: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
items.dz: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

Chinese replies introduce English technical terms with Chinese definitions on first mention, then reuse the English names within the same reply. items.de: Runs a shell command on your machine from the chat box with !cmd or /sh cmd, without sending a model request. The output comes back as your message plus a terminal card with the exit code, run time and a Copy button. While a ! line is typed, a menu offers zsh completions from your own fpath and matc
items.dz: 在聊天框用 !命令 或 /sh 命令 直接在本机运行 shell 命令，不发起模型请求。输出以你的消息加一张终端卡片显示，含退出码、耗时和复制按钮。输入 ! 行时弹出菜单，提供基于你自己 fpath 的 zsh 补全和 shell 历史中的匹配命令。命令以登录 shell 在会话目录中运行，不经过 agent 沙箱，默认超时 120 秒。

items.de: Turns scattered thinking notes into a growing constellation of themes, claims, relations and open questions, plus a written synthesis of the argument.
items.dz: 把零散的思想片段编织成一张会生长的星图：主题、观点、关系与待补充的问题，并生成一份论证总结。

items.de: Tracks token usage and estimated costs for every model call, with daily charts, session and workspace names, provider balances, budgets, and secret-free CSV/JSON exports.
items.dz: 统计本机每次模型调用的 token 用量与预估费用，提供每日图表、会话/工作区名称、账户余额、预算与无凭据 CSV/JSON 导出。
rl: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

items.de: TransProof translation proofreader for DeepSeek Harness: full web UI (AI translation needs your own model API key or a local Ollama endpoint) plus a local, non-networked run-local-check agent tool.
items.dz: 译校助手 TransProof 的 DSH 插件：内置完整网页界面，支持 AI 翻译（需自备模型 API Key 或本地 Ollama 端点）、三段流水线校对、术语与专名核验、批量体检改错与一键交付报告；网页版与插件内置同一套界面，另提供一个不联网、不调模型的本地体检 Agent 工具。
rl: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

items.de: Adds the real CNY cost of each assistant turn, plus today's running total, after the timestamp in DeepSeek Harness's completed-turn footer. Amounts are folded from the session log's usage with a local price table - no billing API, no network call, no extra tokens.
